data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
About Us

At Actioneer, we're building a voice-first customer engagement platform to help enterprises provide intuitive, consumer-grade experiences for their customers. Our suite is designed for cheaply querying enterprise data, detecting bots, and resolving customer queries. We work best in customer journeys where there's multiple parties, and complex documents (think insurance purchase, auto-lending, RFIs etc. )

We're a small, well-capitalized team backed by investors like South Park Commons, Z47, Bitkraft and Sony Ventures. We believe everyone is an IC, and we're in a once-in-a-lifetime moment where all of us have the leverage to punch far above our weight. 

About The Role

We're hiring an experienced Software Engineer to join our engineering team. You'll own features end to end, from prototyping and design to implementation and production. The typical problems we work on revolve around AI agents, data infrastructure, and building products that solve real business problems. You'll work directly with the founders, move quickly from ideas to production, and take ownership of the outcomes of what you build. 

What You'll Own

- Build and ship product features end to end, working across frontend, backend, and AI agents
 - Design and implement scalable systems that support complex enterprise workflows
 - Work closely with sales/product to understand problems, prototype solutions, and iterate based on feedback
 - Build and improve AI agents, including tool integrations, evaluations, and production monitoring
 - Leverage AI coding tools to accelerate development and ship high-quality software faster
 - Own features beyond deployment, measuring performance and continuously improving them

Key Qualifications

- 5+ years in software engineering with experience having worked on production systems at scale
 - Bias for action; Able to quickly ship a v1 and iterate from there
 - Strong experience with distributed systems and event-driven architectures
 - Comfortable working across the stack and picking up new technologies as needed
 - Strong product orientation, with the ability to translate business problems into technical solutions

What we look for

- Strong bias for measuring and improving system performance
 - OCD about personal productivity and AI-agent setup 
 - Ability to break problems down from first-principles and interest in tackling problems across the stack

data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Mobile Automation Tester_SSE based in India. 

We are seeking an experienced QA Automation Engineer to strengthen software quality through reliable, scalable, and efficient automated testing solutions. In this role, you will design and maintain automation scripts, build testing frameworks, and support continuous testing across web applications. You will work primarily with Cypress, JavaScript, SQL, and CI/CD pipelines to validate application functionality, performance, and stability. Collaborating closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders, you will help identify defects early and support smooth, high-quality releases. You will also contribute to regression testing, cross-browser compatibility, and backend data validation. This opportunity is suited to a detail-oriented professional who thrives in a collaborative, quality-focused environment and can work independently in a remote setting. 

Accountabilities

- Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using the Cypress framework. 
 - Build, enhance, and maintain scalable automation frameworks to improve test coverage, efficiency, and reliability. 
 - Perform functional, integration, and regression testing for web applications, including PHP-based applications. 
 - Conduct cross-browser testing to verify application compatibility, functionality, and stability across supported browsers. 
 - Identify, document, track, and troubleshoot defects, collaborating with development teams to ensure timely resolution. 
 - Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines, using Jenkins where applicable, to support continuous testing and reliable software delivery. 
 - Execute SQL queries to validate backend data, verify application behavior, and investigate discrepancies. 
 - Work in Linux environments and perform basic command-line operations to support testing and troubleshooting activities. 
 - Collaborate with developers, product managers, and cross-functional stakeholders to assess release readiness and resolve quality issues. 
 - Contribute to improvements in test coverage, automation practices, and quality assurance processes. 

Requirements

- 5-7 years of experience in quality assurance, with a strong focus on automation testing. 
 - Hands-on experience with the Cypress automation framework and the ability to develop and maintain automated test scripts. 
 - Strong proficiency in JavaScript for test automation and scripting. 
 - Experience working in Linux environments, including familiarity with basic command-line operations. 
 - Knowledge of CI/CD tools and continuous testing practices; experience with Jenkins is preferred. 
 - Basic to intermediate understanding of SQL for backend data validation and testing. 
 - Experience testing web applications, including functional, integration, regression, and cross-browser testing. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a commitment to software quality. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across technical and business teams. 
 - Ability to take ownership of testing activities, manage priorities, and work independently in a remote environment. 
 - A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 
 - Preferred: Experience with API testing tools such as Postman or similar platforms. 
 - Preferred: Exposure to additional automation frameworks and tools, including Playwright or Selenium. 
 - Preferred: Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and cloud-based testing platforms such as BrowserStack or Sauce Labs. 

Benefits

- Permanent, full-time employment opportunity. 
 - Remote working arrangement, with candidates based in Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, or Mumbai preferred. 
 - Opportunity to contribute to automation testing initiatives and continuous quality improvement. 
 - Exposure to modern testing technologies, automation frameworks, and CI/CD practices. 
 - Collaborative environment with opportunities to work closely with developers, product managers, and cross-functional teams. 
 - Opportunity to strengthen technical expertise in test automation, software quality assurance, and continuous delivery. 
 - An inclusive workplace that emphasizes professional excellence and supportive working practices. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Company Overview

Check out this video and find out why our team loves to work here!

Join Us! CDM Smith - where amazing career journeys unfold. 

Imagine a place committed to offering an unmatched employee experience. Where you work on projects that are meaningful to you. Where you play an active part in shaping your career journey. Where your co-workers are invested in you and your success. Where you are encouraged and supported to do your very best and given the tools and resources to do so. Where it's a priority that the company takes good care of you and your family. 

Our employees are the heart of our company. As an employer of choice, our goal is to provide a challenging, progressive and inclusive work environment which fosters personal leadership, career growth and development for every employee. We value passionate individuals who challenge the norm, deliver world-class solutions and bring diverse perspectives. Join our team, and together we will make a difference and change the world. 

Job Description

CDM Smith is seeking a Full Stack Application Developer to join our Digital Engineering Solutions team. This individual will be part of the Development group within the Digital Engineering Solutions team, helping design and implementation of cloud-based solutions facilitating CI/CD practices, and ensuring that software development and operations teams work collaboratively. An ideal candidate will be a critical thinker, proactive, and a highly interested in the application of new technologies and methods. This individual must showcase exceptional abilities in implementing development solutions for AEC initiatives that involve cutting-edge technologies. As a member of the Digital Engineering Solutions team, the Development group will also engage in research and development and provide guidance and oversight to the AEC practices at CDM Smith, engaging in new product research, testing, and the incubation of innovative ideas that arise from around the company. The ideal candidate should possess an extensive background in application development, that includes security, scaling, integration, and application migration, along with a commitment to continuous advancement and interest that drives measurable results. The following are the Key responsibilities for this position

- Engage in the entire software development lifecycle, from the initial concept and design phase to the implementation and support phase. 
 - Take responsibility of the project and operate independently within a collaborative environment. 
 - Understanding storyboards, wireframes, mockups, and basic prototypes, and translating them into tangible solutions. 
 - Involve in the design and recommendation of the project framework, which includes the system, technical, and security architecture. 
 - Use Agile development techniques while ensuring that the code is scalable, reusable, and of high quality. 
 - Solid understanding of Azure pipelines and DevSecOps methodologies. 
 - Deliver efficient solutions to address problems needed to meet business requirements. 
 - Investigate third-party libraries and integrate software components while working with teams from different business units to meet their prototype and development needs. 
 - Conduct research across various disciplines, including IT systems, design, development, deployment, networking, servers, endpoints, hardware/software, and third-party vendor services. 
 - Maintain awareness of market trends and upcoming technology, pursue necessary training and certifications, and share insights to the team. 
 - Addressing complex challenges, possessing a deep comprehension of diverse software technologies and architectural design, as well as expertise in planning, configuring, and managing resources within Microsoft Azure. 
 - Accountable for the development of best practices, the inventive resolution of technical issues, the prioritization of tasks, and the ability to multitask. 
 - Demonstrate exceptional time management abilities, an extensive understanding of task assignments and schedules, and the effective utilization of available resources and time. Skills and Abilities: Experience with the following: 
 - Extensive experience in the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Agile Development, and Programming methodologies. 
 - Solid understanding of the architecture patterns based on MVC, MVVM, and SPA. 
 - Proficient in Designing, developing, and maintaining web applications with. NET languages (C#, VB. NET) and technologies (ASP. NET, . NET Core). 
 - Developing user interfaces that are both responsive and engaging by utilizing popular frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue. js, as well as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript libraries such as jQuery and Bootstrap. 
 - Building and ingesting web services, such as RESTful APIs, to improve communication between the client-side and server-side components. 
 - Developing efficient data access code with Entity Framework or ADO. NET and implementing data storage solutions using structure and unstructured databases services. 
 - Implementing optimal coding, testing, and deployment methodologies to guarantee application security, scalability, and performance. 
 - Establishing and achieving project milestones in collaboration with cross-functional teams comprising designers, project managers, and other developers. 
 - Writing code that is well-documented, maintainable, and orderly to facilitate the development of applications and future iterations. 
 - Conducting code reviews, unit testing, and integration testing to identify and resolve bugs prior to deployment. 
 - Enhancing the functionality and performance of applications by keeping up with the most recent advancements in the. NET framework and other web technologies. 
 - Working experience with OWASP security principles, comprehension of accessibility, and security compliance tools. 
 - Proficiency in security authentication technologies (e. g. , OAuth2. 0, JWT), Customer Identity & Access Management (CIAM), and Identity & Access Management (IAM)
 - Pursuing continuous learning and professional growth to adjust to changing technological trends and full-stack development best practices. 
 - Competent in version control practices with git, including branching, collaboration, reviewing pull requests, and resolving merge conflicts. (GitHub, Azure DevOps, etc. ). 
 - Providing technical assistance and direction to other team members and stakeholders, including troubleshooting and resolving difficulties after deployment. 

Skills & Abilities

Excellent communication, collaboration, and presentation skills with the ability to convey complex IT concepts in an understandable manner. Possesses excellent attention to detail. Excels at diagnosing and solving complex technical problems across the entire development stack. Possesses excellent skills in managing data efficiently across systems, applying strategies for data storage, retrieval, and processing. Possesses solid knowledge and understanding of business metrics and the ability to align company goals and objectives with development strategies and initiatives. Demonstrates excellent understanding of user interface and user experience (UI/UX) principles. Consistent ability to work effectively across all levels in a highly dynamic environment. Demonstrates a proactive approach to innovation by identifying and applying emerging technologies to improve efficiency, quality and process optimization. 

Qualifications

Education and Experience

- Bachelor's degree in software development, Engineering, or related industry. 
 - 5+ years of related work experience. 
 - Azure certifications AZ-900/AZ-204 and accreditation preferred. 

Amount Of Travel Required

No Travel is required

Background Check and Drug Testing Information

CDM Smith Inc. and its divisions and subsidiaries (hereafter collectively referred to as "CDM Smith") reserves the right to require background checks including criminal, employment, education, licensure, etc. as well as credit and motor vehicle when applicable for certain positions. In addition, CDM Smith may conduct drug testing for designated positions. Background checks are conducted after an offer of employment has been made in the United States. The timing of when background checks will be conducted on candidates for positions outside the United States will vary based on country statutory law but in no case, will the background check precede an interview. CDM Smith will conduct interviews of qualified individuals prior to requesting a criminal background check, and no job application submitted prior to such interview shall inquire into an applicant's criminal history. If this position is subject to a background check for any convictions related to its responsibilities and requirements, employment will be contingent upon successful completion of a background investigation including criminal history. Criminal history will not automatically disqualify a candidate. In addition, during employment individuals may be required by CDM Smith or a CDM Smith client to successfully complete additional background checks, including motor vehicle record as well as drug testing. 

Additional Pay Range Information

CDM Smith is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. This pay range is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels for the geographic location assigned to the position. In addition to geographic location, a candidate's salary is determined by several other factors including, but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, relevant work experience, skills, required certifications, and education/training. 

Additional Compensation

All bonuses at CDM Smith are discretionary and may or may not apply to this position. 

Visa Sponsorship Available

No - We are not open to sponsoring for this position

Agency Disclaimer

All vendors must have a signed CDM Smith Placement Agreement from the CDM Smith Talent Acquisition Manager to receive payment for your placement. Verbal or written commitments from any other member of the CDM Smith Inc. and its divisions and subsidiaries staff will not be considered binding terms. All unsolicited resumes sent to CDM Smith Inc. and its divisions and subsidiaries and any resume submitted to any employee outside of CDM Smith Talent Acquisition Team will be considered property of CDM Smith. CDM Smith Inc. and its divisions and subsidiaries will not be held liable to pay a placement fee.

data.title: SWQA Test Developer Engineer
data.description:
NVIDIA has advanced computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. We are developing the next era of computing through AI, supported by dedicated people and a diverse, collaborative environment. 

We are seeking a SWQA Test Developer Engineer to join the Mobile QA Group and help deliver high-quality products built on NVIDIA Tegra systems on a chip (SoCs). You will be validating Nvidia Shield TV supporting AI-enhanced upscaling, 4K HDR, GeForce NOW cloud gaming, built in Google Assistant, which also supports Dolby Vision, Dolby Atmos, etc. You will work on AI platforms running Linux, Android, and proprietary operating systems, collaborating with engineers, workstream leads, and release managers. 

What You Will Be Doing

- Apply AI-powered tools and agents throughout the test development lifecycle to accelerate test generation, code development, test analysis, coverage improvement, log analysis, regression triage, root-cause analysis, and code reviews. 
 - Build and use an E2E AI Agentic Workflow with existing and custom agents and skills for every SDLC phase. This will expedite key objectives and important metrics of test and quality engineering. 
 - Develop AI framework for test strategies, plans, and detailed test cases from customer requirements; regularly implement tests for software features on Tegra-based platforms using AI-powered tools. 
 - Review product requirements, specifications, and technical designs, and provide feedback to improve testability and coverage. 
 - Develop applications, test tools, and automated tests using NVIDIA test frameworks for Tegra platforms. 
 - File clear bug reports, investigate failures, and work with engineers to triage issues and verify fixes. 
 - Collaborate with project management, hardware, and software teams; analyze priority bugs and share periodic quality metrics and reports with collaborators. Improve testing processes and product quality. 
 - Partner with development, architecture, product, and release teams to identify quality risks, analyze sophisticated system-level issues, drive defects to resolution, and communicate release readiness and quality metrics. 

What We Need To See

- B. Tech. or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or Electrical and Electronics Engineering. 
 - 3-5 years of professional experience in software validation, preferably with ARM SoC-based Linux or Android products and end-to-end validation of game console devices. 
 - Strong Python programming skills with experience building test frameworks, automation infrastructure, utilities, and validation tools from the ground up. 
 - Hands-on experience bringing to bear AI-assisted development tools and AI-powered workflows for test development, code generation, test analysis, debugging, coverage improvement, or test development workflow optimization. 
 - Strong proficiency in Linux, including shell scripting, system-level debugging, process/resource analysis, and command-line fixing. 
 - Ability to implement end-to-end AI agentic testing workflows across all software development lifecycle (SDLC) phases, from requirements analysis and test planning through development, integration, release validation, and post-release monitoring. 
 - Experience using AI agents to assess streaming quality of service (QoS) and end-user experience, including playback startup time, buffering, latency, audio-video synchronization, visual quality, and playback stability; automate visual validation to minimize manual checks and surface issues for review. 
 - Ability to validate Android Streaming Devices for multimedia playback, including 4K HDR video, hardware decoding, audio passthrough, format switching, and audio-video synchronization across supported display and audio configurations. 
 - Experience validating local and cloud gaming on Android Streaming Devices, including controller compatibility, input latency, frame pacing, network sensitivity, and stability during extended gaming sessions. 
 - Ability to manage work independently, demonstrate leadership, communicate clearly, and collaborate effectively, with a passion for emerging technologies. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Experience with Android streaming products, graphics rendering techniques, display parameters, graphics processing, shaders, clusters, streaming apps/games, competitive analysis & benchmarking analysis of different streaming devices. 
 - Experience working on the development or validation of AI agents, Agentic AI workflows, multimodal AI, or Physical AI applications, including tool calling, orchestration, perception, or spatial understanding. 
 - Proven track record of applying AI tools or AI-powered test development agents to measurably improve test automation efficiency, coverage, quality, debugging, and regression efficiency.

data.title: Senior System Software Engineer - Local AI
data.description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself for over two decades. The invention of the GPU in 1999 fueled the growth of PC gaming, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning has ignited modern AI, positioning NVIDIA as a leading AI computing company. 

Artificial intelligence is shifting from passive assistance to autonomous, always-on workflows. Our mission is to make this transition seamless, efficient, and secure for millions globally. The Local AI Inference team is seeking a Senior System Software Engineer to lead the development of robust system-level software and infrastructure for deploying, benchmarking, and qualifying high-quality AI applications and models across Linux and Windows systems powered by RTX and DGX-class GPUs. You will partner with inference engineers, model developers, and AI application teams to build reliable, scalable infrastructure that enables reproducible evaluation and improves local AI performance. Using AI tools and developing autonomous agents, you will accelerate infrastructure development, automate operations, and help engineers diagnose complex system issues. If you enjoy tackling systems challenges and shaping how AI infrastructure is built and operated, we would love to hear from you!

What You'll Be Doing

- Partner across organizations with benchmarking teams, inference teams, and AI application developers to define requirements, design, and maintain shared infrastructure for deploying, benchmarking, and qualifying AI workloads across infernece backends such as llama. cpp, Ollama, PyTorch, vLLM, and WinML. 
 - Build Git-based CI infrastructure for automated builds, integration testing, and regression detection across hardware platforms, operating systems, and runtime configurations. 
 - Develop model management services to download, version, cache, and synchronize checkpoints and dependencies for reproducible execution. 
 - Design databases, backend services, and data pipelines to store and query model metadata, benchmark results, system telemetry, and execution artifacts. 
 - Create dashboards and reports that help engineers compare inference configurations, identify regressions, and investigate performance bottlenecks. 
 - Develop and operate server infrastructure, including environment provisioning, workload scheduling, resource management, and failure recovery. 
 - Develop autonomous AI agents for infrastructure management, workload orchestration, monitoring, and diagnostics, with appropriate access controls and execution safeguards. 
 - Maintain Git repositories and companion websites, keeping code, documentation, model recommendations, and evaluation results current. 
 - Collaborate with inference developers to implement instrumentation and debugging capabilities, resolve system issues, and improve infrastructure efficiency and scalability. 

What We Need To See

- B. Tech or higher degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 
 - 5+ years of relevant software development, with strong programming skills in Python, C/C++, C#, or another systems programming language. 
 - Experience developing system software, backend services, or infrastructure supporting engineering development. 
 - Understanding of system APIs, multithreading, process and resource management, and systems debugging. 
 - Hands-on with Git-based CI, databases, SQL, and data modeling. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently own projects and manage competing priorities. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills for collaboration across engineering teams. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Track record of integrating or debugging AI inference frameworks and building model evaluation or benchmarking platforms
 - Proficiency working with AI agents, including tool integration and evaluation of autonomous infrastructure workflows. 
 - Hands-on expertise in developing telemetry and observability systems using tools such as Grafana or Kibana. 
 - Demonstrated ability to publish technical documentation, model recommendations, or benchmark results through companion websites.

data.title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

You will lead the architecture and development of scalable, elastic distributed systems, driving performance, reliability, security, and operational excellence. You will define scalability requirements and SLOs, design fault-tolerant services that support upgrades without downtime, and establish telemetry and rigorous resilience testing. You will also resolve complex production issues, mentor engineers, and build infrastructure automation for safe deployments, patching, and rollbacks. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

-Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools. 

-Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems. 

-Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met. 

-Design systems to scale with elasticity (e. g. , effectively scaling both up and down). 

-Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 

-Design performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

-Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 

-Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e. g. , network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance. 

-Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting. 

-Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

-Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems. 

-Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health. . 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

-Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems. 

-Design complex test scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 

-Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

-Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes. 

-Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 

-Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance. 

-Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation. 

-Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations. 

Compliance & Security: 

-Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls. 

-Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps. 

-Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date. 

Automation & Change Management: 

-Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure. 

-Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes. 

Basic Qualification

7+ years of industry experience working on commercial or open-source software. 

Strong fluency in C++ or Java or similar modern languages

Excellent problem-solving skills and a deep understanding of Computer Science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems. 

Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure) and build control plane systems for cloud scale

Strong systems programming skills, including experience with multi-threading and concurrency. 

A solid foundation in distributed systems concepts (e. g. , consistency, scaling, failure recovery). 

Experience with implementation testing, debugging, and documentation, specifically within a Linux development environment. 

BS in Computer Science; Masters preferred

Intense curiosity, willingness to question and passion for making systems

Experience designing architectures that demonstrate deep technical depth in one area, or span many products, to enable high availability, scalability, market-leading features and flexibility to meet future business demands

Preferred Qualifications

Experience as technical lead on a large scale cloud service

Hands-on experience developing and maintaining services on a public cloud platform (e. g. , OCI, AWS, Azure)

Experience working on Kubernetes

Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IAC) languages, preferably Terraform

Strong knowledge of databases (SQL and NoSQL)

Strong knowledge of Cloud Networking (OSI layers, HTTP, DNS, TCP/IP. )

Knowledge of Linux internals, Linux/Unix troubleshooting skills

Familiarity with host virtualization technologies (KVM, Containers, Docker, etc. )

Able to effectively communicate technical ideas verbally and in writing (technical proposals, design specs, architecture diagrams and presentations)

Experience with hiring, mentorship and raising the talent bar across the organization

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. The App Components Team is a forward-thinking, platform-focused product engineering team dedicated to crafting the cohesive, high-performing building blocks that define Rippling's "Enterprise Studio" experience.

As a Software Engineer II (Backend / Full Stack) on this team you will be responsible to build and scale the systems that power these components. While your primary focus will be on the backend, this is a truly full-stack role. You will help design the distributed systems that power our platform and also contribute to React and React Native code to deliver polished end-to-end product experiences. 

You will be responsible for building scalable backend services, APIs, and data models, while partnering closely with product and design to ensure the underlying complexity is translated into seamless, high-performance user experiences.

- Design and implement scalable backend services using Python and Golang to support complex enterprise data modeling and product use cases.

 - Take ownership of meaningful product initiatives from early problem definition through implementation. You will help shape technical designs for new "App Studio" capabilities and deliver robust solutions.

 - Work closely with Product, Design, and other engineers to break down complex user problems and build components that are technically strong and practically useful for teams building on top of them. 

What You Will Need

data.title: Senior ETL Quality Assurance Engineer
data.description:
Who are we and why should you join us?

ConcertAI is building the future of precision medicine. We use advanced artificial intelligence and real-world data to transform how healthcare and life sciences generate evidence, make decisions, and improve patient outcomes-starting in oncology and rapidly expanding across therapeutic areas. Our teams partner with the world's leading pharmaceutical companies, providers, and research organizations to solve some of healthcare's most complex challenges. 

At the core of our innovation is Cara, our next-generation AI platform that unlocks powerful insights from complex clinical, imaging, and molecular data. Combined with our Precision Suite-which unifies real-world data, advanced analytics, and scalable evidence generation-these solutions are transforming how clinical development, regulatory, and commercialization decisions are made. 

ConcertAI brings together a portfolio of purpose-built solutions, including TeraRecon, an industry leader in advanced imaging and AI-driven visualization, and CancerLinQ, the ASCO-originated oncology platform advancing care quality and large-scale discovery. 

Joining ConcertAI means working alongside bold thinkers, builders, and healthcare experts on innovative, high-impact products that directly improve patient lives. You'll be part of a fast-growing, mission-driven organization at the forefront of AI-enabled healthcare, with meaningful opportunities for growth and leadership. 

Responsibilities

- Lead end-to-end testing of ETL and data pipelines across multiple processing stages. 
 - Review requirements, file layouts, data dictionaries, mappings, transformation rules, and data lineage. 
 - Develop test strategies, test cases, validation queries, and traceable QA evidence. 
 - Perform source-to-target, file-to-table, table-to-table, and table-to-file reconciliation. 
 - Validate record counts, field-level values, aggregates, calculations, transformations, filtering, enrichment, standardization, and default values. 
 - Test null handling, duplicates, data loss, referential integrity, matching, de-duplication, mastering, and survivorship rules. 
 - Validate inbound and outbound files for structure, headers, delimiters, data types, field lengths, required fields, encoding, and naming conventions. 
 - Create controlled test files and synthetic data to validate business and transformation rules. 
 - Design positive, negative, boundary, edge-case, regression, reload, and recovery scenarios. 
 - Investigate data-quality issues and identify root causes across source data, requirements, mappings, configurations, transformations, and downstream processing. 
 - Develop reusable SQL queries, scripts, reconciliation checks, and automated data-quality validations. 
 - Investigate production data issues and support post-deployment validation and regression testing. 
 - Collaborate with Data Engineering, Business Analysis, Product, Operations, and other technical teams to improve pipeline testability and diagnostics. 
 - Participate in client and data-vendor onboarding by reviewing specifications, sample files, mappings, and expected outputs. 
 - Identify requirements gaps, data-quality risks, ambiguities, and testability concerns during onboarding. 
 - Communicate testing status, defects, risks, blockers, and production-readiness findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Document and manage defects in Jira with supporting SQL, test evidence, and sample records. 
 - Lead complex ETL QA initiatives independently, defining testing strategy, scope, approach, and quality standards for critical data pipelines. 
 - Mentor and provide technical guidance to QA engineers on SQL validation, data reconciliation, test design, defect investigation, and ETL best practices. 
 - Drive continuous improvement of ETL QA processes by identifying automation opportunities, improving reusable validation frameworks, and strengthening data-quality and production-readiness checks. 

Qualifications And Skills

- 7+ years of hands-on experience in ETL testing, data pipeline testing, database testing, data warehouse testing, or data-feed validation. 
 - Advanced SQL skills with the ability to write complex queries for reconciliation, transformation validation, and root-cause analysis. 
 - Strong understanding of ETL architecture and data flow across multiple processing stages. 
 - Experience testing CSV, TXT, delimited, fixed-width, and similar data files. 
 - Experience translating requirements, mappings, file layouts, and transformation rules into comprehensive test scenarios. 
 - Strong experience with source-to-target validation and data reconciliation. 
 - Ability to identify and troubleshoot missing records, duplicates, count mismatches, mapping defects, transformation errors, and data-quality issues. 
 - Experience creating synthetic test data and controlled inbound files. 
 - Experience developing reusable SQL validations, scripts, and automated data-quality checks. 
 - Strong understanding of functional, integration, regression, negative, boundary, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Experience with Jira or similar defect-management tools. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills. 
 - Ability to explain complex technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with Data Engineering, Business Analysts, Product, Operations, clients, and data vendors. 

Preferred Skills

- Healthcare, life-sciences, clinical, claims, real-world evidence, or patient-level data. 
 - AWS Glue, S3, Redshift, Snowflake, PySpark, or similar data-processing technologies. 
 - Python or other scripting languages for test automation and data validation. 
 - Data matching, entity resolution, de-duplication, mastering, and survivorship testing. 
 - Data governance and data-quality principles. 
 - CI/CD and automated testing within data-engineering environments. 
 - Experience working with clients, data vendors, or external data providers. 
 - Experience with large-scale data warehouses and analytics platforms. 

Learn More About ConcertAI

Our team at ConcertAI is dedicated to transforming healthcare decision-making through the application of RWE and AI to improve patient outcomes. We work in a fast-paced, dynamic, high-performing culture where diversity, collaboration, and innovation are valued. Join us on our quest to create a world free of disease. Learn more about ConcertAI at www. concertai. com , or follow us on LinkedIn. Serving 1, 300 clinical sites globally, TeraRecon - a ConcertAI company - is a Best in KLAS solution provider for AI-empowered radiology, oncology, cardiology, neurology, and vascular surgery. In the future, the combination with ConcertAI could bring a single, advanced AI-augmented diagnosis and interpretation capability from clinical trials to patient care.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. We are dedicated to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the application and hiring process, as well as during employment, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together. 

Optum is seeking a Senior Engineering Manager to lead a global engineering organization of 20-25 engineers delivering scalable, secure, and AI-enabled healthcare technology solutions. This leader will be responsible for people leadership, technical direction, execution excellence, and modernization initiatives across distributed teams. 

Primary Responsibilities

- Lead, mentor, and develop a globally distributed team of engineers, technical leads, and engineering managers through direct and matrix leadership
 - Drive delivery of strategic technology initiatives while ensuring quality, scalability, reliability, and security
 - Provide technical leadership across architecture, application development, cloud transformation, and engineering best practices
 - Champion AI-enabled software engineering through adoption of AI DLC, ChatGPT, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and modern developer productivity tools
 - Partner with Product, Architecture, Operations, and Business stakeholders to translate business priorities into technology solutions
 - Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, accountability, and engineering excellence
 - Drive operational excellence, production stability, risk management, and talent development
 - Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
 - 15+ years of software engineering experience with progressive leadership responsibilities
 - 8+ years of experience leading large engineering teams
 - Proven experience managing global teams of 20+ engineers through direct and dotted-line leadership models
 - Solid experience delivering enterprise-scale applications using Agile methodologies
 - Demonstrated success leading technology modernization and cloud transformation initiatives
 - Demonstrated excellent communication, stakeholder management, and executive influence skills
 - Technical Skills
 - Knowledge of Java, Spring Boot, Microservices
 - Knowledge of React JS / TypeScript
 - Knowledge of Snowflake, Databricks
 - Knowledge of Azure Cloud (preferred), AWS, or GCP
 - Knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker
 - Knowledge of CI/CD, DevOps, SRE, Observability
 - Knowledge of Distributed Systems and Enterprise Architecture
 - AI & Emerging Technologies
 - Knowledge of AI Development Lifecycle (AI DLC)
 - Knowledge of ChatGPT
 - Knowledge of Claude Code
 - Knowledge of GitHub Copilot / AI-assisted development
 - Knowledge of Agentic AI, RAG, LLM integration patterns
 - Knowledge of AI Governance and Responsible AI practices
Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in a related field
 - Healthcare, payer, provider, or pharmacy domain experience
 - Experience leading AI-driven engineering transformation initiatives
 - Exposure to healthcare interoperability standards (FHIR/HL7)

What Success Looks Like

- High-performing and engaged engineering teams
 - Predictable delivery of business-critical roadmaps
 - Accelerated engineering productivity through AI adoption
 - Improved platform reliability, scalability, and operational excellence
 - Solid partnership and influence across technology and business organizations

At Optum, you'll help transform healthcare through technology, cloud, data, and AI while leading teams that deliver meaningful impact at scale. 

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

data.title: Team Leader EDD
data.description:
SECTION IV: KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & KPIS OF THE ROLE

These responsibilities are representative, and the role holder is also responsible for any other job assigned by the superior authorities from time to time. This section in not intended to be an exhaustive listing of all activities done by the role holder. It should capture only the key responsibilities of the role. 

Responsibilities

Strategy and Planning

- Ensuring adherence to process and policy guidelines by EDD Officers. 
 - Submitting timely reports with the key findings and gaps. 
 - Engagement with relevant stakeholders to foster the collaborative environment and ensuring the redressal of observations. 

Providing trends and patterns for key risk areas to supervisors

For effective risk mitigation

Policies, Processes & Procedures

- Early warning signals relating Portfolio Health. 
 - Competition benchmarking of the process for the product(s). 
 - Recommend changes to process based on field findings / local nuances / market feedback. 
 - Engaging with Third Party Vendors for timely processing of samples & any sort of process improvements. 
 - Providing training, capacity building and feedback to the line team and vendors. 

Metrics that are used to evaluate the success / performance of the role; specific targets do not need to be included as those would change from Y-o-Y. 

KPIs

- EDD case quality and Compliance Rate: Case completion in full adherence to process and Policy of bank. 
 - Turnaround Time (TAT) for EDD cases: Average time taken to complete EDD reviews within defined timeline. 
 - Risk Efficacy: Ensuring that high risk cases are correctly identified and escalated for EDD. 
 - Timely Reporting: Timeliness and quality of reports along with closure rate of Observations. 
 - Stakeholder Engagement: Collaboration with multiple stakeholders for timely resolution of Issues. 
 - Team Management and Development: Team Productivity, Capacity Building and Coaching of team members. 

Metrics that are used to evaluate the success / performance of the role; specific targets do not need to be included as those would change from Y-o-Y. 

KPIs

- EDD case quality and Compliance Rate: Case completion in full adherence to process and Policy of bank. 
 - Turnaround Time (TAT) for EDD cases: Average time taken to complete EDD reviews within defined timeline. 
 - Risk Efficacy: Ensuring that high risk cases are correctly identified and escalated for EDD. 
 - Timely Reporting: Timeliness and quality of reports along with closure rate of Observations. 
 - Stakeholder Engagement: Collaboration with multiple stakeholders for timely resolution of Issues. 
 - Team Management and Development: Team Productivity, Capacity Building and Coaching of team members. 
 - Customer Onboarding/KYC: Perform initial due diligence on new and existing customers, ensuring all necessary documentation is collected and verified. 
 - Verification: Verify customer identities (name, address, date of birth) using government-issued IDs, and identify Beneficial Ownership (UBO) for legal entities. 
 - Risk Assessment: Evaluate customer activities to determine potential risks to the organization, assigning risk ratings and identifying high-risk clients requiring Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), 
 - Screening: Screen customers documents and profile and abnormalities to be picked up for further investigation and verification. 
 - Investigation and Documentation: Document all due diligence findings and research in the system to maintain audit trails for future references. 
 - Customer coordination: Callout the customer to understand the actual profile and to ensure a through EDD and collect the requisite documents from customer wherever required. 
 - Vendor Coordination: Officer may be required to coordinate with vendors for report etc. 
 - Stakeholder Coordination: Alerts to be raised to branches and monitor them for closure within defined TAT. 
 - MIS: Tracker of all the cases to be maintained and shared with management for review. 

People Management

- Maintaining and reviewing monthly performance of the team members. 
 - Ability to work effectively with diverse populations. 
 - Ability to supervise and train employees, to include organizing, prioritizing, and scheduling work assignments. 
 - Grooming team members for taking higher responsibility. 
 - Managing effective liaisoning with all stakeholders on a regular basis. 
 - Driving, participating in projects/ initiatives aligning with organizational goals. 

SECTION V: OPERATING NETWORK

Key interactions which are essential to execute the role. This will include both internal (excluding sub-ordinates) and external stakeholders. 

Internal

Transaction Monitoring Team, Liability Product Management (LPM), Branch Control Unit (BCU), Central Data Analysis Group (CDAG), Technology Team, Branch Leadership

External

Customers, Service Providers/ Vendors

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer III
data.description:
Job Description

There's nothing more exciting than being at the center of a rapidly growing field in technology and applying your skillsets to drive innovation and modernize the world's most complex and mission-critical systems. 

As a Site Reliability Engineer III at JPMorgan Chase within the Commercial & Investment Bank, you will solve complex and broad business problems with simple and straightforward solutions. Through code and cloud infrastructure, you will configure, maintain, monitor, and optimize applications and their associated infrastructure to independently decompose and iteratively improve on existing solutions. You are a significant contributor to your team by sharing your knowledge of end-to-end operations, availability, reliability, and scalability of your application or platform. 

Job Responsibilities

- Uses enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate incident triage, troubleshooting, and post-incident analysis, validating outputs and handling operational data according to sensitivity and security requirements. 
 - Applies enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to identify patterns in operational signals that indicate reliability risk or recurring toil, prioritizing reuse-first improvements tied to SLO outcomes. 
 - Set up and support CI/CD pipeline, code repository, merge approval workflow, and code build and deployment processes. 
 - Collaborate with development teams to gather requirements for onboarding new applications to the CI/CD process. 
 - Execute, build and deploy across environments based on the weekly scheduled build calendar and Perform smoke/sanity tests for deployed applications and troubleshoot issues arising from these tests. 
 - Automate infrastructure provisioning using AWS CloudFormation and Terraform. 
 - Collaborate with development teams to integrate AWS services into applications and manage scalable AWS infrastructure using best practices
 - Learn the architecture of all applications to effectively troubleshoot issues and Monitor and optimize system performance, ensuring high availability and reliability
 - Periodically analyze hardware and software capacities of build infrastructure and recommend improvements to the management team. 
 - Monitor production alerts and optimize system performance and execute necessary runbook actions , ensuring high availability and reliability . 
 - Provide basic L1 & L2 support for PROD issues and communicate with end users and Participate in PROD issue calls and assist in triaging issues. 

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

- Formal training or certification on site reliability engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience 
 - Working knowledge of using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support SRE workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity
 - Ability to validate AI-assisted operational recommendations before applying changes, escalating when uncertain and following data sensitivity requirements
 - Experience in DevOps and in Java, CI/CD pipeline setup, Git, BitBucket, and Jenkins and experience in continuous integration and source control tools, with experience in CI/CD pipeline setup using Jenkins. 
 - Extensive experience with AWS services (e. g. , EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, VPC) and strong knowledge of AWS IAM, security groups, and network configurations. 
 - Proficiency in scripting languages (e. g. , Python, Bash) for automation tasks and Experience with containerization and orchestration (e. g. , Docker, Kubernetes on AWS). 
 - Experience in monitoring and observability tools (e. g. , Splunk, CloudWatch, Dynatrace, Prometheus) and logging solutions (e. g. , AWS CloudTrail) and Experience in code management tools like GIT, BitBucket, and SVN. 
 - Experience in monitoring and responding to production alerts, providing L1 & L2 support, and strong problem-solving skills. 
 - Excellent communication skills for interacting with end users and team members and Ability to use a wide variety of open-source technologies and cloud services. 
 - Advanced knowledge of application, data, and infrastructure architecture disciplines, and understanding of architecture and design across all systems. 
 - Ability to work in large, collaborative teams to achieve organizational goals and Passionate about building an innovative culture and understanding industry-wide technology trends and best practices. 

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

- Bachelor's degree in a technical or quantitative field, preferably with a focus on Information Systems. 
 - Familiarity with modern technologies
 - Exposure to cloud (AWS) technologies
 - Exposure to Microservices

data.title: Director of Artificial Intelligence
data.description:
Client: Fortune 500 company in Hyderabad, Telangana

Role: Director/Senior Manager, AI Engineering & Delivery

Duration: Full time (direct hire)

About client: 

- Global AI & Innovation team to build next-generation AI platforms, autonomous agents, and real-time intelligence solutions that transform how a global enterprise operates and serves its customers. 

Position Summary: 

- It's is seeking a highly experienced, hands-on Senior Manager, AI Engineering & Delivery to lead the Hyderabad GCC AI delivery organization and serve as a critical execution partner to the Global AI & Innovation leadership team. 
 - This role will own the design, delivery, operationalization, and support of enterprise AI, machine learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions across the prioritized global pipeline. 
 - The successful candidate will manage a multidisciplinary team of AI/ML Engineers, Agent Developers, Data Scientists, MLOps resources, contractors, and delivery partners. 
 - The role will act as the single point of contact for the onshore AI team and business stakeholders, translate operational needs into scalable technical solutions, lead Responsible AI training and awareness, and serve as the first-level escalation point for AI/ML and Agentic AI issues. 
 - This is a strategic leadership role requiring deep knowledge of business operations, strong stakeholder management, and the technical depth to design and deploy secure, reusable, production-grade AI capabilities that integrate into business workflows and create measurable value. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Global AI/ML & Agentic Solution Delivery: 

- Lead end-to-end delivery of AI, ML, Generative AI, and Agentic AI initiatives across the prioritized global portfolio, from discovery and design through production deployment, adoption, and value realization. 
 - Create delivery plans, estimates, milestones, resource models, technical dependencies, risk controls, and release readiness criteria. 
 - Ensure solutions are scalable, reusable, maintainable, observable, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture and engineering standards. 
 - Establish reusable implementation patterns, accelerators, components, APIs, and reference architectures to improve speed and quality across the portfolio. 
 - Maintain transparent portfolio reporting on scope, schedule, quality, risks, dependencies, budget, adoption, and business outcomes. 

AI Architecture & Hands-on Technical Leadership: 

- Own solution architecture and technical design for AI/ML applications, AI microservices, RAG solutions, intelligent assistants, and single- and multi-agent workflows. 
 - Guide model, algorithm, platform, orchestration, data, integration, and deployment decisions based on business requirements and operational constraints. 
 - Conduct architecture and code reviews; establish engineering standards for testing, evaluation, observability, resiliency, security, and supportability. 
 - Remain hands-on in design, prototyping, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and production deployment of critical solutions. 
 - Design APIs and integrations that embed AI capabilities into operational processes, enterprise applications, and business workflows. 

GCC Team Leadership & Delivery Management: 

- Build, lead, coach, and develop a high-performing multidisciplinary GCC team of AI/ML Engineers, Agent Developers, Data Scientists, MLOps Engineers, contractors, and partner resources. 
 - Allocate work across the portfolio, balance capacity and demand, remove delivery blockers, and maintain accountability for quality and outcomes. 
 - Define role expectations, engineering practices, onboarding plans, technical learning paths, and knowledge-sharing mechanisms. 
 - Manage contractors and vendors against defined deliverables, acceptance criteria, security requirements, and performance expectations. 
 - Partner with onshore leadership to evolve the global AI operating model and create effective follow-the-sun delivery and support practices. 

Business Partnership & Operational Knowledge: 

- Serve as the primary GCC AI point of contact for the onshore team, technology leaders, and business stakeholders. 
 - Develop detailed knowledge of It's business operations, workflows, data, controls, customer needs, and regional differences. 
 - Facilitate discovery workshops and translate operational pain points into well-defined AI use cases, solution options, and delivery roadmaps. 
 - Partner with business owners to define success measures, adoption plans, process changes, controls, and quantified value outcomes. 
 - Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to executives, business leaders, product owners, engineers, and control functions. 

AI Governance, Security & Responsible AI: 

- Operationalize It's AI governance requirements throughout the solution lifecycle, including intake, design, risk assessment, approval, testing, deployment, monitoring, and retirement. 
 - Ensure security-by-design and privacy-by-design for sensitive financial, customer, employee, and operational data. 
 - Implement safeguards for prompt injection, data leakage, hallucination and inaccuracy, unauthorized access, model misuse, bias, explainability, and regulatory or compliance risk. 
 - Maintain solution documentation, decision records, model cards, evaluation evidence, approvals, risk treatments, and audit ready artifacts. 
 - Partner with Information Security, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Enterprise Architecture, Data Governance, and Internal Audit as required. 

Global AI Training, Adoption & Awareness: 

- Own and drive continuous AI learning, enablement, and Responsible AI awareness across global It's teams. 
 - Develop and deliver executive briefings, business enablement sessions, technical workshops, developer training, and role based learning paths. 
 - Create practical guidance that helps employees use AI safely, responsibly, and effectively within approved policies and tools. 
 - Build a network of AI champions and reusable training assets to scale adoption across regions and functions. 
 - Track participation, adoption, proficiency, policy awareness, and feedback to continuously improve enablement programs. 

AI Operations, Support & Escalation: 

- Serve as the first-level escalation point for delivery, production, model, agent, data, integration, governance, and adoption issues related to AI/ML and Agentic AI. 
 - Lead structured triage, root-cause analysis, stakeholder communication, remediation, and preventive action for critical incidents. 
 - Establish operational readiness standards, service ownership, monitoring, alerting, runbooks, support handoffs, and incident response procedures. 
 - Monitor model and agent quality, latency, reliability, cost, drift, safety, and business performance after deployment. 
 - Escalate material risks and decisions promptly with clear impact, options, recommendations, owners, and resolution plans. 

Strategy Execution & Value Realization: 

- Reporting directly to Global Head, AI & Innovation to translate the Global AI Strategy into an executable roadmap and delivery portfolio. 
 - Support portfolio prioritization, investment planning, governance forums, executive reviews, vendor evaluations, and strategic partnerships. 
 - Identify opportunities to reuse platforms, data products, models, agents, and integration patterns across functions and regions. 
 - Define and report measurable outcomes, including business value, adoption, risk reduction, cycle-time improvement, quality, reliability, and cost efficiency. 
 - Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and recommend practical adoption paths aligned with business need, enterprise readiness, and risk tolerance. 

Required Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline. 
 - 12+ years of progressive experience across software engineering, data science, AI/ML engineering, enterprise architecture, or digital solution delivery. 
 - 5+ years leading multidisciplinary AI/ML, data science, or advanced engineering teams, including contractors and delivery partners. 
 - Demonstrated success designing, deploying, and supporting production-grade enterprise AI/ML or Generative AI solutions. 
 - Experience operating as a technical and delivery leader across geographically distributed onshore and offshore teams. 
 - Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, prioritization, risk management, and delivery governance skills. 
 - Ability to combine strategic leadership with hands-on technical problem solving and detailed operational understanding. 

Required Technical Skills & Experience

AI, Generative AI & Agentic Engineering: 

- LLMs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool use, function calling, AI agents, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, embeddings, semantic search, model evaluation, grounding, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop patterns. 
 - Hands-on experience with Azure OpenAI and/or Amazon Bedrock and with relevant model providers and enterprise AI services. 
 - Experience with frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or comparable orchestration frameworks. 

Data Science & Algorithm Selection: 

- Strong foundation in statistics, experimentation, feature engineering, predictive modeling, optimization, and model evaluation. 
 - Ability to select algorithms based on business objective, target variable, data volume and quality, latency, interpretability, risk, cost, and deployment constraints. 
 - Practical experience with regression, classification, decision trees, random forests, gradient boosting, clustering, anomaly detection, time-series forecasting, NLP, recommendation methods, neural networks, and optimization techniques. 
 - Ability to compare candidate models using appropriate evaluation metrics, validation strategies, explainability methods, and business acceptance criteria. 

Software Engineering & Integration: 

- Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL; strong understanding of APIs, microservices, event-driven integration, object-oriented design, automated testing, version control, and secure coding. 
 - Experience with REST services, containers, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub or Azure DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and modern DevSecOps practices. 

Data Engineering & Knowledge Platforms: 

- Experience with batch and real-time data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, streaming, operational data, document processing, metadata, and data quality. 
 - Experience with Snowflake cortex, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Informatica Claire, Apache Spark, Kafka or comparable technologies. 
 - Experience designing vector search and knowledge retrieval using Azure AI Search, OpenSearch, or comparable vector database technologies. 

Cloud, MLOps & Observability: 

- Strong experience designing and operating solutions across Azure and AWS. 
 - Experience with model and agent deployment, registries, experiment tracking, automated testing, monitoring, drift detection, telemetry, performance tuning, autoscaling, cost optimization, secrets management, and production support. 
 - Familiarity with MLflow and relevant cloud-native AI/ML services. 

AI Security, Governance & Responsible AI: 

- Knowledge of secure AI design, identity and access management, encryption, secrets management, DLP, privacy, retention, auditability, model risk, bias and fairness, explainability, and regulatory compliance. 
 - Experience implementing controls for prompt injection, insecure tool use, sensitive-data exposure, hallucination, unsafe outputs, unauthorized actions, model misuse, and third-party AI risk. 

Business & Domain Experience: 

- Strong knowledge of business operations at a detailed process level is essential. Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable: 
 - Secure logistics and cash management
 - Financial services, banking, payments, or regulated operations
 - Route, branch, vault, fleet, or field-service operations
 - Customer service, sales, pricing, revenue, and retention analytics
 - Forecasting, workforce productivity, fraud, risk, and operational optimization
 - Global shared services, GCC delivery, or large-scale enterprise transformation

Leadership Competencies: 

- Enterprise thinking with disciplined execution
 - Customer- and business-outcome orientation
 - Strong ownership, urgency, and accountability
 - Ability to influence without direct authority
 - Clarity in decision-making and escalation
 - Talent development and inclusive team leadership
 - Comfort operating in ambiguity and managing multiple priorities
 - High standards for security, quality, ethics, and operational excellence

Success Measures: 

- Outcome Area Measures of Success
 - Portfolio delivery On-time, high-quality delivery of prioritized AI/ML and Agentic AI initiatives, with risks and dependencies actively managed. 
 - Business value Measurable operational, customer, revenue, productivity, risk, or cost outcomes from deployed solutions. 
 - Production excellence Reliable, secure, observable, scalable, and cost-effective AI services with effective operational support. 
 - Reusable capability Growth in reusable architectures, components, platforms, models, agents, data products, and engineering standards. 
 - Governance & risk Consistent compliance with AI governance, security, privacy, legal, and Responsible AI requirements. 
 - Talent & capacity Strong team performance, skills growth, retention, succession readiness, and effective partner utilization. 
 - Adoption & awareness Increased AI adoption, proficiency, training participation, and Responsible AI awareness across global teams. 
 - Stakeholder confidence High trust and satisfaction among onshore leadership, business stakeholders, technology teams, and control functions. 

Why This Role Matters: 

- This role is central to the successful execution of It's Global AI Strategy. It combines GCC delivery leadership, enterprise architecture, hands-on engineering, business partnership, governance, Responsible AI, training, and operational accountability. The successful candidate will be a trusted extension of the onshore AI & Innovation team and will help turn It's AI vision into secure, scalable, reusable, and measurable business outcomes across the global enterprise. 

Best Regards, 

-------

David Roy | Accounts Manager - US Staffing | Charter Global Inc. | https: //www. charterglobal. com

data.title: Quality Engineer
data.description:
Project Role : Quality Engineer

Project Role Description : Enables full stack solutions through multi-disciplinary team planning and ecosystem integration to accelerate delivery and drive quality across the application lifecycle. Performs continuous testing for security, API, and regression suite. Creates automation strategy, automated scripts and supports data and environment configuration. Participates in code reviews, monitors, and reports defects to support continuous improvement activities for the end-to-end testing process. 

Must have skills : Selenium

Good to have skills : NA

Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary: 

As a Quality Engineer, your day involves collaborating with diverse teams to design and implement comprehensive solutions that enhance the software delivery process. You engage in planning activities that span multiple disciplines and integrate various components of the development ecosystem. Your role includes continuous testing efforts focused on security, application programming interfaces, and regression to ensure the highest quality standards. You develop and maintain automation strategies and scripts, while also managing data and environment configurations. Additionally, you actively participate in code reviews, track and report defects, and contribute to ongoing improvements throughout the entire testing lifecycle. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

- Expected to perform independently and become an SME. 
 - Required active participation/contribution in team discussions. 
 - Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of testing processes within the development lifecycle. 
 - Assist in maintaining and enhancing automated test frameworks to improve efficiency and coverage. 
 - Support junior team members by sharing knowledge and providing guidance on best practices. 
 - Monitor testing progress and provide timely updates to stakeholders to facilitate informed decision-making. 

Professional & Technical Skills: 

- Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Selenium. 
 - Experience in designing and implementing automated test scripts to validate software functionality and performance. 
 - Strong understanding of continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines to support automated testing. 
 - Familiarity with testing methodologies including regression, security, and API testing. 
 - Ability to analyze test results, identify defects, and communicate findings effectively to development teams. 
 - Knowledge of environment and data configuration to support diverse testing scenarios. 

Additional Information: 

- The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Selenium. 
 - This position is based at our Hyderabad office. 
 - A 15 years full time education is required.
