data.title: Senior Agentic Workflow Engineer
data.description:
HRS As a Company

HRS, a pioneer in business travel, aims to elevate every stay through innovative technology. With over 50 years of experience, their digital platform, driven by ProcureTech, TravelTech, and FinTech, transforms how companies and travelers Stay, Work, and Pay. 

ProcureTech digitally revolutionizes lodging procurement, connecting corporations and suppliers in a cutting-edge ecosystem. This enables seamless efficiency and automation, surpassing travelers' expectations. 

TravelTech redefines the online lodging experience, offering personalized content from selection to check-in, ensuring an unparalleled journey for corporate travelers. 

In FinTech, HRS introduces advancements like mobile banking and digital payments, turning corporate back offices into touchless lodging enablers, eliminating legacy cost barriers. The innovative 2-click book-to-pay feature streamlines interactions for travelers and hoteliers. 

Combining these technology propositions, HRS unlocks exponential catalyst effects. Their data-driven focus delivers value-added services and high-return network effects, creating substantial customer value. 

HRS's exponential growth since 1972 serves over 35% of the global Fortune 500 and leading hotel chains. 

Join HRS to shape the future of business travel, empowered by a culture of growth and setting new industry standards worldwide. 

BUSINESS UNIT

You'll join HRS's Product & IT organization, in the team that builds the AI agent layer for our global sales organization. Our goal: give Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Learning & Development, and leadership teams trusted AI agents that work directly inside the tools they use every day, such as our CRM, Microsoft 365, and our data platforms. The foundation is already in place. A central AI gateway on AWS gives every agent secure, audited access to approved AI models, and a dedicated platform engineer builds and maintains the secure connections into our core business systems. That lets you concentrate on building agents that solve real business problems for our teams worldwide. We are deliberately not a single-vendor shop: we build on Microsoft Copilot Studio, n8n, Dify, and other cloud-native agentic workflow engines, with the platform for each use case selected based on the agent capabilities it requires. 

POSITION

As Senior Agentic Workflow Engineer (all genders), you are the lead architect and builder of HRS's growing portfolio of AI agents and agentic workflows. You define the multi-agent architecture and the development standards the team follows across platforms, and personally drive the delivery of production-grade agents that account executives, sales operations managers, and customer success teams use every day - in Microsoft Teams and beyond. 

Our central AI gateway connects agents to approved AI models, and our platform engineer (a separate role) owns the detailed technical integrations into Dynamics 365, Dataverse, SharePoint, OneDrive, and our other data systems. That leaves your focus on what makes agents valuable: design, orchestration, quality, and scale. You will mentor the mid-level engineer, set the technical bar, and make sure every agent ships as a reliable, well-governed product, whichever platform it runs on. 

CHALLENGE

- Architecture and delivery standards: Define the platform-agnostic multi-agent topology, conversation and workflow design principles, naming conventions, guardrail patterns, and release standards the team follows across all engines. 
 - Multi-agent framework: Design the orchestrator and sub-agent structure, handoff protocols, context passing, and fallback behaviors, including cross-platform communication via open standards like MCP and A2A. 
 - New use cases: Lead design and delivery of agents for pipeline queries, opportunity stage updates, forecasts, opportunity creation, approval workflows, and AI-generated content across a growing sales and customer-facing backlog. 
 - Enterprise data access: Partner with the platform engineer to define tool, API, and connector contracts for Dynamics 365, Dataverse, SharePoint, OneDrive, SAP, Clay, AWS data products, and internal APIs. Enforce governed interfaces only: no direct database access, no free-form SQL, no plaintext credentials. 
 - Guardrail framework: Define and implement RBAC, DLP controls, prompt-injection defenses, output validation, and audit logging standards for every agent on every platform. 
 - Release management: Own versioning, regression testing, and staged rollout to production, including human approval gates for write-back actions, and sign off on every production promotion. 
 - Mentoring: Guide the mid-level engineer through architecture advice, reviews, and structured onboarding, building a team that delivers independently. 
 - Stakeholder translation: Work with sales and sales operations to scope use cases, define acceptance criteria, and manage delivery expectations. 

FOR THIS EXCITING MISSION YOU ARE EQUIPPED WITH

- Experience: Typically 7+ years in software, automation, or integration engineering, with a track record of shipping AI agents or agentic workflows that real users rely on in production. 
 - Agent platforms: Proven experience deploying production agents, including multi-agent orchestrator/sub-agent architectures, on at least one agentic engine (e. g. Copilot Studio, n8n, Dify, Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock Agents, LangGraph). Production experience on multiple platforms is a strong plus. 
 - M-shaped profile: Deep agentic engineering expertise plus broad knowledge of enterprise systems such as CRM (e. g. Dynamics 365), ERP (e. g. SAP), Microsoft 365, and cloud data platforms. 
 - Agentic AI patterns: Deep understanding of orchestrator/sub-agent design, prompt engineering, RAG, tool/function calling, MCP, agent memory, and evaluation. 
 - Platform judgment: Clear view of each platform's strengths and limits, designing every agent to make the most of where it runs. 
 - API fluency: Confident with REST, JSON, webhooks, and OAuth 2. 0 / service principals; consumes APIs, connectors, and MCP servers and specifies precisely what agents need from the platform team. 
 - Governance: Solid knowledge of identity and RBAC (e. g. Entra ID), DLP, secrets management, environment and solution lifecycle, and CI/CD for agents. 
 - Compliance: Understanding of GDPR and EU data residency for agent data handling. 
 - Mentoring: Proven ability to coach engineers and uphold quality standards across a team. 
 - Design and documentation: Strong skills in architecture decision records, conversation and workflow specs, and runbooks. 
 - Certifications (a plus): Microsoft PL-400 or AI-102, AWS, or platform-specific equivalents. 
 - Communication: Fluent English, verbal and written, able to lead discussions with technical and business stakeholders.

data.title: Senior AI Platform Engineer
data.description:
HRS As a Company

HRS, a pioneer in business travel, aims to elevate every stay through innovative technology. With over 50 years of experience, their digital platform, driven by ProcureTech, TravelTech, and FinTech, transforms how companies and travelers Stay, Work, and Pay. 

ProcureTech digitally revolutionizes lodging procurement, connecting corporations and suppliers in a cutting-edge ecosystem. This enables seamless efficiency and automation, surpassing travelers' expectations. 

TravelTech redefines the online lodging experience, offering personalized content from selection to check-in, ensuring an unparalleled journey for corporate travelers. 

In FinTech, HRS introduces advancements like mobile banking and digital payments, turning corporate back offices into touchless lodging enablers, eliminating legacy cost barriers. The innovative 2-click book-to-pay feature streamlines interactions for travelers and hoteliers. 

Combining these technology propositions, HRS unlocks exponential catalyst effects. Their data-driven focus delivers value-added services and high-return network effects, creating substantial customer value. 

HRS's exponential growth since 1972 serves over 35% of the global Fortune 500 and leading hotel chains. 

Join HRS to shape the future of business travel, empowered by a culture of growth and setting new industry standards worldwide. 

BUSINESS UNIT

Revenue Operations (Rev Ops) is building HRS's AI-powered Go-to-Market platform - a single, governed access layer that gives Sales, Rev Ops, Marketing, Learning & Development, and Management teams trusted AI capabilities across our revenue systems. The foundation is already in place: HRS operates a centrally managed AI Gateway running on AWS, providing a shared, auditable AI infrastructure that all agents connect to. Your role is to build on top of this foundation - designing, developing, and scaling Microsoft Copilot Studio agents that solve real business problems for our global revenue teams. 

POSITION

As AI Platform Engineer (all genders) in our Revenue Operations team, you are the technical backbone of HRS's Copilot Studio agent delivery operation. You own the Microsoft Power Platform environments, CI/CD pipelines, security configuration, and Azure services that enable the development team to build, test, and ship Copilot Studio agents reliably and at scale. 

The HRS AI Gateway is already live and managed centrally - your job is not to build infrastructure from scratch, but to ensure the Copilot Studio platform is production-ready: well-governed environments, automated deployment pipelines, clean security controls, and solid observability so the team can focus on delivering agents rather than fighting platform issues. 

CHALLENGE

- Environment strategy and ALM: Design and maintain the dev, test, and production environment topology; manage solution exports, imports, and environment variables; and own the connection references and service accounts agents rely on. 
 - CI/CD pipelines: Build and run Azure DevOps or Power Platform ALM pipelines that promote Copilot Studio solutions across environments, with regression checks, versioning, and rollback procedures. 
 - Azure services: Own Azure Key Vault (secrets), Entra ID (identity and service principals), and Azure Monitor / Application Insights (telemetry and alerting). 
 - HRS AI Gateway connectivity: Configure and maintain the custom HTTP connectors that link Copilot Studio agents to the HRS AI Gateway on AWS, keeping them secure, authenticated, and resilient. 
 - Security and compliance: Implement DLP policies, manage Entra ID RBAC across environments, ensure EU data residency at the connector and environment level, and maintain audit logs of all agent interactions. 
 - Platform monitoring: Track telemetry, connector latency, error rates, and token usage, and build dashboards that surface production issues before they affect users. 
 - Developer support: Unblock developers on environment, connector, and deployment issues, and turn platform requirements into clear standards and guardrails. 

FOR THIS EXCITING MISSION YOU ARE EQUIPPED WITH

- Power Platform administration: Hands-on experience with environment management, DLP policies, solution ALM, connection references, and Dataverse security roles. 
 - CI/CD: Experience designing pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, using Power Platform Build Tools or the Power Platform CLI. 
 - Identity and secrets: Working knowledge of Azure Key Vault, Entra ID, and service principals, including securing credentials and managing identities for automated deployments. 
 - Custom connectors: Experience building custom HTTP connectors to external REST APIs secured with OAuth 2. 0 or API keys. 
 - Monitoring: Familiarity with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Log Analytics for telemetry, alerting, and dashboards. 
 - Compliance: Understanding of GDPR and EU data residency as they apply to Power Platform environments and connectors. 
 - Collaboration: Able to work closely with developers and turn platform constraints into clear guidelines without becoming a bottleneck. 
 - Certifications (required): PL-400 (Power Platform Developer) or AZ-104 (Azure Administrator); holding both is a strong differentiator. 
 - Language: Fluent English, verbal and written.

data.title: Salesforce Application Architect
data.description:
Salesforce Application Architect - Sovos SOVOS Salesforce Application Architect

Accounting/Finance· Full-Time

- India

Build Your Future With Us

The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions. 

We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence - and helping communities thrive. 

AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change. 

Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here. 

The Role

At Sovos, we're building the platform that makes tax compliance simple for thousands of global enterprises. As Salesforce Application Architect, you'll own the technical architecture and engineering of our Salesforce ecosystem, designing scalable solutions that power our go-to-market operations and integrate AI-powered automation directly into production. This is a senior technical leadership role where you'll balance deep platform engineering, CPQ expertise, and modern AI tooling to deliver reliable, maintainable systems at global scale. Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes - apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here. 

More Specifically, You Will

- Own the Salesforce technical architecture across Sales Cloud, CPQ, and Service Cloud, designing scalable, maintainable solutions that balance declarative and programmatic approaches with a strong focus on long-term platform health and org simplicity. 
 - Govern platform engineering standards for Apex, LWC, SFDX, and Flow automation, including coding standards, architecture and code reviews, bulkification patterns, metadata hygiene, and technical debt remediation to keep the platform performant as it scales. 
 - Design and maintain the Salesforce security model including org-wide defaults, role hierarchy, permission sets, permission set groups, field-level security, and sharing rules; conduct periodic security audits and enforce least-privilege access. 
 - Architect and engineer the Salesforce CPQ platform, including product catalogue, pricing rules, QCP (JavaScript quoting processes), MDQ (multi-dimensional quoting), Advanced Approvals, amendment and renewal logic, and ARR categorisation; own end-to-end Quote-to-Cash process integrity and integrations with Zuora and NetSuite via middleware. 
 - Design, build, and deploy AI-powered features directly on the Salesforce platform using LLM APIs (Claude, Copilot), including agentic data-quality workflows, deal and quoting chatbots grounded in CPQ data, and AI-assisted development workflows; evaluate and govern Salesforce-native AI capabilities including Agentforce agents, Einstein Copilot, and Prompt Builder. 
 - Architect and govern Salesforce integration patterns including REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, named credentials, and External Services; set clear standards for declarative versus programmatic callout patterns and partner with data and integrations teams on middleware strategy. 
 - Lead Salesforce DevOps practices using Salesforce DX and CI/CD pipelines; govern platform health via Salesforce Health Check, Code Analyser in the CI pipeline, and org limits monitoring; enforce sandbox strategy, environment governance, and AppExchange package evaluation. 
 - Serve as the technical escalation point for the Salesforce team; conduct code and architecture reviews, mentor administrators and developers, and partner with Sales Operations, Finance, and executive stakeholders to translate business requirements into sound technical design, communicating decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Lead Salesforce workstreams for M&A due diligence and post-close integration; own platform controls aligned to SOX ITGC requirements including change management controls, access review evidence, and audit log configuration. 

What You Bring to Sovos

- You've built deep platform expertise across Salesforce Sales Cloud, CPQ, Service Cloud, and integrations in a global SaaS environment, with solid architecture and engineering skills demonstrated over the course of your career. 
 - Salesforce Certified Application Architect required; Certified Data Architect or Sharing and Visibility Architect strongly preferred; strong data architecture skills including large data volume (LDV) management (skinny tables, custom indexes, archiving), SOQL query optimisation, and data migration design. 
 - Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist required or equivalent experience; deep hands-on experience with QCP (JavaScript quoting processes), MDQ (multi-dimensional quoting), amendment and renewal logic, and ARR categorisation across upsell, cross-sell, churn, migration, and recontracting scenarios. 
 - Demonstrated experience building AI/LLM integrations directly on the Salesforce platform using Claude API, Gemini API, or equivalent, including agentic workflows and AI-powered automation in production CRM environments; familiarity with Salesforce-native AI capabilities including Agentforce, Einstein Copilot, Prompt Builder, and Einstein Trust Layer. 
 - Strong Apex, LWC, and Flow development expertise; ability to set and enforce coding standards, perform code reviews, design complex Flow automation (screen flows, Flow Orchestration), and govern the declarative automation layer at scale. 
 - Experience with Salesforce integration architecture including REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, External Services, and middleware platforms (Boomi, MuleSoft); Zuora and NetSuite integration experience a strong plus; proficiency with Salesforce DevOps (SFDX, CI/CD, Copado, Prodly, or Gearset) and platform governance. 
 - Comfort with AI-assisted development workflows and leveraging AI tools to improve platform architecture, engineering quality, and delivery speed; strong written and verbal English communication skills for cross-time-zone executive stakeholder engagement. 
 - Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire. 

The Process

We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect: 

1

Pre-Employment Assessment

Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot. 

2

Video Interview

A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume. 

3

Meeting with a Recruiter

A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals. 

4

Live Interviews with the Hiring Team

Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role. 

Life at Sovos

The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

- Global Mentoring Programs
 - AI Tools and Technology from Day 1
 - Continuous Learning and Development
 - Language Learning Support
 - Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs
 - Global Parental Leave Policy
 - Comprehensive Health Insurance (Day 1, company paid)
 - Life and Accidental Insurance (company paid)
 - Hybrid Work Arrangement
 - Annual Health Check-up

Equal Opportunity Employer

Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, colour, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work. 

Company Background

Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150+ countries. 

More than 100, 000 customers - including half the Fortune 500 - trust Sovos' tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos. com. 

Ready to make your move?

We'd love to hear from you. Use the Apply button at the top of this page to submit your application

SOVOS © Sovos 2026. All rights reserved.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Finance Test Analyst with strong Oracle Fusion Finance testing expertise to join our testing team. This role will serve as the primary liaison between offshore testing teams and onshore Test Leads, combining hands-on test delivery with test coordination, governance, reporting, and stakeholder communication. 

The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring offshore testing activities are planned, coordinated, executed, and reported effectively while maintaining high quality standards across all testing deliverables. 

This role combines approximately 80% hands-on testing and quality assurance activities with 20% coordination, communication, and governance responsibilities. 

Key Responsibilities Offshore-Onshore Coordination & Communication

- Act as the primary point of contact between offshore test teams and onshore Test Leads. 
 - Participate in governance, status, and project meetings. 
 - Communicate testing priorities and requirements to offshore resources. 
 - Consolidate offshore progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and blockers. 
 - Provide clear and concise status updates to onshore stakeholders. 
 - Coordinate and track queries between offshore and onshore teams. 
 - Ensure agreed actions are understood and executed by offshore teams. 
 - Maintain efficient communication channels and minimize unnecessary escalations. 

Test Coordination & Governance

- Support detailed planning and coordination of offshore testing activities. 
 - Break down testing scope into manageable work packages. 
 - Monitor progress against milestones and delivery timelines. 
 - Identify and escalate risks that may impact testing schedules. 
 - Coordinate test data, environment readiness, and testing dependencies. 
 - Ensure consistent quality standards across testing deliverables. 
 - Review and quality assure test cases and supporting evidence. 
 - Highlight resource and capacity constraints proactively. 

Test Analysis, Preparation & Execution

- Execute and support complex Oracle Fusion Finance test scenarios. 
 - Review requirements and identify required test coverage. 
 - Develop, review, and maintain test cases and test scripts. 
 - Support end-to-end business process testing. 
 - Identify gaps and recommend additional testing where necessary. 
 - Ensure accurate documentation of testing activities and outcomes. 

Defect Management

- Review defects before escalation to ensure completeness and quality. 
 - Ensure defects contain sufficient detail to support investigation. 
 - Participate in defect triage sessions and defect review meetings. 
 - Identify recurring issues and potential root causes. 
 - Escalate critical defects, risks, and blockers promptly. 

Reporting & Tracking

- Maintain accurate test execution status in Azure DevOps (ADO). 
 - Consolidate and report offshore testing progress. 
 - Track defects, risks, dependencies, and blockers. 
 - Participate in daily stand-ups and status meetings. 
 - Provide visibility into resource utilization and testing capacity. 

Required Skills & Experience Oracle Fusion Finance Testing

- Professional testing qualification (ISTQB or equivalent preferred). 
 - Minimum 5 years of experience testing ERP Financials, preferably Oracle Fusion Finance. 
 - Strong understanding of end-to-end Finance processes and controls. 
 - Proven experience in functional system testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing support. 

Oracle Fusion Finance Modules

Experience Across Multiple Oracle Fusion Finance Modules, Including

- General Ledger (GL)
 - Accounts Payable (AP)
 - Accounts Receivable (AR)
 - Cash Management
 - Fixed Assets
 - Expenses
 - Intercompany
 - Tax
 - Budgetary Control
 - Financial Reporting

Business Process Knowledge

Strong Knowledge Of End-to-end Finance Processes, Including

- Procure-to-Pay (P2P)
 - Record-to-Report (R2R)
 - Order-to-Cash (O2C)

Communication & Stakeholder Management

This is a critical requirement for the role. 

The Successful Candidate Should Demonstrate

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. 
 - Experience working with UK-based or other international stakeholders. 
 - Ability to explain testing and technical issues to non-technical audiences. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills. 
 - Ability to consolidate detailed testing information into concise management updates. 
 - Confidence in escalating risks, issues, and blockers appropriately. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working in large-scale ERP transformation or Oracle Fusion implementation programs. 
 - Experience using Azure DevOps (ADO) for test management and defect tracking. 
 - Experience coordinating distributed offshore and onshore testing teams. 
 - Exposure to Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid delivery methodologies. 

Why Join Us?

- Work on enterprise-scale Oracle Fusion Finance transformation programs. 
 - Collaborate with global stakeholders and cross-functional teams. 
 - Contribute to high-impact finance transformation initiatives. 
 - Opportunity to combine hands-on testing expertise with leadership and coordination responsibilities. 

Role Type: Full-Time

data.title: Manager, Data Storage Platforms
data.description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients- that is what Vantive aspires to deliver. 

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don't settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients' lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities. 

The Manager, Data Storage Platforms is responsible for leading a team of platform engineers overseeing the planning, the build, and the operations of data platforms. They will be responsible for architecting, engineering, and optimizing large‐scale, cloud‐native data platforms on AWS and Azure. This role leads development of event‐driven data architectures, CDC frameworks, data lake ingestion pipelines, and scalable ETL/ELT processes. The architect partners closely with cross‐functional teams, leads technical delivery, ensures operational excellence, and provides hands‐on support for global data transformation initiatives. They will be a part of the Data Services Platforms team and provide technological and process expertise and support the global domain data product delivery teams. They will provide leadership by assisting business partners in identifying and responding to opportunities for cost-effective data implementations and solutions by analyzing and making decisions that have cross functional business impact. 

Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of data platform engineers
 - Accountable for strategic planning and technical roadmap development for data platforms. 
 - Oversee the design, implementation, and maintenance of data engineering pipelines in a multi-cloud environment, including integrations with a variety of data sources (including structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data)
 - Collaborate with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams and other stakeholders in Architecture, Data Integration, DevOps, and Data Governance to deliver data platform initiatives
 - Ensure data engineering standards align with industry best practices for data governance, data quality, and data security. 
 - Monitor and optimize the performance of data pipelines, ensuring they meet SLAs for data availability and quality. 
 - Evaluate and recommend new data technologies and tools to improve data engineering processes and outcomes, in collaboration with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams. 
 - Effectively communicate and realize vision and strategy for the organization that aligns with the business and patient needs. 
 - Embrace and embed agile ways of working in support of a fail-fast-learn-fast culture and enabling continual improvement. 
 - Foster a collaborative work environment with strong working relationships within and across businesses and functions, and with strategic external partners. 
 - Manage datasets using Apache Hudi (version 0. 11. x and higher), focusing on supporting near real-time data processing and incremental data loading utilizing cutting-edge features for more efficient data lake management and complex data transformation pipelines
 - Implement the latest versions of Terraform (0. 12. x and higher) to efficiently handle infrastructure changes and versioning with enhanced security and flexibility

Key Experiences & Attributes

- Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or relevant subject area
 - Minimum 5+ years of progressive technical experience in one or more of the cloud-based data warehouse/data lake platforms such as AWS S3, Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse. 
 - Significant experience in leading teams in Data & Analytics programs with experience in native digital technologies (cloud, big data and predictive) in organizations driving product development. 
 - Change Agent - Catalyst for the teams and expected to lead the transformation to a fail-fast-learn-fast culture enabling continual improvement. 
 - Servant Leader - Able to gain respect from their team and willing to get their hands dirty to get the job done. 
 - Courageous - Able to effectively challenge and influence peers and teams, leading them through difficult or uncertain situations. 
 - Significant experience working in a global matrix environment. 
 - Must be a strategic, innovative problem solver, and have strong influencing and communication skills. 
 - Strong knowledge of business process flow and/or entity relationship modeling. 
 - Demonstrated outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively with other technology teams as well as business partners. Ability to effectively present information, interact with, and respond to questions from managers, employees, customers, and vendors
 - Experience in applying best practices to ELT/ETL data transformation from variety of data sources to AWS and other data warehouse platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse etc. 

Required Technical Skills

- AWS CDK (TypeScript/Python)
 - AWS Glue (ETL, Catalog, Crawlers, Job Bookmarks)
 - AWS Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, Step Functions, EventBridge
 - Amazon Kinesis, Route 53, S3 (events, triggers)
 - Terraform (0. 12+)
 - Apache Hudi (0. 11+) and CDC methodologies
 - AWS DMS
 - Apache Spark (2. 4+) and PySpark
 - Amazon EMR (5. x+)
 - Python (3. 6+) for automation and pipeline development
 - IBM DataStage (for supplemental ETL workflows)
 - Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse

Reasonable Accommodation

Vantive is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information. Form Link

Health & wellness coverage including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

Generous time off including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

Work/life support including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

Financial security programs such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts

Signature travel perks including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

Additional perks & discounts like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits

A people-first culture with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

Specific benefits and programs vary by location. 

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work. 

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We'd love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary. 

Applying for this position

We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all current employees, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply.

About The Role

Position Title : Lead Software Engineer

Corporate Title: AVP (Internal: AVP)

Reporting to : VP

Location: MGS - Bengaluru

Job Profile

Position details

The AVP, Lead Software Engineer will apply hands-on technical knowledge across data integration, database engineering, scripting, cloud-based data services, and AI-enabled solutions. The role is to help design secure, scalable Generative AI capabilities, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), enterprise knowledge bases, semantic search, and document intelligence solutions. 

The successful candidate will combine strong engineering fundamentals with analytical thinking, iterative problem-solving, stakeholder management, and a risk-aware approach. The individual will translate business and technical requirements into reliable solutions, guide development teams, and deliver against milestones in a regulated financial-services environment. In the process, you will have exciting opportunities to develop your skills, expand your network, and build your career. 

Roles And Responsibilities

- Design, develop, enhance, and maintain complex ETL mappings, workflows, data pipelines, and UNIX/Linux shell scripts in enterprise data warehouse and data lake environments
 - Build and optimize batch, real-time, and near-real-time integrations using IDMC or comparable integration technologies
 - Develop advanced SQL and database solutions across SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or comparable relational platforms, including performance tuning and data-quality controls
 - Contribute to dimensional, canonical, and integration data models, and support data warehouses and data marts
 - Build reusable Python, Java, or scripting components for data processing, orchestration, validation, automation, and operational support
 - Design and build enterprise RAG solutions that retrieve trusted content and provide grounded responses using large language models
 - Create and maintain knowledge ingestion pipelines covering document parsing, chunking, metadata enrichment, embedding generation, indexing, retrieval, and citation or source traceability
 - Work with vector databases and semantic-search technologies such as Amazon OpenSearch, PostgreSQL with pgvector, or equivalent platforms
 - Apply prompt engineering, hybrid search, reranking, context management, and retrieval evaluation techniques to improve answer relevance and reduce unsupported responses
 - Build AI-enabled document intelligence solutions for extracting, classifying, summarizing, and validating information from structured and unstructured content
 - Establish evaluation approaches for RAG and Generative AI solutions, including retrieval quality, answer groundedness, accuracy, latency, cost, and regression testing
 - Implement responsible AI and model-risk controls, including data privacy, access control, content safety, human review, auditability, monitoring, and secure handling of confidential information
 - Partner with architecture, security, data governance, model risk, legal/compliance, and business teams to move AI proofs of concept into supportable production services
 - Design and support cloud-based data and AI solutions using relevant AWS services such as S3, RDS/Aurora, Redshift, Glue, Athena, Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS, Kinesis, EMR, Textract, Bedrock, SageMaker, OpenSearch, IAM, KMS, CloudWatch, and Secrets Manager
 - Design and deliver conversational "chat with data" solutions for banking use cases, enabling users to query governed structured and unstructured data through natural-language interfaces with appropriate access controls, source traceability, validation, and safeguards against unsupported responses
 - Build resilient, observable, and cost-conscious architectures using infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, automated testing, logging, metrics, and alerting
 - Apply secure cloud engineering patterns for network connectivity, encryption, secrets, least-privilege access, service integration, and operational recovery
 - Provide technical knowledge and understandings across design, development, testing, implementation, release, and production-support activities
 - Create and review functional designs, detailed technical designs, data mappings, interface specifications, runbooks, and operational documentation
 - Gather and document business requirements, assess current technology and processes, and recommend practical target-state solutions
 - Coordinate with IT leads, developers, testers, operations, and business stakeholders to ensure deliverables meet functional, non-functional, security, and control expectations
 - Participate in production rollouts using change-control processes, clear documentation, stakeholder communication, and implementation validation
 - Resolve production defects and incidents within defined service-level expectations; lead root-cause analysis and preventive remediation
 - Mentor engineers, promote engineering standards, conduct design and code reviews, and encourage reusable patterns and continuous improvement

Job Requirements

Bachelors' Degree (or foreign equivalent degree) in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Experience in the financial services or banking industry is preferred. 

Minimum Qualifications

- 10-15 years of hands-on experience in data engineering, ETL, databases, SQL, and UNIX/Linux environments
 - 8+ years of data integration experience in a lead or senior engineering role, preferably within banking or financial services
 - 6+ years of hands-on experience working as a Data Engineer, designing, developing, and supporting scalable data pipelines and data-processing solutions using AWS services
 - 8+ years of experience with IDMC or a comparable enterprise ETL/data-integration platform, including batch and real-time or near-real-time patterns. 
 - 5+ years of hands-on programming or scripting experience using Python, Java, or a comparable language
 - Strong experience with one or more relational database platforms and advanced SQL, including performance tuning and troubleshooting
 - Working knowledge of AWS data, integration, security, and serverless services
 - Demonstrated understanding of Generative AI concepts, embeddings, vector search, RAG architecture, knowledge bases, prompt engineering, and LLM integration patterns
 - Experience producing technical designs and leading delivery through development, testing, release, and production support
 - Hands-on experience delivering a RAG, semantic-search, conversational AI, or enterprise knowledge-base solution from proof of concept through production
 - Experience with Amazon Bedrock knowledge bases or agents, Amazon SageMaker, Amazon OpenSearch, PostgreSQL/pgvector, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or comparable frameworks and platforms
 - Experience with document-processing services and libraries, including OCR, layout-aware extraction, chunking, metadata management, and source citation
 - Knowledge of LLMOps/MLOps practices, including prompt and model versioning, automated evaluation, observability, feedback loops, performance monitoring, and cost controls
 - Understanding of data governance, AI governance, model risk, privacy, security, and regulatory expectations relevant to financial services
 - Experience with ER/Studio, JIRA, enterprise schedulers such as Autosys, and Agile/Waterfall delivery methods
 - Experience with Big Data and streaming technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, Hive, Kinesis, or EMR
 - Experience with Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool and CI/CD pipelines
 - Strong communication, facilitation, analytical, and stakeholder-management skills

Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) is an equal opportunity employer. We view our employees as our key assets as they are fundamental to our long-term growth and success. MUFG is committed to hiring based on merit and organsational fit, regardless of race, religion or gender.

Description

The Amazon Travel & Events (AT&E) Tech team, part of Finance Automation, is driving a multi-year transformation of the end-to-end Travel & Expense experience for over 500, 000 Amazon employees across 64 countries. We are consolidating previously fragmented travel, events, payments, and expense systems into a unified, AI-powered experience within AtoZ, organized around four interconnected modules: Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense. Our platform leverages machine learning, natural language processing, and GenAI to deliver context-aware policy guidance, proactive compliance recommendations, fraud detection, and sustainability intelligence embedded into employee workflows. The transformation eliminates significant administrative burden across the organization while delivering substantial cost savings and recovering employee productivity at scale. 

We are seeking a Software Development Manager (SDM) to lead the development of new services that power the end-to-end travel and expense experience for Amazonians worldwide. You will build and ship solutions across the Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense modules - integrating AI capabilities such as intelligent policy guidance, automated expense categorization, and GenAI-driven workflows into production systems that must work reliably across 64 countries, multiple currencies, and diverse regulatory environments. 

You will partner closely with Product Managers, Software Development Engineers (SDEs), Front-End Engineers (FEEs), and Applied Scientists to translate the platform vision into scalable, high-quality services that simplify how employees travel, host events, and manage expenses. 

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience building and leading teams of software engineers, front-end engineers, and technical program managers, with a proven track record of delivering enterprise-level systems at scale. They will be a strategic thinker who hires and develops exceptional talent, sets clear goals tied to organizational impact, and independently manages both day-to-day execution and long-term roadmap priorities - fostering a high-performance, team-oriented culture. 

Key job responsibilities

As a Software Development Manager, You Will

Technical Leadership & Innovation Shape architectural decisions for next-generation Travel & Expense systems and services that process sensitive financial and employee data across 64 countries Drive adoption of AI technologies - including agentic AI, LLMs, and ML-powered pattern detection - to transform manual travel and expense operations into intelligent, autonomous workflows Design scalable, secure systems with enterprise-grade controls, observability, and auditability built in from day one Build flexible integration patterns that bridge modern and legacy transactional systems across the Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense modules Partner with AWS teams to evaluate and adopt emerging AI capabilities and primitives. 

Team Leadership Lead a high-performing engineering team building solutions that support Travel & Events operations and transactions at massive scale Hire, develop, and retain exceptional engineering talent across backend, frontend, and program management disciplines Set clear goals tied to measurable organizational impact and independently manage both day-to-day execution and long-term roadmap priorities Foster a culture of continuous improvement through data-driven insights, rigorous testing, and robust governance frameworks. 

Impact Transform how 500, 000+ Amazonians plan travel, book events, manage payments, and submit expenses - replacing fragmented, manual processes with a unified AI-powered experience that scales globally Drive measurable operational efficiencies by reducing cycle times, manual touchpoints, and error rates in complex travel and expense workflows Influence the automation and AI strategy for one of Amazon's largest employee-facing platforms. 

A day in the life

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations

MongoDB seeks an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join Enterprise Architecture on a focused team dedicated to AI experimentation. You'll partner with teams across the organization, including Internal Engineering, to explore, prototype, and validate emerging AI capabilities before they become formal roadmap priorities. 

Our ideal candidate: 

- Has 6+ years of professional software engineering experience
 - Deep experience with at least one modern programming language (Python, Typescript, Go, Rust, etc. )

 - Excellent communication skills and comfort collaborating across teams and disciplines

 - Keeps up with emerging AI tooling and models, not just what's already mainstream

Position Expectations:

 - Maintain technical rigor and clear documentation of findings, even for work that doesn't ship

Success Measures:

About MongoDB

Senior Software Engineer, Platform & Infrastructure

Location: Hybrid (India)

Keriton is a healthcare SaaS company focused on improving the safety and efficiency of infant feeding in hospitals. Our platform helps NICU and PICU teams safely prepare, track, and deliver infant feedings while integrating with hospital systems and supporting clinicians nationwide. 

We're a collaborative engineering team where everyone contributes across multiple disciplines. We value curiosity, ownership, automation, and continuous improvement, and we're looking for engineers who enjoy solving a wide variety of technical challenges. 

Position Summary

Keriton is seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Platform & Infrastructure to help build and support the core software and cloud infrastructure that powers our products. 

This is a highly collaborative role that combines backend software engineering with cloud infrastructure, DevOps, automation, and operational support. You'll develop APIs, build cloud environments using Infrastructure as Code, improve deployment pipelines, automate operational processes, and help ensure our platform is secure, reliable, and scalable. 

As a cross-functional engineer, you'll work across multiple areas of the technology stack, partnering closely with software engineers, mobile developers, QA, product management, and implementation teams to deliver reliable software and cloud infrastructure. 

This role is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, lead technical initiatives, influence architecture decisions, and mentor other engineers through technical leadership and collaboration. 

What You'll Do

 - Develop backend functionality using Node. js, JavaScript, and TypeScript. 
 - Design and optimize database interactions and business logic. 
 - Troubleshoot production issues and improve application performance. 
 - Contribute to React Native mobile applications and Angular/React web applications when additional engineering support is needed. 

Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps

- Build and maintain cloud infrastructure using Terraform.

 - Improve and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines for automated builds, testing, and deployments. 
 - Automate infrastructure and operational tasks wherever possible. 
 - Manage application configuration, secrets, and environment provisioning. 
 - Implement monitoring, alerting, logging, and operational dashboards. 
 - Assist with production deployments and release management. 

Platform Engineering

- Improve the reliability, scalability, and security of Keriton's platform. 
 - Participate in architecture discussions and technical planning. 
 - Collaborate with engineers to improve development workflows and tooling. 
 - Assist with security improvements, vulnerability remediation, and platform maintenance. 
 - Support disaster recovery, backup strategies, and high availability initiatives. 
 - Participate in an engineering on-call rotation and production incident response process. 

Quality & Testing

- Build automated tests alongside production code. 
 - Expand test coverage across backend services and infrastructure components. 
 - Help improve engineering quality through automated testing and validation. 

Technical Leadership

- Participate in architecture reviews and technical decision-making. 
 - Identify systemic risks and proactively recommend long-term solutions. 
 - Influence engineering best practices across development, testing, deployment, and operations. 
 - Lead technical investigations and root-cause analysis for complex production issues. 
 - Help mentor engineers through code reviews, technical discussions, and collaboration. 

Healthcare Technology Responsibility

- Develop solutions that support safe, reliable, and auditable clinical workflows used in neonatal and pediatric care environments. 
 - Consider system reliability, data integrity, and patient safety implications when designing software and infrastructure. 
 - Support compliance, security, and audit requirements associated with healthcare technology. 

Technology Stack

Our Primary Technology Stack Includes

- TypeScript / Node. js 22 / Fastify
 - PostgreSQL
 - Microsoft Azure
 - Terraform
 - GitLab CI/CD
 - Docker Compose / Docker Swarm
 - Python
 - Vitest
 - React Native
 - Angular / React

Qualifications

Experience

- 7+ years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - Experience delivering and operating production SaaS applications in cloud-hosted environments. 

Required

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent professional experience. 
 - Strong experience building backend services using TypeScript, Node. js, and modern API frameworks such as Fastify. 
 - Strong SQL skills and experience working with PostgreSQL. 
 - Experience designing and managing cloud infrastructure in Azure using Terraform. 
 - Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitLab. 
 - Experience deploying and operating containerized applications using Docker Compose and/or Docker Swarm. 
 - Experience writing automation and deployment tooling using Python. 
 - Experience implementing automated testing practices using frameworks such as Vitest, Jest, or similar testing platforms. 
 - Familiarity with Linux systems and command-line environments. 
 - Experience using Git and collaborative development workflows. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to manage multiple technical priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Partner with implementation and customer-facing teams to identify and solve operational challenges. 

Preferred

- Experience working with healthcare or HIPAA-compliant applications. 
 - Experience working with clinical workflow systems, healthcare operations, neonatal care environments, or hospital software platforms. 
 - Understanding of patient safety principles and regulated healthcare environments. 
 - Experience with React Native mobile application development. 
 - Experience with Angular and/or React web application development. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes or container orchestration platforms. 
 - Experience with infrastructure security, IAM, networking, and secrets management. 
 - Familiarity with monitoring and observability platforms such as Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, or Azure Monitor. 
 - Experience working in Agile software development environments. 
 - Experience building CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar tools. 

What Success Looks Like

- Builds reliable APIs and cloud infrastructure that enable product teams to move quickly. 
 - Maintains highly available, secure, and observable production environments. 
 - Creates reproducible, scalable infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code. 
 - Automates repetitive operational tasks and improves engineering efficiency. 
 - Responds effectively to production issues and continuously improves platform reliability. 
 - Serves as a trusted technical leader who helps raise engineering standards and accelerates team productivity. 
 - Collaborates across engineering disciplines and willingly contributes wherever needed. 
 - Continuously looks for opportunities to simplify systems and reduce operational overhead. 

Why Join Keriton?

- Help build the platform that powers software improving neonatal and pediatric patient care. 
 - Help shape architecture, engineering practices, and platform strategy in a growing healthcare technology company. 
 - Join a small, collaborative engineering team where you'll have broad technical ownership and influence. 
 - Work across software engineering, cloud infrastructure, automation, and DevOps in a single role.

 - Flexible remote work environment.

Compensation and Benefits: Along with a competitive salary and performance-based incentives, we offer a comprehensive benefits package starting from day one, including medical insurance coverage for employees and their families, gratuity as per statutory norms, and paid time off in accordance with applicable labor laws. 

Join Natus Sensory today. Confidence in every Sense. 

We Offer

In this role, you'll be an innovator and a leader, delivering new functionality for our customers while supporting and modernizing our platform; you will tackle complex engineering challenges at scale, processing millions of transactions daily on a platform that meets aggressive uptime SLAs. 

How You'll Make an Impact

People Leadership

- Lead a cross-functional team of Engineers to design, develop, QA, deploy and maintain the payments platform. 
 - Mentor and grow engineers through regular 1: 1s, actionable feedback, and deliberate stretch opportunities. 
 - Build a safe, accountable culture where high standards and psychological safety coexist.

Technical Leadership

- Spend meaningful time hands-on each week, pairing on complex problems, leading design sessions and pairing on critical issues. 
 - Be the person your team comes to for hard technical calls - you don't defer every decision to a tech lead. 
 - Model engineering excellence through deep, constructive code reviews that teach as well as critique. 
 - Champion responsible, secure adoption of AI tools across the SDLC to accelerate delivery and improve quality. 
 - Play a key role in our architectural direction, evolving our platform to become cloud-native and event-driven. 
 - Continuously explore new technologies to improve our platform and processes. 

Delivery & Operations

- Work with the Product team to translate business requirements into functional, scalable solutions. 
 - Collaborate with your talented peer group to build solutions that are robust, maintainable and future-proof. 
 - Ensure your team delivers reliably, removing friction by unblocking work, reducing tech debt, and streamlining processes to maintain flow. 
 - Ensure availability of the platform through leadership of incident management as required. 
 - Promote resilient architecture and operational excellence across services. 

What You'll Bring

Essential

- Proven track record leading and developing high-performing software engineering teams. 
 - Proven hands-on experience in writing clean, scalable, performant, high quality code. 
 - Deep expertise in modern software engineering practices, cloud platforms, and DevOps approaches including test and deployment automation. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. 
 - A collaborative mindset with a passion for learning and problem-solving. 

Preferred

- Background in supporting highly transactional, highly available, low latency systems. 
 - Experience with C#/. NET and MSSQL are highly advantageous. 

Why WEX?

At WEX, we believe that diversity drives innovation. We are a global company that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Here, you'll find a supportive, inclusive environment where your ideas are valued, and your growth is prioritized. You'll collaborate with teams from around the world, expanding your skills and your horizons. 

We offer flexible work arrangements, professional development opportunities, and a culture that fosters inclusion and belonging. Join us in building the future of payments-together.

data.description:
Job Description

Innovate to solve the world's most important challenges

The Future Is What You Make It. 

When you join Honeywell, you become a member of our global team of thinkers, innovators, dreamers and doers who make the things that make the future. 

There is an immediate opening for a Lead Chemical Engineer in Delhi Engineering Center within Engineering and Projects. This position is an integral part of our global engineering organization and provides a key role in the management of internal resources and transfer of process technology to our customers. 

This position is for Lead Chemical Engineer to provide technical leadership for the UOP technologies along with providing Engineering solutions to diverse technical problems. Lead Chemical Engineer will provide technical expertise on Sch A projects, maintain and improve design tools / documentation, bring in insightful/ innovative approach to advancement of existing technology along with developing new technologies while working closely with R&D and Technical Services and be involved in supporting Services in trouble shooting efforts that need Engineering expertise. Lead Chemical Engineer will provide mentoring and motivation to enhance the skills of less experienced engineers. 

Job Accountabilities

Responsibilities of the position are as follows: 

- Provide engineering design expertise for a group of related processes or technologies, including being the point of contact in IPL Engg for the design related issues originating related to respective technologies. 
 - Abide by and communicate changes in technical standards, policies, and procedures within assigned area. 
 - Provide Process design expertise throughout the duration of Engineering projects, including Proposal phase designs, Basic Engineering for new unit designs & revamps including Post-schedule A. 
 - Support Sales/Sales Support for tailoring UOP's offering to ensure that it is aligned with customer expectations and requirements. 
 - Provide innovative solutions for the changing needs of UOP's customer base and implement those solutions/modifications to our technology offerings.

 - Ensure that all projects in the specific technology area are properly analyzed for hazards using HAZOP techniques. Ensure that PHAs exist for all sold processes and initiate them for all new or modified technologies before the 1st design is completed 
 - Perform/Review the design and technical modifications to improve UOP's technology offering. 
 - Interact closely with other Technical Experts, like Skills Specialists, Technical Services & R&D to come up with the solutions to complex problems. 
 - Keep up to date with customer needs and lead the technology advancements within assigned area, communicate changes to others, and incorporate relevant changes into UOP's design tools/documentation. 
 - Participate and lead the technology development in respective technology area 
 - Support technical services in the resolution of problems in operating units where Engineering expertise is required. 
 - Provide Process Design expertise in internal and external HAZOP studies of Honeywell UOP delivered process units 
 - Coach less experienced engineers to enhance their technology specific skills and understanding 
 - Present in Internal UOP Conferences on updates relating to the process design fundamentals & developments and engineering design principles. 
 - Compliance to Honeywell Policies including HS&E, HR, Legal Compliance, Intellectual Property Protection, Integrity & Codes of Conduct

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications: 

- B. E. / B. Tech in Chemical Engineering 
 - 10-15 years of Experience in Oil & Gas / Refining / Petrochemicals industry, majority in process design engineering 
 - Expertise in aspects of Process Engineering such as Process Simulation, Generation of PFD, P&ID & Equipment Specs, Hydraulic Calculation, Process Control, Project Documentation etc. 
 - Strong familiarization with UOP engineering work processes and inter-discipline interactions 
 - Strong written, verbal and interpersonal communications skills and presentation skills

Additional Qualifications

- Significant experience in Refining and/or Petrochemicals Technologies 
 - Expertise in use and output analysis of simulation and design software such as UNISIM, HTRI etc. 

Unique Aspects Of Position

- Ability to prioritize and adjust to changing priorities, manage multiple tasks, support tool infrastructure, development and digitization 
 - Coordination with other disciplines (R&D, TS, Business, Sales & Technology Sales) within UOP 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, develop, and mentor others. 
 - Ability to analyze and solve complex and challenging problems. 
 - Self-driven and always looking to improve on the current best practices or technology offering. 
 - Strong communication and presentation skills. 
 - Strong internal and external customer facing skills. 
 - Up to 25% travel required, both domestic and international

About Us

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world's most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50, 000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector's transition from automation to autonomy.

With over 40, 000 projects delivered, Aurigo helps organisations in transportation, water and utilities, healthcare, higher education, and government plan, build, and manage infrastructure with confidence. Why This Role Stands Out

 - Opportunity to define AI engineering standards and set the technical direction for the organization
 - High-visibility role driving enterprise AI transformation journey in an organization that is recognized as one of the Top 25 AI Companies - AI is core to the product, not a side project

Leadership

Drive results through aligning the team with business strategy and goals, establishing clear standards of engineering excellence, and setting clear direction and accountabilities through performance management whilst providing balanced feedback at the most critical times to maintain momentum and a strong sense of ownership. 

Act as a change agent, lead, support and contribute to change programmes, driving and championing the implementation, gaining acceptance to enable an agile and engaged team. 

Feed into workforce plans to ensure the right resourcing requirements for current and future business needs. This includes understanding current and future capability needs and addressing those through development interventions.

data.title: SENIOR DIRECTOR, SOFTWARE ENGINEERING
data.description:
About the TeamThe team builds and operates technology that helps Walmart understand and improve its physical environments, modernize manufacturing, and support the assets that keep stores running. Its work spans digital representations and simulations of stores and supply chain facilities, IoT and automation in meat and dairy plants, and GNFR systems connecting stores, service technicians, and distribution centers. 

What You Will DoOwn Business Outcomes and Engineering Strategy· Start with operational problems: Work directly with store, energy, real estate, manufacturing, and GNFR partners to understand user workflows, operational constraints, and business priorities. Translate these into product requirements and engineering commitments. 

- Set direction and prioritize investment: Define a multi-year technology roadmap with product and business leaders. Balance new capabilities, modernization, technical debt, operational resilience, and cost; make investment tradeoffs explicit. 
 - Measure value after launch: Establish business, functional, and engineering baselines before delivery. Review adoption and realized benefits with operating teams, and use evidence to adjust priorities and solution design. 

Business and Domain ResponsibilitiesDigital Twins and Energy and Asset Intelligence· Connect Walmart's digital twins: Deliver a federated ecosystem connecting 13+ digital twins through a unified connective layer for shared simulation, standardized data, and cross-domain intelligence. Preserve domain ownership while enabling information to work across business boundaries. 

- Create a consistent operational model: Standardize the enterprise ontology for associates, products, spaces, and equipment. Define shared identifiers, relationships, and data contracts that reduce silos and shorten use-case onboarding from months to weeks. 
 - Turn simulation into operating decisions: Scale simulation for HVAC, lighting, and refrigeration energy efficiency; emergency routing; predictive equipment maintenance; and hazard detection across stores and the supply chain. Partner with business owners to validate results and incorporate them into operational workflows. 
 - Lead the technical design: Own architecture decisions for 3D engine integration, core service databases, spatial and equipment data, alarms, and event processing. Establish data freshness, interoperability, and simulation validation practices so users can trust the results. 
 - Scale efficiently: Set baselines for simulation latency, query throughput, and concurrent scenario capacity. Improve compute and storage efficiency while maintaining the performance required by each business use case. 

Modern Manufacturing Engineering· Modernize meat and dairy operations: Direct the engineering strategy and technical roadmap for Walmart's proprietary processing and manufacturing plants. Partner with plant leaders to prioritize operational needs and sequence delivery around production requirements. 

- Connect operational data and workflows: Lead IoT and automation solutions that bring equipment and production information into usable engineering and business applications. Define integrations, data ownership, and exception handling across connected systems. 
 - Improve plant visibility and execution: Enable timely insight into equipment condition and operational exceptions. Work with manufacturing teams to reduce manual intervention and improve the reliability and efficiency of technology-supported production processes. 
 - Deliver safely into live operations: Coordinate testing, site readiness, deployment windows, training, and support with plant and operations partners. Validate changes against operational requirements and establish clear recovery and escalation procedures. 

GNFR Supply Chain and Store Asset Support· Own GNFR warehouse technology: Lead engineering and technical operations for Warehouse Management Systems across the GNFR network, with accountability for dependable inventory and fulfillment workflows. 

- Deliver OneAtlas facility rollouts: Lead technical rollout and integration across upcoming GNFR facilities. Own integration readiness, data migration validation, end-to-end testing, cutover, stabilization, and handoff to operational support. 
 - Support store asset maintenance: Enhance ordering, inventory tracking, and fulfillment of maintenance and replacement parts for commercial HVAC, refrigeration systems, fixtures, and other store assets. Improve visibility for stores and service technicians from request through fulfillment. 
 - Connect procurement and fulfillment: Modernize asset procurement, catalog management, inventory visibility, and order routing between stores, service technicians, and GNFR distribution centers. Address inconsistent data and workflow gaps that delay fulfillment or require manual coordination. 

Technical and Operational LeadershipArchitecture and Technical Depth· Own application and integration design: Guide domain modeling, service boundaries, APIs, event contracts, workflow orchestration, and data architecture across the portfolio. Make deliberate choices on scale, decoupling, extensibility, and maintainability. 

- Engage in the hardest engineering decisions: Work directly with architects and engineers on complex design and production problems. Challenge assumptions, review alternatives, and explain tradeoffs in business and technical terms. 
 - Modernize with continuity: Define incremental migration and integration strategies for existing business systems. Protect data integrity and operational continuity through compatibility planning, reconciliation, controlled rollout, and tested rollback or recovery paths. 
 - Govern data quality and access: Establish clear ownership, validation, lineage, and access controls for equipment, location, catalog, inventory, and operational event data. Partner with security and relevant business teams on privacy, security, and compliance requirements. 

Engineering Excellence and Production Ownership· Own the full development lifecycle: Set expectations for design reviews, code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, documentation, and production readiness. Cover integration, performance, resilience, and critical business workflows in validation. 

- Run reliable business services: Define service-level objectives and agreements that reflect operational criticality. Establish end-to-end observability across applications, integrations, and business flows, including detection of stalled or incomplete processing. 
 - Lead incident prevention and recovery: Build clear on-call ownership, runbooks, escalation paths, and recovery procedures. Review incidents with business partners, address recurring causes, and test continuity and disaster recovery plans. 
 - Improve performance and unit economics: Use telemetry, profiling, and capacity analysis to improve latency, throughput, and resource utilization. Manage cloud, storage, and software costs against the business value and workload served. 
 - Eliminate operational toil: Automate repetitive support, data validation, deployment, and recovery tasks. Measure reductions in manual effort and failure rates while retaining appropriate controls for actions affecting live operations. 

Organizational Leadership and Execution· Build and develop the organization: Design teams with clear ownership and appropriate spans and layers. Hire and develop engineering managers, architects, and senior technical contributors across software, data, IoT, and systems engineering. 

- Set a high performance standard: Run consistent goal setting, coaching, calibration, promotion, and performance management. Build succession plans and strengthen both technical and people leadership. 
 - Establish execution mechanisms: Translate strategy into OKRs, milestones, dependency plans, and regular business reviews. Surface risks early, resolve cross-team dependencies, and maintain clear accountability for commitments and benefits. 
 - Influence across functions: Align executive stakeholders in Supply Chain, Real Estate, Store Operations, Manufacturing, Product, and Global Technology. Communicate decisions, investment needs, progress, and risks clearly to technical and business audiences. 
 - Model Walmart values: Respect the Individual, Act with Integrity, Serve our Customers and Members, and Strive for Excellence. Create an inclusive environment where associates can challenge assumptions, learn, and take ownership. 

What You Will BringMinimum Qualifications· Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 

- 15+ years of software engineering and systems architecture experience, including at least 5 years leading large-scale, multi-team engineering organizations at Director level or above. 
 - A proven record of delivering enterprise business applications and distributed systems, with experience in data integration or federation and complex cross-system workflows. 
 - Demonstrated experience in supply chain technologies, specifically Warehouse Management Systems and enterprise asset management. 
 - Experience leading engineering managers, architects, and senior technical contributors, including hiring, organization design, talent development, and performance management. 
 - Evidence of translating business problems into technical requirements and delivering measurable improvements in operational outcomes, service reliability, performance, or cost. 
 - Strong architecture and engineering judgment across APIs, event-driven systems, databases, integration patterns, and the full software development lifecycle.

Cohesity is the leader in AI-powered data security. Over 13, 600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas' enterprise data protection business, the company's solutions secure and protect data on-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe. 

We've been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture. 

Want to join the leader in AI-powered data security?

Cohesity is looking for a Front End Software Engineer to join one of our largest teams in Cloud Vertical. With millions of documents, terabytes of emails, and endless Teams conversations, we deal with unprecedented data volumes that require unique strategies and algorithms to process data efficiently. Keeping pace with the changing nature of products while ensuring seamless protection is a puzzle we solve every day. Our team tackles these challenges head-on with creativity, technical expertise, and a passion for excellence. Through mentorship, cross-training, and constant learning, you'll grow your skills in ways you never imagined. We are a passionate team of customer obsessed and quality focused engineers with a desire to disrupt the way organizations manage and protect their data, to help them unleash the maximum value locked in their data. We are looking for an outstanding UI Engineer to expand our team of UI engineers that are excited about building quality products and delivering value to customers through simplifying the world of data management. 

How You'll Spend Your Time Here

As part of this team, you will design and build massively distributed systems at web-scale. You'll be building the UI that is closest to the customers when they are interacting with Cohesity's hyper-converged, highly-scalable storage clusters.
