data.title: Lead Full Stack Software Engineer (807)
data.description:
At Protegrity, we lead innovation by using AI and quantum-resistant cryptography to transform data protection across cloud-native, hybrid, on-premises, and open source environments. We leverage advanced cryptographic methods such as tokenization, format-preserving encryption, and quantum-resilient techniques to protect sensitive data. As a global leader in data security, our mission is to ensure that data isn't just valuable but also usable, trusted, and safe. 

Protegrity offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of innovation and collaboration, with the ability to make a meaningful impact on the industry while working alongside some of the brightest minds. Together, we are redefining how the world safeguards data, enabling organizations to thrive in a GenAI era where data is the ultimate currency. If you're ready to shape the future of data security, Protegrity is the place for you. 

Role Overview

As a Lead Software Engineer, Platform Services (Back-end Focus) you will serve as a senior technical leader and hands-on individual contributor within the (UIUX)Front-End organisation, with a strong emphasis on back-end services, common platform capabilities, API design, and cloud-native delivery. 

This role will spend much of its time designing and implementing back-end services, microservices, and platform capabilities, while collaborating across the full application stack when needed. The primary focus is on designing and building scalable services, APIs, deployment architectures, integration frameworks, and shared platform capabilities that support multiple Protegrity products. While familiarity with modern front-end technologies is valuable, this is not a UI-specialist role. 

You will own and evolve shared platform services, APIs, distributed systems, and integration capabilities that enable product interoperability, common platform functionality, cloud-native deployment patterns, and future platform scalability across Protegrity's product portfolio. In addition, working with UIUX Engineers, Architects, DevOps, QA, Product Management, and cross-functional engineering teams. 

Success in this role requires strong technical ownership, practical architecture judgment, clean production-grade code, and systems that are reliable, testable, scalable, and maintainable. You should be comfortable working across the full software development lifecycle, from architecture and implementation through testing, deployment, observability, and operational support. While this role partners closely with DevOps its primary focus remains software engineering, platform services, and scalable application architecture. 

What You'll Do

- Design and implement microservices that support Protegrity's next-generation UI Shell Platform architecture, ensuring services are secure, scalable, reusable, and aligned to long-term platform strategy. 
 - Define and influence long-term service architecture, integration patterns, and technical standards across multiple products, helping drive consistency, scalability, and operational excellence throughout the platform. 
 - Develop production-grade software using Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript, with a strong emphasis on back-end services, APIs, distributed systems, authentication, authorization, and platform capabilities. 
 - Lead implementation for complex, high-impact systems, balancing performance, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and ease of integration across multiple products. 
 - Define and improve service integration patterns between front-end and back-end components, ensuring predictable contracts, resilient workflows, and scalable product delivery. 
 - Partner with front-end engineers to deliver cohesive end-to-end user experiences, contributing to modern UI applications where needed while primarily driving back-end and platform service implementation. 
 - Build testable, production-grade software with automated test coverage, code quality validation, and CI/CD-driven delivery practices. Contribute to containerized application deployment patterns and collaborate with DevOps teams to ensure reliable, repeatable software delivery. 
 - Promote reliability, observability, and troubleshooting best practices across platform services, helping teams diagnose issues, improve system visibility, and maintain healthy service operations. 
 - Identify and reduce friction across build, review, testing, release, and operational workflows to support predictable, repeatable, and lower-stress delivery. 
 - Apply GenAI and AI-assisted development practices to improve engineering productivity, accelerate workflows, and support new product capabilities where appropriate. 

What You'll Need

- 6+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, building, testing, and operating production-grade software systems, with strong expertise in back-end development, API design, distributed systems, microservices, and scalable platform capabilities. 
 - Demonstrated success designing and evolving platform architectures, including microservices, API ecosystems, service integration patterns, distributed systems, and cloud-native applications that support scalable product growth. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, with a proven track record of building high-quality back-end services, APIs, and distributed applications. Working knowledge of modern front-end technologies, including React, HTML5, and CSS, to effectively collaborate across the full application stack. 
 - Strong computer science and software architecture fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, system design, distributed systems, integration patterns, scalability considerations, and architecture trade-offs. 
 - Experience designing and integrating cloud-native applications using technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, and modern CI/CD pipelines, with the ability to contribute to software delivery while partnering effectively with DevOps and Cloud Engineering teams. 
 - Experience working across front-end and back-end boundaries, including API contracts, authentication and authorisation, data flows, service dependencies, integration behaviour, and troubleshooting complex multi-service environments. 
 - Proven technical leadership and collaboration skills, including influencing technical direction, documenting architectural decisions, mentoring peers, driving engineering best practices, and aligning teams around scalable, maintainable solutions. 

Nice To Have

- Experience building or supporting shared platform services, common capabilities, or developer tooling used across multiple products and engineering teams. 
 - Familiarity with public cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure, including deploying and supporting cloud-native applications. 
 - Experience supporting containerized application delivery using technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm. 
 - Exposure to data security, privacy, compliance, cryptography, or enterprise security-focused products. 
 - Familiarity with GenAI, LLM-powered product capabilities, AI-assisted development workflows, or agentic engineering tools. 
 - Experience with observability, monitoring, performance testing, load testing, and production support for distributed systems. 
 - Working knowledge of code quality, security scanning, artifact management, and software quality platforms such as SonarQube, JFrog Xray, or similar tools. 

Should you accept this position, you will be required to consent to and successfully complete a background investigation. This may include, subject to local laws, verification of extended education and additional criminal and civil checks. 

We offer a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits with generous vacation and holiday time off. All employees are also provided access to ongoing learning & development. 

Ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace is our priority. We are committed to an environment of acceptance where you are free to bring your full self to work. 

All qualified applicants and current employees will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability or veteran status. 

Please reference Section 12: Supplemental Notice for Job Applicants in our Privacy Policy to inform you of the categories of personal information that we collect from individuals who inquire about and/or apply to work for Protegrity USA, Inc. , or its parent company, subsidiaries or affiliates, and the purposes for which we use such personal information.

data.title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Meet the Team

Join Cisco's Enterprise AI team, the core group enabling Generative AI powered experiences across Cisco. Our mission is to build secure, scalable AI platforms that empower teams to safely develop, deploy, and operationalize AI-powered solutions. We operate at the intersection of applied AI, cloud infrastructure and security - partnering across engineering, security, compliance, and product teams to bring trusted AI to life at an enterprise scale. 

We are a fast-growing, highly collaborative team of platform engineers, AI engineers, and data scientists who value technical depth, ownership, and pragmatic execution. What makes this team exciting is the opportunity to define how secure Generative AI is built and governed inside a global technology leader. 

As a Senior SRE in our India hub, you will tackle complex networking and service mesh challenges across a global footprint. Your expertise in Anthos and Istio will be critical in maintaining the high-availability platform that powers Cisco's most advanced AI initiatives. 

Your Impact

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Overview

Welcome to SITA!

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry. 

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2, 500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. Are you ready to love your job? The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA. 

About The Role & Team

We are seeking a hands-on Lead Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) with strong expertise across application support, Kubernetes environments, and CI/CD pipelines. This role is responsible for ensuring the reliability, performance, and observability of production systems through deep technical analysis and proactive engineering. 

The successful candidate will lead incident and problem investigations, identify root causes, and drive permanent resolutions in close collaboration with Development, Product, and Operations teams. This is an engineering-focused role requiring strong troubleshooting skills, production support experience, and a commitment to continuous service improvement. 

What You Will Do

- Analyze production incidents using logs, metrics, and traces to identify impacted application code and execution paths. 
 - Diagnose system issues and determine whether the root cause is related to application code, configuration, Kubernetes, or infrastructure. 
 - Troubleshoot Kubernetes workloads, including runtime behavior, networking, health probes, and failure scenarios. 
 - Serve as the technical escalation point during critical incidents, providing clear and timely guidance. 
 - Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and drive permanent corrective actions to improve reliability. 
 - Enhance observability and alerting to improve issue detection and resolution. 
 - Partner with Development and Platform teams to resolve systemic issues and strengthen service reliability. 
 - Automate repetitive operational tasks and promote engineering best practices. 
 - Assess the impact of deployments on production environments through CI/CD pipeline expertise. 
 - Monitor system performance and reliability, identifying opportunities to improve resilience and reduce outages. 

Qualifications

ABOUT YOUR SKILLS

- Min 8 years' experience in SRE, DevOps, or Production Engineering supporting high-availability systems. 
 - Strong expertise in root cause analysis (RCA) and permanent issue resolution. 
 - Hands-on troubleshooting of production environments using logs, metrics, and traces. 
 - Strong knowledge of Java and/or . NET applications in production. 
 - Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerized workloads. 
 - Experience with monitoring and observability tools for distributed systems. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and deployment tools (e. g. , Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions). 
 - Scripting and automation skills using Python, Bash, or similar. 
 - Strong analytical, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience. 

What We Offer

We value diversity, operating in 200 countries and spanning 60 languages and cultures. Our inclusive offices are comfortable and fun, with the flexibility to work from home. Join our team and step closer to your best life. 

🏡 Flex Week: Hybrid (2 days from home and 3 days in the office. )

🌿Employee Wellbeing: We've got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health a personalized platform that supports a range of well-being needs.

Context

We are seeking applications for the position of Chief Traction Distribution, SCADA and MIMIC Panel Integration Expert for Phase-I Extension and Phase-II Projects of Pune Metro Rail Project (PMRP)

The project involves the engagement of a General Consultant (GC) for providing comprehensive consultancy services for the implementation of the Pune Metro Rail Project - Phase-I Extension and Phase-II. The scope broadly covers project management, design and engineering review, construction supervision, contract management, quality assurance, safety, testing and commissioning, and overall monitoring of the works. 

Missions/Main Duties

- Traction Power System
 - Review and supervise the design and implementation of the Metro traction power supply system. 
 - Review traction substation (TSS), auxiliary/receiving substations and associated equipment. 
 - Review technical specifications, SLDs, protection schemes and equipment layouts. 
 - Ensure proper interface between traction power, OHE/third rail and other electrical systems. 
 - Monitor installation, testing and commissioning of traction equipment. 
 - Electrical Distribution System
 - Review HT/LT distribution arrangements for stations, depots and other project facilities. 
 - Review RMU, HT panels, transformers, LT panels, DG/UPS interfaces and associated protection systems. 
 - Verify load calculations, power distribution diagrams and equipment ratings. 
 - Ensure reliable and coordinated power supply to stations and operational systems. 
 - SCADA System

 - Review RTU/PLC, communication network, servers, workstations and data acquisition systems. 
 - Verify monitoring and control of traction and auxiliary electrical equipment. 
 - Review SCADA I/O lists, point schedules, control philosophy and alarm/event management. 
 - Ensure integration with OCC and station control systems. 
 - MIMIC Panel Integration
 - Review the design and functionality of MIMIC panels at OCC/SCADA control locations. 
 - Ensure correct representation of electrical network topology and equipment status. 
 - Verify indications for breakers, isolators, feeders, transformers and other critical equipment. 
 - Ensure proper interface between MIMIC panels, SCADA and field equipment. 
 - Witness functional and integrated testing of MIMIC panels. 
 - Design & Technical Document Review
 - Review: 
 - SLDs and schematics
 - Protection coordination studies
 - Equipment specifications
 - Cable schedules
 - Interface drawings
 - SCADA architecture
 - I/O lists
 - Control philosophy
 - MIMIC panel drawings
 - Communication/network diagrams
 - Review contractor technical submissions, calculations, method statements and shop drawings. 
 - Interface Coordination

- Rolling Stock
 - OHE/Third Rail
 - Civil & Structural
 - Station E&M
 - Signalling
 - Telecom
 - AFC
 - Fire & Life Safety
 - Depot systems
 - OCC/Operations
 - SCADA and communication teams

Particular attention should be given to traction power-OHE/third rail, electrical distribution-station systems, SCADA-field equipment and SCADA-OCC interfaces. 

- Construction Supervision
 - Inspect installation of traction and distribution equipment. 
 - Monitor contractor compliance with approved drawings and specifications. 
 - Review site installation quality and identify non-conformities. 
 - Attend technical inspections and resolve site engineering issues. 
 - Monitor progress of critical electrical and SCADA works. 
 - Testing & Commissioning
 - Witness FAT, SAT, pre-commissioning and commissioning of traction and distribution equipment. 
 - Review protection relay testing and functional tests. 
 - Witness SCADA point-to-point testing. 
 - Verify commands, indications, alarms, interlocks and equipment status. 
 - Witness SCADA-MIMIC-field equipment integrated testing. 
 - Support Integrated Testing & Commissioning (ITC) before revenue operation. 
 - Safety & Protection
 - Ensure electrical systems comply with approved safety requirements and applicable standards. 
 - Review protection coordination and interlocking arrangements. 
 - Verify emergency tripping and isolation facilities. 
 - Ensure safe operating procedures for traction and distribution systems. 
 - Contractor & Progress Management
 - Monitor contractor performance and programme. 
 - Participate in technical and progress meetings. 
 - Review RFIs, technical deviations and proposed modifications. 
 - Assist PMC/client in resolving critical technical issues. 
 - Monitor procurement and delivery of critical traction/SCADA equipment. 
 - Handover & Documentation
 - Review As-Built Drawings. 
 - Review testing and commissioning records. 
 - Verify SCADA database and final I/O documentation. 
 - Review O&M manuals, maintenance schedules and spare-parts lists. 
 - Verify training of operations and maintenance personnel. 
 - Support final inspection, taking-over and Defect Liability Period activities. 

Profile/Skills

- Graduate in Electrical - B. tech 20+years in rail related majar infrastructure project / railway/ Metro. 
 - Chief Traction, Distribution, SCADA & MIMIC Panel Integration Expert shall be responsible for leading the technical review, supervision, interface coordination, testing and commissioning of traction power, electrical distribution, SCADA and MIMIC panel systems for the Metro Rail Project. The expert shall review designs, SLDs, protection schemes, technical specifications, SCADA architecture, I/O lists, MIMIC panel drawings and interface requirements. 
 - supervise installation and testing; ensure integration with OHE/third rail, rolling stock, signalling, telecom, station E&M and OCC systems.

On-site

data.description:
Strata Information Group (SIG) is a trusted leader in higher‐education technology consulting, supporting colleges and universities with ERP/SIS modernization, digital transformation, CRM, cybersecurity, and strategic advisory services. As a long‐standing and deeply embedded partner within the higher‐education sector, SIG brings together technical depth, operational insight, and a culture rooted in integrity, collaboration, and exceptional client service. Our heritage is built on hands‐on expertise, genuine relationships, and a commitment to delivering value with humility and excellence-values that continue to define us as we scale. 

Senior Technical Architect - Higher Education Platforms

Location: Pune, India | Hybrid

Employment: Full-time, engaged through SIG's Employer of Record in India

Base salary: ₹25-37 lakh per annum (LPA)

Experience: 10+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years in consulting or professional services delivery for external clients

Reports to: Lead - India Centre of Excellence

Working hours: Flexible, with 3-4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern morning. Typically, your day will finish around 9: 00-10: 00 pm IST, with a correspondingly later start. 

Build the solution. Set the technical standard. 

Strata Information Group (SIG) is a US-based leader in higher education technology consulting. We help colleges and universities modernise their student information, HR and finance systems through ERP/SIS implementation, integration, digital transformation, CRM and cybersecurity work. 

We are building our first engineering Centre of Excellence in Pune. This is a founding-team role: you will help establish how the team designs and builds. You will own technical architecture across application integrations, Ellucian Experience Cards, workflow automation and data migration-and write a meaningful part of the production code yourself. This role carries delivery accountability, not just design accountability. 

Ellucian experience is not required. Deep integration expertise, direct US client delivery experience and the ability to learn a new platform quickly are essential. 

What you will do

- Own architecture and delivery: Design secure integrations, web applications, identity solutions and workflow automation on Ellucian platforms. Document practical designs that work within platform, infrastructure and timeline constraints, and stay hands-on with production code. 
 - Build platform expertise: Learn Ellucian Ethos, Experience, Workflow, Banner/Colleague data structures and the API catalogue, then turn that knowledge into reusable patterns and documentation. 
 - Lead and mentor: Run architecture and code reviews, resolve complex technical problems and help new engineers become productive through hands-on guidance. 
 - Work directly with US clients: Lead technical discovery, explain designs and trade-offs, and support project scoping, estimation and technical proposals. 
 - Lead data migration: Own source analysis, mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation and cutover into Ellucian platforms. 
 - Deliver and improve: Meet your assigned annual billable utilisation target alongside mentoring and design reviews. Use AI coding assistants responsibly and contribute to SIG's internal AI development tools. 

What you will bring

- Engineering and consulting experience: 10+ years of professional software engineering, including at least 5 years delivering for external clients in consulting or professional services. Direct experience leading technical discussions, presenting designs and managing expectations with US-based clients is required. 
 - Deep integration and API expertise: Experience designing, securing, versioning and operating integrations at scale-not simply consuming REST endpoints. Strong command of synchronous REST, event-driven, message-based, batch, file-based and ETL integrations; point-to-point and hub models; JSON, pagination, rate limits, idempotency, retries, versioning and webhooks. 
 - Identity and security: Hands-on SAML 2. 0 and single sign-on (SSO), including troubleshooting failed assertions; working knowledge of OIDC, identity providers, federation, attribute and role mapping, and provisioning. Strong OAuth 2. 0, JWT, API key, token and scope design, least-privilege service-account access, secrets handling and secure data exchange skills. 
 - Hands-on web engineering: Expert-level TypeScript and React. js, including component architecture, state management and performance; deep server-side Node. js, including API design, asynchronous patterns, error handling, dependency management and production debugging. Ability to design end-to-end web applications across the client, APIs, services, data, caching, sessions and deployment. 
 - Workflow and data delivery: Business process automation expertise and hands-on experience with a workflow or business process management (BPM) tool. Experience planning and executing enterprise data migrations, plus SQL, relational data modelling, Git and modern continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) practices. 
 - Technical leadership and learning: Demonstrated architecture leadership and mentoring, sound judgement within delivery constraints, clear written and spoken English, and a specific example of learning an unfamiliar platform quickly. Fluency with AI-assisted development, including verifying and explaining AI-generated output before release. 

Preferred Experience-not Essential

- Ellucian Banner, Colleague, Ethos, Experience or Workflow; higher education technology; or enterprise resource planning (ERP), student information systems (SIS), human resource management systems (HRMS) or finance platforms. 
 - Postman, OpenAPI/Swagger, GraphQL or API gateways; AWS S3, SFTP and secure file exchange. 
 - AI/ML tools, large language model (LLM) APIs, prompt engineering, internal developer tools or AI-assisted automated testing. 
 - Low-code/no-code platforms, distributed teams across time zones, or pre-sales solution design and estimation. 

Your first months at SIG

We will provide access to Ellucian training and certification, with platform badges targeted within your first 60 days; direct knowledge transfer from SIG's experienced US consultants; and a defined onboarding deliverable so you start building real solutions early. We expect you to start contributing within two months and to be teaching others within six. 

Outside the required US overlap window, you manage your own hours. We care about what you deliver, not when you are logged in. If you want to keep building, help engineers develop and shape a new team's technical standards, this role is for you. 

Strata Information Group is an equal opportunity employer. 

The listed salary range for this position is indicative and subject to adjustment based on the candidate's unique skills and location. Final compensation will be determined through mutual agreement between the successful candidate and SIG. 

SIG is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer

data.title: Software Engineer | GO Programming, Cloud-Native, PPPOE/IPOE, Microservices, DHCPV4/DHCPV6 | 8-14 Years
data.description:
Meet the Team

The Cisco cnBNG Control Plane team builds Cisco's cloud-native Broadband Network Gateway - the carrier-grade subscriber-management brain that runs as microservices on the SMI (Subscriber Microservices Infrastructure) / Kubernetes platform and interworks with IOS-XR, Silicon One-based User Plane Functions (UPFs). We power some of the world's largest residential and business broadband deployments, serving millions of subscribers with strict availability and scale requirements. We value technical depth, automation-first engineering, continuous learning, collaborative problem-solving, and responsible adoption of AI-assisted development practices. 

Your Impact

As a Software Engineer on the cnBNG Control Plane, you will own the design, delivery, and end-to-end quality of carrier-grade subscriber-management features in a cloud-native architecture. You will build session-handling, CP-UP separation, redundancy, and scale capabilities that keep millions of subscribers online across Silicon One-based UPFs - and own their unit, integration, system, and scale validation with automation-first practices. You will mentor junior engineers and use modern AI-assisted tools to accelerate development, testing, and debugging. The successful candidate will independently own a significant Control Plane feature area and its unit/integration/system/scale validation and automation, deliver production-quality code and tests, lead sophisticated investigations across CP and Silicon One UPFs, and provide evidence-based release recommendations - while influencing design, mentoring, and using AI-assisted tools responsibly with security and engineering accountability. 

- Design, develop, and maintain cnBNG Control Plane microservices (C/C++/Go) on the SMI/Kubernetes platform, interworking with IOS-XR / Silicon One-based User Plane Functions. 
 - Implement and enhance subscriber-management functionality: PPPoE/IPoE session bring-up, DHCPv4/DHCPv6 (server/proxy/relay), Prefix Delegation, RADIUS/AAA, PAP/CHAP, accounting, Change of Authorization, IPAM, subscriber policy, and QoS. 
 - Develop and harden CP-UP separation over the State Control Interface - session programming, state download/replay, and reconciliation between the Control Plane and Silicon One UPFs. 
 - Build features for scale and high availability: cluster upscale, N: M and geo/warm redundancy (SRG), CP-GR switchover, and subscriber-session continuity during CP-UP communication failures. 
 - Own quality end-to-end: write unit tests and component/integration tests; design and execute system, regression, scale, performance, resiliency, and high-availability tests for your features. 
 - Develop reusable, scalable test automation (Python; pyATS/Genie or equivalent) and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines and regression suites. 
 - Build and maintain containerized/virtual/cloud-based test environments (Docker, Kubernetes, SMI) and validate subscriber-scale, traffic, failover, upgrade/rollback, process-restart, and subscriber-churn scenarios. 
 - Optimize control-plane performance, memory, and convergence for millions of subscribers across large UPF fleets. 
 - Develop and maintain gRPC/REST APIs and YANG/OpenConfig models, plus CLI and model-driven telemetry for configuration and operational visibility. 
 - Troubleshoot sophisticated, distributed issues across CP, Silicon One UPFs, and the SMI/Kubernetes stack; drive RCA using logs, traces, core dumps, RADIUS transactions, and telemetry. 
 - Manage code with Git; participate in code reviews; collaborate with Test Engineering on feature, scale, and HA validation. 
 - Work with architects, DE/DT leads, and PLM to deliver features across the release lifecycle (BC/CC, AC/EC, DEVELOPING, FCS). 
 - Actively use approved AI coding assistants and engineering agents for code generation, unit/automation test creation, static analysis, log analysis, defect triage, and documentation - validating AI-generated output responsibly. 

Minimum Qualifications (Must-Have)

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field. 
 - Experience in systems/embedded or cloud-native software engineering for networking products. 
 - Strong programming in C/C++ and/or Go on Linux; Python for test automation and scripting. 
 - Experience writing unit, integration, system, and scale/performance tests, and building automation (pyATS/Genie or equivalent) integrated into CI/CD and regression pipelines. 
 - Solid understanding of IP networking and subscriber/broadband protocols: PPPoE, IPoE, DHCPv4/v6, RADIUS/AAA, PPP, L2TP. 
 - Knowledge of Cisco Silicon One (SiOne) NPU-based User Plane Functions (UPFs) - data-plane/forwarding architecture, CP-to-UPF programming, and how subscriber sessions map to NPU forwarding. 
 - Cloud-native fundamentals: Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, and service meshes. 
 - Experience building and consuming gRPC/REST APIs and data models (YANG, protobuf). 
 - Distributed-systems concepts: high availability, redundancy, state reconciliation, and scale. 
 - Strong Linux skills; experience with Git, code reviews, debugging, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - AI-assisted engineering is a must: use of AI coding assistants (e. g. , GitHub Copilot) and a working understanding of generative AI, AI agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), reusable AI skills, prompt/context management, and responsible validation of AI-generated output. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with BNG/CUPS, CP-UP separation, SRG geo/warm redundancy, or 5G/BNG converged-core architectures. 
 - Experience with SMI (Subscriber Microservices Infrastructure) or similar cloud-native telco platforms. 
 - Familiarity with Silicon One platform families (Cisco 8000 / ASR 9000 / NCS) as User Planes. 
 - Scale/performance characterization and traffic/subscriber-simulation tools (IXIA/Spirent). 
 - Databases/caching for network state (SQL/NoSQL, key-value stores, etcd); AAA/policy, IPAM at scale, and QoS. 
 - Telemetry, NETCONF/RESTCONF/gNMI, OpenConfig; Aha/Jira API suites. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

data.title: QA AIML Consultant
data.description:
Job Description: AI SDET Engineer

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced AI Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to define and advance quality engineering across web, API, mobile, cloud, and AI-enabled products. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with deep test automation expertise and can validate both deterministic software and probabilistic AI behavior. This role partners closely with Engineering, Product, Design, SRE, Security, and Data/ML teams to build quality into the full delivery lifecycle, improve release confidence, and lead the evolution of our testing strategy, tooling, and people. 

Responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end quality strategy, including risk-based test planning, requirement traceability, coverage analysis, test matrices, release-readiness criteria, and production validation. 
 - Design and maintain scalable automation frameworks for UI, API, mobile, integration, and end-to-end testing using tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, TestNG, and pytest. 
 - Establish maintainable test architecture through modular design, page or screen objects, reusable fixtures, parametrization, test-data management, and appropriate use of BDD, mocking, and stubbing. 
 - Define API and contract-testing practices for REST and GraphQL services using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, or Karate, while promoting effective unit testing and close collaboration with developers. 
 - Automate test execution, reporting, quality gates, and deployment controls in Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps pipelines. 
 - Lead performance, load, reliability, resiliency, and security validation using tools such as k6, JMeter, or Gatling; incorporate chaos testing and OWASP-aligned security checks where appropriate. 
 - Use logs, traces, and metrics from platforms such as ELK, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, and Jaeger to diagnose failures, reproduce production issues, and drive root-cause analysis. 
 - Build automated evaluation harnesses and regression suites for machine-learning models, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation systems, and agentic workflows. 
 - Define quality KPIs and service expectations, including escape rate, flaky-test rate, automation effectiveness, mean time to detect, and release quality; communicate trends and corrective actions to stakeholders. 
 - Create effective defect triage and release-readiness processes, influence product and design decisions, and ensure quality risks are visible and acted upon. 
 - Protect personal and sensitive information through secure test-data generation, access controls, masking, redaction, retention practices, and GDPR/PII-aware validation. 
 - Mentor and lead QA and SDET engineers, contribute to hiring and onboarding, and strengthen engineering practices across distributed cross-functional teams. 

Core Qualifications

- 5+ years of professional experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or an SDET role, with evidence of ownership of complex quality initiatives. 
 - Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Java, C#, or JavaScript/TypeScript, supported by strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, networking, and operating-system fundamentals. 
 - Hands-on experience designing test frameworks and maintainable automation architecture with Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, TestNG, pytest, or comparable tools. 
 - Strong knowledge of test design techniques, risk-based testing, integration and end-to-end strategy, TDD/ATDD practices, requirement traceability, coverage analysis, and test-matrix management. 
 - Experience testing REST and GraphQL APIs and service contracts with Postman, REST Assured, Karate, or equivalent tooling; ability to use mocks and stubs to isolate dependencies. 
 - Practical experience with load and performance testing, reliability or chaos testing, security-testing fundamentals, and OWASP principles. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines and working with Git, Docker, basic Kubernetes concepts, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform. 
 - Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills using logs, distributed traces, metrics, and production observability platforms. 
 - Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, influence decisions, and partner effectively with Development, SRE, Product, Design, Security, and Data/ML teams. 
 - Experience working with quality KPIs and SLAs, supporting release-readiness assessments, and participating in defect triage. 
 - Working knowledge of GDPR and PII obligations, including secure test-data creation, masking, redaction, and least-privilege access. 

AI Testing Expertise

- Experience testing non-deterministic AI systems and translating product expectations into measurable evaluation criteria, representative datasets, scoring rubrics, statistical thresholds, and repeatable acceptance gates. 
 - Ability to evaluate large language model quality across correctness, groundedness, faithfulness, relevance, completeness, consistency, latency, token usage, cost, and failure behavior rather than relying on exact-match assertions alone. 
 - Hands-on understanding of retrieval-augmented generation testing, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval recall and ranking, context relevance, citation accuracy, answer groundedness, and stale or conflicting knowledge. 
 - Experience building golden datasets and regression suites; curating, labeling, versioning, and reviewing evaluation data while preventing leakage, contamination, duplication, and unrepresentative test coverage. 
 - Knowledge of adversarial and safety testing for prompt injection, jailbreaks, indirect injection, sensitive-data disclosure, insecure tool use, hallucinations, harmful content, toxicity, bias, fairness, and model or agent misuse. 
 - Ability to test agentic and tool-calling workflows, including multi-step planning, permissions, memory and state, tool selection, retries, timeouts, partial failures, human approvals, and safe recovery. 
 - Experience validating model, prompt, retrieval, and configuration changes through versioned experiments, reproducible environments, baseline comparisons, confidence intervals, and controlled rollout or canary strategies. 
 - Understanding of model and data drift, feedback-loop risks, online quality monitoring, human-in-the-loop review, and production signals that detect degradation after release. 
 - Familiarity with AI evaluation and observability tools such as OpenAI Evals, promptfoo, Ragas, DeepEval, LangSmith, Langfuse, MLflow, Weights & Biases, or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of AI-specific privacy and security risks, including training-data exposure, model inversion, membership inference, prompt and response logging, retention controls, and safe use of synthetic data. 

Nice-to-Have Skills

- Experience testing mobile, embedded, distributed, event-driven, or highly regulated systems. 
 - Experience with cloud-native testing on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud and with ephemeral test environments managed through Kubernetes and Terraform. 
 - Familiarity with MLOps practices, model registries, feature stores, data validation, experiment tracking, dataset or artifact versioning, and quality-engineering enablement or open-source tooling.

 - Providing hands-on 1st and 2nd Line technical support across a diverse set of applications and services. 
 - Overseeing shift workload, ensuring effective prioritisation and SLA compliance. 
 - Providing guidance, mentoring, and real‐time support coaching to the 2nd Line Engineers on shift.

data.title: Design Manager – Mechanical (Water & Wastewater Infrastructure)
data.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. 

Your impact

As a Design Manager - Mechanical Infrastructure, you will lead the multidisciplinary mechanical design delivery for complex water and wastewater infrastructure projects, including pump stations, water treatment plants (WTPs), wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs), desalination systems, and associated mechanical/process systems. 

You will be responsible for driving design integration, technical excellence, quality assurance, constructability, risk management, and programme certainty across all stages of project delivery-from concept through detailed and construction design. 

Working closely with Project Managers, Discipline Leads, and Sector/Regional Leadership, you will plan, coordinate, and assure the technical execution of mechanical design packages, while mentoring and developing engineers across global teams. 

Key duties include

- Lead and manage mechanical design for water/wastewater pump stations, treatment plants, and associated mechanical/process systems. 
 - Develop project-specific mechanical design strategies ensuring multidisciplinary integration, alignment with project requirements, and risk mitigation. 
 - Oversee preparation and coordination of mechanical deliverables
 - Equipment sizing & selection
 - Mechanical design calculations
 - Pumping system calculations & hydraulic checks
 - P&IDs, equipment layouts, plant general arrangements
 - Mechanical data sheets and specifications
 - Review and validate vendor documents, datasheets, and shop drawings; ensure integration with overall design. 
 - Lead mechanical engineering inputs for Design for Design‐Build (D for DB) and EPC delivery models constructability, staging, installation methodology, O&M requirements. 
 - Support and lead HAZOP/HAZID, value engineering, risk workshops, failure mode assessments, and operability/maintainability reviews. 
 - Manage and own key design management documents
 - Project Responsibility Matrix
 - Basis of Design
 - Overall Design Programme
 - Schedule of Deliverables
 - Design Risk Register
 - Design Change Register
 - Coordinate with process, civil, electrical, ICA, BIM, structural, and architectural teams for holistic design delivery. 
 - Engage with clients through workshops, presentations, design reviews, and technical clarifications. 
 - Ensure design outputs comply with quality standards, codes, project specifications, and HSE requirements. 
 - Support the preparation of technical proposals, LOE estimates, design execution plans, and project scheduling. 
 - Mentor, coach, and provide performance feedback to engineers to strengthen organisational capability. 
 - Collaborate with global delivery centres to ensure consistent design practices and effective resource utilisation. 

We welcome applications from qualified professionals currently based overseas who are open to relocating to India. Relocation support may be provided for exceptional candidates having extensive experience in delivering Design Build water infrastructure projects. 

Here's what you'll need

Key software tools

- PipeFlo, AFT Fathom/Impulse, WaterGEMS (for hydraulics interface), vendor pump selection software
 - Planning & Coordination Primavera P6, MS Project
 - Collaboration ACC, ProjectWise, SharePoint, MS Teams
 - BIM (exposure advantageous) Revit, Plant 3D, OpenPlant Modeler, Navisworks, Revizto

Key Behaviours

- Builds strong, collaborative relationships across multidisciplinary teams. 
 - Confident, approachable leader with strong client‐facing presence. 
 - Demonstrates leadership through coordination, clarity, and proactive communication. 
 - Encourages teams to develop integrated, constructible, and high‐quality mechanical design solutions. 
 - Organised, disciplined, and able to resolve complex mechanical issues in a timely manner. 
 - Champions a strong culture of safety, quality, and innovation. 
 - Flexible, dependable, and capable of performing in fast‐paced, contractor‐integrated environments. 

Work Experience

- 15+ years of experience in mechanical engineering design and design management within water/wastewater infrastructure projects. 
 - Proven leadership of multidisciplinary teams delivering mechanical design for
 - Water/wastewater pump stations
 - WTPs/WWTPs and associated process units
 - Chemical dosing systems
 - Sludge handling systems
 - High‐lift/low‐lift pumping systems
 - Treatment mechanical equipment (screens, clarifiers, blowers, compressors, valves, etc. )
 - Strong understanding of pumping systems NPSH, system curves, pump selection, surge analysis interface, pipework design, and hydraulic analysis. 
 - Demonstrated capability in Design for Design‐Build constructability reviews, contractor interface, installation sequencing, technical risk mitigation. 
 - Experience coordinating mechanical design within a BIM‐enabled environment. 
 - Strong ability to interpret P&IDs, hydraulic profiles, process input documents, engineering drawings, and specifications. 
 - Experience with vendor coordination, MTO/BoQ preparation, equipment procurement support, and technical bid evaluations. 
 - Experience with change management, design risk management, and impacts assessment. 
 - Ability to support bids, proposals, LOE estimates, and multidisciplinary design execution plans. 
 - Experience with alternate delivery models (DB, EPC, CMAR, PPP) is an asset. 
 - Strong interest in digital delivery, automation, and continuous improvement of mechanical workflows. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical (or related discipline)
 - Master's degree in relevant field is advantageous
 - Professional Engineer (PE) / Chartered Mechanical Engineer (CEng) is advantageous

Preferred Attributes

- Experience delivering large, complex water/wastewater facilities and pumping systems. 
 - Exposure to brownfield upgrades, shutdown/staging, and commissioning planning. 
 - Knowledge of sustainability principles and low‐carbon mechanical design approaches. 
 - Experience working with international codes, standards, and global delivery frameworks. 
 - Ability to operate effectively in fast‐paced, contractor‐integrated environments

Hybrid Work Expectation Average office presence of 3 days per week or as per Company Policy, with travel for client/site meetings and occasional team meetings. 

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients' expectations. 

Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you. 

At Jacobs it's all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work. 

Your application experience is important to us, and we're keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

data.title: System Software Engineer – SoC Validation
data.description:
Job Overview

Are you interested in understanding how complex SoCs work and using software to find problems in real silicon?

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our SoC Post-Silicon Validation team. We use Linux and software as powerful tools to exercise, validate, and debug advanced SoCs used in Infrastructure and Data Center systems. 

You will work at the intersection of hardware and software, where you can see the direct impact of the code you develop. We will give you opportunities to expand your knowledge of SoC architecture, Linux, system software, and silicon validation while working alongside experienced engineers. 

If you enjoy debugging complex problems and learning how hardware and software work together, we would love to hear from you!

Responsibilities

You will use Linux to validate SoC functionality, develop software and automated tests, analyze results, and investigate failures. You will work closely with design, firmware, software, and verification engineers to understand problems and contribute to their resolution. 

We will encourage you to look beyond individual tests and help us improve our validation tools, automation, coverage, and ways of working. As your experience grows, you will have opportunities to take ownership of increasingly complex areas of SoC validation. 

Required Skills And Experience

We are looking for someone with around 2-3 years of experience in Linux, embedded software, firmware, system software, validation, or a related area. 

You should have experience programming in C/C++, Assembly and using Python or shell scripting, together with an understanding of computer architecture and operating system fundamentals. Experience using Linux for development, testing, or debugging will help you get started quickly. 

Most importantly, we value curiosity, analytical thinking, collaboration, and an interest in understanding how complex systems work. 

"nice To Have" Skills And Experience

You may already have exposure to areas such as SoC validation, silicon bring-up, Linux kernel or device drivers, CPU and memory systems, PCIe, interrupts, SoC interconnects. 

You do not need experience in all these areas. We are interested in what you can bring to the team and what you would like to learn next. 

IN RETURN

We will support you as you build expertise across Linux, system software, computer architecture, silicon validation, and hardware/software debugging. 

You will have opportunities to learn from experienced engineers, work with advanced SoCs, contribute to real product development, and grow your technical skills and career. We offer a collaborative environment where we share knowledge, learn from each other, and solve challenging engineering problems together. 

We also offer a competitive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, professional development, and work-life harmony. Specific benefits may vary by location. 

We want our recruitment process to be accessible to everyone. If you need reasonable accommodations or adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know, and we will work with you to provide appropriate support. 

Interested in using software to explore what is happening inside a complex SoC? We would like to hear from you!

LI#-KR2

Job Overview

Plan A Technologies is looking for a Automation QA Engineer. In this position you will be responsible for designing and building the automated testing infrastructure that ensures the quality, compliance, and performance of slot game development. This role combines expertise in C# development, computer vision, and AI-assisted testing to automate validation across game logic, visual rendering, and math models, while partnering closely with QA, game development, and engineering teams throughout the game lifecycle. 

Please note: you must have at least 5 years of experience in QA automation, with hands-on expertise in C# to be considered for this role. 

JOB RESPONSIBILITY

- Develop and maintain C# automation suites validating game logic, paytables, reel math, bonus triggers, and payout calculations against certified specs. 
 - Build CV-based systems (OpenCV or similar) to visually verify screen rendering, symbol placement, animations, and on-screen game state - including hardware/cabinet testing where API access is limited. 
 - Develop test harnesses that interface with game engines and firmware to inject test conditions and capture internal state for regulatory certification (GLI, BMM, etc. ). 
 - Create AI/ML tools that detect visual anomalies (glitches, misrenders) and statistical anomalies (RNG/RTP deviations), accelerating regression detection beyond manual QA. 
 - Integrate automated visual, logic, and compliance tests into build pipelines, ensuring every release is validated before reaching QA or regulators. 
 - Other projects and duties as assigned by the manager. 

Experience

- Minimum of 5 years of experience in QA automation, with hands-on expertise in C# (nice to have: C/C++ development). 
 - Proven experience building computer vision-based testing tools (OpenCV or similar) for visual regression and screen-state validation. 
 - Solid understanding of slot machine/gaming domain concepts (RNG, RTP, paytables, reel math, bonus mechanics) and regulatory standards (GLI, BMM, or similar). 
 - Practical experience applying AI/ML techniques to testing, such as anomaly detection or automated test generation. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and maintaining automated test pipelines integrated into CI/CD systems (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, or similar). 
 - Knowledge of the casino gaming industry (slot machines, table games, or iGaming)
 - Experience with Unity or other game engines. 
 - Familiarity with regulatory/compliance testing standards (GLI, BMM, or similar). 
 - Active GitHub profile showcasing personal or open-source projects demonstrating C# development and computer vision applications. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 
 - Ability to balance quality, speed and regulatory constraints. 
 - Excellent verbal and written English communication skills. 
 - Initiative and drive to do great things.

Plan A Technologies is a global engineering firm created to solve the toughest tech challenges facing today's businesses. About Us: 

Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12, 000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world. 

Job Description: 

Join Us. Build a Better World Through Business. 

At Barry-Wehmiller Companies, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, we are a global leader in manufacturing technology and services. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we've grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the St. Louis Business Journal list of the city's Top 150 Privately Held Companies. 

What truly sets us apart is our culture-rooted in Truly Human Leadership, a philosophy that prioritizes the well-being and growth of every individual. We measure success by the way we touch lives, not just by financial results. 

In India, Barry-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services-providing critical support to Barry-Wehmiller divisions worldwide. 

Our culture is built on: 

- Ownership - Drive features end-to-end, from design to deployment. 
 - Flexibility - A friendly, results-oriented environment that respects your time. 
 - Empowerment - Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact. 
 - Learning and Growth - Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development. 

Career Development and Global Exposure

At Barry-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You'll have access to world-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you'll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive. 

If you're ready to bring your best thinking to a high-impact, future-focused environment-where long-term stability meets start-up agility-and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we'd love to hear from you. 

Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Engineer - Controls with 8+ years of experience in the design, development, modification, migration, integration, and implementation of PLC and HMI/SCADA systems for discrete machinery and equipment. 

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with a combination of Siemens, Allen-Bradley (Rockwell Automation), and Beckhoff automation platforms. Experience in printing, paper converting, packaging, textile, or other machinery/OEM industries is highly preferred. 

The engineer should be able to take a systems approach to understand the overall machine design, mechanical functions, electrical architecture, control philosophy, safety systems, and automation requirements, and develop robust PLC and HMI programs ensuring the overall functional quality and performance of the machinery/equipment. 

The role will be responsible for the interface between electrical hardware, PLC software, HMI/SCADA, drives, motion systems, instrumentation, and machine-level automation. 

Technical Skills

PLC & HMI Platforms

Strong hands-on experience in one or more of the following platforms, with the ability to work across multiple automation platforms: 

- Siemens S7-1200 / S7-1500 PLCs
 - Siemens Comfort Panels / Unified Comfort Panels
 - Allen-Bradley / Rockwell Automation PLCs
 - ControlLogix
 - CompactLogix
 - Beckhoff PLC / IPC-based control systems
 - TwinCAT 3
 - EtherCAT
 - Experience with HMI/SCADA development and integration across Siemens, Allen-Bradley, and Beckhoff platforms. 

PLC & HMI Development

- Hands-on experience developing PLC and HMI programs from scratch based on URS, functional specifications, and client standards. 
 - Ability to understand and develop PLC programs using: 
 - Ladder Logic
 - Function Block Diagram
 - Structured Text
 - Sequential Function Chart
 - Develop machine sequences, interlocks, alarms, permissives, recipes, diagnostics, and operator interfaces. 
 - Interface PLC programs with HMI/SCADA systems. 
 - Experience in modifying, debugging, migrating, and optimizing existing PLC/HMI programs. 
 - Experience with machine-level automation and discrete manufacturing applications. 
 - HMI scripting/programming experience using JavaScript, C#, or similar technologies is an added advantage. 

Siemens Automation

- Strong hands-on experience with Siemens S7-1500 PLCs. 
 - Experience with TIA Portal V15. 1 or above. 
 - TIA Portal V17/V18/V19 or later experience preferred. 
 - Siemens Comfort and Unified Comfort HMI development. 
 - PLC/HMI programming, troubleshooting, commissioning, and debugging. 
 - Experience with Siemens drives and motion systems is preferred. 

Allen-Bradley / Rockwell Automation

- Hands-on experience with Allen-Bradley PLCs. 
 - Experience with ControlLogix and/or CompactLogix platforms. 
 - Rockwell Studio 5000 / RSLogix programming experience. 
 - Allen-Bradley HMI experience using FactoryTalk View is preferred. 
 - Experience with Rockwell drives, I/O, communication networks, and motion systems is an advantage. 

Beckhoff Automation

- Hands-on experience with Beckhoff PLC/control systems. 
 - Experience with TwinCAT 3 programming and development. 
 - Knowledge of EtherCAT communication and distributed I/O systems. 
 - Experience with Beckhoff IPCs, motion control, servo systems, and drives is preferred. 
 - Experience developing machine control applications using Structured Text is an advantage. 

Industrial Communication & Networking

Good understanding of industrial communication protocols and networking, including: 

- PROFINET / PROFIBUS
 - EtherNet/IP
 - EtherCAT
 - AS-i
 - CAN / CANopen
 - DeviceNet
 - Modbus TCP/RTU
 - OPC UA
 - Other industrial Ethernet and fieldbus protocols

Ability to configure, troubleshoot, and integrate PLCs, remote I/O, drives, HMIs, sensors, and other automation devices over industrial networks. 

Drives, Motors & Motion Control

- Knowledge of selection and application of motors, motor controllers, VFDs, servo drives, and motion-control systems. 
 - Understanding of: 
 - Motor horsepower
 - Torque
 - Speed range
 - Gear ratios
 - Reduction ratios
 - Acceleration/deceleration
 - Experience with Siemens, Allen-Bradley, or Beckhoff drives is preferred. 
 - Basic understanding of servo positioning and motion-control applications. 

Instrumentation & Control Components

Good understanding of selection and application of industrial control components, including: 

- Sensors for flow, pressure, level, temperature, position, speed, counters, motion, vision, etc. 
 - Digital and analog sensors
 - Proximity and photoelectric sensors
 - Encoders
 - Transducers
 - Solenoid valves
 - Relays
 - Contactors
 - On/Off control devices
 - Analog I/O and signal conditioning
 - A/D and D/A conversion
 - I/P and P/I conversion

Understanding of sensor characteristics such as accuracy, precision, response time, repeatability, reliability, range, and environmental/temperature effects. 

FAT, SAT & Commissioning

- Develop automation test cases and procedures for Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT). 
 - Participate in FAT/SAT with customers and project teams. 
 - Hands-on experience in machine installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and start-up. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot PLC, HMI, drives, I/O, communication, and machine sequence issues. 
 - Experience with remote commissioning and troubleshooting tools. 
 - Willingness to travel to customer sites for commissioning and project support. 

Standards & Compliance

Working knowledge of applicable industry codes, standards, and regulations such as: 

- ANSI
 - ISA
 - NEC
 - NEMA
 - NFPA
 - OSHA
 - UL

Experience working with machine safety systems and safety PLCs is an added advantage. 

Tool Skills

Mandatory / Core

- Siemens TIA Portal - V15. 1 or above
 - Siemens S7-1500 PLC
 - Siemens Comfort / Unified Comfort HMI
 - Allen-Bradley / Rockwell Studio 5000
 - ControlLogix / CompactLogix
 - Beckhoff TwinCAT 3
 - EtherCAT

Preferred

- TIA Portal V17+
 - FactoryTalk View
 - Siemens / Rockwell / Beckhoff drives and motion systems
 - OPC UA
 - Industrial Ethernet networking
 - HMI scripting / C# / JavaScript
 - EPLAN or similar electrical engineering tools

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE), Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Instrumentation, or related engineering discipline. 
 - 8+ years of experience in industrial automation and controls engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in PLC and HMI programming. 
 - Experience with a combination of Siemens, Allen-Bradley, and Beckhoff platforms is strongly preferred. 
 - Demonstrated experience developing PLC/HMI programs from scratch. 
 - Experience in machinery/OEM applications is highly preferred. 
 - Experience in printing, packaging, paper converting, textile, or other discrete machinery industries is an advantage. 
 - Experience in machine commissioning and customer-site support is preferred. 

Key Result Areas

- Configure automation hardware and software according to project design specifications. 
 - Develop PLC and HMI programs from scratch based on machine automation requirements. 
 - Integrate Siemens, Allen-Bradley, and Beckhoff automation platforms with machine hardware and control systems. 
 - Ensure optimal performance, reliability, quality, and responsiveness of PLC/HMI applications. 
 - Troubleshoot PLC, HMI, drives, motion, I/O, and industrial communication issues. 
 - Follow software development, change-management, and version-control procedures. 
 - Maintain proper documentation of PLC/HMI software and project changes. 
 - Manage assigned projects and deliver according to agreed schedules and scope. 
 - Communicate project progress, technical issues, and risks to project stakeholders. 
 - Support FAT, SAT, machine start-up, commissioning, and customer acceptance. 
 - Provide technical support to internal teams and customers as required. 

Soft Skills

- Strong verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Logical and systematic approach to problem-solving. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. 
 - Ability to understand complex machine sequences and identify key technical issues. 
 - Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team. 
 - Strong customer-facing and interpersonal skills. 
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities and changing project requirements. 
 - Willingness to learn and work across multiple automation platforms. 

Travel

Occasional domestic and/or international travel may be required, up to 15%, for customer meetings, FAT, SAT, installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and project support. 

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will be a multi-platform Controls Engineer with strong practical experience in: 

Siemens + Allen-Bradley + Beckhoff

with hands-on capability in: 

PLC Programming → HMI Development → Drives/Motion → Industrial Communication → Machine Integration → FAT/SAT → Commissioning

Experience with OEM/discrete machinery, particularly printing, packaging, paper converting, or textile machinery, will be a strong advantage. 

Barry-Wehmiller is committed to creating a people-centric workplace where employees can bring their best selves to the work they do and grow through meaningful career opportunities. 

At Barry-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work-therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodations during the interview process.
