data.title: Engineer IV , QA
data.description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market. 

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers' success and to our Winning Culture. 

Our customers rank among the who's who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2, 400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform. 

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins - big and small. 

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you'll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let's build what's next - together!

About the Role

Here at Anaplan, we have reinvented how companies see, plan, and run their businesses. Our platform allows our customers to uncover new insights, connect their strategy to their plans, and work in ways they had not previously thought possible. Anaplan is the only scenario planning and analysis platform designed to optimize decision-making in today's complex business environment so that enterprises can outpace their competition and the market. By building connections and collaboration across organizational silos, our platform intelligently surfaces key insights - so businesses can make the right decisions, right now. We are seeking a talented AI QA Lead to guide our team and ensure the quality and reliability of our cutting-edge AI and machine learning solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead, mentor, and grow high-performing QA Engineers across multiple stream aligned teams. 
 - Define and drive the overall QA strategy for our Forecasting project, with a focus on time-series forecasting. 
 - Oversee the design, development, and maintenance of automated test frameworks. 
 - Guide the team in implementing and executing robust test cases for our AI-powered features and APIs. 
 - Champion the use of BDD frameworks, such as Gherkin, to create clear, concise, and maintainable tests. 
 - Ensure the team effectively tests and validates RESTful APIs to meet high standards of quality and performance. 
 - Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and engineering leads to align on quality standards and release criteria. 
 - Oversee the identification, documentation, and tracking of bugs and inconsistencies in our AI/ML systems. 
 - Drive improvements to our CI/CD pipeline to ensure that our AI models are continuously tested and deployed with confidence. Required Qualifications

- A skilled QA Engineer with 8+ years of experience testing and assuring the quality of complex platform, infrastructure, or data-centric systems. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python. 
 - Proven experience leading or mentoring a QA team in a fast-paced technical environment. 
 - Deep understanding of machine learning concepts and a proven track record of testing ML models, particularly in the domain of time-series forecasting. 
 - Expertise with testing frameworks such as pytest. 
 - Strong experience with Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) and Gherkin. 
 - In-depth knowledge of API testing and validation. 
 - Proficiency in modern software development practices (testing, code review, CI/CD). 
 - A proven track record of delivering complex technical projects on time with high quality. 
 - Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills. Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with performance, scalability, and security testing of AI systems. 
 - Familiarity with cloud platforms (e. g. , AWS, GCP, Azure) and their AI/ML services. 
 - Knowledge of containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with strategic planning and roadmap development for a QA function. 
 - A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. What Makes This Role Exciting

- You will lead a talented team at the forefront of AI innovation, working on a platform that is transforming how businesses make decisions. 
 - You will have a strategic impact, shaping the future of quality for our AI-powered products. 
 - You will be part of a collaborative and creative leadership team that values openness, authenticity, and inclusivity. 
 - We are a fast-growing company, and you will have ample opportunities for professional growth and to define your team's trajectory. Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren't just words on paper - this is what drives our innovation, it's how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.   

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer   

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals. 

Anaplan does not:   

- Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.   
 - Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.   All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan. com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan. com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

data.title: Principal AI Go-to-Market Operations Engineer
data.description:
Organization OverviewCompany Description

QAD is a world-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain. 

Job Description

We are seeking a visionary and highly technical AI Go-To-Market (GTM) Engineer to sit at the core of our revenue engine. This is not a traditional operations role; it is a hybrid of software engineering, data science, and revenue strategy. You will be responsible for architecting an AI-first GTM ecosystem that bridges the gap between Sales, RevOps, Marketing, and Customer Success. 

Your goal is to ensure that every individual in our GTM organization and every piece of our technology stack is augmented by Artificial Intelligence. You will build the bridges that allow us to generate more pipeline, accelerate deal velocity, and eliminate administrative friction, all while optimizing our tech spend. 

Responsibilities

- AI Architecture & Custom Integration
 - Design, code, and deploy custom AI integrations from scratch to connect our CRM, Sales Engagement platforms, and other technology stack components. 
 - Build proprietary internal LLM-based tools to automate account and contact enrichment, outbound messaging for early and middle of the funnel prospects. 
 - Develop agentic workflows that handle routine administrative tasks (e. g. , CRM data, meeting summaries, and follow-up scheduling) across the revenue organization. 
 - Revenue Ecosystem Optimization
 - Partner with RevOps and Marketing Ops to audit the existing tech stack, identifying redundancies where AI can replace high-cost, low-utility third-party vendors. 
 - Implement predictive modeling to identify high-intent pipelines and provide Sales with real-time "Next Best Action" recommendations. 
 - Ensure data integrity across all platforms, creating a "single source of truth" that AI models can leverage for accurate forecasting. 
 - Cross-Functional Efficiency
 - Collaborate with Customer Success to build AI-driven retention loops and automated renewal triggers. 
 - Consult with Marketing leadership on AI-driven content distribution and performance marketing automation to lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC). 
 - Act as an internal consultant, training GTM teams on how to effectively "prompt" and utilize deployed AI tools to maximize their individual output. 

Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in Marketing/Revenue Operations or GTM Engineering. Deep understanding of the "Leads-to-Revenue" funnel and "Best-in-Class" SaaS ecosystems. 
 - Ability to write and maintain production integrations - Python, JavaScript, html, or equivalent - connecting AI agents to CRM, MAP, and sequencing tools via APIs. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you need to ship working code, not just configure no-code tools. 
 - Deep working knowledge of the modern B2B GTM stack - specifically Salesforce (as CRM and data hub), Clay, Claude, Outreach, Gong or Chorus, etc
 - Proven track record of consolidating tech stacks and reducing vendor spend without sacrificing performance. 
 - Understanding of pipeline math and unit economics: you should be able to work backward from a revenue target to pipeline required, conversion rates by stage, and the specific AI interventions that move each number. If someone says "we need 20 opportunities per quarter at 20% win rate and $75K ASD, " you should immediately know where AI can compress that funnel. 
 - Experience with AI agent orchestration - managing multiple AI agents working different segments or functions simultaneously, resolving conflicts, preventing duplicate outreach, and maintaining data quality in the hub (Salesforce). 
 - Demonstrated ability to build prompt libraries, training datasets, and refinement workflows for AI agents - treating agent training as a discipline, not a one-time setup. 
 - Strong opinions on when AI should replace human effort versus augment it - and the judgment to know that bad AI automation destroys deals faster than no automation at all. 

Additional Information

- Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance. 
 - Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation. 
 - Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done. 
 - An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy. 
 - Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

About QAD And QAD Redzone

QAD Inc. is a leading provider of adaptive, cloud-based enterprise software and services for global manufacturing companies. Global manufacturers face ever-increasing disruption caused by technology-driven innovation and changing consumer preferences. In order to survive and thrive, manufacturers must be able to innovate and change business models at unprecedented rates of speed. QAD calls these companies Adaptive Manufacturing Enterprises. 

QAD Redzone helps to enable QAD's vision for the Adaptive Enterprise. Labor productivity improvements directly impact efficiency. Productive and empowered employees increase the effective capacity of your plant and accelerate time to productivity for new employees giving manufacturers the agility to increase production beyond what was previously possible without having to invest in production equipment or new plants, and reduce the amount and impact of employee attrition. Empowered employees with a growth mindset take extreme ownership of challenges that impact their production goals, creating resilience in the face of disruption. 

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

What You'll Need To Bring To This Role. . .

What You Can Expect From Us

data.title: Power & Performance Validation Engineer
data.description:
Power and Performance Validation Engineer

About Us

Graphcore is one of the world's leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. 

It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry. 

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world's most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone. 

Graphcore's teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore enjoys a culture of continuous learning and constant innovation. 

Job Summary

Reporting to senior leadership within Architecture and Validation, the Power and Performance Validation Lead will drive validation strategy and execution for advanced AI compute silicon and systems. The role is responsible for leading power, thermal and performance validation activities across pre-silicon and post-silicon environments to ensure products meet efficiency, reliability and scalability expectations. 

This role requires strong technical expertise and collaboration across multiple engineering disciplines to deliver robust validation methodologies, scalable automation frameworks and actionable performance insights. 

The Team

The Power and Performance Validation team sits within the Architecture and Validation organisation and is responsible for validating the performance, efficiency and thermal behaviour of Graphcore silicon and systems. 

The team supports the full product lifecycle, from early architectural modelling through to first silicon bring-up, characterization and production readiness. Engineers work closely with cross-functional teams globally to debug complex issues, optimize workloads and continuously improve validation infrastructure and methodologies. 

Responsibilities and Duties

- Define and lead validation strategies for power, thermal and performance characterization of AI compute silicon and platforms
 - Contribute to planning and execution of validation activities across multiple projects and milestones
 - Develop comprehensive validation plans covering functional, stress, workload and corner-case scenarios
 - Lead post-silicon bring-up and characterization activities for power and performance validation
 - Drive validation of CPU, memory, interconnect and high-speed I/O subsystems under complex workload conditions
 - Develop scalable automation frameworks, regression infrastructure and reporting tools using Python
 - Design and execute benchmark workloads, parameter sweeps and performance experiments to identify optimization opportunities
 - Collaborate with architecture, RTL, firmware, software and systems teams to debug and resolve complex technical issues
 - Define validation metrics, pass/fail criteria and reporting methodologies to ensure repeatable and high-quality analysis
 - Guide development of custom workload generators and micro-benchmarks where required
 - Analyse power, thermal and performance data to identify bottlenecks and recommend improvements
 - Contribute to continuous improvement of validation processes, tooling and engineering practices
 - Communicate technical findings, project status, risks and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and engineering leadership
 - Support knowledge sharing and contribute to continuous improvement across the validation organisation

Candidate Profile

Essential

- Strong experience in power and performance validation, silicon characterization or system performance engineering
 - Deep understanding of modern SoC architecture, including CPU, memory, interconnect and high-speed I/O technologies
 - Strong Linux systems knowledge and low-level performance analysis experience
 - Strong Python programming skills for automation, orchestration and data analysis
 - Experience with benchmarking and profiling tools such as stress-ng, fio, perf, iperf or equivalent technologies
 - Experience debugging complex hardware and software interactions
 - Ability to define structured validation methodologies, workload models and test strategies
 - Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and identify system bottlenecks
 - Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
 - Ability to work independently on complex technical tasks while collaborating effectively across teams

Desirable

- Experience with AI accelerator, GPU or high-performance compute architectures
 - Experience with pre-silicon modelling or simulation environments
 - Knowledge of power management technologies and silicon characterization methodologies
 - Programming experience in C/C++ for low-level system or benchmark development
 - Familiarity with hardware instrumentation and telemetry systems
 - Experience working with high core-count or large-scale compute systems
 - Experience contributing to shared validation infrastructure and engineering best practices

data.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
data.description:
NodeShift is looking for a QA Engineer who writes automation first and uses AI to move faster. You will own the quality of your features end to end, from reviewing requirements to automated tests running in CI. You will also help test AI agents and LLM pipelines, which is a different game from classic web QA. Working with AI is a hard requirement for this role - AI is your default way of testing, used every day to design, write, run, and debug tests. 

Key Responsibilities

- Write and maintain end-to-end, UI, and API tests in Playwright + TypeScript, following the team's framework conventions. 
 - Run tests in CI (GitHub Actions), keep suites fast and stable, and fix flaky tests instead of retrying them. 
 - Prepare test data and environments, and mock external services where needed. 
 - Help build and run evaluation datasets for LLM and agent features, checking accuracy, hallucinations, and regressions after prompt or model changes. 
 - Use traces in Langfuse to reproduce and pin down issues in agentic pipelines. 
 - Test LLM-specific risks: prompt injection, unsafe outputs, and PII leakage. 
 - Review requirements and designs early, and write test plans and acceptance criteria together with developers. 
 - Run exploratory and regression testing where automation doesn't pay off. 
 - Report bugs developers can act on straight away: clear steps, logs, evidence, and severity. 
 - Generate test cases, edge cases, and test data from requirements and Jira tickets with AI. 
 - Write, refactor, and fix automated tests with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Playwright MCP, or similar). 
 - Run exploratory testing with AI browser agents, and use AI to analyze test failures, logs, and traces. 
 - Suggest and try out AI tools that make the team's QA faster. 

Skills & Requirements

- API Testing
 - Arabic
 - CI/CD
 - Docker
 - Git
 - Kubernetes
 - LLM Testing
 - Performance Testing
 - Playwright
 - Python
 - Security Testing
 - TypeScript

Additional Information

Work Experience

- 3+ years of experience in QA
 - 2+ years of experience writing automated tests
 - Experience with B2B, enterprise, or government/regulated products

Project Details

You will work on AI agents and LLM infrastructure used by enterprise and government clients in the GCC. You will test agentic AI pipelines, document processing, and LLM gateways running on Kubernetes in regulated environments where quality, security, and data residency are critical.

data.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) — AI-Enabled Quality Infrastructure
data.description:
SS&C is a leading provider of mission-critical, AI-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23, 000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology. 

Job Description

As a leading financial services and healthcare technology company based on revenue, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has 27, 000+ employees in 35 countries. Some 20, 000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology. 

Join our Quality Infrastructure team as a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) and help build the AI-assisted automation platforms that product development teams rely on every day. You will design, build, and maintain the frameworks, CI pipelines, and reporting systems that power end-to-end quality for the SS&C Advent Eze investment platform - and you will be a primary driver of how AI-assisted engineering practices reach the scrum teams we serve. We welcome candidates new to finance. 

Overview: The SS&C AdventTM solution is a born-in-the-cloud investment solution that supports start-up, emerging equity-, and event-focused hedge funds' full investment process in a single, unified platform through a secure web browser interface. The Quality Infrastructure team builds and operates the automation and quality tooling that product development scrum teams depend on. Our customers are the developers, testers, and scrum teams who add tests, consume dashboards, and rely on healthy CI to ship confidently. As an SDET on this team, you will build and improve the platforms and services behind that experience rather than writing product tests directly. 

Your Impact Quality Infrastructure is a shared platform team, so your work reaches well beyond your own commits. The frameworks, pipelines, and dashboards you build are used every day by every product scrum team - which means when you build AI-assisted capabilities into them (test scaffolding, failure triage, flaky-test diagnosis, smarter alerting), you change how the entire engineering organization works, not just how one team tests. You will have real latitude to introduce AI-assisted engineering practices here, and a direct hand in setting the standards other engineers follow. 

What You'll Do

- Use AI-assisted tooling (e. g. , Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) as a routine part of development, debugging, and test authoring - and help establish effective, well-judged practices for its use across the engineering organization. 
 - Build AI-assisted capabilities into the quality platforms product teams consume test-generation scaffolding, automated failure categorization (environment vs. code vs. flaky), root-cause summarization, and intelligent alert routing that reduces noise and surfaces signal. 
 - Develop, extend, and maintain automation frameworks used across multiple scrum teams (API-level and UI-level). 
 - Build and maintain CI pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins) that execute end-to-end integration and regression suites, and reduce feedback-loop time through smarter test selection and prioritization. 
 - Troubleshoot CI failures, flaky tests, and environment issues; support product teams in unblocking their workflows. 
 - Contribute to test-reporting and alerting infrastructure: data pipelines, dashboards (Grafana), and integrations (PagerDuty, Slack, Teams). 
 - Collaborate with product scrum teams to understand their testing needs and translate them into framework features, CI improvements, and AI-assisted workflows they will adopt. 
 - Participate in code reviews focusing on reliability, maintainability, and developer experience - including reviewing AI-generated contributions with appropriate scrutiny. 
 - Document framework usage, onboarding guides, and runbooks - including guidance on where AI-assisted workflows help and where they do not - so teams can self-serve effectively. 

Required Qualifications

- 2-4 years of professional experience in software engineering, test automation, or a related SDET/QA engineering role. 
 - Hands-on, practical use of AI coding assistants (e. g. , Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar) in real development work, with demonstrated judgment about when to accept, verify, rewrite, or reject AI-generated output. 
 - Solid programming skills in at least one language: JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or similar. 
 - Hands-on experience building or maintaining automated test suites (API, integration, or UI). 
 - Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts and tools (e. g. , GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar). 
 - Familiarity with version control workflows in Git (branching, pull requests, code review). \
 - Prior experience on a product development scrum team or in an Agile environment; understanding of the development lifecycle from feature work through deployment. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills, clear written and verbal communication, and a service-oriented mindset toward internal customers. 
 - Willingness to advocate for and teach AI-assisted engineering practices to peers and partner teams. 

Nice to Have

- Experience integrating LLM APIs or AI-assisted automation into developer tooling, CI pipelines, or internal services. 
 - Exposure to agentic development tooling, prompt design, or evaluating AI output quality in an engineering workflow. 
 - Experience with Cypress, Playwright, or similar browser-automation frameworks. 
 - Exposure to REST API testing tools and frameworks (e. g. , pytest, Jest, Postman/Newman, custom frameworks). 
 - Familiarity with Docker/containers and cloud platforms (AWS preferred). 
 - Exposure to any observability or data tooling (Grafana, InfluxDB, ClickHouse, or similar time-series/analytics databases). 
 - Experience with scripting around notifications or integrations (Slack bots, PagerDuty, AWS Lambda). 
 - Basic SQL and comfort working with structured data. 
 - Interest in developer experience, internal tooling, or platform engineering. 

About the scope of this role: This is a software engineering role, not a machine learning or data science role - no model-training or data science background is required. The AI work here is applied: using AI-assisted tooling in your own engineering workflow and building AI-assisted capabilities into the quality platforms our engineering teams use every day. 

Why You Will Love It Here!

- Flexibility: Hybrid Work Model and Business Casual Dress Code, including jeans
 - Your Future: Provident Fund
 - Work/Life Balance: Flexible Personal/Vacation Time Off, Sick Leave, Paid Holidays
 - Your Wellbeing: Mediclaim, Term Life Insurance, Accidental Coverage, Employee Assistance Program, Parental Leave
 - Diversity & Inclusion: Committed to Welcoming, Celebrating and Thriving on Diversity
 - Training: Hands-On, Team-Customized, including SS&C University
 - Extra Perks: Diwali voucher, Monthly remunerated RnR program

Unless explicitly requested or approached by SS&C Technologies, Inc. or any of its affiliated companies, the company will not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. 

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. 

SS&C Technologies is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any applicant for employment or employee on the basis of race, color, religious creed, gender, age, marital status, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other classification protected by applicable discrimination laws.

data.title: Data QA Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data QA Engineer based in India. 

As a Data QA Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of data delivered to customers. 

You will work with web data extraction projects and AI-assisted solutions, translating customer requirements into clear, measurable quality standards. 

Rather than treating quality assurance as a final checkpoint, you will help identify potential issues early and prevent defects before they reach production. 

Combining exploratory testing, data analysis, and automation, you will investigate anomalies and provide actionable insights to developers and project teams. 

You will use Python, SQL, and modern testing tools to assess data quality and communicate results through meaningful reports, metrics, and visualizations. 

Working closely with project managers, developers, and clients, you will have the autonomy to improve testing processes and strengthen quality practices. 

This is an opportunity to join a globally distributed, multicultural team that values ownership, continuous improvement, and flexible ways of working. 

Accountabilities

- Translate customer data extraction and web scraping requirements into clear, testable criteria and comprehensive QA strategies, taking ownership of quality assurance from the beginning of new projects. 
 - Perform exploratory, manual, and visual testing, complemented by automated testing where it provides measurable value. 
 - Execute test cycles on extracted datasets to validate compliance with customer specifications and identify inconsistencies, inaccuracies, missing information, and other defects. 
 - Document defects clearly and thoroughly, providing reproducible steps and supporting evidence so developers can investigate and resolve issues efficiently. 
 - Apply descriptive statistics, data summaries, and visualizations to assess completeness, accuracy, consistency, and data drift. 
 - Prepare quality reports and scoring metrics that communicate results honestly to internal teams and, where appropriate, customers. 
 - Clearly identify the scope of testing, any untested areas, and the associated risks to support informed project decisions. 
 - Collaborate with project managers and customers to clarify ambiguous requirements and ensure that expectations are measurable and testable before QA begins. 
 - Contribute to the development and improvement of test automation frameworks, with an emphasis on coverage, reliability, and performance. 
 - Identify, propose, and implement improvements to QA processes and tooling, including browser extensions, spreadsheet add-ons, and user-interface-based testing tools. 
 - Work independently while maintaining close collaboration with QA leadership, developers, and project managers to uphold quality standards throughout delivery. 

Requirements

- At least 5 years of experience as a QA Engineer or in a comparable role involving software testing, data testing, or data quality assurance. 
 - Proficiency in Python for data analysis and validation, preferably using Pandas and Jupyter notebooks. 
 - Basic to intermediate SQL skills, including the ability to query and validate data in at least one relational database environment. 
 - Strong understanding of web technologies and protocols, including HTML, XPath, JSON, HTTP, and CSS. 
 - Experience testing HTTP/REST APIs and validating their responses against expected requirements. 
 - Solid knowledge of test case design, test data management, and practical approaches to exploratory and automated testing. 
 - Understanding of data quality principles, particularly completeness, accuracy, consistency, and data drift. 
 - Experience working in an Agile environment, such as Scrum or Kanban, and collaborating effectively with developers. 
 - Familiarity with AI and large language model (LLM) tools to improve test case generation and accelerate data validation workflows. 
 - A proactive, detail-oriented mindset with strong ownership of project quality and the confidence to uphold standards under delivery pressure. 
 - Ability to learn new technologies quickly, understand complex project requirements, and adapt testing strategies to different domains. 
 - Strong written and spoken English communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings clearly and precisely. 

Nice To Have

- Practical knowledge of Scrapy or other Python-based web scraping frameworks. 
 - Experience working with test automation frameworks. 
 - An interest in data science concepts and their application to data analysis and validation. 
 - Enthusiasm for exploring AI and LLM-powered approaches to improve data quality assurance. 

Benefits

- 35 days of paid holidays, supporting substantial time away from work. 
 - Flexible, location-independent working, with the freedom to work from where you are most productive. 
 - Global, multicultural team: Join a self-motivated, progressive, and internationally distributed team. 
 - Modern technology: Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies and tools. 
 - Autonomy and ownership: Contribute ideas, take responsibility for improvements, and help shape QA processes and tooling. 
 - Collaborative environment: Work closely with technical and project teams to solve meaningful data quality challenges. 
 - Additional details regarding salary, healthcare, retirement plans, and other benefits were not specified in the original job description. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

As a Quality Assurance Analyst at Infor, you will have a critical role in ensuring the delivery of high-quality enterprise applications that meet the evolving needs of our global customers. You'll collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and customer success teams to validate functionality, performance, and scalability-helping us deliver smarter, faster, and more intuitive software.

Preferred Qualifications

About Infor

Infor is where ambition meets impact. Join a global community of bold thinkers and innovators, where your expertise doesn't just solve problems. it shapes industries, unlocks opportunities, and creates real-world impact for billions of people. At Infor, you're not just building a career. you're helping to build what's next. 

Infor is a global leader in business cloud software products for companies in industry specific markets. Infor builds complete industry suites in the cloud and efficiently deploys technology that puts the user experience first, leverages data science, and integrates easily into existing systems. Over 60, 000 organizations worldwide rely on Infor to help overcome market disruptions and achieve business-wide digital transformation. 

For more information visit www. infor. com

Our Values

At Infor, we strive for an environment that is founded on a business philosophy called Principle Based ManagementTM (PBMTM) and eight Guiding Principles: integrity, stewardship & compliance, transformation, principled entrepreneurship, knowledge, humility, respect, self-actualization.

data.title: Pre-Validation, CSV & AI Quality
data.description:
Quality Engineer - Pre-Validation, CSV & AI Quality

Bangalore

5+ years

Role Overview

We are seeking a Pre-Validation and Computerized System Validation (CSV) Expert with 2 to 5 years of experience in GxP validation, quality assurance, and regulated software environments to contribute to the quality engineering and validation of enterprise-grade SaaS and AI-powered products. 

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in risk-based validation, pre-validation activities, requirements assessment, validation strategy, test planning, traceability, IQ/OQ/PQ, data integrity, audit trail assessment, electronic records/signatures, and validation documentation for cloud-based and integrated systems. 

The candidate will work closely with Engineering, Product, Testing, Implementation, Quality, Security, and Customer teams to assess requirements and risks early, identify validation gaps, define appropriate verification and testing approaches, review configuration and implementation evidence, and ensure systems are fit for intended use in regulated manufacturing and life-sciences environments. 

AI/GenAI - Must have: Hands-on use of AI for requirements analysis, risk assessment, test/OQ script generation, traceability analysis, validation document review, defect investigation, gap identification, and AI-assisted CSV workflows. Strong understanding of the need to independently verify AI-generated outputs and maintain GxP compliance, data integrity, confidentiality, and auditability. 

Key Responsibilities

Pre-Validation & Validation Strategy

- Lead and execute risk-based pre-validation activities for product releases, customer implementations, configuration changes, integrations, and new functionalities in regulated environments. 
 - Review business, user, functional, and configuration requirements to identify validation impact, GxP relevance, critical functionality, data integrity risks, and test coverage needs. 
 - Define validation approaches, scope, deliverables, acceptance criteria, and verification strategies based on intended use, system risk, complexity, and regulatory impact. 
 - Review and challenge Configuration Specifications, functional specifications, design/configuration documentation, and implementation details to confirm that the configured system aligns with approved requirements. 
 - Perform validation readiness assessments before formal OQ/PQ and identify gaps in requirements, configuration, test data, environments, traceability, documentation, and evidence. 
 - Support dry runs and pre-validation testing to identify defects, ambiguous requirements, usability gaps, missing scenarios, and OQ script/data-sheet issues before formal execution. 
 - Review release and customer-specific changes for validation impact and provide risk-based recommendations on regression testing, revalidation, or additional verification. 

Computerized System Validation (CSV) & GxP

- Apply CSV lifecycle principles to SaaS, web applications, APIs, databases, integrations, and enterprise platforms used in GxP-regulated processes. 
 - Develop and review validation deliverables including validation plans/strategies, risk assessments, URS/FRS or equivalent requirements, configuration specifications, traceability matrices, test scripts, test evidence, summary reports, and validation closure documentation. 
 - Strong understanding of IQ, OQ, PQ and risk-based testing principles, including appropriate separation of verification activities from formal qualification execution. 
 - Review and assess system functionality related to audit trails, user roles and access control, electronic records, electronic signatures, data retention, data export, data integrity, and system-generated reports. 
 - Apply principles of 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, GxP, ALCOA+ data integrity, and applicable computerized-system controls when reviewing validation scope and evidence. 
 - Review deviations, defects, test failures, change controls, CAPA actions, and validation impacts; assess whether issues affect intended use, data integrity, or validation status. 
 - Support periodic review, change impact assessment, release certification, and revalidation activities for validated systems. 

Pre-Validation Testing, OQ Readiness & Quality Engineering

- Review and challenge test scenarios, OQ scripts, datasheets, expected results, and evidence requirements for completeness, accuracy, traceability, and risk coverage. 
 - Perform functional, integration, regression, exploratory, configuration, and end-to-end testing as part of pre-validation and validation readiness activities. 
 - Validate critical business workflows, configuration rules, calculations, data flows, integrations, reports, exports, audit trails, and role-based behavior against approved requirements. 
 - Identify edge cases, negative scenarios, boundary conditions, dependencies, data inconsistencies, and usability gaps that may not be adequately covered in formal test scripts. 
 - Ensure test evidence is objective, reproducible, attributable, contemporaneous, complete, and suitable for regulated validation records. 
 - Partner with Engineering and Testing teams to perform root-cause analysis and confirm defect fixes through appropriate regression and impact-based testing. 

AI/GenAI Validation & AI-Assisted CSV

- Use AI/GenAI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or equivalent tools to accelerate requirements analysis, risk identification, test scenario generation, OQ script drafting, traceability mapping, document review, and defect analysis. 
 - Design AI-assisted workflows that convert requirements and test cases into structured validation scenarios, OQ steps, expected results, traceability mappings, and validation documentation while retaining human review and approval. 
 - Evaluate AI-generated test cases and validation content for correctness, completeness, hallucinations, unsupported assumptions, regulatory suitability, and alignment with approved requirements. 
 - Apply AI to analyze large volumes of requirements, test results, defects, logs, audit-trail data, and validation evidence to identify trends, gaps, inconsistencies, and potential quality risks. 
 - Understand validation considerations for AI-enabled and AI/ML functionality, including intended use, risk classification, model/output reliability, data quality, explainability, human oversight, change management, and ongoing monitoring where applicable. 
 - Establish appropriate controls for the use of AI with GxP and customer data, including confidentiality, privacy, data minimization, secure prompting, output verification, and prevention of uncontrolled use of production or sensitive data. 
 - Contribute to AI-enabled Quality Engineering initiatives and reusable tools that improve validation efficiency, traceability, test coverage, and quality without compromising compliance. 

Domain Knowledge - Manufacturing, Life Sciences & Enterprise Systems

- Strong understanding of GxP-regulated manufacturing or life-sciences processes and the role of computerized systems in supporting critical business and quality processes. 
 - Understand common enterprise systems and data flows such as ERP, MES, LIMS, QMS, WMS, supply chain, batch/material processes, genealogy, master data, reporting, and analytics platforms. 
 - Ability to understand manufacturing workflows, material and batch relationships, process hierarchies, genealogy/traceability, data lineage, and business-critical configuration rules. 
 - Assess the impact of system configuration and software changes on business processes, data integrity, downstream integrations, reporting, and validated state. 
 - Translate business and domain knowledge into practical validation scenarios, risk assessments, traceability, and meaningful test coverage. 

Documentation, Compliance & Stakeholder Collaboration

- Review validation and quality documentation for consistency, completeness, traceability, clarity, and alignment with approved procedures and regulatory expectations. 
 - Maintain strong traceability between requirements, risks, configuration, test cases, OQ/PQ evidence, defects, and final validation conclusions. 
 - Prepare clear validation observations, risk assessments, review comments, certification recommendations, and release-readiness assessments. 
 - Work closely with Engineering, Product, Testing, Implementation, CSV, Security, and Customer teams to resolve validation gaps and ensure timely delivery. 
 - Support customer audits, internal quality reviews, inspection readiness, and responses to validation-related questions when required. 

Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 2 to 5 years of experience in CSV, Computer System Validation, Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, Validation, or a closely related regulated environment. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with GxP validation and risk-based testing for SaaS, web applications, APIs, databases, integrations, or enterprise systems. 
 - Strong understanding of 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, GxP principles, ALCOA+ data integrity, audit trails, electronic records, and electronic signatures. 
 - Hands-on experience with validation documentation, requirements, risk assessments, traceability matrices, IQ/OQ/PQ, test evidence, deviations, change controls, and validation reports. 
 - Experience with Agile/Scrum software development and working with Engineering, Product, Testing, DevOps, Implementation, and Quality teams. 
 - Experience with JIRA, Confluence, or similar tools for requirements, defects, documentation, and traceability. 
 - Hands-on experience using AI/GenAI tools for quality and validation activities, with strong ability to critically review and validate AI-generated outputs. 
 - Experience in manufacturing, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, chemicals, food & beverage, consumer goods, or other regulated industries is strongly preferred. 

Skills & Attributes

- Strong understanding of CSV lifecycle, risk-based validation, GxP controls, and data integrity principles. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess validation risk and determine appropriate testing depth. 
 - Ability to understand complex business workflows, system configurations, integrations, data models, and downstream impacts. 
 - Strong requirement-to-test traceability and validation documentation skills. 
 - Ability to identify functional gaps, edge cases, configuration risks, data integrity risks, and compliance gaps. 
 - Strong understanding of audit trails, role-based access, electronic records/signatures, data retention, and controlled changes. 
 - Ability to independently review OQ scripts and datasheets and identify missing coverage, ambiguous steps, incorrect expected results, and evidence gaps. 
 - Strong AI literacy with the ability to use AI as a productivity and quality-engineering accelerator while maintaining human oversight and regulatory accountability. 
 - Ability to assess AI-generated content for accuracy, hallucination, completeness, bias, confidentiality, and suitability for regulated use. 
 - Good understanding of manufacturing processes, enterprise data models, and GxP business workflows. 
 - Strong attention to detail and a quality-first mindset. 
 - Good communication, stakeholder management, and technical documentation skills. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced product engineering environment and manage multiple validation priorities. 

What you will get to work on: 

- Opportunity to work with AI-powered enterprise platforms and regulated digital transformation initiatives. 
 - Opportunity to work at the intersection of CSV, Quality Engineering, AI, Manufacturing, and Life Sciences. 
 - Culture focused on innovation, learning, quality, compliance, and technical excellence. 
 - Regular workshops, training programs, and tech talks. 

About Mareana

Mareana builds cutting-edge enterprise digital AI products focused on Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Sustainability. Our AI-driven platforms solve complex data challenges and deliver real-time insights, enabling businesses to accelerate digital transformation. 

We have delivered more than $1B+ in business value to global clients, including leading firms in life sciences, consumer goods, chemicals, food & beverage, and manufacturing. We are recognized by Gartner as a "Cool Vendor in AI" and have been featured in Silicon Review and Manufacturing Insights.

In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories. 

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality - bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse - the Group's innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally. 

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and futureproofing. Today, it brings together over 16, 000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. 

Sustainability is at the core of the Group's strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women's Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040. 

What You'll Be Doing

Lead delivery of the group's digital commerce applications, owning sprint and Program Increment execution from planning through release. Keep commitments realistic against available capacity, and manage risks, dependencies, and release readiness across the digital release cycle. 

- Lead delivery for digital commerce capability within the Omnichannel domain, managing the squad that delivers these capabilities for the group's brands. 
 - Deliver the committed sprint and PI scope for the capability to agreed quality, with predictable velocity and no unplanned slippage against committed dates. 
 - Improve release readiness and stability for the capability, reducing defects reaching production and the time taken to resolve them. 
 - Produce the sprint and PI plan in Confluence, documenting objectives, scope, capacity, dependencies, risks, and committed deliverables, and maintain it through the increment. 
 - Provide objectives, status updates, and exact man-days per item for consolidation into PI billing to the business. 
 - Manage delivery demand against squad capacity, ensuring commitments are realistic, and dependencies across squads are understood before work is planned. 
 - Facilitate agile ceremonies, track RAID items through to closure, and coordinate release readiness, cutover, and handover with engineering and business stakeholders.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Role purpose

Own the hardest engineering outcomes in X3 and turn architecture direction into working, supportable product capabilities. Set the technical bar across squads while remaining close enough to the code, evidence and customer impact to make sound decisions. 

X3 context

Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics. 

The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes. 

Required Technical And Domain Skills

- Expert understanding of distributed systems architecture, including domain-driven design, service decomposition, event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, scalability, resiliency engineering, fault tolerance, consistency models, disaster recovery, observability, and operational excellence. 
 - Extensive experience defining and governing API-first and event-driven platforms, including REST, GraphQL, messaging architectures, service contracts, versioning strategies, backward compatibility, integration governance, and ecosystem extensibility. 
 - Strong engineering and architecture expertise across relational databases and document databases, including platform-scale data modeling, performance optimization, reliability, replication, migration strategies, data lifecycle management, and operational resilience. 
 - Deep experience leading cloud-native engineering initiatives encompassing containers, orchestration platforms, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, platform engineering, secure software supply chains, observability, reliability engineering, security architecture, upgrade strategies, and recovery mechanisms. 
 - Hands-on experience with containerization and Kubernetes. 
 - Demonstrated success leading complex modernization initiatives, balancing legacy constraints, customer continuity, platform evolution, technical debt reduction, and long-term architectural sustainability. 
 - Proven ability to evaluate and govern AI-assisted engineering practices, ensuring appropriate human review, traceability, security controls, testing strategies, and operational safeguards. 
 - Exceptional communication and influence skills, with the ability to align engineers, architects, product leaders, operational teams, and executives around complex technical decisions, risks, investments, and trade-offs. 

Modern platform skills for this role

- Shape platform capabilities as strategic products that enable engineering velocity, operational excellence, ecosystem extensibility, and long-term scalability across multiple squads and domains. 
 - Define and govern service boundaries, domain ownership models, API contracts, event architectures, distributed systems patterns, and platform standards that remain sustainable as the organization scales. 
 - Establish organization-wide engineering expectations for secure software delivery, supply-chain security, identity and access management, secrets management, policy enforcement, infrastructure automation, observability, reliability, and operational readiness. 
 - Drive adoption of OpenTelemetry-compatible observability, reliability engineering practices, SLOs, performance management, capacity planning, resilience testing, incident learning, and recovery strategies across engineering teams. 
 - Provide technical leadership for platform engineering capabilities, including containers, orchestration, Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, developer experience improvements, automation, self-service engineering capabilities, and FinOps optimization where appropriate. 
 - Define and govern compatibility, upgrade, migration, deprecation, recovery, and rollback strategies that protect customer continuity, partner investments, operational stability, and long-term platform evolution. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and technical leaders, establish engineering standards, review architectural direction, and influence cross-functional technical decision-making across the portfolio. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience modernizing large-scale ERP, enterprise business applications, batch-processing platforms, reporting platforms, or complex legacy systems. Legacy X3 technologies and 4GL experience are valuable context but are not required. 
 - Deep understanding of ERP, manufacturing, distribution, finance, supply-chain, commerce, or operational workflow domains, including platform modernization, migration, reconciliation, and business continuity. 
 - Experience leading platform engineering, SaaS infrastructure, cloud platform transformations, developer-experience initiatives, or internal platform product development. 
 - Experience designing extensible ecosystems, marketplace architectures, partner enablement platforms, metadata-driven platforms, migration factories, or highly configurable enterprise applications. 
 - Experience delivering regulated, highly available, enterprise-scale SaaS platforms with strong requirements for reliability, security, compliance, privacy, auditability, and operational governance. 
 - Experience influencing engineering organizations through architecture governance, technical strategy, technology roadmap definition, engineering excellence programs, and senior technical mentorship. 

Experience And Qualifications

- Typically 12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant ownership of architecture, platform strategy, distributed systems design, and cross-team technical leadership for large-scale cloud-native products. 
 - Demonstrated success leading major modernization, transformation, platform, or SaaS initiatives that span multiple teams, business domains, and technology stacks. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Recognized as a trusted technical leader capable of balancing customer outcomes, business priorities, engineering quality, operational excellence, and long-term architectural sustainability. 

Provide your feedback on BizChat

Expected outcomes / success measures

- A small number of agreed architecture decisions and transition states guide delivery without blocking squads. 
 - Modern components and contracts reduce coupling, runtime dependency and support effort while preserving customer behaviour. 
 - Critical releases and migration waves have repeatable quality, observability and rollback evidence. 
 - Engineers make more decisions locally because standards, examples and mentoring are clear. 

Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role's owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant. 

Key stakeholders and collaboration model

Works with Architects, Product Management, Engineering Managers, Principal and Senior Engineers, Automation, Cloud Support/L3, Security, Customer Services, partners and Europe/North America domain experts. India delivery is a first-class ownership centre with planned Europe/North America overlap and clear hand-offs across time zones. 

Sage behaviours / leadership expectations

Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Accountability, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Acts as a calm technical role model, makes uncertainty visible, develops talent and chooses the simplest safe path that improves customer and business outcomes. 

Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible. 

Key Responsibilities

Core accountabilities and decision ownership

- Own cross-squad technical strategy for a significant modernisation outcome, from current-state discovery through a viable transition state and measurable exit criteria. 
 - Make and record decisions on domain boundaries, GraphQL contracts, componentisation, data-path simplification and legacy-runtime reduction. 
 - Lead difficult implementation, incident, performance and migration problems; decide when to retain, wrap, translate, rebuild or retire a capability. 
 - Set engineering standards for secure coding, testing, observability, deployment, upgrades and rollback, and ensure they are adopted rather than merely documented. 
 - Coach senior and developing engineers, grow technical leadership in India and across the distributed squad network, and challenge designs constructively. 

Decision ownership: 

Technical direction within the assigned portfolio, cross-squad trade-offs, exception escalation, transition-state design and acceptance of engineering evidence. Escalates product, legal, security or commercial policy decisions with a clear recommendation. 

Common capability baseline

All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level: 

- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role. 
 - Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need. 
 - Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities. 
 - Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths. 
 - Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence. 
 - Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership. 
 - Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate. 
 - Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerization and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.

data.title: Lead Back End Engineer
data.description:
This is a leadership role in our engineering team - not just a cog in the wheel. 

This is not a "maintenance" role. This is engineering leadership-owning the backend architecture of a global, privacy-first communication platform. You'll lead by example, guide a high-calibre team, and ensure our backend systems remain blazing-fast, rock-solid, and uncompromising on security. You'll be at the intersection of code and leadership-mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, and setting engineering standards that define how a global product is built. 

Who are we?

We are a young product company scaling fast and outgrowing the startup tag-with global scale in our crosshairs. We don't do "okay. " We give everything we've got to build the best communication platform in the world. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top institutions-people who care deeply about the craft, performance, and purpose. You'll learn more in 6 months here than most engineers do in 3 years elsewhere. We're intense. High-strung. Focused. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top-tier

backgrounds. But what defines us is not our degrees-it's our refusal to compromise on quality, performance, or privacy. 

What are we building?

WrkTalk is the world's first zero-access, zero-spam enterprise communication product that operates on a structural privacy architecture. One that's already earned the trust of large enterprises like L&T Finance, Adani Group, and Kalyan Jewellers - just to name a few of our enterprise clients. This is not an MVP. This is production-grade software that secures communication for thousands-and soon, millions-of professionals worldwide. 

What's the role?

• Architect backend systems in NestJS and Golang to meet global scale and enterprise-grade performance. 

• Drive design for microservices, real-time comms (WebSockets, WebRTC), and data stores (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Lead code reviews, enforce coding standards, and maintain CI/CD discipline. 

• Mentor and upskill backend engineers. 

• Collaborate cross-functionally with frontend, DevOps, and product leaders. 

• Own technical problem-solving-anticipate bottlenecks, make hard calls, and prevent tech debt from being parked for "later. "

• Manage task allocation, workflow discipline, and ensure smooth collaboration with frontend and DevOps. 

The tech here is serious. 

We work on socket-driven comms infrastructure, distributed control towers, multi-category encryption, root detection, app kill-switches, dynamic guest access, device-level lockout, and OOO/ DND logic layered with smart whitelisting. This is not lightweight app dev. This is protocol-layer decision-making. 

Who should apply?

• 6-8+ years in backend engineering, with at least 2 years in a leadership role. 

• Expertise in Golang and Node. js (NestJS). 

• Strong database tuning skills (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Solid understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, and scalable deployment. 

• Experience building real-time systems at scale. 

• Proven ability to lead technical discussions and inspire engineering teams. 

• Track record of shipping production-grade, high-performance systems. 

Why should you join?

• Because you want to own backend architecture-not just follow it

• Because you'll work directly with established founders, not buried under layers

• Because you'll ship real, deeply engineered features used by large number of enterprise users

• Because you'll grow 10x faster here-in experience, learning, and impact

• And because if you walk this road with us for 3-4 years, it'll catapult you into a tech orbit or fame and glory you never imagined

Where are we located?

We're based in Navi Mumbai and building for the world.

data.title: Team Lead - AI & Data Science
data.description:
Designation : Team Lead - AI & Data Science

Required Experience: 5-6 years overall with AI/ML, data science or applied AI; at least 5 years of hands-on AI/ML/data-science work and 2+ years of technical/team leadership. 

Job Description:   

Aventior is looking for a hands-on Team Lead - AI & Data Science to lead customer-facing AI and analytics engagements from discovery through production and ongoing improvement.   

The role combines technical direction, people leadership, customer communication and delivery ownership. You will turn business problems into clear requirements, assess feasibility and data readiness, shape pragmatic AI/GenAI solutions, guide engineers and data scientists, and deliver secure, measurable outcomes in production. 

The strongest candidate is equally comfortable discussing business value with a customer, explaining technical options and trade-offs, reviewing code or model quality, and managing scope, risks and delivery commitments. 

Key Responsibilities:   

    

1. Customer engagement, discovery and requirement gathering -

●Lead customer and stakeholder discovery sessions, interviews and workshops to understand business goals, users, existing workflows, pain points, data sources, constraints and success criteria. 

●Translate business needs into clear problem statements, functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies and measurable KPIs. 

● Assess data availability, data quality, integration constraints, privacy/security requirements and technical feasibility before recommending an approach. 

● Present solution options and trade-offs in business-friendly language, including build-versus-buy, model selection, expected value, risks, cost, latency and operational implications. 

● Lead proof-of-concept planning, demos, review meetings and customer sign-off; manage clarifications, scope changes, priorities and expectation setting throughout the engagement. 

2. AI solution architecture and technical leadership

● Own solution design across data ingestion and preparation, model or LLM selection, retrieval, orchestration, APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure and operational monitoring. 

● Choose fit-for-purpose approaches for the business problem rather than defaulting to a particular model, vendor, framework or architecture pattern. 

● Establish engineering standards through design reviews, code reviews, testing practices, reusable components, documentation and secure development practices. 

● Remain hands-on for critical design decisions, prototypes, complex debugging and performance/cost optimization while enabling the team to execute independently. 

3. Generative AI, LLMs, RAG and agentic workflows

● Design and deliver LLM-powered applications using commercial APIs and/or managed or open models; apply prompt design, structured outputs, tool/function calling and workflow orchestration as appropriate. 

● Build and improve RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector or hybrid retrieval, reranking, access-aware retrieval, source attribution and grounded answer generation. 

● Select and apply agentic patterns only where they add value; define tool permissions, bounded actions, state transitions, approval steps, retries and safe failure behavior. 

● Create systematic evaluation approaches for task success, groundedness, retrieval relevance, factuality, safety and user experience; use representative test sets, regression tests and human review where needed. 

●Improve quality, latency and cost through retrieval/model comparisons, prompt and context tuning, caching, routing, token-usage controls and production feedback loops. 

4. Applied machine learning and data science

● Guide the framing, development and validation of appropriate ML/statistical solutions such as classification, regression, forecasting, anomaly detection, clustering, NLP or optimization. 

● Establish baselines and evaluation criteria; interpret results, investigate failure modes, check for data leakage and communicate limitations and confidence clearly. 

● Partner with data engineers and analysts on data profiling, feature engineering, data pipelines, dataset quality, reproducibility and reliable access to data. 

● Guide specialist computer-vision, OCR/intelligent document processing or multimodal work when required by the project portfolio; deep specialist research methods are not a blanket requirement for this role. 

5. Production engineering, cloud and MLOps / LLMOps

●Build or guide production services and integrations using Python and REST APIs (FastAPI or equivalent), with appropriate validation, authentication, error handling, testing and documentation. 

●Deploy and operate solutions in AWS or the agreed cloud platform. Relevant AWS services may include S3, SageMaker, Bedrock, RDS, Glue, EventBridge, Redshift, Lambda and container/orchestration services, depending on the architecture. 

●Implement or oversee CI/CD, containerization, environment management, model/prompt/version tracking, automated tests, release controls, rollback and operational handover. 

●Monitor application health and business/model quality, including latency, throughput, availability, cost, token consumption, retrieval quality, feedback signals and model/data drift where applicable. 

● Own incident triage and root-cause analysis with engineering/platform teams; define fallback paths and support processes for customer-facing AI capabilities. 

6. Delivery management and stakeholder alignment

●Own the delivery plan from discovery to launch: estimates, milestones, sprint/backlog priorities, resource needs, dependencies, risks, testing, UAT, release readiness and transition to support. 

●Maintain a clear decision, action and risk log; provide concise progress updates; escalate issues early and propose options instead of only reporting blockers. 

●Coordinate across customer teams, product/business analysts, data engineering, software engineering, QA, cloud/DevOps, security and domain experts. 

●Ensure acceptance criteria and agreed business outcomes are met, and capture lessons learned and post-launch improvements

7. Team leadership, governance and responsible AI

● Coach and mentor AI engineers and data scientists; support work allocation, technical growth, feedback, code/model reviews and consistent quality standards. 

●Apply appropriate data governance, privacy, access control, PII handling, audit logging, human review and responsible-AI safeguards based on use-case risk. 

●Identify GenAI-specific risks such as prompt injection, insecure tool access, unintended data exposure, unsupported outputs and misuse; document mitigations and residual risks. 

●Build reusable patterns, documentation and team practices that improve delivery predictability across multiple customer engagements

Required Qualifications and experience: 

●5-6 years of relevant software engineering, AI/ML, data science or applied                          

  AI experience, including at least 5 years of hands-on delivery experience. 

●At least 2 years leading a technical team, delivery workstream or project; demonstrated ownership of technical decisions and outcomes. 

●At least 2 years in customer-facing or stakeholder-facing delivery, with evidence of running discovery workshops, clarifying requirements, presenting options and managing expectations. 

●Strong Python engineering and practical SQL/data skills; understanding of testing, APIs, code quality and software engineering fundamentals. 

●Strong applied ML/statistical reasoning and model evaluation skills, including the ability to choose baselines, validate results and explain limitations. 

●At least 2 years building GenAI/LLM applications, including practical RAG experience; able to explain architecture, evaluation, failure modes and production trade-offs. At least one production deployment is strongly preferred. 

●Working experience with AWS or the target cloud platform, and with model/application deployment, CI/CD, observability and production support. 

●Experience with REST APIs using FastAPI or an equivalent Python web framework, and with at least one vector database or semantic-search technology when RAG is in scope. 

●Strong communication, facilitation, documentation, mentoring and problem-solving skills. 

●Hands-on experience with agentic/tool-using workflows, multimodal LLMs, VLMs, or more than one model provider. 

●Computer vision, OCR, intelligent document processing, object detection, image segmentation or document-understanding experience where relevant to the client pipeline. 

●Experience with model fine-tuning, embedding adaptation, open-source model serving or GPU/inference optimization. 

●Familiarity with evaluation and tracing tools such as LangSmith, OpenTelemetry, Phoenix or equivalent; equivalent tools are acceptable. 

●Experience in consulting, professional services or multi-client delivery environments. 

●Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Statistics or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may be considered.
