Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values - caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like what we're saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

In SimCorp, we help some of the biggest financial institutions in the world be successful by simplifying their accounting, operations, and investments. We do this through IT systems, processes, and financial knowledge. High quality, performing, secure, and cost-effective software is at the core of what we do. To build, maintain and operate this software, engineers are essential to us. 

SimCorp's AI & Insights area is building the foundation for the agentic future of investment operations: Running SimCorp agents, leveraging partner agents, and integrating with clients workflows. The AI Platform team owns that foundation: a compliant, standardized, secure, and user-friendly agentic ecosystem that domain teams can leverage when building their AI features. 

The team's recent deliveries and current focus include preparing Agent Orchestrator and SimCorp One Neo for production, publishing the Agent Development Stack, implementing evaluation, trust, safety and guardrails, progressing multi-agent orchestration, and exploring MCP for SimCorp One APIs. 

You will be working with a team located in Noida/Hyderabad in India and Copenhagen, Denmark. The Product Development team functions as a center of enablement for artificial intelligence (AI), providing knowledge and guidelines to other teams, as well as working hands on implementing and operating solutions with AI. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

The Lead Software Engineer at SimCorp, at the IC5 grade, is responsible for leading and driving the design, development, and implementation of complex software solutions. This role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop high-quality software that meets business requirements and technical specifications. The Lead Software Engineer takes ownership of key engineering projects, provides technical guidance to junior engineers, and ensures that software is delivered on time and within scope. This position requires strong problem-solving skills, expertise in software engineering practices, and the ability to work in a collaborative and fast-paced environment. 

We work team-based, so your primary responsibility is as a team member. You need to make sure the team delivers on its commitments, that it's a good place to work for you and your teammates, and that it continuously improves. 

Daily tasks are for example: 

- Developing plugins and tools for generative AI models, Agentic AI solutions. 
 - Going from proof-of-concepts to high quality, production ready solutions. 
 - Integrating AI functionality with modules and Agents developed by other teams
 - Lead the design and development of software solutions, ensuring they meet business needs and technical requirements
 - Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams, fostering a collaborative and high-performance environment
 - Collaborate with product management, design, and quality assurance teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery of software solutions
 - Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, ensuring high-quality solutions that are scalable, reliable, and performant
 - Ensure adherence to software development best practices, including coding standards, testing, and documentation
 - Take ownership of key features and components, driving their design and implementation from concept to delivery
 - Continuously assess and improve engineering processes, recommending new tools and technologies to enhance productivity and software quality
 - Participate in code reviews, ensuring that the team follows best practices and maintains high standards for software quality

What We Value

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. 

- 7+ years of hands-on experience with . NET technologies (C#, Microsoft . NET). 
 - Experience in building AI solutions (preferably 2+ years), with a passion for Agentic AI and associated projects will be an added advantage. 
 - Experience with generative AI tools like OpenAI for Azure, protocols like A2A/MCP plugins & function calls for example through MAF. 
 - Comprehensive understanding and practical experience with application architecture, covering both frontend and backend systems
 - Proficiency in working with Azure and Azure DevOps. 
 - Experience with Agile development methodologies, as well as DevOps and CI/CD practices

As a person, you have the following traits: 

- Taking ownership. Comfortable taking the lead on tasks. 
 - Earn trust, think big, and take calculated risks. 
 - You collaborate with team members to work towards common goals. 
 - Solid problem-solving skills and comfortable questioning assumptions and as-is. 
 - Exhibits a consistent approach and a creative mindset. 
 - Thrives in a collaborative environment and values teamwork
 - Like to have fun at work and positivity comes easily to you
 - Excellent English verbal and communication skills

Benefits

- Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference. 
 - Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application. 
 - Self-Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work. 
 - Inclusive and diverse company culture
 - Work-life balance - We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace
 - Empowerment - We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. 

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. 

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. 

Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3, 000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

data.title: Principal/Senior/Software Engineer (AI-Powered Advertising Agents - AgenticOS)
data.description:
About The Role

PubMatic is looking for engineers with expertise in Generative AI and AI agent development. You will be responsible for building and optimizing advanced AI agents that leverage the latest technologies in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, and large language models (LLMs). You will work on developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance Generative AI capabilities and enable our platform to handle complex information retrieval, contextual generation, and adaptive interactions. 

What You'll Do

- Lead the design, development, and deployment of AI-driven features. Drive end-to-end ownership-from feasibility analysis and design specifications to execution and release-while ensuring quick iterations based on customer feedback in a fast-paced Agile environment. 
 - Spearhead technical design meetings and produce detailed design documents that outline scalable, secure, and robust AI architectures. 
 - Ensure that the solutions are aligned with long-term product strategy and technical roadmaps. 
 - Implement and optimize LLMs for specific use cases, including fine-tuning models, deploying pre-trained models, and evaluating their performance. 
 - Develop AI agents powered by RAG systems, integrating external knowledge sources to improve the accuracy and relevance of generated content. 
 - Design, implement, and optimize vector databases (e. g. , FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate) for efficient and scalable vector search, and work on various vector indexing algorithms. 
 - Create sophisticated prompts and fine-tune them to improve the performance of LLMs in generating precise and contextually relevant responses. 
 - Utilize evaluation frameworks and metrics (e. g. , Evals) to assess and improve the performance of generative models and AI systems. 
 - Work with data scientists, engineers, and product teams to integrate AI-driven capabilities into customer-facing products and internal tools. 
 - Stay up to date with the latest research and trends in LLMs, RAG, and generative AI technologies to drive innovation in the company's offerings. 
 - Continuously monitor and optimize models to improve their performance, scalability, and cost efficiency. 

We'd Love For You To Have

- 2 to 10 years of total experience and strong understanding of LLMs and their underlying principles - transformer architecture, attention mechanisms, and hyperparameter tuning. 
 - Proven experience designing and building AI agents, including multi-agent orchestration, tool-use patterns, multi-step planning, and agent memory architectures (short-term and long-term). 
 - Hands-on experience with agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen, and familiarity with RAG pipelines that integrate external knowledge sources (documents, databases, APIs). 
 - In-depth knowledge of vector databases and indexing algorithms; practical experience with FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, or Milvus. 
 - Experience with agent observability, tracing, and guardrails - tools like Langfuse or equivalent - to ensure reliability, safety, and debuggability of agentic systems. 
 - Proficiency in prompt engineering - crafting, iterating, and optimizing complex prompts for context-sensitive, domain-specific LLM outputs. 
 - Familiarity with Evals and other performance evaluation tools for measuring model quality, relevance, and efficiency. 
 - Proficiency in Python and experience with machine learning libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Hugging Face Transformers. 
 - Experience with data preprocessing, vectorization, and handling large-scale datasets. 
 - Ability to present complex technical ideas and results to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Nice-to-Have

- Experience in building AI agents using graph-based architectures, including knowledge graph embeddings and graph neural networks (GNNs). 
 - Experience with training small base models using custom data, including data collection, pre-processing, and fine-tuning models to specific domains or tasks. 
 - Familiarity with deploying AI models on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Familiarity with programmatic advertising, RTB, or ad auction mechanics. 
 - Knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar tool-integration standards
 - Publication or contributions to research in AI, LLMs, or related fields. 

Qualification

Should have a bachelor's degree in engineering or an equivalent degree from a well-known institute/university. 

Additional Information

Return to Office: PubMatic employees throughout the globe have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days "in office" and 2 days "working remotely") that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions. 

Benefits: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we're back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!. 

Diversity and Inclusion: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don't just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status

About PubMatic

PubMatic is one of the world's leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes. 

Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.

Role: Full Stack Developer / Lead - Full Stack Development

Location: Pune, MH

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Developer / Lead with 5-10 years of experience to design, build, and maintain scalable, high-performance applications. This role blends hands-on full stack development with technical leadership, including mentoring developers and contributing to architectural decisions. 

You will work on real-time, cloud-native systems that integrate with IoT devices and sensors for critical applications. The platform enables real-time control, monitoring, dashboards, and alerting through secure web, mobile, and cloud solutions. Reliability, availability, and compliance are key design considerations. 

Key Responsibilities

• Technical & Development

• Design, develop, and maintain scalable full stack applications using Python and Golang for backend services and React. js for frontend development. 

• Build cloud-native microservices and REST APIs for real-time monitoring, control, and alerting systems. 

• Develop intuitive web dashboards and applications for real-time visualization, alerts, emergency messaging, and scheduled events. 

• Engineer real-time data pipelines and communication systems using technologies such as Kafka, REST APIs, MQTT, WebRTC, or SIP where applicable. 

• Implement high-availability, fault-tolerant architectures, including failover mechanisms, device heartbeat monitoring, and telemetry analytics. 

• Design, manage, and optimize PostgreSQL databases, ensuring performance, scalability, and data integrity. 

• Cloud, Data & Platforms

• Deploy, manage, and scale applications on AWS, leveraging services such as EC2, S3, RDS, and other cloud-native components. 

• Integrate and work with big data and streaming platforms, including Apache Hadoop, Apache Spark, and Apache Kafka. 

• Build and maintain logging, monitoring, and observability solutions using the Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana). 

• Contribute to or integrate machine learning models (using TensorFlow) to enhance system intelligence and analytics where required. 

• Leadership & Collaboration

• Mentor and guide junior and mid-level engineers, promoting best practices and code quality. 

• Participate in code reviews, ensuring adherence to coding standards, performance, and security guidelines. 

• Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, hardware/embedded teams, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions. 

• Contribute to architectural discussions, technical planning, and continuous improvement of development processes. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

• Experience: 5-10 years of professional experience in full stack software development. 

• Education: BE / BTech / MTech / MCA (Computer Science or related field). 

• Backend: Strong hands-on experience with Python and Golang. 

• Frontend: Proficiency in React. js and its ecosystem (Hooks, Redux, etc. ). 

• APIs & Microservices: Experience building scalable RESTful services and microservice-based systems. 

• Databases: Strong experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design and query optimization.

data.description:
P-1408

The Mission

We are democratizing Data and AI for every enterprise user. Our vision is a world where anyone can master their organization's data through Apps and AI Agents. We are building the retrieval backbone for two worlds: the high-precision context layer for AI agents and the intuitive search experience for people goal is the same: instant, accurate, and actionable insight. 

The Role

- As a Search Quality Engineer, you sit at the heart of this transformation. You aren't just building a search engine; you are building the contextual backbone of the entire company. 
 - You will own the quality of results for two distinct but deeply connected "users": 
 - The AI Agent: Optimizing the retrieval layer that allows LLMs to reason over data they weren't trained on, ensuring they have the "ground truth" needed to synthesize accurate, high-stakes business actions. 
 - The Human User: Improving the traditional search experience so employees can find assets and answers through intuitive, high-recall interfaces. 

The Technical Challenge

This isn't a solved problem. You will be tackling "Search" in its most evolved form: 

- Hybrid Retrieval: Balancing traditional keyword-based search (for exactness) with semantic vector search (for intent). 
 - Dual-Optimization: Fine-tuning ranking models that satisfy both human readability and LLM-ready context. 
 - High-Stakes Accuracy: In a world of Agents, poor search quality leads to hallucinations. You will build the guardrails and relevance scoring that ensure our AI stays grounded in reality. 
 - Data Heterogeneity: Connecting the dots across structured SQL tables, unstructured docs, and real-time business metrics. 

Why This is the Place to Be

- You will have a front-row seat to the Agentic revolution. If you want to solve the hardest problems in data discovery and see your work power the decision-making of thousands of people, let's talk. 

What We're Looking For

- The IR Specialist: You know your way around Lucene/Elasticsearch, embeddings, and ranking algorithms. 
 - The Quality and Metrics Obsessive: You understand that "relevance" is subjective and love building evaluation frameworks (human-in-the-loop and LLM-based) to measure it. You are obsessed with relevance metrics (nDCG, MRR, Precision@K). 
 - The Bridge Builder: You're excited to apply traditional Information Retrieval (IR) wisdom to the cutting-edge world of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

 - Coach mid-level engineers into seniors and seniors into staff-track contributors; run a healthy interview loop and onboarding plan.

 - Partner with Product, Design, and Platform stakeholders to translate roadmap into well-scoped engineering work; own delivery commitments - estimation accuracy, scope discipline, and on-time releases. 
 - Represent ActivePipe Engineering in cross-team initiatives across the broader MoxiWorks technology org and in collaborations with global engineering leadership. 
 - Drive incident response and post-incident learning; own the on-call posture and reliability of the platform. 

Required Skills

- 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 2 years leading a team of 3+ engineers (tech lead, or staff engineer with people leverage). 
 - Deep Ruby on Rails background - you have shipped, scaled, and rescued non-trivial Rails systems in production. 
 - Strong systems thinking - distributed systems, event-driven architecture, ETL / data pipelines, and SQL at scale. 
 - Hands-on Kafka (or equivalent streaming platform) and Sidekiq (or equivalent background processing). 
 - Solid experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs; familiarity with GraphQL is a strong plus. 
 - Working knowledge of relational databases (MySQL or PostgreSQL), including schema design, indexing, query optimization, and migration safety at scale. 
 - Track record of mentoring engineers, conducting fair code reviews, and running healthy hiring loops. 
 - Excellent written communication - design docs, PR descriptions, incident write-ups, and clear async updates with global teammates. 
 - Comfortable operating in a multi-team, cross-product organization with stakeholders in multiple time zones. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 

Nice to Have

- Real estate, MLS, CRM, MarTech, or other high-volume data-driven SaaS domain experience. 
 - Familiarity with real estate data standards (RESO Data Dictionary, RESO Web API, RETS). 
 - GraphQL schema stewardship across multiple consumers; exposure to schema federation. 
 - AWS infrastructure literacy - ability to read Terraform, debug an ECS deployment, or reason about RDS performance. 
 - Prior experience contributing to or owning observability and SRE practices (Datadog, on-call rotations, SLOs). 
 - Experience leading a polyglot team - specifically Ruby + PHP, or Ruby + JVM/Go. 

Tech Stack

Ruby on Rails, PHP, REST and GraphQL APIs, MySQL, Elasticsearch, Redis, Sidekiq, Karafka / Kafka, AWS, Docker, Git/GitHub, Buildkite, Datadog, Protobuf, and a growing set of internal tooling for building, monitoring, and operating the platform at scale. 

Growth Opportunities

Lead Software Engineer - AI and DevOps

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values - caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like what we're saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

In SimCorp, we help some of the biggest financial institutions in the world be successful by simplifying their accounting, operations, and investments. We do this through IT systems, processes, and financial knowledge. High quality, performing, secure, and cost-effective software is at the core of what we do. To build, maintain and operate this software, engineers are essential to us. 

SimCorp's AI & Insights area is building the foundation for the agentic future of investment operations: Running SimCorp agents, leveraging partner agents, and integrating with clients workflows. The AI Platform team owns that foundation: a compliant, standardized, secure, and user-friendly agentic ecosystem that domain teams can leverage when building their AI features. 

The team's recent deliveries and current focus include preparing Agent Orchestrator and SimCorp One Neo for production, publishing the Agent Development Stack, implementing evaluation, trust, safety and guardrails, progressing multi-agent orchestration, and exploring MCP for SimCorp One APIs. 

You will be working with a team located in Noida/Hyderabad in India and Copenhagen, Denmark. The Product Development team functions as a center of enablement for artificial intelligence (AI), providing knowledge and guidelines to other teams, as well as working hands on implementing and operating solutions with AI. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

The Lead Software Engineer (DevOps) at SimCorp, at the IC5 grade, is responsible for

DevOps best practices and the Azure cloud ecosystem for AI enabled software solutions. This role requires a strong mix of hands-on engineering, architectural thinking, and leadership to ensure both immediate delivery and long-term sustainability. You will be part of a scrum team working closely with Product Owner and business stakeholders. The Lead Software Engineer takes ownership of key engineering projects, provides technical guidance to junior engineers, and ensures that software is delivered on time and within scope. This position requires strong problem-solving skills, expertise in software engineering practices, and the ability to work in a collaborative and fast-paced environment. 

We work team-based, so your primary responsibility is as a team member. You need to make sure the team delivers on its commitments, that it's a good place to work for you and your teammates, and that it continuously improves. 

Daily tasks are for example: 

- Build and maintain Infrastructure, CI/CD process and monitoring for AI solutions developed using C#, . Net and Azure. 
 - Going from proof-of-concepts to high quality, production ready solutions. 
 - Lead the design and development of DevOps solutions and infrastructure ensuring they meet business needs and technical requirements
 - Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering team, fostering a collaborative and high-performance environment
 - Collaborate with product management, design, and quality assurance teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery of software solutions. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, ensuring high-quality solutions that are scalable, reliable, and performant
 - Ensure adherence to Devops best practices, including industry standards, testing, and documentation
 - Take ownership of key features and components, driving their design and implementation from concept to delivery
 - Continuously assess and improve engineering processes, AI advancements, automation, recommending new tools and technologies to enhance productivity and software quality
 - Participate in code reviews, ensuring that the team follows best practices and maintains high standards for azure infrastructure and pipelines. 

What We Value

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. 

- 7+ years of hands-on experience with DevOps. 
 - Deep understanding of modern CI/CD, industry best practices and tooling
 - Sound understanding of Azure cloud services, infrastructure, pipelines, scalability and architecture
 - Experience deploying solutions using Azure OpenAI, Azure Foundry, model versioning & quota mgmt. 
 - Experience with RAG pipelines (Azure AI Search, embedding pipelines, indexing jobs)
 - Exposure to Agentic frameworks (MAF, MCP/A2A plugins, etc)
 - Observability design (App Insights/Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry) and incident response
 - Good understanding of Managed Identity first, Key Vault integration, secure network boundaries, Azure Policy, RBAC, networking, private endpoints
 - Solid experience of Azure Bicep, PowerShell scripts and Yaml for IaC. 
 - Understanding of data governance (PII, tenant isolation) for AI workloads

As a person, you have the following traits: 

- Taking ownership. Comfortable taking the lead on tasks. 
 - Earn trust, think big, and take calculated risks. 
 - You collaborate with team members to work towards common goals. 
 - Solid problem-solving skills and comfortable questioning assumptions and as-is. 
 - Exhibits a consistent approach and a creative mindset. 
 - Thrives in a collaborative environment and values teamwork
 - Like to have fun at work and positivity comes easily to you
 - Excellent English verbal and communication skills

Benefits

- Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference. 
 - Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application. 
 - Self-Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work. 
 - Inclusive and diverse company culture
 - Work-life balance - We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace
 - Empowerment - We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. 

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. 

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. 

Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3, 000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

data.title: Lead Service Data Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

The Service & Operational Insights organization is seeking a Lead Service Data Engineer to join our growing Service & Operational Data team. This candidate will build, scale, and operationalize the data platform that powers service reliability, operational visibility, and data-driven decision-making across technology operations, partnering closely with the Enterprise Architect, Service & Operational Data, and other key stakeholders to translate target-state architecture, canonical data models, and governance standards into robust, production-grade pipelines and data products. 

Key Responsibilities

- Implement the target architecture: Translate the operational data architecture and roadmap (incidents, changes, problems, alerts/events, CMDB, SLOs/SLIs, capacity, cost) into concrete, well-engineered pipelines, implementing canonical schemas such as service topology, event normalization, and incident timelines. 
 - Own pipeline reliability and operations: Build batch and streaming pipelines ingesting data from ITSM, observability platforms, cloud logs/metrics/traces, CI/CD, and infrastructure systems - with strong monitoring, alerting, and on-call practices. 
 - Operationalize data quality and trust: Implement data contracts, validation rules, testing frameworks, and lineage tracking; enforce dataset SLAs/SLOs and drive remediation when breached. 
 - Deliver operational data products: Build and maintain curated datasets, semantic layers, and metrics definitions powering dashboards, analytics, and automation use cases (AIOps, correlation, anomaly detection). 
 - Drive engineering excellence and mentorship: Establish coding standards, CI/CD practices, and reference implementations; provide technical direction through design/code reviews and mentor team members. 
 - Partner cross-functionally: Work with the Architect and Service Reporting team to influence data model design; collaborate with SRE, IT Ops, Security, and Analytics stakeholders to prioritize high-value use cases (incident reduction, alert noise reduction, change failure rate, capacity planning). 
 - Implement governance and security controls: Build RBAC/ABAC enforcement, retention policies, encryption, and auditability into pipelines and platforms. 
 - Support the roadmap: Provide engineering estimates, identify technical risks, and help sequence delivery of the operational data roadmap. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field, with 10 + years of experience as a Data Engineer working with complex, large-scale data
 - Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with proven experience designing and delivering production-grade batch and streaming data pipelines
 - Experience building data products (curated datasets, semantic layers, metrics definitions) and applying security governance principles (RBAC/ABAC, encryption, retention, auditability)
 - Familiarity with ITSM, observability, and cloud data sources (incidents, changes, alerts/events, CMDB, logs/metrics/traces), along with data quality practices (contracts, testing, lineage)
 - Strong problem-solving skills with minimal supervision, excellent communication, and ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in parallel. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting AIOps, correlation, or anomaly detection use cases
 - Familiarity with SLA/SLO enforcement frameworks for data platforms
 - Experience with capacity planning, cost, and reliability engineering data domains
 - Prior experience partnering with data architecture functions to shape canonical schemas and data models
 - Experience with DevOps technologies such as Jenkins, CodePipeline, CloudFormation, Terraform, Ansible

What's in it For You?

- Hybrid Work Model: We've adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected. 
 - Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance. 
 - Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow's challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future. 
 - Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing. 
 - Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together. 
 - Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. 
 - Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world. 

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news. 

We are powered by the talents of 26, 000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace. 

We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:
Meet the Team

The Cisco cnBNG Control Plane team builds Cisco's cloud-native Broadband Network Gateway - the carrier-grade subscriber-management brain that runs as microservices on the SMI (Subscriber Microservices Infrastructure) / Kubernetes platform and interworks with IOS-XR, Silicon One-based User Plane Functions (UPFs). We power some of the world's largest residential and business broadband deployments, serving millions of subscribers with strict availability and scale requirements. 

We value technical depth, automation-first engineering, continuous learning, collaborative problem-solving, and responsible adoption of AI-assisted development practices. 

Your Impact

As a Software Engineer on the cnBNG Control Plane, you will own the design, delivery, and end-to-end quality of carrier-grade subscriber-management features in a cloud-native architecture. You will build session-handling, CP-UP separation, redundancy, and scale capabilities that keep millions of subscribers online across Silicon One-based UPFs - and own their unit, integration, system, and scale validation with automation-first practices. You will mentor junior engineers and use modern AI-assisted tools to accelerate development, testing, and debugging. 

What You Will Do

Design, develop, and maintain cnBNG Control Plane microservices (C/C++/Go) on the SMI/Kubernetes platform, interworking with IOS-XR / Silicon One-based User Plane Functions. 

Implement and enhance subscriber-management functionality: PPPoE/IPoE session bring-up, DHCPv4/DHCPv6 (server/proxy/relay), Prefix Delegation, RADIUS/AAA, PAP/CHAP, accounting, Change of Authorization, IPAM, subscriber policy, and QoS. 

Develop and harden CP-UP separation over the State Control Interface - session programming, state download/replay, and reconciliation between the Control Plane and Silicon One UPFs. 

Build features for scale and high availability: cluster upscale, N: M and geo/warm redundancy (SRG), CP-GR switchover, and subscriber-session continuity during CP-UP communication failures. 

Own quality end-to-end: write unit tests and component/integration tests; design and execute system, regression, scale, performance, resiliency, and high-availability tests for your features. 

Develop reusable, scalable test automation (Python; pyATS/Genie or equivalent) and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines and regression suites. 

Build and maintain containerized/virtual/cloud-based test environments (Docker, Kubernetes, SMI) and validate subscriber-scale, traffic, failover, upgrade/rollback, process-restart, and subscriber-churn scenarios. 

Optimize control-plane performance, memory, and convergence for millions of subscribers across large UPF fleets. 

Develop and maintain gRPC/REST APIs and YANG/OpenConfig models, plus CLI and model-driven telemetry for configuration and operational visibility. 

Troubleshoot complex, distributed issues across CP, Silicon One UPFs, and the SMI/Kubernetes stack; drive RCA using logs, traces, core dumps, RADIUS transactions, and telemetry. 

Manage code with Git; participate in code reviews; collaborate with Test Engineering on feature, scale, and HA validation. 

Work with architects, DE/DT leads, and PLM to deliver features across the release lifecycle (BC/CC, AC/EC, DEVELOPING, FCS). 

Actively use approved AI coding assistants and engineering agents for code generation, unit/automation test creation, static analysis, log analysis, defect triage, and documentation - validating AI-generated output responsibly. 

Minimum Qualifications (Must-Have)

Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field. 

Experience in systems/embedded or cloud-native software engineering for networking products. 

Strong programming in C/C++ and/or Go on Linux; Python for test automation and scripting. 

Hands-on experience writing unit, integration, system, and scale/performance tests, and building automation (pyATS/Genie or equivalent) integrated into CI/CD and regression pipelines. 

Solid understanding of IP networking and subscriber/broadband protocols: PPPoE, IPoE, DHCPv4/v6, RADIUS/AAA, PPP, L2TP. 

Working knowledge of Cisco Silicon One (SiOne) NPU-based User Plane Functions (UPFs) - data-plane/forwarding architecture, CP-to-UPF programming, and how subscriber sessions map to NPU forwarding. 

Cloud-native fundamentals: Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, and service meshes. 

Experience building and consuming gRPC/REST APIs and data models (YANG, protobuf). 

Distributed-systems concepts: high availability, redundancy, state reconciliation, and scale. 

Strong Linux skills; experience with Git, code reviews, debugging, and CI/CD pipelines. 

AI-assisted engineering is a must: hands-on use of AI coding assistants (e. g. , GitHub Copilot) and a working understanding of generative AI, AI agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), reusable AI skills, prompt/context management, and responsible validation of AI-generated output. 

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on with BNG/CUPS, CP-UP separation, SRG geo/warm redundancy, or 5G/BNG converged-core architectures. 

Experience with SMI (Subscriber Microservices Infrastructure) or similar cloud-native telco platforms. 

Familiarity with Silicon One platform families (Cisco 8000 / ASR 9000 / NCS) as User Planes. 

Scale/performance characterization and traffic/subscriber-simulation tools (IXIA/Spirent). 

Databases/caching for network state (SQL/NoSQL, key-value stores, etcd); AAA/policy, IPAM at scale, and QoS. 

Model-driven telemetry, NETCONF/RESTCONF/gNMI, OpenConfig; Aha/Jira API suites. 

Expectations

The successful candidate will independently own a significant Control Plane feature area and its unit/integration/system/scale validation and automation, deliver production-quality code and tests, lead complex investigations across CP and Silicon One UPFs, and provide evidence-based release recommendations - while influencing design, mentoring, and using AI-assisted tools responsibly with security and engineering accountability.

data.title: GPU DevOps / Infrastructure Setup Engineer
data.description:
We are looking for an experienced GPU DevOps / Infrastructure Setup Engineer to build, configure, deploy, and maintain GPU-enabled infrastructure for AI/ML and High-Performance Computing (HPC) workloads. 

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with GPU server setup, on-premises AI infrastructure, Linux administration, NVIDIA GPU drivers, CUDA, containerization, infrastructure automation, and GPU workload deployment. 

Experience with NVIDIA Base Command Manager (BCM), GPU cluster bring-up, InfiniBand networking, and LLM application deployment will be highly preferred. Candidates with experience across different GPU hardware vendors and cloud, on-premises, or hybrid environments are welcome. 

Key Responsibilities

- Set up, configure, and maintain GPU-enabled servers, compute nodes, and AI infrastructure. 
 - Build and deploy on-premises AI infrastructure and GPU compute clusters. 
 - Perform end-to-end GPU cluster bring-up, including provisioning, configuration, validation, and testing. 
 - Configure and manage NVIDIA Base Command Manager (BCM) for cluster deployment and management, where applicable. 
 - Install and configure operating systems, GPU drivers, CUDA Toolkit, libraries, and supporting software. 
 - Deploy and maintain GPU workloads on bare-metal servers, cloud platforms, and hybrid environments. 
 - Configure GPU-enabled Docker containers and Kubernetes workloads. 
 - Deploy and manage LLM applications using frameworks such as vLLM, Ollama, Hugging Face Text Generation Inference (TGI), or NVIDIA Triton. 
 - Configure and troubleshoot GPU hardware, driver compatibility, CUDA initialization, memory utilization, and workload execution issues. 
 - Support InfiniBand networking and high-speed interconnects for multi-GPU or multi-node environments. 
 - Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and deployment using appropriate scripting and automation tools. 
 - Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments. 
 - Monitor GPU utilization, memory, temperature, power consumption, system health, and performance. 
 - Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, health checks, and automated recovery using tools such as Prometheus and Grafana. 
 - Optimize GPU utilization, VRAM consumption, inference latency, throughput, and overall infrastructure performance. 
 - Troubleshoot Linux, networking, storage, container, hardware, and application deployment issues. 
 - Perform infrastructure upgrades, patching, maintenance, capacity planning, and resource scaling. 
 - Maintain technical documentation, installation procedures, configuration guides, and troubleshooting records. 
 - Collaborate with AI/ML, development, platform, and infrastructure teams to support production workloads. Required Technical Skills

GPU Infrastructure and Hardware

- Hands-on experience with GPU server setup, configuration, and operations. 
 - Knowledge of GPU hardware, server components, PCIe, power requirements, cooling, and hardware compatibility. 
 - Experience with GPU models such as NVIDIA A100, H100, H200, L40S, RTX series, or equivalent GPU platforms. Linux, Drivers, and CUDA

- Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills. 
 - Experience installing and configuring GPU drivers, CUDA Toolkit, and supporting libraries. 
 - Ability to validate GPU detection, driver functionality, CUDA compatibility, and workload execution. AI Infrastructure and HPC

- Experience building or maintaining on-premises AI infrastructure. 
 - Understanding of GPU cluster provisioning, compute nodes, and cluster validation. 
 - Experience with NVIDIA Base Command Manager (BCM) is preferred. 
 - Experience deploying on-premises GPU infrastructure without BCM is also valuable. 
 - Knowledge of InfiniBand, RDMA, and high-speed networking for GPU clusters is an advantage. DevOps and Containerization

- Experience with Docker and GPU-enabled containers. 
 - Kubernetes experience for GPU workload deployment and orchestration. 
 - Infrastructure automation using Bash, Python, Ansible, Terraform, or equivalent tools. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, configuration management, and infrastructure monitoring. LLM Deployment and Performance

- Experience deploying LLM applications on GPU-enabled cloud instances or on-premises GPU servers. 
 - Familiarity with vLLM, Ollama, Hugging Face TGI, NVIDIA Triton, or equivalent model-serving frameworks. 
 - Understanding of API-based model serving and GPU resource allocation. 
 - Experience troubleshooting GPU memory issues and optimizing inference performance. 
 - Familiarity with Prometheus, Grafana, NVIDIA SMI, or DCGM for GPU monitoring. Experience Requirements

- 3+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, platform engineering, or infrastructure engineering. 
 - At least 1-2 years of hands-on experience working with GPU environments. 
 - Demonstrated experience in at least one real-world GPU infrastructure or AI deployment project. 
 - Ability to explain the infrastructure architecture, GPU hardware used, individual responsibilities, deployment process, and technical issues resolved. 
 - Experience supporting production environments is preferred. Preferred Qualifications

- End-to-end GPU cluster deployment using NVIDIA BCM. 
 - Hands-on InfiniBand configuration and troubleshooting. 
 - Bare-metal GPU server installation and configuration without Docker. 
 - Multi-GPU or multi-node cluster deployment. 
 - Production LLM serving and GPU performance optimization. 
 - Experience across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure environments. Candidate Profile

We are looking for engineers with practical infrastructure experience who can independently configure GPU environments, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and support reliable AI/ML and HPC deployments. 

Candidates must be able to explain real projects they have worked on, the GPU hardware and tools used, their individual contributions, and the challenges they successfully resolved.

data.title: Full-Stack Azure Engineer
data.description:
The role needs to combine hands-on application development with cloud architecture, SaaS provisioning, NoSQL data modelling, and production operations. Because SaaSApp requires a dedicated deployment for every customer, the candidate should have practical experience building automated single-tenant deployment stamps rather than only maintaining conventional hosted applications. 

Job Title

Full-Stack Azure SaaS Engineer

Position Objective

Own the technical architecture and hands-on implementation of SaaSApp's transition from a hosted application to a serverless SaaS platform. The platform will use a shared SaaS control plane and a dedicated application-and-data deployment stamp for each customer. 

This is a hands-on engineering position. The successful candidate must be able to make architecture decisions and implement production-quality React, Node. js, Python, NoSQL, infrastructure-as-code, security, deployment, and monitoring components. 

Essential Experience

- Minimum 4 years of relevant application-development or cloud-engineering experience. 
 - Previous delivery experience on a similar SaaS, cloud-native, serverless, deployment-stamp, or tenant-isolated application. 
 - Demonstrable ownership of application architecture and implementation, not only infrastructure administration. 
 - Experience moving a conventionally hosted or monolithic system to independently deployable services. Core Technical Requirements

- React
 - Node. js and TypeScript
 - Python
 - Azure Functions and Durable Functions
 - Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL
 - Azure Blob Storage
 - Azure Service Bus
 - Azure API Management
 - Azure Front Door and WAF
 - Microsoft Entra External ID
 - Azure Key Vault and managed identities
 - Application Insights and Log Analytics
 - Bicep or Terraform
 - Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
 - REST APIs, OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect, and role-based access control
 - Event-driven and asynchronous application architecturePrimary Accountabilities

- Define the SaaSApp target architecture and technical standards. 
 - Build reusable customer deployment-stamp templates. 
 - Build the central tenant registry and provisioning orchestrator. 
 - Implement automatic customer-instance deployment and validation. 
 - Lead NoSQL document modelling and Cosmos DB partitioning decisions. 
 - Implement case, user, organization, forms, document, and AI-processing services. 
 - Design deployment rings and customer-instance upgrade automation. 
 - Establish tenant isolation at the identity, compute, database, storage, secrets, and monitoring layers. 
 - Implement observability, security, backup, restore, and disaster-recovery controls. 
 - Review code and infrastructure changes for reliability, performance, security, supportability, and cost. 
 - Investigate production failures and improve the architecture based on operational findings. 
 - Maintain architecture decisions, API contracts, deployment procedures, and support runbooks. Evidence Expected From Applicants

Applicants should be able to describe a comparable project and clearly identify: 

- The SaaS tenancy model used
 - Which application and infrastructure components the applicant personally designed or built
 - How new customers were provisioned
 - How customer data was isolated
 - How databases were partitioned or separated
 - How asynchronous jobs and failures were handled
 - How customer deployments were upgraded
 - How monitoring, security, and recovery were implemented
 - What production issues occurred and how those issues were resolvedSuccess Indicators

- New customer instances can be provisioned consistently through automation. 
 - Customer data and runtime resources remain isolated. 
 - Application deployments can be rolled out through controlled release rings. 
 - APIs and background jobs are observable and safely retryable. 
 - Cosmos DB queries follow defined partitioning and indexing patterns. 
 - Customer documents are securely handled through Blob Storage. 
 - Deployment, upgrade, recovery, and decommissioning processes are documented and repeatable.

data.title: Co-Founder & CTO
data.description:
I'm not looking for someone to build an app. I'm looking for someone to build a company with me. 

I've spent years building Snapzo, made mistakes, learnt from them and understood what it really takes to build a scalable technology business. 

Now I'm looking for a technical co-founder who can take complete ownership of technology while I focus on business, growth, partnerships and fundraising. 

What you'll be building: 

- Own Snapzo's technology vision, architecture and product development. 
 - Lead the development of our mobile applications and backend infrastructure. 
 - Work with our existing native mobile stack, PHP and Python backend, and make the right technology decisions for the future. 
 - Build a scalable, secure and reliable platform capable of supporting millions of users. 
 - Hire, mentor and lead the engineering team as we grow. 
 - Work directly with me on product strategy, user experience, monetisation and investor discussions. 
 - Move fast, test assumptions and build around product-market fit rather than unnecessary features. Who I'm looking for: 

- 7-12+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering and product development. 
 - Strong understanding of mobile applications, backend systems, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Someone who has built and shipped real products, not just managed developers. 
 - Comfortable working with an existing codebase and improving it without rebuilding everything. 
 - A problem solver who understands business as much as technology. 
 - Someone who can work with limited resources today while preparing for much bigger opportunities tomorrow. 
 - Most importantly, someone who thinks like an owner, not an employee. One thing you should know. 

Snapzo is at an early stage. This isn't a conventional CTO position with a large team, established processes and guaranteed comfort. 

There will be unpredictable days, difficult decisions and moments when we'll have to figure things out ourselves. 

I'm looking for someone who can see what Snapzo could become over the next 5-10 years and is willing to put in the work to get there. 

This is a co-founder opportunity with an equity-led structure, subject to mutual agreement. We'll discuss ownership, commitment and long-term alignment transparently. 

I don't expect you to know everything. 

But I do expect you to take responsibility for finding the answers. 

I've already taken my bet on Snapzo. Now I'm looking for someone who wants to build it alongside me. 

If that sounds like you, don't send me just your CV. Tell me what you've built and why you want to build Snapzo. 

Kush Chauhan | Born at 41. 

kush@snapzo. in

data.title: Senior Developer, Artificial Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

A QA Engineer for AI Initiatives is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, fairness, and performance of AI/ML-powered products and systems. Unlike traditional QA, this role requires deep understanding of non-deterministic model behavior, data quality, and AI-specific failure modes such as hallucinations, bias, and model drift. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and execute test strategies specifically for AI/ML models, LLM-based applications, and data pipelines
 - Develop automated test frameworks for model validation, regression testing, and performance benchmarking
 - Evaluate model outputs for accuracy, consistency, relevance, hallucination, and bias across diverse inputs
 - Test RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, chatbots, recommendation systems, and other AI-driven features
 - Collaborate with data scientists and ML engineers to define acceptance criteria and quality thresholds
 - Build and maintain evaluation datasets, ground truth sets, and adversarial test cases
 - Monitor models in production for drift, degradation, and anomalous behavior
 - Validate data quality, data pipelines, and feature stores that feed AI systems
 - Document defects, edge cases, and failure patterns specific to AI behavior
 - Ensure AI systems meet ethical, fairness, and compliance standards (bias audits, explainability checks)

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
 - 3-6 years of QA experience, with at least 1-2 years in AI/ML quality assurance
 - Strong proficiency in Python for test automation and data analysis
 - Familiarity with LLM evaluation frameworks (e. g. , RAGAS, DeepEval, Promptfoo, LangSmith)
 - Hands-on experience with testing tools: Pytest, Selenium, Postman, or similar
 - Understanding of ML lifecycle - training, validation, deployment, and monitoring
 - Knowledge of data quality tools and pipeline testing (Great Expectations, dbt tests)

Nice to Have

- Experience with prompt engineering and red-teaming LLMs
 - Familiarity with MLOps platforms (MLflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI) 
 - Knowledge of vector databases and embedding quality evaluation
 - Understanding of AI safety, responsible AI principles, and fairness frameworks
 - Experience with A/B testing and shadow deployment strategies

Soft Skills

- Analytical and inquisitive mindset - comfortable challenging model outputs
 - Ability to think like both a user and an adversary (red-team thinking)
 - Strong documentation and communication skills
 - Collaborative approach with data science, engineering, and product teams
 - High attention to detail with a quality-first attitude

 - Awareness of cloud platforms such as AWS.

data.title: Member of Technical Staff - Kernel/BSP
data.description:
About Wind River

Wind River is a global leader in delivering software for mission-critical intelligent systems. For more than four decades, the company has been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that require the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability. 

Wind River helps customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries solve complex technology challenges on their journey toward the new intelligent machine economy. The company's software powers generation after generation of the safest, most secure systems in the world. Examples include playing a key role in NASA space missions such as Artemis I, the James Webb Space Telescope, and multiple Mars rovers. We've achieved recent 5G milestones including the world's first successful 5G data session with Verizon and building one of the largest Open RAN networks in the world with Vodafone. 

The company has received industry recognition for its technology innovation and leadership, and for its workplace culture, including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a "Top Workplace" for ten consecutive years. If you want to be part of a unique culture where the lived experience is based on our cultural attributes of growth mindset, customer-focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging, come join us and help advance the future software defined world. 

About The Role

As a Member of Technical Staff on the Wind River Linux team, you're the senior technical anchor for a safety-critical embedded Linux platform - and this is a build-and-decide role, not a keep-it-running one. You own the architecture-level calls across the Yocto build system, Linux kernel, and multiple BSPs; you drive where we go upstream; and you build the engineering workflows the whole team runs on. Yes, you'll keep the platform solid - but the reason this role exists is to move it forward: the tooling migration, the AI-native engineering stack, the upstream strategy, and the cross-layer problems no single track owner can close. 

You're the person the team leans on when a problem spans the kernel, the BSP, the build system, and a customer's field deployment all at once - and the one who decides how we solve that class of problem for good, not just this once. 

What You'll Do

Linux Kernel & Low-Level Development

- Drive determinism, real-time (PREEMPT_RT), and reliability improvements that hold up under safety-critical scrutiny - you set the technical bar here. 
 - Debug the deepest kernel, driver, networking, and boot issues across ARM/x86 (and PPC/RISC-V where relevant) with GDB, JTAG, ftrace, and perf. 
 - Own kernel maintenance across LTS lines as the baseline - backports, CVE remediation, -stable rebases, local-patch discipline - and, more importantly, decide the strategy that shrinks that burden over time. 

Multi-BSP & Yocto Build System

- Own the Yocto/OpenEmbedded architecture - layers, templates, recipe design, and the build-farm topology that produces the release matrix. 
 - Serve as the technical expert across multiple BSPs (Intel x86, ARM/Zynq MP, NXP i. MX, TI, NVIDIA Tegra, and the growing edge-AI board set): machine configs, kernel provider resolution, layer architecture, and platform bring-up. 
 - Resolve the cross-layer, cross-repo problems (recipe + BSP + kernel + template) that no single track owner can close alone. 

Build the Way the Team Works

- Drive AI-native engineering - CVE triage, test generation, build diagnosis - as the person who builds the workflows the team runs on, not just consumes them.

 - Partner with Engineering Leadership and HR on performance management and compensation planning. 
 - Participate in hiring activities, including candidate screening, interviewing, and selection.

Experience & Requirements

- 7+ years of experience in software development or a related technical role. 
 - Experience leading, mentoring, or providing technical direction to engineering teams. 
 - Strong background in designing, developing, and delivering software applications. 
 - Experience working in Agile development environments. 
 - Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. 
 - Experience driving engineering best practices, code quality, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies and Agile practices. 
 - Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities. 
 - Knowledge of secure coding standards, software security principles, and quality engineering practices. 
 - Ability to coach, mentor, and develop team members in a collaborative environment. 
 - Commitment to continuous learning and professional growth.

To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations. 

About Arctic Wolf

At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021-2025), Best Places to Work - USA (2021-2025), Great Place to Work - Canada (2021-2024), Great Place to Work - UK (2024-2026), and Kununu Top Company - Germany (2024-2026). As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry. 

Our Values

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that-by protecting people's and organizations' sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk- we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good. 

We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here. 

We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities. 

Benefits

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including: 

- Equity for all employees 
 - 18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days 
 - Training and career development programs 
 - Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance. 
 - A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru

Security Requirements

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business and customer information.

data.title: Sr. Full Stack Developer
data.description:
We are seeking an experienced Tech Lead to spearhead the modernisation of a large-scale enterprise application from legacy ASP. NET to a modern . NET 10 Web API and React stack. You will own the technical direction of a cross-functional delivery pod, mentor a team of developers, and drive hands-on engineering across both frontend and backend. 

This is a hands-on leadership role - you will write production code, lead architecture decisions, and be accountable for the technical quality of everything your pod delivers. You will work in a structured Agile environment, collaborating closely with the Solution Architect, QA leads, and client stakeholders across a multi-year, multi-phase modernisation programme. 

What You Will Do

Technical Leadership

- Own end-to-end technical delivery of your pod - architecture, design, coding, code review, and quality gates
 - Lead the migration from legacy ASP. NET (MVC / Web API / Web Forms) to . NET 10 REST APIs and React 18 frontend
 - Define and enforce coding standards, branching strategy, and PR review process across the pod
 - Produce Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) for all significant technical choices
 - Conduct structured code reviews covering architecture, security, performance, and maintainability - not just syntax
 - Identify and resolve technical debt proactively; maintain a tech debt register visible to stakeholders
 - Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps) with quality gates: SonarQube, unit coverage, OWASP dependency scan
 - Collaborate with Solution Architect on cross-pod API contracts, shared services, and infrastructure decisions

Hands-On Engineering

- Design and build . NET 10 Web API microservices using Clean Architecture and Domain-Driven Design patterns
 - Build React 18 SPAs: component architecture, Redux Toolkit / Zustand state management, routing, and performance optimisation
 - Implement OAuth2 / OIDC / JWT authentication and role-based access control
 - Design and optimise relational database schemas (SQL Server / PostgreSQL); write complex LINQ and EF Core queries
 - Build and consume RESTful APIs with versioning, error handling, and OpenAPI documentation
 - Write unit, integration, and contract tests as a core part of the Definition of Done

Migration & Modernisation

- Lead the technical approach for migrating legacy ASP. NET code to . NET 10 - analysis, characterisation testing, phased migration, parity validation
 - Use GitHub Copilot and AI-assisted tooling to accelerate migration while maintaining review discipline
 - Identify breaking changes, deprecated dependencies, and third-party package migration paths
 - Establish repeatable migration patterns that the whole pod can follow consistently across modules
 - Ensure all migrated code has adequate unit test coverage before merge - parity tests are non-negotiable

Team Leadership & Mentoring

- Lead a pod of 4-6 engineers (mix of senior, mid, and junior developers)
 - Run daily technical standups, remove technical blockers, and escalate risks to the Architect early
 - Mentor mid and junior developers through pair programming, code reviews, and 1: 1 technical guidance
 - Create a learning environment - internal tech talks, documentation, actionable review feedback
 - Make resourcing recommendations and flag capacity risks to the Delivery Manager

Agile Delivery (Added Advantage)

- Participate in Scrum ceremonies - Sprint Planning, Daily Standup, Sprint Review, Retrospective, Backlog Grooming
 - Collaborate with the Product Owner / BA to refine user stories, provide technical input on acceptance criteria, and raise technical stories
 - Provide accurate SP estimates; track sprint progress and flag scope risk early
 - Support the Scrum Master in removing impediments with a technical root cause
 - Champion the Definition of Done - ensure every story that ships meets quality, test, and documentation standards

Delivery Manager - FinTech SaaS & Market Data

IMPORTANT - PLEASE REVIEW THE FOLLOWING BEFORE APPLYING

- We are ideally looking for candidates with 5 -8 years of total professional experience with relevant domain experience of at least 3-4 years. 
 - Candidates with relevant experience in the financial-market domain will be preferred, particularly in Stock Market, Capital Markets, Market Data, Real-Time Financial Data, Trading Platforms, Wealth Management, or Mutual Fund technology/products. 
 - Relevant domain experience is an important requirement for this role, as the position involves working closely with financial-market data, products, and technologies. 
 - Candidates whose experience and domain expertise align with Global Datafeeds' products and business will be given preference. 

Company: Global Financial Datafeeds LLP

Location: Mumbai OR Nashik, India (100% On-site)

Team Size: 15 Engineering & Product Professionals

Industry: Financial Technology / Capital Markets / Software-as-a-Service (SaaS)

About Us

At Global Financial Datafeeds LLP, we are a growing fintech SaaS company and pioneers in developing high-performance, real-time SaaS-based products for the stock market and financial data domain. We build the infrastructure that empowers traders, investors, and institutions with ultra-low latency data feeds and advanced charting solutions. 

As we continue to grow and expand our product ecosystem, we are looking for a tech-savvy Delivery Manager - FinTech SaaS & Market Data to manage our product delivery lifecycle, improve engineering efficiency, and work closely with our 20 Engineering & Product team on-site in Mumbai/Nashik. 

What You'll Do

- Own Delivery: Lead the end-to-end delivery of our SaaS stock market platforms and data-feed solutions from scoping to production. 
 - Optimize Agile Culture: Establish and fine-tune Agile/Scrum/DevOps workflows to support fast-paced financial market requirements. 
 - Drive Scalability: Work with engineering teams to identify and address technical bottlenecks, data streaming latency, performance, and security risks critical to live market applications. 
 - Lead & Collaborate: Coordinate and support a high-performing 20 member team consisting of Developers, QA Testers, and Product Engineers. 
 - Manage Operations: Support delivery planning, resource allocation, project tracking, and critical third-party integrations such as market data feeds and cloud delivery pipelines. 
 - Stakeholder Management: Work closely with product, technology, and business stakeholders to ensure timely and high-quality product delivery. 
 - Track Performance: Monitor project progress, identify delivery risks, and ensure issues are resolved within defined timelines. 

What We're Looking For
