data.title: Staff Engineer – Distributed Data Systems & Infrastructure
data.description:
About HighLevel: 

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes. 

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. 

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2. 5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability. 

Our People

With over 2, 000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home. 

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1. 5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We're proud to be a part of that. 

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts . 

About the Role: 

We are looking for an exceptional Staff Engineer to shape the architecture and evolution of our data infrastructure as we scale. 

Our engineering ecosystem operates multiple database technologies, handles large volumes of data and traffic, and supports a growing number of services and engineering teams. 

We need a strong individual contributor who has built and scaled distributed data systems, understands database technologies at a fundamental level, and can solve complex infrastructure challenges across multiple engineering teams. 

This role goes beyond operating existing databases. You will design systems, build infrastructure capabilities, challenge architectural limitations, and drive technical initiatives that improve scalability, reliability, performance, and infrastructure economics. 

What You'll Do: 

- Architect for scale: Design and evolve distributed data architectures capable of supporting significant growth in traffic, data volume, and engineering complexity. 
 - Build infrastructure platforms: Develop reusable infrastructure components, frameworks, and platform capabilities that enable engineering teams to build scalable systems. 
 - Drive architectural evolution: Identify fundamental limitations in existing systems and lead large-scale initiatives involving data distribution, sharding, replication, migrations, and architectural modernization. 
 - Shape technical strategy: Influence database technology choices, architectural patterns, and long-term infrastructure direction across the company. 
 - Improve infrastructure economics: Lead engineering initiatives that materially improve scalability, resource efficiency, and infrastructure costs. 
 - Engineer for reliability: Design systems that remain available and resilient under high throughput, infrastructure failures, and changing workload patterns. 
 - Create organizational leverage: Establish engineering standards and reusable solutions that eliminate recurring problems across teams. 
 - Lead through technical influence: Work with senior engineers and engineering leadership to turn ambiguous, company-level challenges into executable technical programs. 

What We're Looking For: 

- 9+ years of strong software engineering experience, including significant hands-on experience designing and building distributed systems, backend infrastructure, or large-scale data platforms, with demonstrated Staff-level technical impact. 
 - Strong software engineering background with experience designing and building production infrastructure, not only operating or administering it. 
 - Experience architecting systems handling multi-terabyte datasets and 30K-50K+ operations per second, or comparable large-scale distributed workloads. 
 - Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts, including partitioning, sharding, replication, consistency, concurrency, fault tolerance, and data distribution. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with both relational and NoSQL database architectures, including their design principles, scalability characteristics, and trade-offs. 
 - Experience leading complex architectural initiatives involving multiple systems and engineering teams. Ability to identify systemic technical problems and design solutions that improve infrastructure across the organization. 
 - Strong technical judgment, ownership, and the ability to influence architectural decisions without formal authority. 

Tech Experience: 

We value engineering depth and architectural understanding over familiarity with a long list of technologies. 

Strong experience with relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL, combined with experience in one or more distributed database technologies such as MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or similar systems, is highly relevant. 

Experience with distributed SQL, search infrastructure, analytical databases, or other large-scale storage systems is an advantage. 

We do not expect expertise in any particular combination of database products. What matters is the ability to understand their internals, evaluate trade-offs, and design scalable infrastructure around them. 

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role: 

You have previously taken ownership of challenging infrastructure problems where the solution required more than improving an individual service or database. 

You have designed or significantly evolved distributed architectures, built infrastructure adopted by multiple teams, led complex technical transformations, or enabled systems to operate at substantially greater scale. 

You are equally comfortable discussing database internals, distributed systems trade-offs, and long-term architecture as you are working with engineers to turn those decisions into production systems. 

Your impact is measured by the systems you enable, the architectural problems you eliminate, and the engineering capabilities you leave behind. 

EEO Statement: 

The company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As an employer subject to affirmative action regulations, we invite you to voluntarily provide the following demographic information. This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision. 

We encourage you to review our Privacy Policy before submitting your application

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Description

About the Role

We are looking for an exceptional PMTS / LMTS to lead the engineering vision for AgentExchange's Search and Personalization services - the AI-powered discovery layer that sits at the heart of how customers find and engage with solutions across the Salesforce ecosystem. 

As a Principal Engineer or Lead on the Search & Personalization team, you will be the technical authority for the systems that determine what customers see, find, and click on across AgentExchange. You'll design and deliver the next generation of agentic search - multi-turn, context-aware, and enriched with AI overviews, next-best query suggestions, and personalized recommendations - alongside the indexing infrastructure and contextual discovery services that power embedded surfaces across Agentforce, Slack, Setup, and beyond. 

AgentExchange is building the next generation of our ecosystem marketplace, extending the base and boundaries of our platform while infusing intelligence through every step of our partners' and customers' journey. The new ecosystem enables packaging, publishing, and listing solutions across multiple technologies - Agentforce, MuleSoft, Tableau, and Slack - while delivering full transactability (Discover → Purchase → Provision). The One AppExchange Framework is our dynamic, extensible data and services platform that expands the tenancy capabilities of the AgentExchange site. 

This is not a search-maintenance role. You will own the technical vision for discovery at scale, drive AI-native engineering across the search stack, and set the bar for relevance, latency, personalization, and observability across one of the most strategically important surfaces in the AgentExchange. 

What You'll Do

- Architectural Leadership: Lead architectural design and delivery of major Search & Personalization capabilities, including: GenAI Search: AI overview results, next-best query suggestions, and natural language query understanding. Multi-Turn Agentic Search: Conversational discovery with recommendations, comparisons, and contextual follow-up. Personalization Service: Behavioral and preference-based ranking and recommendations. Contextual Discovery Service: Powering embedded AgentExchange discovery surfaces within Agentforce, Slack, Setup, and other core product surfaces. Search Indexer: Scalable, low-latency indexing pipelines for new asset types including standards-based agents, MCP tools/resources, skills, subagents, and A2A listings. 
 - AI-Native Engineering: Champion AI-native engineering - actively use and promote AI tools across the development lifecycle, from code completion to production monitoring. Model AI fluency and help build an AI-native team culture. 
 - Domain Strategy & Vision: Define the Northstar architecture for the Search & Personalization domain - leading discovery, design, and execution tracks that align with the broader AgentExchange one-marketplace strategy. 
 - Platform Modernization: Drive platform modernization - contribute to the migration off Heroku and onto Falcon, including the enabling roadmap for search services infrastructure migration. 
 - Engineering Excellence: Own engineering excellence across the search stack: observability and telemetry (SLOs/SLIs, latency budgets, relevance metrics), safe change practices, 99. 95% availability targets, and security risk governance. 
 - Technical Authority & Mentorship: Act as the technical authority for your domain - providing guidance, mentorship, and sponsorship to senior and junior engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and bold innovation. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Platform Services, Marketing and Growth, and Embedded Exchanges teams to deliver shared discovery infrastructure, unified catalog indexing, and contextual search surfaces across all AgentExchange touchpoints. 
 - Culture Carrier: Be a culture carrier - embody our values of Trust, Innovation, Engineering Commitment, and Curiosity. Challenge the status quo and build the best-engineered solutions. 

Requirements

- Experience: 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with a demonstrated track record of technical leadership on enterprise-scale search, recommendation, or personalization systems. 
 - Technical Vision: Proven ability to define and drive long-term technical vision and architectural roadmaps for large, complex search or ML-infused platform domains. 
 - Search System Expertise: Deep expertise in building and operating search systems at scale: Search Engine Internals: Indexing pipelines, ranking, query understanding, relevance tuning. Search Infrastructure: Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Solr, or equivalent. Back End: Node. js, Java, or equivalent for high-throughput search services. 
 - Recommendation Systems: Experience designing and delivering recommendation or personalization systems - collaborative filtering, content-based ranking, behavioral signal processing, or equivalent. 
 - GenAI & LLM Integration: Hands-on experience integrating LLMs or GenAI into search products - AI-generated summaries, query expansion, semantic search, or conversational retrieval. 
 - Data Pipelines: Experience with real-time and near-real-time data pipelines for indexing and signal ingestion. 
 - Production Reliability: Strong commitment to engineering excellence: observability, telemetry, latency SLOs, CI/CD, service ownership, safe change practices, and production reliability. 
 - Communication & Influence: Excellent communication skills - able to influence and build consensus across engineering, product, and executive stakeholders. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Conversational Search: Experience building multi-turn or conversational search experiences, including context management and session-aware ranking. 
 - Agentic Systems & MCP: Hands-on experience with agentic systems, MCP tools/resources, or A2A patterns - particularly catalog and metadata requirements for new AI-native asset types. 
 - Embedded Surfaces: Experience with contextual or embedded discovery surfaces - delivering search within host product surfaces (e. g. , in-app, in-builder, in-Slack contexts). 
 - E-Commerce Search: Familiarity with marketplace or e-commerce search - faceted navigation, intent classification, CTR optimization, and funnel instrumentation. 
 - Personalization at Scale: Experience with personalization at scale - user modeling, preference inference, A/B experimentation, and behavioral analytics. 
 - Platform Migrations: Experience with platform infrastructure migrations (e. g. , Heroku → cloud-native platforms) and tech stack modernization. 
 - Security & Governance: Strong security mindset - experience with data governance, access control, and security best practices for search and recommendation systems. 
 - Salesforce Ecosystem: Conversant with Salesforce Platform features and best practices. 
 - Mindset & Language: A strong desire to learn technology and a polyglot attitude; proficient in written and spoken English. 

Our Engineering Values

We hold ourselves to a high standard - because our partners and customers depend on us: 

- Trust by default: Secure, accessible, performant, and scalable in everything we build.

data.title: Senior AI Engineer
data.description:
Position Summary

The Senior AI Engineer is a highly experienced individual contributor responsible for solving complex, high-impact problems through the applied use of AI in production software systems. 

This role goes beyond execution alone. The Senior AI Engineer will define how AI is built and used by setting implementation patterns, quality standards, and technical guardrails that can scale across engineering teams. 

The role involves leading critical initiatives end to end, working effectively in ambiguous problem spaces, and making high-impact technical decisions involving models, agentic systems, architecture, and engineering trade-offs. 

The ideal candidate will build and operate AI-enabled systems that meet enterprise expectations for reliability, performance, cost efficiency, security, and safety. 

This is not a research or theoretical machine learning role. The focus is on applied, production-grade AI, including agentic systems, model-driven workflows, AI automation, and integration of AI capabilities into real-world software products. 

Key Responsibilities

Advanced AI Engineering & System Design

- Design, build, and operate sophisticated AI-enabled software systems that solve complex business and product challenges. 
 - Architect and implement agentic systems capable of autonomous tool selection, multi-step goal execution, and controlled decision-making in production environments. 
 - Define and implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) patterns for managing tools, context, memory, policies, and system boundaries at scale. 
 - Make informed decisions on model selection, composition, and deployment by balancing reasoning quality, latency, cost, and reliability. 
 - Treat model behavior, agent flows, prompts, and contextual inputs as core system components that are designed, versioned, tested, and observable. 
 - Design scalable AI architectures and contribute to system and architecture design decisions for AI-powered applications. 

Technical Leadership & Initiative Ownership

- Serve as a technical lead for high-impact AI initiatives, owning architecture, execution strategy, and delivery outcomes. 
 - Break down ambiguous and open-ended problems into clear technical approaches and guide implementation. 
 - Identify system-level risks, failure modes, and technical trade-offs early and address them through appropriate design and safeguards. 
 - Influence technical direction across teams through technical expertise, judgment, and strong engineering practices. 
 - Take ownership of the long-term technical health and scalability of AI-enabled systems. 

AI-First Development Practices & Standards

- Define and evolve effective AI development practices across engineering teams, including: 
 - AI-assisted and AI-generated code
 - Agent-based engineering workflows
 - AI-driven testing, debugging, and refactoring
 - AI-enabled documentation and observability
 - Establish standards and best practices for: 
 - Agent behavior and autonomy
 - Prompt and context design
 - Model selection and usage
 - AI evaluation and regression detection
 - Safe and explainable AI behavior in production
 - Promote AI as an integrated capability within engineering workflows rather than an experimental or standalone initiative. 

Mentorship & Capability Building

- Mentor AI Engineers through technical guidance, design discussions, pairing, and code reviews. 
 - Improve AI engineering practices, system thinking, and technical rigor across teams. 
 - Share reusable patterns, lessons learned, and failure analyses. 
 - Act as a technical resource for complex AI, GenAI, and agentic system challenges. 

Product & Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to deliver AI-powered features end to end. 
 - Translate product requirements into scalable and maintainable technical architectures. 
 - Balance development speed, quality, security, safety, and maintainability when making technical decisions. 
 - Communicate complex AI and agentic system concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Help product and engineering teams understand AI capabilities, limitations, and trade-offs. 

Quality, Reliability & Accountability

- Ensure AI-enabled systems meet high standards for security, performance, reliability, and compliance. 
 - Design and implement evaluation, monitoring, and safeguard strategies for AI behavior in production. 
 - Address areas such as: 
 - Hallucination and error detection
 - Traceability and explainability
 - Behavioral regression and drift
 - Model performance and reliability
 - Cost and latency optimization
 - Monitor and improve the operational stability, scalability, and cost efficiency of AI systems. 

Continuous Improvement & Learning

- Stay current with AI tools, platforms, models, frameworks, and agentic patterns relevant to production systems. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and responsibly incorporate proven approaches into engineering practices. 
 - Continuously improve how AI systems are designed, developed, evaluated, and operated. 
 - Contribute to a culture of disciplined execution, continuous learning, and technical excellence. 
 - Perform other duties as assigned. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Extensive experience building and operating complex production software systems. 
 - Strong hands-on experience designing and operating Agentic AI systems in production, including autonomous tool usage and multi-step workflows. 
 - Strong technical expertise in Model Context Protocol (MCP) or equivalent approaches. 
 - Strong understanding of modern AI and foundation models, including: 
 - Model names, versions, and parameter scales
 - Context window limitations and optimization strategies
 - System prompts vs. user prompts
 - Model selection and trade-offs
 - Latency, cost, reasoning quality, and reliability considerations
 - Experience working with both frontier and open-source models and making informed decisions between them. 
 - Proven experience scaling AI systems and addressing: 
 - Latency optimization
 - Cost optimization
 - Caching
 - Parallelization
 - Model selection
 - System scalability
 - Proven ability to take complex AI systems from prototype to production and maintain them over time. 
 - Strong system design and architecture skills with the ability to make technical decisions for scalable AI applications. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience defining engineering standards, patterns, or platforms adopted by multiple teams. 
 - Experience designing AI platform architectures or shared agentic frameworks. 
 - Experience with cloud-native, SaaS, or platform-oriented environments. 
 - Experience working with enterprise, regulated, or mission-critical systems. 
 - Experience with modern AI development tools and AI-assisted software engineering workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of observability, evaluation frameworks, and production monitoring for AI systems. 

What We're Looking For

We value engineers who see AI as a force multiplier rather than a novelty. The ideal Senior AI Engineer is a strong builder and technical leader who takes ownership of outcomes, designs systems that scale safely, and uses AI to improve both product capabilities and engineering effectiveness. 

If you are excited about designing and operating production-grade agentic AI systems, solving complex engineering problems, and shaping how AI is built and used across teams, this role is an opportunity to make a significant technical impact.

data.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Senior Process Manager - Operational Risk & Audit Quality

Location - Mumbai / Pune

Function: Operational Risk & Quality Assurance | Reporting: Audit Quality Head

Role Summary

Own the end-to-end delivery and quality of assigned Class 1 audits across BFSI client engagements. Lead risk-based scoping, control testing, evidence review, finding articulation, stakeholder readouts, and remediation tracking while strengthening audit discipline, preventive controls, and team capability. 

Key Responsibilities

- Plan and execute risk-based audits covering process governance, transaction accuracy, SOP/SLA adherence, regulatory and client requirements, and key operational controls. 
 - Lead walkthroughs, risk and control assessments, sample testing, data analysis, and evidence validation; maintain complete, traceable, and defensible working papers. 
 - Review audit files and deliverables for accuracy, completeness, consistency, evidence sufficiency, and appropriate application of audit methodology and risk ratings. 
 - Draft clear findings covering condition, criteria, root cause, risk/impact, recommendation, owner, timeline, and closure evidence; identify repeat or systemic issues. 
 - Conduct insightful readout sessions with Operations, Risk/Compliance, and client stakeholders; manage challenge constructively while preserving audit independence. 
 - Facilitate RCA using 5 Whys, Fishbone, FMEA, Pareto, or control mapping: challenge corrective and preventive actions for sustainability and proportionality. 
 - Track findings to closure, validate implementation evidence and effectiveness, and escalate overdue, high-risk, repeated, or inadequately remediated actions. 
 - Maintain audit dashboards and governance reporting covering plan versus completion, ratings, themes, action aging, repeat findings, and decisions required. 
 - Calibrate review quality, and improve checklists, test scripts, sampling, analytics, and audit automation. 

Qualifications and Experience

- Bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business, Economics, Risk, or a related field; master's preferred. 
 - 8-12 years' BFSI, investment banking operations, or financial-services KPO experience across operations, audit, risk, controls, quality assurance, incidents, or remediation. 
 - Experience leading process or audit reviews, control assessments, RCA, corrective-action tracking, reporting, and senior stakeholder management preferred. 
 - CA, CPA, CIA, CISA, FRM, Lean Six Sigma, or relevant domain certification preferred. 
 - Strong knowledge of TQM, process standardization, defect prevention, quality measurement, and continuous improvement. 

Core Skills and Knowledge

Audit and risk: Risk-based auditing, control design/operating-effectiveness testing, sampling, evidence assessment, finding writing, rating calibration, RCA/CAPA, and closure validation. 

Leadership and communication: Analytical judgment, attention to detail, professional skepticism, ethical conduct, concise writing, confident readouts, stakeholder management, coaching, and execution under tight deadlines. 

Tools and improvement: Advanced Excel; exposure to Power BI/Tableau, SQL/Alteryx, GRC tools, VBA/RPA, continuous monitoring, and governed AI use is advantageous.

data.title: Senior Embedded Product Cybersecurity Engineer
data.description:
Senior Embedded Product Cybersecurity Engineer

About L4B Software

L4B Software specializes in embedded software engineering, platform development and product cybersecurity. We work with Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP, board support packages (BSPs) and real-time embedded systems to develop reliable, secure and maintainable software platforms. 

Our engineering work supports industries including medical devices, consumer electronics and other connected embedded products where security must be integrated throughout the product lifecycle. 

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Product Cybersecurity Engineer with strong hands-on experience securing embedded devices and connected products, particularly in consumer electronics or medical-device environments. 

This is a hands-on engineering position, not a general IT cybersecurity, SOC, network security or compliance-only role. 

You will work directly with embedded software, platform and product-engineering teams to design, implement, test and maintain security mechanisms across device hardware, bootloaders, operating systems, firmware and software-update infrastructure. 

We are particularly interested in engineers who have contributed to security architectures and controls in real products, from development and integration through production release and ongoing maintenance. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Embedded Product Security Architecture

- Design and implement security architectures for Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP and other embedded platforms. 
 - Perform device-level threat modeling, attack-surface analysis and security risk assessments. 
 - Identify threats involving physical device access, debug interfaces, firmware extraction, communication interfaces and software vulnerabilities. 
 - Translate security requirements into practical technical controls and engineering tasks. 
 - Collaborate with hardware, BSP, platform and application engineers to implement security by design. 2. Secure Boot, Device Identity and Cryptography

- Implement and validate Secure Boot, Verified Boot and chain-of-trust mechanisms. 
 - Work with hardware-backed security technologies such as TPM, HSM, secure elements, ARM TrustZone and OP-TEE, as applicable. 
 - Design secure device identity, key provisioning, key storage and key lifecycle mechanisms. 
 - Implement cryptographic signing, integrity verification and secure firmware authentication. 
 - Support secure manufacturing provisioning and device lifecycle security. 3. Embedded Linux and Android Platform Hardening

- Implement security controls within Embedded Linux and, where applicable, Android/AOSP platforms. 
 - Harden bootloaders, Linux kernels, operating-system configurations and device services. 
 - Work with Linux security mechanisms such as SELinux, AppArmor, dm-verity, dm-crypt and filesystem protection. 
 - Reduce attack surfaces by securing services, ports, permissions, interfaces and debug capabilities. 
 - Collaborate with Yocto/BSP engineers to integrate security controls into production firmware images. 4. Secure Firmware Updates and Product Lifecycle Security

- Design and implement secure firmware and OTA update mechanisms. 
 - Ensure firmware authenticity, integrity, rollback protection and secure recovery. 
 - Support secure update architectures for connected and field-deployed products. 
 - Investigate product vulnerabilities and contribute to remediation across supported software versions. 
 - Help establish security maintenance practices for products throughout their operational lifecycle. 5. Vulnerability Management and Security Verification

- Perform vulnerability analysis across embedded firmware, operating systems, libraries and third-party components. 
 - Work with CVE databases, software composition analysis and SBOM generation. 
 - Assess vulnerability exploitability and product-specific security impact. 
 - Support static analysis, dynamic analysis, firmware analysis and penetration-testing activities. 
 - Develop or integrate security verification into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Document security findings, remediation actions and verification evidence. 6. Product Security and Engineering Collaboration

- Work closely with Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP, BSP, hardware, DevSecOps, QA and product-engineering teams. 
 - Participate in security design reviews and technical risk assessments. 
 - Support security requirements, verification and traceability for regulated or security-sensitive products. 
 - Contribute to product-security documentation and technical security decisions. 
 - Independently investigate and resolve complex embedded security issues. Required Qualifications and Experience

- Strong professional experience in embedded software engineering, with substantial hands-on responsibility for embedded product cybersecurity. 
 - Professional experience securing consumer electronics, medical devices or comparable connected embedded products. 
 - Strong understanding of embedded hardware, firmware, bootloaders, operating systems and device security boundaries. 
 - Hands-on experience implementing security controls in Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP or comparable embedded platforms. 
 - Demonstrated practical experience in several of the following: 
 - Secure Boot, Verified Boot or hardware root of trust. 
 - Secure key storage, provisioning and cryptographic integration. 
 - Embedded Linux security hardening. 
 - Secure firmware updates and rollback protection. 
 - Device-level threat modeling and attack-surface reduction. 
 - Embedded vulnerability analysis and remediation. 
 - Strong Linux debugging and embedded systems troubleshooting skills. 
 - Proficiency in C/C++ and scripting with Python or Bash. 
 - Ability to independently own technical security tasks from design through implementation and verification. 
 - Experience working with cross-functional product-development teams. Preferred Qualifications

- Direct experience with consumer electronics, connected devices, smart home products, multimedia devices, wearables or other commercially deployed embedded products. 
 - Experience developing or securing medical-device software, connected medical equipment or regulated healthcare products. 
 - Practical experience with ARM TrustZone, OP-TEE, TPM, secure elements or hardware security modules. 
 - Experience with Yocto/OpenEmbedded, U-Boot, Linux kernel configuration and BSP security integration. 
 - Android Verified Boot (AVB), Android security architecture or SELinux policy development. 
 - Secure OTA frameworks and firmware-signing infrastructure. 
 - Experience with SBOM tooling, CVE assessment and software composition analysis. 
 - Familiarity with applicable product-security standards and guidance, such as IEC 62443, ETSI EN 303 645, IEC 81001-5-1, IEC 62304, ISO 14971 or relevant EU Cyber Resilience Act requirements. 
 - Experience supporting security verification, technical documentation and product-security audits. 
 - Experience working on products requiring long-term security maintenance and vulnerability response. What We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in engineers who can demonstrate: 

- Security mechanisms they have personally designed, implemented, integrated or validated. 
 - Experience working with actual embedded products rather than security concepts alone. 
 - Understanding of how hardware, firmware, operating systems and connectivity affect device security. 
 - Ability to investigate vulnerabilities and implement practical remediation. 
 - Ownership of technical decisions and security deliverables. 
 - Clear communication with embedded engineering and product teams. Important: This position requires practical embedded product-security engineering experience. General IT security, SOC operations, infrastructure security, penetration testing without embedded-product engineering, or compliance-only experience will not independently meet the role requirements. 

Why Join L4B Software?

- Work on embedded platform and product-security engineering challenges. 
 - Contribute to secure software platforms used in complex connected products. 
 - Collaborate with international engineering teams. 
 - Take ownership of meaningful security design and implementation responsibilities. 
 - Work in an environment where technical depth, independent problem-solving and engineering quality matter. Application

Please share your resume highlighting the embedded products and platforms you have worked on, the security mechanisms you personally implemented, and your experience with production or commercially deployed devices. 

L4B Software is committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. Candidates will be assessed on demonstrated technical capabilities and alignment with the requirements of the role.

Duties and Responsibilities: 

- Plan, implement, and monitor Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) activities throughout project execution to ensure compliance with client contractual requirements, approved quality documentation, applicable codes, standards, and the Company's Integrated Management System (IMS).

 - Execute Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) activities throughout project execution in accordance with approved quality documents, project requirements, and company procedures, utilizing established quality management systems such as the Event Note System, Inspection Database, and Job Hub to ensure effective quality monitoring, traceability, and compliance.

data.title: System Integration Test Engineer (4-10 Years of experience in Automotive system integration and testing ECU)
data.description:
We are seeking a System Integration engineer to contribute to the system integration and testing activities for the next generation vehicle controller and software platform. This new architecture will integrate new and advanced software functions for cloud connectivity and edge processing, thus enabling highly automated driving and advanced connectivity features. The individual should be an experienced engineer in system integration and testing, with strong skills in system-level issue root-causing and having a strong technical background in systems engineering and vehicle architecture development. 

The primary focus will be to integrate the system of ECUs on a system bench and ensure that the software running on all ECUs function without issues or vulnerabilities. The process starts with flashing the software of the involved ECUs, and then running a suite of tests that verifies the communication (Ethernet, CAN, and LIN) among multiple ECUs, assess the stability of the software under stress, and run tests that involve verifying diagnostics functions and cybersecurity features. The responsibilities may include setting up and maintenance of system benches to ensure a workable test environment that is also remotely accessible. These activities involve a cycle of testing, analyzing results, and implementing remediation to improve overall security posture. 

The job also entails reviewing relevant requirements, developing test cases using Python and CAPL scripting (among others), automating the execution of the test cases on CI pipelines, and analyzing the results. The HRS AI Workflow team serves as a pivotal force in transforming customer support by harnessing the power of advanced AI technologies. Our primary goal is to enhance customer satisfaction by providing swift, intelligent solutions to inquiries, ensuring a seamless experience across all channels. Through continuous improvement and real-time insights, the AI Workflow team plays a crucial role in elevating service quality, allowing our support agents to concentrate on complex tasks that drive operational excellence and foster innovation. 

POSITION

We are seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to architect, implement, and maintain our AWS-centered cloud infrastructure. This role is vital in ensuring the scalability, reliability, security, and performance of our AI-driven customer support platform. The Cloud Infrastructure Engineer must have strong hands-on experience with AWS and will be responsible for designing and managing AWS cloud resources, implementing infrastructure as code, and establishing robust CI/CD pipelines. This position requires deep expertise in AWS cloud technologies and DevOps practices to support our mission of delivering exceptional customer service through technological innovation. 

PERSPECTIVE

HRS is, at its heart, a platform company. To provide the market-leading Lodging-as-a-Service platform, we hire people with a broad set of technical skills (and from a wide variety of backgrounds) who are ready to take on some of the most challenging problems in the industry - from reliably handling 100M API requests per day, to building adaptive machine learning as a result of years of data science and infrastructure work, and enabling corporates worldwide to create a unique lodging experience for their employees. 

We look at HRS as a constant work in progress and the same is true of our people; for all of us, we believe the best is yet to come. We're here to support each other in our curiosity and creativity - which we pursue through thoughtful discussion and knowledge-sharing among a diverse set of peers and colleagues.

data.description:
Job Description

Company: CGH Earth Experience Hotels

Location: Dasada, Gujarat

Designation: Chief Engineer

Department: Engineering & Maintenance

Role Overview

CGH Earth is looking for an experienced, dynamic, and hands-on Chief Engineer to direct all engineering, maintenance, and asset management at our luxury resort in Dasada, Gujarat. 

The resort combines heritage accommodation, nature, wildlife, wellness, and curated guest experiences. The Chief Engineer is fully responsible for all MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) and civil infrastructure, ensuring operational efficiency while upholding CGH Earth's standards for sustainability, resource conservation, and responsible hospitality. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Overall Operations & Preventive Maintenance (PPM)

- Direct day-to-day engineering operations, predictive maintenance, and utility networks (power, water, refrigeration, automation) to prevent service disruptions. 
 - Inspect plant rooms, BOH areas, and public spaces daily to maintain safety, presentation, and SOP compliance. 
 - Design and execute PPM programs across all 25 guest cottages, public zones, and offices. 
 - Enforce a strict 15-minute turnaround target for guest-room maintenance requests. 
 - Maintain guest room HVAC units, plumbing, water pressure, hot water delivery, and room amenities to luxury hospitality standards. 

2. Pre-Opening Staging & Asset Commissioning

- Lead structural snagging, testing, calibration, and formal commissioning for all MEP installations in new structures. 
 - Establish contractor handover protocols, securing all operation manuals, blueprints, and wiring diagrams. 
 - Set up the initial maintenance database, tag all equipment assets, and build the critical spare parts inventory. 

3. Sustainability, Zero-Waste & Energy Management

- Supervise the daily operation, chemical dosing, and testing of the biological Sewage Treatment Plant (STP). 
 - Manage the on-site glass water bottling line, solar PV grids, solar hot-water arrays, and rainwater harvesting systems. 
 - Track daily energy, fuel, and water consumption; execute load-shedding and timer controls to optimize utility draw. 
 - Maintain power-factor correction units and LED/high-efficiency lighting systems. 
 - Compile monthly utility, carbon footprint, and ESG metrics for corporate reporting. 

4. Financial Management & CAPEX/OPEX

- Prepare and control the annual engineering operating budget (OPEX) in coordination with Finance. 
 - Formulate annual Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) plans with ROI justifications for machinery upgrades. 
 - Track monthly spending on DG fuel, electricity, STP/pool chemicals, and technical spares under strict approval trails. 

5. Heritage Preservation & Specialist Systems Support

- F&B Engineering: Maintain commercial kitchen equipment (Flamingo restaurant & premium wing), walk-in freezers, dishwashers, and food waste macerators. Set up temporary MEP networks for outdoor bush/desert dining events. 
 - Heritage Architecture: Preserve local Kooba and Bhunga mud/thatch architecture, blending modern waterproofing with ethnic building mediums to prevent structural and pest damage. 
 - Pools & Water Systems: Manage 'Desjoyaux' single-skin shell swimming pools, water chemistry, deep-well pump stations, booster pumps, and water softeners. 
 - IT & Automation: Support site-wide fiber optic networks, Wi-Fi, telecom lines, server room climate controls, and UPS battery systems. 

6. Compliance, Safety & Risk Management

- Serve as primary Safety Officer; oversee fire hydrants, smoke detectors, alarm systems, and emergency generator grids. 
 - Conduct regular engineering safety drills, blackout simulations, and technical risk assessments. 
 - Secure and maintain statutory permits, boiler licenses, elevator certifications, and Gujarat Pollution Control Board (GPCB) clearances. 

7. Leadership, Training & Administration

- Lead, roster, and mentor the engineering team to provide seamless 24/7 technical coverage. 
 - Deliver technical training on HVAC, plumbing, high-voltage safety codes, SOPs, and CGH Earth sustainability standards. 
 - Negotiate and manage Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) for DG sets, STPs, and central pumps; supervise third-party contractors on site. 
 - Maintain auditable equipment logs, work orders, fuel drops, and task completions in the resort ERP system. 

Candidate Profile

- Education: Bachelor's Degree or   Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, or Hotel Engineering. Certifications in High-Voltage Systems, Industrial Safety, or Project Management preferred. 
 - Experience: 10 years in luxury hospitality maintenance, with 3-4 years as Chief Engineer, Assistant Chief Engineer, or Engineering Manager. Hands-on pre-opening and remote resort experience highly valued. 
 - Technical Skills: Troubleshooting HVAC, single/3-phase power, DG sets, biological STPs, water filtration, and pool systems. 
 - Financial & Digital Capability: Proven experience managing OPEX, CAPEX, P&L lines, maintenance management software, and ERP systems. 
 - Languages: Fluency in English and Hindi is required; proficiency in Gujarati is highly preferred. 

Role Expectation

The Chief Engineer is the ultimate custodian of the property's physical infrastructure, capital assets, safety compliance, and ecological standards-balancing long-term asset planning with active daily operational leadership.

Assistant Manager will oversee a team of medical coders, ensuring accurate and timely coding of medical diagnoses, procedures, and services for healthcare facilities. The role involves managing day-to-day operations, ensuring compliance with industry standards (e. g. , ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS coding), and acting as the primary point of contact between the coding team and other departments. - Supervise a team of medical coders, ensuring workload distribution and deadlines are met. 
 - Conduct regular performance evaluations and provide feedback to team members. 
 - Serve as the primary point of escalation for coding-related issues or complex cases. 
 - Foster a collaborative and productive team environment by providing guidance, support, and training opportunities. 2. Quality Assurance: 

- Ensure coding accuracy and compliance with industry standards such as ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS codes. 
 - Perform random audits of coded claims to ensure accuracy and adherence to organizational and regulatory guidelines.

- Organize and conduct regular training sessions on updates to coding standards, regulations, and software tools. 
 - Mentor junior coders and help develop their skills to improve performance.

- Manage day-to-day operations of the coding team, ensuring tasks are completed on time and meet quality standards. 
 - Track and report team performance metrics, including coding accuracy, productivity, and turnaround times. 
 - Collaborate with other departments such as billing, compliance, and healthcare providers to resolve coding and reimbursement issues. 5. Compliance and Documentation: 

- Ensure that coding practices are in compliance with HIPAA regulations, organizational policies, and state/federal guidelines. 
 - Maintain accurate documentation of all coding processes and updates for auditing purposes. 
 - Assist in preparing the department for internal and external audits. 6. Process Improvement: 

- Identify areas of inefficiency in the coding process and recommend improvements. 
 - Implement new processes, tools, or systems to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of medical coding operations. 7. Client/Stakeholder Relations: 

- Act as a liaison between the coding team and other internal and external stakeholders, including physicians, administrative staff, and external auditors. 
 - Address and resolve any queries related to coding from insurance companies, providers, or billing departments. 

Qualifications

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree in Health Information Management, Medical Coding, or a related field preferred. 
 - Certified Professional Coder (CPC), Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), or similar certification required. Experience: 

- 6+ years of experience in medical coding, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or leadership role. 
 - Extensive knowledge of ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS coding systems with E&M coding. 
 - Experience with healthcare billing processes and Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems. Skills: 

- Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.

We are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects. 

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software.

We are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them. 

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently. 

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important.

- Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup. 
 - Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time. 
 - Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness. 
 - Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation. 
 - Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments. 
 - Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation. 
 - Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring. 

Growth, Responsibility And Compensation

Joining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team. 

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years. 

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment. 

What We Offer

- A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective. 
 - Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives. 
 - The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team. 
 - Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery. 
 - Close collaboration with startup leadership. 
 - The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops. 

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process. 

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup. 

How To Apply

We are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning. 

Please submit your CV and a short overview covering: 

- A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions. 
 - An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results. 
 - Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities. 
 - A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes. 
 - Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables. 
 - Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account. 

Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials.

data.description:
About Audax

audax means courage. To have the courage to change the banking scene, eliminating constraints caused by existing legacy infrastructure. Our mission is to empower banks and financial institutions to scale and modernise at speed, reaching new customers without breaking the bank. 

We began our journey supplying services to and powering Standard Chartered's white-label plug and play Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) solution, Standard Chartered nexus, through our technology capabilities. At audax, we seek go-getters who are hungry for growth and can bring fresh perspectives. 

Website - https: //audax. io/

Summary

Audax is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to lead the design and delivery of a defined engineering domain within our banking-as-a-service platform. This is a hands-on technical leadership role responsible for driving solution design across adjacent domains, ensuring engineering readiness for committed initiatives, and mentoring engineers to raise technical standards. The role combines deep backend and distributed-systems expertise with practical application of AI-assisted development tooling to improve engineering quality and speed. 

What You'll Do

- Lead design and build readiness for a defined engineering area so committed initiatives start with clear designs, dependencies, milestones, and operational considerations. 
 - Drive solution design across two or more adjacent domains, ensuring designs are actionable and adopted with minimal rework. 
 - Provide technical leadership on major trade-offs, architectural exceptions, and cross-team dependency decisions within owned domains. 
 - Improve delivery predictability and engineering quality by managing risks early and reducing quality-gate failures. 
 - Strengthen integration testing, E2E readiness, observability, and reliability ownership for multi-component changes. 
 - Mentor engineers and align with Product, QA, DevOps, and Security on technical trade-offs and release readiness. 
 - Apply AI-assisted development tools (code generation, copilots, developer tooling) to improve engineering efficiency and code quality within the owned domain. 
 - Identify and shape performance and scalability risks early for critical flows or services to avoid late-stage surprises. 
 - Contribute to platform and shared engineering practices (CI/CD, observability, developer tooling) adopted across multiple teams. 
 - Evaluate emerging technologies relevant to the owned domain and recommend adoption where they materially improve delivery or reliability. 

Who You Are

- 8-12 years of software engineering experience, including demonstrated technical leadership at a Staff/Lead Engineer level. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Java/Spring Boot, REST APIs, and distributed systems. 
 - Practical experience with cloud-native architecture (AWS), Kubernetes (EKS), Helm, and container orchestration. 
 - Experience with event-driven design, message brokers (e. g. , SolacePubSub+), and API design patterns. 
 - Working knowledge of observability tooling (OpenSearch, Prometheus, Grafana) and distributed tracing. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipeline design, Git workflows, and test automation. 
 - Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools (code generation, copilots) in a production engineering context. 
 - Ability to mentor engineers and influence technical decisions across two or more adjacent teams or domains. 
 - Experience in fintech or digital banking environments preferred. 
 - Comfortable working hands-on in an IDE, reviewing PRs, and debugging production issues. 

Why Join Us?

- Be Part of a Bold Vision - At audax, we're not just building software - we're transforming how financial institutions and businesses manage risk, compliance, and growth. Join a team that's fearless in challenging the status quo. 
 - Flexible, People-First Workplace - We value the importance of Family, Team, Self. In that order. 
 - Competitive Rewards and Startup Perks - We offer competitive salaries and meaningful benefits that look after your well-being. 

Privacy Notice: 

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and understood audax's Privacy Policy for Employees, Freelancers, Contractors and Job Applicants (the "Policy"), and consent to the collection, use and disclosure of your personal data by audax for the purposes set out in the Policy. 

You may withdraw consent for such collection, use and disclosure, and make an access or correction request in respect of your personal data, in accordance with the Policy by emailing dpo@audax. io. 

Disclaimer: At Audax, we use AI to support our recruitment process, including reviewing applications and identifying candidates whose skills and experience best match our opportunities. AI assists our recruiters-it does not make hiring decisions. All applications are reviewed by our recruitment team, and hiring decisions are made by people. Please ensure the information you submit is accurate and reflects your own qualifications and experience.

Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. data.title: Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer - DevOps & Technical Leadership
data.description:
Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position

Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement

Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years

About Us

We are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects. 

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software. 

AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve. 

We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company. 

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them. 

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently. 

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important. 

This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend. 
 - Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations. 
 - Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review. 
 - Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria. 
 - Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations. 
 - Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures. 
 - Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting. 
 - Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks. 
 - Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies. 
 - Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners. 
 - Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification. 
 - Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes. 
 - Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies. 
 - Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback. 
 - Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead. 

Required Qualifications

- Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications. 
 - Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. 
 - Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling. 
 - Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs. 
 - Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified. 
 - Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery. 
 - Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience. 
 - A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies. 
 - Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents. 
 - Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills. 
 - Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery. 
 - Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly. 
 - Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams. 
 - The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget. 
 - Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility. 

Especially Valuable Experience

- Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup. 
 - Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time. 
 - Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness. 
 - Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation. 
 - Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments. 
 - Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation. 
 - Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring. 

Growth, Responsibility And Compensation

Joining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team. 

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years. 

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment. 

What We Offer

- A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective. 
 - Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives. 
 - The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team. 
 - Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery. 
 - Close collaboration with startup leadership. 
 - The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops. 

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process. 

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup. 

How To Apply

We are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning. 

Please submit your CV and a short overview covering: 

- A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions. 
 - An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results. 
 - Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities. 
 - A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes. 
 - Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables. 
 - Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account. 

Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials.

data.title: Lead Full Stack Engineer
data.description:
About The Company

Founders today are building global companies from day one - but the systems that manage their money were built for a different era. Aspire exists to change that!

We're building the financial operating system for global founders, bringing banking, software, and automation into a single platform so businesses can move faster across borders and stay focused on building. 

Aspire is built by people who think from first principles, care deeply about solving hard problems, and take real ownership of their work. Our team brings global experience from leading fintech and technology companies, and many of us are former founders and operators who understand what it takes to build thoughtfully, make trade-offs, and deliver at scale in a global environment. 

Backed by leading global investors including Y Combinator, Peak XV, and Lightspeed, Aspire has been trusted by more than 50, 000 startups and growing businesses worldwide to manage their finances since 2018. Together with partners like J. P. Morgan, Visa, and Wise, we're building for the next generation of global companies. 

About The Role

What you'll do: 

Customer first, always

- Find and remove friction across key customer journeys on web and mobile, from onboarding to day-to-day usage
 - Use support tickets, contact drivers, app reviews and product analytics to decide what to fix next
 - Build self-service capabilities that let customers resolve issues without contacting support
 - Own and evolve the customer support AI bot: improve answer quality and resolution rate, connect it to product data and actions, and hand off smoothly to human agents when needed
 - Treat bugs and incidents through the customer's eyes: fix the root cause, not only the symptom

Build

- Write production code across frontend and backend, spending around 80% of your time hands-on
 - Own technical design for the squad's work and set a high bar for quality, performance and reliability
 - Instrument every change so we can measure its impact on customer behaviour and contact rate
 - Run experiments and A/B tests to validate improvements before scaling them

Lead

- Lead, coach and grow a squad of 2 engineers, and help hire as the team grows
 - Work with the Product Manager and Designer to shape the roadmap and turn problems into shippable increments
 - Partner with engineering teams across Aspire to land changes in code your squad does not own
 - Work closely with Customer Support and Operations to understand pain points and close the feedback loop

What We're Looking For

- 7+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years leading engineers as a tech lead
 - Strong, recent hands-on experience on both frontend (e. g. React, TypeScript) and backend (APIs, services, databases)
 - A genuine obsession with customer experience: you notice friction, care about the details and use the product yourself
 - A track record of shipping improvements that moved a customer metric, and you can explain how you measured it
 - Experience working across team boundaries in a multi-team engineering organisation, influencing without authority
 - Good product sense: you can push back, propose simpler solutions and trade off scope against impact
 - Comfortable with data: you can read dashboards, define events and query data to answer your own questions
 - Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Nice To Have

- Experience in fintech, banking or another regulated industry where security and compliance shape the product
 - Mobile development experience (e. g. React Native)
 - Built self-service or support tooling: help centres, in-app guidance, chatbots or AI-assisted support
 - Hands-on with product analytics and observability tools (e. g. Mixpanel, PostHog, Sentry, Datadog)
 - Experience with accessibility, web performance and front-end design systems
 - Worked in a B2B or SME-focused product across multiple markets

How We'll Measure Success

In your first 90 days

- You know the top customer contact drivers and the journeys behind them
 - You have shipped at least one measurable friction fix end to end
 - You have working relationships with the engineering teams that own our most critical flows

Over time

- Contact rate goes down and self-service and AI bot resolution rates go up
 - Customer satisfaction (CSAT/NPS) and app store ratings improve
 - Retention improves in the journeys the squad has worked on
 - The squad ships predictably, with high quality and few regressions

By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Aspire. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Aspire may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Aspire's Candidate Privacy Notice.

data.title: Quality Assurance Lead
data.description:
As a QA Lead, you will be responsible for driving the organization's quality assurance and process excellence initiatives by ensuring compliance with CMMI, ISO 9001, ISO 27001, and ISO 20000-1 standards. You will lead quality governance activities, define and monitor quality metrics, conduct audits and gap assessments, identify process improvement opportunities, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance operational efficiency and compliance. The role requires strong leadership, analytical, and stakeholder management skills to foster a culture of continuous improvement, quality excellence, and adherence to organizational standards across all projects and departments. 

5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, Process Excellence, Quality Management Systems, or Compliance roles. 

Responsibilities: 

Quality Management & Process Excellence: 

·              Define, monitor, and analyze quality metrics and KPIs across projects and organizational functions. 

·              Conduct gap analysis to identify deviations between existing processes and quality standards such as CMMI, ISO 9001, ISO 27001, and ISO 20000-1. 

·              Lead initiatives to improve processes, enhance operational efficiency, and strengthen quality compliance. 

·              Develop, implement, and maintain quality frameworks, procedures, standards, and best practices. 

·              Ensure consistent adherence to organizational quality policies and regulatory requirements. 

Audit & Compliance Management

·              Plan, coordinate, and participate in internal and external audits. 

·              Lead audit preparation activities, including evidence collection, documentation reviews, and compliance assessments. 

·              Monitor audit findings, drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and ensure timely closure. 

·              Maintain audit trackers, compliance records, quality logs, checklists, and reporting documentation. 

·              Ensure organizational compliance with ISO standards, CMMI requirements, and other applicable quality frameworks. 

Quality Reporting & Documentation

·              Develop and present quality dashboards, management reports, and review summaries. 

·              Analyze quality trends, identify risks, and provide recommendations for improvement. 

·              Review project documents, deliverables, process records, and metrics for completeness, accuracy, and compliance. 

·              Standardize and improve documentation processes across departments. 

Risk Management

·              Conduct quality risk assessments to identify process, project, and compliance risks. 

·              Collaborate with project teams and stakeholders to implement risk mitigation plans. 

·              Track quality-related issues and drive resolution through structured corrective actions. 

Project Quality Governance

·              Participate in project review meetings and governance forums to ensure quality compliance. 

·              Assess project adherence to defined processes, standards, and quality objectives. 

·              Provide quality guidance and recommendations to project teams and department heads. 

·              Support delivery teams in implementing process improvements and quality controls. 

Training & Stakeholder Management

·              Conduct quality awareness programs, process training sessions, and compliance workshops. 

·              Guide project teams on quality standards, audit requirements, and process implementation. 

·              Communicate quality policies, process updates, and improvement initiatives across the organization. 

·              Act as a point of contact for quality-related queries and compliance guidance. 

Continuous Improvement

·              Drive continuous improvement initiatives through data analysis, audits, lessons learned, and feedback mechanisms. 

·              Recommend and implement process optimization strategies to improve quality performance. 

·              Promote a culture of quality, accountability, and operational excellence within the organization. 

Skills Required: 

·              Strong expertise in CMMI framework implementation and process compliance. 

·              Hands-on experience with ISO 9001, ISO 27001, and ISO 20000-1 standards. 

·              Proficiency in Quality Management Systems (QMS) and quality governance practices. 

·              Experience in defining, tracking, and reporting quality metrics and KPIs. 

·              Strong capability in conducting gap analysis and compliance assessments. 

·              Expertise in process improvement, process optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

·              Experience in planning, conducting, and managing internal and external audits. 

·              Knowledge of risk assessment, risk mitigation, and quality risk management. 

·              Proficiency in Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), and issue resolution. 

·              Experience in quality reporting, documentation management, and compliance tracking. 

·              Ability to review project deliverables, process documentation, and quality records for compliance and accuracy. 

·              Advanced proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint for reporting, analysis, and presentations. 

Qualification: 

·              Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Quality Management, or a related discipline. 

·              5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, Process Excellence, Quality Management Systems, or Compliance roles. 

·              Hands-on experience with ISO 9001, ISO 27001, ISO 20000-1, and CMMI frameworks.
