data.title: Principal Engineer - Design Verification
data.description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world-leading MCUs, SoCs, analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world's leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you. 

Renesas employs roughly 21, 000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

We are seeking a diligent SoC/MCU Verification engineer to join our team at Renesas. The Verification engineer will be responsible for performing various verification tasks including Test Plan creation, Testcase creation, Coverage closure, Requirements traceability and Gate Level Simulation. They will also review system requirements and track quality assurance metrics. Ultimately, the role of the Verification Engineer is to ensure that our products, applications, and systems work correctly, safely & securely. 

Job Responsibilities: 

- Drive Verification R&D team driving technical execution and best in class methodologies used in the design of advanced microcontrollers and microprocessors. 
 - Work closely with system architects to understand high level specifications to be able to verify them. 
 - Work with various EDA vendors to deploy next generation tools 
 - Build strong collaboration with other R&D teams such as RTL, DFT, digital IP, PD, Design Enablement, Emulation, and Validation to achieve project milestones 
 - Promote continuous improvement to design techniques to ensure 'Zero Defect' chips 
 - Collaborate with SME's and key leaders in architecture, systems, emulation, SoC design, software, physical design, and IP teams developing key technical networks to influence overall design improvements and verification methodologies 
 - Responsible for developing detailed Technical SoC verification execution plans, progress reports and tracking milestones, managing technical risks, and providing mitigations to meet schedule quality and costs commitments. Communicate across technical teas as well as provide executive level presentations 
 - Complete ownership for SoC verification quality sign-offs ensuring all deliverables for team hand-offs. 
 - Drive best in class verification methodologies collaborating with global internal and external SME's and developing adoption and compliance processes. Including, driving key innovation strategies which significantly impact efficiency and quality for overall R&D and ROI

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in electronics engineering. 
 - 14+ years of experience in SoC Verification domains and have working knowledge of industry standard EDA toolkits. 
 - Experience in Microcontroller and Microprocessor architecture & Interconnect
 - Experience in protocols like AHB/AXI, Memory (ROM, RAM, Flash, MRAM) and memory controllers. 
 - Advanced knowledge of Verilog, System Verilog, C/C++, Shell. 
 - Good knowledge in scripting like Perl, TCL or Python is a plus 
 - Proven experience in testbench design and development using UVM methodology for IP/Subsystem and SOC. 
 - High proficiency in Metric Driven Verification concepts, functional and code coverage. 
 - Expertise in directed and constrained random methodologies. 
 - Good knowledge of formal verification methodologies and assertions. 
 - Experience with debugging of designs pre- and post-silicon, in simulation and on the bench. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skill. 
 - Must have worked on complex, multi-core SoC's with extensive interconnects and a large range of peripherals. 
 - Fair domain knowledge of clocking, system modes, power management, debug, security and other architectures is a must. Preferred/Plus Qualifications

- Exposure to formal verification and hybrid formal‐simulation flows
 - Experience with low‐power verification
 - Familiarity with Medium‐speed or communication IPs, such as: 
 - CANXL, CANFD, LINFLEX, UART, FLEXRAY
 - Interconnect fabrics
 - Security, debug, or safety‐critical IPs
 - Experience delivering reusable, production‐quality VIPs used across multiple SoCs

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21, 000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‐leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future. 

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. 

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. 

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity & Inclusion Statement.

data.title: Senior Microsoft AI Engineer - Copilot, Foundry & Power Automate
data.description:
Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position

Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement

Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with substantial growth potential during the first few years

About Us

We are a startup developing AI-powered solutions, business applications, integrations, and automations across different products and internal initiatives. 

Microsoft technologies are an important part of our work. We want to turn business requirements into useful AI assistants, reliable workflows, and connected systems that deliver measurable results. 

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We are looking for someone who enjoys hands-on implementation, can coordinate external specialists, and wants to help build and lead a growing team. 

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Microsoft AI Engineer with strong practical experience in Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate. 

You will take responsibility for projects from requirements discovery and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement. Your work will span different business processes and products. 

Alongside technical delivery, your responsibilities may include project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced contributors. You should be comfortable discussing business priorities, organizing delivery, reviewing technical work, and helping colleagues improve. 

Ownership of Our Microsoft Environment

You will independently manage and develop our company's Microsoft environment across Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform. This includes taking ownership of configuration, access management, operational reliability, governance, documentation, and cost control. 

We need someone who can identify issues, propose practical improvements, coordinate implementation, and verify that our systems continue to work reliably. You should be comfortable combining hands-on technical work with project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced specialists. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build and maintain AI assistants and agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry. 
 - Identify practical opportunities for Microsoft 365 Copilot and help teams use it effectively. 
 - Connect AI solutions to relevant business knowledge and systems while respecting permissions and data boundaries. 
 - Develop Power Automate workflows with reliable validation, exception handling, monitoring, and recovery. 
 - Integrate Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, external APIs, and other business systems. 
 - Implement custom connectors or supporting code where the project requires them. 
 - Evaluate AI output quality, grounding, failure behavior, latency, and operating costs. 
 - Establish appropriate human review and approval steps for consequential automated actions. 
 - Independently administer our Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform environments, including users, groups, roles, application registrations, permissions, and service connections. 
 - Configure and manage GitHub-connected Power Platform solutions, including repositories, authentication, source control, branching, reviews, and deployment workflows. 
 - Manage the solution lifecycle across development, testing, and production, including solution dependencies, environment variables, connection references, release verification, and recovery procedures. 
 - Maintain secure application identities, credentials, and access configurations with clear ownership and appropriate permissions. 
 - Monitor platform health, investigate failures, maintain operational documentation, and control licensing and cloud expenditure. 
 - Translate business requirements into clear tasks, delivery milestones, and verifiable acceptance criteria. 
 - Manage project scope, priorities, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communication. 
 - Coordinate outsourced developers, review their deliverables, and maintain clear ownership. 
 - Mentor colleagues through practical demonstrations, reviews, and knowledge transfer. 
 - Keep solutions maintainable and proportionate to the problem and startup budget. 

Required Qualifications

- Demonstrated experience delivering production solutions using Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate. 
 - Practical understanding of Microsoft 365 Copilot and its use in business workflows. 
 - Experience building AI agents or assistants connected to business data, tools, and APIs. 
 - Experience evaluating AI-generated answers and actions, including handling unreliable or unsupported output. 
 - Strong knowledge of Power Automate cloud flows, connectors, expressions, approvals, and troubleshooting. 
 - Experience integrating SharePoint, Teams, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, or comparable business platforms. 
 - Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, application permissions, authentication, and secure credential handling. 
 - Ability to write and review supporting code or scripts, for example in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or PowerShell. 
 - Proven experience independently administering a company's Microsoft environment, with responsibility for reliable operation and ongoing improvement. 
 - Hands-on experience configuring and managing Power Platform solutions connected to GitHub. 
 - Practical experience with GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD workflows for Microsoft solutions. 
 - Strong understanding of environment separation, managed and unmanaged solutions, dependencies, connection references, and environment-specific configuration. 
 - Previous responsibility for technical project delivery, including planning and stakeholder communication. 
 - Proven experience leading developers, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating distributed contributors. 
 - The ability to take ownership of technical problems, communicate their business impact, and carry improvements through to a verified result. 
 - Ability to work independently, explain technical decisions clearly, and prioritize within a limited startup budget. 

Especially Valuable Experience

- Delivering Microsoft AI or automation projects in a startup or consulting environment. 
 - Building retrieval workflows with documented knowledge sources and permission-aware access. 
 - Working with Power Apps, Azure services, SQL databases, or Azure DevOps. 
 - Experience with Azure API Management and its AI gateway capabilities, including authentication, model routing, usage limits, monitoring, and cost control. 
 - Experience with related components such as Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Azure AI Search. 
 - Experience building and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards, including Power Query, data modelling, DAX, scheduled refresh, workspace permissions, and row-level security.

data.title: DevOps Engineer (Vac DST)
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a DevOps Engineer (Vac DST) based in India. 

Join a distributed systems testing team dedicated to evaluating the performance, scalability, and reliability of advanced decentralized technologies. In this role, you will design and optimize Kubernetes infrastructure for large-scale experiments and performance benchmarks. You will build automated deployment workflows and strengthen observability to make complex testing environments more reliable and reproducible. Working closely with researchers and engineers, you will investigate distributed system behaviors and turn technical findings into actionable improvements. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to open-source technologies supporting privacy, digital freedom, and decentralized peer-to-peer networks. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure challenges and improving the performance of distributed systems, this role offers a technically challenging environment with meaningful impact. 

Accountabilities

As a DevOps Engineer, you will build and maintain the infrastructure needed to test distributed systems at scale, working closely with researchers and development teams to improve experimentation, performance analysis, and operational reliability. 

- Design, configure, and optimize Kubernetes clusters for large-scale experiments and benchmarking of peer-to-peer technologies. 
 - Improve cluster scalability, resource utilization, and infrastructure efficiency to support increasingly complex deployments. 
 - Deploy, maintain, and optimize monitoring, logging, and observability solutions, including Grafana, Prometheus, and Loki. 
 - Collaborate with distributed systems researchers and engineers to streamline experimentation workflows and make results easier to analyze and reproduce. 
 - Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and deployment processes to improve reliability and reduce operational overhead. 
 - Troubleshoot, profile, and tune distributed workloads to ensure accurate, consistent, and high-performance benchmarks. 
 - Identify, reproduce, and debug complex distributed systems issues in collaboration with development teams. 
 - Translate technical observations and benchmarking data into practical recommendations for improving system performance and reliability. 

Requirements

The ideal candidate combines strong DevOps and infrastructure engineering skills with a solid understanding of Linux, networking, and distributed systems. You should be comfortable automating complex environments, investigating technical issues, and communicating findings clearly across multidisciplinary teams. 

- Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration in production or research environments. 
 - Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure, Linux systems, and networking, particularly in distributed and peer-to-peer environments. 
 - Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, and VictoriaLogs. 
 - Experience with infrastructure-as-code and deployment tools, including Terraform, Ansible, or Helm. 
 - Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language, ideally Python. 
 - Interest in or experience with distributed systems, peer-to-peer networks, or blockchain technologies. 
 - Experience with networking and systems programming. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical teams. 
 - Alignment with principles centered on privacy, digital liberties, decentralization, and open technology. 

Bonus Qualifications

- Hands-on experience with libp2p or projects within decentralized technology communities. 
 - Background in performance benchmarking, scalability testing, or systems research. 
 - Contributions to open-source projects. 
 - Previous experience working with an open-source organization. 

Benefits

- Remote work opportunity with a worldwide team. 
 - Opportunity to contribute to open-source infrastructure and decentralized technologies. 
 - Exposure to complex distributed systems, large-scale Kubernetes deployments, and performance research. 
 - Collaborative environment working alongside engineers, researchers, and technical specialists. 
 - Compensation expectations are collected during the application process; a specific salary range and additional benefits are not disclosed in the listing. 
 - Candidates are asked whether they would consider receiving part of their compensation in cryptocurrency; this is a preference question, not a stated requirement. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.  - Opportunities for professional growth and mentorship. 
 - Competitive salary and benefits package. 
 - Exposure to a diverse range of exciting client projects. 

If you are a back-end developer with extensive experience in Shopify and enjoy working on complex, custom solutions, we'd love to have you on our team!

Role: Senior AI Architect

Location: Pune/Nagpur, Maharashtra (Work from office)

Duration: Full-time at Quanta Systems Technologies LLP (Quantum Integrators)

Shift Time: 02: 00 PM to 11: 00 PM IST

Experience: 10+ years in software or data architecture, 3+ years designing AI/ML solutions

About the role: 

Quantum Integrators is hiring a Senior AI Architect to design and deliver production AI systems for our enterprise clients. You will own the technical vision for generative AI, agentic and machine learning solutions, from first discovery workshop through to scaled deployment. 

This is a hands-on, client-facing role. You will shape architecture, guide engineering teams, and help clients turn AI pilots into secure, governed systems that deliver measurable business value. 

What you'll do, 

- Lead the end-to-end architecture of AI solutions: LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and classical ML models. 
 - Partner with client executives and stakeholders to identify high-value use cases, assess feasibility, and define roadmaps. 
 - Select and integrate models, frameworks and platforms (e. g. , Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, open-source models) based on cost, performance and risk. 
 - Design scalable data and integration patterns that connect AI services to enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM and data platforms. 
 - Define MLOps and LLMOps practices covering evaluation, monitoring, versioning, CI/CD and cost control. 
 - Build in security, privacy and responsible AI controls, including guardrails, access management and compliance with regulations such as the EU AI Act. 
 - Guide and mentor engineers and data scientists; review designs and code, and set reference architectures and standards. 
 - Build proofs of concept quickly, then harden them for production. 
 - Support pre-sales: scope solutions, write technical proposals and present to client leadership. 
 - Track emerging AI research and tools, and turn what matters into reusable accelerators for the practice. 

What you bring: 

- 10+ years in software engineering, data engineering or solution architecture, with 3+ years architecting AI/ML solutions in production. 
 - Hands-on experience building LLM-based applications: prompt engineering, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, fine-tuning and agent frameworks (e. g. , Google ADK, LangChain, LlamaIndex). 
 - Deep expertise in at least one major cloud (Azure, AWS or GCP) and its AI services. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python, plus working knowledge of APIs, microservices, containers and Kubernetes. 
 - Solid grounding in data architecture: pipelines, data lakes/warehouses, and data quality and governance. 
 - Experience with model evaluation, observability and MLOps tooling (e. g. , MLflow, Weights & Biases, OpenTelemetry). 
 - Track record of explaining complex technical trade-offs to executive and non-technical audiences. 
 - Consulting or client-facing delivery experience. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience. 

Nice to have: 

- Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning or a related field. 
 - Cloud architect or AI certifications (e. g. , Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Machine Learning Specialty, Google Professional ML Engineer). 
 - Experience in regulated industries such as life sciences, manufacturing, financial services or healthcare, including GxP or validated systems. 
 - Experience integrating AI with enterprise platforms such as SAP, Salesforce or ServiceNow. 
 - Familiarity with AI governance frameworks such as NIST AI RMF or ISO/IEC 42001.

data.title: HEAD OF SYSTEM RELIABILITY AND QUALITY
data.description:
ABOUT US: 

Join a team that is redefining the accessibility of space. Azista space is a transformative force in the global aerospace sector, uniquely positioned at the intersection of indigenous innovation and industrial scalability. Operating India's first private-sector satellite mass-production facility in Ahmedabad, we have bridged the gap between complex engineering and high-volume manufacturing. 

As a vertically integrated leader, we provide end-to-end solutions from the precision design of satellite buses and advanced payloads to mission management and communication systems. We don't just build hardware, we are democratizing the final frontier by providing global clientele with the cost-effective, high-performance technology needed to power the next generation of orbital missions. At Azista, you won't just be starting a job, you'll be fuelling the future of space exploration. 

JOB SUMMARY: 

Azista Space is seeking a visionary and rigorous Head of System Reliability and Quality to lead our entire quality division across satellite design, development, assembly, integration, and testing (AIT). Operating as a vertically integrated leader in the global aerospace sector, we bridge the gap between complex engineering and high-volume manufacturing. In this critical executive role, you will own reliability, product, and mission assurance for every space programme, driving our commitment to zero-defect manufacturing from concept through launch readiness. 

You will set the overarching quality strategy, build and scale a world-class QA/QC team, and act as the definitive quality authority across electrical, mechanical, and software domains. Your leadership will directly govern compliance with aerospace standards-including AS9100D, DO-178C, and DO-254, while embedding a culture of "first-time-right" process discipline. By spearheading Material Review Boards, Failure Review Boards, and robust supplier quality frameworks, you will safeguard our orbital missions, protect mission-critical hardware, and cement Azista Space's reputation as a trusted global provider of high-performance space technology. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 

- Executive Quality Leadership: Lead the entire QA/QC division across hiring, organizational structure, performance management, and succession planning, setting clear product assurance objectives for all satellite programmes. 
 - Final Quality Authority: Serve as the ultimate sign-off authority for design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR), test readiness, material review boards (MRB), failure review boards (FRB), and final shipment/launch clearances. 
 - QMS & Regulatory Governance: Establish, maintain, and continuously improve a QMS fully compliant with AS9100D and ISO 9001, successfully hosting customer, certification, and regulatory audits. 
 - Full Lifecycle Mission Assurance: Oversee quality gates and verification matrices across the complete satellite lifecycle, including environmental testing (thermal vacuum, vibration, shock, and EMI/EMC). 
 - Software & Hardware Compliance: Govern complex electronic hardware assurance to DO-254 and flight/ground software quality assurance to DO-178C alongside ECSS/NASA standards where required. 
 - Workmanship & EEE Parts Control: Enforce strict adherence to IPC J-STD-001 (Space Addendum), IPC-A-610, and IPC/WHMA-A-620 standards, alongside rigorous EEE parts screening and counterfeit-part prevention. 
 - Supplier Quality & Risk Management: Qualify and monitor subcontractors, flow down stringent quality requirements, and drive root cause analysis and corrective actions (CAPA, 8D, FMEA) to eliminate quality escapes. 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR: 

- Education: Minimum B. Tech / B. E. in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Aerospace, or a related engineering discipline. 
 - Experience: 12+ years of progressive QA/QC experience within aerospace systems. 
 - Space Systems Expertise: Hands-on quality assurance experience on satellites, spacecraft subsystems, or launch vehicle systems (non-negotiable). 
 - Lifecycle Ownership: Proven track record of owning quality through design, development, integration, and testing of space hardware. 
 - Multi-Disciplinary Mastery: Demonstrated capability managing QA/QC for both electrical/electronic and mechanical systems. 
 - Standards Familiarity: Practical working knowledge of software and complex hardware assurance standards (DO-178C and DO-254). 
 - Leadership Track Record: Experience leading a multi-tiered QA/QC function, including managing subordinate managers and leads. 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: 

- M. Tech / M. E. or MBA in Quality or Operations Management. 
 - Prior experience with ISRO, global space agencies, or leading commercial satellite manufacturers. 
 - Deep knowledge of ECSS-Q product assurance standards and NASA workmanship standards. 
 - Professional certifications: AS9100D Lead Auditor, ASQ CQE / CQM, Six Sigma Black Belt, or IPC Certified Trainer/Specialist. 
 - Direct experience setting up a certified QMS or QA/QC function completely from scratch. 
 - Exposure to clean-room operations and space-qualified EEE parts programmes. 

WHY JOIN US / BENEFITS: 

- Pioneering Impact: Play a pivotal role in shaping India's private space ecosystem, contributing directly to state-of-the-art satellite constellations and orbital missions. 
 - Unmatched Scale: Work at the forefront of indigenous innovation inside India's premier private satellite mass-production facility, bridging high-volume manufacturing with rigorous aerospace engineering. 
 - Culture of Excellence: Collaborate with passionate aerospace visionaries, engineers, and technologists dedicated to democratizing access to space. 
 - Professional Growth: Enjoy executive-level ownership, autonomous decision-making authority, and the opportunity to build and mentor a high-performing engineering culture from the ground up.

data.title: Director, Core Infrastructure
data.description:
If you're passionate about being part of a dynamic organization that enables a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales to drive innovation and adopt new technologies that deliver business results, then Nationwide's Technology team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, "on your side" goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we're looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care. 

Position Overview

The Director, Core Infrastructure is a hands-on leader responsible for the reliability, resilience, performance, operational discipline, and continuous improvement of Nationwide's core infrastructure capabilities in India. This role leads a broad, multidisciplinary portfolio spanning Mainframe, Network, Telephony, Compute, Storage, Database, Middleware, Containers, and FinOps, while partnering closely with Cloud, Security, Architecture, Application, and business teams. 

The successful candidate combines strong technical judgment with a positive, people-centered leadership style. They will be comfortable engaging at both strategic and technical levels, and passionate about developing, coaching, and recognizing people so the organization builds durable capability for the future. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead day-to-day delivery and operational performance across the core infrastructure portfolio for Nationwide India
 - Liaise and coordinate with Nationwide US leadership team and frontline staff
 - Establish clear priorities, service expectations, ownership models, and escalation paths across participating teams. 
 - Maintain a strong focus on availability, resilience, capacity, performance, recoverability, security, and compliance. 
 - Provide hands-on leadership during complex incidents, problem investigations, major changes, and service-improvement initiatives. 
 - Drive standardization, automation, lifecycle management, modernization, and reduction of operational toil. 
 - Partner with architecture and engineering leaders to shape practical, scalable infrastructure road maps. 
 - Build disciplined practices for monitoring, observability, configuration management, patching, vulnerability remediation, disaster recovery, and technical debt reduction. 
 - Strengthen FinOps practices by improving cost transparency, forecasting, demand management, utilization, and accountability across infrastructure services. 
 - Coordinate dependencies across Mainframe, Network, Compute, Storage, Database, Middleware, and Containers to deliver integrated outcomes rather than isolated technology improvements. 
 - Develop trusted relationships with internal partners, vendors, and service providers. 
 - Translate business needs into clear technical priorities, delivery plans, risks, and decisions for senior leadership. 
 - Ensure operational processes and technical solutions support Nationwide's risk-management, governance, and audit expectations. 

People leadership expectations

- Create a positive, inclusive, and accountable team environment. 
 - Coach individuals through regular feedback, career conversations, mentoring, and meaningful development opportunities. 
 - Build a strong bench of technical and operational talent through delegation, stretch assignments, knowledge sharing, and succession planning. 
 - Recognize contributions and reinforce behaviors that improve customer outcomes, teamwork, and reliability. 
 - Lead through change with transparency, empathy, consistency, and a bias toward constructive problem solving. 
 - Encourage healthy challenge, learning from incidents, and continuous improvement without blame. 

Required Qualifications And Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 
 - Significant experience leading infrastructure engineering or operations teams in a complex enterprise environment. 
 - Demonstrated experience across multiple core infrastructure domains, with sufficient depth to guide technical decisions and challenge assumptions. 
 - Experience leading critical incidents, operational reviews, service improvements, and cross-functional delivery. 
 - Strong understanding of infrastructure reliability, security, resilience, capacity, performance, and lifecycle management. 
 - Proven ability to coach and develop technical professionals and first-line leaders. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical issues to senior and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Experience working with distributed teams, external partners, and global operating models. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in a regulated, highly available, or financial-services environment. 
 - Experience with infrastructure automation, observability, platform engineering, and modern operational practices. 
 - Experience managing budgets, vendor relationships, service providers, and technology road maps. 
 - Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and hybrid technology environments. 
 - Experience establishing or improving FinOps, IT service management, or reliability engineering practices. 

Leadership profile

We are seeking a leader who is technically credible, calm under pressure, optimistic, collaborative, and committed to making the people and the platform better every day. The right candidate brings energy to difficult problems, stays close enough to the work to understand reality, and creates an environment where people can do their best work. 

Job Description Summary

If you're enthusiastic about delivering secure technological solutions to support a company providing extraordinary care to its customers, then Nationwide Technology is the place for you. Nationwide's industry-leading technology workforce embraces an agile work environment and a collaborative culture to deliver outstanding solutions and results. If that sounds like something you aspire to, we want to hear from you!

The Director of Technology Engineering leads a team of infrastructure engineers involved in the analysis, design, development and implementation of hardware/software. You'll determine hardware/software systems requirements, authorize and oversee systems hardware/software design; plan projects; establish priorities and monitor progress. You'll also evaluate project status and resource utilization and implement changes to improve the staff's effectiveness. The ability to ensuring project completion, on time and on budget, is essential. You'll also need the ability to generate hardware/software systems engineering policies, standards, and procedures. You also may mentor associates who are not members of your core team.

data.title: Sales Manager
data.description:
About the Role

Mercom India is looking for an experienced and highly driven Sales Manager to lead our sales team and drive revenue growth across the company's research, market intelligence, news, advertising, and events businesses. 

This is a hands-on sales leadership role responsible for managing, motivating, training, and developing a team of approximately five sales professionals while taking ownership of overall sales performance. The Sales Manager will be expected to understand Mercom's products, identify growth opportunities, strengthen sales processes, build customer relationships, negotiate with customers, close deals, and ensure the team consistently meets and exceeds its targets. 

We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the sales function and operate independently with minimal day-to-day supervision. 

Key Responsibilities

Sales Leadership & Team Development

- Lead, manage, motivate, train, and develop Mercom India's sales team. 
 - Take responsibility for the team's overall sales performance and revenue targets. 
 - Set clear individual and team targets and ensure every salesperson understands what is expected. 
 - Coach team members on a daily basis on prospecting, pitching, follow-ups, objection handling, negotiations, and closing. 
 - Review calls, pitches, proposals, and customer interactions regularly and provide practical feedback to improve performance. 
 - Conduct regular one-on-one coaching sessions and sales reviews with each team member. 
 - Identify individual strengths and weaknesses and create development plans to improve sales capabilities. 
 - Train the team on Mercom's products, pricing, positioning, and value proposition. 
 - Ensure salespeople can independently pitch the full Mercom portfolio without relying on senior management. 
 - Help salespeople prepare for important customer meetings and participate when needed. 
 - Identify performance gaps early and work directly with team members to improve results. 
 - Build a sales culture focused on urgency, accountability, consistent follow-up, and closing business. 
 - Keep the team motivated and focused during challenging sales periods. 
 - Address underperformance quickly while continuing to develop strong performers. 

Product & Market Knowledge

- Develop a strong understanding of Mercom India's research, data, news, advertising, event, and consulting products. 
 - Ensure every salesperson can confidently present and sell the full Mercom portfolio. 
 - Stay current on developments in India's renewable energy and clean energy markets. 
 - Understand competitor products, pricing, positioning, and sales strategies. 
 - Work with internal teams to continuously improve sales presentations, proposals, pitches, and marketing materials. 

Revenue Growth & Business Development

- Develop and implement sales strategies to grow revenue across all Mercom India business verticals. 
 - Identify new customers, markets, industries, and revenue opportunities. 
 - Build and maintain a strong, qualified sales pipeline. 
 - Drive new customer acquisition while expanding business with existing customers. 
 - Identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities across Mercom's products and services. 
 - Take ownership of major opportunities and strategic accounts. 
 - Provide accurate revenue forecasts and identify potential shortfalls early. 
 - Personally engage with key prospects and customers when required to move opportunities forward. 

Customer Negotiation & Deal Closure

- Lead negotiations with customers on pricing, packages, contracts, sponsorships, subscriptions, and custom solutions. 
 - Support salespeople in overcoming objections and moving stalled opportunities toward closure. 
 - Participate directly in important customer negotiations and close strategic or high-value deals. 
 - Protect Mercom's pricing and product value while developing commercial solutions that meet customer requirements. 
 - Ensure discounts and custom proposals are commercially justified and aligned with company guidelines. 
 - Develop strong closing discipline across the sales team and ensure opportunities do not remain open without clear next steps. 
 - Build long-term customer relationships that lead to renewals, repeat business, and expansion opportunities. 

Customer Relationships

- Develop strong relationships with existing and prospective customers. 
 - Understand customer businesses, challenges, and requirements and position the appropriate Mercom products and services. 
 - Maintain relationships with key accounts and senior industry executives. 
 - Improve customer retention, renewals, and account growth. 
 - Gather customer feedback and share relevant insights with the Research, News, Events, and management teams. 
 - Ensure customers receive professional, responsive, and knowledgeable support throughout the sales process. 

Sales Across Mercom's Product Portfolio

- Drive revenue growth across Mercom's full portfolio of research, media, and event products. 
 - Lead sales of Market Tracker dashboards, market research reports and subscriptions, custom research and consulting services, proprietary market data, and new intelligence products. 
 - Grow revenue from Mercom Insider subscriptions, digital and magazine advertising, newsletter advertising, sponsored content, and other media opportunities, with a focus on expanding the paid subscriber base and recurring revenue. 
 - Drive sponsorship, exhibition, partnership, and delegate sales for the Mercom India Events, webinars, and other industry events. 
 - Ensure the sales team understands and can clearly communicate the value of Mercom's products, particularly how its proprietary research and market intelligence help customers make better business decisions. 
 - Work closely with the Research, Media, and Events teams to identify prospects early, build strong pipelines, improve renewals, and maximize revenue across every product line and event. 

What We Are Looking For

- Proven experience managing, training, and developing a sales team. 
 - Strong track record of achieving and exceeding revenue targets. 
 - Experience in B2B sales, preferably involving research, data, subscriptions, media, conferences, consulting, information services, or other knowledge-based products. 
 - Demonstrated ability to generate new business, negotiate effectively, and close complex B2B sales. 
 - Strong leadership and coaching skills with the ability to improve individual salesperson performance. 
 - Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills. 
 - Strong pipeline management and sales forecasting capabilities. 
 - Comfortable selling multiple products and developing cross-selling opportunities.

An established enterprise software organization is strengthening the way it builds, protects, and operates its cloud services. An integrated operating model for cloud platforms, service operations, SRE, secure software delivery, and security engineering. 

Organization design, leadership development, and measurable accountability across managers and specialist teams. 

The executive view of service health, operational risk, security posture, major incidents, and investment priorities. 

A close partnership with engineering leaders so reliability and security are built into architecture, development, release, and support. 

Areas of impact

Service resilience and operational leadership

Define how critical services are measured and operated, including SLOs, error budgets, availability, performance, capacity, and release risk. 

Lead high-severity incident response and 24x7 escalation. Set expectations for command, communications, root-cause analysis, and completion of corrective work. 

Use telemetry, service reviews, readiness practices, and resilience exercises to identify weak signals and prevent customer-impacting failures. 

Build repeatable operating practices for change management, on-call readiness, escalation, and continual service improvement. 

Cloud platform and financial stewardship

Guide the architecture and operating model for OCI or an equivalent major provider such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. 

Oversee Kubernetes and virtualized environments, microservices foundations, cloud networking, databases, provisioning, and platform lifecycle. 

Expand infrastructure as code and policy as code to make environments consistent, reviewable, and controlled. 

Ensure backups and disaster recovery are routinely tested against agreed recovery objectives; improve resilience based on exercise results. 

Introduce sound cloud financial management through cost allocation, forecasting, capacity choices, rightsizing, and accountable spend. 

Security engineering and threat response

Own identity and privileged-access practices, secrets handling, and least-privilege design across cloud and engineering environments. 

Ensure application and API authorization testing addresses tenant boundaries, isolation, and access-control failures in multi-tenant services. 

Operate a risk-based vulnerability program that assigns owners, sets remediation targets, verifies fixes, and escalates overdue exposure. 

Maintain cloud security posture management, continuous monitoring, security incident response, and disciplined penetration-test follow-through. 

Secure delivery, assurance, and AI operations

Work with software engineering to embed automated checks in CI/CD: SAST, DAST, SCA, secret detection, container scanning, and IaC scanning. 

Agree practical remediation SLAs and risk exceptions with engineering teams, keeping controls effective and delivery workflows usable. 

Maintain operating evidence for ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, and SOC 2; lead customer security assessments and responses. 

Apply automation and AIOps to detection, triage, response, and toil reduction. For AI agents, establish identity controls, authorized tool access, isolated execution, complete audit trails, and human approvals for sensitive actions. 

Experience and leadership profile

At least 20 years of technology experience, with a track record of senior ownership in cloud platforms, production operations, reliability engineering, DevSecOps, or security engineering. 

Executive leadership across multiple functions, including managing managers, setting direction, building leadership capability, and delivering outcomes through sizeable teams. 

Accountability for business-critical production services; product SaaS or other cloud-native, multi-tenant environments are especially relevant. 

Practical depth in a major cloud provider, Kubernetes, microservices, networking, databases, observability, IaC, and recovery planning. 

Credible record of leading significant production incidents and converting lessons into lasting changes to architecture, process, or operational readiness. 

Applied security engineering experience spanning IAM/PAM, secrets, application and API authorization, vulnerability remediation, cloud posture, monitoring, and response. 

Experience introducing automated CI/CD security checks and achieving sustained remediation without relying on manual review as the main control. 

Experience leading ISO 27001-family and SOC 2 assurance, including evidence quality and customer-facing security reviews. 

Ability to communicate technical risks, trade-offs, service performance, and investment needs clearly to executive stakeholders. 

Additional strengths

Production experience with OCI; equivalent leadership depth with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud is applicable. 

Background in enterprise SaaS or a regulated, security-conscious technology environment. 

Relevant cloud, security, SRE, or audit credentials, such as cloud architecture/security certifications, CISSP, CISM, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor. 

Demonstrated use of AIOps or AI agents in operational settings with clear boundaries, oversight, and auditability.

Job description: 

Job Description Role Summary
Design, develop, test and deploy Fullstack Microsoft AI applications combining traditional web/application development with Generative AI, RAG, AI agents and intelligent automation. The developer works across both pro-code Microsoft AI technologies and low-code Copilot Studio/Power Platform technologies. 
Key Responsibilities
•     Develop AI-enabled web applications and enterprise solutions using Microsoft Azure technologies. 
•     Pro-Code AI: Develop AI applications and agents using Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure AI Search and Semantic Kernel using C#/. NET and/or Python. 
•     Low-Code AI: Build agents and automation using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate and Power Platform, including integration with APIs and enterprise systems. 
•     Develop Generative AI features including prompting, structured responses, grounding, tool/function calling and RAG. 
•     Build AI agents with tools, APIs, knowledge sources, context/state management and workflow orchestration. 
•     Implement RAG solutions including document processing, chunking, embeddings, indexing and retrieval. 
•     Develop frontend components using React/Angular, TypeScript/JavaScript and appropriate Microsoft UI technologies. 
•     Develop backend services and APIs using . NET/ASP. NET Core and/or Python/FastAPI. 
•     Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications using REST/OpenAPI, MCP, Microsoft Graph and Azure integration services. 
•     Work with Azure AI Search, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL and Azure Storage for application and AI data requirements. 
•     Implement authentication and authorization using Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identity and OAuth. 
•     Deploy applications using App Service, Functions, Container Apps, Docker and other Azure runtime services. 
•     Develop automated unit, API and integration tests and participate in AI/prompt evaluation. 
•     Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub or Azure DevOps. 
•     Implement logging, telemetry and monitoring using Application Insights, Azure Monitor and OpenTelemetry. 
•     Use GitHub Copilot and modern AI-assisted engineering practices to improve development productivity and code quality. 

  

Mandatory Skills: M365 Copilot
. 

  

Experience: 3-5 Years
. 

  

Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end-to-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA - as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

data.description:
Our Mission

Mercari is a Japan-based C2C marketplace company founded in 2013 with the mission to "Create value in a global marketplace where anyone can buy & sell. " From being the first tech unicorn from Japan before its IPO in 2018 we have come a long way towards becoming a global player and continuously and diligently work towards our transformation journey with a strong focus on our mission. 

Since its inception, Mercari Group has worked to grow its services, investing in both our people and technology. Over time, Mercari has expanded from being the top player in the C2C marketplace in Japan to new geographies like the U. S. We have also successfully launched new businesses such as Merpay, which is a mobile payment service platform with a vision to create a society where anyone can realise their dreams through a new ecosystem centered not only on payment service but also on credit. Today, Mercari Group is made up of multiple subsidiary businesses, including logistics, B2C platform, blockchain, and sports team management. 

About Mercari India

Established in Bangalore in 2022, Mercari India serves as a crucial technology hub for the Mercari Group. Leveraging the rich and diverse tech talent in India, we primarily collaborate closely with our development hub in Japan to drive engineering development for Mercari's applications. Having grown to an organization of approximately 80 members over about three years since its inception, Mercari India aims to evolve into an even stronger engineering organization that spearheads technological innovation for the entire group. This will be achieved by further enhancing our engineering capabilities and promoting AI initiatives that reflect India's cutting-edge technology and knowledge. 

Our Culture

To achieve our mission at Mercari, our organisation and each of our employees share the same values and perspectives. 

Our individual guidelines for action are defined by our four values: 

- Go Bold
 - All for One
 - Be a Pro
 - Move Fast

Our organisation is also shaped by our four foundations: 

- Sustainability
 - Diversity & Inclusion
 - Trust & Openness
 - Well-being for Performance

Regardless of how big Mercari gets, the culture will remain essential to achieving our mission and something we want to preserve throughout our organisation. 

We invite you to read the Mercari culture doc that summarizes the behaviours and mindset shared by Mercari and its employees. We continue to build an environment where all of our members of diverse backgrounds are accepted and recognised, and where they can thrive while holding dear to Mercari's culture. 

Requirements

Work Responsibilities

- What You'll Do: 
 - Languages: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript(ES6), TypeScript, Reactjs, Next. js, GraphQL, Apollo Client, Redux, Cypress, Rendertron and Storybook
 - Infrastructures: Google Cloud Platform (Compute Engine, Kubernetes Engine, App Engine)
 - Configuration management tool: Terraform
 - Other: GitHub, Slack, JIRA, Spinnaker and DatadogMinimum Requirements

- Shared understanding and belief in Mercari Group's mission and values
 - At least 2-5 years of experience in development related to frontend fields such as web browsers, JavaScript, TypeScript, React. js, Next. js and Redux
 - Experience with developing and operating large-scale products
 - Ability to design and develop with performance and scalability in mind
 - Ability to use HTML and CSS to develop solid user interfaces
 - Knowledge of JavaScript and experience developing with UI libraries or frameworks such as React
 - Strong understanding of cross browser compatibility and best practices
 - Understanding of version management and ability to participate in development via Git
 - Effective communication skills, needed for product development with team members and with other teams

Preferred Requirements

 - Ability to consistently take initiative in implementing improvements to the app

Benefits

Job Title: Senior Front End Developer

About Us

"Capco, a Wipro company, is a global technology and management consulting firm. Awarded with Consultancy of the year in the British Bank Award and has been ranked Top 100 Best Companies for Women in India 2022 by Avtar & Seramount. With our presence across 32 cities across globe, we support 100+ clients across banking, financial and Energy sectors. We are recognized for our deep transformation execution and delivery. 

WHY JOIN CAPCO?

You will work on engaging projects with the largest international and local banks, insurance companies, payment service providers and other key players in the industry. The projects that will transform the financial services industry. 

MAKE AN IMPACT

Innovative thinking, delivery excellence and thought leadership to help our clients transform their business. Together with our clients and industry partners, we deliver disruptive work that is changing energy and financial services. 

#BEYOURSELFATWORK

Capco has a tolerant, open culture that values diversity, inclusivity, and creativity. 

CAREER ADVANCEMENT

With no forced hierarchy at Capco, everyone has the opportunity to grow as we grow, taking their career into their own hands. 

DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

We believe that diversity of people and perspective gives us a competitive advantage. 

Role Description

Job Title: Senior Front End Developer

Location: Hinjewadi Phase 1 - Pune

Shift Time: EMEA

Overview

Role Description : 

About The Role

As a Frontend Engineer specializing in React. js at Capco, you will be at the heart of designing and developing modern, high-performance, and accessible user interfaces for high-value digital solutions in the banking and insurance sectors. You will work closely with product, design, and backend teams to deliver robust, high-quality, and scalable applications. 

Your Responsibilities Will Include

- Designing and developing responsive and performant user interfaces using React. js, while ensuring accessibility and user experience best practices. 
 - Collaborating on the definition of frontend architecture, alongside Tech Leads and other technical experts. 
 - Integrating backend APIs and handling complex state management and user interactions effectively. 
 - Participating in the implementation of automated testing (unit, integration, end-to-end) and continuous integration pipelines. 
 - Contributing ideas on technology choices, frameworks, and libraries, and playing an active role in code quality improvement. 
 - Working in an agile environment, and collaborating effectively with UX/UI designers, Product Owners, and backend developers. 
 - Getting involved in the Capco frontend chapter through workshops, code reviews, tech watch, tech talks, and more. 

At Capco, our stack includes Next. js 15 and therefore React. js 19. Our backend developers use Java / Spring Boot, and in some client contexts, we also offer NestJS-perfect for fullstack developers!

We also welcome React Native developers when responsive web solutions no longer meet our clients' needs. 

Experience And Required Skills

- Professional Experience
 - Minimum of 5 years of experience in frontend development on complex projects or applications with high user exposure. 
 - Proven track record working on React. js production projects, ideally in micro-frontend or modular application environments. 
 - Experience working in agile teams, integrated within multidisciplinary setups
 - Technical skills
 - Advanced expertise in Next. js / React. js and its ecosystem (Hooks, React Router, Redux/Zustand/Recoil, Context API, etc. ). 
 - Strong knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3 (or modern styling tools like Styled Components, Tailwind CSS, etc. ). 
 - Good practices in state management, side effect handling, and component lifecycle management. 
 - Experience with frontend automated testing tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, or Cypress. 
 - Basic understanding of accessibility principles (a11y) and UX standards. 
 - Familiarity with build tools and CI pipelines (e. g. , Webpack, Vite, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions). 
 - Knowledge of additional frameworks (Next. js, Vue. js, Angular) is a valuable asset. 
 - Soft Skills and Other Competencies
 - Autonomous, detail-oriented, with a strong sense of responsibility and rigor. 
 - Strong team player, able to communicate and collaborate effectively in cross-functional environments (UX/UI, backend, Product Owners, QA. . . ). 
 - Passion for building well-designed, high-performance interfaces, with a constant focus on the user experience. 
 - Keen on knowledge sharing and contributing to continuous improvement. 
 - Technologically curious, with a desire for ongoing growth and learning. 
 - Fluent in English. 

If you are keen to join us, you will be part of an organization that values your contributions, recognizes your potential, and provides ample opportunities for growth. For more information, visit www. capco. com. Follow us on Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

data.title: Lead Developer
data.description:
Purpose of the role

We help security leaders replace spreadsheets and fragmented tools with a unified platform for risk, compliance, incidents, suppliers, metrics, culture, and AI-enabled workflows. We are building our first engineering team in Kochi, and we are looking for a Founding Lead Developer to establish it, lead it, and grow it. 

You will be the first developer in our Kochi team and its technical lead from day one. Working closely with the Head of AI and Engineering, you will start hands-on: building deep knowledge across the entire codebase and deployment pipeline, shipping roadmap features, and owning client requests and production issues. As the Kochi team grows, you will help hire, onboard, and lead the developers who join you, and establish the engineering standards the team works to. 

This is a genuine founding role. Your leadership scope will grow with the team, with a clear path to Engineering Manager as the Kochi team scales. 

As the company expands into the United States, the Kochi team will provide overnight turnaround for US clients, with issues raised during the US business day addressed while those clients sleep. You will help shape how this support model operates. 

Core hours are 8: 00 AM to 5: 00 PM IST, overlapping with the Sydney afternoon, with a paid, rostered on-call arrangement for urgent US client issues

Major Accountabilities

Founding Team Leadership

- Act as technical lead for the Kochi team from day one, setting local engineering practices, tooling, and ways of working. 
 - Help hire and onboard future Kochi developers, including shaping roles, interviewing candidates, and conducting technical assessments. 
 - Lead and mentor developers as the team grows, reviewing their work and raising engineering standards. 
 - Build a strong working rhythm between Kochi and Sydney through clear written updates, demonstrations, and shared planning. 

Platform Delivery & Ownership

- Build deep knowledge across the front end, back end, data, and deployment pipeline. 
 - Deliver roadmap features in collaboration with the Head of AI and Engineering and the Product team, from design through to tested release. 
 - Deploy, troubleshoot, and recover the platform independently, ensuring no critical component depends on a single person. 
 - Maintain runbooks and architecture documentation to ensure platform knowledge is shared across the team. 

Client Requests & Issue Resolution

- Own the triage and resolution of client requests and bugs in accordance with agreed service levels. 
 - Identify the root causes of production issues and deliver tested fixes that prevent recurring defects. 
 - Deliver client-requested enhancements in collaboration with the Product team, keeping clients informed throughout the process. 

US Expansion Support

- Provide overnight turnaround for US client issues, with rostered on-call coverage for urgent escalations. 
 - Support US client onboarding and the engineering work required for US hosting, data residency, and compliance. 
 - Feed recurring US client issues back to Product and Engineering to help shape the roadmap. 

Engineering Quality & Secure Delivery

- Apply established engineering standards for code review, testing, and release management to every change. 
 - Embed secure coding practices across access control, secrets management, and third-party dependencies. 
 - Work within an agent-driven engineering model, reviewing and hardening AI-generated code. 
 - Follow client data-handling and access requirements, including restrictions on where client data can be accessed from. 
Outcomes and Measures

- By day 60, independently deploy, troubleshoot, and roll back the platform. 
 - By day 90, ensure every critical platform component has runbooks and architecture documentation, with at least two people capable of supporting it. 
 - Resolve client requests and bugs within agreed service levels while reducing the backlog. 
 - Reduce recurring defects, production incidents, and rollbacks with each release. 
 - Provide US clients with overnight turnaround on reported issues and a consistent onboarding experience. 
 - As the team grows, ensure new Kochi developers become productive within 60 days and work to the same standards as the wider engineering team. 
Professional Skills, Qualifications and Experience

- 7+ years of software development experience, including 2+ years as a technical lead on a production SaaS platform. 
 - Experience mentoring developers, ideally including hiring and building an engineering team. 
 - Strong hands-on skills in TypeScript/JavaScript, Angular front-end development, and back-end API development. 
 - Deep relational database experience with PostgreSQL or SQL Server, including performance tuning. 
 - Practical cloud experience with Azure or AWS, along with Git, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes, and Docker. 
 - Proven production support experience, including debugging complex issues in multi-tenant SaaS environments. 
 - Knowledge of secure coding practices, including the OWASP Top 10. Exposure to ISO 27001, NIST CSF, or SOC 2 is an advantage. 
 - AI-native developer who uses AI coding tools daily and rigorously reviews generated code. 
 - Excellent written and spoken English, with the confidence to work directly with Australian and US clients and colleagues. 
 - Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience. 
Personal Attributes & Interpersonal Skills

- Builder at heart: Comfortable creating structure and processes where none exist yet. 
 - Clear communicator: Proactively keeps the Sydney team informed of progress, risks, and blockers without being asked. 
 - Calm problem solver: Approaches complex issues methodically and remains composed when clients are waiting for a fix. 
 - Strong sense of ownership: Follows every issue through to resolution. 
 - Customer-minded: Treats each client request as an opportunity to build trust. 
 - Disciplined documenter: Shares knowledge freely rather than keeping it to themselves. 
 - Collaborative mentor: Helps improve the skills and performance of the developers around them. 
How You Will Lead

- Set the standard: Model the engineering practices you expect from the team. 
 - Hire well: Raise the bar with every person who joins the Kochi team. 
 - Communicate early: Surface progress, risks, and blockers before anyone has to ask. 
 - Develop people: Provide clear feedback and help each developer grow. 
 - Own the outcome: Combine accountability, pace, and high standards. 
Our Values

- Secure First: Security is at the forefront of our decision-making. 
 - Fail Fast: Try new approaches, but change course quickly when necessary. 
 - Customer-Driven: Listen to our customers and act on their feedback. 
 - Elegant Simplicity: Less is more. 
 - Stronger Together: We are individually brilliant, but even better together. 
Health, Safety and Security Responsibilities

All employees are responsible for their own health, safety, and wellbeing, as well as that of their colleagues, and for protecting company and client information. 

- Comply with applicable local workplace health and safety laws and company policies. 
 - Maintain a safe and ergonomic working environment, including when working from home. 
 - Follow company information security policies, including access control, acceptable use, and data handling. 
 - Report any hazards, injuries, or security incidents to your manager promptly. 
 - Complete pre-employment background screening and ongoing security awareness training.

Company DescriptionVector Origin LLC specializes in structural and miscellaneous steel detailing, BIM modeling, and connection engineering for steel fabricators, EPCs, contractors, and commercial construction projects. The company delivers accurate, fabrication-ready solutions that minimize rework and improve project efficiency. 

With dedicated Tekla and SDS2 teams, Vector Origin uses industry-leading software, including Tekla Structures, SDS2, AutoCAD, and Revit. The company emphasizes technical accuracy, quality assurance, transparent communication, and timely project delivery. 

Role DescriptionWe are looking for an experienced Senior Tekla Checker cum Team Lead with 8+ years of experience in structural steel detailing using Tekla Structures. The candidate will check Tekla models and fabrication drawings, maintain project quality standards, lead a team of modelers and detailers, allocate work, monitor productivity, and ensure timely project delivery. 

The ideal candidate should possess strong technical checking expertise, leadership capabilities, and the ability to resolve complex detailing issues while maintaining high-quality project deliverables. 

Key ResponsibilitiesTechnical Checking and Quality Control
 - Independently check and review Tekla models, General Arrangement (GA) drawings, shop drawings, assembly drawings, and single-part drawings. 
 - Verify dimensions, member orientation, levels, connections, bolt arrangements, weld symbols, hole locations, and plate details. 
 - Ensure compliance with client standards, project specifications, and applicable AISC and international detailing standards. 
 - Identify and correct modeling, connection, and detailing errors before project submission. 
 - Verify Bills of Materials (BOM), material specifications, quantities, and drawing consistency.
