data.title: Head Commissary
data.description:
About Food Stories

Foodstories is redefining the gourmet food landscape in India, catering to the nation's most discerning and affluent consumers with an unwavering passion for exceptional culinary experiences. With an ambitious vision to become the leader in India's gourmet food space, Foodstories is committed to shaping the narrative around food, while offering products and experiences that delight the senses and elevate everyday dining. 

Currently, Foodstories operates flagship stores in Ambience Mall, Vasant Kunj (Delhi), Banjara Hills (Hyderabad), Hill Road (Mumbai), Lokhandwala, Andheri (Mumbai) and Prestige Sterling Square (Bengaluru) with customers also enjoying seamless access through FoodStories. Shop. These thoughtfully designed spaces offer a curated selection of premium, farm-sourced produce, artisanal bakery items, bespoke cheeses, single-origin chocolates, exotic spices, and more. The range is further complemented by a unique all-day dining café, where patrons can indulge in a culinary journey that includes a specialized estate-tocup organic coffee program and a cutting-edge bio-hacking zone, designed to address the evolving wellness needs of today's health-conscious consumer. Nearly half of the offerings at Foodstories are freshly prepared on-site, ensuring the highest standards of quality and flavor. The brand also provides an exclusive assortment of domestic and international pantry essentials, dry fruits, and other premium food products, all handpicked to cater to the most refined tastes. Looking ahead, Foodstories plans to expand its footprint with multiple stores across Gurgaon supported by state-of-the-art commissaries, back-end kitchens, and dark stores. Founded by Ashni and Avni Biyani, 

Foodstories is the result of their shared passion for food and their commitment to offering unparalleled quality and innovation. Owned and operated by Foodstories Private Limited, 

Foodstories is setting a new standard in gourmet food retail in India, combining luxury, sustainability, and culinary excellence in every product and experience. 

Visit us : 

https: //www. foodstories. shop/

https: //www. linkedin. com/company/foodstoriesshop/posts/?feedView=all&viewAsMember=true

About the Role

We are looking for a National Head - Commissary & Central Food Operations to own the end-to-end performance of FoodStories' commissary network. 

The role will be responsible for establishing standardized processes across cities, improving product quality and consistency, optimizing raw material and production costs, and ensuring that the commissary network is capable of supporting rapid store expansion. 

The ideal candidate will combine strong food operations expertise with commercial and procurement understanding and will be comfortable working across multiple cities, teams and stakeholders. 

A key part of the role will be to build systems that allow FoodStories to scale nationally without compromising product quality, consistency or customer experience. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Commissary Operations & SOPs

- Review, streamline and standardize all commissary SOPs across the network. 
 - Own the end-to-end commissary process covering procurement, ordering, receiving, storage, production, portioning, packaging, inventory and dispatch. 
 - Establish standardized operating processes that can be replicated across cities and new commissaries. 
 - Identify operational gaps and eliminate unnecessary complexity, duplication and process variation. 
 - Build clear operating manuals, checklists and process controls for commissary teams. 
 - Establish systems to ensure SOP adherence across all locations. 2. Product Quality & Consistency

- Own product quality and consistency across all commissaries and markets. 
 - Establish clear product specifications, recipes, yields, portion sizes and quality benchmarks. 
 - Ensure that products manufactured across different cities deliver the same taste, texture, appearance and quality. 
 - Develop robust quality-control mechanisms and regular commissary audits. 
 - Identify root causes of quality deviations and drive corrective actions. 
 - Work closely with Store Operations to understand customer and store-level feedback and translate it into improvements at the commissary level. 3. Procurement & Cost Optimization

- Review raw material procurement across commissaries and stores to identify cost optimization opportunities. 
 - Establish standardized pricing and acceptable cost bands for key raw materials across cities. 
 - Benchmark procurement costs across locations and identify significant variances. 
 - Work closely with Procurement to improve vendor selection, negotiation, sourcing and supply reliability. 
 - Identify opportunities for local sourcing without compromising quality or consistency. 
 - Specifically evaluate and develop suitable alternatives to TWF for flour procurement, while maintaining product specifications and quality. 
 - Drive greater purchasing efficiency through standardization, vendor consolidation and volume leverage. 4. Production Efficiency & Yield

- Monitor production costs, yields, wastage and productivity across commissaries. 
 - Establish benchmarks for yield, wastage, labour productivity and production efficiency. 
 - Identify and address production losses and inefficiencies. 
 - Improve forecasting and production planning in partnership with Operations and Supply Chain. 
 - Ensure the right balance between centralized production and local production based on product, geography and economics. 
 - Build scalable capacity-planning models to support FoodStories' national expansion. 5. New Product Development & Innovation

- Work closely with Avni (Founder) and the Innovation team to operationalize new product launches. 
 - Translate product concepts and recipes into scalable production processes. 
 - Ensure new products are commercially viable and can be consistently produced across multiple commissaries. 
 - Establish standardized recipes, production methods, specifications, packaging and quality benchmarks before launch. 
 - Partner with Store Operations to ensure successful execution of new products at store level. 
 - Identify operational challenges early in the innovation process and provide practical solutions. 6. National Standardization

- Build a national operating framework for commissaries while accounting for relevant local requirements and supply realities. 
 - Ensure consistency in processes, recipes, raw materials and quality standards across cities. 
 - Create mechanisms for sharing best practices between commissaries. 
 - Lead cross-city operational reviews and benchmarking. 
 - Ensure that every new commissary is set up using standardized FoodStories processes and operating principles. 7. Food Safety & Compliance

- Strengthen food safety, hygiene, storage and handling practices across all commissaries. 
 - Establish and monitor food safety and quality-control standards. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable food safety and statutory requirements. 
 - Conduct regular audits and ensure timely closure of identified gaps. 
 - Build a strong culture of food safety and operational discipline across commissary teams. 8. Team & Capability Building

- Build and lead a strong commissary leadership team across locations. 
 - Define organizational structures, roles, responsibilities and performance metrics. 
 - Develop the capability of Commissary Heads, Production Managers and frontline teams. 
 - Establish clear performance expectations and review mechanisms. 
 - Build a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement. 9. Business & Cross-functional Partnership

- Partner closely with Founder, Innovation, Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance and Store Operations. 
 - Provide regular visibility on commissary performance, quality, cost and capacity. 
 - Work with Finance to identify and deliver cost-saving opportunities. 
 - Partner with Operations to ensure commissaries consistently meet store requirements. 
 - Act as the central owner for resolving cross-functional issues affecting product quality, availability or cost. Key Metrics / Success Measures

The role will be measured on: 

- Product quality and consistency across cities
 - Commissary-level food cost and production cost
 - Raw material cost optimization
 - Yield and wastage
 - Production efficiency and capacity utilization
 - SOP adherence
 - Food safety and audit scores
 - Store-level product complaints and quality deviations
 - New product launch execution
 - Commissary service levels and dispatch accuracy
 - Readiness of the commissary network to support national store expansion

We are specifically looking for someone with national / multi-city experience. 

The ideal candidate would have: 

- 10-15+ years of experience in food operations, preferably across QSR, restaurant chains, food retail, FMCG, central kitchens or food manufacturing. 
 - Proven experience managing multi-city / national commissary or central kitchen operations. 
 - Experience managing multiple commissaries or production facilities across different geographies. 
 - Strong understanding of food production, recipes, yields, quality control, procurement and food costs. 
 - Experience in building and implementing SOPs across a distributed network. 
 - Strong understanding of raw material sourcing, vendor management and cost optimization. 
 - Experience scaling central kitchens/commissaries alongside rapid store expansion. 
 - Strong exposure to new product commercialization and product launches. 
 - Demonstrated ability to standardize operations without losing flexibility required for local markets. 
 - Strong commercial orientation and understanding of the relationship between quality, cost and operational efficiency. 
 - Experience managing senior teams across multiple locations. 
 - Strong stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work closely with founders and senior business leaders. 

We would particularly value candidates who have: 

- Managed a national QSR / restaurant / food-retail network
 - Set up or scaled multiple central kitchens / commissaries
 - Managed operations across 5+ cities
 - Worked in organizations undergoing rapid geographic expansion
 - Delivered measurable improvements in food cost, yield, wastage and product consistency
 - Worked closely with Founders / CXOs on product and operational strategy

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12-18 months, this person should help FoodStories build a nationally scalable commissary operating model where: 

Every city produces consistently → at the right cost → with the right quality → using standardized processes → and with the capacity to support the next phase of store expansion. 

This is a hands-on leadership role, not a purely corporate or strategy position. We are looking for someone who can operate at a national level while being close enough to the ground to identify what is actually happening inside each commissary.

Job Title: Senior Manager/Manager - Process Assurance

Department: Quality & Process Assurance

Location: Baheri, Uttar Pradesh

Role

Control and continuously improve the overall operation standards, process assurance, production/feedstock quality, manufacturing process discipline, laboratory testing, and quality systems of the plant. Ensure that process parameters, raw-material/feedstock quality, equipment operating conditions, production practices, and gas quality remain within defined standards. Drive systematic Root Cause Analysis (RCA), CAPA, process improvement, and cross-functional quality ownership across manufacturing and Operations. 

QUALITY & PROCESS ASSURANCE ACCOUNTABILITIES: 

Basic Accountability

· Take complete ownership of plant-wide process assurance and control, extending beyond laboratory testing. 

· Establish and maintain quality standards for incoming feedstock/raw materials, intermediate process streams and finished products. 

· Develop and implement process control plans covering critical process parameters, operating ranges, sampling frequency, testing methods, acceptance criteria and corrective actions. 

· Ensure process parameters are monitored consistently by Production/Operations and deviations are immediately identified, recorded and corrected. 

· Establish a system for early identification of process deviations before they result in production loss, quality deterioration or equipment/process instability. 

· Lead quality assurance of feedstock such as pressmud, biomass and other incoming materials, including assessment of moisture, organic matter, contamination, foreign material, particle size, consistency and other relevant parameters. 

· Correlate feedstock quality and variability with digester performance, gas generation, process stability and downstream product quality. 

· Monitor and control critical parameters of the biological/chemical process, including pH, temperature, TS/DM, VS/OM, alkalinity, organic loading, VFA and other applicable parameters. 

· Establish suitable sampling locations, sampling methods, sampling frequency and sample-handling procedures across the plant. 

· Ensure laboratory testing is carried out accurately and consistently under defined SOPs. 

· Guide and supervise laboratory testing through the available laboratory personnel and ensure proper recording, traceability and interpretation of results. 

· Develop a daily/weekly/monthly process stability dashboard covering critical process parameters, deviations, trends, corrective actions and improvement opportunities. 

· Identify process variations arising from raw material, manpower, machine, method, measurement and environment and drive corrective action. 

· Work closely with Maintenance to identify the impact of equipment condition, machine precision, instrumentation, calibration and equipment performance on process quality &reliability. 

· Ensure critical instruments used for process control and laboratory testing are calibrated and maintained as per defined schedules. 

· Coordinate with the Maintenance team for instrumentation and process-control issues where inaccurate measurement or equipment condition may affect process performance. 

· Work closely with Production/Operations to ensure process parameters are controlled within approved operating windows. 

· Establish a structured Deviation → RCA → CAPA → Effectiveness Verification system

Skills Required: 

Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering / Chemical Technology / Biotechnology / Microbiology / Food Technology / Dairy Technology / Pharmaceutical Technology / Industrial Chemistry or other relevant technical discipline. 

· Graduation /Post-graduation in relevant technical/quality discipline would be an advantage. 

· 6-15 years of experience in a manufacturing /process industry, · Candidates from FMCG, Food & Beverage, Dairy, Pharmaceutical, Chemical, Fermentation, Bio-processing, Biotechnology, Distillery, Sugar, Ethanol, Waste-to-Energy, Biogas/CBG or other process manufacturing industries may be considered. 

· Strong exposure to manufacturing processes and understanding of the relationship between raw material → process conditions → equipment performance → product quality.

data.title: Optical Engineer – Payload Integration & Test
data.description:
About EON Space Labs

EON Space Labs is a Hyderabad-based defence-technology company building indigenous EO/IR optical payloads for space, aerial and ground platforms - from miniaturised telescopes and star trackers for satellites, to EO/IR gimbals for UAVs, to long-range ground surveillance systems. 

Objective

Own the optical bench. You will take our payloads from loose optics to aligned, characterised, flight- and field-ready hardware - setting up the test methods, running them, and writing the procedures that make the results repeatable. 

Key Roles & Responsibilities

A. Optical Alignment & Assembly

·            Align and integrate reflective, refractive and catadioptric optical systems (e. g. , Cassegrain / Ritchey-Chrétien telescopes, multi-element VIS and LWIR lenses) to specified wavefront and focus tolerances. 

·            Focus and boresight detectors to optics; set and verify back-focal distance, tilt and decentre; align EO and IR channels to a common line of sight. 

·            Work with mechanical engineers on mounts, shims, adhesives and bonding processes that hold alignment through vibration and temperature change. 

B. Test & Characterisation

·            Measure MTF (slanted-edge, knife-edge or bar targets on a collimator), effective focal length, distortion, field of view, stray light and relative illumination. 

·            For IR cameras: measure NETD, MTF and MRTD using blackbody sources; perform non-uniformity correction (NUC) checks. 

·            Support environmental and qualification testing - thermal cycling, thermal-vacuum, vibration - including pre/post optical performance checks. 

C. Lab Ownership

·            Set up and maintain the optical lab: collimators, autocollimators, interferometer, optical tables, blackbodies, laser sources and measurement instruments. 

·            Maintain cleanroom (ISO-classified area) and ESD discipline, optics handling and cleaning practice, and laser safety per IEC 60825-1. 

·            Automate repetitive measurements and data reduction in Python or MATLAB. 

D. Documentation & Cross-Functional Work

·            Write test procedures, SOPs, test reports and alignment travellers; maintain traceability between design tolerances and measured results. 

·            Feed measured data back to optical design (Zemax OpticStudio / CODE V) to close the loop on tolerancing. 

·            Work with mechanical, electronics, firmware and AI/ML teams; support customer acceptance tests and trials; assist with patent drafting. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

Education

B. Tech / M. Tech / M. Sc. in Optics, Photonics, Applied Physics, Optoelectronics, or Electronics/Instrumentation with a strong optics specialisation. 

Must-have

·            Hands-on optical alignment and testing on a real optical bench (not only simulation). 

·            Practical use of at least two of: collimator, autocollimator, interferometer, MTF bench, theodolite. 

·            Solid grounding in geometrical and physical optics - aberrations, diffraction limit, MTF, sampling (Nyquist), radiometry basics. 

·            Ability to read and work to optical drawings and tolerances (ISO 10110 or equivalent). 

·            Python or MATLAB for data analysis. 

Good to have

·            Optical design or tolerancing in Zemax OpticStudio, CODE V or similar. 

·            MWIR/LWIR camera testing (NETD, MRTD, blackbody calibration). 

·            Experience with space or defence hardware - cleanroom work, contamination control, thermal-vacuum or vibration testing. 

·            Familiarity with image sensors (CMOS/microbolometer), focusing and boresighting cameras. 

Core Competencies

·            Careful, methodical bench practice - you write down what you did and the result is reproducible. 

·            Comfort with ownership in a small team: you will set up processes, not only follow them. 

·            Clear technical writing. 

Deliverables (first 6 months)

·            Documented, repeatable alignment procedure for at least one EON payload telescope. 

·            Working MTF and wavefront test setups with written SOPs and calibrated reference measurements. 

·            Test reports for payload units delivered to customers during the period. 

What We Offer

·            Work on real flight and field hardware across space, UAV and ground platforms - from bare optics to delivered payload. 

·            Direct exposure to optical design, manufacturing and testing

·            A founding-stage role with visible ownership of the optical lab. 

To Apply

Apply via LinkedIn, or send your CV and a short note on optical systems you have personally aligned or tested to career@eonspacelabs. com with subject line: "Application - Optical Engineer"

data.title: Senior DFT Engineer
data.description:
Role: Senior DFT Engineer

Function: Design for Test (DFT) / Semiconductor Engineering

Location: Bangalore / Malaysia / Japan / Chennai

Type: Full-time

Industry: Semiconductors, Information Technology & Services

About Company

A Bangalore-based technology consulting firm specialising in Semiconductor ASIC Design Services and Embedded Software Development. Founded by industry veterans with over 100 years of combined semiconductor experience. 

The company guides projects from initial specifications all the way to first-pass silicon success. It operates across six verticals: Design & Verification, Physical Design & SignOff, DFT, FPGA Design, Analog & Analog Layout, and Embedded Software. 

A close-knit team of 67, with deep multi-foundry capabilities and advanced node expertise from 180nm to 3nm. 

Position Overview

This role sits at the heart of the company's DFT vertical, responsible for defining and implementing test architectures that ensure high fault coverage across complex SoC and ASIC designs. The engineer will own the full DFT flow - from scan insertion and ATPG pattern development through GLS debug and post-silicon bring-up support - working across design, verification, and physical design teams to accelerate client time-to-market. 

Role & Responsibilities

- Define and implement DFT architecture for SoC/ASIC designs, including scan insertion and scan chain stitching
 - Develop and validate ATPG patterns for stuck-at, transition, bridge, and path delay fault models
 - Implement and verify MBIST and memory repair solutions
 - Perform DFT rule checks (DRC) and drive resolution of violations
 - Support JTAG/boundary scan (IEEE 1149. 1) implementation and verification
 - Run and debug Gate Level Simulations (GLS) for DFT pattern validation
 - Analyse and improve test coverage, pattern count, and test time; support post-silicon bring-up and failure analysis
 - Create and maintain DFT documentation, methodology guides, and best-practice flows

Must Have Criteria

- 7+ years of hands-on DFT experience on SoC/ASIC designs
 - Proven experience with scan insertion, scan chain stitching, and ATPG pattern generation (stuck-at, transition, bridge, path delay)
 - Experience implementing and verifying MBIST and memory repair solutions
 - Proficiency in DFT rule checks (DRC) and violation debug
 - Experience with JTAG/boundary scan and IEEE 1149. 1 implementation
 - Hands-on experience running and debugging Gate Level Simulations (GLS) for DFT patterns
 - Exposure to advanced process nodes and industry-standard EDA tools for DFT

Nice to Have

- Experience with post-silicon bring-up and silicon failure analysis
 - Familiarity with multi-foundry design environments
 - Exposure to advanced nodes (7nm and below)
 - Experience authoring DFT methodology documentation and best-practice flows

What We Offer

- Opportunity to work on complex SoC/ASIC projects spanning 180nm to 3nm process nodes
 - Close collaboration with industry veterans carrying 100+ years of combined semiconductor expertise
 - Skill development through diverse, client-driven semiconductor engagements
 - Stable, engineering-first culture in a focused 67-person firm

data.title: Quality Specialist
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Quality Specialist based in India. 

As a Quality Specialist, you will play a vital role in maintaining quality standards, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement across healthcare and pharmaceutical-related operations. You will support the implementation and management of quality management systems, ensuring compliance with applicable Good Practice (GxP) guidelines and regulatory requirements. Your responsibilities will include managing deviations, quality events, corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and change control activities. You will also contribute to audit readiness, regulatory inspections, quality reporting, and root cause investigations to strengthen operational effectiveness. For medical information activities, you may evaluate telephone interactions and case reports to ensure adherence to established quality standards. This role offers the opportunity to collaborate with cross-functional teams and clients in a quality-focused environment that values precision, accountability, and continuous learning. You will help safeguard process integrity while supporting the delivery of reliable, high-quality services. 

Accountabilities

- Maintain awareness of applicable GxP guidelines and regulatory requirements, ensuring that quality processes and service delivery activities remain compliant with established standards. 
 - Support and coordinate electronic Quality Management System (eQMS) activities, including change control, deviations, quality events, CAPAs, and effectiveness checks. 
 - Develop, recommend, monitor, and document deviations, quality events, and corrective and preventive actions, ensuring appropriate root cause analysis and effective resolution. 
 - Review, approve, and communicate root cause investigation findings and CAPA plans to relevant stakeholders, ensuring clear documentation and accountability. 
 - Conduct effectiveness checks to verify that corrective and preventive actions have addressed identified issues and reduced the likelihood of recurrence. 
 - Participate in GxP change management activities, including risk and impact assessments, change plan reviews and approvals, implementation monitoring, and tracking actions through completion. 
 - Coordinate client audits and regulatory inspections, including preparing agendas, organizing required documentation, arranging logistics, and ensuring relevant subject matter experts are available. 
 - Coordinate audit-related CAPA responses, collaborating with internal stakeholders to prepare accurate, comprehensive, and timely responses. 
 - Maintain audit and inspection records in the eQMS, ensuring that documentation is complete, accurate, appropriately stored, and tracked through closure. 
 - Generate quality reports and analyze data related to deviations, quality events, CAPAs, and key performance indicators to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement. 
 - Investigate quality issues, identify root causes, and recommend improvements to quality systems, procedures, and operational processes. 
 - For medical information quality assurance activities, retrospectively evaluate telephone interactions and case reports to verify compliance with applicable procedures and quality standards. 
 - Collaborate with internal teams, quality stakeholders, and clients to support continuous improvement, strengthen compliance, and maintain high service quality. 
 - Undertake additional quality-related responsibilities as needed to support evolving business and operational requirements. 

Requirements

- A bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience in a suitable discipline is required. 
 - At least 2 years of professional experience in a Quality Assurance role. 
 - Working knowledge of GxP quality management systems and the regulatory requirements applicable to quality-related activities. 
 - Experience with quality management processes, including deviations, quality events, CAPAs, effectiveness checks, and change control, is preferred. 
 - Familiarity with electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS), including quality record management, documentation, reporting, and data analysis. 
 - Strong understanding of root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action planning, risk assessment, and continuous improvement methodologies. 
 - Excellent organizational, prioritization, project management, and multitasking skills, with the ability to manage several activities and deadlines simultaneously. 
 - Exceptional attention to detail and a strong commitment to accuracy, documentation quality, and regulatory compliance. 
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. 
 - Fluency in written and spoken English, with strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. 
 - Ability to build effective professional relationships with clients, internal teams, management, and cross-functional stakeholders. 
 - Strong customer service skills and a collaborative approach to resolving quality issues and supporting internal and external stakeholders. 
 - Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while remaining proactive, flexible, and responsive to changing priorities. 
 - A professional attitude, openness to change, and the ability to contribute positively to a diverse, collaborative, and quality-driven environment. 
 - Preferred: Experience conducting Medical Information Quality Assurance reviews, particularly evaluating recorded telephone calls and case reports in a call center environment. 

Benefits

- Flexible working arrangements: Remote working opportunities in India, with potential hybrid arrangements for employees located within a reasonable commuting distance of an office, as agreed with their manager. 
 - Professional development: Opportunities to strengthen expertise in quality assurance, GxP compliance, quality management systems, and regulatory processes. 
 - Meaningful contribution: The opportunity to support quality and compliance activities that contribute to reliable healthcare and pharmaceutical services. 
 - Collaborative environment: Opportunities to work with cross-functional teams, subject matter experts, and clients on quality improvement initiatives. 
 - Continuous learning: Exposure to audits, regulatory inspections, quality investigations, and process improvement activities. 
 - Inclusive workplace: A commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and creating an environment where employees can contribute authentically and develop their skills.

data.title: Chief Technology Officer - Consumer
data.description:
GlobalData is a productivity and intelligence platform that empowers leaders to act decisively in a world of complexity and change. 

By uniting proprietary data, human expertise, and purpose-built AI into a single, connected platform, we help organizations see what's coming, move faster, and lead with confidence. 

Our solutions are used by over 5, 000 organizations across the world's largest industries, delivering tailored intelligence that supports strategic planning, innovation, risk management, and sustainable growth. 

Data that goes deeper

Proprietary coverage of 95% of global GDP, synthesized in real time from internal and external sources, aligned under a single business taxonomy - giving you earlier insight, unified context, and decisions you can trust. 

Experts who turn insight into impact

Human insights that AI alone can't replicate, from industry specialists and strategic advisors, embedded in your workflows to decode complexity and guide high-value action. 

AI that moves smarter & faster

AI that doesn't just think, but acts - forecasting market moves, surfacing answers in seconds, and freeing your teams to focus on execution when timing matters most. 

Workflow solutions

Together, our six solutions turn intelligence into action, helping every team make smarter, faster decisions. Each solution focuses on the decisions that matter most, driving measurable impact. 

About the Role

We are looking for an exceptional Chief Technology Officer for GlobalData's Consumer Division and provide senior leadership for our Bangalore technology organization. 

This is a critical leadership role with responsibility for the technology strategy, engineering organization and AI agenda supporting our Consumer business. The CTO will partner closely with business teams including central development teams and product leadership to shape the next generation of GlobalData's Consumer products, using our proprietary data, research and rapidly evolving AI capabilities to create differentiated customer experiences. 

In parallel, the CTO will lead and develop our Bangalore technology organization, establishing it as a strategic center for engineering, data and AI excellence within GlobalData. 

What we are looking for: 

The CTO will be accountable for: 

• Technology Strategy: Define and execute the technology vision and roadmap for the Consumer business, ensuring technology investment is closely aligned with product strategy, customer needs and commercial growth. 

• Product & Engineering: Lead the engineering organisation across Software Engineering, Data Engineering, AI/ML, QA, DevOps and Platform Engineering, creating a culture of technical excellence, ownership, pace and innovation. 

• AI & Data: Drive the adoption of Generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning and modern data architectures across the Consumer portfolio, turning GlobalData's proprietary data and expertise into differentiated products and customer experiences. 

• Architecture & Platforms: Evolve our technology architecture to deliver scalable, secure and resilient platforms while simplifying the technology estate and accelerating product development. 

• Bangalore Leadership: Build and develop a high-performing technology organisation in Bangalore, attracting exceptional talent and developing the next generation of technology leaders. 

• Execution & Operational Excellence: Improve engineering productivity, delivery predictability, platform reliability and cloud efficiency while maintaining high standards of security and governance. 

• Executive & Customer Leadership: Act as the senior technology voice for Consumer, partnering with senior leadership and engaging directly with strategic customers where technology and AI are central to the relationship. 

What we are looking for: 

We are looking for a technology leader who combines strategic thinking, deep technical credibility, strong product instincts and outstanding organisational leadership. 

The successful candidate will bring: 

• Significant senior technology leadership experience in a SaaS, data, information services, AI or technology product business. 

• A track record of building and scaling high-performing engineering organisations and leadership teams. 

• Experience owning technology strategy for customer-facing products and platforms. 

• Strong understanding of AI/ML, Generative AI, modern data platforms and cloudnative architectures. 

• Experience modernising complex technology environments while continuing to deliver ambitious product roadmaps. 

• Strong commercial judgement and the ability to connect technology decisions to customer value and business outcomes. 

• Experience leading globally distributed teams, ideally including significant technology organisations in India. 

• The executive presence to operate with senior business leaders and customers, combined with sufficient technical depth to challenge architecture and engineering decisions. 

Our current environment includes Python, AWS, React/JavaScript, large-scale data pipelines, DevOps and platform engineering, alongside growing capabilities in LLMs, RAG, NLP, Generative AI and agentic AI. Experience with every technology is not required; architectural judgement and the ability to build exceptional technology organisations matter more. 

What Success Looks Like

The CTO will establish a clear technology and AI strategy for Consumer Divison, strengthen our engineering leadership and operating model, and materially increase the speed at which we can turn ideas, data and AI capabilities into valuable customer products. 

Over time, we expect the CTO to create a more scalable and coherent technology platform, embed AI meaningfully across the Consumer portfolio, improve engineering quality and velocity, and establish Bangalore as a strategic centre of technology excellence for GlobalData. 

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to lead technology for a strategically important GlobalData business at a point where AI is fundamentally changing how data and intelligence products are created and consumed. 

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to shape that transformation: defining the technology strategy, building the organization and platforms behind it, and creating the next generation of AI-powered Consumer intelligence products. 

Commitment to D&I and EEO: 

We believe strongly in the value of diversity and creating supportive, inclusive environments where our colleagues can succeed. As such, GlobalData is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. GlobalData is determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favorable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, or is disadvantaged by conditions or requirements which cannot be shown to be justifiable.

data.description:
. NET Application Reliability

· Read, debug, and contribute to production C#/. NET code to diagnose and fix app-level reliability issues. 

· Identify and resolve memory leaks, thread pool exhaustion, and GC pressure before they manifest as incidents. 

· Partner with application engineers to embed reliability into new feature design and deployment practices. 

· Instrument . NET services with distributed tracing and structured logging to surface runtime anomalies early. 

AWS Compute & Infrastructure

· Operate and optimize EC2 Auto Scaling, ECS Fargate, and Lambda workloads - with clear judgment on when each is the right fit. 

· Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code using CloudFormation or CDK for consistent, reproducible environments. 

· Automate operational tasks, deployment pipelines, and disaster recovery procedures. 

· Continuously reduce toil through tooling and automation, freeing the team for higher-impact engineering work. 

RDS SQL Server Operations

· Manage RDS SQL Server deployments including Multi-AZ failover configuration and read replica setup. 

· Operate backup and point-in-time recovery (PITR) processes and validate restore procedures regularly. 

· Diagnose and resolve performance issues: slow queries, missing indexes, and blocking chains. 

· Capacity plan and scale database infrastructure to support transaction volume growth. 

Observability & Monitoring

· Build and maintain observability stacks using CloudWatch metrics, log insights, and alarms; AWS X-Ray for distributed tracing. 

· Own service health dashboards, SLOs/SLIs, and drive data-driven reliability improvements. 

· Design alerts that surface signal - not noise - and ensure on-call responders have the context to act quickly. 

· Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) on incidents and lead blameless post-mortems to capture lessons and prevent recurrence. 

Networking & Security

· Design and maintain secure AWS network topologies: VPCs, subnets, security groups, and NACLs. 

· Configure and manage ALB/NLB routing, Route 53 DNS, and TLS certificate lifecycle via ACM. 

· Author and review least-privilege IAM policies; audit roles and resource-based policies for over-permissioning. 

· Support compliance and security controls relevant to a PCI-regulated payments environment. 

Incident Response & On-Call

· Participate in on-call rotation to respond to production incidents and drive swift resolution. 

· Define and track error budgets; use them to balance velocity and reliability investment. 

· Communicate status updates clearly during incidents and coordinate cross-functional response. 

· Maintain and improve runbooks, escalation paths, and on-call health over time. 

Cross-Functional Partnership

· Collaborate with platform engineering teams on architecture decisions and scalability requirements. 

· Share observability and reliability best practices with application teams. 

· Mentor engineers on SRE principles and operational excellence. 

· 7+ years in SRE, DevOps, platform engineering, or a systems-focused software engineering role. 

· C#/. NET engineering ability - can read, debug, and contribute to production code; experience diagnosing memory leaks, thread exhaustion, and GC pressure. 

· AWS compute fluency: hands-on depth across EC2 Auto Scaling, ECS Fargate, and Lambda, with informed opinions on when to use each. 

· RDS SQL Server operational experience: Multi-AZ failover, read replicas, backup/PITR, slow query analysis, and blocking chain resolution. 

· Native AWS observability proficiency: CloudWatch (metrics, logs, alarms), X-Ray, and infrastructure-as-code via CloudFormation or CDK. 

· AWS networking and security competence: VPCs, security groups, ALB/NLB, Route 53, TLS/ACM, and least-privilege IAM. 

· SLO discipline: experience defining SLIs/SLOs against real metrics, running blameless postmortems, and carrying an on-call pager.

data.title: Software Engineer I - Product / Full-Stack
data.description:
Location: Jayanagar, Bengaluru - in office

Type: Full-time

Experience: 0-1 years; strong fresh graduates and builders are welcome

Compensation: the posted range is fixed pay; ESOPs come over and above. 

About Kulfi

Kulfi is where couples in India spend time together, even when they can't be in the same place. 

About 100 million unmarried Indian couples don't get to be together most nights. Different cities, different homes, parents around. A phone is all they have. So they join a class just to be near each other, or stay on a one-way call, or watch a movie over video. They do all this for love, and nothing was built for them. 

We are building that. Kulfi is a digital experiences app for couples, and close to a million people already use it. We did not get here by spending. Daily users grew 4x in 30 days this summer. We added 100, 000 users in the first 20 days of August without paying for a single ad. 80% of all play happens between 9pm and midnight. That is bedtime, and we own it. We are backed by South Park Commons and by founders and CEOs from Swiggy, Mosaic Wellness, Snitch and Moonshot. 

Next is an AI personalization engine for games. Every couple gets a new game every day, made for them on the spot from what they like. Our team already ships a new game in about two days. No couple should run out of things to do together. 

India has more couples than any other country. We want every one of them on Kulfi. 

We are a small, high-intensity team. Your work will reach real users quickly, and you will be expected to notice what is broken-not wait for someone else to notice it for you. 

The role

You will build product features end to end across our Flutter app, web surfaces, backend APIs, and data. We do not need you to know every part on day one. We need evidence that you learn quickly, finish what you start, care about the user experience, and understand the code you ship. 

What you will do

- Build and ship small product features across app/web, API, and data layers. 
 - Turn product/design intent into complete user flows, including loading, empty, error, and retry states. 
 - Debug issues across client, network, backend, and data-not stop at the first layer. 
 - Write tests, review your own diff, and verify behavior before handoff. 
 - Read user feedback and product metrics to understand whether a release worked. 
 - Use AI coding tools to move faster while remaining responsible for every line you ship. 
 - Ask precise questions, communicate blockers early, and learn from direct feedback. 

What we are looking for

- You have built and shipped at least one real software project, internship deliverable, freelance product, or meaningful open-source contribution. 
 - You can write readable code and reason through bugs without blindly relying on autocomplete or AI. 
 - You have worked across at least two layers: mobile/web, backend/API, database, or deployment. 
 - You care about product details and notice when a technically correct feature creates a bad user experience. 
 - You move quickly, but you test your work and own mistakes. 
 - You can explain your contribution, trade-offs, and what you would improve next. 
 - You are comfortable working in person in Jayanagar, Bengaluru. A computer-science degree is not required. Evidence of building matters more than credentials. 

Useful, not mandatory

- Flutter/Dart and mobile fundamentals. 
 - State management such as BLoC or Riverpod. 
 - REST APIs, SQL, caching, queues, or real-time systems. 
 - Experience with Node. js, Go, Python, Java, or another production backend language. 
 - CI/CD, cloud deployment, monitoring, or app-store releases. 
 - Thoughtful use of Claude Code, Codex, or similar tools. 

What success looks like

Within three months, you can own a scoped feature from problem statement to release, handle the obvious failure states, write useful tests, review your own work, and explain what user signal or metric should improve. 

Interview process

- Short application review based on shipped work. 
 - 15-20 minute screening call. 
 - 75-minute practical product-engineering interview combining a project deep dive, live task, self-review, changed requirement, and product/UX discussion. 
 - 30-minute founder and mutual-expectations conversation. 

We allow AI tools during the practical exercise. You must disclose how you used them and be able to explain and defend the final code. 

Please answer the application questions yourself. Clear and specific beats polished and generic.

data.title: Engineering Manager, Automation Intelligence
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Engineering Manager, Automation Intelligence based in India. 

Lead the development of an innovative intelligence platform designed to distinguish legitimate AI agents and automated traffic from malicious bots and other online threats. In this role, you will manage a high-impact engineering team responsible for delivering advanced detection capabilities, classification systems, and APIs that help enterprises navigate an increasingly automated internet. You will guide the product from beta through general availability and commercial launch, ensuring exceptional detection accuracy, reliability, and scalability. Combining strategic leadership with strong technical judgment, you will establish quality-driven engineering practices and champion an AI-native development model powered by coding agents and automated reviews. You will also build a high-performing team with the autonomy to innovate, deliver independently, and continuously improve. This fully remote opportunity offers direct collaboration with engineering leadership and the chance to shape both a strategically important product and the future of software engineering practices. 

Accountabilities

- Product Delivery & Launch Readiness: Own the engineering roadmap from beta through general availability and standalone commercial launch, partnering with product management on requirements, estimates, prioritization, delivery sequencing, and launch-readiness criteria. 
 - Service Reliability & Performance: Define and validate the service's operational limits, including throughput, latency, rate limiting, availability targets, and service-level objectives (SLOs), ensuring the platform meets production requirements. 
 - Detection Quality & Accuracy: Establish a continuous detection quality framework using representative test datasets, automated false-positive and false-negative testing, regression suites, and monitoring to maintain and improve detection performance. 
 - Automation Coverage & Classification: Guide detection capabilities for AI agents, assistants, stealth automation, headless browsers, and other emerging frameworks. Evolve classification systems to provide detailed context, confidence levels, identity verification status, and reason codes. 
 - Safe Deployment & Continuous Improvement: Manage staged rollouts of detection updates using feature flags, rollback procedures, and measurable release criteria. Incorporate customer feedback and reported detection errors into prioritized engineering improvements. 
 - Team Leadership & Development: Lead, coach, and develop a small team of senior engineers, manage recruitment as the team grows, and establish clear ownership, accountability, and opportunities for professional growth. 
 - Engineering Standards & Operational Excellence: Introduce effective engineering practices, including technical specifications, code review standards, repository ownership, and performance benchmarks covering delivery speed, throughput, predictability, failure rates, and recovery time. 
 - Cross-Team Collaboration: Establish effective working agreements with adjacent engineering teams, clarify shared responsibilities, and progressively reduce dependencies that prevent independent development and deployment. 
 - AI-Native Engineering Leadership: Lead an agent-first development workflow in which AI tools support specification, coding, review, and security checks, with appropriate human oversight for critical changes. Maintain and improve the tools, instructions, and review frameworks that enable this approach. 
 - Measurement & Knowledge Sharing: Evaluate the effectiveness of AI-assisted development against established engineering baselines, conduct regular performance reviews, and document lessons learned to inform broader engineering practices. 
 - API Design & Integration Standards: Ensure all product interfaces follow a contract-first approach, with OpenAPI specifications, automated breaking-change detection, generated documentation and SDKs, and APIs that are accessible to both developers and AI agents. 
 - Observability & Executive Communication: Own service observability through logs, metrics, traces, and SLOs. Communicate engineering progress, technical trade-offs, detection quality, and launch readiness clearly to leadership, product partners, and customer-facing teams. 

Requirements

- Engineering Management Experience: At least three years of experience managing software engineers, ideally including senior and staff-level individual contributors, with a proven track record of delivering complete products through launch. 
 - Strong Technical Foundation: At least eight years of software engineering experience before or alongside management. Ability to critically assess technical designs and pull requests, engage in architectural discussions, and make sound technical decisions when trade-offs arise. 
 - Relevant Domain Expertise: Strong experience in at least one of the following areas: bot detection or management, fraud and abuse prevention, web security, browser or client-side engineering, or high-volume API services. Understanding of adversarial environments, where automated threats continually evolve, is particularly valuable. 
 - Quality-Driven Engineering: Experience building or operating measurement-driven engineering processes, including test datasets, precision and recall metrics, false-positive and false-negative tracking, regression testing, monitoring, and service-level objectives. 
 - Hands-On AI Coding Experience: Regular use of AI coding agents and a practical understanding of their strengths, limitations, and appropriate application in software development workflows. 
 - Product & Cross-Functional Leadership: Demonstrated ability to collaborate closely with product managers, researchers, and customer-facing teams, making dependencies, priorities, and technical trade-offs explicit. 
 - Communication & Decision-Making: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document decisions and their rationale and explain technical performance, detection quality, and release readiness to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. 
 - Team Building & Autonomy: Ability to develop high-performing engineering teams, establish clear ownership structures, recruit effectively, and create an environment where experienced engineers can work independently and deliver consistently. 
 - Preferred Bot Detection & Security Experience: Direct experience with bot detection, bot management, anti-automation products, content delivery networks (CDNs), web application firewalls (WAFs), fraud prevention, or security platforms. 
 - Preferred AI Agent Knowledge: Familiarity with AI agent ecosystems, agent frameworks, verified-agent protocols, and how autonomous agents interact with websites and APIs. 
 - Preferred Browser & Automation Expertise: Understanding of browser internals, headless browsers, automation frameworks, and techniques used to detect or evade automated activity. 
 - Preferred API & Platform Experience: Experience operating API-first products with public OpenAPI specifications, software development kits (SDKs), and Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar agent-facing interfaces. 
 - Preferred Organizational Experience: Experience establishing a new engineering team from an existing organization, separating codebases, defining ownership boundaries, and maintaining productive relationships between teams. 
 - Preferred Business Environment: Background in a high-growth SaaS company serving enterprise customers. 

Benefits

- Fully Remote Work: Join a globally distributed, remote-first organization, subject to country eligibility and local employment requirements. 
 - Strategic Leadership Opportunity: Report directly to the VP of Engineering and lead a strategically important product initiative with clear objectives and significant decision-making autonomy. 
 - Product Ownership & Impact: Guide an emerging product from beta to commercial launch, with dedicated product management support and a clear path to market. 
 - Experienced Engineering Team: Lead an established group of senior engineers, with plans to expand the team and recruit additional specialized talent. 
 - Innovation & Technical Leadership: Help establish an AI-native engineering model, with the opportunity to influence development standards and practices across the wider engineering organization. 
 - Professional Growth: Develop expertise in AI agent detection, online fraud prevention, high-volume services, and advanced engineering management. 
 - Inclusive Work Environment: Join a workplace that values diverse perspectives, professional respect, and equal opportunity. 
 - Important Employment Considerations: The original posting states that certain countries are excluded for regulatory and security reasons and that visa sponsorship is not available. India-based eligibility, compensation, and contractual arrangements should be confirmed during recruitment. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

About The Role

- May propose changes in design or formulation to improve system and/or process reliability. 
 - Builds and conducts dry running of basic qualification test set ups. 
 - sCompiles and analyzes performance reports and process control statistics; investigates and analyzes relevant variables potentially affecting product performance and processes. 
 - Liaises closely with other project team members in the areas such as stress, manufacturing, sourcing and configuration, with respect to new designs or design changes. 

Key Responsibilities

Reliability Modeling & Prediction

- Perform reliability predictions for electronic assemblies and systems using industry-standard methodologies. 
 - Calculate: 
 - MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures)
 - Failure Rate (FIT)
 - Product Useful Life
 - Service Life Estimates
 - Reliability Growth Metrics
 - Reliability Block Diagrams (RBD)
 - Mission Reliability
 - Conduct reliability analysis using: 
 - Telcordia SR-332
 - MIL-HDBK-217F
 - IEC 61709
 - FIDES methodologies
 - Perform component-level and assembly-level reliability assessments
System-Level Reliability Analysis

- Develop and maintain system-level reliability models for complete products and platforms. 
 - Create reliability block diagrams - RBDs - for system architecture analysis. 
 - Evaluate reliability of complete systems considering: 
 - PCB assemblies
 - Sensors
 - Power supplies
 - Communication modules
 - Displays
 - Relays/contactors
 - Motors/fans
 - Connectors and harnesses
 - Mechanical/electromechanical interfaces
 - Analyze series, parallel, redundant, standby, and fail-safe architectures. 
 - Calculate system reliability, availability, maintainability, and probability of failure over mission time. 
 - Assess single-point failures and critical reliability contributors at system level. 
 - Support architecture trade-off studies to improve system robustness, redundancy, serviceability, and product life. 
 - Work with hardware, firmware, systems, mechanical, quality, compliance, and field teams to translate reliability risks into design actions
Product Lifetime & Wear-Out Analysis

- Estimate product useful life and service life based on operating profiles and field usage conditions. 
 - Perform lifetime calculations for wear-out-sensitive components such as: 
 - Electrolytic capacitors
 - Relays
 - Power semiconductors
 - Fans
 - Connectors
 - Batteries
 - Displays
 - Electromechanical parts
 - Apply appropriate models such as Arrhenius, Weibull, Coffin-Manson, thermal acceleration, voltage derating, and duty-cycle-based life models. 
 - Evaluate environmental impact including temperature, humidity, vibration, cycling, load profile, and power-on hours. 
 - Recommend design margins, derating guidelines, and component selection improvements
Field Data Analytics

- Analyze warranty claims, field returns, service records, and customer failure data. 
 - Develop reliability dashboards and reliability KPIs. 
 - Identify dominant failure modes and reliability trends. 
 - Establish failure-rate distributions and reliability growth plans. 
 - Generate actionable recommendations to improve product robustness. 

Reliability Testing & Validation

- Define reliability validation plans for new product development and sustaining programs. 
 - Support HALT, HASS, accelerated life testing, temperature cycling, humidity testing, vibration testing, power cycling, and environmental stress testing. 
 - Correlate lab test results with predicted reliability and actual field performance. 
 - Define sample size, test duration, confidence level, and acceptance criteria for reliability demonstration tests. 
 - Support design verification and product qualification from a reliability perspective

Failure Analysis & Root Cause Investigation

- Support root cause investigations involving: 
 - Field failures
 - Manufacturing defects
 - Component failures
 - Early-life failures
 - Perform statistical analysis of failures. 
 - Work with hardware, firmware, component engineering, quality, manufacturing, and suppliers to implement corrective actions. 
Reliability Tools & Data Management

- Utilize reliability prediction software and databases for analysis and reporting. Expertise in Relex, Reliasoft, Minitab, ITEM tool suite
 - Maintain reliability calculation models, assumptions, and documentation. 
 - Develop automated reliability reporting tools and dashboards. 
 - Support design reviews with quantitative reliability assessments

University Degree or equivalent

data.title: Solution Test Engineer
data.description:
Join our Team

About the Opportunity: 

At Ericsson, we're shaping the future of connectivity through cutting-edge 5G and cloud-native technologies. We're looking for a Solution Test Engineer to lead end-to-end testing, system integration, automation, and validation of Ericsson Private 5G solutions ( BEWS - Private Networks). In this role, you'll work across 5G Core, RAN, Kubernetes, and cloud-native platforms, drive quality through automation and CI/CD, troubleshoot complex network issues, and collaborate with global teams to deliver world-class telecom solutions. 

What You Will Do

- Test Design & Execution: Design and execute detailed E2E system test plans for Ericsson Private 5G (EP5G) solutions, ensuring full coverage of 3GPP features and customer use cases. 
 - System Integration: Integrate and validate 5G components, including Cloud-Native Core (cn5GC), RAN, and Management/Orchestration platforms, ensuring seamless interoperability. 
 - Advanced Validation: Own the E2E validation for specific feature sets across performance, scaling, and stability, utilizing CI/CD pipelines for automated regression. 
 - Protocol Debugging: Perform deep-dive troubleshooting of complex call flows using tools like Wireshark/QXDM to analyze NAS/AS signaling and interfaces (N1, N2, N3, etc. ). 
 - Automation Development: Develop and maintain automated test scripts within a Python/Robot Framework environment to increase test velocity and reliability. 
 - Stability & Performance Testing: Design and run soak tests, stress tests, and load models to identify memory leaks and system bottlenecks before deployment. 
 - Mentorship: Provide technical guidance to junior engineers, conduct peer reviews of test cases, and contribute to the team's internal knowledge base. 

Skills You Bring

Bachelor's/Master's in CS, EE, or related field with 6-8 years of experience in Telecom/Network testing. 

5G/4G Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of 3GPP architectures and protocols (NGAP, S1AP, RRC, HTTP/2). Ability to analyze multi-interface traces to isolate faults. 

Cloud-Native Skills: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (K8s), Docker, and Helm. Understanding of K8s networking (Services, Load Balancers, and CNI basics) is essential. 

Networking Foundations: Solid knowledge of L2/L3 networking, including IPV4/V6, VLANs, Routing, and familiarity with OSPF/BGP. 

Automation Proficiency: Strong Python scripting skills and experience with Robot Framework (or similar) to automate complex system-level scenarios. 

System Validation Expertise: Proven ability to design test cases for performance (throughput/latency), scaling, and stability (soak/reliability). 

Infrastructure & Tools: Proficiency in Linux/Unix environments. Experience with industry tools such as Spirent (Landslide), Keysight, or Viavi. 

"All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification. "

80% of the workers across the globe are Deskless. These are the people who keep our lights on and gas flowing, build roads and bridges, run our manufacturing factories, ensure that we get healthcare service, and provide us with reliable phone and internet connectivity. As entrepreneurs, have we considered solving their problems and making them more productive?

Zinier is a company on a mission to empower frontline workers - and the people supporting them - to achieve greater things for themselves and the world around them. With the majority of workers worldwide being deskless, Zinier recognizes the need for Technology Equity to improve the lives and productivity of these workers who keep the world up and running.

- Jenkins Administration: Administer, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Jenkins environments, including jobs, pipelines, plugins, credentials, agents/nodes, and build execution. 
 - CI/CD Pipeline Management: Develop, optimize, and maintain Jenkins pipelines using Jenkinsfiles and Groovy scripting. Ensure reliable pipeline execution and efficient build and deployment workflows. 
 - GitLab-Jenkins Integration: Configure and maintain GitLab integrations with Jenkins, enabling automated pipeline triggers through webhooks and repository events. 
 - Webhook Integration & Routing: Configure and troubleshoot webhook delivery from GitLab to multiple downstream Jenkins pipelines. Develop or maintain intermediary services such as RelayProxy, or configure suitable tunneling and routing tools where required. 
 - Automation & Infrastructure as Code: Develop and maintain Terraform configurations to automate repository-related setup and configuration migration from Gerrit to GitLab. 
 - API-Based Automation: Use GitLab REST APIs and scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or Go to automate configurations, validate migrations, and reduce repetitive manual work. 
 - Bulk Repository Configuration: Execute and validate automated configuration changes across 40+ repositories, improving operational efficiency and reducing manual intervention. 
 - Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Diagnose Jenkins build failures, webhook delivery issues, plugin conflicts, agent connectivity problems, authentication errors, and CI/CD integration bottlenecks. 
 - Documentation & Operational Support: Maintain technical documentation, automation scripts, and troubleshooting procedures while ensuring reliable day-to-day CI/CD operations. 

Requirements

Required Qualifications

- 6-9 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, CI/CD engineering, build and release automation, or Jenkins administration. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in Jenkins administration, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting in production environments. 
 - Experience creating and maintaining Jenkins pipelines using Jenkinsfiles and Groovy. 
 - Strong understanding of Jenkins architecture, controller-agent configuration, plugins, credentials management, build execution, and pipeline security. 
 - Practical experience integrating Jenkins with GitLab using webhooks, repository events, APIs, and authentication mechanisms. 
 - Experience troubleshooting pipeline triggers, failed builds, webhook delivery, and connectivity issues. 
 - Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language, preferably Python, Bash, or Go. 
 - Working knowledge of GitLab REST APIs and Git-based repository management. 
 - Exposure to Terraform and Infrastructure as Code for configuration automation. 
 - Understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, network routing, reverse proxies, webhook payloads, and request/response handling. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced engineering environment. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience migrating CI/CD integrations or repository configurations from Gerrit to GitLab. 
 - Experience developing custom webhook relay or proxy services to route events to multiple Jenkins pipelines. 
 - Familiarity with Docker, Linux administration, Git, and CI/CD security best practices. 
 - Experience managing Jenkins at scale across multiple repositories, teams, or build agents. 
 - Experience automating repetitive administrative tasks through APIs and Infrastructure as Code. 

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a Jenkins-first engineer who can administer, optimize, integrate, and troubleshoot CI/CD systems hands-on. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with Jenkins pipelines and GitLab integrations, writing automation scripts, and using Terraform where required. 

Candidates with strong Jenkins administration and pipeline expertise, supported by practical GitLab integration and automation experience, will be preferred over candidates whose experience is limited to general DevOps operations.

data.description:
Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, including 3+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML, LLM application development, Generative AI, platform architecture, solution architecture, or technical product development. 

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead to drive the development and evolution of the Fluid AIQ Platform and lead AI-powered application development for upcoming client projects. 

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience building production-ready applications using LLMs, AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool/function calling, workflow orchestration, and modern AI frameworks. 

This role goes beyond traditional chatbot development, focusing on building intelligent agentic applications capable of reasoning, planning, interacting with enterprise systems, using tools, and operating within defined guardrails. 

The position combines AI architecture, hands-on engineering, technical leadership, and product commercialization. You will help transform platform capabilities into modular commercial offerings that can be deployed independently and expanded based on client requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Agentic AI Architecture & Platform Development

- Design scalable architectures for agentic AI applications, including single-agent and multi-agent systems. 
 - Define agent orchestration, tool usage, memory, state management, and workflow patterns. 
 - Establish reusable reference architectures, implementation guides, client onboarding playbooks, and engineering standards. 
 - Evaluate AI technologies, models, frameworks, and infrastructure based on business and technical requirements. 
 - Contribute to the evolution and architecture of the Fluid AIQ Platform. 

2. AI Application Development

- Build production-ready applications using AI agents, LLMs, RAG, and workflow automation. 
 - Implement tool/function calling, planning and reasoning workflows, and human-in-the-loop processes. 
 - Develop integrations with enterprise APIs, business applications, and external systems. 
 - Implement MCP Server/Client integrations and autonomous or semi-autonomous workflows. 
 - Build AI-powered decision-support solutions and reusable platform components. 

3. LLM & Generative AI Engineering

- Work with LLM providers and models, including OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, and open-source or local models. 
 - Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, context management, function calling, and model fallback strategies. 
 - Evaluate and benchmark models based on cost, performance, latency, privacy, and business use cases. 
 - Ensure flexibility in model and framework selection without unnecessary platform dependency on a single provider. 

4. Product Leadership & Commercialization

- Take technical and product ownership of Fluid platform components and client AI programs. 
 - Help package platform capabilities into independent, commercially viable modules. 
 - Support the commercialization of reusable platform capabilities and technical IP. 
 - Develop sales-enablement materials and implementation guidance. 
 - Track and report platform health, adoption, and delivery metrics to leadership. 

5. AI Safety, Reliability & Governance

- Implement guardrails and validation mechanisms to reduce hallucinations, incorrect tool usage, unauthorized actions, and unsafe outputs. 
 - Design human-approval workflows where required. 
 - Build reliable agent workflows with error handling, retries, fallback mechanisms, and observability. 
 - Support release management, environment management, service-level objectives, and production support models. 
 - Address security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI requirements. 

6. Technical Leadership & Collaboration

- Lead and mentor architects and engineers working on agentic AI solutions. 
 - Collaborate with architecture, development, and cross-functional teams. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI technologies and build proof of concepts (POCs). 
 - Ensure solutions meet business requirements, quality standards, and delivery timelines. 

Mandatory Technical Skills

Agentic AI & Generative AI

- Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, and agentic AI architectures. 
 - Hands-on experience with RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, context management, and AI evaluation. 
 - Experience with agent orchestration, tool/function calling, multi-agent systems, agent memory and state, and human-in-the-loop workflows. 
 - Understanding of agent guardrails, reliability, and observability. 

Programming & Application Development

- Strong programming skills in at least one of the following: Python or Node. js/TypeScript. 
 - Experience with REST APIs, microservices, authentication and authorization, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, and database integration. 

AI Frameworks & SDKs

- Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI SDK, Anthropic SDK, Claude Agents SDK, or equivalent agent SDKs. 
 - Ability to evaluate and select frameworks based on solution requirements rather than relying on a single technology. 

LLM Integration

- Experience integrating multiple LLM providers, preferably OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Ollama/open-source LLMs. 

Data Engineering & RAG

- Experience with PostgreSQL, vector databases, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or similar technologies. 
 - Knowledge of embedding models, document processing, semantic search, and hybrid search. 
 - Familiarity with knowledge graphs and ontology design, including Neo4j, RDF/OWL, or GraphRAG. 
 - Understanding of multi-tenant data architecture. 

Cloud Platforms

- Strong experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. 

Good-to-Have Skills

- Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. 
 - Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and other AI coding tools. 
 - Ollama and open-source LLMs.

 - Product management experience and experience commercializing consulting IP as licensed software. 
 - Experience replacing or complementing traditional RPA solutions with AI-agent-based approaches. 

What We're Looking For

- A hands-on technical leader who can translate business requirements into scalable agentic AI solutions. 
 - Someone who can combine architecture, engineering, platform development, and product thinking. 
 - A professional capable of taking AI capabilities from proof of concept to production-ready and commercially deployable solutions.

Interested in building production-grade Agentic AI platforms and bringing AI-powered products to market? Apply now!
