data.title: Lead OLTP Database Architecture, ETL & SSOT
data.description:
Work Timings: 10: 15 AM - 7: 15 PM

Working Days: 5 Days a Week - We Chose Balance Over the Industry Norm

Work Mode: Work from Office

Location: Marol, Mumbai

Job description

About IIDE

IIDE is India's leading digital business school, offering industry-relevant programs in digital marketing, AI, and business. With a strong focus on experiential learning, we equip students, graduates, and working professionals with the skills required to thrive in today's digital-first world. 

Backed by a community of 500, 000+ learners and 250+ industry experts, IIDE delivers hands-on training, real-world projects, and robust placement support. With campuses in Mumbai and Delhi, we continue to expand our presence across India and globally. 

About the Role

As the Team Lead Data Engineering & Analytics at IIDE, Mumbai, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, and managing the organisation's data infrastructure, application databases, and business intelligence ecosystem. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role that involves leading a team of data engineers and analysts while actively contributing to database architecture, ETL/ELT pipelines, business system integrations, and reporting solutions. 

You will be responsible for establishing a reliable, centralised source of truth across the organisation, ensuring data accuracy, scalability, and accessibility. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will translate business requirements into robust technical solutions that enable data-driven decision-making and operational efficiency. 

You will also explore opportunities to leverage AI, machine learning, and predictive analytics to enhance business intelligence and automation. 

What You'll Do

- Database Architecture & Application Development: Design and develop scalable relational database architectures and schemas from scratch for business applications, including LMS, CRM, ERP, and student management systems. 

Define database entities, relationships, constraints, indexing strategies, and data models using PostgreSQL. 

Ensure transactional integrity, data consistency, security, and optimal performance across application databases. 

Collaborate with backend development teams to align database structures with application logic, APIs, and evolving business requirements. 

Plan and execute database migrations, schema versioning, performance optimisation, and scalability improvements. 

- Data Engineering & System Integration: Design, develop, and maintain robust ETL/ELT pipelines to integrate data from CRM, websites, LMS, marketing platforms, and other business systems. 

Build automated data ingestion, transformation, and processing workflows using SQL, APIs, Python, and relevant integration tools. 

Implement incremental data loading, data validation, deduplication, error handling, retry mechanisms, and pipeline monitoring. 

Establish a centralised analytical data architecture with standardised data definitions and reliable historical records. 

Optimise data pipeline performance, processing efficiency, system reliability, and infrastructure costs. 

- Reporting & Business Intelligence: Consolidate existing reporting systems and establish standardised business metrics across departments. 

Develop reliable reporting datasets, analytical data models, and dashboards using BI platforms such as Looker Studio, Power BI, or Tableau. 

Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into accurate, actionable, and scalable reporting solutions. 

Identify and resolve reporting discrepancies, eliminate manual reporting processes, and improve data accessibility. 

Enable leadership and business teams to make informed decisions using consistent, trustworthy, and timely data. 

- Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management: Lead, mentor, and guide data engineers and analysts while ensuring clear ownership, accountability, and timely project delivery. 

Conduct technical reviews of SQL queries, database designs, data pipelines, and engineering implementations. 

Establish development standards, documentation practices, quality assurance processes, and technical best practices. 

Collaborate with technology, marketing, sales, finance, and academic teams to understand requirements and prioritise data initiatives. 

Remain actively involved in complex technical implementations, troubleshooting, and solution design while managing team responsibilities. 

- AI & Advanced Analytics: Identify opportunities to apply artificial intelligence, machine learning, and advanced analytics to improve business operations. 

Contribute to AI-enabled data solutions, automated insights, and intelligent reporting systems. 

Support predictive analytics initiatives, including lead conversion prediction, forecasting, customer segmentation, and trend analysis. 

Evaluate and implement relevant AI-driven solutions that improve operational efficiency and business decision-making. 

- Additional Duties: Establish and maintain a reliable, centralised data platform that supports seamless integration across business applications. 

Continuously improve data accuracy, database performance, reporting efficiency, and overall system reliability. 

Drive automation initiatives to reduce manual dependencies and enhance data engineering productivity. 

Ensure the team delivers maintainable, scalable, well-documented technical solutions aligned with organisational objectives. 

Perform any other reasonable duties as requested by management, aligned with the broad scope of the position. 

RequirementsWho You Are

- Must-Have: 4 - 8 years of relevant experience in data engineering, database development, analytics engineering, or related technical roles. 

Strong hands-on expertise in SQL and PostgreSQL, including query optimisation and database performance management. 

Proven experience designing relational database architectures for production applications, including ER modelling, normalisation, constraints, indexing, and transaction management. 

Strong understanding of OLTP databases, data integrity, transactional consistency, and backend application integration. 

Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines and integrating multiple data sources. 

Proficiency in data modelling, data warehousing concepts, data transformation, and data quality management. 

Experience developing reporting datasets, consolidating business information, and standardising organisational metrics. 

Previous experience leading or mentoring data engineers, analysts, or other technical team members. 

Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and the capability to independently own complex technical implementations. 

Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders while translating business requirements into scalable data solutions. 

- Should Have: Proficiency in Python for data processing, automation, scripting, and pipeline development. 

Experience working with cloud-based data warehouse platforms such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Amazon Redshift. 

Familiarity with data orchestration and transformation tools such as Apache Airflow, dbt, or Dagster. 

Experience developing dashboards and business intelligence solutions using Looker Studio, Power BI, or Tableau. 

Working knowledge of REST APIs, cloud infrastructure, database deployments, and system integration practices. 

Experience implementing automated data validation, monitoring, and performance optimisation processes. 

- Nice to Have: Exposure to AI/ML initiatives, LLM integrations, predictive modelling, or business forecasting solutions. 

Familiarity with Spring Boot, Java, or other backend application development frameworks. 

Experience supporting predictive analytics use cases such as lead scoring, customer segmentation, or conversion forecasting. 

Relevant certifications or professional training in cloud platforms, database engineering, data analytics, or AI/ML technologies. 

Prior experience working with education technology platforms, LMS, CRM, ERP, or student management systems. 

BenefitsWhy Join IIDE?

- Work with one of India's fastest-growing digital education brands. 
 - Gain exposure to end-to-end data engineering, database architecture, and business intelligence initiatives. 
 - Take ownership of building and scaling the organisation's data infrastructure and centralised analytics ecosystem. 
 - Lead a technically driven team while remaining hands-on with architecture, engineering, and implementation. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams and contribute directly to business-critical decisions and technology initiatives. 
 - Explore opportunities to implement AI-enabled solutions, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation. 
 - Work in a collaborative, high-growth environment that encourages innovation, ownership, and continuous learning. 
 - Enjoy a five-day workweek that supports work-life balance and sustainable professional growth. 

Who You'll Thrive As

You're someone who: 

- Is a hands-on technical leader who enjoys designing and building scalable data solutions as much as guiding a team. 
 - Has a strong foundation in SQL, PostgreSQL, database architecture, and data engineering, with a passion for solving complex technical challenges. 
 - Thinks beyond individual reports and pipelines, focusing on building reliable, integrated, and future-ready data ecosystems. 
 - Takes complete ownership of technical initiatives, from understanding business requirements to architecture, implementation, and ongoing optimisation. 
 - Is passionate about data accuracy, consistency, automation, and establishing a single source of truth across the organisation. 
 - Can translate complex business problems into practical, scalable technical solutions that create measurable impact. 
 - Enjoys mentoring team members, establishing engineering best practices, and fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. 
 - Communicates effectively with cross-functional stakeholders and understands how technology supports broader business objectives. 
 - Is curious about emerging technologies, AI, machine learning, and predictive analytics, and actively explores opportunities to apply them.

data.description:
About Lyra

Lyra Health is the leading provider of mental health solutions for employers supporting more than 20 million people globally. The company has delivered 13 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 20 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra's transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Clinical Governance & Quality Assurance

 - Policy Development: Develop, review, and update local clinical policies and protocols to ensure full compliance with Indian mental health regulations (e. g. , Mental Healthcare Act 2017), ethical guidelines, and best practices. 
 - Quality Oversight: Design and oversee robust quality assurance activities, including systematic clinical audits, in-depth case reviews, and continuous outcome monitoring (CORE-10/Work Impact). 
 - Incident Management: Lead investigations into serious clinical incidents and formal complaints, collaborating with stakeholders to ensure corrective actions and systemic learning. 
 - Senior Escalation: Act as the final clinical escalation point for complex queries, ethical dilemmas, and high-risk situations, providing expert guidance and resolution. 
 - Clinical Delivery Oversight & Team Management
 - Team Leadership: Provide senior clinical oversight and leadership to teams responsible for direct service delivery, including Intake Counselors, Clinical Case Managers, and Structured Counselors. 
 - Fidelity & Pathways: Ensure consistent application of Lyra's clinical pathways, standardized assessment tools, and evidence-based intervention protocols across all delivery teams. 
 - Capacity Planning: Contribute to strategic planning regarding clinical team capacity and resource allocation to align with service demand and operational efficiency. 
 - Professional Development: Oversee onboarding and continuous professional development programs, focusing on clinical fidelity and the sophisticated use of Lyra's methodologies. 
 - Mentorship: Foster a high-performance environment by providing direct mentorship and supervision to Clinical Team Leaders. 
 - Case Management Excellence
 - Clinical Integrity: Maintain overall responsibility for the clinical integrity and effectiveness of the case management function. 
 - Data-Driven Optimization: Analyze aggregate case management data and trends to identify areas for process refinement and improved client outcomes. 
 - High-Acuity Consultation: Provide direct clinical guidance on high-acuity or highly sensitive cases requiring senior-level review and intervention. 
 - Care Coordination: Ensure rigorous adherence to best practices in care coordination, inter-provider collaboration, and referral pathways across the service spectrum. 
 - Interdepartmental Collaboration & Strategic Input
 - Network Partnership: Partner with the Network Operations Manager to ensure the provider network aligns with Lyra's standards, providing clinical input on recruitment criteria and performance expectations.

 - Thought Leadership: Represent Lyra's clinical approach and quality standards in external forums, conferences, and industry discussions. 

Requirements And Qualifications

- Master's degree in a clinical field (e. g. , Clinical Psychology, Counseling, Social Work).

Experience

- Several years of extensive post-qualification clinical experience in mental health, including direct assessment, diagnosis, and evidence-based interventions. 
 - Several years of progressive experience in a clinical leadership, supervisory, or programmatic oversight role within India. 
 - Deep understanding of the Indian mental healthcare landscape and regulatory compliance. 
 - Fluency in English and Hindi is essential; knowledge of other major regional languages is a significant advantage. 

About You

- Clinical Acumen: Exceptional clinical understanding and the advanced ability to identify, assess, and manage high-level clinical risk and complex psychological presentations. 
 - Problem Solver: Highly analytical with superior problem-solving skills, capable of navigating intricate clinical and operational challenges independently. 
 - Autonomous & Accountable: Able to work independently without close supervision, while ensuring all key issues are escalated appropriately and critical decisions are clinically sound. 
 - Detail-Oriented: Meticulous attention to detail, ensuring accuracy of data, maintaining strict confidentiality, and adhering to complex clinical procedures. 
 - Communicator: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex clinical concepts clearly and professionally to diverse stakeholders internationally. 
 - Proactive & Adaptive: Strong continuous improvement mindset, always seeking opportunities to innovate and refine clinical processes. Flexible, adaptable, and thrives in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Organized: Highly organized with exceptional ability to plan, prioritize, and manage a high-volume, complex clinical function effectively. 
 - Collaborative: A strong team player who readily accepts change and collaborates effectively with internal and external partners.

Technologies
 - Manual & Automation Testing, Python (pytest/unittest), SQL, Apache Airflow (DAGs & Pipeline Orchestration), API Testing, ETL/ELT & Data Lakehouse Testing, Great Expectations / Soda Core (Data Quality), OpenMetadata (Governance & Lineage), Apache JMeter / Locust (Performance), CI/CD Tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), Test Management & Defect Tracking (Jira, Kiwi TCMS, Confluence), and Agile/Scrum methodologies.

Strong understanding of insurance industry regulations, data accuracy, auditability, and compliance standards. 
 - E2E Data Pipeline & Lakehouse Testing: Strong experience testing modern data architectures, covering source ingestion, transformations, and consumption layers. 
 - Hands-on Technical Validation: Expertise in SQL-based data validation, source-to-target reconciliation, pipeline dependency tracing, and identifying anomalies across automated workflows. 
 - Proven QA Governance: Experience defining test strategies, test scenarios, data acceptance criteria, entry/exit criteria, and release readiness gates.

 - Insurance & Financial Data Quality Frameworks: Using data quality and assertion tools such as Great Expectations or Soda Core to validate nulls, duplicates, schema evolution, freshness, and custom insurance business-rule checks (e. g. , premium calculations, claim settlements). 
 - Data Governance, Lineage & Reconciliation: Verifying metadata ingestion, catalog completeness, column-level lineage tracking via OpenMetadata, alongside robust SQL-based source-to-target record and aggregate reconciliation.

data.title: Senior Technical Specialist
data.description:
We are seeking a Senior Technical Specialist to join our Professional Services team supporting the implementation, configuration, and business analysis of our ConceptOneTM platform and advanced Identity & Access Management solutions. This role is ideal for a technically strong professional with expertise in SQL development, system configuration, business requirements gathering, and analysis. You will possess deep insurance domain knowledge and the ability to work directly with project teams to deliver scalable, compliant software configurations and data-driven solutions. 

We count on your expertise to prevent defects and represent both technical and end-user perspectives, fostering a commitment to excellence within the dynamic Insurtech landscape. Your attention to detail, analytical capabilities, and collaborative spirit are crucial for maintaining the highest quality standards in our software solutions. 

In this role, you will design and develop custom forms, reports, and database logic that support complex insurance workflows. You will conduct business requirements analysis, perform system configuration and customization, and implement advanced configurations. You will work closely with Business Analysts, Solution Architects, project managers, and client stakeholders to translate functional requirements into comprehensive technical solutions. 

What will you do in this role?

- Business Requirements Gathering & Analysis
 - Facilitate and elicit customer business requirements through workshops, interviews, and discovery sessions. 
 - Analyze and document functional and non-functional requirements for complex insurance implementations. 
 - Develop comprehensive documentation including business rules, use cases, and process flows. 
 - Translate business needs into technical specifications and system design recommendations. 
 - System Configuration and Customization
 - Participate in technical solution design and configuration for the ConceptOneTM platform. 
 - Implement configurations and customizations to support identity and access management requirements. 
 - Perform system configuration and customization based on detailed design documentation and insurance industry best practices. 
 - Implement relevant aspects of customer requirements through system configuration and advanced customization. 
 - SQL Development and Database Management
 - Develop SQL stored procedures, functions, and queries supporting system configuration, integrations, and business logic. 
 - Design and implement data sources used for merge documents, form generation, and reporting. 
 - Manage and maintain Microsoft SQL Server databases using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS). 
 - Optimize database performance through query tuning, indexing strategies, and efficient data retrieval. 
 - Support migration and conversion of database systems and SQL dialects. 
 - Forms, Reports, and Document Generation
 - Design and develop interactive forms and data-driven document generation solutions. 
 - Ensure forms support efficient data capture, validation, and document production. 
 - Build custom reports and data extracts using Appeon Infomaker, Qlik, SSRS, or similar reporting tools. 
 - Technical Subject Matter Expert & Implementation Support

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer (Bengaluru)
data.description:
We Are Hiring | Product Manager, Enterprise AI Platform | Bengaluru

About ReN3

ReN3 is a sovereign AI platform for the enterprise, built to unify an organization's knowledge and let teams execute AI-powered work under strict governance and access control. The platform runs in air-gapped, private-cloud, or other sovereign environments, so sensitive data never leaves the client's own infrastructure. ReN3 works with government, banking and financial services, insurance, healthcare, manufacturing, and construction clients, and partners with major infrastructure and cloud providers on deployment. 

About the Role

As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will own the reliability, security and cost of a multi-tenant AI platform running on Kubernetes. You'll own the full spectrum of reliability engineering, from provisioning infrastructure with Terraform to building alerting systems that keep our services running smoothly. As one of the first SREs on the team, you'll have the opportunity to shape our engineering practices, establish standards, and build a strong foundation for reliability as we scale. 

Our stack

- Platform: GKE, Terraform, Helm charts deployed through GitOps (Argo CD)
 - Services: TypeScript (NestJS) APIs and workers, Python agent runtime, JVM data-processing jobs
 - Data and messaging: PostgreSQL (plus MySQL and SQL Server for some customer deployments), Kafka, Temporal, Redis, a vector store
 - Security: OpenFGA for fine-grained permissions, a secrets manager, sandboxed code execution (gVisor)
 - Observability: OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs
 - AI: several LLM providers behind a gateway, plus self-hosted models

Key Responsibilities

- Own SLOs. Define and defend uptime and latency targets for the APIs, the document-ingestion pipeline and the agent runtime. 
 - Change infrastructure only through code. Every change goes through Terraform and GitOps: planned, reviewed and applied. No click-ops and no ad-hoc kubectl in production. 
 - Make the system observable. Build tracing, dashboards and alerts that point to the cause, not just the symptom. Add AI-specific signals: token spend, provider latency and errors, queue depth and workflow backlog. 
 - Lead incidents. Run on-call, lead response, write blameless postmortems and make sure the root cause gets fixed. 
 - Control capacity and cost. Autoscaling, Kafka and Temporal throughput, database sizing, and LLM and GPU spend. 
 - Keep tenants isolated and secure. Secrets handling, network policy, sandbox isolation and least-privilege access. Help us pass customer security reviews and compliance audits. 
 - Support customer deployments. Some customers need their own region, their own cloud or their own data centre. Help make those installs repeatable. 
 - Run operations with agents, safely. Use coding agents to write Terraform, runbooks, scripts and alert triage. Build the guardrails (plan review, dry runs, scoped credentials, human approval) that keep agents from making unsafe changes to production. 

What We're Looking For

Must-have

- Based in Bengaluru
 - 3-5 years in SRE, DevOps or platform engineering, running production Kubernetes for real users. 
 - Strong Terraform and Kubernetes skills on at least one major cloud (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure is fine). 
 - You write real code in Python, Go or TypeScript: tools and automation, not only YAML. 
 - Daily use of agentic coding, including on infrastructure. You can explain how you use agents without risking production. 
 - Hands-on incident experience with databases, queues, networking or DNS. You have been the one who found the cause. 
 - Observability experience with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Datadog or similar. 
 - High agency. Take initiative, solve problems, deliver results, adapt quickly, and own your outcomes. 

Nice-to-have

- Running Kafka or Temporal in production. 
 - PostgreSQL operations: tuning, backups and point-in-time recovery, upgrades. 
 - Multi-tenant SaaS for enterprise or regulated customers. 
 - OpenShift, on-premises or air-gapped deployments. 
 - Serving LLMs or running GPU workloads. 
 - Sandboxing technologies such as gVisor or Firecracker. 

How to apply

- Submit your resume (more specifications below). 
 - Ensure your resume includes a link to something you built mostly with coding agents (a repo, a live URL, a writeup or a 3-minute Loom). 
 - Ensure your resume includes a short paragraph on a production incident you led: what broke, how you found it and what you changed afterwards.

data.title: Staff Engineer - AI Platform
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Engineer - AI Platform based in India. 

The Staff Engineer - AI Platform will architect and build advanced AI foundations and agentic systems that empower engineering teams to develop and operate intelligent applications at enterprise scale. This hands-on technical leadership role combines system design, software development, and strategic direction to establish reliable, reusable AI platform capabilities. You will build production-grade AI agents, shared frameworks, model gateways, and evaluation systems while improving developer productivity through intelligent automation. You will also lead efforts to strengthen AI safety, observability, scalability, and cost efficiency across cloud infrastructure. Working closely with product engineering, security, infrastructure, and leadership teams, you will shape technical standards and drive an AI-first engineering culture. This remote opportunity is ideal for an experienced engineer passionate about distributed systems, agent orchestration, and building resilient AI capabilities that deliver measurable impact. 

Accountabilities

- Architect, develop, and maintain production-grade agentic systems featuring multi-step reasoning workflows, tool usage, orchestration, planning, memory and context management, and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Build and evolve a shared AI platform for product and engineering teams, including reusable agent frameworks, tool integrations, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, LLM gateways, and prompt and model versioning. 
 - Design and implement LLM gateway capabilities such as model routing, rate limiting, caching, fallback strategies, and usage controls. 
 - Establish comprehensive AI evaluation and observability practices, including evaluation frameworks, regression testing, agent tracing, and production metrics for quality, latency, cost, and safety. 
 - Lead the adoption of AI-driven engineering workflows, developer tooling, and automation that improve engineering velocity and reduce repetitive operational work. 
 - Manage cloud infrastructure for AI workloads across Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and/or AWS, including provisioning, scaling, security, access management, and cost governance. 
 - Implement robust AI safety and reliability measures, including guardrails, scoped permissions, sandboxing, prompt-injection defenses, audit trails, graceful degradation, and incident management practices. 
 - Drive continuous optimization of inference, token usage, and infrastructure costs while maintaining high standards of performance, reliability, and output quality. 
 - Define technical architecture and engineering standards, lead design reviews, produce design documentation, and mentor engineers across teams. 
 - Collaborate with product engineering, site reliability engineering, infrastructure, security, and organizational leadership to align AI platform capabilities with business and technical priorities. 
 - Use measurable performance data to guide architectural decisions, prioritize improvements, communicate risks, and report on platform health, agent quality, and cost efficiency. 
 - Champion an AI-first engineering culture, ensuring teams adopt shared AI capabilities and achieve measurable improvements in productivity and operational effectiveness. 

Requirements

- At least 12 years of overall software engineering experience, including substantial experience as a senior or staff-level individual contributor. 
 - At least one year of recent experience architecting and operating production agentic systems, including multi-step tool-using agents, orchestration, memory and context management, and safety guardrails. 
 - An AI-first mindset, with active use of AI tools in personal engineering workflows and the ability to encourage adoption across an engineering organization. 
 - Expert-level proficiency in at least one of the following programming languages: Go, Python, or Node. js. 
 - Strong hands-on engineering experience, including writing and reviewing code, debugging production issues, and making deep architectural contributions. Candidates whose work has been exclusively managerial rather than hands-on during the past year are not a fit for this role. 
 - Strong understanding of LLM application fundamentals, including tool and function calling, MCP, retrieval, context engineering, prompt and model management, and evaluation methods for nondeterministic systems. 
 - Extensive experience with observability practices, particularly AI observability, including tracing agent executions and monitoring production quality, latency, cost, and safety. Familiarity with Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, or equivalent tools is expected. 
 - Deep knowledge of distributed systems architecture, including consistency, availability, fault tolerance, scalability, and large-scale system design trade-offs. 
 - Demonstrated experience optimizing costs in enterprise cloud environments, including managing LLM inference and token spend through model routing, caching, and budget controls. 
 - Practical experience managing GCP and/or AWS services, including infrastructure provisioning, scaling, identity and access management (IAM), networking, and cost governance. 
 - At least three years of experience as an individual contributor on platform engineering teams operating at enterprise scale. 
 - Proven ability to lead through technical influence, including writing design documents, aligning cross-functional teams, setting engineering standards, and mentoring other engineers. 
 - Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills, with experience using performance metrics to guide priorities and report outcomes. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Preferred: Open-source contributions or published work related to agentic systems. 

Benefits

- Remote working arrangement in India. 
 - Professional growth opportunities through technical leadership and ownership of enterprise-scale AI platform initiatives. 
 - Opportunities to work on advanced AI agents, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and developer productivity tooling. 
 - Collaboration with a globally distributed engineering organization and cross-functional technical teams. 
 - Opportunity to shape AI engineering standards, mentor engineers, and influence platform architecture and strategy. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)

The Role

As a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), you will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, 

availability, performance, and operability of production systems across our AI platforms and

hosted applications. 

You will apply software engineering principles to operational challenges, with a strong focus on

automation, observability, and proactive reliability management. Reliability is treated as a feature, 

measured objectively, and improved continuously through engineering best practices rather than

reactive support. 

This role works closely with product engineering and platform teams to enable teams to ship

changes safely, operate services at scale, and learn from incidents through a blameless culture. 

The role includes participation in a global oncall model supporting production systems across

multiple time zones.

Participate in incident management, including detection, triage, mitigation, escalation, 

and recovery.

ownership and timely communication. 

Design, implement, and operate observability solutions including monitoring, logging, 

tracing, synthetics, and dashboards (e. g. Splunk Observability, OpenTelemetry). 

Define, monitor, and report SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets for critical services. 

Reduce operational toil through automation and engineeringled solutions. 

Contribute to production readiness reviews, capacity planning, and deployment safety

mechanisms. 

Perform rootcause analysis and lead or contribute to blameless postincident reviews. 

Communicate complex technical issues clearly to engineers, stakeholders, and

leadership.

Strong experience with cloudnative concepts and technologies, preferably

on GCP. 

Handson experience operating production cloud infrastructure at scale. 

Proven experience with incident management, ideally using platforms such

as ServiceNow.

5-7Years

data.title: Assistant Manager- Java Back End
data.description:
Job Title: Assistant Manager- Java Back End

Department: RISK IT

About Business line/Function: The mission of RISK function is to provide Senior Management of the Group and of the Operating Divisions with full transparency and dynamic analysis of the risks and clients managed by the various operating divisions: Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB), Retail Banking, Investment & Protection Services (IPS). 

Position Purpose: We are looking for a candidate with an excellent level of experience on Java and enthusiastic to develop distributed applications with a focus on high throughput and high performance. 

The role is for a position within the Risk Systems - Counterparty Measures tribe in Mumbai. The tribe is split into multidisciplinary squads implementing Scrum inside an agile at scale methodology. It works on three-month Program Increments and two-week sprints, following all the ceremonies typical of Scrum and Agile at Scale. 

The team has as well completed the re-engineering of the counterparty risk system into a highly distributed architecture using a technology stack composed of big data solutions, data grids, compute grids, REST based architectures and a pricing and simulation engine that uses Graphics Processing Units. The team also uses development practices such as Continuous Delivery to reduce time taken from development to delivery into production. 

The successful candidate will work in a fast paced, agile environment in a multi-disciplinary team. The role is technical with elements of programming and design. It is primarily focused on the Java side of the counterparty risk calculation system. The developer will be working on implementing requirements coming from different sources: Technical, Regulatory and Business

Responsibilities

Direct Responsibilities

Design and development

- Help to clarify and qualify needs
 - Help to carry out studies before project launch
 - Help to design software solutions
 - Develop software that meets development and security standards, while incorporating data and security objectives
 - Help to optimise existing code and improve its maintainability
 - Help to integrate software packages and in the definition of settings
 - Enforce agile development practices such as automated testing, continuous integration and continuous delivery. 
 - Review code and ensure that it is compliant with the principles and practices of the development teams while ensuring that the needs of the quantitative developers are met. 
 - Hands on development of any tools/framework changes to meet requirements. 

Testing, acceptance and release

- Implement and/or create a test strategy
 - Install the product deployment tools in the different environments
 - Upgrade and/or help to upgrade the documentation

Contributing Responsibilities

- Help in implementing improvements to their activity and maintaining technical know-how
 - Participate in internal and external developer networks to communicate and share best practices
 - Engage in continuous training in new information technologies

Technical & Behavioral Competencies

Computing Skills

- Excellent software design, coding, documentation and analysis skills. 
 - Excellent Java knowledge including hands on experience with Spring, REST and multithreading. 
 - Excellent computer science fundamentals. 
 - Knowledge of distributed Systems and technologies (e. g. Oracle Coherence, Apache Cassandra, Spectrum Symphony, Kafka, Tomcat, etc. ). 
 - Experience on testing, from Unit Testing to Acceptance Testing. 
 - Experience on Continuous Integration and Delivery techniques and tooling. 
 - An appreciation of distributed systems programming patterns. 
 - An appreciation of parallelisation techniques

Behavioural Skills

- Ability to collaborate / Teamwork
 - Creativity & Innovation / Problem Solving
 - Adaptability
 - Ability to Deliver / Results Driven

Transversal Skills

- Analytical Ability
 - Ability to develop and leverage networks

Tools - Methodologies

- AI-assisted Development
 - Jira, Jenkins, Bitbucket, Artifactory, Claude Code
 - IT Programs Conception
 - Testing
 - Agile methodologies

Specific Qualifications

6 to 10 Years of Hands-on Experience

Technical Skills

Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)

- 
 - Java - Core, Multithreading, Collection framework, JDBC
 - Knowledge of distributed systems programming patterns & parallelisation techniques
 - Spring Framework, REST APIs 
 - Knowledge of distributed Systems and technologies (e. g. Oracle Coherence, Apache Cassandra, Spectrum Symphony, Kafka
 - Software design patterns 
 - CI/CD, Testing (Junit & System Testing), Kafka, Tomcat 
 - Development Tools (Jira, Jenkins, Bitbucket, Artifactory, Claude Code) 
 - AI Assisted development 
 - Agile methodologies
Behavioral Skills

- 
 - Ability to Collaborate / Teamwork
 - Analytical Ability
 - Strong Communication
 - Results Driven
Education Level: Bachelor Degree or equivalent

Location: Mumbai

About BNP Paribas Group

BNP Paribas is the European Union's leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185, 000 employees, including more than 145, 000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group's commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability. 

About BNP Paribas India Solutions

Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union's leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions. 

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in.

data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr Manager Client Technology based in India. 

In this role, you will lead and develop a team of Cloud Platform Engineers responsible for delivering reliable, secure, and scalable cloud infrastructure. You will combine people management with hands-on technical oversight, ensuring high-quality Kubernetes operations and Terraform automation. Working closely with senior platform experts across international teams, you will help maintain architectural consistency and enforce engineering best practices. You will oversee workload planning, technical reviews, delivery priorities, and team performance while ensuring that progress reporting accurately reflects actual system and repository states. This position offers the opportunity to influence platform reliability, strengthen automation practices, and build engineering capabilities in a collaborative, distributed environment. If you enjoy balancing technical leadership with team development and operational excellence, this role offers a meaningful opportunity to make an impact. 

Accountabilities

- Lead and manage India-based Cloud Platform Engineers, overseeing workload allocation, prioritization, day-to-day execution, performance management, and team development. 
 - Review and validate Terraform modules, Kubernetes configurations, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) changes to ensure technical correctness, maintainability, compliance with established standards, and production readiness. 
 - Establish and enforce engineering workflows, including issue-based tracking, work triage, prioritization, work-in-progress limits, and regular status updates. 
 - Provide senior leadership with accurate, evidence-based progress reports verified against actual infrastructure, system configurations, and repository activity. 
 - Collaborate with Principal and Expert Platform Engineers across regions to align implementation with established platform architecture, GitOps practices, Terraform standards, and AKS conventions. 
 - Identify and escalate technical challenges, delivery risks, and operational concerns proactively to support timely resolution and predictable execution. 
 - Contribute to recruitment, onboarding, knowledge sharing, and skills development, particularly in Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD practices. 
 - Apply established security controls and policy-as-code standards, using Kyverno or equivalent tools, to ensure infrastructure changes meet platform governance requirements. 

Requirements

- At least 5 years of experience in platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, site reliability engineering, or a closely related technical field, including previous people-management or formal technical-lead responsibilities. 
 - Hands-on production experience with Kubernetes, ideally Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), with the ability to independently review cluster configurations and workload changes and identify potential issues. 
 - Practical experience with Terraform, including reviewing modules for correctness, reusability, maintainability, and compliance with documented engineering standards. 
 - Experience with GitOps tools such as Argo CD, Flux, or equivalent, with a strong commitment to managing infrastructure and cluster changes through version-controlled workflows. 
 - Proven experience directly managing engineers, including performance development, workload planning, prioritization, and day-to-day team coordination. 
 - Strong reporting, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to provide senior stakeholders with accurate, verifiable updates on technical progress and delivery risks. 
 - Working knowledge of policy-as-code solutions such as Kyverno, Open Policy Agent (OPA), Gatekeeper, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, sound technical judgment, and the ability to balance operational execution with people leadership. 
 - Experience managing geographically distributed or offshore engineering teams reporting to leadership in another region is an advantage. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and their practical application in everyday engineering workflows is preferred. 
 - Experience with observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos, or equivalent is beneficial. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy automation, including PowerShell-based workflows, into Terraform-driven or platform-native solutions is an additional advantage. 

Benefits

- Competitive compensation package aligned with experience and qualifications. 
 - Comprehensive employee benefits, with specific healthcare and coverage details to be confirmed during the recruitment process. 
 - Flexible working arrangements within a remote-friendly role based in India. 
 - A collaborative, supportive work environment that encourages initiative, knowledge sharing, and professional growth. 
 - Opportunities to strengthen technical expertise in cloud platforms, infrastructure automation, Kubernetes, and modern engineering practices. 
 - Access to learning opportunities and career development in a diverse, international business environment. 
 - Long-term organizational stability combined with the autonomy to contribute ideas, improve engineering processes, and make a meaningful impact. 
 - A people-focused culture that values curiosity, teamwork, continuous improvement, and a positive approach to work.

data.description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients- that is what Vantive aspires to deliver. 

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities. 

The Manager, Data Storage Platforms is responsible for leading a team of platform engineers overseeing the planning, the build, and the operations of data platforms. They will be responsible for architecting, engineering, and optimizing large‐scale, cloud‐native data platforms on AWS and Azure. This role leads development of event‐driven data architectures, CDC frameworks, data lake ingestion pipelines, and scalable ETL/ELT processes. The architect partners closely with cross‐functional teams, leads technical delivery, ensures operational excellence, and provides hands‐on support for global data transformation initiatives. They will be a part of the Data Services Platforms team and provide technological and process expertise and support the global domain data product delivery teams. They will provide leadership by assisting business partners in identifying and responding to opportunities for cost-effective data implementations and solutions by analyzing and making decisions that have cross functional business impact. 

Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of data platform engineers

 - Oversee the design, implementation, and maintenance of data engineering pipelines in a multi-cloud environment, including integrations with a variety of data sources (including structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data)

 - Monitor and optimize the performance of data pipelines, ensuring they meet SLAs for data availability and quality.

- Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or relevant subject area

 - Servant Leader - Able to gain respect from their team and willing to get their hands dirty to get the job done.

 - Must be a strategic, innovative problem solver, and have strong influencing and communication skills. 
 - Strong knowledge of business process flow and/or entity relationship modeling. 
 - Demonstrated outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively with other technology teams as well as business partners. Ability to effectively present information, interact with, and respond to questions from managers, employees, customers, and vendors
 - Experience in applying best practices to ELT/ETL data transformation from variety of data sources to AWS and other data warehouse platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse etc. 

Required Technical Skills

- AWS CDK (TypeScript/Python)
 - AWS Glue (ETL, Catalog, Crawlers, Job Bookmarks)
 - AWS Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, Step Functions, EventBridge
 - Amazon Kinesis, Route 53, S3 (events, triggers)

 - AWS DMS

What if the code you write could determine how smart the next generation of AI truly is? We're looking for experienced Software Engineers to design and build the coding benchmarks and data pipelines used to evaluate frontier AI models - the systems that decide whether an AI can actually reason, debug, and write production-quality software. 

This is high-impact, technically demanding work at the intersection of software engineering and AI research. You'll work with large codebases, multiple programming languages, and scalable infrastructure to create evaluation systems that push the boundaries of what AI can do. 

This is a fully remote contract role. If you thrive in fast-paced engineering environments and want your work to directly shape the trajectory of AI - this is the role.

 - Location: Remote

 - Build and maintain scalable data pipelines for AI evaluation workflows

data.title: Senior Engineering Operations Manager
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Engineering Operations Manager based in India. 

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on professional to lead the evolution of product development processes within a global, remote-first technology environment. In this role, you will own the end-to-end Product Development Process (PDP), ensuring strong alignment between product strategy, engineering execution, and business priorities. You will also design, build, and maintain automated workflows using an enterprise orchestration platform to improve operational efficiency and streamline product delivery. By applying practical experience with AI agents and agentic workflows, you will help transform how product teams collaborate and execute their work. This role combines engineering expertise, process design, and product thinking to drive measurable improvements across multiple teams. It offers an opportunity to influence organizational practices and contribute directly to an AI-first approach to software development. 

Accountabilities

- Own and continuously improve the end-to-end Product Development Process across Core and Experience product tracks, including process design, workflow stages, board management, and epic definitions and tracking. 
 - Align product development processes with product strategy, ensuring clear connections between strategic objectives, initiatives, and engineering epics. 
 - Establish consistent working practices across product divisions, fostering alignment and trust among Product, Engineering, and leadership teams. 
 - Build, maintain, and operate process automation using Camunda 8, ensuring a reliable and scalable foundation for both product development tracks. 
 - Manage the automation lifecycle, including source control, testing, test environments, monitoring, integration maintenance, and ongoing improvements. 
 - Design and implement agentic workflows that use the organization's own orchestration platform to support internal product development activities. 
 - Apply lessons learned from internal workflow implementations to identify opportunities for product improvements and share actionable feedback with product teams. 
 - Collaborate cross-functionally to improve engineering operations, simplify workflows, and increase the effectiveness of product development. 
 - Combine hands-on technical execution with strategic process ownership, ensuring that solutions are practical, user-focused, maintainable, and aligned with organizational objectives. 

Requirements

- Demonstrated experience combining product thinking, process design, and technical implementation, with the ability to assess workflow usability and build effective solutions directly. 
 - Hands-on engineering experience, including writing code and scripts, working with GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, APIs, and debugging integrations. 
 - Proven experience designing, owning, and improving product or engineering processes within a software organization of 100 or more engineers. 
 - Practical experience building AI agents or agentic workflows that perform meaningful tasks in real-world environments, beyond experimentation or proof-of-concept projects. 
 - Strong understanding of product development workflows, operational processes, and the relationship between product strategy and engineering execution. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to influence Product, Engineering, and leadership teams toward shared processes and objectives. 
 - A proactive, hands-on mindset, with strong problem-solving abilities, ownership, and the capacity to balance strategic thinking with implementation details. 
 - Willingness and ability to use the organization's own orchestration platform to design and implement workflows and improve internal operations. 
 - Familiarity with BPMN, Camunda, or other workflow automation engines is an advantage. 
 - Previous experience in product operations, developer experience, or platform engineering is considered a plus. 

Benefits

- Competitive compensation: Location-based salary packages designed to reflect local market conditions. Compensation is determined by experience, skills, and location. For India-based employees, personalized total rewards information is provided during the recruitment process. 
 - Equity opportunities: Access to a Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP), where applicable. 
 - Fully remote work: Work from anywhere, with flexibility to create a productive working environment. 
 - Home office support: Budget for home office equipment and support for coworking spaces. 
 - Flexible time off: Time away from work to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 
 - Global team connections: Annual company gatherings, team offsites, local meetups, and connection budgets to encourage collaboration and relationship-building. 
 - Healthcare and wellbeing: Locally tailored healthcare benefits, access to global mental wellbeing resources, and a flexible lifestyle spending program. 
 - Lifestyle spending allowance: A global wellbeing program covering areas such as fitness, family care, personal interests, meaningful experiences, and financial wellbeing, with an annual allowance scaling to €1, 000 from 2027. 
 - Financial protection: Retirement or pension plans, potentially including employer contributions, along with life and disability insurance where applicable. 
 - Professional development: Up to $1, 000, €1, 000, or £1, 000 annually, depending on location, for self-directed learning, courses, certifications, and books. 
 - Inclusive work culture: An environment that values diverse perspectives, encourages collaboration, and supports professional growth. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: AI Evaluation Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Evaluation Engineer based in India. 

As a founding AI Evaluation Engineer, you will design and build the evaluation, testing, and observability infrastructure that ensures production-grade AI agents perform reliably, safely, and efficiently. You will develop automated testing systems for complex reasoning, multi-turn conversations, and agent interactions involving APIs, databases, and code execution. Working across AI engineering, software testing, and infrastructure, you will create scalable evaluation pipelines that go beyond traditional QA and manual prompt testing. You will establish robust regression testing, statistical evaluation methods, and adversarial scenarios to identify weaknesses before deployment. This is an opportunity to take ownership of an evaluation architecture from the ground up while working with modern AI technologies in a fully remote, globally distributed environment. Your work will directly contribute to the reliability, security, and continuous improvement of advanced AI systems. 

Accountabilities

- Design, build, and maintain automated CI/CD testing pipelines to validate AI agent behavior before deployment and throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - Develop and maintain golden datasets containing regression prompts, edge cases, and synthetic scenarios to measure agent accuracy, safety, performance, and latency. 
 - Implement fast, cost-effective, deterministic evaluation checks before introducing LLM-as-a-judge approaches, including JSON schema validation, regular expressions, API status checks, and embedding similarity. 
 - Create comprehensive test suites for multi-turn agent conversations, evaluating context retention, state consistency, reasoning behavior, and safeguards against infinite tool-calling loops. 
 - Design and implement adversarial testing scenarios to assess resilience against prompt injection, malformed inputs, unexpected tool responses, and other potential security vulnerabilities. 
 - Build statistical evaluation frameworks to measure non-deterministic AI behavior using pass rates across multiple runs, confidence intervals, and other quantitative reliability metrics. 
 - Integrate evaluation workflows into GitHub Actions or comparable CI systems using SDK-level execution and automated testing practices. 
 - Implement observability and tracing solutions using tools such as OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, W&B Weave, or equivalent platforms to monitor agent execution and diagnose failures. 
 - Optimize evaluation efficiency and cost through caching, mocking, and other techniques that reduce unnecessary LLM API calls. 
 - Validate structured outputs, including JSON schemas, OpenAPI specifications, and function-calling payloads, to ensure agents interact reliably with external systems. 
 - Evaluate and improve agent performance under load, accounting for variable response times and non-deterministic endpoint behavior. 
 - Independently design and own the evaluation architecture, establishing best practices, testing standards, and scalable processes for ongoing quality assurance. 

Requirements

- Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript, particularly for API testing, headless execution, asynchronous programming, and automated testing systems. 
 - Hands-on experience building LLM evaluation pipelines, AI testing frameworks, or statistical testing systems capable of measuring performance across repeated runs. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD environments, particularly GitHub Actions or similar platforms, with SDK-level execution. 
 - Strong expertise in validating structured data and outputs, including JSON schema, OpenAPI specifications, and function-calling payloads. 
 - Familiarity with observability and tracing tools such as OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, W&B Weave, or custom logging solutions. 
 - Ability to independently design, implement, and maintain an evaluation architecture from scratch, with a strong sense of ownership and technical judgment. 
 - Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate technical findings clearly in a distributed team. 
 - Availability to overlap with US Central Time business hours for at least three hours each day. 
 - Experience with code execution sandboxes or AI agent frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or CrewAI. 
 - Strong understanding of embedding models, vector databases, and their applications in AI evaluation and similarity-based testing. 
 - Experience with load testing non-deterministic endpoints and assessing system behavior under varying workloads. 
 - A proactive, analytical approach to problem-solving, with the ability to work independently, adapt to evolving technologies, and continuously improve testing methodologies. 

Benefits

- Fully remote work: Work from anywhere with a reliable internet connection, with the flexibility to choose your preferred time zone and working hours. 
 - Flexible schedule: Organize your working day around your productivity while maintaining the required overlap with US Central Time. 
 - Professional development: Access paid training and other opportunities to expand your technical expertise and support your career growth. 
 - Modern technology: Work with contemporary AI tools, frameworks, and engineering practices in an environment that values innovation and continuous improvement. 
 - Consistent project opportunities: Benefit from a steady flow of engaging and challenging product development work. 
 - Performance recognition: Strong performance and dedication may be rewarded through annual pay increases. 
 - Negotiable compensation: Your starting hourly rate will be determined based on your skills, experience, and qualifications. 
 - Independent contractor arrangement: Compensation is based on hours worked, with payments made monthly via wire transfer. 
 - Flexible working environment: Enjoy the autonomy to work in a setting that supports your focus, independence, and professional development. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. data.description:
Engineering Operations Lead

Location: Pune/Bengaluru, India (hybrid) | Team: Engineering | Reporting to: CTO

OVERVIEW

APEXX is an independent, enterprise payment orchestration platform. Merchants connect to APEXX once and reach the world's payment ecosystem: acquirers, alternative payment methods (APMs), Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) providers and network tokenisation. Our routing engine (AIRE), cascading, Smart Split and Revenue Protect decide in milliseconds where each transaction should go to maximise acceptance and minimise cost. We don't own an acquirer, so our only incentive is the merchant's outcome. 

We're backed by MMC, Forward Partners, Alliance VC & Finch Capital and growing with enterprise travel and eCommerce merchants including Jet2, TUI, Ryanair, CarTrawler and Hotelbeds. 

We're looking for an Engineering Operations Lead to strengthen how our Product & Technology team operates, collaborates and delivers. 

Working closely with our CTO and Engineering Leadership Team, you'll take ownership of our Atlassian ecosystem, improve delivery governance, release readiness and engineering performance visibility, and use AI, automation and modern development tools to build smarter, more scalable ways of working. 

Your initial focus will be transforming Jira and Confluence, establishing effective workflows, reporting and platform governance, before expanding into broader technology operations, engineering productivity and strategic support for the CTO. 

This is a hands-on role combining technical expertise, delivery management and operational improvement, ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, building practical solutions and helping engineering teams perform at their best. 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Atlassian Platform & Engineering Operations

- Own and transform our Atlassian ecosystem: take responsibility for Jira, Confluence and Jira Service Management, improving configurations, workflows, permissions, integrations and overall platform governance. 
 - Standardise engineering workflows: establish consistent, scalable processes across Engineering, Product, Platform and QA, reducing unnecessary complexity while supporting different teams' delivery needs. 
 - Build automation and integrations: connect Jira with GitLab, Slack, CI/CD tooling and other systems to improve traceability, data quality and operational efficiency. 
 - Maintain secure, reliable platforms: oversee access controls, configuration standards, documentation and audit trails in support of our PCI DSS, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 environment. 
 - Drive platform adoption and improvement: troubleshoot issues, simplify legacy configurations and enable teams through documentation, training and self-service capabilities. 

Technology Delivery, Governance & CTO Office

AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement

 - Confident partnering with CTOs, Engineering leaders and senior stakeholders, constructively challenging existing processes and driving cross-functional improvements.

NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in a FinTech, SaaS or scale-up environment, ideally with exposure to PCI DSS, SOC 2 or ISO 27001. 

HOW WE HIRE

Three conversations: 

- a talent screen,

 - a practical technology operations, delivery and automation discussion. 

The practical session will explore how you approach real-world challenges - improving Jira workflows, establishing delivery governance, interpreting engineering performance metrics and using AI or automation to solve operational problems. 

You're welcome to use AI tools where appropriate. We're interested in how you think, validate and make decisions. 

Once a decision is made, every candidate receives written feed-forward from the panel. Tell us about any adjustments you need and we'll make them. 

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

WHO WE ARE & WHERE WE ARE

data.title: Senior Software Engineer / Tech Lead
data.description:
Senior Software Engineer / Tech Lead at Monay

Location: Kakinada or Hyderabad, India

Work arrangement: On-site, full-time

Monay is building two connected products: a wallet for enterprise and consumer payments, and a blockchain settlement layer that links payments to invoices and records confirmed money movement. 

We need a strong engineer who can lead a small team in India and write production code every week. You'll work directly with our US-based founder and team, make technical decisions and take responsibility for getting features delivered. 

What the role involves

You'll lead and mentor 3-5 engineers across Monay Wallet and Monay Blockchain. The work includes wallet applications, backend services, ledger integrations and smart contracts. 

Our stack includes TypeScript, Next. js, React Native with Expo, Node. js, PostgreSQL, Rust, TigerBeetle and Solidity. We use Foundry, Hardhat and Arbitrum Orbit/Stylus across the blockchain work. 

You'll be expected to: 

• Take features from specification through implementation, testing and release. 

• Review code carefully and keep pull requests small enough to review properly. 

• Protect payment and ledger correctness as the products grow. 

• Use Claude Code or comparable AI coding agents daily, and verify what they produce. 

• Help your team solve problems, improve their work and meet commitments. 

• Raise blockers early and take the initiative to resolve them. 

Who we're looking for

• 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years leading or mentoring engineers. 

• Strong, current coding skills in TypeScript/Node. js or Rust, with a willingness to work in both. 

• Practical experience with AI coding agents in everyday engineering. 

• Exposure to Ethereum/EVM, Solidity and smart contract tooling. 

• A solid understanding of APIs, relational databases and testing. 

• Clear written English and dependable communication. 

• A record of taking ownership and finishing difficult work without constant supervision. 

Payments, fintech, double-entry accounting, reconciliation, wallet integrations, TigerBeetle or Arbitrum experience would be useful. 

Please read this before applying

This is a demanding startup role. It is not a routine 8-to-5 position where responsibility ends when the working day does. There will be tight deadlines, difficult problems and periods that require additional effort to get a release over the line. 

We're looking for someone dedicated, focused and highly motivated. You should be comfortable starting work without waiting for detailed instructions, making decisions and being accountable for the result. 

Commitment means delivering consistently, helping the team and maintaining quality when the pressure is on. We care about what you accomplish and whether people can depend on you. 

Employment and stock options

You'll initially be employed by Tilli Software India. The role will move to Monay India once the local entity is established. 

After two years, you may qualify for Monay stock options based on your dedication, performance, leadership and consistency. Eligibility and any grant are subject to review, approval and the terms of Monay's stock option plan. Completing two years does not automatically qualify you for a grant. 

You'll have the opportunity to help build our India engineering team and earn greater responsibility as the company grows. 

How to apply

Send your CV to both hr@tilli. pro and talent@Monay. com, along with links to code you've written and a short note telling us: 

• About a difficult feature or product you personally delivered. 

• How you use Claude Code or other AI coding agents. 

• Why this kind of role appeals to you. 

• Whether you prefer Kakinada or Hyderabad.

data.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. 

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365-all within 90 seconds.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling. com addresses. 

About The Role

The Data Infrastructure Team is a lean, high-impact group operating in a true founder mode. We are responsible for building and safeguarding all data systems, managing the lifecycle of 500+ production-grade resources across 10+ types of data stores. Our core mission is to build self-serve, automated platforms that ensure our systems are efficient, scalable, and continuously evolving. We don't just operate systems-we invent them. 

What You Will Do

We are looking for enthusiastic, innovative engineers to join our engineering team as Software Engineers (SDE-1). In this role, you'll collaborate with experienced engineers, contribute to real-world projects from day one, and gain exposure to cutting-edge tools and technologies. You'll play a key role in building and optimizing products that reach millions of users globally. you will join one of our many teams to develop robust, well-designed products, implement new updates and features, and solve complex problems that affect our business and our clients. 

- Invent, design, and build self-serve, automated platforms for managing the lifecycle of 500+ production-grade data resources across 10+ data store types.

 - Pioneer and execute complex projects like large-scale, zero-downtime database migrations.

 - Build and maintain the core foundations for strategic initiatives, including multi-region architecture, sandbox environments, and a comprehensive, Terraform-based infrastructure-as-code platform. 
 - Focus intensely on performance, observability, cost and operability to maintain infrastructure that just works, even when handling ~100 billion queries/day and 10 PB of data transfer. 
 - Write core libraries like middlewares, ORMs, proxies, rate limiters, shard routers (in Python and Go) to support scalability and developer experience. 
 - Take end-to-end ownership of projects, from initial design and planning to successful rollout and operation. 

What You Will Have

- 1-2 years experience working with fast growing, top tier product companies

 - Expert understanding of data structures, algorithms, software design principles and low level design
 - Ability to communicate clearly and work effectively in a collaborative environment
 - Understanding of system design and complex distributed systems
 - Eagerness to learn new technologies and apply them to solve real-world problems. 
 - Bonus points for open source contributions, competitive coding experience, and a strong Computer Science background from a Tier 1 institution.

integrate cutting-edge AI technologies natively built on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

leveraging our enterprise AI platforms to deliver low-latency, scalable, and ethical implementations. While you will remain deeply hands-on, your success will also be measured by your ability to elevate the engineers around you, champion design standards, and turn complex

AI paradigms into seamless user experiences.

 - Deep experience building complex, production-grade web applications using React, TypeScript, Next. js, and Node. js. Strong understanding of SSR (Server-Side Rendering).

 - A strong focus on the end-user. You understand how to handle the unique UI/UX challenges of Generative AI, such as streaming model responses, conversational state management, and elegant fallback UI states.

Preferred / Bonus Points
