data.title: Head of Printing
data.description:
Faridabad, Delhi NCR | On-site | 12-18 years | Reports to the founders Qualification: B. E. / B. Tech - Printing Technology, Polymer or Plastics Engineering, Mechanical, Chemical or Production

Printing is the step that makes our product ours. It's also where most of our quality risk sits, because a defect found at pack is a part we've already paid to mould. 

Your scope is everything that happens to a part after it leaves the tool: UV printing, dye-sublimation, cylindrical and bottle printing, coating, and assembly - through to a finished product ready to pack. 

We have shift managers running the floor, an engineer keeping machines healthy, and a specialist owning colour. What we don't have is anyone accountable for whether our decoration as a whole is good and getting better - or for deciding what we should be able to produce two years from now. 

This role is technical before it is managerial. If you can't stand at a press and tell us why the part in your hand failed, the rest of the job won't work. 

And a large share of the time, the answer isn't the press. Adhesion failures usually trace back to materials - mould release contamination on the part surface, a substrate whose surface energy was never going to accept ink without treatment, plasticiser migrating out of a TPU weeks after it shipped. We want someone who looks upstream before blaming the machine. 

Who owns what - read this

Several roles touch printing, and all of them sit under you: 

- You own the outcome - print and assembly quality, process capability, and what we can and can't produce
 - Operations Managers own daily throughput and dispatch on their shifts
 - The UV Printing Engineer owns machine condition, maintenance and uptime
 - The Colour Management Specialist owns profiles and colour standards

When a defect appears, the diagnosis crosses all four. You decide where it actually came from, what changes, and you're accountable if it comes back. 

What you'd build

- Validated recipes per product and substrate across every process, so output doesn't depend on who's on shift
 - A process capability baseline - what our defect rates actually are, by type and by process. Harder to establish than it sounds, and impossible to improve without
 - A qualification route for new substrates and products, so new product development gets a real answer on printability and assembly rather than an opinion
 - Technology strategy: which process suits which product, where current capability runs out, and what we invest in next
 - A capability roadmap that lets us say yes to work we currently have to decline

Building the team

We're scaling, and most of our operators arrive without print-specific skills. How you build capability matters as much as how you build process. 

- A skill matrix per process - who can set up, who can run, who can judge quality on UV, sublimation, cylindrical and assembly. Certification before anyone operates unsupervised
 - Cross-training as a capacity lever, not an HR nicety. In high-mix production, if one person can set up the bottle line then that line's availability equals their attendance. Depth on every process is how we stop losing days to one person's leave
 - Limit samples, so "acceptable" is a physical object an operator can hold rather than an opinion that shifts by shift. Most quality arguments on a print floor are really definition arguments
 - Train-the-trainer, so capability multiplies rather than routing through you
 - A progression path that gives a good operator a reason to stay beyond the next ₹2, 000 offer
 - The structure of the function itself as we grow - shift coverage, technical specialists, quality

You'd own

- UV flatbed, cylindrical and bottle printing, dye-sublimation, coating and assembly
 - Quality and first-pass yield across the whole post-moulding chain. The number this role is judged on
 - Capacity planning against the production plan
 - Capital decisions for new capacity, and the business cases behind them
 - Customer complaints through to root cause and corrective action
 - The function and its team: shift operations, machine engineering, colour

You need

Real technical depth across our processes. Specifically: 

- Dye-sublimation - transfer printing onto polyester and poly-coated substrates, heat press and 3D vacuum sublimation, and how time, temperature and pressure shift the final result
 - UV inkjet - flatbed printing, LED curing, primer and surface preparation, white ink and varnish layers, and adhesion that holds up weeks later rather than just at inspection
 - Cylindrical and bottle printing - rotary setup, chuck alignment, tapered and non-uniform profiles, maintaining head gap over a curved surface
 - Assembly - multi-part products, fit and tolerance, insert handling, and cosmetic damage prevention on finished parts

Materials - plastics. How substrate behaviour decides what decoration is possible: PC, ABS, PC/ABS, TPU, TPE, PP, PMMA and filled grades. Surface energy and dyne level, and which plastics need corona, plasma or flame treatment before they'll accept anything. Heat deflection limits, which govern what can be sublimated without distorting the part. Mould release carryover, plasticiser migration, and the other upstream causes of a print that fails three weeks later. 

Materials - coatings. Hard coat, soft-touch and PU systems, UV-curable versus two-component thermal cure. Primer and adhesion promoter selection. Mix ratio, pot life and cure schedules for 2K systems. Order of operations - coating over print versus print over coating - and why that choice is rarely reversible. Coating defects: orange peel, fish eyes, pinholes, poor levelling. 

Testing. Cross-hatch adhesion, abrasion, chemical and sweat resistance, and accelerated ageing - enough to establish whether a finish actually holds rather than assuming it will. 

Plus: 

- An engineering degree. B. E. /B. Tech in Printing Technology, Polymer or Plastics Engineering, Mechanical, Chemical or Production. Printing Technology and Polymer Engineering map most closely to this role; a CIPET background is directly relevant on the materials side
 - 12+ years in industrial or digital printing production, with genuine function ownership rather than supervision alone
 - Defect diagnosis you can demonstrate - separating machine, ink, substrate, file, operator and environment as causes rather than guessing
 - Colour management fundamentals, fluent enough to challenge the specialist who owns them
 - Quality improvement with numbers - a defect rate you reduced, and how
 - Equipment selection and commissioning, with capital accountability
 - Demonstrated team building - you've hired, structured and grown a production team, not just inherited one
 - A training system you built, with evidence it worked: skill matrices, certification, limit samples, or whatever you used
 - Leadership across shifts and across technical specialists who know their speciality better than you do
 - Fluent Hindi; working English

Good to have: injection moulding exposure, coating line operation, metals and glass decoration, high-mix short-run environments, screen or pad printing, IMD/IML, drinkware or promotional product decoration. 

Tell us: one print defect you root-caused where the obvious answer turned out to be wrong, one adhesion or coating failure you traced to a material cause, one quality metric you moved with before and after numbers, one operator you developed into something more, and the specific processes, substrates and coatings you've personally run.

Company Description Modutec Ready Panels Pvt Ltd designs and manufactures modular switchboard enclosure systems that simplify panel building for domestic and international markets. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Bengaluru, India, the company focuses on modular technology, standardized components, and flexible configurations to help panel builders streamline fabrication, assembly, and logistics. Its portfolio includes modular LV switchboard enclosures, bayable systems, outdoor and wall-mounted enclosures, and modular accessories. The MODDIS platform supports Form 3 and Form 4 configurations, backed by extensive type testing to IEC 61439 and IEC/TR 61641, with high performance ratings and global-standard protection. Modutec serves customers across Africa, Australia, New Zealand, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East, and offers technical support, training, documentation, and compliance guidance to panel builders, system integrators, consultants, and distribution partners. 

Role Description The Mechanical Design Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in the Greater Bengaluru Area, responsible for leading the mechanical design function for modular switchboard enclosure systems. This role oversees concept development, detailed design, and engineering documentation for enclosure products, ensuring compliance with relevant standards and performance requirements. Day-to-day responsibilities include managing a design team, reviewing and approving CAD models and drawings, coordinating with electrical engineering, production, supply chain, and quality teams, and supporting type testing and product validation activities. The Mechanical Design Manager will optimize designs for manufacturability, flat-pack logistics, and assembly efficiency, while driving continuous improvement in design processes, tools, and standards. The role also involves collaborating with sales and application engineering to provide technical support on enclosure selection, customization, and project-specific solutions.

data.title: Analytics Lead – Data, AI & Automation
data.description:
Job Title: Analytics Lead - Data, AI & Automation

Location: New Delhi, India

Experience: 5-8 years

About MARS Cosmetics: 

MARS Cosmetics is a globally recognized beauty brand that thrives on innovation, diversity, and empowering individuals through high-quality beauty solutions. Headquartered in New Delhi, MARS Cosmetics is committed to offering groundbreaking products that meet the ever-evolving needs of consumers worldwide. 

About the Role: 

We are looking for a technically strong, hands-on Analytics Lead to build MARS Cosmetics' data intelligence capabilities. 

You will be responsible for organising data across business systems, developing automated data pipelines, integrating AI tools and LLMs, and building Python-based systems that proactively generate actionable business insights. 

Our objective is to move beyond conventional dashboards towards AI-powered, automated and event-driven business intelligence. 

This is a hands-on engineering and analytics role, not a traditional reporting or dashboard management position. 

Key Responsibilities: 

1. Data Engineering & Architecture

- Integrate and consolidate data from ERP, marketplaces, Shopify, distributor systems, marketing platforms and internal applications. 
 - Design and maintain reliable data pipelines, databases and analytical data models. 
 - Establish data quality, consistency and governance standards. 
 - Build scalable infrastructure that makes business data easily accessible for analytics and AI applications. 2. AI & LLM Integration

- Integrate structured business data with AI tools and LLMs such as OpenAI, Claude and other models through APIs. 
 - Develop AI-powered analytical workflows that investigate business performance and generate meaningful insights. 
 - Build natural-language interfaces that allow business teams to query and analyse data. 
 - Evaluate and implement emerging AI tools to improve analytical capabilities. 3. Python Automation & Event-Driven Insights

- Develop Python and SQL-based scripts for automated data processing, analysis and reporting. 
 - Build systems that proactively detect anomalies, emerging trends and business opportunities. 
 - Automate root-cause investigations and generate actionable recommendations. 
 - Create event-driven alerts for situations such as declining SKU sales, unusual inventory movements, margin deterioration and changes in advertising performance. 
 - Deliver automated insights through email, Teams, dashboards and other business applications. 4. Business Intelligence & Analytics

- Develop analytical frameworks covering sales, profitability, marketing, inventory and operations. 
 - Define standardised KPIs and reusable analytical datasets across business functions. 
 - Collaborate with business teams to identify high-impact analytical problems and translate them into automated solutions. 
 - Build dashboards and reporting systems wherever necessary. 5. Technical Ownership & Leadership

- Independently design, code, deploy and maintain analytical systems. 
 - Establish best practices for testing, monitoring, documentation and security. 
 - Lead and mentor a lean team of data and analytics engineers. 
 - Prioritise initiatives based on business impact, scalability and execution speed. Required Skills: 

- Python: Advanced proficiency in Pandas, data processing, scripting, automation and API integrations. 
 - SQL & Databases: Strong SQL skills, data modelling and experience with relational databases or data warehouses. 
 - Data Engineering: Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines and integrating multiple data sources. 
 - AI/LLMs: Hands-on experience with LLM APIs, function calling, AI agents or AI-powered analytical workflows. 
 - Analytics: Strong statistical reasoning, anomaly detection and business problem-solving capabilities. 
 - Automation: Experience developing scheduled and event-driven workflows. 
 - Engineering: Experience deploying, monitoring and maintaining production-grade solutions. Good to Have: Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Power BI, dbt, workflow orchestration tools, and experience in e-commerce, FMCG or retail. 

Ideal Candidate: 

- A hands-on builder, not just a dashboard developer or analytics manager. 
 - Has independently built end-to-end data and analytical systems. 
 - Strong in both technical engineering and commercial problem-solving. 
 - Comfortable working with fragmented data and converting it into reliable, actionable intelligence. 
 - Curious, resourceful and capable of independently evaluating new tools and technologies. 
 - Demonstrates ownership, speed of execution and a preference for simple, scalable solutions. What Success Looks Like: 

Within the first 90 days, you should have: 

- Established reliable data pipelines and structured datasets for priority business functions. 
 - Developed automated systems to detect significant business anomalies and opportunities. 
 - Integrated analytical workflows with LLMs to generate evidence-backed insights. 
 - Deployed at least two automated intelligence workflows delivering actionable insights to business stakeholders. Why Join MARS?

- Opportunity to build an AI-native analytics function from the ground up. 
 - Work directly on high-impact business problems across multiple functions. 
 - Significant technical ownership and freedom to evaluate modern technologies. 
 - Build intelligent systems that influence real business decisions.

MARS Cosmetics is a globally recognized beauty brand that thrives on innovation, diversity, and empowering individuals through high-quality beauty solutions. We are looking for a hands-on Data Engineer to build and maintain the data infrastructure powering analytics, AI and automation at MARS Cosmetics.

You will work closely with the Analytics Lead - Data, AI & Automation to build scalable systems that transform fragmented business data into actionable intelligence.

 - Design efficient ETL/ELT processes for data extraction, transformation and storage.

- Write Python and SQL scripts for automated data processing, transformation and analytical calculations. 
 - Develop reusable functions and data services for automated business analysis. 
 - Support event-driven monitoring, anomaly detection and automated reporting workflows. 
 - Make structured datasets accessible to AI tools and LLMs through secure APIs and controlled data interfaces. 4. Engineering & Collaboration

- Collaborate with the Analytics Lead and existing Automation & AI team to develop scalable data solutions. 
 - Implement automated testing, pipeline monitoring and performance optimisation. 
 - Maintain clear technical documentation and version-controlled code.

- Python: Strong proficiency in Pandas, scripting, API integrations and data processing. 
 - SQL: Advanced querying, joins, aggregations, database design and optimisation. 
 - Databases: Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server or equivalent. 
 - Data Engineering: Hands-on experience developing ETL/ELT pipelines and integrating multiple data sources. 
 - APIs & Automation: Experience with REST APIs, authentication, data synchronisation and scheduled workflows. 
 - Engineering Practices: Git, debugging, automated testing and production deployment. Good to Have: 

- Experience with Azure, Microsoft Fabric, dbt, Airflow, Dagster or equivalent tools. 
 - Familiarity with LLM APIs and AI-powered analytical applications. 
 - Experience working with e-commerce, FMCG, retail or ERP datasets. Ideal Candidate: 

- A strong hands-on engineer who enjoys building reliable data systems. 
 - Has independently designed, developed and deployed production data pipelines. 
 - Comfortable handling large, fragmented and inconsistent datasets. 
 - Strong problem-solving ability with attention to data accuracy and reliability. 
 - Resourceful, execution-oriented and comfortable working in a lean, fast-moving team. 
 - Interested in leveraging AI and modern development tools to accelerate engineering workflows. What Success Looks Like: 

Within the first 90 days, you should have: 

- Integrated priority business data sources into a centralised analytical platform. 
 - Built reliable, automated data pipelines with appropriate monitoring and error handling. 
 - Developed clean, standardised and reusable datasets supporting business analytics. 
 - Enabled the Analytics Lead to build automated, AI-powered insights on top of trustworthy data. Why Join MARS?

- Opportunity to build the data infrastructure for a rapidly growing Indian cosmetics brand. 
 - Work on real-world engineering challenges across e-commerce, sales, supply chain and finance. 
 - Significant technical ownership and freedom to adopt modern tools and technologies. 
 - Be part of a lean team building AI-native business intelligence capabilities.

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.

You will work closely with colleagues across Editorial, Marketing, Customer Services, and external technology partners, helping to deliver high-quality digital solutions that support OUP's mission of advancing knowledge and learning. 

The role offers exposure to product management, agile delivery, digital content management, quality assurance, customer-focused product enhancements, and educational technology. It is ideal for someone who enjoys solving problems, building innovative solutions, and contributing to the ongoing growth of digital learning products. 

  Opportunity As Analyst, DPM, you will support the delivery of digital products throughout their lifecycle, ensuring high-quality user experiences and timely product releases. 

Key responsibilities include: 

- Supporting the development of new products, product features, and innovative ideas, including building quick MVPs to help stakeholders visualize product concepts. 
 - Developing feature backlogs and user stories, agreeing priorities with stakeholders, and supporting agile delivery of product enhancements within agreed timelines. 
 - Managing the sourcing, ingestion, and delivery of learning content for digital products.

 - Supporting product development processes and ensuring adherence to quality standards.

 - Ensuring compliance requirements, NDA obligations, and third-party processes are followed in accordance with group guidelines. 
 - Coordinating effectively with Editorial, Marketing, Customer Support, Finance teams, and third-party vendor partners.   Impact This role is critical in ensuring OUP's digital products are delivered efficiently, maintained to high standards, and continually improved to meet customer needs. By supporting product development, content delivery, quality assurance, and stakeholder collaboration, you will help drive successful product launches, improved customer experiences, and operational excellence across OUP's digital portfolio.

data.title: DevOps and MLOps Engineer
data.description:
Hyperworks Imaging is a cutting-edge technology company based out of Bengaluru, India since 2016. We are seeking an ambitious junior ML researcher who wants to do more than fine-tune off-the-shelf models. In this role, you will build, train and deploy new LLMs, SLMs, VLMs and AI agents from the ground up - designing architectures, running training experiments, and shipping models into production systems that power the AI assistants of the future. 

We are seeking a high-ownership DevOps & MLOps Engineer with 2-3 years of hands-on experience to own and manage our hybrid cloud infrastructure across Azure (Primary Preference) and AWS (Secondary). In this role, you will be responsible for multi-environment cloud provisioning (Dev, Staging, Production), automated wildcard subdomain routing, API Gateways, centralized logging stacks, database reliability, cloud cost governance, and text-to-speech (TTS) AI pipelines across multiple internal applications. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Cloud Infrastructure & Automation (IaC)

- Manage secure multi-environment (Dev/Staging/Prod) provisioning on Azure and AWS using Terraform modules. 
 - Standardize container build workflows and infrastructure state management. 2. Networking, Subdomain Routing & Gateways

- Automate wildcard subdomains, CNAME mappings, and ingress routing. 
 - Manage API Gateways (Azure APIM, AWS API Gateway, NGINX, Traefik, Kong). 
 - Handle SSL/TLS lifecycles via Cloudflare, Azure Key Vault, or AWS ACM. 3. AI, Speech & Storage Pipelines

- Maintain low-latency TTS integration pipelines (AWS Polly, Azure Speech Services). 
 - Optimize AWS S3/Azure Blob Storage lifecycle rules, access controls, and CDN delivery. 4. Database Administration & Performance

- Manage, tune, and scale PostgreSQL and Redis databases. 
 - Configure PgBouncer, read-replicas, automated snapshots, and point-in-time recovery. 5. Cost Governance & Observability

- Audit/optimize Azure/AWS spending (Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, rightsizing). 
 - Maintain centralized logging (ELK, Loki, CloudWatch) and metrics dashboards (Prometheus, Grafana). 6. Security, CI/CD & MLOps

- Enforce Zero-Trust IAM, secrets management (Azure Key Vault, AWS Secrets Manager), and OAuth/JWT auth. 
 - Manage CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) for Node. js/Python microservices. 
 - Deploy ML inference endpoints (MLflow, BentoML, SageMaker, Azure ML). 

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

- Experience Level: 2-3 Years
 - Educational Requirement: B. Tech / B. E. / B. S. in Computer Science, IT, or related technical field

Must Have Skills: 

- Experience: 2-3 years of proven hands-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Platform, or Systems Engineering in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Hybrid Cloud: Direct experience managing workloads on AWS (Primary) and exposure to Azure as well. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: High proficiency in writing declarative, modular Terraform code. 
 - Database Management: Practical experience with PostgreSQL and Redis administration, query tuning, and automated backup strategies. 
 - Networking & Gateways: Hands-on setup of API Gateways, wildcard DNS routing, and SSL certificate management. 
 - Audio & Cloud Storage: Experience integrating cloud Speech/TTS APIs (AWS Polly / Azure Speech) and handling cloud object storage (S3 / Azure Blob). 
 - Cost Optimization: Demonstrated track record of auditing and reducing cloud expenditure across AWS or Azure. 
 - Logging & Monitoring: Setup and management of centralized logging (Loki, ELK, or CloudWatch) and metrics collection (Prometheus + Grafana). 
 - Containers & CI/CD: Hands-on expertise with Docker and automated pipeline creation via GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps. 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (Nice-To-Have)

- Certifications: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate, or HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate. 
 - MLOps Frameworks: Prior exposure to model deployment frameworks (MLflow, BentoML, TorchServe, Azure ML, or AWS SageMaker). 
 - Backend Debugging: Ability to read and debug Node. js or Python backend code. Please note that we will reach out to ONLY those applicants who satisfy the criteria listed above. 

SALARY DETAILS: commensurate with experience

JOINING DATE: Immediate

JOB TYPE: full time

CONTACT: naveen@hyperworksimaging. com

The successful candidate will embed security and reliability in engineering and operational practices, reduce risk before it becomes an incident, and use automation and AI-driven operations to improve service health and response. 

Key Responsibilities

Production Operations and Reliability

- Own the reliability, availability, performance, and operational readiness of production services. 
 - Establish clear service ownership, operational accountability, escalation paths, and on-call practices. 
 - Lead incident response, service restoration, root-cause analysis, and follow-through on corrective actions. 
 - Define and improve service-level objectives, service-level indicators, error budgets, and operational health measures. 
 - Strengthen change, release, capacity, resilience, backup, and disaster-recovery practices. 
 - Reduce recurring incidents and operational toil through engineering-led improvements. Cloud Infrastructure and Platform Engineering

- Set the direction for secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-aware cloud infrastructure. 
 - Lead the design and operation of cloud-native platforms, environments, networks, identity controls, and shared services. 
 - Promote infrastructure as code, standard platform patterns, self-service capabilities, and repeatable environment provisioning. 
 - Ensure platform design supports availability, recovery, observability, performance, and secure delivery. 
 - Guide capacity planning, cloud cost visibility, and optimization without compromising reliability or security. SRE and Operational Excellence

- Build and mature SRE practices that make reliability measurable and part of day-to-day engineering. 
 - Develop observability across services using actionable metrics, logs, traces, alerts, and service health views. 
 - Improve deployment safety through progressive delivery, automated checks, rollback readiness, and resilient release practices. 
 - Use incident trends, operational data, and post-incident reviews to guide prioritized improvements. 
 - Create a culture of learning and accountability in which incidents lead to durable fixes. DevSecOps and Security Engineering

- Embed security into software delivery, infrastructure management, and operational workflows. 
 - Lead practical security engineering across identity and access, secrets, configuration, network controls, workload protection, and data safeguards. 
 - Build automated security checks into build, test, deployment, and infrastructure pipelines. 
 - Establish continuous monitoring and threat detection with clear triage, escalation, and response ownership. 
 - Drive vulnerability prevention and remediation through asset visibility, risk-based prioritization, patching, secure configuration, and dependency controls. 
 - Strengthen cloud security posture and address risks across applications, platforms, identities, and operational processes. 
 - Partner with product and engineering teams to resolve security issues early and sustainably. 
 - Ensure audits and ISMS obligations are supported by effective technical controls and evidence, while keeping operational security and risk reduction at the center. Automation and AI-Driven Operations

- Set an automation strategy that reduces manual work, improves consistency, and speeds up safe delivery and recovery. 
 - Apply AI and advanced analytics to suitable operational use cases, such as anomaly detection, alert correlation, incident triage, capacity forecasting, and knowledge retrieval. 
 - Establish appropriate safeguards, human oversight, validation, and access controls for AI-supported operational workflows. 
 - Measure automation outcomes through reduced toil, faster response, fewer repeat incidents, and improved service health. Organization and Leadership

- Build, develop, and retain strong teams across production operations, cloud infrastructure, SRE, DevSecOps, and security engineering. 
 - Define organizational structure, role clarity, decision rights, service ownership, and measurable accountability. 
 - Develop senior technical leaders and create growth paths for engineering and operations talent. 
 - Work closely with product, application engineering, architecture, risk, and business leaders to align technology priorities with business outcomes. 
 - Communicate operational risk, service health, security posture, and investment needs clearly to executive stakeholders. 
 - Lead through technical credibility, sound judgment, collaboration, and consistent follow-through. Required Technical Qualifications

- 20+ years of progressive experience in technology, infrastructure, production operations, cloud engineering, reliability, or security, including substantial leadership responsibility. 
 - Demonstrated hands-on technical leadership in cloud-native production environments. 
 - Strong understanding of cloud architecture, distributed systems, networking, identity, compute, storage, and platform operations. 
 - Experience designing and operating containerized and orchestrated workloads, such as Kubernetes or comparable platforms. 
 - Practical knowledge of infrastructure as code, configuration management, CI/CD, source control, and deployment automation. 
 - Deep working understanding of SRE principles, observability, service-level objectives, incident management, resilience, and disaster recovery. 
 - Experience implementing security controls in cloud and software delivery environments, including identity management, secrets, vulnerability management, secure configuration, and threat detection. 
 - Experience establishing continuous monitoring, alerting, incident response, and security operations practices. 
 - Ability to assess architecture and operational risk, make trade-offs, and guide teams through complex technical decisions. 
 - Familiarity with cloud cost management and capacity planning in production environments. Required Leadership Qualifications

- Experience leading multiple technical functions and managing managers or senior technical leaders. 
 - Track record of building technically strong teams with clear ownership and measurable outcomes. 
 - Ability to stay close to technical decisions while setting direction and enabling teams to execute. 
 - Proven leadership in major incidents, security events, operational change, or complex service transformations. 
 - Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risk and investment priorities to executive and non-technical audiences. 
 - A practical, engineering-led approach to governance, risk management, and compliance. 
 - Demonstrated ability to build trust and work across organizational boundaries. Preferred Skills and Experience

- Experience leading operations and security in a high-scale, high-availability, or business-critical environment. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy infrastructure and operational models into cloud-native platforms and practices. 
 - Familiarity with zero-trust principles, security architecture, threat modeling, and secure software supply chains. 
 - Experience with chaos engineering, resilience testing, game days, and recovery exercises. 
 - Experience using AI or machine learning to improve operational monitoring, incident workflows, or engineering productivity. 
 - Familiarity with security and service-management frameworks or standards relevant to the organization. 
 - Relevant cloud, security, SRE, or leadership certifications. Success Measures

Success in this role will be assessed through sustained improvements in: 

- Production service availability, reliability, performance, and recovery readiness. 
 - Incident frequency, severity, time to detect, time to restore, and recurrence rates. 
 - Adoption and quality of service-level objectives, observability, and service ownership. 
 - Vulnerability exposure, remediation timelines, secure configuration, and cloud security posture. 
 - Security monitoring coverage, alert quality, response readiness, and closure of corrective actions. 
 - Automation coverage, reduction in manual toil, and safe deployment frequency. 
 - Resilience, backup, disaster-recovery, and continuity test outcomes. 
 - Cloud cost visibility and efficiency while meeting reliability and security requirements. 
 - Team capability, role clarity, leadership depth, and accountability across the functions. 
 - The ability of engineering teams to adopt secure and reliable practices as part of normal delivery.

data.title: Engineer II, Systems
data.description:
This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

Your Role At Baxter

The role of Engineer II , Product Owner is to contribute in design and development of a product or solution, from conception to design and verification/validation. You will apply expert technical knowledge and engineering principles in the development of products and solutions. You will collaborate with cross functional team for technical issues, design changes, design reviews, and complex problem resolution

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and translate customer, business, regulatory, performance, usability, and safety requirements into clear system requirements and product specifications. 
 - Lead requirements engineering activities, including use case development, requirements decomposition, traceability, and change management using tools such as DOORS, Polarion, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Apply systems engineering principles to balance design trade-offs, identify risks early, and support informed technical decision-making. 
 - Execute and support risk management activities in accordance with ISO 14971, ensuring product safety and regulatory compliance throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - Partner with cross-functional engineering teams to resolve technical challenges and drive optimal technology solutions. 
 - Support Usability Engineering and Human Factors activities, ensuring compliance with IEC 62366 and relevant FDA guidance. 
 - Apply reliability and robustness engineering principles to enhance product performance, quality, and customer experience. 
 - Develop high-quality technical documentation that effectively communicates system architecture, requirements, design decisions, and development outcomes. 
 - Collaborate closely with software, hardware, and systems teams to support successful product integration and development testing. 
 - Work with Verification & Validation (V&V) teams to define comprehensive verification strategies and test plans that ensure thorough requirements coverage. 
 - Provide technical leadership and expertise to help projects achieve key objectives related to quality, cost, schedule, and regulatory compliance. 
 - Contribute to the successful delivery of innovative healthcare solutions by championing best practices in systems engineering, risk management, and product development. 

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - 3-6 years of experience in Systems Engineering, with a strong focus on electro-mechanical product development. 
 - Experience supporting the development of complex products within highly regulated industries, preferably medical devices. 
 - Working knowledge of FDA regulations, Medical Device Regulation (MDR), and applicable quality and regulatory standards. 
 - Experience with requirements management, systems engineering processes, and product lifecycle development. 
 - Familiarity with Usability Engineering and Human Factors Engineering methodologies. 
 - Understanding of design and development tools and methodologies such as QFD (Quality Function Deployment), Pugh Matrix, CTQ (Critical to Quality), Design for Reliability (DFR), and Design for Excellence (DFX). 
 - Knowledge of FDA, ISO, and IEC standards, including design controls, risk management, and product development best practices. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate complex technical challenges and recommend effective solutions. 
 - Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and successfully deliver project objectives within quality, cost, and schedule expectations. 
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic. 

Reasonable Accommodations

Baxter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information. 

Recruitment Fraud Notice

Baxter has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Baxter employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

data.title: Platform Engineer - Data Storage
data.description:
At Brevo, we're not just building a CRM. With our technology, we're helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers. 
From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection. 

As a certified B Corp, we're proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance. 

Today, more than 500, 000 businesses across 180 countries-from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin-trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches. 

In 2024, we reached €179M ARR with nearly 1, 000 team members worldwide. And we're just getting started!

Join us as a Platform Engineer to join our dynamic Data Storage team. The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of database technologies such as Postgres, MongoDB, ClickHouse, etc. , and a strong curiosity to learn how to manage and automate large-scale infrastructure in a distributed system environment. 

Your Impact at Brevo: 

- Design and implement data storage solutions that meet the performance, reliability, security, and scalability requirements of our software products, using automation tools such as Terraform and Ansible
 - Perform installation, configuration, parameter tuning, and monitoring of database technologies using automation tools like Ansible or Terraform
 - Monitor and optimise performance to ensure high availability and reliability
 - Develop and implement data backup and disaster recovery plans to safeguard against data loss and ensure business continuity
 - Collaborate with internal teams to understand hosting requirements and deliver solutions that meet business needs
 - Participate in automation for deployment pipelines to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention
 - Help diagnose and resolve production issues, ensuring minimal service disruption
 - Maintain comprehensive documentation of architecture, processes, and procedures
 - Participate in on-call rotations to provide timely incident response and support for production database environments, ensuring rapid resolution and minimal business impact

Who you are: 

- Experience between 4-8 years
 - Must have good knowledge of Linux
 - Must be well-versed in managing any of the data engines: NoSQL, SQL, RDBMS, Object Storage, File Storage (i. e. PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Clickhouse, ScyllaDB, Minio, etc. )
 - Must have a strong understanding of data backup and disaster recovery best practices and methodologies
 - Must have good knowledge of Ansible, Bash or Terraform for automation tasks
 - Must possess excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyse complex storage issues and develop effective solutions
 - Must be comfortable participating in on-call rotations, taking ownership of production incidents, and responding to critical database issues promptly outside of regular working hours

If you don't meet all the requirements below but believe this opportunity aligns with your expectations and experience, we still encourage you to apply. 
Why people love working at Brevo: 

- A place to grow, together: Join a diverse, international team in a modern office buzzing with energy and ideas
 - Practical perks for everyday balance: Cab Facility and per-day meal vouchers; Employee-friendly salary structure; 1. 4x pay on holidays/weekends for critical work; excellent referral program with high-value gift options (e. g. , bike, flight tickets)
 - Learning, every step of the way: Over 1, 55, 000 courses on Udemy, along with facilitator-led sessions, and personalised training programs tailored to individual and team needs
 - Flexible for life: A hybrid setup (2 days WFH), budget for your home workspace, and a generous leave policy to help you balance life and work effortlessly
 - Wellbeing that works: INR 10 Lakh medical insurance, maternity support, childcare facilities, and wellness bonuses to keep you and your family covered
 - A culture that cares: Annual company off-sites, inter-office trips, team outings, active social, green, and LGBTQIA+ communities, along with festive celebrations - all making Brevo a vibrant and inclusive workplace

Your candidate journey: 

- Round 1 - Screening call with the Talent Acquisition team
 - Round 2 - Face-to-Face Interview with our Deputy Platform Manager
 - Round 3 - Virtual Interview with the Hiring Manager
 - Round 4 - Virtual Interview with the VP of Platform

Whoever you are, wherever you're from, if this role speaks to you, we'd love to hear from you. 

At Brevo, we're proud to be an AI-first company. Still, every application is carefully reviewed by a member of our team. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: Digital Quality Analyst - Marketing Tech Team
data.description:
At Columbia, we're as passionate about the outdoors as you are. And while our gear is available worldwide, we're proud to be based in the Pacific Northwest, where natural wonders are our playground. 

Every product we make and every task we undertake is inspired by the famous words of our founder Gert Boyle: "It's perfect. Now make it better. " As pioneers of relentless improvement, we are constantly evolving. 

We believe the outdoors is ours to protect and strive to keep our planet healthy. We believe in empowering people to experience the outdoors to the fullest. 

And we believe in you. 

About The Position

Although we're an apparel and footwear-focused company, technology is central to everything we do. Columbia Sportswear's Digital Technology (CDT) group enables an IT infrastructure and applications across four global brands, a global supply chain, and 500+ geographically dispersed stores. These teams support in-store, mobile, and data platforms to enhance customer interface and service in an ever-evolving industry. 

The Quality Analyst II has a solid understanding of technology platforms and utilizes best practices among the quality team. This person reviews test strategies, authors test plans, and authors and executes test cases. The Quality Analyst II uses a variety of testing tools and methods and updates or creates automated test cases. The role executes automated test scripts and identify process and/ technology issues. 

How You'll Make a Difference

- Communication, Collaboration & Leadership: Communicates status in daily meetings, fosters constructive, collaborative and effective communication with others, both internally and externally. Actively participates in design discussions, planning, and retrospective reviews. Explains and simplifies complex information to others. 
 - Knowledge: Ensures processes are clearly documented. Demonstrates a basic understanding of the functions and technologies of the product. Learns about multiple test techniques, tools and business context and technologies of the software used. Addresses problems, proposes solutions, and takes action to resolve, referring more complex issues to senior employees. 
 - Metrics: Creates and monitors status dashboards for tracking team progress
 - Quality Standards: Drives analysis of post release quality and defect escapes and implements improvements based on the results of analysis. Completes straightforward projects and provides input for enhancements to improve test coverage and processes. Assesses the testability of components and features built by development teams. Works with project team to establish quality standards or metrics and identify risks. 
 - Test Strategy & Planning: Identifies salient test cases based on product domain knowledge and traceability to use cases, enabling on-time sprint deployments. Writes effective and efficient test scripts and test cases. Reviews of test plans are thoughtful and considerate of the customer and time frames needed for releases. 
 - Test Execution: Ensures thorough and complete resolution and closure of tickets once deployed to production. Assists developers in desk checks and testing. Works with the team to ensure code is tested at the appropriate level, assists in gaining efficiencies. Identifies and prevents defects early. Proactively works to identify the root cause of problems and identifies efficient ways to reproduce issues. Contributes to bug triage and prioritization processes. 
 - Mentorship: Provides peer level technical guidance for team members. Helps more junior team members learn, grow and contribute to the team. 

YOU ARE

- Genuinely curious - you ask why, not just whether. You want to understand why a tag fires in a specific sequence, what the Liquid personalization token is supposed to render for a given profile, and what a consent mode change means downstream for pixel data. You treat every testability gap as a signal worth investigating, not an obstacle to work around. 
 - Shift-left by default. You don't wait for a build to find problems. You read acceptance criteria like an auditor - spotting what's missing, what's ambiguous, and what will create a defect if it isn't clarified before dev starts. Refinement is where your value shows up first. 
 - A master of async defect communication. You file bugs the way a distributed team needs you to - self-contained, structured, and immediately actionable. A QA defect in your queue is never a mystery that needs a Zoom call to decode. Your documentation is your reputation. 
 - Globally minded, with experience working on geographically distributed teams. You understand the discipline, cadence, and over-communication required to make a US-India collaboration genuinely cohesive - and you've built those habits in practice. 
 - Methodical and detail-oriented - you understand that a missed pixel fire or a broken personalization token has real downstream consequences for marketing measurement and campaign performance. You bring that care to every test case you write and every defect you file. 
 - A collaborative teammate, comfortable working across engineering, product, analytics, and marketing functions within a globally distributed model. You don't stay in a QA swim lane - you go where quality needs attention. 

YOU HAVE

- Bachelor's Degree required Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered. 
 - 4+ years' experience
 - Proficiency with Postman for API testing - structured request/response validation, test data generation, role-based access checks, and SLA timing verification. 
 - Experience with email QA - template render testing using Email on Acid, Litmus, or equivalent; familiarity with ESP platform testing (Zeta, Braze, Emarsys, or similar). 
 - Working knowledge of tag management QA - understanding what tag management systems do, how to use browser developer tools to validate tag fires, and how to read data layer objects against a specification. Experience with the Adobe Experience Platform Debugger or equivalent tag debugging tooling is strongly preferred. 
 - Solid understanding of agile/Scrum delivery - shift-left quality practices, sprint ceremony participation, Definition of Ready and Definition of Done as quality gates, QA sizing in sprint planning. 
 - Experience with Jira for defect tracking, defect lifecycle management, and sprint ticket status workflows. 
 - Experience testing across a multi-phase test lifecycle: QA → SIT → UAT → E2E → Production validation. 
 - Demonstrated experience working on a globally distributed or cross-timezone team - including a US-India GCC model, offshore delivery, or equivalent. Prior experience collaborating with remote stakeholders is strongly preferred. 
 - Strong written and verbal English communication skills - including the ability to write async-friendly defect reports, test status updates, and QA documentation that remote teammates can act on independently without a live call. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with Adobe Analytics validation - understanding how events, eVars, props, and conversion metrics are captured and how to confirm accuracy against a measurement plan (SDR). 
 - Familiarity with OneTrust or consent management platforms and how they gate tag firing (GDPR/CCPA context). 
 - Experience testing on Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) - navigating Business Manager for test data setup, order creation, and profile configuration. 
 - Knowledge of CI/CD pipeline integration for test automation - CircleCI, GitHub Actions, or equivalent; understanding of artifact reporting and suite segmentation (smoke, regression, integration). 
 - Exposure to Liquid templating in ESP platforms - ability to validate personalization logic and token rendering in email templates. 

#Hybrid

This job description is not meant to be an all-inclusive list of duties and responsibilities, but constitutes a general definition of the position's scope and function in the company.

Location: Remote (India)

About Notifi

Notifi is the AI-native platform that runs home service businesses. HVAC, plumbing and electrical shops use it to answer calls, book jobs, dispatch techs, send estimates, take payments and keep members on plan, all in one place. Iris, our AI voice agent, answers the phone and books the work. 

Shops are switching to Notifi from ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro and FieldEdge. Every release has to hold up for techs in the field and offices on the phone all day. That's where you come in. 

The role

We're hiring a QA Automation Engineer to own testing across our web app and our iOS and Android tech app. You'll build and run our Playwright regression suite, write end-to-end tests for the flows our customers depend on, and catch bugs before they reach a live shop. 

What you'll do

- Build and maintain a Playwright E2E suite in TypeScript for the web app
 - Write end-to-end tests for the core flows: call to job, dispatch, visit, estimate, invoice, payment
 - Run full regression before every release and turn failures into clear, reproducible bug reports
 - Wire the suite into CI so tests run on every pull request
 - Test the iOS and Android tech app on real devices and simulators
 - Test calling and texting: inbound, outbound, transfers, missed calls, voicemail
 - Write API tests for the backend endpoints behind each flow

You are the hub's performance and improvement engine. You will build the Intelligent Command Centre that gives leaders one real-time view of service health across every tower. You will also run the continuous improvement system that moves the hub from stable operations to best-in-class service. 

Key Responsibilities

- Transition and shared services set-up
 - Design the hub's performance framework: a KPI tree, SLA definitions, data sources and a reporting cadence shared by all towers. 
 - Capture and certify the pre-transition baselines for each country, so the hub can prove its value against the starting point. 
 - Support the transition PMO with readiness scorecards, go/no-go dashboards and hypercare tracking for every wave. 
 - Set up the Intelligent Command Centre, covering architecture, data pipelines, dashboards and alerting. 
 - Process ownership and service delivery
 - Run the ICC day to day, with real-time SLA, volume, backlog and escalation monitoring across R2P, R2H, Q2R and A2W. 
 - Lead the hub's governance rhythm: daily stand-ups, weekly tower reviews, monthly service reviews and quarterly business reviews with stakeholders. 
 - Own the hub-wide customer voice programme, including CSAT and NPS surveys, closing the loop with respondents, and reporting insight. 
 - Run hub-level capacity and productivity analytics to support resourcing decisions. 
 - Governance, risk and controls
 - Own the hub quality management system, covering process documentation standards, internal quality audits and control testing across towers. 
 - Maintain the hub risk register and the tracking of issues and actions. 
 - Build data governance for performance reporting so that there is one version of the truth. 
 - Continuous improvement and digital
 - Build and govern the hub-wide continuous improvement backlog. Prioritise by value and effort, and agree ownership with each GPO. 
 - Lead improvement projects using Lean, Six Sigma and process mining. Track benefits through to realised savings. 
 - Run the hub's automation and AI pipeline, from idea intake to business case, delivery and benefits tracking. 
 - Build a continuous improvement culture through training, recognition and a simple way for every employee to raise ideas. 
 - People leadership, performance and culture
 - Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave. 
 - Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state. 
 - Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings. 
 - Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots. 
 - Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day. 
 - Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers. 

What Success Looks Like

- First 90 days: hub KPI framework, baseline method and ICC design signed off. 
 - By go-live: ICC live with real-time dashboards for the first transition wave, and the governance rhythm running. 
 - Within 12-18 months: continuous improvement portfolio delivering measurable, validated benefits, with hub-wide dashboards trusted by global stakeholders. 

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

KPI

Indicative target

Hub-wide SLA adherence

≥ 95% across towers

Validated CI Benefits

Annual savings and hours released against target

Automation hours released

Increased year on year

Reporting timeliness and accuracy

100% on schedule

Hub CSAT / NPS

At or above target

Audit and quality findings

Closed within agreed timelines

CI participation

% of employees who submitted or delivered an improvement

Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines. 

Technical Skills

- Performance management and command-centre design for multi-tower shared services. 
 - Lean Six Sigma methods, including DMAIC, value-stream mapping and root-cause analysis. 
 - Data analytics and visualisation (Power BI or Tableau). SQL or data-modelling skills are an advantage. 
 - Process mining (Celonis, Signavio or similar) and automation pipeline management (RPA, AI). 
 - ITIL service level management and quality management systems. 
 - Benefits realisation and business case development. 

LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES

Customer-centric leadership

- Builds teams from zero
 - Drives change and adoption
 - Sound judgement under pressure
 - Influences without authority across countries
 - Data-led decision making
 - Coaches and develops talent
 - Holds a high bar on control

Essential

EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

- 15+ years of experience, including 7+ years in shared services performance, excellence or transformation roles. 
 - Has built and run an ICC, command centre or equivalent governance function. 
 - Has deployed continuous improvement frameworks across multi-tower shared services centres. 
 - Lean Six Sigma Black Belt. 
 - Master's degree in Business, HR, Engineering or a related field. 

Preferred

- Transition PMO experience
 - Process mining certification
 - Change management certification (Prosci or equivalent)

KEY STAKEHOLDERS

Hub Director, all tower GPOs, Global HR leadership, HR technology and data teams, Finance, Internal Audit, transformation partners.

data.title: Solutions Architect
data.description:
About the role

You will be the architect who wins the technical deal. Before a contract is signed, you show enterprise customers that their AI agents will work, at their scale and under their rules. You build the demos and proofs of concept, answer the architecture questions, and hand delivery a plan they can execute. This is a hands-on engineering role in front of customers. You write code most weeks and spend the rest with CIOs, platform teams and risk officers. You report to the Co-Founder and CTO. 

What you will do

• Discover: run technical discovery with CIOs, platform-engineering and risk teams at banks, insurers and asset managers. Map their systems, data and controls to the agent use cases that matter. 

• Demo: build tailored demos of agent workflows, using the customer's own scenarios where you can. 

• Prove: scope and deliver 2 to 6 week proofs of concept. Write the code, wire up integrations and measure results against agreed success criteria. 

• Design: produce reference architectures for agent deployment on AWS, Azure or GCP, covering identity, data access, observability and guardrails. 

• De-risk: answer security, compliance and model-risk questionnaires (SOC 2, data residency, audit logging, human-in-the-loop controls). 

• Hand off: turn every won proof of concept into a delivery plan our forward-deployed engineers can run from day one. 

• Feed back: bring field patterns to product and build reusable demo assets, templates and starter agents. 

What we are looking for

• 8+ years in software engineering, solutions engineering, solutions architecture or forward-deployed engineering for enterprise customers. 

• Hands-on experience building LLM applications or agents: prompt and tool design, RAG, evaluation, and at least one agent framework. 

• Strong Python, plus working knowledge of APIs, containers and one major cloud. 

• Comfort in regulated environments, where governance, auditability and access control decide the deal. 

• Consulting experience: client-facing work, scoping engagements and running workshops with enterprise stakeholders. 

• Understanding of tool calling and MCP, guardrails and policy controls, access management, observability and audit trails. 

Nice to have

• Experience selling to, or working inside, financial services. 

• Kubernetes, observability or AIOps tooling. 

• AWS, Azure or GCP certifications. 

• A public demo, repo, talk or post about something you built with agents. 

Location: Chennai, India (Chennai office), hybrid 3 days on-site, with travel to customer sites as needed.

Moring helps enterprises put AI agents into production safely.

Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www. synchrony. com. 

Organizational Overview

Synchrony's Risk Team provides independent oversight of Synchrony's risk-taking activities to ensure safety and soundness, meet regulatory and legal requirements, and manage risks to the risk-appetite of the Board. Risk is responsible for independently assessing, quantifying, and overseeing risks & providing effective challenge . Risk serves as Synchrony's Second Line of Defense. 

Overall, Risk Team oversees and manages the Risk Program to support the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues and challenges. Results are consistent with the respective strategic uses and complying with related overall risk, risk testing policies, standards, procedures as well as regulations. Our Risk organization consists of 4 pillars: Compliance, Credit & Financial Risk, Enterprise Risk and Operational Risk. Each of the pillars play a vital role in managing Risk and supports the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues, and challenges. 

Role Summary/ Purpose

The eGRC Solution Architect is an individual contributor who partners with one or more Agile teams within the Risk Infrastructure delivery team to support Risk & Compliance stakeholder s . This role translates enterprise GRC objectives into technology solutions that automate, standardize, and integrate governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance processes. The architect designs end-to-end solutions, decomposes complex objectives into actionable deliverables, evaluates and aligns technical standards and tools, and provides technical leadership across the full delivery lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and deliver GRC solutions: Serve as the GRC technical architecture lead supporting multiple concurrent initiatives, designing end-to-end solutions that span GRC functions, provide design guidance, conduct architecture reviews, and resolving complex technical decisions. 
 - Translate requirements into technical solutions: Work with stakeholders, including Risk and Compliance leaders , to understand GRC requirements and translate them into actionable, technology-based solutions . 
 - Lead technical implementations : Guide and support development teams and related technical resources through the configuration and deployment of GRC software platforms. 
 - Provide technical and architectural guidance: Serve as the subject matter expert for GRC frameworks, processes (e. g. , RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments), enabling technologies, and industry best practices. Partner with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions; lead architecture/design reviews; mentor teammates ; and maintain architecture diagrams and technical documentation.

 - GRC platform expertise : 5+ years of hands-on advanced configuration/development experience with leading GRC platforms , including ServiceNow IRM, Archer , SAI360 . 
 - Solution architecture experience: 5+ years designing and delivering end-to-end GRC solutions on ServiceNow, Archer, or SAI360, including target-state architecture, standards, and non-functional requirements.

Desired Skills/Knowledge

data.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
data.description:
About the rolePravar AI builds governed agent infrastructure for wealth management firms. Our customers are financial services firms, RIAs and asset managers who will demand varying levels of control of their data - On-Prem, Client VPC, Airgapped, or Multi-tenant. These require enterprise grade security, they can see, permission, and audit every action it takes. That requirement shapes how we deploy. Each customer comes with a variety of deployment needs, cost optimization and security.   

You would own the machinery that makes this repeatable. The job is to take a stack with many moving parts, including agent runtimes, policy and redaction layers, evaluation pipelines, and vector stores, and make it install cleanly in places we don't control. You would also keep it running once it's there. We are a small, fast team, so you will have real influence over how we build, and you will ship things in your first month. 

What you'll do
 - Design and run the pipelines, infrastructure code, and release process that take Pravar AI from commit to customer environment. 
 - Write Terraform and Helm packaging that behaves the same way on AWS, Azure, GCP, and bare-metal Kubernetes. 
 - Build deployment paths that hold up under customer change-control and approval gates. 
 - Treat the air-gapped install as a design constraint from the start, not a special case added later. 
 - Manage observability and reliability across those environments: metrics, logs, traces, alerting, and runbooks. 
 - Own the SLOs we commit to, and lead the incident reviews that follow when we miss one. 
 - Own backup, failover, and disaster recovery, and test them on a schedule rather than trusting the diagram. 
 - Build vulnerability scanning, dependency checks, and image validation into the pipeline. 
 - Manage secrets and certificates, and support customer-managed encryption keys. 
 - Help collect the evidence our SOC 2 and ISO/IEC 42001 work requires, and make that collection routine. 
 - Build the tooling behind our delegated support model: just-in-time access, session recording, and least-privilege roles. 
 - Work at the cutting edge of product availability and enterprise requirements, with room to try new things. 
 - 
What we're looking for
 - Four to six years in DevOps, platform engineering, or SRE, with at least two years running production systems that other people depended on. 
 - Real experience deploying in both worlds. You have shipped to public cloud and to customer-controlled or on-premises infrastructure, and you know how different the two feel when something breaks at 2 a. m. 
 - Strong Kubernetes and Helm skills, including ingress, autoscaling, network policy, and upgrades without downtime. 
 - Infrastructure as code in practice. Terraform or something equivalent, written for reuse and not just for a single environment. 
 - CI/CD fluency in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or ArgoCD, along with sound release habits: versioning, promotion, rollback. 
 - Working knowledge of observability (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenSearch, or comparable) and a feel for what is worth alerting on. 
 - Solid Linux, networking, and scripting. You can debug DNS, TLS, and IAM problems without a long detour, and you write Bash or Python when a task calls for it. 
 - A security-minded habit of mind. Least privilege, secrets handling, and encryption in transit and at rest are things you do by default. 
 - Comfort with ambiguity and pace. You make a reasonable decision with incomplete information, write down why, and revisit it when you learn more. 

Desired Requirements  
 - Experience in regulated settings such as banking, fintech, or healthcare.   
 - AWS/ GCP DevOps certification.   
 - Experience of running on-prem infrastructure.

data.title: Software Product Assurance Engineer
data.description:
ReOrbit is looking for a motivated and detail oriented Software Product Assurance Engineer for Space Systems to join our growing team. 

As our new Software Product Assurance Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and safety of software throughout the spacecraft development lifecycle. You will define and evolve software product assurance requirements, adapted to lean and agile development practices, while applying a criticality-based approach where the level of rigour is aligned with the safety and mission impact of each software item. 

You will work closely with software, systems, hardware, AIT, Product Assurance and supplier teams to ensure that software development, verification, configuration management and change control activities meet the required quality and product assurance standards. 

It's an exciting chance to join a dynamic start-up, with the opportunity to make a real impact, to reach our goal of pushing the boundaries of space data transfer. 

Responsibilities

- Define and evolve software product assurance requirements across the development lifecycle, adapted to lean and agile development practices. 
 - Apply a criticality-based approach to software product assurance, scaling the level of rigour according to the safety and mission impact of the software item. 
 - Develop, implement, monitor and review Software Product Assurance (SW PA) plans. 
 - Oversee and participate in verification and validation (V&V) activities according to defined V&V plans. 
 - Support Independent Verification and Validation (IV&V) activities, working with IV&V personnel to mitigate software risks and enhance safety and quality. 
 - Help drive internal and external reviews of development plans and software designs to ensure seamless integration with the satellite system. 
 - Participate in the analysis and evaluation of software designs, including change impact analysis and regression testing, particularly for COTS software. 
 - Support Product Assurance activities across engineering and flight models and associated infrastructure, ensuring documentation and objective evidence are captured consistently. 
 - Contribute to estimating and tracking the expected reliability and availability of the satellite platform as part of Product Assurance reporting. 
 - Support Product Assurance follow-up on supplier discrepancies and defects, ensuring corrective actions are documented and tracked. 
 - Support engineering change control, including understanding the Class I / Class II concept and ensuring the required approvals are obtained. 
 - Be willing to travel to supplier facilities for audits when required. 

Skills And Requirements

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in aerospace, electronics, information technology, systems engineering and minimum 8 years of work experience in a similar relevant field. 
 - Knowledge of software development processes and lifecycles. 
 - Knowledge of software verification techniques, including testing and inspections. 
 - Knowledge of software configuration management fundamentals and related tools. 
 - Clear conceptual understanding of the difference between proactive Product Assurance and retrospective Quality Control. 
 - Familiarity with non-conformances, deviations, waivers, and corrective/preventive actions, including RCA and CAPA, at a basic level. 
 - Awareness of SW Product Assurance principles and the ECSS/Q Product Assurance philosophy. 
 - Ability to constructively challenge engineering decisions and ask, "What is the risk?"
 - Comfortable working cross-functionally with systems, hardware, software, AIT and suppliers. 
 - Clear and effective technical writing and communication skills in English, both written and spoken. 
 - Previous exposure to satellite technologies through an internship, thesis, or student satellite project (e. g. CubeSat, nanosat or payloads), with an understanding of software Product Assurance concepts such as verification matrices, test coverage and configuration management. 
 - Introductory knowledge of risk management and single-point failure identification, with proficiency in C/C++ and Python and familiarity with NASA software assurance standards such as NASA-STD-8739. 8 and NASA-GB-8719. 13. 

What does ReOrbit do?

ReOrbit builds the foundation for the next generation of space applications by transforming satellites into truly intelligent, interconnected platforms, defined by software. Our satellite design philosophy revolves around the idea that satellites must network, communicate with each other and thus improve mission efficiency. How can this be achieved? Thanks to a flexible software-first architecture, where all these aspects are dealt with upfront in the mission concept, as integrated functionalities. 

ReOrbit's top-notch team of software engineers and system architects develop in-house software, procure hardware from the best-in-class suppliers, and seamlessly integrate the components to create flexible and secure satellites. Today, we are a rapidly growing company building a very strong multidisciplinary team to support our activities. We are headquartered in Helsinki, Finland with a subsidiaries in Bristol, UK, Bariloche, Argentina and Bengaluru, India. 

Working at ReOrbit

At ReOrbit, we are focused on building a strong team as we believe nothing can be accomplished without innovative, humble and curious minds working together on a common goal. We're all about fostering an inclusive, dynamic environment where equality and diversity are our strength. 

We offer

- Challenging but rewarding environment - you will thrive if you are always reflecting on how to make things better. Your ideas will be heard. 
 - Ambitious and supportive network of people, who are motivated to change the space industry, bringing expertise from both classic and new space . 
 - Benefits such as lunch vouchers, events, parties, occupational health care and additional health insurance - but most importantly a possibility to be a part of a unique and diverse team, connected by similar mindset and sense of humor. 
 - We like to spend time together! You can choose activities whichever is to your liking - runOrbit, climbOrbit; become ping pong or board games champion. 

Join us in our journey of building software enabled satellites for secure communications

and, thus, creating the most compelling in space data flow company of the new space era. 

The Company may require a security clearance for certain positions. Any such security clearance will be conducted in accordance with applicable law and the Company's relevant policies

For agencies: We do not accept unsolicited CVs for our open vacancies. Any CV sent to our team unsolicited will reserve us the right to pursue a candidate without obligation to the sender. All candidate submissions must be conducted through our official channels and in accordance with our terms of engagement.

This position is responsible for delivering high‐quality engineering design across multiple concurrent projects ranging from moderate‐scale assignments to major project work packages while ensuring cost‐effective execution aligned with contract specifications, safety requirements, and agreed project timelines. 

The role demands a commitment to technical excellence, proactive team guidance, and a strong focus on quality and timely delivery of day‐to‐day outputs

Responsibilities
