data.description:
Razorpay is one of India's leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we've since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India's digital payment revolution. 

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow. 

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that's redefining how money moves across Asia. 

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India's largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently. 

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India's unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region. 

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia. 

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you're curious, you'll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say "thank you. " Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you'll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future. 

The Role

A lead software development engineer at Razorpay is well-grounded - innovative, quality focussed, product thinker, and business conscious - not mere coders, of course, with deeper technical context and experience to build quality software. You should be able to see nuances and elements that others might not. Engineering creates a significant impact across different areas, considering the scale of our software product outreach. You're also expected to influence the culture of the company and help shape it in the right way. 

Roles And Responsibilities

- Be involved and drive product & design discussions. 
 - Help us scale our payment infrastructure to get every Indian to pay online. 
 - Help us make decisions to shape our REST APIs for developers worldwide. 
 - Contribute to open source as we set the standards for mobile payments. 
 - Be involved and drive product & design discussions. 
 - And, most importantly, brainstorm and create new directions that Razorpay can take in our quest to make online payments easy and accessible to all. 

Mandatory Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in Technology. 
 - A strong product design sense. 
 - Good experience in working with any of the programming languages like PHP, Python, Django, Golang, Java, C++
 - Understand end-user requirements, formulate use cases and come up with effective solutions. 
 - Good understanding of REST APIs and the web in general. 
 - Ability to build a feature from scratch & drive it to completion. 
 - A willingness to learn new technology, whatever lets you deliver the best product. 
 - Have a few weekend side projects up on GitHub
 - Have contributed to an open-source project
 - Have worked at a product company
 - Have a working knowledge of a backend programming language

Location: Bangalore

data.title: Staff Cloud Infra Engineer
data.description:
The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo. 

Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it. 

Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started. 

At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible. 

When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places. 

This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works

This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office. 

About The Role

You'll own a significant area of our cloud platform end to end - the Kubernetes and IaC foundations, the reliability of what runs on them, or the security controls that wrap them - across cloud regions and out to edge sites co-located with our satellite gateways. 

At Staff level we expect you to take a problem that's stated loosely, turn it into a plan, and deliver it without close supervision. You'll write the design doc, get it reviewed, build the thing, and then operate it. You're not expected to set direction for the whole org - but you are expected to shape it for your area, and to be the person others come to when that area is on fire. This is a hands-on role. The majority of your week is building. 

What you'll own

Platform and Kubernetes

- Operate and improve our multi-cluster, multi-region Kubernetes platform: cluster lifecycle, upgrades, workload isolation, networking, and resource management. 
 - Build and maintain infrastructure as code as a real engineering artifact - reviewed, tested, versioned, no manual drift. 
 - Extend our developer platform so shipping a service is fast and boring: golden paths, progressive delivery, environments that don't require a ticket. 
 - Own CI/CD pipelines for workloads ranging from ordinary stateless services to network functions with strict latency and availability requirements. 

Reliability and observability

- Instrument services against SLOs and build out the metrics, logs, and tracing needed to know whether we're meeting them. 
 - Participate in on-call, lead incidents in your area, and write postmortems that produce real changes rather than filed documents. 
 - Tune alerting so engineers trust it. Drive down toil through automation, deliberately and measurably. 
 - Contribute to capacity planning, failure-domain design, and DR testing for a network that can't take a casual maintenance window. 

Security and compliance infrastructure

- Implement and maintain platform security controls: least-privilege IAM, secrets management, network segmentation, image scanning, and supply-chain integrity. 
 - Automate the evidence that compliance requires, so audits are a query rather than a project. 
 - Work with Security on the requirements that come with operating inside a carrier's network. 

Technical contribution

- Write design docs for the systems you own and take them through review. 
 - Review code and infrastructure changes with an eye on operability, not just correctness. 
 - Mentor mid-level engineers and improve the team's practices by demonstrating them. 

What we're looking for

Required

- 7+ years in infrastructure, platform, DevOps, or SRE roles, with clear ownership of production systems that mattered. 
 - Strong production Kubernetes experience - not just deploying to it, but operating it: upgrades, networking, resource limits, and debugging failures that aren't in the documentation. 
 - Hands-on depth in AWS or GCP. Exposure to a second cloud, or to hybrid and edge infrastructure, is a real plus - our footprint isn't uniform and we need people who don't stall when the environment gets irregular. 
 - Solid infrastructure as code practice (Terraform or equivalent), applied where discipline actually mattered. 
 - Proficiency in at least one systems or automation language - Go or Python preferred - enough to build tooling, not only scripts. 
 - Direct production reliability ownership: you've carried a pager for something important, run incidents, and changed systems as a result. 
 - Working knowledge of infrastructure security: IAM, secrets, network policy, container hardening. 
 - Clear written communication. Design docs and postmortems are core to how this team works. 

Strongly Preferred

- Telecom or network infrastructure exposure - 5G core, cloud-native network functions, or carrier-grade availability requirements. 
 - Have some experience in managing databases and applications with High Availability of 99. 999%. 
 - Edge or on-premises infrastructure alongside public cloud, particularly sites with constrained connectivity. 
 - Compliance-adjacent environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or carrier security requirements). 
 - FinOps Cost engineering - you've meaningfully reduced cloud spend without degrading reliability. 
 - Working across distributed teams and time zones. 

What This Role Is Not

- Not a people-management role. This is an IC position and we intend to keep it one. 
 - Not a ticket queue. You'll be given problems, not tasks, and we expect you to scope them yourself. 
 - Not a greenfield rewrite. You'll be improving a system already carrying live traffic, which is harder and more interesting. 

Why this role is worth your time

Satellite direct-to-device is a genuinely new category, and the infrastructure patterns for it are not settled. The team is small enough that what you build is in production within weeks and visibly yours. If you're strong technically and looking for scope that would take years to get at a larger company, that's the trade we're offering. 

What We Offer

With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide and inclusive culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we also offer an attractive range of benefits such as: 

- Competitive compensation packages including a stock option based equity program
 - Comprehensive benefits plans
 - Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement
 - A generous time off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad
 - Once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to be part of developing and running the world's first commercial, live direct-to-device satellite network and service
 - Access to a world-class team and talent across tech domains: software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite and network virtualization
 - Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends Silicon Valley, Nordic and South Asia characteristics

EEO Statement

Skylo is an equal-opportunity employer and we celebrate diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, parent or caregiver status, political affiliation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. 

We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability.

data.title: Software Engineering Manager, Agentic Transformation for Graphics Systems
data.description:
Agents are changing how all software will be built. Agentic systems can perform substantial engineering work. It is still unproven whether they can be a reliable production capability at graphics systems' quality standards. Meanwhile, teams continue shipping new features, sustaining platforms, and meeting product commitments. Graphics drivers are a difficult proving ground. They involve large codebases, complex hardware-OS interactions, strict performance demands, broad application compatibility, and formal safety obligations in automotive. 

NVIDIA seeks an engineering manager in India to develop a new framework for agentic software development. You will test this model against one of our most fast-paced production software stacks. You will lead a graphics systems team through this transition and continue delivering the necessary product roadmap. Afterwards, you will transform effective practices into a reusable engineering product for other teams. You will grow the people, technology, and operating model together, creating an ambitious, highly engaged team that uses agents to surpass typical capacity. Success goes beyond one team's transformation; it establishes a production-proven system for software development in the agentic era at NVIDIA. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Develop and launch an end-to-end production model for agentic software development. Apply it to graphics systems, where agents perform engineering tasks from requirements and diagnosis to implementation, validation, review, and release. 
 - Define the technical strategy and transformation roadmap, turning fast paced agentic capabilities into dependable production execution and steadily growing the work agents complete end to end. 
 - Keep the team delivering its must-do graphics and display roadmap. This includes new features, platform enablement, performance, stability, and release commitments. At the same time, fundamentally evolve how that work gets done. 
 - Build an ambitious, highly engaged team that produces outstanding results, nurturing engineers and technical leaders alongside the technology and operating model. 
 - Transform the established agentic engineering system into a reusable product for other teams. Package its orchestration, skills, tools, evaluations, validators, and operating methods. Collaborate across NVIDIA to encourage adoption with measurable production outcomes. 

What We Need To See

- Demonstrated experience developing and delivering production software via autonomous engineering systems that include planning, tool application, retrieval, memory, evaluation, and validation, with agents handling a significant portion of actual engineering tasks. 
 - Demonstrated ability to turn a fast paced and ambiguous technical opportunity into a clear strategy, roadmap, and measurable production system while keeping an existing product roadmap on track. 
 - 10+ overall years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years of engineering management or technical leadership, with a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent experience. 
 - Strong technical foundations in complex production software, including systems architecture, debugging, validation, CI/CD, and release engineering. 
 - High-agency, results-focused leadership: you build an environment where people grow, enjoy doing their best work, and use technology to deliver results far beyond the team's traditional capacity. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Acknowledged advancements in the field of agentic systems, shown through peer-reviewed publications, widely embraced open-source projects, public benchmarks, or other externally validated outcomes. 
 - Experience with graphics or display driver development and technologies such as Vulkan, OpenGL ES, EGL, SurfaceFlinger, HWC, Gralloc, UMD/KMD drivers, X11, or Wayland. 
 - Familiarity with NVIDIA DRIVE OS and experience developing safety-critical automotive software using standards such as ISO 26262 and ASIL. 
 - Meaningful contributions to the Linux kernel, graphics software ecosystem, developer tools, or other broadly adopted systems software. 

NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working with us. If you are a creative and autonomous engineering leader who wants to invent how the most demanding production software will be built in the agentic era and prove it by helping real driver teams ship, we would love to hear from you.

data.title: Lead Software Engineer, Real Time Index Engineering(Java)
data.description:
FTSE Russell is a leading global provider of financial services, specialising in the creation and management of indexes, data, and analytic solutions. As part of the London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG), we support investors worldwide in making informed decisions across asset classes, investment strategies, and market segments. Our products are trusted by institutional and retail investors, asset managers, and pension funds to benchmark performance, build investment portfolios, and manage risk. 

Job Summary

We're seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the team building the Real Time Framework (RTF), our low-latency, cloud-native platform for calculating, managing and distributing FTSE Russell's real-time indices at global scale, spanning Equity, Fixed Income and Multi-Asset coverage. Reliability, security, and data quality are non-negotiable as we modernise the platform that underpins our entire real-time franchise. 

The ideal candidate is a self-sufficient, technically excellent engineer who can lead through architectural clarity, thorough code review, and hands-on delivery. You combine strong expertise in low-latency, event-driven system design, data modelling, and debugging with genuine passion for how AI tooling is redefining software engineering. This is an individual contributor role where you will lead through the quality of your thinking and your engineering standards. 

AI-First Engineering This team operates with an AI-first approach. We expect hands-on experience with AI development tooling: terminal-based agents, AI-augmented IDEs, and automated workflows. You are ultimately accountable for production quality, security, and correctness. This means owning infrastructure review, security validation, system observability, and operational guardrails. 

What You'll Do

- Build low-latency, event-driven calculation engines that price indices accurately through market events. 
 - Operate a cloud-native, horizontally scalable, always-on platform, built as resilient and managed through infrastructure as code. 
 - Own data foundations for real-time market and reference data, with strong modelling, quality and auditability. 
 - Deliver secure APIs and streaming, event-driven distribution that make real-time index data easy to consume. 
 - Help bring advanced and multi-asset methodologies to market (e. g. volatility-controlled, options/futures-based, long-short). 
 - Modernise the operations experience: replace manual workflows with intuitive tooling and observability. 
 - Lead through architecture, code review and test strategy, partnering across product, operations and client-facing teams. 

Tech Stack

- Development: Java, C#, , Python, SQL, OpenAPI
 - Cloud: AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, SQS, SNS, Aurora, and others as required)
 - Databases: Sybase ASE, Sybase IQ, Aurora Postgres
 - IaC and CI/CD: Terraform, AWS CLI, GitLab
 - AI Development: Agentic AI tooling (e. g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code)

Experience We Value

- 9+ years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - Strong expertise in system design, distributed and event-driven systems, and relational data modelling. 
 - Solid experience building and operating cloud-native applications on AWS. 
 - Ability to write and maintain infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent). 
 - Experience designing test strategies at multiple levels of the testing pyramid. 
 - Proficiency with AI development tooling and a clear understanding of how to use AI to accelerate delivery while maintaining quality. 
 - Strong debugging skills across distributed systems. 
 - Basic understanding of financial services or capital markets. 
 - Effective collaboration and the ability to communicate technical decisions to non-technical audiences. 

How We Work

The Real Time team builds and operates the platform that calculates, manages and distributes FTSE Russell's real-time indices to the global financial ecosystem. We foster a culture of engineering excellence, solving real-world problems with purpose and ambition. We're looking for skilled and passionate engineers to drive the future of modern solutions working with leading AI development tools. 

- Build with purpose. Start with why. Define the problem before reaching for a solution. 
 - Customer driven. Work backwards from client needs and build products to address real-world problems. 
 - Technically courageous. Go beyond your comfort zone and push boundaries to deliver excellence. 
 - Learn and be curious. Continuously seek feedback, learn in formal and informal settings, actively share knowledge. 
 - Act as owners. Operate as though it is your business. Make thoughtful trade-offs and deliver long-term value. 
 - Lead with data. Validate assumptions, stay close to the details, act decisively. 
 - Build responsibly, deliver incrementally. Look for the small opportunities and milestones to build ambitious solutions. 
 - AI-native by default. Use AI tooling as a force multiplier, frame problems clearly, validate continually, and own the output.

data.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer Manager
data.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a senior, hands-on mechanical engineering leader to manage the engineering team and own final technical quality control across our engineering workstreams. These include CAD and engineering design data, simulation load cases, and reviews of FEA and CFD work used in AI development. 

You will assess whether deliverables are technically sound, supported by evidence, and ready for client delivery. The role combines broad engineering judgment with detailed technical review, guidance for engineers and external partners, and ownership of consistent quality standards as delivery scales. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own final technical review and sign-off across workstreams; identify critical issues, request corrections, and verify their resolution before delivery. 

• Review CAD models, assemblies, drawings, design changes, and engineering rationale for functional validity, consistency, and manufacturability. 

• Evaluate FEA and CFD simulation assumptions, material properties, loads, boundary conditions, mesh quality, results, and relevant modelling choices; assess convergence, physical plausibility, and whether conclusions are supported. 

• Review load-case definitions and engineering workflows for realistic use scenarios, clear documentation, and traceability between requirements, models, and outputs. 

• Define acceptance criteria and review checklists, resolve technical disagreements, and involve specialist reviewers where deeper domain expertise is needed. 

• Manage and mentor engineers, assess vendor and freelancer capability, and improve review processes to increase throughput while maintaining quality. 

• Communicate directly with customers to clarify technical requirements, discuss review findings, and explain risks and limitations; align with project leads on delivery readiness. 

REQUIREMENTS

• Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline, with 6+ years of relevant industry experience and demonstrated technical leadership at lead or head of engineering level. 

• Experience working with international teams and coordinating quality across multiple projects and external partners. 

• Strong foundations in design, engineering and manufacturing, supported by experience solving real industrial engineering problems. 

• Hands-on expertise in CAD and FEA, with sufficient breadth to evaluate CFD work alongside specialists and recognise the limits of an analysis. 

• Experience reviewing and approving other engineers' work, challenging assumptions, and making defensible technical decisions. 

• Proficiency in relevant CAD and simulation tools, such as SolidWorks, Ansys, Abaqus, Fluent, or Simcenter.

data.title: Senior CPU Verification Engineer
data.description:
CPU Random Tools Engineer - Grade 4

Introduction to Arm

You know us. With 125 Arm-powered products shipped every second, we'll be in over a trillion smart devices by 2035. Your smartphone, award-winning VR gaming, the world's fastest supercomputer - our engineers are crafting the sophisticated core processors leading the race towards a connected, autonomous, hyper-performance future. 

ARM designs the technology that is at the heart of sophisticated digital products, from wireless, networking and consumer entertainment solutions to imaging, automotive, security and storage devices. ARM improves people's lives by enabling the intelligence in affordable, easy-to-use electronic products that transform the way we live and work. We work in partnership with a global network of leading technology companies which are using our smart low-power technology. Together we are enabling the future of a better world. 

ARM is well recognized as the market leader in the CPU and System IP industry and this has been achieved by consistently delivering reliable and high quality IP products. The cost of design and manufacturing is high and that warrants "right first time" approach for all IP and System products. Time-to-market is essential for our partners to take care of steadfast competition in the marketplace, being first would enable them to get premium value from the end products. In this context, Design Verification of CPU IPs is an exciting challenge requiring an engineering abilities that is both broad and deep. 

So, we promise you endless exciting opportunities to experiment and go even further in CPU IP design!

Job Description: Role and Responsibilities

As an Engineer responsible for CPU Random Tools for stress verification, you will work on a sophisticated Random Instruction Sequences (RIS) tool. With a combination of techniques, the tool verifies the functionality of our CPU cores, being designed in Austin (US), Cambridge (UK) or Sophia Antipolis (FR). The existing team ensures addition of new architecture features, its customization to specific CPU cores, and provides support. 

You will be based in Arm's Bangalore design centre in India. 

As Senior Verification Engineer, your role will cover the development of the tool from development to deployment, and accountable for: 

- Understanding the intricacies of the CPU micro-architecture and defining how to push the test boundaries; 
 - Architect and develop solutions to improve the generation of stimuli to produce programs to stress our next generation CPUs; 
 - Implementing and supporting the tool, from the early stages of CPU development to product maturity. 

Job Requirements

- Problem Ownership and ability to work from abstract requirements 
 - Good communication and presentation skills 
 - Self-motivated and willing to take up additional responsibilities 
 - Quick learner with a strong desire to learn and develop new skills

Qualification And Experience

- B. Tech/B. S. or MTech/M. S. in Computer/Electronics Engineering or Computer Science from a reputed institute 
 - 5-10 years of stable proven experience with significant project contributions

Crucial Skills

- You hold experience in software design, and should be comfortable working with low-level hardware 
 - You have good solid understanding of programming languages, such as C and Python 
 - You are knowledgeable about CPU architecture and micro-architecture concepts 
 - You are able to understand assembly language (ASM) 
 - You have strong interpersonal skills and ability to work well as part of a team with the willingness to tackle varied technical challenges. 

Desirable Skills

- Fundamentals of Processor Architecture. 
 - Basics of ARM Architecture. 
 - Familiarity with EDA tools and Hardware Design Verification. 

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

Use of AI in Your Application

At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm. com so we can support you. 

Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team's needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you. 

Equal Opportunities

Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

data.title: Member of Technical Staff
data.description:
About the Company

Grey Machines is a decision intelligence platform: it lets you simulate a strategic decision before you make it. You ask a "what if" question in plain language, and the system builds a working model of that world from scratch, with its actors, feedback loops and delays, grounded in real data and cited evidence. It then plays out thousands of possible futures and shows the range of outcomes, what drives them, and a brief in which every number traces back to its source, in hours rather than the weeks a strategy team would take. It is built for strategy teams, investors and policy makers. 

The Problem

Take a question like "What happens to nickel markets if Indonesia bans ore exports?" or "What does a US-Iran escalation do to oil and LNG?" Answering it well usually takes weeks: a strategy team, a financial model, expert calls and a deck. 

Grey Machines answers it in hours. From one plain-language question, the system builds a model of that world from scratch: the actors, the stocks and flows, the feedback loops and the delays. It grounds the starting values in real data and cited evidence, then runs thousands of Monte Carlo futures, with convergence checks deciding when to stop. What comes back is an interactive causal loop diagram, the range of outcomes, and a written brief in which every number traces back to where it came from. 

It works end to end and is in private beta. Now it has to be correct, fast and reliable at scale. That is the job. 

What You Will Build

You will be the first engineer and the most senior technical person in the room, so the scope is all of engineering. You will make the architecture calls every later engineer builds on, and own the consequences. 

- The simulation core: the ODE solver, the Monte Carlo engine, sensitivity analysis, and the convergence and health checks that decide when a result can be trusted

- The model-building pipeline: frontier LLMs build the model in stages, and deterministic validators and repair loops check every step. The real work is deciding what the LLM can be trusted with, what code has to verify, and how to fail safely. 

- The data and evidence layer: values from sources such as FRED, the academic literature, the web and the documents users bring, with units, ranges and provenance that survive end to end

- The execution layer: long Monte Carlo jobs are checkpointed and resume after a restart, today on one machine. Next they need to be scheduled and run in parallel across many. 

- Production: AWS, deploys, monitoring, tracing and incident response

- The frontend when it needs you: a React 19 app with Canvas 2D and D3 visualisations that make dense quantitative output readable for a strategist, not just a quant

- The engineering bar: testing, review and release discipline, and hiring the team that comes after you

Who You Are

- You have built systems from zero, not just shipped features into existing ones, and lived with your own architecture decisions, including the wrong ones. 

- You are fluent in Bayesian probability and statistics, stochastic processes and numerical methods: ODEs, Monte Carlo and convergence diagnostics. A PhD is not required. Being able to reason about what the numbers mean is. 

- You write production code fast, debug carefully and care when it is wrong. Production experience with Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL and React is required: the codebase is built on them. 

- You have run LLMs in production: structured output, prompt caching, multi-stage pipelines and the failure modes that only show up there. 

- You write clearly. We work remotely and asynchronously, so your design docs and code reviews are how you work. 

Strong Signals

None of these is required. They are backgrounds that tend to fit. 

- A year or two at a quantitative trading firm (Jane Street, Hudson River Trading, Tower Research, Graviton or similar)

- Your own startup, including one that did not work out. We care about what you learned. 

- A maths, CS, physics or statistics degree from a school these firms hire from

- Multi-tenant SaaS or high-throughput compute pipelines

- CTO, Staff or Principal Engineer experience at an early-stage company

What It Is Honestly Like

We are an early-stage startup, and we would rather say so up front. 

- Priorities move. Something you build this month may be thrown away next month because we learned something. 

- There is no team behind you yet. You will check your own blind spots and make calls with incomplete information. 

- Some weeks will feel like a drawdown. We want someone who stays steady through the good weeks and the bad ones, and treats uncertainty as part of the job. 

In return you get real ownership, founder-level say in the product and the company, and a genuinely hard applied-maths problem. Fully remote, flexible hours.

data.title: Head of Solutions & Delivery
data.description:
About the Company

Fineshift is a founder-led technology services company helping enterprise customers solve complex engineering challenges across DevSecOps, Monitoring & Observability, and AI. 

As an independent, bootstrapped company, we prioritise customer outcomes, delivery accountability, and fast decision-making. We are authorised partners of GitLab, IBM, JFrog, Snyk, and AWS, working with large enterprises across banking, financial services, and manufacturing. 

We are at a stage where the leaders we hire will shape our next phase of growth. This is an opportunity to build and scale a technology practice, not simply inherit one. 

About the Role

This is the senior technology leadership position in the company, reporting directly to the CEO. 

You own what we propose to our customers and what we deliver to them. That means owning the technical solution end to end - understanding the requirement, designing the approach, preparing the proposal, defending it in front of the customer, and then standing behind it when it goes into delivery. 

It also means owning the commercial outcome of the technology business and deciding how the technology organisation should be structured as it grows. You will have the mandate to shape the team, the practices, and the technical standards we hold ourselves to. 

We are looking for someone who wants that level of ownership, not someone who wants a defined scope. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own technical solutioning for customer requirements across all three service lines, from discovery and requirement analysis through to the final solution. 
 - Prepare the technical proposal in line with the solution - architecture, approach, effort estimate, assumptions, and risks. 
 - Review and approve any technical proposal prepared by others before it reaches a customer. 
 - Present and defend the solution to the customer - solution walkthroughs, demonstrations, architecture discussions, and workshops. 
 - Act as the senior technical presence in customer conversations, including steering meetings, quarterly reviews, and escalation discussions. 
 - Own customer escalations end to end, including containment, resolution, and written root cause analysis. 
 - Define the right structure for the technology organisation - how solutioning, delivery, and support are organised - and evolve it as the business grows. 
 - Set technical direction for each service line and define the standard engagements are delivered to. 
 - Build and mentor the technical team, including senior technical staff responsible for solution design, estimation, and customer communication. 
 - Grow existing accounts through upsell and cross-sell, and grow the number of engineers deployed at customer sites. 
 - Own the technology P&L - margin per engagement, revenue per deployed engineer, and cost of unassigned capacity. 

Must Have

- 12+ years in technology, including at least 3 years leading a delivery or solutions practice in an IT services or systems-integration company. 
 - Deep expertise in one of DevSecOps, Monitoring & Observability, or AI, with working credibility in the other two. 
 - Strong hands-on solution design and estimation ability - able to architect an engagement and size it accurately before it is sold. 
 - Strong understanding of CI/CD, release management, containers and Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure). 
 - Working knowledge of observability tooling - IBM Instana, Prometheus, Grafana, Nagios, or Icinga - along with incident management and root cause analysis. 
 - Familiarity with AI engagement patterns - LLM and agent applications, RAG, on-premise versus cloud trade-offs - enough to scope an engagement without a specialist in the room. 
 - Experience carrying a P&L or a practice margin number, not only a delivery target. 
 - Experience building and leading a technical team across multiple concurrent customer engagements. 
 - Ability to hold a technical discussion with a CIO or customer architect directly, and to handle escalations without escalating them further. 

Good to Have

- Experience in a partner or reseller model, working alongside product vendors. 
 - Enterprise customers in banking, financial services, or manufacturing in India. 
 - Experience growing a technical practice from a small team into a larger one. 
 - Exposure to presales in a services environment - RFP responses, solution defence, and competitive positioning.

data.description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide. 

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves. 

About Five9

Five9 is a leading provider of cloud software for the enterprise contact center market, bringing the power of the cloud to thousands of customers and facilitating more than three billion customer interactions annually. Since 2001, Five9 has led the cloud revolution in contact centers, helping organizations transition from legacy premise-based solutions to the cloud. Five9 provides businesses with cloud contact center software that is reliable, secure, compliant and scalable, which is designed to create exceptional customer experiences, increase agent productivity and deliver tangible business results. 

Role Overview

To complement our rapid growth, we are actively sourcing for a Network Engineer to operate in a 24/7 Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environment maintaining IP Networking components in a production setting. 

In this role you will: 

- Design, engineer, and oversee highly scalable CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, digital-twin dry-running, and zero-downtime deployment of configurations across massive physical and virtual network fabrics
 - Champion the "Network-as-Code" paradigm, establishing enterprise-wide GitOps workflows and enforcing source control (Git) as the absolute single source of truth for all network state, policy, and infrastructure design
 - Drive the strategic vision for network automation, designing complex, reusable code frameworks and Playbooks to permanently eliminate manual configuration and operational "toil" at a global scale
 - Design and optimize massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and container networking interfaces (CNIs) supporting ultra-high-throughput, multi-region cloud and bare-metal environments
 - Serve as the ultimate technical authority (SME / Tier 4) for complex network, routing, and overlay issues, rapidly deciphering and resolving the most difficult challenges across physical underlays and software-defined layers
 - Design and implement next-generation telemetry, monitoring, and alerting-as-code platforms, leveraging advanced heuristics for proactive auto-remediation of performance, security, and capacity issues

Key Responsibilities

- Partner at a strategic level with Enterprise Designers, SRE leaders, and Platform teams to build and implement highly resilient, secure, and multi-tenant-isolated network infrastructure
 - Establish coding standards and write/review sophisticated Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Ansible, Terraform, Helm, Python, and Bash
 - Lead the engineering, deployment, and optimization of modern overlay and container networking solutions, particularly VXLAN, OVN (Open Virtual Network), and Project Calico
 - Design the automation of complex security and traffic management policies across enterprise-grade firewalls (Palo Alto/Fortinet) and load balancers (F5 BIG-IP/Cloudflare/Octavia)
 - Embed "Security-as-Code" directly into CI/CD pipelines, engineering automated validation gates for security groups, ACLs, and firewall rules prior to production pushes
 - Engineer robust, automated network validation suites to continuously verify network health, state, and complex routing tables (BGP, OSPF) pre- and post-deployment
 - Drive the adoption of code-based infrastructure definitions and dynamic, living technical documentation (e. g. , NetBox, Git Markdown), setting the standard for documentation across the engineering organization

Qualifications & Skills

- 8+ years of progressive experience in Network Engineering, DevOps, or SRE roles, with a deeply established focus on large-scale network design, automation, and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC)
 - Expert-level proficiency in engineering complex network automation tooling utilizing Ansible, Terraform, and Python (including deep experience with network-specific libraries like Netmiko, Nornir, or NAPALM)
 - Deep design and operational expertise with massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and overlays, specifically VXLAN, OVN, and Project Calico
 - Advanced mastery of Kubernetes networking designs (CNIs, Ingress controllers, Service Mesh, Kube-Proxy behaviors) at an enterprise scale
 - Extensive, expert-level experience engineering and automating enterprise edge, routing, and security fabrics, including Cisco Nexus (9k/7k/5k/2k), Arista, Versa SD-WAN, and firewalls (Palo Alto and Fortinet)
 - Authoritative knowledge of API-driven application delivery and load balancing across monolithic and cloud-native stacks (e. g. , F5 BIG-IP AS3, Cloudflare APIs, Octavia LBaaS)
 - Deep Linux internals and networking expertise, including advanced knowledge of Linux network namespaces, virtual interfaces, eBPF/iptables, and kernel-level routing
 - CCIE-level (or equivalent) mastery of core routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, EVPN) and a comprehensive understanding of how virtual/container overlay networks map to physical underlays
 - Extensive experience designing and scaling CI/CD platforms (e. g. , GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and implementing test-driven development (TDD) for infrastructure changes
 - Unparalleled troubleshooting capabilities utilizing advanced packet analysis (tcpdump/Wireshark), NetFlow, and log aggregation platforms to trace asymmetric routing and microburst traffic across hybrid fabrics
 - Proven track record of technical leadership, including mentoring mid-level engineers, leading design review boards, and driving cross-functional engineering initiatives
 - Deep telecommunications background, specifically VoIP, RTP, SIP peering/trunking, and Session Border Controllers (SBC), is highly advantageous
 - Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to executive stakeholders while fostering a collaborative, DevOps-oriented engineering culture

The company has invested in multiple solar projects under the OPEX (CAPEX-free / RESCO) business model, where continuous monitoring of generation, plant performance, equipment health, and operational efficiency is essential. 

As part of its technology development strategy, Roofsol Energy intends to establish its own end-to-end solar monitoring ecosystem, including proprietary data loggers, IoT-based data acquisition systems, cloud infrastructure, and a centralized solar generation monitoring platform. The objective is to develop and own the underlying technology and Intellectual Property (IP), while ensuring reliable monitoring and management of a large portfolio of distributed solar projects across India. 

  

Role Overview

Roofsol Energy is looking for an experienced technology professional to lead the conceptualization, design, development, deployment, and maintenance of an in-house solar data logging and generation monitoring system. 

  

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Strategy and Technology Development

·            Define the technology roadmap for Roofsol Energy's proprietary solar monitoring and data acquisition ecosystem. 

·            Lead the end-to-end development of the monitoring platform, from product architecture and prototype development to commercial deployment. 

·            Evaluate appropriate hardware, communication protocols, software frameworks, cloud technologies, and system architectures. 

·            Develop solutions suitable for both small rooftop solar installations and large distributed solar portfolios. 

2. Data Logger and IoT Hardware Development

·            Lead the design, development, prototyping, testing, and deployment of in-house solar data logging equipment. 

·            Develop expertise in integrating inverters, energy meters, weather sensors, and other plant equipment using protocols such as Modbus RTU/TCP, RS485, Ethernet, and MQTT, as applicable. 

·            Ensure reliable data acquisition, local buffering, time synchronization, remote configuration, and recovery during network or power outages. 

·            Establish hardware validation, field testing, quality assurance, and lifecycle management processes. 

3. Cloud Platform and Software Development

·            Lead the architecture and development of a centralized cloud-based solar monitoring platform. 

·            Establish scalable infrastructure for collecting, processing, storing, and analyzing data from hundreds of geographically distributed solar installations. 

·            Oversee the development of dashboards, plant-level monitoring screens, portfolio-level reporting, alerts, notifications, and automated performance reports. 

·            Ensure integration with existing business systems, maintenance workflows, and third-party equipment where required. 

·            Establish high availability, disaster recovery, backup, cybersecurity, and system performance standards. 

  

4. Solar Generation Monitoring and Analytics

·            Develop real-time and historical solar generation monitoring capabilities. 

·            Establish monitoring of energy generation, plant availability, equipment health, communication failures, and performance deviations. 

·            Enable automated alerts for generation losses, inverter faults, abnormal operating conditions, and data gaps. 

·            Support performance analysis through relevant metrics such as specific yield, Performance Ratio (PR), plant availability, and actual-versus-expected generation, where applicable. 

  

5. Intellectual Property and Technology Ownership

·            Build and maintain Roofsol Energy's proprietary technology stack, including hardware designs, firmware, software source code, system architecture, technical documentation, and associated IP. 

·            Establish appropriate IP ownership, confidentiality, source-code control, licensing, and third-party technology compliance practices. 

  

6. Team Leadership and Vendor Management

·            Build and lead a multidisciplinary team covering embedded systems, electronics, firmware, IoT, cloud engineering, software development, and data analytics. 

·            Evaluate and manage technology vendors, hardware manufacturers, system integrators, and development partners. 

  

Candidate Profile

·            Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics & Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, IoT, or a related technical discipline. 

·            Approximately 10 years of relevant experience in IoT product development, embedded systems, industrial data acquisition, cloud platforms, energy monitoring, or related technology domains. 

·            Demonstrated experience in developing and deploying connected hardware and software products, preferably from concept through production and field deployment. 

·            Experience with cloud infrastructure, databases, APIs, cybersecurity, remote device management, and scalable system architecture. 

·            Knowledge of solar PV systems, inverter communications, energy meters, generation monitoring, and renewable energy analytics will be highly advantageous. 

  

  

Why Join Roofsol Energy?

  This is an opportunity to establish a proprietary technology platform from the ground up and take ownership of a strategic digital initiative within the renewable energy sector. The selected professional will have the opportunity to shape the company's technology roadmap, develop in-house IP, and build a scalable monitoring ecosystem supporting a growing portfolio of solar assets across India. 

Interested candidates may share their updated CV highlighting relevant experience in IoT product development, embedded systems, cloud platforms, energy monitoring, and technology ownership.

data.description:
About This Role

Wells Fargo is seeking a Software Engineering Senior Manager

In This Role, You Will

- Manage, coach, and develop a team or teams of experienced engineers and engineering managers in roles with moderate complexity and risk, responsible for building high quality capabilities with modern technology
 - Ensure adherence to the Banking Platform Architecture, and meeting non-functional requirements with each release
 - Partner with, engage and influence architects and experienced engineers to incorporate Wells Fargo Technology technical strategies, while understanding next generation domain architecture and enable application migration paths to target architecture; for example cloud readiness, application modernization, data strategy
 - Function as the technical representative for the product during cross-team collaborative efforts and planning
 - Identify and recommend opportunities for driving escalated resolution of technology roadblocks including code, build and deployment while also managing overall software development cycle and security standards
 - Determine appropriate strategy and actions to act as an escalation partner for scrum masters and the teams to meet moderate to high risk deliverables and help remove impediments, obstacles, and friction while encouraging constant learning, experimentation, and continual improvement
 - Build engineering skills side-by-side in the codebase, conduct peer reviews to evaluate quality and solution alignment to technical direction, and guide design, as needed
 - Interpret, develop and ensure security, stability, and scalability within functions of technology with moderate complexity, as well as identify, manage and mitigate technology and enterprise risk
 - Collaborate with, partner with and influence Product Managers/Product Owners to drive user satisfaction, influence technology requirements and priorities in the product roadmap, promote innovative and intelligent solutions, generate corporate value and articulate technical strategy while being a solid advocate of agile and DevOps practices
 - Interact directly with third party vendors and technology service providers
 - Manage allocation of people and financial resources to ensure commitments are met and align with strategic objectives in technology engineering
 - Hire, build and guide a culture of talent development to have the skills required to effectively design and deliver innovative solutions for product areas and products to meet business objectives and strategy, as well as conduct performance management for engineers and managers

Required Qualifications

- 7+ years of Software Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
 - 3+ years of management or leadership experience

Desired Qualifications

- Software Engineering experience, with 6+ years leading DevOps - CI/CD areas and a proven track record of delivering multi hybrid cloud programs at an enterprise scale. 
 - 6+ years of management experience leading engineering, DevOps, CI/CD, or platform delivery teams in a large-scale technology environment. 
 - Proven ability to provide thought leadership, define strategy, and execute major initiatives that deliver robust, scalable, secure, and resilient engineering solutions. 
 - Strong experience across DevOps, CI/CD, SDLC, SRE, and next-generation platform capabilities, including automation, orchestration, pipeline modernization, and industry-leading vendor solutions. 
 - Demonstrated understanding of Agile delivery, release engineering, continuous integration, continuous delivery, site reliability practices, and enterprise-grade software delivery controls. 
 - Hands-on exposure to AI/ML and GenAI-enabled software delivery, with the ability to identify practical opportunities to improve developer productivity, automation, quality, and remediation workflows. 
 - High-level understanding of Infrastructure as Code practices, including Terraform, Ansible, GitOps, policy-as-code, reusable templates, and automated compliance guardrails. 
 - Ability to drive innovation across CI/CD product areas by simplifying developer experiences, improving platform adoption, and supporting continual service improvement for cloud and enterprise delivery services. 
 - Experience managing vendor relationships, influencing cross-functional stakeholders, negotiating priorities, and driving outcomes in a complex matrixed environment. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical strategy, risks, decisions, and progress to engineering teams, partners, and senior leadership. 
 - Strong people leadership skills, with a demonstrated ability to lead with integrity, foster inclusion, build trust, and create an environment where team members feel valued, supported, and energized. 
 - Passion for hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing diverse talent, while actively supporting career growth, coaching, succession planning, and team capability building. 
 - Curiosity to learn emerging technologies, self-starting mindset, sound prioritization skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced enterprise environment. 
 - Preferred qualifications include cloud certification on Azure, GCP, or equivalent platforms; prior experience in banking or regulated industries; and experience delivering in a multi-cultural, globally distributed organization

Job Expectations

- Should have cloud certification on Azure or GCP. 
 - Preferably prior management experience in Banking
 - Ability to deliver & engage with partners effectively in a multi-cultural environment by demonstrating co-ownership & accountability in a matrix structure. 
 - Delivery focus and willingness to work in a fast-paced, enterprise environment

Posting End Date

27 Oct 2026

- Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants. 

We Value Equal Opportunity

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic. 

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. remain always-up and always-available.

data.description:
Job Description Summary

At GE Vernova, we are tackling some of the world's most challenging energy problems. Joining our team means you will work on technology that powers the world, surrounded by people who are committed to safety, innovation, and sustainability. We believe that diverse perspectives drive the best solutions; that is why we foster an inclusive environment where your voice is heard, your curiosity is encouraged, and your professional development is a priority. We offer the opportunity to take true technical ownership of complex hardware while working alongside world-class experts who are dedicated to mentoring the next generation of engineering leaders. 

As a Lead Mechanical Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in the design, analysis, and optimization of components across our gas power portfolio. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to deliver high-quality solutions, drive product upgrades, and ensure our designs meet rigorous performance and safety standards. This role requires a balance of technical ownership, innovative problem-solving, and a commitment to continuous improvement. 

Job Description

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design & Analysis: Execute mechanical design and analysis (stress, modal, lifing) for Stationary components in gas turbines, steam, generators, and accessory systems. 
 - Technical Stewardship: Take ownership of mechanical hardware; perform validation testing; and evaluate designs for factors like thermal growth, manufacturing variation, and assembly stack-up to ensure optimal product behavior. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering experts, manufacturing, and sourcing teams to optimize sub-systems and components. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Lead root cause analyses (RCA) to improve reliability, quality, and yield. Apply Lean principles to streamline processes and drive innovation. 
 - Project Delivery: Manage milestones through formal/informal technical reviews, ensuring compliance with NPI processes and design practices. 
 - Mentorship: Foster a collaborative environment by coaching team members and building strong relationships with key stakeholders, including Principal and Chief Engineers. 

What You'll Bring - Basic Qualifications

- Master's or bachelor's in engineering with specialization in Mechanical, Design and Applied Mechanics
 - Minimum of 4 years of Engineering experience. 

What Will Make You Stand Out - Desired Qualifications

- Additional 1-2 years of relevant engineering experience
 - Technical proficiency in engineering software (ANSYS-Classic/Workbench, NX) and programming languages (Python, Excel VBA) for data analysis. 
 - A "Lean" mindset, familiarity with AI-driven tools, and a passion for innovative design. 
 - Demonstrated ability to thrive in a collaborative, inclusive, and fast-paced environment. 
 - Strong communication skills, with a transparent approach to project management and problem-solving.

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

data.description:
Company Overview

At Cosmoserve Space, we are pioneering a cleaner, more sustainable future for space exploration through innovative technology focused on active debris removal. Our mission is to safeguard the orbital environment by developing high-tech, cost-effective solutions that lead the market in addressing the growing challenge of space debris. With a passionate team of engineers and a commitment to cutting-edge engineering, Cosmoserve is driving the next generation of responsible space activities, ensuring that the space remains accessible for future missions. 

Position: Avionics Hardware Lead

Location: Hyderabad, Telangana

Employment Type: Full-Time

Reports To: CEO

Location: Financial District, Hyderabad, Telangana

Job Summary

We are looking for an Avionics Hardware Lead to own the onboard electronics of our spacecraft, from system specification to tested flight hardware. The role covers defining avionics requirements from mission goals and designing microcontroller-based circuits, power electronics and subsystem interfaces. The Lead will drive circuit simulation, PCB layout, component selection and testing, and ensure every board meets space-grade quality and reliability standards. 

This is a hands-on leadership role. The Lead will head a team of engineers, set design and documentation standards, and work closely with the GNC, AIT and QA teams to deliver reliable hardware on schedule. 

Key Responsibilities

•  Translate mission and system goals into clear avionics system specifications. 

•  Lead design and development of electronic circuits built around microcontrollers. 

•  Run circuit simulations and review PCB layouts before fabrication. 

•  Select, design and test low-power DC-DC converters and power distribution circuits. 

•  Define and implement interfaces between avionics units over serial and parallel buses, with signal conditioning using op-amps and current-to-voltage converters. 

•  Select components suitable for space applications, including qualified use of industrial-grade parts. 

•  Apply QA practices in line with MIL-STD-883, ISO and AS9100 requirements. 

•  Prepare and maintain design documents, test procedures and reports. 

•  Lead, mentor and review the work of a team of avionics engineers. 

Qualifications

Education: BE / B. Tech or M. Tech in ECE or EEE with specialisation in Electronics / Instrumentation. 

Work Experience: 8 to 10 years

Required Skill Set (Major)

•        Experience in design and development of electronic circuits with microcontrollers. 

•        Experience in preparing system specifications for system goals and functions. 

•        Good knowledge of circuit simulation in KiCad, PSpice or similar tools. 

•        Knowledge of PCB layout. 

•        Knowledge of power electronics such as low-power DC-DC converters, including selection and testing. 

•        Good knowledge of interfacing various avionics systems using serial or parallel buses, op-amps, current-to-voltage converters, etc. 

•        Knowledge of QA aspects related to MIL 1553 STD, ISO and AS standards. 

•        Good knowledge of component selection for space applications. 

•        Knowledge of building systems for space using industrial-grade components. 

•        Experience in leading a team of engineers. 

•        Good documentation aptitude. 

•          Added Advantage

1.       General knowledge of space systems for satellite building. 

2.       Firmware knowledge

Required Soft Skills

•          Ability to lead, guide and motivate a team of engineers. 

•          Strong sense of ownership from design through to testing. 

•          Clear communication with engineers, management and vendors. 

•          Works well with GNC, mechanical, AIT and QA teams. 

•          Methodical approach to debugging and root cause analysis. 

•          High attention to detail and discipline in following quality processes. 

•          Good planning and prioritisation in a fast-paced startup. 

•          Adaptable to changing requirements and limited resources. 

•          Willing to mentor juniors and give constructive design reviews.

data.title: Lead AI Engineer (LLM Agents)-Immediate
data.description:
Location: Remote (India), working with a San Francisco-based founding team

Engagement: Full-time, long-term, dedicated

Experience: 8-10+ years in software engineering, including 2+ years building production LLM applications and agents

Openings: 1

Time zone: Flexible hours, with a daily live overlap with the founders

About the ClientOur client is an early-stage AI startup in San Francisco, founded by alumni of Harvard and MIT. The company is in stealth. It is building an agent-based product that takes complex, high-stakes paperwork off the hands of US families: working out what applies to them, researching official sources, handling correspondence and following up over weeks, with every step checked and backed by evidence. 

Parts of the product are already built and running in test. The team today is two co-founders and one engineer. As Lead Engineer, you will be the most senior technical person on the team. You will be the founders' technical partner, own the architecture, and lead the product into production with real users. 

The Role: CTO Judgement, Builder's HandsWe are looking for someone with the judgement of a CTO who still writes code every day. Expect roughly 70-80% of your week to be hands-on: designing, building, reviewing and shipping. The rest goes into technical direction, standards and growing the team. 

•      Own the architecture end to end, and be accountable for how the system behaves in production. 

•      Be the founders' technical partner: shape the roadmap, make build-vs-buy calls, size work honestly, and push back when something is the wrong thing to build. 

•      Set the engineering bar for code review, testing, evals, security and releases. 

•      Lead and mentor the engineers on the team, and help interview future hires. 

•      Lead from the front in production: when something breaks, you're on it, and you make sure it doesn't break the same way twice. 

This role is not for you if you haven't shipped production code in the last 12 months, or you'd rather manage engineers than build alongside them. 

What You'll Own•      Agent platform architecture: design the agent harness, with tool-calling loops that have budgets, stop conditions and failure recovery, and a check on every output before it reaches a user or an outside party. 

•      Model layer: route across model vendors with fallbacks, manage prompts and versions, and weigh the cost, latency and quality behind each choice. 

•      Durable, long-running workflows: agent runs that wait days or weeks for a reply, survive restarts and deployments, and can be audited afterwards. 

•      Evaluation and safety: build the eval framework that decides when an agent is correct, when it can act without a person approving, and when it must escalate. Trace and observe every run. 

•      Data, security and compliance: store sensitive personal records securely, with row-level access control, encryption, secrets management and audit trails. Get the platform ready for the security reviews (e. g. SOC 2) that customers and partners will ask for. 

•      Infrastructure and reliability: AWS and Azure architecture, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting. Build performance-critical services in Go, Rust or Python where TypeScript is not the right tool. 

•      Full-stack product: you will still ship features end to end, from the agent to the screen a family sees on phone or desktop. 

Milestones•      First 30 days: ship code in week one. Review the existing system, then agree an architecture, a risk list and a 90-day technical plan with the founders. 

•      By 90 days: the core agent harness, eval framework and production infrastructure are in place, and the first real users are live. 

•      By six months: the platform runs in production with real users, with measurable reliability and eval coverage, and the team ships to your standard. 

Core RequirementsSeniority and leadership•      8-10+ years of professional software engineering. In recent years you have worked as a tech lead, principal or staff engineer, founding engineer or CTO in early-stage startups, and still written production code throughout. 

•      You have owned the architecture of a production system from early design through scale, and lived with the consequences of your decisions. 

•      0-to-1 experience: you have taken a product from prototype to real users, at an early-stage startup or on a new product line. 

•      You have led or mentored a small team (2-8 engineers) without big-company process around you. 

Agents and AI systems (hands-on, in production)•      2+ years building LLM applications, including at least one agent system you architected, shipped to real users and ran in production. 

•      Deep understanding of agent architecture: 

-      tool and function calling

-      planning vs. execution, and single vs. multi-agent designs

-      context and memory management

-      human-in-the-loop approvals and guardrails

-      defence against prompt injection

•      You know the frameworks (LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, MCP) well enough to know when to write the loop yourself. 

•      Structured output and failure handling: you get typed, schema-validated output from models, and you handle the cases where the model gets it wrong with retries, repair and fallbacks. 

•      Evaluation at production level: you have built eval sets and graders (including calibrated LLM-as-judge), wired regression gates into CI, and used the results to decide whether to ship. 

•      Running models in production economically: caching, routing, batching, and choosing the right model for each task. 

•      Designing around interfaces, so a model vendor, cloud or database can be swapped without a rewrite. 

Engineering depth•      Expert TypeScript across the stack: Node. js on the server and React in the browser. 

•      Production depth in at least one of Go, Rust or Python. 

•      Designing and running systems on AWS or Azure, with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Pulumi). 

•      PostgreSQL: data modelling, query performance and row-level security. 

•      Durable workflow engines and queues in production (e. g. Temporal, Inngest, Step Functions, Celery). 

•      Security engineering for sensitive personal data: threat modelling, access control, encryption, secrets handling and audit logging. 

•      Observability and incident response: tracing, metrics, alerting and post-mortems. 

•      Automated testing as a habit, including tests of behaviour that depends on a model. 

•      Heavy daily use of AI coding tools (e. g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex). You set the team's standard for reviewing what they produce. 

Nice to Have•      Hands-on experience with both AWS and Azure. 

•      A previous founder, co-founder or CTO role at a startup. 

•      Research agents that search the web and cite sources; browser automation or voice agents; MCP servers you have built. 

•      Document processing: OCR and pulling data from scans and PDFs. 

•      Compliance work such as SOC 2, HIPAA or GDPR. 

•      Products in high-stakes, regulated areas such as legal, financial, government or healthcare paperwork. 

•      Public repos, technical writing, talks or open-source work on agent systems. This will make your application stand out. 

What We Look For Beyond Code•      A founder mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, owns outcomes, and cares about the people using the product. They are going through a hard time, so every screen, message and automated action matters. 

•      "Evidence before claims": when you say something works, you show the test, the log or the screenshot. 

•      A clear technical communicator: you can explain a trade-off to non-technical founders in plain words, and write a design doc engineers can build from. 

•      Excellent written and spoken English. You are comfortable on video: a daily stand-up with cameras on, plus short recorded video updates. 

•      A reliable internet connection, a quiet workspace, and your own laptop (32 GB RAM preferred, disk encryption on). 

Working HoursThe founders are in San Francisco, and the wider team works across time zones. You should be open to any of these patterns (India time), agreed with the founders: 

•      9: 30 a. m. - 6: 30 p. m. 

•      2: 30 p. m. - 11: 30 p. m. 

•      8: 00 a. m. - 5: 00 p. m. 

Engagement Details•      Full-time, long-term engagement through Metric Tree Labs, working only with this client as part of its core team. 

•      Target start: as early as possible. The joining date is agreed on selection. 

•      Senior, competitive compensation, reviewed after six months.

data.title: Staff Engineer, CPU Core Verification
data.description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities. 

At Tenstorrent, we build open, state of the art compute for real workloads and real developers. You will own CPU core‐level verification, shaping how our out‐of‐order RISC‐V CPUs behave in silicon. 

This role is hybrid, based out of Bangalore, India. 

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting. 

Who You Are

- You bring 8+ years in CPU verification or closely related digital design. 
 - You know high‐performance out‐of‐order CPU microarchitecture in depth. 
 - You work comfortably with RTL, waveforms, logs, and complex debug scenarios. 
 - You communicate clearly across design, DV, emulation, and post‐silicon teams. 

What We Need

- Plan and drive functional verification for CPU core features and complex microarchitectural scenarios. 
 - Develop UVM, assembly, and C/C++ based stimulus, functional models, and coverage for ISA, RISC-V extensions, and un-core components. 
 - Debug simulation and emulation regressions using RTL understanding, waveforms, and logs to identify and resolve issues efficiently. 
 - Build and enhance coverage models, testbenches, and debug infrastructure to improve verification quality and coverage closure. 
 - Collaborate with design, validation, and test teams to support bring-up and delivery of robust CPU cores and clusters. 

What You Will Learn

- How Tenstorrent designs and validates high‐performance RISC‐V CPU cores and clusters. 
 - Techniques for spanning pre‐silicon, emulation, and post‐silicon verification with shared stimulus. 
 - Ways to scale coverage, debug, and infrastructure across multiple CPU programs. 
 - How open hardware and software fit into Tenstorrent's broader compute roadmap. 

Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer.
