data.title: Assistant Manager Quality, Emerging Growth Opportunites
data.description:
The role is based at Mumbai and reporting to Lead QA

Business Context and Opportunities

A global conglomerate, the Aditya Birla Group is in the League of Fortune 500. Anchored by an extraordinary force of over 150, 000 employees belonging to 100 nationalities, the Group is built on a strong foundation of stakeholder value creation. Backed by seven decades of responsible business practices, the Group operates leading businesses across metals, chemicals, textiles, cement, financial services, fashion retail, telecom, and renewable energy, with over 50% of revenues generated from international operations. 

The group expanded its Retail Footprint, leveraging the trust and synergy built over the years in luxury retail by launching its Jewellery brand Indriya, in June 2024. 

India's jewellery market is at an exciting inflection point. For decades, jewellery has largely been associated with weddings, family occasions, inheritance and long-term value. A new generation is now expanding what jewellery can mean. For Gen Z and young consumers, jewellery is increasingly about self-expression, identity, mood, styling, gifting and everyday confidence. It is no longer reserved only for milestone moments. It is becoming part of how young people show up each day, at college, at work, at a café, at a concert, on social media and in the moments that define their personal style. 

Project Tiara is our attempt to build a distinctly new-age jewellery brand for this generation. 

The brand is currently in its conceptualisation stage as a separate and independent business under the legal entity Novel Jewels (the creators of Indriya), backed by the trust, ambition and scale of the Aditya Birla Group. 

The Core Idea

Project Tiara is a jewellery brand will speak to young consumers who want jewellery that is stylish, affordable, versatile and relevant to their lives. It will focus on everyday wear, trend-responsive drops and pieces that can be worn, stacked, layered, mixed, matched and made personal. 

Where the Brand Will Play

Project Tiara is being imagined for the fast-growing daily wear and self-purchase jewellery space. This is a large, under-branded opportunity in India, where young consumers are actively looking for jewellery that feels more current, more expressive and more accessible than traditional fine jewellery. 

The brand will likely operate across digital-first channels, selective physical experiences, pop-ups and omni-channel journeys. It will be designed for a consumer who discovers on Instagram, engages through content, browses online, walks into stores and expects a seamless experience across all touchpoints. 

How We Aim To Differentiate

Project Tiara will be different from traditional jewellery brands in both product and personality. 

This brand will not simply sell jewellery. It will create a new buying behaviour, where jewellery becomes part of everyday identity, styling and self-expression. 

Why This Is Exciting

Project Tiara gives us the opportunity to build a brand from the ground up: the consumer lens, product strategy, design system, brand voice, digital ecosystem, supply chain model, retail experience and growth engine. 

It will also serve as an innovation sandbox for Novel Jewels, allowing us to experiment with new designs, faster drops, creator collaborations, digital storytelling, consumer communities and more agile ways of building a jewellery brand. 

The 3 to 5 Year Ambition

Over the next 3 to 5 years, the ambition is to build Project Tiara into a meaningful, scalable, national Gen Z jewellery brand. The plan is to create a strong digital-first foundation, build repeat-led consumer behaviour, expand through selective offline formats and create a brand that young India sees as expressive, aspirational and accessible. 

Project Tiara will also help Novel Jewels engage consumers early in their jewellery journey, creating a long-term relationship that can grow with them as their life stage, income and jewellery needs evolve. 

Why Join Us

This is a rare opportunity to be part of a founding team for a new consumer brand within one of India's most respected business groups. The team will have the chance to shape the brand's identity, product language, consumer experience, content engine, commercial model and growth journey from the very beginning. 

We are looking for people who are entrepreneurial, consumer-obsessed, culturally aware, digitally fluent and excited by the idea of building something that can redefine how young India experiences jewellery. 

Project Tiara is not just a new brand. It is a chance to reimagine jewellery for a new generation

data.title: Australian Migration (GSM) Documentation Specialist
data.description:
Job description: 

The Quality Assurance Manager is a senior function within ACET Migrations responsible for owning the full documentation quality lifecycle across Australian migration services. This role ensures every client file lodged by ACET Migrations meets the required accuracy, compliance, and regulatory standards set by Australian immigration authorities. The QA Manager leads the quality team, drives process consistency, and holds accountability for submission outcomes across all visa categories. 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Setting the Quality Standard

-Builds a clear system for how documents should be checked and approved

-Sets the rules and targets the QA team works toward

-Makes sure everyone on the team knows what good looks like and works to reach it

-Steps in to help any team member who is struggling or unsure

2. Checking Files Before Submission

-Reviews every file before it is sent to the immigration authority

-Makes sure each file meets current Australian immigration requirements

-Gives final approval - nothing gets lodged without QA sign-off

3. Keeping Up With Immigration Rules

-Stays on top of any changes to Australian immigration laws and guidelines

-Updates the team quickly whenever rules change

-Makes sure the team is always working with the most current requirements

4. Improving How Things Work

-Creates clear step-by-step processes for the team to follow

-Spots where things are going wrong and fixes them properly

-Makes sure the same mistakes do not keep happening

5. Reducing Errors and Rejections

-Tracks where errors and rejections are coming from

-Investigates every rejection to understand why it happened

-Puts steps in place so the same issue does not happen again

-Works toward getting files right the first time, every time

6. Reporting to Leadership

-Keeps track of how each team member and the overall team is performing

-Prepares clear reports on submission quality, errors, and trends

-Shares findings and suggestions with senior management regularly

7. Working With Other Teams

-Works alongside case managers, migration agents, and operations staff

-Makes sure quality is not just a QA job - it runs through the whole business

-Gets involved in cases that are complicated or carry higher risk

8. Training the Team

-Runs training sessions to help the team improve their documentation skills

-Teaches the team about any new immigration rules or process changes

-Builds a team culture where everyone cares about quality, not just the QA Manager

9. Protecting Client Information

-Makes sure all client data is handled safely and kept private

-Follows all legal and company rules around data protection

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

-Has a relevant degree

-Has 3 to 5 years or more working in Australian migration services

-Has led a QA or compliance team for at least 2 to 3 years

-Knows Australian immigration visa types and what each one requires

-Has used case management or CRM systems before

-Experience across PR, work visas, and student visas is a bonus

Work Location: In person

data.title: Staff/Principal Engineer - AI/ML & System-Level Validation
data.description:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences-from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you'll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world's most important challenges-striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career. 

Principal Member of Technical Staff - ROCm Validation & System-Level Quality

About The Role

We are seeking a Principal Member of Technical Staff (PMTS) to serve as the senior technical leader for ROCm software validation across compute workloads and server-class systems. In this individual-contributor leadership role, you will define how AMD proves ROCm is ready to ship - from unit and component testing, through full-stack workload validation, to multi-node system-level qualification on AMD InstinctTM GPU platforms. You will set the technical direction for validation strategy, build and evolve the test infrastructure that gates every ROCm release, and personally drive the hardest debugging, characterization, and qualification problems. Your work directly determines the quality bar experienced by hyperscalers, OEMs, sovereign-AI customers, and the open-source community running ROCm in production. 

What You Will Do

- Own the end-to-end validation architecture for ROCm - unit, integration, framework, workload, performance, stress, stability, scale-out, and system-level test layers - across multiple GPU generations and server platforms. 
 - Define release-qualification gates and exit criteria for ROCm software releases (functional coverage, performance regressions, stability hours, scale targets, RAS criteria) and drive the org to meet them. 
 - Lead system-level testing for server nodes - multi-GPU topologies, PCIe/Infinity Fabric/xGMI, BMC/IPMI, thermal/power, firmware interactions, and multi-node fabric (Ethernet/InfiniBand/UALink) bring-up and validation. 
 - Drive compute workload validation and characterization - LLM training and inference (PyTorch, vLLM, Triton, JAX), recommender systems, scientific HPC kernels, MLPerf-class benchmarks - establishing reproducible methodology, baselines, and regression tracking. 
 - Architect the test infrastructure - distributed test runners, GitHub Actions / Jenkins / internal CI fleets, hardware lab orchestration, result data lakes, flaky-test detection, bisection automation, and self-service developer pre-submit pipelines. 
 - Champion modern, agile quality engineering - shift-left testing, test pyramids, contract testing between layers, hermetic test environments, deterministic reproducers, and continuous validation in trunk. 
 - Set the bar for GitHub-based quality workflows - PR gating policy, required checks, code-coverage standards, bug-bash and triage cadences, and disciplined issue management across ROCm/* repositories and partner upstream projects. 
 - Lead complex escalation debug - partner with development, hardware, firmware, and customer-facing teams to root-cause the hardest multi-day, multi-node, multi-component failures and convert findings into durable test coverage. 
 - Influence the roadmap - work with product management, silicon, platform, and software architecture to ensure validation readiness for next-generation Instinct GPUs and server platforms before tape-in milestones and silicon arrival. 
 - Mentor and elevate Senior and Staff validation engineers, SDETs, and SQA leads; raise the technical bar through design review, code review, and written guidance. 
 - Represent ROCm validation externally - strategic customer engagements, OEM qualification programs, and open-source community quality initiatives. 

Minimum Qualifications

- 12+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong validation, SDET, or quality-engineering focus, including 5+ years in a senior IC role (Staff/Principal/PMTS or equivalent) leading validation of complex systems software. 
 - BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related discipline (or equivalent demonstrated experience). 
 - Expert-level Python for test automation and infrastructure; strong C++ for debugging, and extending production code paths under test. 
 - Deep, demonstrable validation experience in at least two of the following domains: 
 - GPU compute software stacks (ROCm, CUDA, oneAPI, SYCL)
 - Deep-learning frameworks and inference engines (PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, Triton, vLLM)
 - HPC / parallel runtimes and communication libraries (MPI, RCCL/NCCL, UCX, Libfabric)
 - Linux kernel, GPU drivers, or accelerator firmware
 - Distributed systems and large-scale cluster software
 - System-level validation for server-class compute nodes- multi-GPU, multi-node, fabric-attached environments - including stress/stability, soak, fault-injection, and RAS testing. 
 - Proven, hands-on experience working efficiently in an agentic AI engineering environment - daily, production use of LLM-based coding agents (e. g. , Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot Workspace, Codex-class agents) and orchestration frameworks for real engineering work, with demonstrable productivity, quality, or coverage gains attributable to those workflows. Comfort designing prompts, tool/MCP integrations, evaluation harnesses, and guardrails for autonomous and semi-autonomous agents. 
 - Hands-on experience defining and shipping release qualification programs for software consumed by hyperscalers, OEMs, or other Tier-1 customers. 
 - Mastery of GitHub at scale for quality engineering - PR gating, GitHub Actions, self-hosted runners, required status checks, release tagging, and open-source contribution and triage norms. 
 - Strong command of modern, agile software development practices - trunk-based development, CI/CD, shift-left testing, observability, feature flags, and incremental delivery - applied specifically to validation organizations. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication - able to author crisp test plans, qualification reports, RFCs, and post-mortems, and to influence development teams without authority. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Direct contributions to validation, CI, or test infrastructure for ROCm, PyTorch, LLVM, Triton, vLLM, or comparable upstream open-source projects. 
 - Demonstrated leadership in agentic-AI adoption - built or rolled out agent-based workflows across an engineering team (e. g. , autonomous test generation, AI-driven log/triage pipelines, multi-agent debug systems, MCP server design, retrieval-augmented engineering knowledge bases) with measurable outcomes. 
 - Experience operating or validating large GPU clusters (256+ GPUs) - fabric bring-up, cluster health monitoring, and fleet-level diagnostics. 
 - Familiarity with Training/Inference/HPC industry-standard benchmark methodologies and submissions. 
 - Background in performance validation: roofline analysis, profiler tooling (rocprof, Omniperf, Nsight-class), regression detection
 - Experience with fault injection, RAS, telemetry, and long-haul stability programs for accelerator platforms. 
 - Familiarity with hardware lab automation: BMC/IPMI/Redfish, PDU control, serial-console capture, automated re-imaging, and topology-aware test scheduling. 
 - Prior experience standing up validation for pre-silicon / emulation / first-silicon bring-up of accelerators. 

Why This Role

ROCm powers AI and HPC workloads on AMD Instinct GPUs at the largest scale in the industry. The quality of every ROCm release is felt across millions of GPUs in production - and the validation organization is what stands between "code complete" and "customer ready. " As Principal MTS for ROCm Validation, you will define that bar, build the systems that enforce it, and personally lead the toughest qualification problems on AMD's most strategic platforms.

Job Title: QA - Engineer/ Sr. Engineer

Location: Pan India (Site-Based)

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience Level: 3-5 Years

About Company: DDE ULTRA is a leading provider of ultra-high purity utility systems for Semiconductor, Solar, and High-Tech industries, with strong expertise in turnkey solutions. 

We are looking for a Detail-Oriented QA Engineer to ensure quality standards across projects. The role involves implementing QA processes, conducting inspections, maintaining documentation, and ensuring compliance with industry and client requirements. The ideal candidate should have a strong eye for detail, knowledge of quality standards, and the ability to coordinate effectively with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities: 

•Prepare, review & approve of the Project Quality Plan (PQP), Work Method statement (WMS), ITP (Inspection test plan), Installation & Operational Qualification protocol, Quality Management System (QMS) SOP's, HIRA (Hazard identification and risk assessment documents), checklists and project-specific quality requirements. 

•Ensure compliance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and customer quality requirements. 

•Review welding qualification documents including WPS, PQR, WPQ and WOPQ. 

•Coordinate internal quality audits and support external/customer audits. 

•Ensure implementation of material traceability requirements throughout project execution

•Review and verify Material Test Certificates (MTCs), Certificates of Conformance (CoC), surface finish certificates, cleaning certificates and other manufacturer quality documents for project materials and components. 

•Perform components technical specifications verification to ensure compliance with approved specifications. 

•Review and approve vendor quality documents, inspection records and manufacturing documentation. 

•Coordinate vendor evaluations, supplier quality assessments and quality issue resolution. 

•Ensure all required quality documents and inspection records are available prior to fabrication, installation and dispatch activities. 

•Conduct final quality walkdown of completed assemblies, skids, manifolds and systems prior to dispatch. 

•Support FAT (If applicable), IOQ, customer inspections and project quality reviews. 

•Coordinate dispatch clearance activities by verifying inspection status, documentation completeness, punch point closure and customer-specific quality requirements. 

•Review engineering documents from a quality compliance perspective. 

•Ensure effective implementation of document control processes and maintenance of quality records. 

•Drive continual improvement initiatives within the organization. 

•Interface with clients, EPC contractors and consultants on quality-related matters. 

•Conduct quality awareness and training programs for project teams. 

•Review and approve quality dossiers, manufacturing record books (MRBs), test reports, calibration certificates and turnover documentation prior to release. 

•Coordinate with Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing and Project teams for closure of quality-related issues. 

•Manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and ensure timely closure, Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and implementation of Corrective & Preventive Actions (CAPA). 

•Periodical clean room requalification and maintaining records. 

Qualification and Skills: 

•Bachelor's degree in mechanical / production / industrial engineering. 

•3-5 years of experience in QA for Process Equipment, Gas Systems, Semiconductor, EPC projects. 

•Knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 requirements. 

•Familiarity with ASME B31. 3, SEMI Standards, ASTM standards and welding quality requirements. 

•Experience in NCR, CAPA, RCA and Internal Audits. 

•Strong documentation and customer interaction skills. 

Note: Preference will be given to candidates with experience in semiconductor fabs, ultra-high purity gas systems, and cleanroom projects. Exposure to process piping, orbital welding quality systems, and high purity stainless steel tubing systems will be an added advantage.

data.title: Sales Quality Analyst
data.description:
Sales Quality Analyst (QA)

Team: Business Development

Location: Bengaluru (In-office)

Type: Full-time

Experience: 1-3 years

About Airtribe: 

At Airtribe, we're reimagining how professionals upskill and grow in the age of AI. We run cohort-based, expert-led programs that focus on real-world application, not just passive learning. Our instructors come from companies like Gojek, Razorpay, Uber, Coinbase, Microsoft, and Meta, and more than 5, 000+ professionals have already trusted Airtribe to accelerate their careers. Backed by investors such as Better Capital and 640 Ventures, we're scaling fast and building a strong sales team is core to that journey. If you're looking to learn sales in a high-ownership, fast-paced startup, this role will push you to grow quickly. 

The Context: 

As our sales team scales, maintaining consistency and quality across conversations becomes increasingly challenging. Great sales outcomes are not just driven by volume, but by how conversations are handled, how problems are understood, and how trust is built. This role exists to build a strong feedback and quality engine that helps the sales team improve continuously and perform better over time. 

The Role: 

As a Sales Quality Analyst, you will own the evaluation and feedback loop for sales conversations. You will work closely with sales and training teams to identify gaps, highlight best practices, and contribute to building a more structured and effective sales system. This is a high-ownership role at the intersection of sales, data, and coaching. 

What You'll Own: 

- Evaluating sales calls across Pre-Sales, Sales, and Post-Sales functions. 
 - Reviewing and scoring 20-30 calls per week using a structured evaluation framework 
 - Writing detailed and actionable feedback for individual agents 
 - Identifying high-quality calls and best practices for team-wide learning 
 - Maintaining QA scorecards and tracking agent performance 
 - Supporting training initiatives through insights and real call examples 
 - Collaborating with sales and training teams to improve quality standards 
 - Ensuring QA insights are integrated into performance reviews and improvement plans. 

What Problems You'll Solve: 

- Inconsistency in sales conversations across agents 
 - Lack of structured feedback for performance improvement 
 - Identifying why deals are not converting and where drop-offs occur 
 - Bridging the gap between training and real-world sales execution 
 - Building visibility into quality metrics across the sales function

How This Role Evolves

In the initial phase, your focus will be on understanding sales processes, evaluating calls, and delivering consistent feedback. Over time, you will contribute to refining evaluation frameworks, improving training inputs, and building scalable QA systems. Based on your trajectory, this role can evolve into a Senior QA position or a Sales Training and Enablement role. 

What We're Looking For

- 1-3 years of experience in sales QA, inside sales, telesales, or sales support roles 
 - Strong listening skills with attention to communication details 
 - Ability to write clear, structured, and actionable feedback 
 - Comfort working with spreadsheets and basic data tracking 
 - High attention to detail and consistency in evaluations 
 - Curiosity about sales, edtech, and what drives effective conversations 
 - High ownership mindset with a willingness to learn and improve

What This Role Is Not

This is not a passive or checklist-based evaluation role. We are not looking for someone who only scores calls. We are looking for someone who understands conversations, identifies patterns, and helps improve outcomes. 

Why Join Airtribe

- Opportunity to build and shape the QA function from the ground up 
 - Direct exposure to a high-performance, data-driven sales team 
 - Close collaboration with sales and operations leadership 
 - High ownership with visible impact on team performance 
 - Clear growth path into training, enablement, or senior QA roles.

Job Title: 

- Principal Engineer-High Speed Interface Pre-Silicon Validation/Verification

We Are: 

At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation. 

You Are: 

You are a driven and insightful Emulation Expert, passionate about pushing the boundaries of what's possible in ASIC digital design. With a deep understanding of IP interfaces--especially PCIe and DDR--you are skilled in leveraging advanced emulation platforms like Zebu to accelerate verification and product development. Your career is marked by a proven ability to deliver robust, production-ready IP through rigorous emulation and verification cycles. You thrive in highly collaborative, matrixed, and international environments, bringing together diverse teams and perspectives to solve complex challenges. 

Your hands-on approach and proactive attitude make you a go-to resource for bridging gaps between Emulation IP and Design IP, ensuring seamless integration and verification of both Controller and PHY components. You have a keen eye for detail and are committed to right-first-time development, always ensuring traceability and completeness across verification requirements. You stay ahead of industry trends, standards, and evolving technologies, and are adept at translating these into actionable insights for your teams. As an excellent communicator and natural collaborator, you are comfortable working with multiple stakeholders and driving change within the organization. Your adaptability, resilience, and commitment to continuous learning set you apart as a leader in your field.

- Bridging and closing gaps between the available or required Emulation IP feature set and the Design IP verification for all functions, spanning both Controller and PHY domains. 
 - Reporting key metrics and driving continuous improvement initiatives in Emulation IP quality and performance. 
 - Providing technical leadership and expertise to define requirements for Emulation IP, ensuring its correct implementation and deployment within verification strategies. 
 - Staying ahead of evolving industry standards, interpreting future changes, ECNs, and specification errata, and integrating this knowledge into Emulation and Design IP teams. 
 - Reviewing and validating test plans for both Emulation IP and Design IP, guaranteeing best-in-class function, feature coverage, and product quality. 
 - Collaborating cross-functionally to optimize workflows, standardize methodologies, and ensure compliance with organizational goals. 
 - Mentoring and guiding junior engineers, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement. 

The Impact You Will Have: 

- Enhancing cross-functional collaboration to elevate product quality and end-customer satisfaction. 
 - Transforming the approach to Emulation IP usage in validating cutting-edge digital designs and system architectures. 
 - Driving innovation by defining and refining requirements for IP product development, particularly in emulation contexts. 
 - Championing the adoption of best-in-class verification methodologies across the organization. 
 - Standardizing and optimizing verification workflows to boost efficiency, traceability, and compliance. 
 - Influencing the next generation of emulation and verification solutions, positioning Synopsys as an industry leader. 
 - Accelerating time-to-market for high-performance silicon solutions through advanced emulation strategies. 

What You'll Need: 

- 8+ years of relevant experience in emulation, verification, or IP product development. 
 - Expert-level knowledge of PCIe or DDR interfaces, including protocol and verification strategies. 
 - Extensive hands-on experience with Zebu or similar emulation platforms, particularly for IP verification. 
 - Demonstrated track record in leading IP product development initiatives with a focus on emulation. 
 - Strong background in cross-functional collaboration, with an ability to drive consensus and deliver results. 
 - Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to influence and inspire change across diverse teams. 
 - Adaptability and comfort working in a fast-paced, matrixed, and international environment. 

Who You Are: 

- A proactive and collaborative problem-solver with a passion for excellence. 
 - Innovative thinker who embraces change and seeks out opportunities for continuous improvement. 
 - Strong communicator, able to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. 
 - Resilient and adaptable, thriving in dynamic environments and embracing new challenges. 
 - Committed to mentoring others and fostering an inclusive, team-oriented culture. 

The Team You'll Be a Part Of: 

You will join a dynamic, high-performing engineering team focused on IP development, emulation, and verification at the forefront of semiconductor innovation. Our team is collaborative, cross-functional, and globally distributed, working together to solve complex challenges and deliver industry-leading solutions. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with experts across multiple domains, drive impactful initiatives, and shape the future of digital design and verification at Synopsys. 

Rewards and Benefits: 

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.title: Director - Application Development
data.description:
About The Company

Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend's financial products and services span prepaid, debit, cross-border payments, and loyalty solutions for consumers and enterprise partners. 

Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U. S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130, 000 reload points and over 100, 000 distributing locations. 

Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide. 

I. The Mission

You will lead a world-class engineering organization responsible for our core Fintech and Banking portfolios. You aren't just a leader; you are a technical visionary who ensures our systems are reliable and fast. You will bridge the gap between complex business requirements and elite engineering execution, pioneering an AI-first development culture (AIDLC) to set a new industry standard for productivity. 

As the Director of Application Development, you will function as a high-impact technical executive. This role is designed for a technologist who can manage large-scale portfolios, lead multi-disciplinary teams (Front-end & Back-end), and navigate the complexities of the Fintech and Banking sectors. 

You are expected to be a "technologist first"- a leader who can sit in an architectural review or a deep-dive debugging session and add immediate value, while simultaneously presenting digital transformation roadmaps for your portfolios. 

The Director of Application Development will serve as a pivotal leader within the Netspend Product & Technology organization, reporting directly to the Engineering Leader. This highly visible Senior leadership role requires an accomplished engineering leader with deep expertise in building and scaling consumer products. 

The Director of Application Development will shape the long-term technology vision, drive SaaS-first engineering excellence, and ensure our product's solutions remain the industry benchmark for innovation, reliability, and customer value. This leader will inspire high-performing global teams and foster strong cross-functional partnerships. 

II. The Core Mandate

- Strategic Technical Leadership & Stakeholder Management
 - The Bridge: Act as the primary interface between business units and engineering. You will translate high-level commercial objectives into executable technical strategies. 
 - Portfolio Oversight: Manage a comprehensive portfolio of applications, ensuring that cross-functional teams are aligned, unblocked, and delivering high-value features. 
 - Agile Transformation: Lead the evolution of the engineering org into a high-performing, fast-paced Agile environment, optimizing for both speed-to-market and system stability. 
 - Technical Depth & Innovation (AIDLC)
 - Hands-on Guidance: While not required to write daily production code, you must possess the technical depth of a former Solution Architect or Dev Lead. You will guide teams through complex technical hurdles and ensure code quality standards. 
 - AI-Augmented Engineering: A core focus will be the AIDLC (AI-driven Development Life Cycle). You will be expected to implement AI tools and frameworks to drastically enhance team productivity and developer experience. 
 - Cloud Strategy: Direct the architecture and migration initiatives within the AWS ecosystem, ensuring cost-efficiency, scalability, and security. 
 - Move Fast with Stability: Transition teams into high-performing, autonomous units that ship code daily without compromising the integrity of financial transactions. 
 - Metric-Driven Results: Define and track KPIs that correlate engineering output with actual business revenue and user engagement. 
 - Organizational Mentorship
 - Leader of Leaders: Provide direct mentorship and career development for Senior Managers and Associate Directors. 
 - Culture of Excellence: Foster an environment of continuous learning, psychological safety, and technical curiosity. 
 - Bottom-Up Leadership: Empower Senior Managers and Associate Directors to take extreme ownership. Foster a culture where the best ideas win, regardless of hierarchy. 

III. Educational & Foundation (Mandatory)

- Academic Excellence: B. Tech / B. E. from a reputed, top-tier institute or a Master of Computer Applications (MCA). 

IV. Experience & Skills

- Years of Experience: 12+ years in Software Development with a progressive track record of leadership. 
 - Domain Expertise: Deep experience in Fintech and Banking (High-volume transactions, security protocols, regulatory compliance). 
 - Full-Stack Vision: Proven experience leading both Front-end and Back-end initiatives simultaneously. 
 - Technical Stack: Strong foundational knowledge in modern microservices, distributed systems, and AWS Migration. 
 - Communication: Elite communication skills; able to influence senior business stakeholders and inspire junior engineers. 

High-Weightage Qualifications

- Demonstrated success in using AI to enhance team efficiency (e. g. , LLM-integrated workflows, automated code synthesis, or AI-driven testing).

Job Description

The RADAR product line is a rapidly expanding business within TI, investing to address the fast-growing segment in Industrial & automotive markets. This product line will enable a scalable portfolio using DSP and ARM multi-cores to support high-end applications in ADAS, body & Chassis and in Industrial space. Radar systems process digital information from sources like digital cameras, lasers, radar and other sensors to perform tasks such as lane departure warning or parking assistance. The processed information can be displayed on screens or announced via acoustical warning signals. The system has multifaceted features such as High precision ADC, extremely accurate chirp, wide range visibility and Faster scene processing abilities. As a Verification Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our advanced RADAR products. You will be responsible for the verification of IP, Subsystem (SS), and System-on-Chip (SoC) designs, contributing to the development of robust verification methodologies, strategies and team. 

Responsibilities

Complete ownership of IP/subsystem/SOC DV ownership right from spec definition till the post silicon verification and solving the customer issues on need basis. This includes: 

- Build, Mentor and scale high preforming verification team across IP, Subsystem and SoC level
 - Lead verification activities for overall verification strategy, methodology, infrastructure and execution plans across multiple SoC programs. 
 - Verification strategy definition along with Verification plan to meet 100% spec to regression traceability along with signoff metrics. 
 - IP/SS/SOC verification covering functional and Firmware scenarios in RTL/PARTL, GLS/PAGLS modes. 
 - DV Environment ownership: TB development/enhancements including checkers and coverage monitor definitions along with DV flow updates as per the project needs 
 - Active collaboration with cross functional teams -Architecture, RTL, PD, DFT, Systems, Analog, FW and application teams -to enable the Verification goals for IP/Subsystem/SOC starting from spec definition till post silicon verification closure activities
 - Final SoC DV signoff based on Regressions, coverage metrics, DV to spec traceability using C and/or SV-UVM adhering to ISO26262 guidelines 
 - Active involvement in the customer reviews and certifications (ISO26262/ISO21434). 

Qualifications

Qualifications: 

- 8+ years of DV experience in IP/SS/SOC/Post silicon DV with a Bachelor or Master's degree in EE/ECE/CS or related specializations

Skills

- Strong people management skills along with experience in leading DV projects

 - Experience in one or more of the following areas: C-based SoC design verification (DV), firmware verification exposure, scripting knowledge (Perl/Python/AI/ML based DV), DV flow ownership for functional/firmware verification, deep understanding of UVM/SystemVerilog, Specman, GLS/PAGLS/CPF/UPF based verification, post-silicon verification, etc.

 - Work experience in a C-based environment with complex ARM/DSP multi-processor systems, including power-aware simulations, is a significant plus. 
 - Strong understanding of digital design fundamentals, computer organization and architectures, and bus protocols.

data.description:
What You'll Do

This role is responsible for leading the electrical engineering design, development, and implementation of large-scale, mission-critical data center infrastructure projects. The position combines technical leadership, people leadership, and project delivery responsibilities to ensure innovative, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective data center solutions. The role serves as the technical authority for electrical systems while driving engineering excellence, design quality, innovation, and team development across the data center project lifecycle. 

Engineering Management

- Lead and manage electrical engineers and subject matter experts across projects. 
 - Allocate resources and manage engineering workloads. 
 - Drive engineering execution to meet project schedules, quality targets, and customer requirements. 
 - Build, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams. 
 - Provide technical coaching and professional development support to engineers. 

Project Delivery & Client Engagement

- Manage electrical engineering deliverables throughout project execution. 
 - Act as the primary technical interface for customers, contractors, and internal stakeholders. 
 - Participate in client meetings, technical reviews, and project discussions. 
 - Support successful project delivery through close collaboration with project management, commercial, and technical teams. 
 - Ensure alignment between customer expectations, project requirements, and engineering execution. 

Quality, Standards & Governance

- Establish and maintain electrical engineering standards, procedures, and best practices. 
 - Conduct formal design reviews and peer reviews. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable electrical codes, standards, and industry best practices. 
 - Promote continuous improvement of engineering processes and design methodologies. 

Site Support & Commissioning

- Lead site visits during installation, testing, and commissioning phases. 
 - Monitor electrical installation activities and resolve technical issues. 
 - Support commissioning activities and operational readiness assessments. 
 - Provide technical guidance for field challenges and project execution risks. 

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

- Drive adoption of innovative technologies and engineering solutions. 
 - Evaluate new approaches to improve efficiency, reliability, and cost performance. 
 - Contribute to the advancement of next-generation data center infrastructure. 
 - Support strategic engineering initiatives and long-term technology roadmaps. 

Qualifications

Bachelor's/ Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering with 8 to 12 years of relevant experience in electrical engineering and data center infrastructure design. 

Skills

Proven experience delivering electrical systems for mission-critical facilities. 

The ideal candidate should possess strong technical expertise in the design and delivery of mission-critical data center electrical infrastructure, including medium- and low-voltage power distribution systems, transformers, UPS systems, standby generation, and critical power architectures. The role requires proficiency in electrical system design, power distribution analysis, design verification, installation and commissioning practices, as well as a thorough understanding of applicable electrical codes, standards, and quality processes. data.title: Lead Quality Assurance, Emerging Growth Opportunites
data.description:
The role is based at Mumbai and reporting to the Head Merch. & Sourcing

Business Context and Opportunities

A global conglomerate, the Aditya Birla Group is in the League of Fortune 500. Anchored by an extraordinary force of over 150, 000 employees belonging to 100 nationalities, the Group is built on a strong foundation of stakeholder value creation. Backed by seven decades of responsible business practices, the Group operates leading businesses across metals, chemicals, textiles, cement, financial services, fashion retail, telecom, and renewable energy, with over 50% of revenues generated from international operations. 

The group expanded its Retail Footprint, leveraging the trust and synergy built over the years in luxury retail by launching its Jewellery brand Indriya, in June 2024. 

India's jewellery market is at an exciting inflection point. For decades, jewellery has largely been associated with weddings, family occasions, inheritance and long-term value. A new generation is now expanding what jewellery can mean. For Gen Z and young consumers, jewellery is increasingly about self-expression, identity, mood, styling, gifting and everyday confidence. It is no longer reserved only for milestone moments. It is becoming part of how young people show up each day, at college, at work, at a café, at a concert, on social media and in the moments that define their personal style. 

Project Tiara is our attempt to build a distinctly new-age jewellery brand for this generation. 

The brand is currently in its conceptualisation stage as a separate and independent business under the legal entity Novel Jewels (the creators of Indriya), backed by the trust, ambition and scale of the Aditya Birla Group. 

The Core Idea

Project Tiara is a jewellery brand will speak to young consumers who want jewellery that is stylish, affordable, versatile and relevant to their lives. It will focus on everyday wear, trend-responsive drops and pieces that can be worn, stacked, layered, mixed, matched and made personal. 

Where the Brand Will Play

Project Tiara is being imagined for the fast-growing daily wear and self-purchase jewellery space. This is a large, under-branded opportunity in India, where young consumers are actively looking for jewellery that feels more current, more expressive and more accessible than traditional fine jewellery. 

The brand will likely operate across digital-first channels, selective physical experiences, pop-ups and omni-channel journeys. It will be designed for a consumer who discovers on Instagram, engages through content, browses online, walks into stores and expects a seamless experience across all touchpoints. 

How We Aim To Differentiate

Project Tiara will be different from traditional jewellery brands in both product and personality. 

This brand will not simply sell jewellery. It will create a new buying behaviour, where jewellery becomes part of everyday identity, styling and self-expression. 

Why This Is Exciting

Project Tiara gives us the opportunity to build a brand from the ground up: the consumer lens, product strategy, design system, brand voice, digital ecosystem, supply chain model, retail experience and growth engine. 

It will also serve as an innovation sandbox for Novel Jewels, allowing us to experiment with new designs, faster drops, creator collaborations, digital storytelling, consumer communities and more agile ways of building a jewellery brand. 

The 3 to 5 Year Ambition

Over the next 3 to 5 years, the ambition is to build Project Tiara into a meaningful, scalable, national Gen Z jewellery brand. The plan is to create a strong digital-first foundation, build repeat-led consumer behaviour, expand through selective offline formats and create a brand that young India sees as expressive, aspirational and accessible. 

Project Tiara will also help Novel Jewels engage consumers early in their jewellery journey, creating a long-term relationship that can grow with them as their life stage, income and jewellery needs evolve. 

Why Join Us

This is a rare opportunity to be part of a founding team for a new consumer brand within one of India's most respected business groups. The team will have the chance to shape the brand's identity, product language, consumer experience, content engine, commercial model and growth journey from the very beginning. 

We are looking for people who are entrepreneurial, consumer-obsessed, culturally aware, digitally fluent and excited by the idea of building something that can redefine how young India experiences jewellery. 

Project Tiara is not just a new brand. It is a chance to reimagine jewellery for a new generation.

data.description:
Company Description

Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming, with teams around the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences through franchises such as Assassin's Creed, Rainbow Six, Just Dance, and more. 

We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you're passionate about technology, innovation, and pushing the boundaries of interactive entertainment, join us in creating the unknown. 

Job Description

About Our Team

At Ubisoft, our technology teams operate within Production Services, part of the broader Core Services organization, which brings together specialized teams delivering technology, solutions, and expertise to production studios worldwide. 

Within this structure, our team goes well beyond traditional Quality Control. We focus on Test Automation, Quality Engineering, AI/GenAI, Data Analytics, Engineering Tools, and R&D, developing intelligent systems and scalable engineering solutions that address real challenges across game production. 

Our work includes everything from advanced automation frameworks and AI-powered autonomous agents to data-driven intelligence platforms. We actively explore emerging technologies and turn promising ideas into practical solutions that improve how AAA games are developed, tested, and delivered. 

Why Join Us?

As a Technical Architect within Ubisoft's Production Services organization, you will have the opportunity to: 

- Build technology beyond traditional testing: Work on automation platforms, engineering tools, AI-driven solutions, and R&D initiatives that support game production. 
 - Influence technology at a global scale: Design solutions with the potential to benefit multiple AAA projects and Ubisoft studios worldwide. 
 - Work with emerging technologies: Explore practical applications of Generative AI, autonomous agents, and intelligent engineering systems. 
 - Own meaningful technical challenges: Shape architectural decisions, guide implementations, and see the impact of your work. 
 - Collaborate across disciplines: Work alongside engineers, technical leaders, and production teams solving diverse challenges. 
 - Help shape future capabilities: Contribute to how Ubisoft evolves its engineering solutions and production technology. 

If you enjoy solving complex technical problems, building scalable systems, and exploring how emerging technologies can improve real-world production workflows, we'd love to hear from you. 

Job Summary : 

We are looking for an experienced Technical Architect to join our technology team at Ubisoft Pune. 

In this role, you will shape the technical architecture of solutions spanning Automation, Engineering Tools, and R&D initiatives. You will work closely with Programming Leads, engineers, project teams, and global technical stakeholders to design and deliver scalable, reliable, and maintainable technology solutions. 

As a senior individual contributor, you will take ownership of key architectural decisions, evaluate emerging technologies, guide engineering teams, and help transform innovative concepts into production-ready solutions. 

This is an opportunity to work across multiple technical domains, solve complex engineering problems, and influence technology decisions that can benefit multiple Ubisoft projects and studios worldwide. 

Key Responsibilities

- Technical Architecture & Solution Design
 - Design scalable, reliable, and maintainable architectures for automation frameworks, engineering tools, and intelligent systems. 
 - Translate complex production and engineering challenges into practical technical solutions. 
 - Define architectural standards, design principles, system interfaces, and integration approaches. 
 - Ensure solutions meet performance, security, scalability, and maintainability requirements. 
 - Evaluate technical trade-offs and make informed architectural decisions that support long-term sustainability. 
 - Automation & Engineering Solutions
 - Drive the architecture and evolution of automation frameworks and engineering platforms. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve development, testing, and production workflows through technology. 
 - Design reusable solutions that can support multiple projects, teams, and production environments. 
 - Collaborate with engineers to optimize system performance, reliability, and integration. 
 - Promote engineering best practices, including code quality, modularity, documentation, and maintainability. 
 - Emerging Technologies & R&D
 - Explore and evaluate emerging technologies, including AI, Generative AI, machine learning, and intelligent automation. 
 - Work with R&D teams to assess technical feasibility and develop proofs of concept. 
 - Guide the technical transition of promising prototypes into scalable, production-ready solutions. 
 - Evaluate new frameworks, tools, and architectural approaches based on their practical value and long-term potential. 
 - Encourage experimentation while maintaining sound engineering and architectural practices. 
 - Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence
 - Provide technical guidance and architectural direction to Programming Leads and engineering teams. 
 - Conduct architecture reviews, design discussions, and code reviews to maintain engineering standards. 
 - Help resolve complex technical challenges and guide teams toward effective solutions. 
 - Support technical planning, effort estimation, and implementation strategies. 
 - Contribute to the technical growth of teams through mentoring, knowledge sharing, and capability development. 
 - Global Collaboration & Technology Strategy
 - Act as a key technical point of contact for the team in discussions with global technical stakeholders. 
 - Collaborate with engineering, production, and technology teams across Ubisoft studios. 
 - Identify opportunities to share, reuse, and scale technology solutions across projects. 
 - Contribute to long-term technology roadmaps and architectural direction. 
 - Ensure local engineering initiatives align with broader organizational technology objectives. 

Core Competencies

- Architectural Thinking: Ability to design solutions that balance immediate requirements with long-term scalability and maintainability. 
 - Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills and a practical approach to solving complex engineering challenges. 
 - Technical Curiosity: Interest in exploring emerging technologies and identifying opportunities for their application. 
 - Technical Leadership: Ability to influence engineering decisions, guide technical teams, and establish strong engineering practices. 
 - Collaboration: Confidence working with multidisciplinary teams and global stakeholders. 
 - Ownership: Ability to drive technical initiatives from problem definition and architectural design through implementation and adoption. 
 - Communication: Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. 

Qualifications

- 12+ years of experience in software engineering, technical architecture, or solution development. 
 - Strong programming expertise in one or more languages such as C++, C#, and Python, with the ability to work across different technology stacks. 
 - Proven experience designing and implementing scalable software architectures, frameworks, or engineering platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of software design principles, design patterns, APIs, system integration, and application architecture. 
 - Experience developing automation frameworks, developer tools, or complex engineering solutions. 
 - Hands-on experience evaluating technologies, building prototypes, and converting technical concepts into working solutions. 
 - Strong understanding of performance optimization, reliability, maintainability, and scalable system design.

 - Ability to assess engineering challenges, evaluate technical trade-offs, and recommend sustainable solutions. 

Good to Have

data.title: Embedded QA & Test Engineer
data.description:
Major Responsibilities

Embedded Gateway & IoT Connectivity Testing: 

- Test embedded C++ firmware on Linux/RTOS-based IoT gateways. 
 - Validate Azure IoT Hub communication workflows, including: 
 - Telemetry messaging
 - Cloud-to-device (C2D) commands
 - Device Twins
 - Device Provisioning Service (DPS)
 - Certificate rotation and secure connectivity
 - Validate message queueing, offline buffering, reconnect logic, and retry behavior under real-world network conditions

Industrial Protocol Testing: 
 - Develop and execute test cases for: 
 - Modbus Serial (RTU): timing behavior, register maps, function codes, exception handling. 
 - Modbus TCP: multi-client scenarios, socket recovery, error handling. 
 - CAN bus: arbitration, extended/standard IDs, error frames, bus overload, and edge-case behavior. 
 - Uses protocol analyzers, CAN interfaces, Modbus simulators, and logic analyzers to capture and analyze traffic. 
Firmware Update & OTA Lifecycle Validation: 

- Test firmware and system updates using hawkBit (deployment orchestration) and SWUpdate (A/B updates, failover, signing, rollback)
 - Validate update workflows under stress, including: 
 - Interrupted updates (power loss, network drop)
 - Corrupted image scenarios
 - Update rollback and fallback behavior
 - Ensure secure update chain-of-trust, signature verification, and partition layout integrity. 
Automation & CI/CD Integration: 

- Develop automated test suites using Python or C++ to validate firmware, protocols, OTA processes, and system services. 
 - Build hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) automated test setups for regression, protocol simulation, and device behavior testing. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Jenkins). 
 - Maintain automation tools for serial logging, bus capture, cloud message verification, and gateway diagnostics. 

Debugging & Quality Reporting: 

- Investigate firmware and system issues via logs, traces, core dumps, serial output, and protocol captures. 
 - Reproduce field issues in controlled environments and collaborate with engineering teams to diagnose root causes. 
 - Generate test reports, defect metrics, and release readiness assessments. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement of testing tools, processes, and standards.

Certification / License

Work Experience

The candidate will lead automation delivery for International Marketplace features, stabilize the existing regression suite, and drive the migration of Playwright test scripts to the InteractAI platform. 

The role requires a combination of hands-on coding, automation framework expertise, test strategy, team leadership, and client-facing delivery management. The candidate must be comfortable using Claude AI to accelerate test script development, improve maintainability, troubleshoot failures, and optimize automation workflows.

1. GenAI-based automation engineering

 - Review and validate AI-generated code for correctness, maintainability, security, and adherence to coding standards. 
 - Identify opportunities to use AI for test design, failure analysis, test maintenance, and automation productivity improvements. 
 2. Playwright framework development

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable Playwright automation frameworks using JavaScript/TypeScript.

data.title: AI Architect
data.description:
The AI Architect designs, governs, and delivers production-grade AI capabilities, including LLM integration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic workflows, as part of secure, scalable, and maintainable healthcare products. The role is weighted toward AI/GenAI architecture and core system architecture: distributed systems, microservices, APIs, data, cloud infrastructure, security, and operations. The AI Architect translates product goals, customer commitments, and engineering constraints into architecture that works end to end, from user experience and service boundaries through data pipelines, model and retrieval layers, integrations, deployment, and runtime monitoring. 

This is not a prompt-engineering or agent-building role in isolation. Prompts, models, and agents are components of a larger system, and this role is accountable for everything around them: service decomposition, contracts, data flow, state management, latency and cost budgets, failure handling, security and PHI protection, observability, evaluation, and long-term maintainability. The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect who has shipped GenAI to production and can defend the full system design, not only the model layer. 

Key Outcomes

- Production GenAI and agentic AI capabilities delivered as reliable, secure, observable product features rather than isolated prototypes or demos. 
 - A reusable enterprise AI platform (model gateway, retrieval/RAG services, agent orchestration, evaluation, and guardrails) that product teams adopt consistently. 
 - End-to-end architectures in which AI components are properly integrated with microservices, APIs, event flows, data stores, identity, and cloud infrastructure, with clear service boundaries and contracts. 
 - AI systems that meet defined targets for quality, latency, availability, cost, and safety, with governance, PHI protection, and Responsible AI practices built in from the start. 
 - Stronger alignment among product, engineering, QA, DevOps, data, security, and leadership stakeholders around feasible and sustainable AI-enabled solutions. 

Roles and Responsibilities

- Lead the architecture of GenAI, RAG, and agentic AI solutions, including model selection, prompt and context design, retrieval strategy, tool/function calling, multi-agent orchestration, memory and state management, and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Design and evolve a shared enterprise AI platform: LLM gateway and model abstraction, prompt and configuration management, embedding and vector search services, agent orchestration (e. g. , LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), guardrails, and evaluation services. 
 - Define RAG and knowledge architectures end to end: ingestion, chunking, embedding, indexing, hybrid search, re-ranking, access control on retrieved content, data freshness, and grounding/citation strategy. 
 - Establish AI evaluation and LLMOps practices, including offline and online evaluation, golden datasets, regression testing of prompts and models, hallucination and quality metrics, A/B testing, and controlled model/version rollout and rollback. 
 - Drive AI governance, safety, and security: prompt-injection and data-exfiltration defenses, PII/PHI redaction, content filtering, auditability, model risk assessment, and alignment with Responsible AI and healthcare regulatory requirements such as HIPAA. 
 - Make and document build-vs-buy and model trade-off decisions (managed services such as AWS Bedrock vs. open-weight or self-hosted models) based on quality, latency, cost, data residency, and vendor risk. 
 - Own end-to-end system design for AI-enabled features: service decomposition, microservice boundaries, API and event contracts, synchronous vs. asynchronous patterns, data ownership, and integration with existing product and legacy systems. 
 - Design for non-functional requirements across the full stack: scalability, availability, resiliency (timeouts, retries, circuit breakers, fallbacks, and graceful degradation when models fail), performance, latency and token-cost budgets, multi-tenancy, and disaster recovery. 
 - Define data architecture for AI workloads, including operational and analytical stores, vector databases, caching, streaming and event pipelines, data lineage, retention, and secure handling of clinical and patient data. 
 - Architect cloud-native deployment on AWS containers and Kubernetes/ECS, serverless, networking, identity and access, secrets management, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD for both application and AI artifacts. 
 - Define observability across AI and non-AI components together: distributed tracing across services and model calls, prompt/response logging with privacy controls, quality and drift monitoring, cost tracking, SLOs, and alerting. 
 - Define architecture standards, reference architectures, design patterns, API guidelines, and service templates that product teams can adopt consistently. 
 - Analyze current-state architecture, technical debt, and integration constraints to identify where AI can be introduced safely and where modernization must come first. 
 - Partner with product management to translate business priorities and customer commitments into technically feasible AI roadmaps, implementation strategies, and incremental releases with measurable outcomes. 
 - Build proofs of concept and reference implementations hands-on to validate feasibility, and define the path from proof of concept to production-hardened service. 
 - Lead architecture reviews and lightweight governance aligned to agile delivery, covering both AI-specific risks and core design quality. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and engineering managers in GenAI engineering, system design, distributed systems, service ownership, and accountable AI practices. 
 - Document architecture decisions (ADRs), system and sequence diagrams, service catalogs, AI model and prompt inventories, technical risks, and roadmaps in formats usable by engineers and product stakeholders. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, and ChatGPT Enterprise to accelerate codebase exploration, design comparison, and documentation while retaining accountability for decisions. 
 - Track the evolving AI landscape (models, agent frameworks, protocols such as MCP, and evaluation methods) and turn relevant advances into pragmatic architecture guidance. 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline is required; equivalent deep technical experience may be considered. 
 - Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred. 
 - Certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect, AWS Machine Learning/GenAI, TOGAF, AI Engineer, or CKA/CKAD are preferred when supported by practical implementation experience. 

Experience

- Overall Experience of 14+ years in software development and architecture. 
 - 8+ years of architecture or technical design experience across distributed systems, microservices, APIs, data, and cloud platforms. 
 - 3+ years architecting and delivering AI/GenAI solutions, including at least one LLM, RAG, or agent-based system running in production with real users. 
 - Proven experience designing end-to-end architectures for complex, high-scale applications, from service decomposition and data modeling through deployment, observability, and operations. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating AI components into existing products and legacy systems, including reliability, latency, cost, and security trade-offs. 
 - Experience with AI evaluation, LLMOps/MLOps, and AI governance in a regulated industry; healthcare/EHR experience is preferred. 

Skills

- Expert knowledge of GenAI architecture: LLM integration, prompt and context engineering, RAG, embeddings and vector search, agentic and multi-agent patterns, tool/function calling, and frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, or LlamaIndex. 
 - Expert knowledge of system design and distributed systems: microservices, domain-driven design, API design (REST, gRPC, GraphQL), event-driven architecture, messaging and streaming, consistency and state management, caching, and scalability patterns. 
 - Strong understanding of AI quality and safety: evaluation frameworks, hallucination mitigation, guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, AI observability, and Responsible AI principles. 
 - Strong understanding of full-stack product engineering, relational, NoSQL, and vector databases, CI/CD, containers and Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, security architecture (identity, encryption, zero trust), and performance engineering. 
 - Ability to reason about and quantify trade-offs across accuracy, latency, cost, reliability, and maintainability, and to explain them clearly. 
 - Ability to create architecture decision records, reference architectures, system and sequence diagrams, service catalogs, and reusable engineering patterns. 
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to align technical and non-technical stakeholders around architecture decisions and trade-offs. 

Abilities

- Thinks in systems: designs the full request path, data flow, and failure modes around AI components, not only the model or prompt. 
 - Influences across engineering, product, QA, DevOps, data, security, and leadership teams without relying only on formal authority. 
 - Balances innovation speed with production readiness, customer commitments, and regulatory obligations. 
 - Converts ambiguity into clear architecture direction, incremental delivery plans, and executable engineering guidance. 
 - Mentors teams toward full-cycle ownership, reusable patterns, and accountable AI engineering practices. 
 - Maintains practical governance that improves quality and speed rather than increasing unnecessary process overhead. 

Tools and Technologies

- GenAI and LLM platforms: AWS Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI models, and open-weight models (e. g. , Llama, Mistral); Model Context Protocol (MCP). 
 - Agent and orchestration frameworks: LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LlamaIndex, and AWS Bedrock Agents. 
 - Vector and knowledge stores: pgvector, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, Pinecone, Weaviate; knowledge graphs and graph databases such as Neo4j or Neptune. 
 - AI evaluation and observability: LangSmith, Langfuse, Ragas, or similar; OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, and APM tools. 
 - Java, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL, REST/gRPC APIs, microservices, Angular/React, Node. js, and legacy technologies relevant to existing products. 
 - AWS services including Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, S3, IAM, Cognito, Step Functions, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, CloudWatch, Aurora, DynamoDB, Glue, and SageMaker. 
 - Kafka/streaming, relational and NoSQL databases, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis, data lakes, and distributed computing tools where applicable. 
 - CI/CD and platform tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Git/GitHub, NuGet, NPM, and feature management tools. 
 - AI-assisted engineering tools: GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise/Team, Claude, and approved AI assistants; architecture and documentation tools for diagrams, ADRs, and service catalogs. 

AI Usage and Accountability Requirements

- AI capabilities must be designed as part of the full system, with defined service boundaries, fallbacks, and ownership; prompts and agents are not shipped as standalone artifacts. 
 - Every production AI feature must have defined evaluation criteria, quality thresholds, monitoring, and a rollback path before release. 
 - PHI/PII handling, access control on retrieved data, audit logging, and human-in-the-loop controls must be designed in from the start, aligned with HIPAA and organizational AI policy. 
 - Architecture decisions must remain traceable to business goals, quality attributes, cost, implementation feasibility, and known trade-offs. 
 - AI-assisted recommendations, including those from coding and architecture assistants, must be validated against product context, engineering constraints, performance needs, maintainability, and operational risk. 
 - Reusable prompts, agent patterns, evaluation datasets, reference architectures, and design-review checklists should be maintained as organizational assets. 

Success Measures / Accountable Outcomes

data.title: Java Technical Architect
data.description:
About the Role

- We are hiring for a Principal Architect to define and govern the application and service architecture of a mature Java enterprise platform being modernized toward Spring Boot services and Angular. The role works across all pods and is a peer to the Principal Engineer for Data and Platform Architecture. 
 - You will define the target architecture, establish decision guardrails, and prove critical patterns with reference implementations. You will not act as a central approval queue. Engineering Leads retain pod delivery ownership, while you guide decisions that affect multiple domains, shared contracts, or the long-term platform shape. 

What You Will Own

- Define the target application, service, API, integration, security, and deployment architecture. 
 - Establish incremental migration patterns from Java EE, Wildfly, and JSF to Spring Boot and Angular. 
 - Create reference implementations and architecture decision records for high-impact patterns. 
 - Review cross-domain and irreversible design decisions with Engineering Leads and Staff Engineers. 
 - Define standards for service boundaries, API contracts, resilience, observability, and backward compatibility. 
 - Partner with the Data and Platform Principal on data ownership, migration sequencing, and shared platform concerns. 
 - Maintain a pragmatic technical debt and decommissioning strategy for the existing platform. 

What You Bring

- 12+ years of software engineering and 4+ years in architecture roles on enterprise platforms. 
 - Deep Java and Spring Boot architecture experience, including REST services and distributed-system patterns. 
 - Strong understanding of Java EE application servers, Hibernate or JPA, and incremental modernization. 
 - Working knowledge of modern Angular architecture and frontend-backend contract design. 
 - Experience with containers, CI/CD, security, observability, and production reliability. 
 - Ability to communicate architecture through code, diagrams, decision records, and direct coaching. 

What Sets You Apart

- You have led the architecture of a live Java EE to Spring Boot modernization without a big-bang rewrite. 
 - Your standards are specific enough to guide teams and flexible enough to handle real product constraints. 
 - You influence senior engineers through technical credibility rather than organizational authority. 

Success in This Role

- Pods make consistent architecture decisions without waiting for routine approvals. 
 - Modernization reduces coupling and operational risk in measurable increments. 
 - Cross-pod designs have clear ownership, documented trade-offs, and working reference patterns.

data.title: NAP Network Test Automation Development Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

As Network Test Automation Development Engineer is responsible for designing and developing scalable, intelligent test automation solutions for complex network systems. This role combines strong networking expertise with modern automation, CI/CD, and AI/ML technologies to ensure high quality, reliability, and faster delivery of carrier-grade, cloud-native network products. 

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for functional, regression, performance, and end‐to‐end network testing. 
 - Develop automated test suites using Python, Java, or Go with frameworks such as Robot Framework, pytest, and Selenium. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing and faster release cycles. 
 - Apply AI/ML techniques for intelligent test case generation, anomaly detection, predictive defect analysis, and self‐healing automation. 
 - Analyze large volumes of test and network data to identify patterns, trends, and quality risks. 
 - Develop AI‐driven tools for network test data analysis, insights, and visualization. 
 - Collaborate with development, product, and QA teams to ensure testability and timely defect resolution. 
 - Contribute to test strategy, code reviews, design discussions, and maintain automation documentation. 

Key Skills And Experience

You have: 

- Bachelor degree with 8-12 years of relevant experience. 7+ years of experience with strong programming skills in Python, Java, or Go for test automation and tool development. 
 - Hands‐on experience with test automation frameworks such as Robot Framework, pytest, Selenium, and Postman. 
 - Solid understanding of network protocols and architectures (TCP/IP, IP/MPLS, Routing & Switching, SDN/NFV, 4G/5G). 
 - Experience with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar). 

It would be nice if you also had: 

- Practical understanding of AI/ML concepts applied to automation or data analysis. 
 - Exposure to ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit‐learn. 
 - Familiarity with cloud platforms and container technologies (AWS/Azure/GCP, Docker, Kubernetes).
