data.description:
Company Description

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it's consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future. 

Job Description

Gracenote is the content business unit of Nielsen that powers the world of media entertainment. Our metadata solutions help media and entertainment companies around the world deliver personalized content search and discovery, connecting audiences with the content they love. We're at the intersection of people and media entertainment. 

With our cutting-edge technology and solutions, we help audiences easily find TV shows, movies, music and sports across multiple platforms. As the world leader in entertainment data and services, we power the world's top streaming platforms, cable and satellite TV providers, media companies, consumer electronics manufacturers, music services and automakers to navigate and succeed in the competitive streaming world. Our metadata entertainment solutions have a global footprint of 80+ countries, 100K+ channels and catalogs, 70+ sports and 100M+ music tracks, all across 35 languages. 

Job Purpose

- Architect & Design our flagship metadata software solutions. 
 - Design applications with a Platform-first mentality where scale, consistency and reliability are at the core of every decision. 
 - Responsible for driving Technology & good practices in Engineering in their respective teams. 
 - Partner with the Product team to translate vague business requirements into concrete, feasible technical roadmaps. 
 - Actively participate in development along with team members for as much as 60% of their time, creating modules & systems that can then be treated as a working reflection of the best practices. 
 - Cross-System Integration ensuring data flow seamlessly & consistently across ingestion, processing and data deliveries to end customers. 
 - Work closely with Data Science, DevOps, and Frontend architects to ensure our backend infrastructure supports emerging needs. 
 - Being responsible for Scaling, Performance & Quality. 
 - Experiment with new & relevant technologies and tools, and drive adoption while measuring yourself on the impact you can create. 
 - Implementation of long-term technology vision for your teams. 
 - Creating architectures & designs for new solutions around existing and new problem spaces. 
 - Responsible for the architecture of your platform; ensuring it is aligned to the long term requirements and the platform vision. 
 - Drive technology & tool choices for your team & be responsible for them. 
 - Drive technology forums & rhythms in the team to drive best practices. Establish organization-wide engineering standards (coding guidelines, API contracts, security protocols, design standards) to ensure consistency across different teams. 
 - Mentor and guide Senior engineers, fostering a culture of learning and collaboration within the team
 - Going beyond your role and contributing to make the organization & business better. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 10+ years of professional experience in software development
 - Experience in designing, developing and scaling enterprise grade applications, including developing solutions from scratch. 
 - In depth knowledge and proficiency of messaging queue concepts 
 - Proficiency in Java/Python frameworks such as Spring, Hibernate, or similar. 
 - Experience with RESTful APIs and microservices architecture. 
 - Familiarity with front-end technologies (e. g. , HTML, CSS, JavaScript) is a plus. 
 - Working knowledge of machine learning and data science concepts 
 - Champion of SDLC practices. Understanding of software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum, etc. ). 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently as well as in a team environment. 
 - Strong understanding of application development, infrastructure management, data engineering and platform constructs. 
 - Deep understanding of various datastores: SQL & NoSQL. 
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (e. g. , AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). Familiarity with containerization technologies (e. g. , Docker, Kubernetes). Knowledge of CI/CD tools and practices. 
 - Experience with test-driven development (TDD) and automated testing frameworks. 

What We Offer

- Competitive salary and benefits package. 
 - Opportunities for professional growth and development. 
 - A collaborative and inclusive work environment. 

Additional Information

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen. com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen. com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

data.title: Principal SaaS Architect and Engineering Lead
data.description:
Principal SaaS Architect and Engineering Lead

(. NET Core / Azure)

Location: Surat Gujarat

Experience: 15+ years in software engineering, including SaaS architecture and engineering leadership

Working hours: Full shift aligned with U. S. Pacific Time business hours. This is an ongoing, non-negotiable requirement. 

The opportunity

We are seeking a senior, hands-on technology professional with proven experience designing, building, and operating enterprise SaaS products. You will work closely with technology leadership, contribute independent architectural judgment, and strengthen engineering capabilities across the organization. 

The role has two primary responsibilities: working alongside the existing treasury SaaS product leader to support the product's technical management and day-to-day operations, and guiding the architecture and engineering of our future SaaS products. 

Key responsibilities

SaaS architecture and future product engineering

· Translate business requirements into architecture options, technical roadmaps, implementation phases, and engineering estimates for future SaaS products. 

· Design and review tenancy models, tenant isolation, identity and access, onboarding, integrations, data architecture, and product extensibility. 

· Evaluate trade-offs across scalability, availability, disaster recovery, security, maintainability, and Azure operating costs. Document decisions and guide implementation. 

Hands on delivery and production ownership

· Develop enhancements, review code, investigate complex application and SQL issues, and troubleshoot Azure services and integrations. 

· Own assigned production incidents during the agreed shift: assess impact, identify defects or operational issues, communicate progress, and coordinate resolution. 

· Take fixes through internal testing, UAT coordination, approved production release, and post-release verification; improve monitoring, runbooks, and root-cause prevention. 

Engineering leadership and security

· Guide onsite and India-based engineers through sprint planning, technical discussions, estimation, design reviews, and delivery reviews. 

· Mentor engineers and strengthen code quality, testing, secure development, CI/CD, documentation, and troubleshooting practices across teams. 

· Support VAPT assessments and SOC audits by providing technical evidence, addressing findings, and coordinating remediation, validation, and retesting as applicable. 

· Review application and Azure security posture. Identify potential attack paths and weaknesses in access controls, exposed services, and configurations, working with security teams to prioritize and reduce risk. 

· Communicate clearly with client stakeholders and technology leadership about technical options, operational issues, risks, and delivery commitments. 

Essential experience and capabilities

· 15+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including strong recent hands-on development and technical leadership. 

· Demonstrated responsibility for designing and delivering SaaS products, with experience operating and evolving them in production. 

· Strong C#, . NET Core / ASP. NET Core, SQL, and REST API development, debugging, code review, and performance optimization skills. 

· Practical Azure application architecture experience, including App Service, Azure SQL, Functions, Key Vault, Application Insights, and Log Analytics. 

· Sound understanding of SaaS tenancy models, data isolation, authentication, authorization, secure configuration, and integration design. 

· Experience with source control, Azure DevOps or equivalent tooling, CI/CD, testing, controlled releases, and production incident management. 

· Ability to learn an established codebase, explain architectural trade-offs, independently recommend improvements, and mentor distributed teams. 

· Strong client communication and a willingness to combine architecture leadership with hands-on development and ongoing production support. 

Desirable experience

· Blazor WebAssembly or Server; Azure Logic Apps, Data Factory, and Microsoft Fabric. 

· Treasury, banking, fintech, or financial SaaS applications; VAPT remediation and technical support for SOC audits. 

Working expectations

This role includes regular production support alongside architecture, development, and mentoring. The full U. S. Pacific Time shift is essential.

Marriott Tech Accelerator is part of Marriott International, a global leader in hospitality. Marriott International, Inc. is a leading American multinational company that operates a vast array of lodging brands, including hotels and residential properties. It consists of over 30 well-known brands and nearly 8, 900 properties situated in 141 countries and territories. 

Title: Lead Software Engineer

Position Summary: 

Marriott International is the world's largest hotel company, with more brands, more hotels and more opportunities for associates to grow and succeed. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you. 

We are looking for a Lead Software Engineer to join our Revenue Management and Pricing Technology team. In this role, you will provide hands-on technical leadership and drive end-to-end delivery of scalable, cloud-native applications that support critical pricing and revenue business functions. You will work across the full stack using technologies like Java, Spring Boot, React, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift, PostgreSQL, and Couchbase/Document DB, while modernizing platform architecture, improving reliability, and enabling team growth through mentorship and engineering excellence. 

Job Responsibilities: 

- Own low-level design (LLD) for assigned modules/services; define patterns that meet scalability, security, performance, and reliability standards. 
 - Lead end-to-end technical delivery-from design and development through testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. 
 - Design, build, and evolve microservices and APIs using Java/JEE and Spring Boot for enterprise-grade pricing and revenue systems. 
 - Build distributed systems using Pub/Sub and streaming patterns (e. g. , Kafka), including event-driven and asynchronous processing. 
 - Lead, Design and optimize data models and queries across SQL and NoSQL stores (PostgreSQL and Couchbase/DocumentDB); tune SQL queries for application performance. 
 - Drive containerized development and deployments using Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift; contribute to cloud-native practices on AWS. 
 - Define & Champion engineering best practices including code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, secure coding, and agile methodologies. 
 - Mentor and coach engineers; facilitate technical grooming, knowledge sharing, and upskilling to improve team capability. 
 - Own production readiness and operational excellence: lead incident response, perform root-cause analysis (RCA), improve observability (logs/metrics/traces), and reduce technical debt. 

Required Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience. 
 - 7+ years of professional software development experience with strong hands-on coding and technical leadership for small teams or workstreams. 
 - Strong Java/JEE and Spring Boot expertise. 
 - 5+ years of experience building microservices and distributed systems. 
 - 3+ years of experience with ReactJS or similar front-end frameworks. 
 - Hands-on experience with AWS or other cloud platforms. 
 - Proficiency with SQL & NoSQL database design and development (e. g. , PostgreSQL and Couchbase/DocumentDB), including optimizing SQL queries for application performance. 
 - Working experience building distributed systems using Pub/Sub and streaming platforms such as Kafka. 
 - Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes/OpenShift). 
 - Solid understanding of DevOps tools and practices (Git, Harness/Jenkins, JIRA, CI/CD pipelines). 
 - Strong communication and problem-solving skills; ability to translate technical complexity to business stakeholders and influence decisions. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience with enterprise integration patterns (e. g. , Apache Camel). 
 - Exposure to distributed systems and concurrency frameworks (e. g. , Akka). 
 - Background in travel, hospitality, or pricing systems. 
 - Experience contributing to architectural decisions or solution design and modernization initiatives. 
 - Agile/Scrum team experience, including facilitating technical ceremonies and release planning. 
 - Experience with modern front-end experiences using ReactJS (or similar) with strong UX, performance, and accessibility practices. 
 - Familiarity with big data tools and batch processing (e. g. , Spark, Scala, Oozie, EMR) will be a big plus. 

Education and Certifications: 

- Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience/certification. 

Work Location: Hyderabad, India. 

Work Mode: Hybrid.

data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Job Title: AI Platform Engineering Manager

Role Overview: 

EY GDS's Managed Services "AI for AI" team is looking for an AI Platform Engineering Manager to own the deployment, scaling, and reliability of our agentic AI solutions across a complex, hybrid infrastructure landscape - multi-cloud, on-prem, and hosted model environments. You'll lead a team of engineers responsible for turning AI prototypes into resilient, enterprise-grade platforms that run globally, securely, and cost-effectively. 

This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, MLOps/LLMOps, and agentic systems architecture. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Own platform deployment for agentic AI solutions across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, as well as on-prem and hybrid-hosted model environments (open-source and proprietary LLMs). 
 - Design and manage CI/CD and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines for model deployment, versioning, rollback, and continuous evaluation at scale. 
 - Architect for scale and resilience - ensuring platforms reliably serve 100, 000+ concurrent users globally with strong uptime, latency, and cost-efficiency targets. 
 - Lead a team of platform/infrastructure engineers, setting technical direction, mentoring, and managing delivery timelines. 
 - Partner cross-functionally with AI Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Responsible AI leads, and Product Design to translate agentic workflows into production-ready systems. 
 - Manage model-hosting strategy, including trade-offs between hosted APIs (e. g. , Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI), self-hosted open-source models, and on-prem deployments for data residency/compliance needs. 
 - Build observability and monitoring for agentic systems - tracing, logging, cost monitoring, drift detection, and performance dashboards. 
 - Drive security, compliance, and governance of AI infrastructure in collaboration with Responsible AI and InfoSec teams, particularly given enterprise/regulated-client contexts (tax, cybersecurity, supply chain data). 
 - Optimize infrastructure cost and performance, balancing GPU/compute resource allocation across cloud and on-prem environments. 
 - Contribute to platform strategy and roadmap, advising leadership on build-vs-buy decisions, emerging tools, and infrastructure investments. 

Experience

What We're Looking For

- 5-8 years in platform engineering, infrastructure/DevOps, SRE, or MLOps roles, with at least 2+ years working on AI/ML or LLM-based systems in production. 
 - Demonstrated experience deploying and scaling software/AI platforms across multiple cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) and in on-prem/hybrid environments. 
 - Experience deploying and managing both hosted LLM APIs and self-hosted/open-source models (e. g. , Llama, Mistral) in production. 
 - Experience building or operating agentic AI systems or complex multi-step AI workflows is highly preferred. 
 - Prior experience managing or leading a team of engineers. 

Technical Skills

- Strong proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation). 
 - Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containerization (Docker), and orchestration at scale. 
 - Experience with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, etc. ). 
 - Familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps tooling
 - Understanding of model-hosting economics, GPU resource management, and inference optimization techniques (quantization, batching, caching). 
 - Working knowledge of enterprise security, data residency, and compliance requirements in regulated industries. 
 - Proficiency in at least one major programming language (Python strongly preferred; Go or Java a plus)

Soft Skills / Leadership

- Proven ability to lead engineering teams in fast-paced, ambiguous, build-from-scratch environments. 
 - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills - comfortable working with Data SMEs, Product, Responsible AI, and business stakeholders. 
 - Clear communicator who can translate technical trade-offs into business impact for non-technical leadership. 
 - Comfortable operating in a "zero to one" environment - building platform foundations rather than maintaining existing ones. 

What We Offer: 

- A leadership position within a globally recognized team at the cutting edge of AI/ML innovation, providing the opportunity to work on transformative projects with significant impact. 
 - Access to an extensive network of professionals and resources across the globe, fostering an environment conducive to continuous learning and career advancement. 
 - A diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates individuality and encourages the expression of ideas, facilitating collaborative team efforts and personal growth. 
 - Comprehensive support and guidance to develop into a transformative leader, equipped to navigate and excel in today's rapidly evolving technological landscape. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Technical Architect – Design for Test (DFT)
data.description:
Technical Architect - Design for Test (DFT)

Location: Bengaluru

Experience: 12-16 Years

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Technical Architect - DFT to define and drive DFT architecture, methodology, and implementation for complex ASIC/SoC designs. The role requires deep technical expertise in MBIST, ATPG, scan insertion, and end-to-end DFT sign-off, with ownership of test architecture, coverage optimization, and design-for-manufacturing requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and drive DFT architecture and test strategies for complex IP and SoC designs. 
 - Own scan architecture, scan insertion, scan compression, and DFT RTL integration. 
 - Architect and implement MBIST solutions, including memory test algorithms, controller integration, and verification. 
 - Drive ATPG pattern generation, fault simulation, pattern validation, and test coverage closure. 
 - Develop DFT specifications, implementation plans, and sign-off methodologies. 
 - Optimize stuck-at, transition-delay, and other relevant fault coverage while managing test time and pattern volume. 
 - Drive DFT rule checking, testability analysis, and resolution of DFT violations. 
 - Collaborate with RTL, Physical Design, Verification, and Silicon Validation teams to ensure seamless DFT integration. 
 - Debug DFT-related issues and support silicon bring-up, manufacturing test, and yield improvement. 
 - Evaluate DFT flows, establish reusable methodologies, and provide technical guidance to engineering teams. Required Technical Skills

- 12-16 years of hands-on experience in DFT architecture and implementation for ASIC/SoC designs. 
 - Strong expertise in DFT architecture, scan insertion, and ATPG. 
 - In-depth experience with MBIST architecture, integration, and verification. 
 - Strong understanding of scan compression, scan-chain architecture, and test-point insertion. 
 - Hands-on experience with ATPG pattern generation, fault modeling, fault simulation, and coverage analysis. 
 - Expertise in DFT rule checking, testability analysis, and DFT sign-off. 
 - Experience with industry-standard DFT tools such as Synopsys TestMAX, Siemens Tessent, or equivalent. 
 - Strong understanding of stuck-at and transition-delay fault models, test coverage, and manufacturing test requirements. 
 - Knowledge of DFT timing, area, power, and physical implementation trade-offs. Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with LBIST, JTAG/IEEE 1149. 1, boundary scan, and hierarchical DFT. 
 - Exposure to advanced technology nodes and complex SoC test architectures. 
 - Experience with post-silicon DFT debug, ATE integration, and silicon yield analysis. 
 - Strong technical leadership, architecture documentation, and cross-functional problem-solving skills. Education

B. E. /B. Tech/M. E. /M. Tech in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.

data.title: Senior Software Test Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

At NI IP Routing SW, we believe in fostering a flat and non-hierarchical work environment. We are obsessed about delivering high-quality products and ensure the utmost level of excellence in everything we do. We are a passionate bunch and strive to be technological leaders in our industry. You will be integral to a close-knit team to engineer best-in-class products for the most critical networks - data centers for web/hyper-scalers, telcos and enterprises (including AI fabrics), and communication service provider networks. 

We are looking for SW Test engineers who wish to be a part of developing and evolving the current and next generation of routers that form the core of anything internet. These routers are at the heart of Nokia's IP product offerings, from data centers (including AI fabrics), to providing strong, resilient low latency and dependable IP backhaul for service providers and mission critical networks. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with one of the best engineering teams in the industry. We value your expertise and offer an environment where you can thrive both professionally and personally. There are more customers we want to win, more networks to penetrate, more technologies to enable and more applications to support. We want to make smaller products, and we want to make bigger products. We want to build products based on newer standards and newer ASICS in the market. 

DCN2026

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

- Own software features end to end and ensure their quality is robust across products and platforms
 - Specialize in datacenter and AI networks 
 - Write modular, lean, and efficient automation code including libraries and infrastructure
 - Work closely with product management and software developers to meet customer requirements

Key Skills And Experience

- Bachelor's degree with 3-10 years of relevant experience in networking and software automation. 
 - Exposure to any of the below domains: 
 - Layer-2 switching and layer-3 routing
 - Routing protocols (ospf, isis, bgp)
 - Multicast (pim, igmp) 
 - Segment Routing
 - Mpls (ldp, rsvp-te)
 - Evpns with vxlan, mpls, sr-te underlays
 - QoS (policers, schedulers, shapers) 
 - Automation experience in python, golang or any programming language
 - Experience in virtualized environments such as kvm, dockers, and Kubernetes

Engineering Lead

AI Agentic Platform Orchestration, Benchmarking & Unification

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to build, architect, and lead the team behind our next-generation AI Agentic Platform. This platform empowers enterprises to measure ROI on industry-specific agent activity, benchmark AI agents against performance standards, orchestrate complex multi-agent workflows, and unify AI agents seamlessly across diverse platforms and ecosystems. 

As the engineering leader for this strategic product, you will combine deep technical expertise with strong people management skills to deliver a unified control plane for the rapidly evolving agentic AI landscape. You will own the technical vision, drive architectural decisions, and grow a high-performing team that ships at the frontier of AI engineering. 

Platform Capabilities You'll Own

- Industry-Specific ROI Measurement: Build instrumentation, analytics, and reporting frameworks that quantify the business impact of AI agents across verticals such as BFSI, healthcare, retail, and telecom. 
 - AI Agent Benchmarking: Develop standardized evaluation harnesses, performance scoring, and quality metrics that allow enterprises to compare agents on accuracy, latency, cost, safety, and task success. 
 - Agent Orchestration: Design multi-agent orchestration engines, workflow planners, routing layers, and coordination frameworks that enable agents to collaborate on complex tasks reliably. 
 - Cross-Platform Agent Unification: Architect a unified abstraction layer, connectors, and protocol adapters (MCP, A2A, OpenAI Assistants, LangGraph, etc. ) so customers can manage agents across vendors and frameworks from a single pane of glass. 

Key Responsibilities

- Hire, build, and lead a high-caliber engineering team across backend, AI/ML, and platform infrastructure
 - Define and own the technical architecture for a multi-tenant, scalable AI agentic platform
 - Drive the technical roadmap for orchestration, benchmarking, observability, and unification capabilities

 - Establish engineering best practices for AI agent development, evaluation, safety, and deployment
 - Lead architectural reviews, design discussions, and technical decision-making for complex distributed systems
 - Build robust evaluation frameworks and ROI dashboards that customers and internal teams trust
 - Ensure platform reliability, performance, security, and cost efficiency at scale
 - Mentor engineers, set growth paths, run performance reviews, and foster an inclusive, high-trust team culture
 - Communicate progress, risks, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership

Required Qualifications

- 8+ years of software engineering experience with at least 3+ years managing engineering teams

 - Proficiency in modern programming languages such as Python, Go, Java, or TypeScript
 - Experience designing APIs, SDKs, and integration platforms used by enterprise customers

 - Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar)
 - Familiarity with emerging agent interoperability standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols
 - Experience designing LLM evaluation and benchmarking systems (offline evals, A/B testing, golden datasets, judge models)

 - Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or related field

Technical Stack & Tooling

- Languages: Python, Go, TypeScript/Node. js, Java
 - AI/ML Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, PyTorch, OpenAI/Anthropic/Google APIs
 - Agent Protocols: MCP, A2A, OpenAI Assistants API, function calling, tool use frameworks

 - Streaming & Messaging: Kafka, Redis, RabbitMQ, gRPC

What We're Looking For

Our technology protects the world's most critical infrastructure-from data centers to next generation cloud and AI platforms-by securing systems at the foundation levels of hardware, independent of host CPUs and operating systems. 

Founded in 2019 and now over 150 employees are strong, Axiado has evolved into a recognized leader in the convergence of AI, security, and silicon innovation. We partner with and are actively engaged in commercial programs with multiple Tier 1 industry leaders, validating both our technology and our long-term market trajectory. Axiado has also won numerous industry awards for our ground-breaking products and technological innovations, including being named one of Fast Company's 2025 Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Security, winning the 2025 Global InfoSec Award for Outstanding AI Security Solution, and being named a finalist for the Global Semiconductor Alliance's 2025 "Start-Up to Watch" award. 

At Axiado, developing breakthrough technology takes more than great engineering-it takes a team of exceptional people who collaborate boldly, challenge assumptions, and take pride in building what comes next. We value curiosity, execution, respect, and a shared desire to make a meaningful impact on the security and reliability of the digital world. 

If you're driven to innovate, energized by hard problems, and excited to help define the future of secure AI infrastructure, we invite you to apply and join us on this journey. 

Job Description

This position is your opportunity to join one of the industry's leading companies in Smart Edge SoCs for network/systems control, management security systems, and IOT. 

You will be responsible for chip level verification of complex ARM based SOC HW, debugging, and ROM and FW bringup. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop SOC system level test environment for simulation and emulation, including log generation, backdoor configuration and device modeling
 - Develop testplan and tests, including error condition tests and stress tests
 - Run and debug tests in regressions, both in simulation and on emulator
 - Work with other teams in root-causing HW issues, and creating system level test cases for them
 - Validation ROM
 - Work with SW team in debugging device driver issues, and OS boots

Qualifications

- 7 years of DV or validation experience, and 5 years of system Level verification experience using C

This role requires a deep understanding of software design and development and the ability to plan, execute, and deliver product features in a timely and predictable manner. You will also be responsible for maintaining high technical standards, managing team bandwidth, and ensuring project milestones are met with efficiency and accuracy. 

What you'll get to do

To succeed in this role, you should have

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

 - Ability to drive alignment across cross-functional stakeholders, both technical and non-technical.

Generic Skills

What we can offer you

data.title: Agentic AI Architect/Sr. Architect
Staff Architect
data.description:
We are looking for a Staff Architect to help drive architecture across two connected pillars at organisation: the internal AI engineering platform that accelerates how teams build, and the client-facing product architecture that our customers depend on every day. This is a hands-on, deeply collaborative technical leadership role for someone who has shipped real systems with LLMs and agents, who is comfortable shaping architecture across services, data, security and developer experience, and who is energized by working through other engineers rather than around them. 

The Role

You will help drive the technical direction of organisation's AI engineering platform and the architecture of our client-facing products. That means partnering with engineering leads, product, security and operations to shape the systems that internal teams build on, the products customers rely on and the AI capabilities that increasingly run through both. You will write code, write design docs, lead reviews, mentor other senior and staff engineers and turn good local decisions into durable enterprise patterns. 

This role is intentionally cross-cutting. You will move between platform problems (how engineers and product managers ship faster and more consistently across the company) and product problems (how our client-facing systems scale, integrate, stay secure and incorporate AI in ways that hold up in a regulated industry). 

Key Responsibilities

Internal AI Engineering Platform

- Help drive the architecture of organisation's internal AI scaffolding platform, including agent orchestration, skill and contract design, multi-IDE adapters (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and successors) and the developer experience that ties them together. 
 - Co-design enterprise-wide standards for building with LLMs and agents: prompt and context patterns, retrieval and grounding, tool integration, evals, guardrails, cost and latency budgets, observability and incident response. 
 - Partner with engineering leads across product teams to evolve their stacks toward shared scaffolding rather than parallel reinvention, and contribute reusable skills, templates and adapters back to the platform. 
 - Help shape the evaluation strategy for AI features: how we measure quality, regressions, safety and business impact, and how evals are wired into CI, staging and production telemetry. 
 - Influence model selection, agent framework choices, vendor versus in-house tradeoffs and where to place the boundaries between platform and product code. Client-Facing Product Architecture

- Partner with product engineering leads to drive the architecture of organisation's client-facing systems across the surfaces customers interact with, including web applications, APIs, integrations and embedded AI features. 
 - Shape the service architecture: domain boundaries, service decomposition, design platform services, AI services and event-driven patterns. 
 - Contribute to the data architecture in close collaboration with the Data Architect: how transactional, analytical and regulatory data flows through products, how contracts are defined between systems, how lineage and quality are preserved. 
 - Help drive the AI in product strategy: where LLMs, RAG, agents and assistive features belong in customer-facing workflows, how they are evaluated, how they fail gracefully and how their behavior is auditable. 
 - Shape choices around scalability, performance, multi-tenancy and resilience for client workloads, including capacity planning, caching, rate limiting, async processing and graceful degradation. 
 - Co-design the security and compliance posture for products in a regulated domain: authentication, authorization, tenancy isolation, encryption, secrets handling, audit logging and data residency. 
 - Influence observability and operability standards: telemetry, logging, tracing, SLOs, on-call ergonomics and incident review. 
 - Guide integration and interoperability decisions across customer integrations, third-party services, data feeds and partner platforms. Technical Leadership Across Both Pillars

- Lead and contribute to design reviews, architecture decision records and technical writing that sets the bar for the broader engineering organization. 
 - Mentor staff and senior engineers across teams. Coach them through hard tradeoffs rather than making the calls for them. 
 - Be the technical voice that helps leadership decide what to build, what to buy and what to retire, and that translates technical reality back to business stakeholders. 
 - Work with security, compliance and risk to make sure AI-driven workflows and product features meet ORAGANISATION's obligations around data handling, auditability, access control and regulatory exposure. 
 - Stay close to the broader industry. Bring back practices that are working elsewhere and adapt them to our context. Essential Criteria

- 11+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a clear track record of technical leadership at staff level or equivalent cross-team scope. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and shipping production systems built on LLMs or autonomous agents. You can speak in detail to systems you architected, the tradeoffs you made and what you would do differently. 
 - Strong distributed systems and software architecture background. You can move fluently between service design, API design, data flow, security and developer experience. 
 - Hands-on experience architecting client-facing SaaS or enterprise products: service boundaries, APIs, integrations, multi-tenancy, performance, resilience and observability. 
 - Working understanding of data architecture: storage choices (relational, document, analytical, vector), data contracts and how product systems and data platforms meet at the boundary. 
 - Hands-on fluency with modern AI engineering practice: prompt and context engineering, retrieval augmented generation, agent orchestration, tool use, evals and guardrails. 
 - Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives through influence in a mid to large engineering organization. You can move a group of senior engineers toward shared decisions without relying on positional authority. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication. You can write a one-page design doc that aligns a room of senior people and a five-line summary that aligns an executive. 
 - A pragmatic, collaborative mindset. You balance rigor with delivery, work inside legacy constraints and still move the architecture forward. Nice to Have

- Experience building developer tooling or internal platforms at enterprise scale, especially scaffolding, code generation, workflow automation or developer productivity systems. 
 - Experience integrating AI assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot or similar) into team workflows as a deliberate engineering practice, not just individual use. 
 - Familiarity with MCP-style tool integration, agent contracts and multi-agent orchestration patterns. 
 - Experience with eval frameworks (LangSmith or commercial/in-house equivalents) and with observability for LLM and agent systems in production. 
 - Experience designing for compliance, audit and regulatory requirements in financial services, healthcare or another regulated, data-sensitive domain. 
 - Familiarity with cloud-native architecture on AWS (or equivalent), containerization, IaC and modern CI/CD. 
 - A track record of writing or speaking publicly about software architecture or AI engineering practice. What We Offer

- A senior technical leadership role with scope across both the AI platform that internal teams build on and the products our customers rely on. 
 - The chance to help define the architectural standards and patterns that hundreds of engineers and product managers will use every day. 
 - A collaborative, forward-thinking team that takes both engineering rigor and emerging AI practice seriously. 
 - The opportunity to work at the intersection of regulated financial data and modern AI tooling, where the technical bar and the business stakes are both high.

CTS Group/CTS Asia - Part of CTS Group is hiring Electrical Design Engineer (HV/MV) for its growing Data Center engineering & delivery teams in Oragadam, Chennai. 

Role: Electrical Engineer (HV/MV)

Company: CTS Group

Location: Oragadam, Kanchipuram

Type: Full-Time, On-Site

About CTS Group

CTS Group is a fast-growing international design and build company specialising in data center development across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA). We combine engineering excellence, innovation, and digital transformation to deliver high-performance, sustainable, and future-ready data center solutions. 

With over 40 nationalities represented across our teams, CTS fosters a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performance culture where innovation and technical precision drive every project. Beyond construction, CTS develops digital systems and standardised modular data center units to meet the evolving needs of hyperscalers, colocation providers, and enterprise clients. 

Our proven track record and strong partnerships have established CTS as a trusted industry leader delivering large-scale, complex data center facilities with speed, efficiency, and excellence. 

Role Overview

The Electrical Engineer (HV/MV) leads the high- and medium-voltage electrical scope for CTS Group's Chennai production campus, where standardised modular data center units are engineered and manufactured. The role owns the design, specification, and integration of HV/MV power distribution systems, from incoming supply through switchgear, transformers, and protection, ensuring every unit is safe, reliable, and compliant before dispatch. 

Working across the engineering, production, and quality teams, the role provides technical direction to a team of electrical engineers and designers, and interfaces with vendors, consultants, and commissioning teams. It combines hands-on design ownership with day-to-day leadership of the electrical function on the campus. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design and specification of HV/MV power distribution systems for modular data center units and campus infrastructure, including switchgear, transformers, ring main units, protection, and earthing. 
 - Prepare and review electrical calculations and studies (load flow, short-circuit, protection coordination, cable sizing, earthing) along with single-line diagrams and layouts. 
 - Define technical requirements and specifications for HV/MV equipment, and review vendor submittals and drawings for compliance. 
 - Coordinate the electrical scope with mechanical, controls, structural, and production teams to ensure designs are buildable within the campus manufacturing process. 
 - Oversee Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) of switchgear and power equipment, and support site acceptance testing and commissioning as required. 
 - Ensure designs comply with applicable standards (IEC, IS, NFPA) and client technical requirements, and maintain accurate design documentation and as-builts. 
 - Manage and mentor a team of electrical engineers and designers, setting technical standards and reviewing deliverables for quality and consistency. 
 - Support root-cause analysis of electrical issues during production and testing, and drive corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Liaise with utilities, consultants, and clients on HV/MV interfaces, approvals, and technical clarifications. 
 - Contribute to standardisation, value engineering, and continuous improvement of the modular electrical design. 

Required Skills and Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering; a Master's degree is an advantage. 
 - 3+ years of electrical engineering experience with a strong focus on HV/MV power systems, including experience in a managerial or team-lead capacity. 
 - Proven expertise in HV/MV distribution design, covering switchgear, transformers, protection and control, earthing, and cabling. 
 - Hands-on experience with power system studies and tools such as ETAP or equivalent for load flow, short-circuit, and protection coordination. 
 - Experience in data center, industrial, manufacturing, or EPC environments; exposure to modular or prefabricated builds is preferred. 
 - Sound knowledge of relevant standards (IEC, IS, NFPA) and safety practices for HV/MV systems. 
 - Experience with FAT/SAT, commissioning support, and vendor and contractor management. 
 - Proficiency in AutoCAD and electrical design documentation; familiarity with Revit is an advantage. 
 - Strong communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to lead a team in a fast-paced production environment.

data.title: Senior Physical Design Engineer
data.description:
Job Details

Job Description: 

Altera is seeking an experienced Physical Design Manager to lead a high-performing team responsible for delivering production-quality physical implementation for advanced semiconductor designs. This role combines technical leadership, people management, cross-functional execution, and ownership of predictable, high-quality tapeout results. 

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise across the physical design flow, a strong track record managing complex SoC or ASIC programs, and the ability to build an inclusive, accountable engineering culture. 

What you will do

- Lead, mentor, and grow a team of physical design engineers in Bangalore. 
 - Own physical implementation planning and execution from netlist through signoff and tapeout. 
 - Drive floorplanning, power planning, placement, clock-tree synthesis, routing, optimization, extraction, timing closure, physical verification, and signoff activities. 
 - Establish technical direction, project priorities, execution plans, and quality standards for the team. 
 - Partner closely with RTL design, microarchitecture, DFT, STA, CAD, verification, packaging, and product engineering teams. 
 - Identify physical design risks early and lead mitigation plans across schedule, power, performance, area, and manufacturability. 
 - Review and improve design methodologies, automation, flows, tools, and engineering practices. 
 - Ensure effective use of metrics, reviews, documentation, and lessons learned to improve predictability and execution quality. 
 - Contribute to staffing plans, capability development, performance management, and succession planning. 
 - Communicate technical status, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to engineering leadership. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 12+ years of experience in ASIC or SoC physical design, with significant experience leading teams or major project areas. 
 - Strong hands-on understanding of the complete physical design flow from synthesis handoff through signoff. 
 - Experience with floorplanning, power distribution, placement, CTS, routing, timing closure, signal integrity, IR drop, electromigration, physical verification, and design-for-manufacturability considerations. 
 - Demonstrated experience delivering complex designs to tapeout in advanced process technologies. 
 - Strong knowledge of timing constraints, multi-voltage or low-power design, ECO implementation, and signoff methodologies. 
 - Experience collaborating across geographically distributed, cross-functional engineering teams. 
 - Strong problem-solving, planning, prioritization, communication, and people-leadership skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with high-performance, high-volume, networking, compute, FPGA, or other complex SoC designs. 
 - Experience managing multiple projects, blocks, or design programs concurrently. 
 - Familiarity with industry-standard implementation and signoff tools, including tools from leading EDA vendors. 
 - Experience developing automation using Tcl, Python, Perl, or similar scripting languages. 
 - Experience defining physical design methodologies, flows, dashboards, and productivity improvements. 
 - Track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineering teams. 
 - Knowledge of advanced-node challenges such as congestion, variability, multicorner-multimode closure, and restrictive design rules.

data.title: Senior Control Engineer
data.description:
Controls Engineer

Location: Bangalore, India

Experience: 4-6years

Employment Type: Full-Time

About Inova

Inova is a global provider of innovative data center infrastructure solutions, delivering cutting-edge technologies across AI infrastructure, cooling solutions, and next-generation data center environments. We are committed to building reliable, scalable, and sustainable solutions that help customers operate mission-critical infrastructure efficiently. 

Job Summary

We are seeking a Controls Engineer with 4-6 years of experience to develop, test, commission, and troubleshoot control systems for data center liquid-cooling equipment. 

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in PLC programming, HMI development, PID control, instrumentation, and industrial communication protocols, with the ability to translate control requirements into reliable and robust equipment sequences. 

The role will own assigned controls deliverables and work closely with the Lead Controls Engineer, electrical design, and project teams throughout the design, testing, and commissioning lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and troubleshoot PLC applications for liquid-cooling equipment, including operating sequences, pump duty/standby control, automatic changeover, interlocks, and fault handling. 
 - Implement and tune PID control loops for temperature, pressure, and flow regulation. 
 - Develop HMI screens for equipment operation, monitoring, alarms, trends, and diagnostics. 
 - Configure and integrate communication protocols such as Modbus TCP/RTU, Ethernet, and SNMP. 
 - Select and configure field instrumentation, including temperature sensors, pressure transmitters, flow meters, control valves, and variable-frequency drives (VFDs). 
 - Prepare and maintain I/O lists, Functional Design Specifications (FDS), control sequences, alarm lists, communication mappings, and test procedures. 
 - Review electrical schematics, control-panel drawings, bills of materials, and cable schedules in coordination with the electrical design team. 
 - Execute Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and support Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), commissioning, and troubleshooting activities. 
 - Validate equipment response to sensor faults, communication loss, pump failure, power restoration, and other operating conditions against approved control requirements. 
 - Maintain software backups, revision records, commissioning reports, and as-built documentation. Essential Skills

- 4-6 years of practical experience in PLC programming, HMI development, controls engineering, and commissioning. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with at least one PLC/controller platform, preferably Schneider Electric or Siemens. 
 - Proficiency in Structured Text, with working knowledge of Ladder Logic and/or Function Block Diagram. 
 - Hands-on experience with PID control, pumps, VFDs, instrumentation, and automated equipment sequences. 
 - Good understanding of industrial communication protocols, including Modbus TCP/RTU, Ethernet, and SNMP. 
 - Experience developing and troubleshooting control logic, interlocks, alarms, and equipment fault-handling sequences. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively during testing and commissioning activities. 
 - Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and control-panel drawings. Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Automation, Mechatronics, or a related discipline. 
 - Experience working with liquid-cooling systems, HVAC/chilled-water systems, data center infrastructure, or other industrial cooling equipment is a plus. 
 - Experience participating in FAT, SAT, equipment commissioning, and site troubleshooting is preferred. 
 - Relevant hands-on experience may be considered in lieu of formal qualifications.

A leader in the travel tech space, FCM has proprietary client solutions. FCM provides specialist services via FCM Consulting and FCM Meetings & Events.

You will be the finance testing expert inside our internal QA team, running point on finance for every migration from here. You won't be expected to know each market on day one. Travel industry experience isn't needed. Attention to detail and the drive to get it right are.

data.title: Lead Quality Engineer
data.description:
About The Role

Grade Level (for internal use): 

11

The Role: Lead Quality Engineer

The Team

Enterprise Solutions (ES) Technology brings together data, software, services, and expertise to deliver innovative solutions for global financial markets. The team works closely with customers to help them manage complex business, regulatory, and risk requirements. 

Financial Risk Analytics (FRA), part of Enterprise Solutions, delivers information-centric capital markets and risk solutions for trading desks and their risk-management partners. Its products support counterparty credit risk, xVA, and market risk for both buy-side and sell-side institutions. 

We are seeking a Lead Quality Engineer to join the FRA Technology team. Quality Engineering is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle and spans application, analytics, data, integration, and platform layers. The successful candidate will help evolve QA from a primarily validation-focused function into a proactive, automation-first, engineering-led capability. 

The Impact

As a Lead Quality Engineer, you will own and influence the quality strategy across the software delivery lifecycle-from requirements and solution design through development, release, and production support. You will partner with Product, Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, Operations, and Customer Support teams to identify risks early, improve test coverage, increase release confidence, and promote shared accountability for quality. 

This role requires strong technical expertise, a solid understanding of financial risk platforms, and the ability to lead quality initiatives across agile delivery teams. 

Responsibilities

- Own and continuously improve the quality strategy across the full software development lifecycle, embedding effective quality gates from requirements and design through release and production support. 
 - Shift quality engineering from defect detection to defect prevention by identifying risks, control gaps, and testability concerns early in the delivery process. 
 - Lead the design, development, and evolution of scalable automated test frameworks covering UI, API, data, integration, regression, and other relevant testing areas. 
 - Develop, execute, and maintain comprehensive test suites based on software requirements, technical specifications, business workflows, and real-world customer usage. 
 - Drive risk-based testing for financial risk platforms, prioritising coverage for regulatory workflows, calculation accuracy, data integrity, security controls, system integration, and customer-critical journeys. 
 - Design and implement test automation using Java, Python, Selenium, Cucumber, Carina, and other appropriate technologies and frameworks. 
 - Establish and monitor quality engineering standards and metrics, including automation coverage, defect leakage, release readiness, test reliability, environment stability, and production incident feedback. 
 - Champion continuous testing within CI/CD pipelines by integrating reliable and efficient automated validation into build, deployment, and release processes. 
 - Improve release confidence and operational resilience by validating deployment readiness, rollback capability, observability, environment consistency, and applicable non-functional requirements. 
 - Lead quality governance for agile teams, ensuring that acceptance criteria, test evidence, sign-offs, and release risks are clearly documented, auditable, and decision-ready. 
 - Manage and support QA and UAT environments, build deployments, test data, test execution, release planning, and testing sign-off activities. 
 - Partner with Product, Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, Operations, and Customer Support to resolve quality issues and strengthen end-to-end software reliability. 
 - Collaborate with business stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand business impact and translate workflow complexity and customer needs into effective test coverage. 
 - Use AI and modern engineering practices to improve QA productivity through intelligent test generation, defect analysis, regression optimisation, log analysis, and test data creation. 
 - Mentor QA engineers and influence developers to build quality into their work by promoting automation, code quality, testability, maintainability, and shared ownership. 
 - Perform gap analysis across application and platform test coverage and define remediation plans to address identified risks. 
 - Balance manual and automated testing based on delivery needs, while continuously moving toward automation-first and analytics-driven quality engineering. 
 - Act as a technical leader and subject-matter expert, proactively resolving issues, managing risks, and escalating concerns appropriately. 

What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience may also be considered. 
 - 10 plus years of work experience across software quality engineering and end-to-end testing activities, including experience in a technical leadership or lead QA capacity. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with automation and white-box testing using Java, Python, or both. 
 - Experience designing and maintaining test automation frameworks using Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber, Carina, or equivalent web-testing frameworks. 
 - Demonstrated experience with API and web services testing, including the development or use of API automation frameworks. 
 - Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, software testing principles, test design techniques, and quality engineering practices. 
 - Experience with SQL and relational databases; knowledge of PL/SQL, NoSQL databases, and Linux/UNIX environments is desirable. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and working with build and deployment processes. 
 - Understanding of performance, integration, regression, data, security, and non-functional testing practices. 
 - Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex issues across application, data, and platform layers. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present quality risks and recommendations to technical and business stakeholders. 
 - Demonstrated ability to work effectively across cross-functional and geographically distributed agile teams. 
 - Ability to operate independently, take ownership, influence engineering decisions, and drive quality improvements across the organisation. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working with capital markets, financial risk analytics, counterparty credit risk, xVA, market risk, or related financial services platforms. 
 - Experience testing calculation-intensive, data-intensive, or regulatory applications. 
 - Knowledge of cloud-deployed applications, containers, microservices, messaging platforms, and distributed systems. 
 - Experience applying AI-enabled tools and modern engineering practices to improve testing efficiency and quality outcomes. 
 - Experience establishing quality metrics, governance processes, and continuous improvement programmes for engineering teams. 

About S&P Global Market Intelligence

At S&P Global Market Intelligence, a division of S&P Global we understand the importance of accurate, deep and insightful information. Our team of experts delivers unrivaled insights and leading data and technology solutions, partnering with customers to expand their perspective, operate with confidence, and make decisions with conviction. 

For more information, visit www. spglobal. com/marketintelligence. 

What's In It For You?

Our Mission

Advancing Essential Intelligence. 

Our People

We're more than 35, 000 strong worldwide-so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all. The Role: Lead Quality Engineer

The Team

Enterprise Solutions (ES) Technology brings together data, software, services, and expertise to deliver innovative solutions for global financial markets. The team works closely with customers to help them manage complex business, regulatory, and risk requirements. 

Financial Risk Analytics (FRA), part of Enterprise Solutions, delivers information-centric capital markets and risk solutions for trading desks and their risk-management partners. Its products support counterparty credit risk, xVA, and market risk for both buy-side and sell-side institutions. 

We are seeking a Lead Quality Engineer to join the FRA Technology team. Quality Engineering is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle and spans application, analytics, data, integration, and platform layers. The successful candidate will help evolve QA from a primarily validation-focused function into a proactive, automation-first, engineering-led capability. 

The Impact

As a Lead Quality Engineer, you will own and influence the quality strategy across the software delivery lifecycle-from requirements and solution design through development, release, and production support. You will partner with Product, Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, Operations, and Customer Support teams to identify risks early, improve test coverage, increase release confidence, and promote shared accountability for quality. 

This role requires strong technical expertise, a solid understanding of financial risk platforms, and the ability to lead quality initiatives across agile delivery teams. 

Responsibilities

- Own and continuously improve the quality strategy across the full software development lifecycle, embedding effective quality gates from requirements and design through release and production support. 
 - Shift quality engineering from defect detection to defect prevention by identifying risks, control gaps, and testability concerns early in the delivery process. 
 - Lead the design, development, and evolution of scalable automated test frameworks covering UI, API, data, integration, regression, and other relevant testing areas. 
 - Develop, execute, and maintain comprehensive test suites based on software requirements, technical specifications, business workflows, and real-world customer usage. 
 - Drive risk-based testing for financial risk platforms, prioritising coverage for regulatory workflows, calculation accuracy, data integrity, security controls, system integration, and customer-critical journeys. 
 - Design and implement test automation using Java, Python, Selenium, Cucumber, Carina, and other appropriate technologies and frameworks. 
 - Establish and monitor quality engineering standards and metrics, including automation coverage, defect leakage, release readiness, test reliability, environment stability, and production incident feedback. 
 - Champion continuous testing within CI/CD pipelines by integrating reliable and efficient automated validation into build, deployment, and release processes. 
 - Improve release confidence and operational resilience by validating deployment readiness, rollback capability, observability, environment consistency, and applicable non-functional requirements. 
 - Lead quality governance for agile teams, ensuring that acceptance criteria, test evidence, sign-offs, and release risks are clearly documented, auditable, and decision-ready. 
 - Manage and support QA and UAT environments, build deployments, test data, test execution, release planning, and testing sign-off activities. 
 - Partner with Product, Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, Operations, and Customer Support to resolve quality issues and strengthen end-to-end software reliability. 
 - Collaborate with business stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand business impact and translate workflow complexity and customer needs into effective test coverage. 
 - Use AI and modern engineering practices to improve QA productivity through intelligent test generation, defect analysis, regression optimisation, log analysis, and test data creation. 
 - Mentor QA engineers and influence developers to build quality into their work by promoting automation, code quality, testability, maintainability, and shared ownership. 
 - Perform gap analysis across application and platform test coverage and define remediation plans to address identified risks. 
 - Balance manual and automated testing based on delivery needs, while continuously moving toward automation-first and analytics-driven quality engineering. 
 - Act as a technical leader and subject-matter expert, proactively resolving issues, managing risks, and escalating concerns appropriately. 

What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience may also be considered. 
 - 10 plus years of work experience across software quality engineering and end-to-end testing activities, including experience in a technical leadership or lead QA capacity. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with automation and white-box testing using Java, Python, or both. 
 - Experience designing and maintaining test automation frameworks using Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber, Carina, or equivalent web-testing frameworks. 
 - Demonstrated experience with API and web services testing, including the development or use of API automation frameworks. 
 - Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, software testing principles, test design techniques, and quality engineering practices. 
 - Experience with SQL and relational databases; knowledge of PL/SQL, NoSQL databases, and Linux/UNIX environments is desirable. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and working with build and deployment processes. 
 - Understanding of performance, integration, regression, data, security, and non-functional testing practices. 
 - Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex issues across application, data, and platform layers. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present quality risks and recommendations to technical and business stakeholders. 
 - Demonstrated ability to work effectively across cross-functional and geographically distributed agile teams. 
 - Ability to operate independently, take ownership, influence engineering decisions, and drive quality improvements across the organisation. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working with capital markets, financial risk analytics, counterparty credit risk, xVA, market risk, or related financial services platforms. 
 - Experience testing calculation-intensive, data-intensive, or regulatory applications. 
 - Knowledge of cloud-deployed applications, containers, microservices, messaging platforms, and distributed systems.

Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients- that is what Vantive aspires to deliver. 

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don't settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients' lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities. 

The Manager, Data Storage Platforms is responsible for leading a team of platform engineers overseeing the planning, the build, and the operations of data platforms. They will be responsible for architecting, engineering, and optimizing large‐scale, cloud‐native data platforms on AWS and Azure. This role leads development of event‐driven data architectures, CDC frameworks, data lake ingestion pipelines, and scalable ETL/ELT processes. The architect partners closely with cross‐functional teams, leads technical delivery, ensures operational excellence, and provides hands‐on support for global data transformation initiatives. They will be a part of the Data Services Platforms team and provide technological and process expertise and support the global domain data product delivery teams. They will provide leadership by assisting business partners in identifying and responding to opportunities for cost-effective data implementations and solutions by analyzing and making decisions that have cross functional business impact. 

Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of data platform engineers
 - Accountable for strategic planning and technical roadmap development for data platforms. 
 - Oversee the design, implementation, and maintenance of data engineering pipelines in a multi-cloud environment, including integrations with a variety of data sources (including structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data)
 - Collaborate with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams and other stakeholders in Architecture, Data Integration, DevOps, and Data Governance to deliver data platform initiatives
 - Ensure data engineering standards align with industry best practices for data governance, data quality, and data security. 
 - Monitor and optimize the performance of data pipelines, ensuring they meet SLAs for data availability and quality. 
 - Evaluate and recommend new data technologies and tools to improve data engineering processes and outcomes, in collaboration with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams. 
 - Effectively communicate and realize vision and strategy for the organization that aligns with the business and patient needs. 
 - Embrace and embed agile ways of working in support of a fail-fast-learn-fast culture and enabling continual improvement. 
 - Foster a collaborative work environment with strong working relationships within and across businesses and functions, and with strategic external partners. 
 - Manage datasets using Apache Hudi (version 0. 11. x and higher), focusing on supporting near real-time data processing and incremental data loading utilizing cutting-edge features for more efficient data lake management and complex data transformation pipelines
 - Implement the latest versions of Terraform (0. 12. x and higher) to efficiently handle infrastructure changes and versioning with enhanced security and flexibility

Key Experiences & Attributes

- Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or relevant subject area
 - Minimum 5+ years of progressive technical experience in one or more of the cloud-based data warehouse/data lake platforms such as AWS S3, Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse. 
 - Significant experience in leading teams in Data & Analytics programs with experience in native digital technologies (cloud, big data and predictive) in organizations driving product development. 
 - Change Agent - Catalyst for the teams and expected to lead the transformation to a fail-fast-learn-fast culture enabling continual improvement. 
 - Servant Leader - Able to gain respect from their team and willing to get their hands dirty to get the job done. 
 - Courageous - Able to effectively challenge and influence peers and teams, leading them through difficult or uncertain situations. 
 - Significant experience working in a global matrix environment. 
 - Must be a strategic, innovative problem solver, and have strong influencing and communication skills. 
 - Strong knowledge of business process flow and/or entity relationship modeling. 
 - Demonstrated outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively with other technology teams as well as business partners. Ability to effectively present information, interact with, and respond to questions from managers, employees, customers, and vendors
 - Experience in applying best practices to ELT/ETL data transformation from variety of data sources to AWS and other data warehouse platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse etc. 

Required Technical Skills

- AWS CDK (TypeScript/Python)
 - AWS Glue (ETL, Catalog, Crawlers, Job Bookmarks)
 - AWS Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, Step Functions, EventBridge
 - Amazon Kinesis, Route 53, S3 (events, triggers)
 - Terraform (0. 12+)
 - Apache Hudi (0. 11+) and CDC methodologies
 - AWS DMS
 - Apache Spark (2. 4+) and PySpark
 - Amazon EMR (5. x+)
 - Python (3. 6+) for automation and pipeline development
 - IBM DataStage (for supplemental ETL workflows)
 - Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse

This role focuses on building scalable automation frameworks for validating machine learning models, telecom analytics workflows, network KPIs, alarms, voice services, SIP signaling, and data quality across 2G, 3G, 4G, and 5G environments.  - Provide troubleshooting support for production incidents impacting telecom analytics, ML models, and network intelligence platforms. 

Expertise You'll Bring

- 6?12 years of experience in Quality Assurance, with significant focus on automation and data-driven testing. 
 - Strong understanding of functional, integration, regression, system, exploratory, and end-to-end testing methodologies. 
 - Experience building scalable automation frameworks for analytics, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. 
 - Strong telecom domain experience across 2G, 3G, 4G, and 5G technologies. 
 - In-depth understanding of SIP signaling, call flows, telecom protocols, voice services, and service assurance platforms. 
 - Experience validating telecom KPIs, network performance metrics, subscriber analytics, QoS/QoE measurements, alarms, and operational reporting systems. 
 - Strong understanding of machine learning concepts, model validation techniques, and AI-driven application testing. 
 - Experience validating feature engineering pipelines, data transformations, model outputs, and prediction results. 
 - Hands-on expertise with SQL, Pandas, and NumPy for data verification and analytical validation. 
 - Experience validating dashboards, reporting platforms, trend analysis, anomaly detection outputs, and time-series analytics. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python and automation development. 
 - Hands-on experience with PyTest and automated test execution frameworks. 
 - Expertise in REST API testing and validation using Postman and automation frameworks. 
 - Experience creating automated validation suites for APIs, data platforms, analytics services, and ML workflows. 
 - Experience with Git, Docker, Linux, Jira, Kubernetes, and CI/CD environments. 
 - Understanding of MLOps processes and model lifecycle validation. 
 - Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, debugging, and root-cause analysis skills. 
 - Ability to independently investigate complex ML, telecom, and data-quality issues. 
 - Excellent documentation, reporting, stakeholder management, and communication skills. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively with geographically distributed and cross-functional teams. 

Benefits

- Competitive salary and benefits package
 - Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
 - Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
 - Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
 - Annual health check-ups

Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment

Job Purpose

This role exists to design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using Microsoft technologies, enabling the company to deliver reliable and high-performance financial solutions that support business growth and digital transformation. 

Duties And Responsibilities

Major Activities carried out by the role

- Major Activity 1
 - Design, develop, test, and deploy web-based applications using . NET Core, Angular, and WebAPI. 
 - Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code following best practices and design patterns. 
 - Develop data access layers using Entity Framework/ADO. Net/Dapper and optimize queries for performance.

 - Should have experience in developing applications using design principle/patterns and architecture design patterns like MVC and MVVM.

Good-to-Have Skills
