data.description:
About Business

JOB DESCRIPTION

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. 

Job Purpose

The QA Lab Head in a copper mining and smelting operation ensures the highest standards of quality across all stages of production by overseeing various lab functions. The role involves managing multiple labs, ensuring compliance with industry regulations, optimizing testing processes, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve quality control and operational efficiency. 

Responsibilities

Lab Operations Planning and Execution: 

- Manage daily and shift-wise laboratory testing activities in line with smelter production priorities. 
 - Ensure timely receipt, preparation, analysis, and reporting of samples from smelting, converting, refining, slag, dust, by-products, and related process streams. 
 - Coordinate with production, process, and quality teams to prioritize urgent samples and ensure quick analytical feedback for operational decisions. 
 - Monitor adherence to sample collection, labelling, preservation, testing, and reporting protocols to maintain reliability of results. 

Process Optimization And Continuous Improvement

- Identify improvement opportunities in sample preparation, testing turnaround time, analytical accuracy, and laboratory workflow efficiency. 
 - Support implementation of standard methods, best practices, and continuous improvement initiatives within WSMD laboratory operations. 
 - Track routine operational bottlenecks and coordinate corrective actions with the Lab Head and concerned departments. 
 - Assist in adoption of improved analytical practices, automation support, and digital tools for better lab productivity and data reliability. 

Quality Assurance And Control

- Ensure execution of quality control checks, calibration verification, standardization, and validation of analytical results as per defined procedures. 
 - Maintain compliance with approved laboratory SOPs, test methods, internal quality standards, and applicable statutory or customer requirements. 
 - Review routine test data for abnormalities, deviations, or inconsistencies and escalate critical issues to the WSMD Lab Head. 
 - Support root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions for testing errors, repeat analysis, delays, and non-conformities. 

Equipment Readiness And Troubleshooting

- Ensure availability, calibration, routine checks, and proper functioning of laboratory instruments and equipment used for WSMD analysis. 
 - Coordinate with maintenance, OEMs, and service providers for troubleshooting, breakdown resolution, AMC support, and instrument reliability. 
 - Maintain equipment logbooks, calibration records, preventive maintenance schedules, and breakdown history for audit readiness. 
 - Support safe and correct operation of instruments by lab chemists, technicians, and shift personnel. 

HSE And Regulatory Compliance

- Ensure strict adherence to HSE requirements, PPE usage, chemical handling procedures, waste disposal norms, and emergency response protocols inside the WSMD Lab. 
 - Conduct routine safety observations, housekeeping checks, and compliance follow-ups in coordination with the Lab Head and Safety team. 
 - Support compliance with environmental and statutory requirements related to laboratory chemicals, residues, samples, and waste streams. 
 - Promote safe work practices among lab team members and ensure timely closure of safety observations and audit points. 

Cost Management And Budgeting

- Monitor consumption of chemicals, reagents, gases, standards, glassware, spares, and other laboratory consumables to support uninterrupted operations. 
 - Assist the Lab Head in inventory planning, PR follow-up, vendor coordination, and cost control initiatives for routine lab requirements. 
 - Identify opportunities to reduce wastage, optimize reagent usage, and improve cost efficiency without compromising testing quality. 
 - Maintain records of consumable usage, stock levels, and critical inventory items for operational planning and audit purposes. 

Shift Team Coordination And Capability Building

- Coordinate daily work allocation for lab chemists, technicians, samplers, and shift personnel as per testing load and operational requirements. 
 - Guide team members on standard test procedures, safe lab practices, instrument handling, documentation, and quality expectations. 
 - Support training, skill development, and multi-skilling of laboratory team members to build operational flexibility. 
 - Ensure continuity of laboratory operations during shifts, peak workload, audits, and absence of senior leadership, while developing readiness to succeed the WSMD Lead role in future. 

Reporting And Data Analytics

- Ensure timely preparation, review, and submission of routine analytical reports, shift reports, quality summaries, deviation reports, and MIS data. 
 - Maintain accurate documentation of sample records, test results, calibration data, corrective actions, and audit-related information. 
 - Analyze lab performance trends such as turnaround time, repeat testing, deviations, equipment uptime, and sample load to support improvement actions. 
 - Escalate critical quality trends, abnormal results, and urgent operational issues to the WSMD Lab Head and concerned stakeholders. 

Digitization And Tech Adoption

- Support use of SAP Lab/LIMS and other digital systems for sample tracking, result entry, report generation, and data traceability. 
 - Ensure timely and accurate digital updating of test results, equipment records, calibration schedules, and lab MIS. 
 - Assist in implementation of automation, dashboards, and data-driven reporting practices to improve laboratory efficiency. 
 - Promote disciplined data entry, record retention, and system compliance among lab team members. 

Qualifications

Education Qualification: 

Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Industrial Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Metallurgy, or a related science/engineering discipline

Master's degree in Chemistry/Analytical Chemistry or relevant postgraduate qualification preferred

Work Experience (Range Of Years)

Over 15 years of experience in Quality Assurance within the Copper Manufacturing industry

Relevant experience in laboratory operations, analytical quality control, or process lab functions, preferably in copper smelting, metals, mining, chemicals, or process industry environment; suitable for Senior Manager level with team coordination, operational ownership, and future leadership readiness

Certifications

Certification in Quality Management or Quality Assurance

data.title: Architect - System Performance Verification and Analysis
data.description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel. 

NVIDIA is a "learning machine" that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life's work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you'll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. As part of this team, you would be working on projects that will help make our next generation visual computing, automotive, GPU, HPC systems better. You will get to work on high performance CPU and Memory sub-systems, Next-Gen GPUs , NOC based Interconnect Fabric etc. Make the choice to join us today. Our work spans the full pre-silicon and post-silicon lifecycle: performance models, RTL simulation, emulation platforms, and silicon bringup. We catch bugs early, influence architecture and design decisions, and help ensure that the final product delivers the performance that our customers depend on. If you are passionate about building the hardware that underpins the future of AI and computing, this is where you belong. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Partner with System Architecture, Usecase Modeling, Unit Architecture/PV, and Design/Verification teams to define comprehensive performance test plans that reflect real product usecases. 
 - Drive full-chip SoC performance verification across all real engines and subsystems, running realistic concurrent workloads that represent how the product will be used by customers in the field. 
 - Execute performance test plans across the full verification stack: cycle-accurate performance models, RTL simulation, emulation platforms, and silicon, identifying bottlenecks and regressions at each stage. 
 - Debug performance failures through waveform analysis, signal-level queries, trace analysis, and system-level profiling to root-cause issues in the memory subsystem, fabric, or individual engines. 
 - Influence architecture and microarchitecture decisions by surfacing performance data and trade-off analysis to the design and architecture teams early in the product development cycle. 
 - Develop and maintain performance workloads, test suites, and infrastructure - including testbench components, performance simulators, analysis scripts, and automated regression flows. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted tools and automation to accelerate repetitive analysis tasks, improve coverage, and free up engineering time for higher-level problem solving. This includes using LLM-based assistants for querying results and specs, AI-driven triage of regressions, and intelligent tooling that improves over time. 
 - Drive methodology improvements to reduce verification turnaround time, improve coverage of representative workloads, and enable earlier performance insight in the product development cycle. 

What We Need To See

- B. E. /B. Tech or M. S. /M. Tech (or equivalent experience) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 
 - 3+ years of relevant experience in SoC or system-level architecture, performance verification, or hardware validation. 
 - Strong understanding of SoC architecture including GPU and CPU pipelines, memory subsystem design (caches, DRAM controllers, coherency), Network-on-Chip (NoC)/fabric architecture, and high-speed IO interfaces. 
 - Hands-on experience with RTL simulation and debug, including waveform-based debug and signal-level querying to isolate performance failures. 
 - Solid programming skills in Python and C/C++; scripting proficiency in Bash/Python for automation and analysis. Exposure to Verilog/SystemVerilog or SystemC/TLM is a strong plus. 
 - Strong debugging, data analysis, and statistical analysis skills - ability to synthesize large volumes of performance data into actionable insights. 
 - Experience with or exposure to pre-silicon performance analysis methodologies, including performance models, cycle-approximate simulators, or emulation platforms. 
 - Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a large, globally distributed engineering organization. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Deep experience with RTL-level performance debug - particularly the ability to formulate precise signal queries and interpret waveforms to root-cause complex system-level interactions. 
 - Background in system-level performance analysis for GPU, AI accelerators, or high-bandwidth memory subsystems, with knowledge of bottleneck identification across multiple concurrent engines. 
 - Demonstrated use of AI and LLM-based tools (e. g. , NVIDIA NIM/NeMo, OpenAI APIs, LangChain, or similar agentic frameworks) to measurably improve your own engineering productivity - whether for automated analysis, natural-language querying of data, intelligent triage, or workflow automation. 
 - Experience building or deploying ML/AI-assisted tooling in an engineering or EDA context (e. g. , regression analysis, anomaly detection, test generation, coverage closure). 
 - Expertise in data analysis and visualization - ability to build dashboards and tooling that surface performance trends clearly to both engineering and architecture stakeholders.

data.title: Quality Specialist - Bengali, AGI Data Services - Quality
data.description:
Description

Quality Specialists play a vital role in establishing and maintaining comprehensive quality frameworks across our operations. Their primary responsibility begins with developing robust quality strategies in collaboration with customers and CPMs, encompassing metrics, audit approaches, and specific targets for each workflow. When quality issues arise, these specialists create prescriptive actions, examining data patterns to formulate effective solutions. They maintain a continuous improvement cycle by managing a critical feedback loop between operations and customers, drawing insights from multiple sources including quality auditors, side-by-side observations, and metric analysis. Through regular side-by-side sessions, they identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements. The specialists serve as key escalation points for customer concerns, providing strategic recommendations based on their deep understanding of processes. They consistently evaluate quality tools, suggesting refinements to enhance effectiveness, while simultaneously maintaining and updating process documentation to ensure standardization and clarity across all workflows. This comprehensive approach ensures quality remains at the forefront of our operational excellence. 

Key job responsibilities

- Define and implement quality metrics for established workflows
 - Create prescriptive actions for quality issues
 - Partner with customers, operations and internal support teams to optimize workflow quality
 - Conduct side-by-sides to identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements
 - Analyze data trends and develop solutions
 - Monitor quality performance and coach operations teams
 - Create and maintain quality metrics reports
 - Handle customer escalations and recommendations
 - Evaluate and suggest improvements for quality tools
 - Support process documentation and implementation. 

A day in the life

Your day starts by checking quality dashboards for your assigned workflows - reviewing audit scores, appeal rates, SLA status, and any overnight escalations. You will spend approximately 30% of your time on analysis: reviewing data trends, investigating root causes of quality dips, and creating prescriptive actions for operations teams. 

Another 30% goes to stakeholder communication: leading weekly customer meetings, preparing quality reports, and handling escalations. The remaining time is split between process work (updating SOPs, refining audit rubrics, conducting side-by-sides) and calibration activities (aligning audit standards with Senior Quality Auditors and operations teams). 

You are measured on: SLA metrics (appeals and batch completion), customer satisfaction, quality improvement trends for your workflows, and documentation quality. 

About The Team

The Quality Operations team within FAI Data Services ensures that labeled training data meets accuracy and consistency standards before it is used to train Amazon's AI models. Quality Specialists own the quality strategy for assigned workflows, bridging the gap between operations execution and customer expectations. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
 - Advanced-level proficiency or C1+ in Bengali language (Strong verbal and written communication skills, with fluency in speaking, listening, and writing. )
 - Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and develop prescriptive actions
 - Experience in creating and maintaining process documentation, SOPs, or quality guidelines

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e. g. , Linguistics, Data Science, Business, or related discipline)
 - Demonstrated ability to build or improve quality frameworks, audit processes, or feedback loops
 - Experience coaching or providing quality feedback to operations or associate-level teams

data.title: Software Development Engineer in Test
data.description:
The Opportunity

ACA believes that we can deliver the world's best GRC software to our blue-chip financial services client base of over 3500 firms. We are seeking top talent to join us in our journey to build and deliver "The Salesforce of Compliance". Compliance Officers in finance have been stuck in the past, with inefficient, manual effort driving their compliance programs. ACA's ComplianceAlpha is deployed at 800+ clients, with more added daily, to help modernize that. We are investing significantly to drive technology adoption among our clients. 

The SDET role is responsible for the development and delivery of an automation-first test suite for our ComplianceAlpha products. Each SDET will be part of a geo-located agile product team, and will provide guidance to the team during planning and refinement as well as execute on the plan during the sprint. 

We are looking for an imaginative self-starter with a passion for great software and a curiosity for developing test automation solutions that drive exceptional quality and productivity. Only motivated problem solvers willing to take the initiative and demonstrate consistent follow-through need apply. Qualified candidates will have hands-on experience building automated tests and a drive to keep growing their skills. 

What To Expect Day To Day

As a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) on the Connectors team, you'll help ensure the reliability of data pipelines that ingest and process large volumes of data from platforms such as Microsoft Teams, Slack, Zoom, Bloomberg, and other enterprise systems. 

On a typical day, you will: 

- Work alongside a highly collaborative and talented engineering team. 
 - Design, develop, and execute automated functional tests to ensure the reliability and quality of our data pipelines. 
 - Collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into effective test coverage. 
 - Investigate failures, identify root causes, and help improve the overall quality of our platform. 
 - Explore and adopt new testing techniques, tools, and automation strategies. 
 - Expand your Python expertise while working with modern data engineering technologies. 
 - Participate in manual validation and release testing during production release cycles when needed. 

Required Skills

Skills and attributes for success

- Curious, lifelong learner who is excited to develop new skills and explore new technologies. 
 - Passionate about software quality, automation, and continuous improvement. 
 - At least 2 years of experience developing software in Python. 
 - Experience developing automated test pipelines for Python-based ETL processes. 
 - Experience consuming REST APIs using Python. 
 - Working knowledge of asynchronous Python (asyncio) and strategies for testing asynchronous code. 
 - Experience translating business requirements into automated functional tests. 

Nice to have

- Experience developing automated tests for Apache Airflow pipelines. 
 - Experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL. 
 - Experience testing data-intensive or distributed systems. 
 - Familiarity with AWS services commonly used in data pipelines. 

What We Look For

We are interested in innovative technology professionals with strong vision and a desire to stay on top of trends in the industry. If you have a genuine passion for new technologies and transforming an entire industry, this role may be for you. A BE or B-Tech in computer Science, or equivalent is a great preference. 

What Working At ACA Offers

We offer a competitive compensation package where you'll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options as well as a flexible work environment. You'll also be granted time off for designated ACA Paid Holidays, Summer Fridays, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being. 

Plus, we offer: 

- Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. 
 - Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. 
 - Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. 
 - Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. 

Why join our team?

We are the leading governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) advisor in financial services. When you join ACA, you'll become part of a team whose unique combination of talent includes the industry's largest team of former regulators, compliance professionals, legal professionals, and GIPS® standards verifiers in the industry, along with practitioners in cybersecurity, ESG, and regulatory technology. 

Our team enjoys an entrepreneurial work environment by offering innovative and tailored solutions for our clients. We encourage creative thinking and making the most of your experience at ACA by offering multiple career paths. We foster a culture of growth by focusing on continuous learning through inquiry and curiosity, and transparency. If you're ready to be part of an award-winning, global team of thoughtful, talented, and committed professionals, you've come to the right place. 

More About ACA

ACA was founded in 2002 by four former SEC regulators and one former state regulator. The founders saw a need for investment advisers to receive expert guidance on existing and new regulations. 

Over the years, ACA has grown both organically and by acquisition to expand our GRC business and technology solutions. Our services now include GIPS standards verification, cybersecurity and technology risk, regulatory technology, ESG advisory, AML and financial crimes, financial and regulatory reporting, and Mirabella for establishing EU operations. 

What We Commit To

ACA is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity. We conduct our business without regard to actual or perceived age, race, color, religion, disability, caregiver, marital or partnership status, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), ancestry, national origin and citizenship, sex, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, sexual and reproductive health decisions, military or veteran status, creed, genetic predisposition, carrier status or any other category protected by federal, state and local law. 

ACA is firmly committed to a policy of nondiscrimination, which applies to recruiting, hiring, placement, promotions, training, discipline, terminations, layoffs, recall, transfers, leaves of absence, compensation and all other terms and conditions of employment. 

Here at ACA, we have created a variety of programs to promote ACA's culture of inclusivity and work hard to ensure that all our employees have an equal opportunity to contribute to ACA and feel that ACA is exactly where they belong.

data.title: DISTINGUISHED, SOFTWARE ENGINEER
data.description:
About Team

The Data Services team within Global Technology Platform powers mission-critical data infrastructure across the enterprise, enabling SQL, NoSQL, and messaging services for tens of thousands of deployments across Walmart Global Tech. These platforms support multi-petabyte-scale data, millions of requests per second, and extremely high availability requirements for applications used across Walmart stores, digital channels, supply chain, and internal enterprise systems. 

The candidate will shape the architecture and evolution of database capabilities across the organization, with a strong focus on Search & Cache systems. You will work on some of the most complex database challenges in the industry including automated scaling, recovery, large scale system design and schema registry. 

As a Distinguished Engineer, you will operate as a hands-on technical leader, influencing platform strategy, guiding architectural decisions, mentoring senior engineers, and partnering closely with application teams to design and operate complex, high-scale systems. You will help build sophisticated tooling and platforms on top of open-source and commercial database technologies, tailoring them to Walmart's scale, reliability, security, and developer productivity needs. 

What You'll DoDefine and drive the long-term technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for the data services teams. 

Lead the design and evolution of highly available, scalable, secure, and operationally efficient NoSQL platforms that support mission-critical workloads at enterprise scale. 

Diagnose and resolve complex production issues across large installations, including performance degradation, query regressions, replication issues, availability incidents, capacity constraints, and operational bottlenecks. 

Build and influence sophisticated tooling, automation, and platform capabilities that improve database reliability, performance, observability, developer productivity, and operational simplicity. 

Partner with application engineering teams to design, review, and optimize database architectures for complex distributed systems and high-throughput workloads. 

Establish technical standards, best practices, reference architectures, and operational patterns for database usage across the organization. 

Influence senior engineering leaders, architects, product teams, and business stakeholders by clearly communicating technical strategy, trade-offs, risks, and execution plans. 

Mentor principal and senior engineers, raising the technical bar across database engineering, distributed systems, performance engineering, and production operations. 

What You'll Bring12+ years of software engineering, infrastructure engineering, or database engineering experience, with significant depth in database systems. 

Deep hands-on expertise in any database system at scale, preferably NoSQL databases with strong understanding of database internals. 

Proven experience debugging and operating complex database deployments in production, including high-availability, high-throughput, and low-latency environments. 

Experience designing and operating database platforms with strong reliability, availability, backup and restore, disaster recovery, observability, security, and compliance characteristics. 

Strong systems engineering background, with the ability to reason deeply about distributed systems, concurrency, networking, storage, failure modes, and capacity planning. 

Experience building automation, tooling, or platform capabilities around open-source or commercial database systems. 

Proven ability to define technical strategy, drive architecture across teams, and influence large-scale engineering direction without relying solely on formal authority. 

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex database and platform concepts to senior technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Strong track record of mentoring engineers, reviewing architecture, and raising engineering standards across a large organization. 

Strong programming experience in one or more systems or platform languages such as Java, Python, C++, Go. 

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity experts and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. 

We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. 

Flexible Work

Walmart's culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Bangalore office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives. 

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. 

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is-and feels-included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.

Option 1: Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 6 years' experience in software engineering or related area. 

Option 2: 8 years' experience in software engineering or related area. 

Preferred Qualifications. . . Outlined below are the optional preferred qualifications for this position. If none are listed, there are no preferred qualifications. 

Master's degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 4 years' experience in software engineering or related area, We value candidates with a background in creating inclusive digital experiences, demonstrating knowledge in implementing Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2. 2 AA standards, assistive technologies, and integrating digital accessibility seamlessly. The ideal candidate would have knowledge of accessibility best practices and join us as we continue to create accessible products and services following Walmart's accessibility standards and guidelines for supporting an inclusive culture.

data.title: AI Engineering Manager
data.description:
Manager/Team Lead - Agentic AI, ML

Location: Bangalore (Hybrid)

Role Summary

As Manager - AI Engineering, you will lead a multidisciplinary team of AI Engineers and Data Scientists delivering GenAI-powered solutions, agentic AI systems, LLM-integrated applications, machine learning models, and retrieval-enabled intelligent products. This role combines technical leadership, people management, delivery accountability, and product ownership. You will be responsible for ensuring that the team delivers scalable, secure, supportable, and business-relevant AI and ML solutions from discovery through production operation and continuous improvement. 

This is not a lightweight line-management role. The successful candidate must be technically strong enough to guide senior engineers, data scientists, and technical leads, make sound architectural and implementation trade-offs, and raise the engineering bar of the team. You are expected to provide hands-on technical direction across LLM-powered systems, agent orchestration, RAG, ML model development, MLOps, cloud-native application delivery, integrations, observability, and SDLC discipline, while also building a culture of accountability, ownership, experimentation rigor, and engineering excellence. 

You will work closely with Product Managers, Solution Architects, Lead AI Engineers, Lead Data Scientists, Platform teams, DevOps, Security, and business stakeholders to translate business goals into implementable engineering work and durable product outcomes. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of AI Engineers and Data Scientists across varying experience levels, including senior engineers and technical leads, ensuring strong delivery quality, modeling rigor, engineering discipline, and technical growth
 - Own end-to-end delivery of GenAI, agentic AI, and ML-enabled solutions - from discovery, design, and backlog shaping through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement
 - Guide architectural and design decisions across LLM-powered systems, embeddings pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agent orchestration, tool-enabled workflows, ML model pipelines, APIs, and cloud-native application services
 - Oversee the design, development, evaluation, and operationalization of machine learning models for predictive, classification, recommendation, anomaly detection, forecasting, optimization, or other business use cases where applicable
 - Ensure strong practices across feature engineering, experimentation, validation, model performance assessment, explainability, drift awareness, and MLOps readiness
 - Translate business and product priorities into executable engineering and data science plans, technical workstreams, model delivery milestones, and sustainable release outcomes
 - Review and challenge implementation choices to ensure systems and models are scalable, secure, observable, cost-aware, and maintainable
 - Partner with Product Managers and engineering leadership to prioritize work, manage technical dependencies, and align delivery with roadmap goals
 - Establish strong SDLC and build-own-operate practices within the team, including design reviews, code reviews, model reviews, automated testing, release readiness, production support, reliability improvement, and technical debt management
 - Drive reuse and productivity by scaling frameworks, shared components, prompt templates, orchestration patterns, feature templates, modeling utilities, evaluation frameworks, and internal accelerators across the team
 - Promote a culture of responsible AI and operational excellence, emphasizing security, token and cost governance, model safety, quality, observability, reproducibility, and supportability
 - Coordinate with cloud platform, DevOps, Security, Integration, Architecture, and data teams to ensure enterprise readiness of all deployments
 - Own hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance development, and growth plans for both the AI Engineering and Data Science team members
 - Track and communicate KPIs related to delivery, GenAI adoption, model quality, latency, business impact, reliability, experimentation outcomes, and production performance
 - Act as the primary technical and delivery escalation point for the team, helping remove blockers and resolve design, modeling, execution, and operational issues

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in software engineering, AI / ML engineering, data science, solution engineering, or technology delivery, including strong experience building and operating production-grade intelligent systems
 - 4 to 5 + years of experience delivering or leading AI / ML / GenAI / LLM-powered solutions in enterprise or product environments
 - Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams or technical pods delivering LLM-powered products, agentic AI workflows, machine learning models, or AI-enabled application capabilities, with accountability for both technical quality and delivery outcomes
 - Strong technical depth in Python, modern backend engineering, machine learning solution delivery, API-first architectures, microservices, distributed systems, and cloud-native application delivery
 - Strong hands-on or design-level experience with LLM platforms and orchestration frameworks such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, AutoGen, or equivalent platforms used for enterprise GenAI delivery
 - Strong experience designing or guiding implementations involving retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings pipelines, vector search, grounding strategies, and retrieval optimization using platforms such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, or equivalent
 - Strong understanding of machine learning model development, including feature engineering, model training, validation, tuning, evaluation, performance interpretation, and production-readiness considerations
 - Practical experience guiding or reviewing MLOps practices, including experiment tracking, model versioning, deployment automation, CI/CD for ML, monitoring, drift detection, retraining readiness, and reproducibility
 - Experience building and deploying AI- and ML-enabled cloud-native services using technologies such as Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, FastAPI, Docker, Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes / AKS, Azure Machine Learning, Databricks, MLflow, or equivalent engineering and deployment platforms
 - Strong understanding of CI/CD, containerization, deployment automation, secure delivery practices, and operational readiness for AI-driven and ML-enabled systems
 - Knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent-to-agent (A2A) interaction models, memory / context management approaches, and other distributed AI coordination patterns
 - Practical experience with observability and operational tooling such as Application Insights, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry, Log Analytics, Datadog, New Relic, or equivalent platforms, including monitoring of reliability, latency, cost, runtime behavior, and model / workflow health

We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer to join our core engineering team to design and develop a high-throughput, mission-critical active-active SIP based microservices across multi-site deployments. 

Job Description

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design and architect high-throughput, stateless SIP microservices using Go, achieving strict performance targets such as 5, 000+ TPS and sub-15ms latency budgets. 
 - Implement complex protocol translation layers to convert inbound SIP-over-TCP/TLS traffic from load balancers into high-speed SIP-over-ZeroMQ traffic for internal stateless services. 
 - Engineer advanced concurrency models utilizing ZeroMQ Router/Dealer socket pooling and internal thread-bridging patterns to prevent mutex bottlenecks and ensure thread-safe message passing under heavy load. 
 - Integrate distributed state and security mechanisms, including automated cryptographic key rotation using discovery tools for leader election and secured vaults for private key storage. 
 - Enforce surge protection and reliability by building multi-layered throttling, distributed batch schedulers, and exponential backoff handling
 - Partner with Network and Infrastructure teams to define advanced load balancer routing frameworks, DNS SRV query logic, and implement distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry) for end-to-end observability.

Required Skills & Experience

- Knowledge of SIP/VOIP & related telecom protocols. 
 - Deep hands-on experience in Golang (preferred) and proficiency in c++/c
 - Strong computer science fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms. 
 - Deep understanding of distributed systems, multi-threading, concurrency control, stateless proxies and Finite State Machines (FSM). 
 - Hands-on expertise with networking and messaging protocols including gRPC and RabbitMQ. 
 - Strong background with distributed databases like Apache Ignite and GridGain. 
 - Practical knowledge of persistence and caching solutions such as PostgreSQL, Redis, and ElasticSearch. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and explaining complex ideas. 
 - Industry Experience - 8+ years

Travel Requirements

Under 10%

None

Experienced

Yes

The Principal AI Engineer - R&D is a senior individual-contributor technology leader responsible for defining the architecture, engineering standards, and technical direction for enterprise AI solutions that transform research and development across Beckman Coulter Diagnostics. This role combines hands-on solution design and development with cross-functional technical leadership to build, validate, and scale production-grade AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation solutions, and intelligent engineering workflows across product development, systems engineering, software engineering, verification and validation, quality, and regulatory activities. The Principal AI Engineer partners with R&D and technology leaders to identify high-value opportunities, establish reusable architecture patterns and responsible AI controls, mentor engineering teams, and deliver secure, observable, compliant solutions that improve productivity, product quality, traceability, and speed to market. - Architect and deliver production-grade AI agents, engineering assistants, and agentic workflows that improve requirements development, systems engineering, risk management, design reviews, technical documentation, and end-to-end traceability.

data.description:
Location

Pune

Business Area

Engineering and CTO

Ref #

10054453

Description & Requirements

Bloomberg delivers billions of data points to hundreds of thousands of customers daily. When markets move, our customers need their data immediately and without fail. That's not a nice-to-have. It's the whole product. 

The Data License Reliability & Analytics group exists to make sure that promise holds - and to make sure we keep it efficiently. Our new Pune-based DL Optimization & Automation team will build the AI tooling and the context layer that lets engineers, SREs, and AI agents across Data License reason about our systems the way our most experienced people do: which pipelines feed which products, where capacity is wasted, which risks are real, and what to fix first. 

Role

In this role, you'll build and lead a team that puts AI to work on one of the most demanding data platforms in financial services. Your team will create intelligent systems that make Data License leaner, safer, and easier to run: 

Smarter use of infrastructure - finding where compute, storage, and other system resources are over-provisioned or idle, and turning that insight into action. 

Sharper data products - analyzing how the datasets in our Data License packages are built, delivered, and used, so we can keep improving what we offer clients. 

Security, risk, and compliance on autopilot - automating the evidence-gathering, tracking, and reporting that keep us ahead of evolving regulatory and security requirements. 

Maintenance that runs itself - finding the routine upkeep that consumes engineering time and handing it to machines. 

Underpinning all of this is an AI context layer you'll help design: a living, machine-readable understanding of our systems, data, and dependencies that lets engineers and AI agents answer hard questions in minutes instead of weeks. 

You will lead a team of four engineers, setting its technical direction and driving projects from idea to delivery. You'll work closely with engineering teams across Data License and Bloomberg infrastructure - as well as our reliability teams in New York and Dublin - turning their hardest operational questions into tools they rely on every day. 

What You'd Actually Be Working On

- Building and leading the team. Build and grow a team of four engineers. Set a high bar for engineering quality and analytical rigor, run the team's planning and delivery, and create an environment where people ship useful things quickly and learn fast. You'll stay hands-on - this is a lead who writes code and reviews designs, not just one who runs meetings. 
 - The AI context layer. Design and evolve the knowledge foundation our AI tools stand on: architecture knowledge bases, semantic models and ontologies of our data and services, and knowledge graphs that connect code, configuration, telemetry, and incident history. You'll own retrieval quality across RAG and GraphRAG pipelines, decide how knowledge is structured, verified, and kept fresh, and make sure an agent's answer can always be traced back to a source. 
 - AI-driven optimization of systems, processes, and architecture. Turn one-off investigations into repeatable tooling. Build analytics that find underused machines and tenancies, unneeded storage and datasets, and architectural bottlenecks - and quantify the impact of acting on them. If we answered a question once by hand, you'll be figuring out how to answer it on demand. 
 - Agents and MCP tooling. Build MCP servers and AI agents that expose Data License systems and knowledge to engineers and to other agents, and use agent-to-agent (A2A) patterns to compose them into multi-step workflows. Work on context retrieval, prompt and tool design, evaluation frameworks, and the feedback loops that make these systems more accurate over time. 
 - Risk and compliance analytics. Own the automated analytics behind regulatory and risk programs such as emerging cyber-resilience regulation and enterprise risk management: scanning codebases and inventories, tracking remediation, and producing evidence that holds up to scrutiny from auditors and leadership. 
 - Tools people actually use. Build the web applications, dashboards, and reports (React, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python) that put these insights in front of engineers, managers, and leadership, and make them self-service. 
 - Shaping the AI Development Lifecycle (AI-DLC). Help define how Data License builds software with AI agents - agentic development workflows, guardrails, and evaluation. Your team will be an early adopter and an example for the rest of the organization. 
 - Partnering across Data License and Bloomberg infrastructure. Work directly with application, platform, and SRE teams to understand their problems, review designs, and bring data to architecture decisions. You'll be the person teams come to when they want to know what a change will really cost, what it will save, and what it might break. 

What You Bring

- 7+ years writing production software, with strong Python and solid JavaScript/TypeScript
 - 2+ years leading engineers - as a team lead, tech lead, or in a role where you owned a team's technical direction and delivery
 - Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent hands-on experience
 - Hands-on experience building with LLMs: RAG pipelines, prompt and tool design, agents, or evaluation of AI output quality
 - Experience building full-stack applications, including React front-ends and Python back-end services and APIs
 - A data-driven mindset: you measure before you optimize, you show your evidence, and you're skeptical of conclusions - including an AI's - that can't be traced to a source
 - Strong communication skills. You'll lead a team in Pune while partnering with teams in New York, Dublin, and elsewhere, so you need to explain trade-offs clearly and build consensus without authority
 - Willingness to pick up new tools fast - this field changes month to month

What Would Set You Apart

- Experience with GraphRAG, knowledge graphs, ontologies, or semantic modeling
 - Building or deploying MCP servers, multi-agent systems, or agent-to-agent (A2A) protocols in production
 - Experience defining evaluation frameworks for LLM and agent systems - retrieval accuracy, groundedness, regression testing
 - Background in SRE, observability, or infrastructure analytics: capacity planning, cost and utilization optimization, telemetry (metrics, logs, traces)
 - Familiarity with data platforms such as Spark, Iceberg, Trino, or PostgreSQL
 - Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud or virtualized compute environments
 - Exposure to software supply-chain security, regulatory compliance, or risk management programs
 - A track record of building a team from the ground up, or of hiring and growing engineers into leads
 - Experience in a consulting or advisory role where you influenced engineering decisions across multiple teams

If This Sounds Like You

Apply if you think we're a good match. We'll get in touch to let you know what the next steps are, but in the meantime, feel free to have a look at this: 

Discover what makes Bloomberg unique - watch our for an inside look at our culture, values, and the people behind our success.

Job Description

AI Infrastructure Engineer (Mid / Senior)

Location: Bengaluru (Hybrid - 3 days a week in office)

About Us

Sage is a global leader in accounting and business management software, trusted by millions of businesses worldwide. Together with our Bengaluru engineering team, we are building finance, accounting, payroll and expense management solutions that simplifies how businesses track and reconcile spending. 

Thousands of finance teams globally use our product to streamline expense management, integrate seamlessly with leading accounting platforms, and are recognized for its clean design, usability, and speed. 

We're investing heavily in AI - building the platform that lets AI agents and assistants do real engineering work, reliably and at scale. This team designs and runs the infrastructure behind our coding agents, review agents, and internal AI assistants: the orchestration, context and memory systems, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops that make them better over time. 

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone with 3+ years of software engineering experience (mid-level) or 6+ years (senior), with hands-on experience building LLM-powered or agent-based systems in production. 

Technical Skills

- Solid software engineering fundamentals: system design, API design, data modelling, and clean, maintainable code. 
 - Experience building and running production systems in the cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including containers, Kubernetes or similar, and infrastructure as code. 
 - Hands-on experience with distributed systems: queues, async workflows, concurrency, reliability, and failure handling. 
 - Practical experience building with LLMs: tool use, agents, prompt and context engineering, RAG, and evaluation. 
 - Familiarity with agent protocols and ecosystems (e. g. , MCP) and with using AI coding tools day to day. 

Leadership & Ownership

- Comfort working independently and handling ambiguity: you can take a loosely defined problem, scope it, and drive it to production. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining trade-offs to both technical and non technical audiences. 
 - At the senior level, we also expect you to lead projects and set technical direction, mentor other engineers, define evaluation and quality standards, and influence architecture across teams. 

Mindset & Collaboration

- Growth mindset - curious, always learning, and open to feedback. 
 - Works closely with the engineers who use these tools every day; you help the whole organization build software better and faster. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with trace analysis or log mining to find and fix agent failure modes. 
 - Experience building internal platforms or SDKs that other teams adopted. 
 - Background in observability, CI/CD, or developer productivity tooling. 
 - Experience with model routing, cost optimization, or prompt caching. 
 - Open-source or public contributions in agent tooling or LLM infrastructure. 

What to Expect

- We value humility and collaboration - we're looking for people who can work as part of a team, not in silos. 
 - We expect engineers to take ownership beyond just writing code - including tests, documentation, and long-term system quality. 

Key Responsibilities

The Impact You'll Make

- Build and operate agent platforms: orchestration, tool and skill registries, plugin frameworks, and sandboxed execution. 
 - Develop coding agents and review agents that work well on real, large codebases, and integrate them into the existing SDLC (IDE, CI/CD, code review, issue tracking). 
 - Design context and memory management: retrieval (RAG), summarization and compression, session state, long-term memory, and repository-aware context. 
 - Build evaluation frameworks - both offline (benchmarks, regression suites) and online (production quality signals) - so we can measure whether agents are improving. 
 - Create feedback loops: capture and mine traces, find failure patterns, and turn them into better prompts, tools, skills, and evals. 
 - Build developer tooling and internal SDKs that make it easy for other teams to build on and adopt the platform. 
 - Own observability for agent systems: tracing, cost and latency tracking, and quality monitoring.

data.title: High Speed IO Validation Engineer
data.description:
NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the world's most desirable employers in the technology field. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. The NVIDIA Silicon Co-Design Group is seeking a versatile engineer to join our High Speed SERDES IO electrical validation team. Your bench is where silicon meets the signal - where every link train, jitter sweep, eye diagram, and protocol corner gets exercised before the part ships. You drive characterization and debug for IO interconnects across silicon, board, firmware, and driver - designing tests that anticipate rack-scale deployment so marginality surfaces at die-and-board scale, never in a rack. Your decisions show up in link margin, BER, power per lane, and the go/no-go calls that gate samples and production. 

This role focuses on industry-leading high-speed interconnects such as PCIe, USB3, Ethernet, and UFS. You will perform bring-up and electrical validation with a strong emphasis on quality, stability, and efficiency. Additionally, you will leverage AI-assisted workflows, automation, and advanced analytics to enhance validation quality, accelerate root cause analysis, and improve engineering efficiency. This position offers the opportunity to make a significant impact in a dynamic, technology-driven environment influencing product lines that span artificial intelligence, consumer graphics, self-driving cars, and more. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Execute electrical validation for PCIe, Ethernet, USB3, and UFS interfaces for NVIDIA GPUs, CPUs, and SOCs, ensuring adherence to signal integrity standards. 
 - Engage with cross-functional engineering teams to facilitate the design and development process, leveraging your knowledge of firmware/driver interactions and circuit design. 
 - Analyze complex HSIO bugs by applying strong debugging techniques and collaborating with various teams for rapid resolution. 
 - Diagnose issues and validate high-speed interfaces using modern lab equipment, including DSOs and BERT, with expert-level proficiency. 
 - Develop and apply test/debug programs using scripting languages (such as Perl and Python) to perform stress and failure analysis on high-speed interfaces. 
 - Innovate methodologies that leverage AI-assisted workflows and data-driven analytics to enhance debugging efficiency and improve validation quality. 

What We Need To See

- BS or MS in Electronics Engineering (or equivalent experience) with at least 3 years of relevant experience. 
 - Deep high-speed/SERDES electrical validation and tuning experience, with strong SI and PI fundamentals - S-parameters, eye diagrams, channel margin, crosstalk, return loss, PDN noise, jitter decomposition - and validation experience across silicon and platform boundaries (CoWoS/interposer/substrate, board), translating rack-environment effects into silicon/board characterization. 
 - Expert-level proficiency in electrical validation of PCIe (or similar) protocols, hands-on with lab equipment (DSOs, BERT, protocol analyzers), and scripting skills (Perl, Python) for developing test/debug programs. 
 - Proven experience in building AI solutions specifically in the context of electrical and silicon validation, including designing and implementing AI-assisted workflows and automation frameworks to enhance engineering productivity and validation quality. 

If you are energized by challenging problems, real ownership, deep work, and AI-enabled engineering at scale, we'd love to talk to you.

data.description:
Description

The Amazon Cross Border Core Technology team is seeking a seasoned Software Engineer to drive the development of innovative technologies that will shape platforms and products impacting a multibillion-dollar business and enhancing the global customer experience. Our team is focused on building next-generation services that will transform international trade at Amazon. We aim to revolutionize how shoppers worldwide discover and purchase global products. We're developing new services in areas like Customer Returns, Accounting, Customer Service and Mobile App to enhance the international shopping experience. Our goal is to offer a seamless, one-stop shopping experience for international customers, which includes: 

Building products (mobile and web based) that reach millions of new customers globally, delivering a world-class shopping experience with localized language, payment options, and currencies. 

Designing API-based services in NAWS that enable scalable platforms for both internal and external partners. 

Advancing customer experience technologies to support shoppers worldwide. 

Innovating strategies for global expansion and developing solutions that will sustain the continued rapid growth of this thriving business. 

Key job responsibilities

You're seeking a career where you can create, deliver, and make a lasting impact. You design solutions that reach millions of new customers globally, addressing complex problems with a holistic approach. You thrive in environments that demand intricate feedback loops and the development of robust ecosystems. You're passionate about solving real-world challenges with creative and thoughtful solutions, leveraging a deep understanding of the problem space. You constantly challenge yourself and others to improve, always striving for better outcomes. By collaborating closely with the business, you help define expansion strategies and develop innovative solutions that support the continued rapid growth of this dynamic and thriving business. 

About The Team

We're going to enable customers around the globe to purchase products on Amazon with guaranteed shipping and import duty fees. We're going to improve this experience by making selection available across all Amazon marketplaces, so that customers can search and browse in their preferred language and currency. Along the way, we're going to face seemingly impossible problems. We're going to argue about how to solve them, and we'll work together to find a solution that is superior to each of the proposals we came in with. Job Description

This strategy is key to the WSP in India Buildings Mechanical Electrical Public Health (MEP) business as we position ourselves to address the challenges of a changing global economy. This will involve recruiting, leading, developing a team of Engineers over a relatively short period of time. Cultural awareness, an open mind and excellent communication skills are essential requirements for the role.

- Agree and confirm the project brief to anticipate and identify needs and expectations in conjunction with others. 
 - Agree the project deliverables and programme. 
 - Agree the resource in India that will be required to undertake the designs to complete the project brief in time and cost. 
 - Agree the project fees according to brief, resource required and programme.

data.title: QA Engineer - Networking L2/L3 Testing | 4 - 8 yrs
data.description:
Meet the Team

The Cisco IOS XR Routing and BNG Test Team ensures the reliability, scalability, performance, and resiliency of Cisco's carrier-grade routing platforms. We work closely with software developers, architects, product managers, and customer-facing teams to deliver comprehensive, end-to-end validation across Layer 2, Layer 3, routing, subscriber-management, and network-service technologies for service providers, hyperscalers, and web-scale customers operating some of the world's largest and most demanding networks. 

Our team values technical depth, automation-first engineering, continuous learning, collaborative problem-solving, and responsible adoption of AI-assisted development practices. 

Your Impact

As a Software Test Engineer, you will own the quality validation of IOS XR routing and Broadband Network Gateway capabilities. You will design test strategies, develop automation, validate complex customer scenarios, investigate system-level failures, and provide data-driven release recommendations. 

Your work will help ensure that Cisco delivers stable, scalable, and production-ready networking solutions. You will also mentor junior engineers, improve test frameworks, and use modern AI-assisted tools to accelerate engineering and troubleshooting workflows. 

What You Will Do

- Design and implement functional, system, regression, scale, performance, interoperability, resiliency, and high-availability tests for IOS XR routing and BNG features. 
 - Validate BNG subscriber technologies, including IPoE, PPP, PPPoE, DHCPv4/DHCPv6, DHCP relay, Prefix Delegation, RADIUS, AAA, PAP/CHAP, accounting, Change of Authorization, subscriber policies, and session lifecycle management. 
 - Test Layer 2 and Layer 3 technologies such as Ethernet, VLAN, QinQ, LACP, IPv4/IPv6, BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, MPLS, Segment Routing, L2VPN, L3VPN, EVPN, ECMP, BFD, QoS, and high-availability mechanisms. 
 - Develop reusable and scalable test automation using Python and frameworks such as pyATS, Genie, or equivalent tools. 
 - Build and maintain physical, virtual, containerized, and cloud-based test environments using Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, clustering technologies, VMware, OpenStack, and network simulation platforms. 
 - Validate control-plane, forwarding-plane, subscriber-scale, traffic, failover, software upgrade, rollback, process restart, route churn, and subscriber churn scenarios. 
 - Troubleshoot complex issues using IOS XR logs, protocol traces, packet captures, telemetry, RADIUS transactions, crash information, and system-resource data. 
 - Validate model-driven interfaces and telemetry using YANG, NETCONF, RESTCONF, gNMI, gRPC, OpenConfig, and native IOS XR models. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, version control, and regression testing. 
 - Use approved AI coding assistants and engineering agents for test generation, automation development, log analysis, defect triage, and documentation. 
 - Apply foundational knowledge of generative AI, AI agents, MCPs, reusable AI skills, prompt and context management, and responsible validation of AI-generated output. 
 - Collaborate across engineering teams, review test designs and automation code, mentor junior engineers, and communicate product-quality risks and release readiness. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related technical field. 
 - 4 to 8 years of experience in software engineering, network product testing, test automation, or quality engineering. 
 - Strong knowledge of BNG architecture and subscriber-management technologies, including PPP/PPPoE, DHCP, RADIUS, AAA, accounting, and subscriber session management. 
 - Comprehensive understanding of Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking, including TCP/IP, Ethernet, VLANs, IPv4/IPv6, BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, and MPLS. 
 - Experience configuring and troubleshooting Cisco IOS XR or another carrier-grade network operating system. 
 - Advanced Python programming skills for test automation, scripting, API interaction, data analysis, and troubleshooting. 
 - Experience developing system, scale, performance, resiliency, and high-availability test scenarios. 
 - Strong Linux or Unix skills and experience with Git, code reviews, debugging, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Working experience of cloud, containerization, virtualization, and clustering technologies, including Docker, Kubernetes, VMware, and OpenStack. 
 - Familiarity with AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot or equivalent tools. 
 - Basic understanding of generative AI, AI agents, MCP, reusable skills, and responsible AI practices. 
 - Strong knowledge of software development life cycle. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing BNG and routing capabilities on Cisco IOS XR platforms such as Cisco 8000, ASR 9000, or NCS 5500/5700. 
 - Experience with traffic generators and subscriber-simulation tools such as IXIA or Spirent. 
 - Knowledge of advanced BNG features, including subscriber QoS, dynamic policy activation, etc. 
 - Experience with L2VPN, EVPN, telemetry, and network programmability. 
 - Familiarity with scale and performance characterization. 
 - CCNP Service Provider, CCIE Service Provider, DevNet Professional, or equivalent technical knowledge. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site

 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.

data.title: Staff Software Development Engineer
data.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in-line cloud security platform. 

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler. 

Role

We are looking for a Staff Software Development Engineer to join our team. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, reporting to the Director, of Engineering. 

What You'll Do (Role Expectations)

- Develop automation frameworks and automate test cases for the various features of Zscaler Client Connector. 
 - Expand automation coverage and infrastructure to improve the quality and efficiency of testing. 
 - Understand requirements, develop an exhaustive test plan, execute manual and automated test cases, dig deeper into issues, identify root causes and articulate defects clearly. 
 - Deliver a high-quality robust product in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Work closely with the Development, Product Management, and cloud Operations teams from design to release of the product/ feature. 
 - Recreate complex customer and production reported issues to determine root cause and verify the fixt

Who You Are (Success Profile)

- You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful. 
 - You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution. 
 - You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact. 
 - You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback-knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust. 
 - You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose. 

What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

- Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
 - 5+ years' experience as Software QA Engineer working on VPN related products or network traffic related testing / automation
 - Proficient programming skills (python preferred) and good amount of hands-on experience developing automation frameworks, CICD pipelines and leading automated test case development
 - Good knowledge of TCP/IP stack, ICMP/UDP, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/ TLS, DNS and DHCP
 - Proficient in Networking fundamentals (L3, L4, L7) , Proxies, Firewalls, Routers and Load Balancers

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

- Experience implementing AIOps, AI-driven predictive scaling, or automated anomaly detection to optimize cloud infrastructure performance and reliability
 - Hands on experience with configuring VPNs and setting up GRE / IPSec Tunnels is a plus
 - Experience setting up testbeds in a Virtualization environment is good to have

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure. 

Benefits

Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including: 

- Various health plans
 - Time off plans for vacation and sick time
 - Parental leave options
 - Retirement options
 - Education reimbursement
 - In-office perks, and more!
