data.title: Senior AI Business Automation Engineer (Dot Compliance) - Technology IT
data.description:
About Signant Health

At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support - so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency. 

Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals. 

If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health - including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies - you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health. 

About The Role

Signant Health is seeking a Senior AI Business Automation Engineer who works in two modes. In one, you embed with functional Subject Matter Experts - learning their workflows, including the workarounds and group knowledge that never appear in process documents, then designing, prototyping, and delivering the custom technical solutions that transform how those teams operate. In the other, you work on a small, focused delivery squad - leading or contributing - shipping AI-driven automation into a business unit at pace. 

Both modes share the same spirit: find business processes ripe for reinvention, rebuild them with an AI-first mindset, and put working code in front of real users fast. The role sits inside IT and carries the full weight of our infrastructure, data, integration, automation, and information security standards required of a clinical-trial technology provider. Code ships to production through regular, incremental delivery against real workflow data - not to a slide deck. Success is measured by how many workflows you've permanently transformed and how consistently your business teams start every task with an AI tool. 

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES - Function

- Flex between two modes: embedded with an assigned cohort of business SMEs, observing how work actually happens - the workarounds, shared spreadsheets, group knowledge - to find the highest-leverage workflows for an AI-first redesign; and contributing to or leading small delivery squads shipping AI-driven automation into a business unit at pace. Either way, the discipline is the same: get close to the real work, find the leverage, rebuild rather than automate as-is. 
 - Design, prototype, and deliver working solutions - custom tools, AI agents, automations, reusable skills - tailored to each engagement's workflows, delivered incrementally against real workflow data so value lands continuously, not just at project end. 
 - Coach and partner with the business users you work alongside - SMEs or squad stakeholders - through a progression: awareness, first win, regular AI integration, full workflow transformation. 
 - Develop and deploy AI agents using LLMs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, end-to-end automations across REST APIs, webhooks, and third-party SaaS, and secure data pipelines - built to enterprise standards. 
 - Build every solution for handoff from day one - documentation, observability, and runbooks so other engineers can operate, diagnose, and evolve it without you. 
 - Recognise patterns across engagements and scale what works: a tool built for one SME should become reusable for peers; a proven pattern should be documented for other engineers. 
 - Translate observed business problems into technical solutions and share wins visibly with your cohort and leadership, articulating ROI, effort, and risk honestly enough to make prioritisation easy. 
 - Participate in end-to-end testing and quality validation of AI, automation, and integrated solutions before production deployment. 
 - Use AI development tools fluently throughout the build lifecycle - coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) for rapid prototyping, LLMs for mining workflow signals from tickets and transcripts, AI-assisted drafting of designs, runbooks, and tests - while applying rigorous evaluation discipline (golden datasets, eval harnesses, regression suites, hallucination/grounding checks, human-in-the-loop checkpoints) before production deployment. 
 - Ensure automation solutions meet enterprise standards for security, scalability, and maintainability, with working knowledge of SOC 2 and ISO 27001 compliance requirements. 
 - Mentor both directions: upskill business users to build and maintain their own AI-assisted workflows, and support junior engineers with reusable patterns, solution designs, runbooks, and executive-ready status reports. 
 - Participate in and extend internal automation platforms to support more advanced workflows, reusable modules, and greater process autonomy. 

Knowledge, Skills & Attributes

Essential: 

- 5+ years of experience in enterprise automation, software development, or IT engineering. 
 - Hands-on experience designing and operating workflow automation (self-hosted or cloud) with REST API and webhook integrations across enterprise SaaS platforms. 
 - 2+ years building with the modern AI development toolkit: LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or equivalent), MCP servers and clients, agent frameworks and agentic workflow patterns, AI coding assistants as a daily driver, structured prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation grounded in enterprise data, and eval harnesses for measuring agent accuracy and safety in production. 
 - Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and Python; experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). 
 - Ability to communicate technical solutions clearly to engineering teams and executives; experience authoring business cases, solution designs, and implementation roadmaps. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a passion for continuous improvement and delivering measurable business outcomes through technology. 
 - Demonstrated ability to discover real workflows by working closely with practitioners - surfacing workarounds, shared spreadsheets, and undocumented group knowledge that determine whether an AI solution works on real edge cases. 
 - Comfortable operating in small, high-velocity delivery teams - able to lead or contribute on a squad of 2-4 engineers, hold a clear delivery line under time pressure, and partner well with stakeholders who expect working software fast. Desirable: 

- Relevant professional certifications in IT service management, project management, or enterprise automation platforms (e. g. ITIL, PMP, or platform-specific). 
 - Experience with iPaaS integration platforms (Boomi, MuleSoft, or Workato) connecting ERP, HRIS, CRM, and ITSM systems. 
 - Global experience collaborating with distributed teams to deliver enterprise technology initiatives. 
 - Experience using AI itself to discover and redesign workflows - analysing transaction histories, ticket logs, or content repositories with LLMs to surface bottlenecks, or building agentic prototypes in hours to test a hypothesis before a full build. 

Platform-Specific Requirements - Dot Compliance Track

Essential: 

- 3+ years of hands-on experience configuring and extending the Dot Compliance eQMS (built on Salesforce), including CAPA, Deviations, Audits, Change Control, Document Control, and Training Management workflows. 
 - Proven experience building and deploying custom Salesforce Apex triggers/classes, Lightning Web Components, and Flow automations in a validated Dot Compliance production environment. 
 - Proficiency in Apex and SOQL, plus JavaScript/TypeScript and Python, for scripting and integration on the Salesforce/Dot Compliance platform. 
 - Experience integrating AI/LLM APIs into Dot Compliance quality workflows (e. g. automated CAPA root-cause drafting, deviation triage, audit-readiness summarisation) grounded in regulated GxP data. Desirable: 

- Salesforce Platform Developer I/II certification and/or Dot Compliance administrator or configuration credentials. 

Why Signant Health?

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster - improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission. 

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation - not just maintain the status quo. 

If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it. 

At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough - we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment. 

Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

What You Will Do

We are seeking a QA Tester to ensure the quality, functionality, accessibility, and performance of websites built on Sitecore AI and related digital experience technologies. In this role, you will plan and execute manual and automated testing across web pages, components, forms, content workflows, APIs, integrations, and releases. You will work closely with developers, content authors, product owners, designers, and delivery partners to identify defects early, expand automated test coverage, and deliver reliable, secure, and user-friendly digital experiences across browsers, devices, and environments. 

- Develop and execute test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test data for Sitecore AI websites, features, components, forms, content updates, integrations, and releases. 
 - Perform functional, regression, smoke, exploratory, integration, end-to-end, cross-browser, responsive, accessibility, performance, and visual testing across supported environments. 
 - Build, maintain, and improve automated tests for critical website journeys, reusable components, APIs, and regression scenarios using modern web test automation frameworks. 
 - Validate Sitecore AI authoring experiences, page and component configuration, content publishing, personalization, search, forms, analytics tagging, consent behavior, and third-party integrations. 
 - Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines and review results to support release readiness and rapid defect detection. 
 - Document defects with clear reproduction steps, expected and actual results, screenshots or logs, severity, and business impact; verify fixes through retesting and regression testing. 
 - Partner with developers, designers, content teams, and product owners to clarify acceptance criteria, identify test risks, and improve testability early in the delivery lifecycle. 
 - Create and maintain reusable automation utilities, page objects, test fixtures, test data, and reporting that improve test reliability and reduce manual effort. 
 - Track test execution, automation coverage, defect trends, escaped defects, and release quality metrics, and communicate findings and risks clearly to stakeholders. 
 - Contribute to quality standards, test documentation, peer reviews, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of website testing practices. 

What You Will Need

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - At least 4 years of experience in software quality assurance, with hands-on responsibility for testing websites or web applications in enterprise environments. 
 - Strong knowledge of QA methods, the software development lifecycle, test design techniques, defect management, risk-based testing, and release validation. 
 - Hands-on experience creating and maintaining web test automation frameworks using tools such as Selenium, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Proficiency with JavaScript or TypeScript and working knowledge of another scripting or programming language such as Python, Java, or C#. 
 - Experience testing modern websites and web applications, including responsive layouts, reusable components, navigation, search, forms, content publishing, APIs, and third-party integrations. 
 - Experience with API testing tools and techniques, including request validation, response validation, authentication, error handling, and integration scenarios. 
 - Experience with Git-based workflows, pull requests, CI/CD pipelines, automated test execution, test reporting, and quality gates. 
 - Ability to use browser developer tools, logs, network traces, and test evidence to isolate and communicate website defects effectively. 
 - Experience validating cross-browser and cross-device behavior, accessibility, performance, security-related requirements, analytics tagging, and production readiness. 
 - Ability to write clear test cases, automation code, defect reports, test summaries, and release-quality recommendations. 
 - Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a hybrid, cross-functional delivery environment. 
 - Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, review test assets, troubleshoot failures, and share testing and automation knowledge with team members. 

What Would Be Nice To Have

- Hands-on testing experience with Sitecore AI, Sitecore XM Cloud, Experience Edge, or another composable digital experience platform. 
 - Experience testing React and Next. js websites deployed through Vercel, Microsoft Azure, or another cloud platform. 
 - Experience with Selenium, REST clients, accessibility testing tools, visual regression tools, and performance testing tools such as JMeter or k6. 
 - Experience designing maintainable automation frameworks using page objects, fixtures, data-driven testing, mocking, parallel execution, retry strategies, and actionable reporting. 
 - Familiarity with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jira, test management platforms, and browser or device testing services. 
 - Relevant certification in Sitecore, software testing, test automation, accessibility, cloud technologies, or web quality engineering. 
 - Experience testing high-traffic, multilingual, personalized, or regulated enterprise websites and coordinating quality activities with distributed delivery teams.

Observability & Debuggability

Test Data & Environment Management

Assets

What Would Be Nice To Have

The AI Architect defines and guides scalable, maintainable, AI-enabled product architecture for modern product delivery and legacy modernization. This role translates product goals, customer commitments, engineering constraints, and modernization needs into practical architecture, service models, integration patterns, technical standards, and reusable solution accelerators. The role is expected to use AI tools to improve architecture discovery, documentation, design comparison, codebase understanding, modernization planning, and engineering enablement while maintaining accountability for technical decisions. 

Key Outcomes

- Clear architecture direction for new product features, modernization, cloud adoption, integrations, and scalable product capabilities. 
 - Reduced technical debt and increased maintainability through service modeling, architecture standards, reusable patterns, and modernization roadmaps.

 - Stronger alignment among product, engineering, QA, DevOps, data, and leadership stakeholders around feasible and sustainable technical solutions. 

Roles and Responsibilities

- Lead product architecture for new capabilities, modernization initiatives, service decomposition, API strategies, integration patterns, data flows, cloud adoption, and non-functional requirements.

 - Define architecture standards, design patterns, API guidelines, service boundaries, data handling patterns, observability expectations, and quality attributes for product teams.

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline is required; equivalent deep technical experience may be considered.

 - Experience with legacy modernization, cloud services, distributed systems, API design, data architecture, technical debt management, and cross-functional solutioning.

Skills

 - Ability to create architecture decision records, diagrams, service catalogs, modernization roadmaps, technical standards, and reusable engineering patterns.

Abilities

 - Converts ambiguity into clear architecture direction, incremental modernization plans, and executable engineering guidance.

data.title: SONIC Principal Engineer
data.description:
About Marvell

Marvell's semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. 

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead. 

Your Team, Your Impact

Marvell's Prestera SONiC team mission is to drive next-gen switch silicon features while supporting enterprise customers with existing silicon on SONiC. In today's fast-moving industry, we learn and develop next-gen enterprise solutions for Marvell Prestera with a strong open-source presence in the SONiC community. 

What You Can Expect

- Design new enterprise solutions/protocols in SONiC while integrating existing SONiC features into internal releases
 - Contribute new features (or bugfixes) to the SONiC community to keep internal releases closer to upstream SONiC
 - Understand industry trends to drive end-to-end solutions in SONiC and in next-gen Marvell Prestera switch silicon
 - Help drive OCP SAI specifications to bridge enterprise solution gaps from a SONiC point of view
 - Develop unit tests for SONiC features and support the validation team to ensure stable releases

What We're Looking For

- 12+ years of experience designing switch NOS software, with a solid understanding of hardware; familiarity with OCP SAI is a plus
 - Demonstrated significant contributions to NOS solutions such as EVPN, SRv6, etc. 
 - Understanding of memory management, inter-process communication, containers (Docker), and build systems in a typical NOS
 - Proficiency in using AI-assisted tools for faster development
 - Expertise in C++ and Python
 - Preferred / Nice to Have: 
 - Understanding of how to expose switch silicon features to NOS/SONiC in the best possible manner
 - Understanding OCP SAI is preferable

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success. 

Additional Compensation And Benefit Elements

With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We're dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it's like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews. 

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process. 

This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U. S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U. S. Department of Commerce and/or the U. S. Department of State. Except for U. S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U. S. C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.

data.title: Sr.Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most. 

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships. 

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8, 000 organizations in over 100 countries - moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day. 

Sr Principal Software Engineer - Genesys Cloud AI & Industry Solutions

Role Overview

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer and employee experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data, and AI to deliver personalized experiences, automate complex business processes, and improve operational efficiency. 

We are looking for a Senior Principal Software Engineer with deep, hands-on Genesys Cloud experience to design and build the next generation of AI-powered applications and industry solutions on the Genesys Cloud platform. 

This is a highly technical, hands-on engineering role. The ideal candidate combines deep Genesys Cloud engineering expertise with hands-on experience building advanced conversational or agentic AI applications using Genesys AI, Cognigy, Sierra, Decagon, Kore. ai, or similar platforms. 

The ideal candidate has extensive experience developing applications and integrations on Genesys Cloud and understands how to combine Genesys Cloud APIs, Architect, AI capabilities, experience orchestration, data, and enterprise systems to create production-grade solutions. 

A major focus of this role will be translating industry-specific business processes and customer challenges into reusable AI solutions. You will build AI applications, Digital Teammates, solution accelerators, and industry solutions for areas such as financial services, healthcare, insurance, retail, travel and hospitality, telecommunications, and the public sector. 

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Innovations, customers, and partners to turn emerging Genesys AI capabilities, external AI technologies, and industry requirements into scalable, repeatable, and productized solutions that can be deployed across multiple customers. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and build production-grade applications and industry solutions on Genesys Cloud, leveraging Genesys Cloud APIs, SDKs, events, integrations, AI capabilities, and platform services. 
 - Develop AI-powered customer and employee applications using Genesys Cloud AI capabilities, including AI Studio, Virtual Agent/Agentic Virtual Agent capabilities, Copilot, Architect, knowledge, and Experience Orchestration. 
 - Translate industry-specific business processes and use cases into scalable AI applications, combining Genesys Cloud capabilities with enterprise systems, data, knowledge, AI models, and agentic technologies. 
 - Build reusable industry solution accelerators, Digital Teammates, AI agents, workflows, and application components that can be configured and deployed across multiple customers within an industry. 
 - Develop industry solutions addressing complex business challenges across financial services, healthcare, insurance, retail, travel and hospitality, telecommunications, and public sector environments. 
 - Design sophisticated Genesys Architect flows and orchestration patterns across voice, digital, AI, workflows, data, and enterprise applications. 
 - Build integrations using Genesys Cloud Platform APIs, Data Actions, event-driven architectures, webhooks, and external APIs. 
 - Integrate Genesys Cloud with industry and enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft, AWS, CRM, ITSM, ERP, knowledge, healthcare, financial services, and workflow platforms. 
 - Build agentic applications and multi-agent workflows where AI agents can reason, retrieve information, invoke tools and APIs, execute business processes, and collaborate with human employees. 
 - Apply modern conversational and agentic AI patterns learned from platforms such as Genesys AI, Cognigy, Sierra, Decagon, Kore. ai, and similar technologies to build differentiated solutions on Genesys Cloud. 
 - Design AI applications that combine LLMs, enterprise knowledge, tool/API calling, workflow orchestration, business rules, and enterprise systems of record. 
 - Create reusable solution patterns that encapsulate industry workflows, business rules, integrations, AI capabilities, and best practices, accelerating time to value for customers. 
 - Work with industry experts, customers, Product, and Engineering teams to identify high-value use cases and convert them into repeatable, productized solutions. 
 - Build prototypes and MVPs using emerging Genesys Cloud AI and other AI technologies and rapidly convert successful concepts into scalable, production-ready industry applications. 
 - Design applications for enterprise-scale requirements including security, reliability, observability, scalability, performance, compliance, and governance. 
 - Provide technical leadership, architecture guidance, code reviews, and mentorship while remaining a hands-on builder and contributor. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical discipline. 
 - 10+ years of software engineering, application development, or solution architecture experience. 
 - 5+ years of hands-on Genesys Cloud experience, including designing, developing, integrating, and deploying applications on the platform. 
 - Deep understanding of Genesys Cloud architecture, APIs, Architect, routing, conversations, integrations, Data Actions, and event-driven capabilities. 
 - Strong hands-on experience developing enterprise applications using modern programming languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or similar technologies. 
 - Experience building AI-powered applications, conversational AI solutions, virtual agents, or agentic applications using enterprise AI platforms and modern AI technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of modern AI architectures including LLMs, RAG, AI agents, tool calling, orchestration, multi-agent systems, conversational AI, and agentic workflows. 
 - Demonstrated experience building reusable enterprise or industry solutions, rather than only one-off customer implementations. 
 - Experience translating complex industry business processes and use cases into technical architectures and production applications. 
 - Experience building applications using REST APIs, SDKs, webhooks, event streams, microservices, and cloud-native architectures. 
 - Experience integrating Genesys Cloud with enterprise applications such as CRM, ITSM, ERP, knowledge, and workflow platforms. 
 - Experience translating AI capabilities into production-grade applications and reusable solutions, including integrations with enterprise APIs, knowledge systems, workflows, and business applications. 
 - Experience taking solutions from prototype/MVP through production deployment and operation. 
 - Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership while remaining deeply involved in architecture, design, coding, prototyping, debugging, and implementation. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience with Genesys Cloud AI capabilities, including AI Studio, Virtual Agent/Agentic Virtual Agent, Copilot, Predictive Engagement, knowledge capabilities, and Experience Orchestration. 
 - Hands-on experience building production AI applications using Cognigy, Sierra, Decagon, Kore. ai, or similar enterprise conversational and agentic AI platforms. 
 - Experience developing custom applications and reusable solutions using the Genesys Cloud Developer Platform and APIs. 
 - Experience with Genesys Cloud CX voice and digital channels, including routing, Architect flows, bots, messaging, and agent experiences. 
 - Experience designing AI agents that combine conversational intelligence, reasoning, knowledge retrieval, tool/API calling, workflow orchestration, and business-process execution. 
 - Experience building agentic AI applications that integrate LLMs with enterprise APIs, knowledge systems, CRM/ITSM platforms, workflow engines, and other systems of record. 
 - Experience designing or developing industry-specific AI applications and reusable solution accelerators for financial services, healthcare, insurance, retail, telecommunications, travel and hospitality, or public sector. 
 - Understanding of industry-specific business processes, regulatory requirements, data models, and enterprise application ecosystems. 
 - Familiarity with AI development and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar technologies. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, including AI services such as Amazon Bedrock. 
 - Experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar ecosystems. 
 - Experience taking AI applications from prototype through enterprise production, including security, scalability, observability, governance, and reliability. 
 - Experience working in innovation teams, rapid prototyping environments, or customer co-creation programs. 

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means being able to take an industry business problem or use case and rapidly turn it into a working, production-quality AI application built on Genesys Cloud. 

More importantly, the goal is not simply to solve the problem for one customer. You will identify the common business process, integrations, AI capabilities, and orchestration patterns and turn them into a reusable industry solution that can be deployed across many customers. 

You should be equally comfortable understanding an industry business process, discussing architecture, working with Genesys Cloud APIs, designing an Architect flow, writing application code, integrating enterprise systems, connecting AI models and agents, implementing tool/API calling, debugging interactions, and demonstrating the finished solution to customers and executives. 

You should also be able to bring experience and architectural patterns from leading conversational and agentic AI platforms and apply those concepts effectively within the Genesys Cloud ecosystem. 

This is not a traditional high-level architecture role. We are looking for a hands-on Principal Engineer who knows Genesys Cloud deeply and can combine its AI, orchestration, API, and integration capabilities with modern agentic AI technologies to build the next generation of AI-powered industry solutions. 

Working at Genesys

- AI at enterprise scale - Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8, 000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
 - A flexible-first culture - Join a global team of nearly 7, 000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work
 - Growth in the AI era - Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support
 - Time to recharge and give back - Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families
 - Recognized globally - Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report. 

What Happens After You Apply

After you apply, here's what you can typically expect: 

- Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team
 - A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview. 
 - Next, you'll meet the hiring manager and other members of the interview team
 - We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with no more than five interviews in most cases
 - After interviews are complete, our team will follow up with the final steps

Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process. 

Stay Connected

Stay connected to learn more about how we're applying AI to customer and employee experience challenges and get notified when relevant opportunities become available. 

Get notified about relevant opportunities. 

Be the one building what's next - where AI, experience and impact come together. 

Employee Referral

If a Genesys employee referred you, please apply using the link they shared so we can connect your application to their referral. 

About Genesys: 

Genesys® empowers more than 8, 000 organizations worldwide to create the best customer and employee experiences. Genesys CloudTM is the Agentic Orchestration Platform that securely connects people, systems, data and AI across the enterprise with built-in governance and control. As a result, organizations can drive customer loyalty, growth and retention while increasing operational efficiency and teamwork across human and AI workforces. To learn more, visit www. genesys. ai. 

Reasonable Accommodations: 

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are limited in your ability to access or use this online application and need an alternative method for applying, you or someone you know may contact us at reasonable. accommodations@genesys. com. 

You can expect a response within 24-48 hours. To help us provide the best support, click the email link above to open a pre-filled message and complete the requested information before sending. If you have any questions, please include them in your email. 

This email is intended to support job seekers requesting accommodations. Messages unrelated to accommodation-such as application follow-ups or resume submissions-may not receive a response. 

Genesys is an equal opportunity employer committed to fairness in the workplace. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, domestic partner status, national origin, genetics, disability, military and veteran status, and other protected characteristics. 

Please note that recruiters will never ask for sensitive personal or financial information during the application phase.

data.title: Lead Service Engineer
data.description:
Organization Background

Engineering Services & Infrastructure (ESI) provides the core technology foundation enabling caregivers, physicians, patients, and technology partners to deliver on Providence's mission. ESI supports Cloud Services, Network Connectivity, Data Centers, Collaboration Platforms, and End User Computing (EUC), driving large‐scale cloud adoption, infrastructure modernization, and digital experience transformation. 

Role Summary

The Senior / Lead ControlUp & Digital Experience Engineer is responsible for designing, operating, and evolving enterprise‐scale digital experience monitoring, real‐time observability, and automation using ControlUp. 

This role serves as a technical architect and platform lead, owning ControlUp strategy across Citrix, VDI, and endpoint environments, driving experience‐led operations, proactive remediation, and automation‐first practices that improve reliability, performance, and end‐user experience. 

Key Responsibilities

Lead and own the ControlUp platform end‐to‐end by architecting real‐time observability and experience analytics across Citrix, VDI, and endpoints; designing and operating dashboards, alerts, and triggers; building governed, event‐driven workflows and advanced PowerShell‐based remediation; integrating with ServiceNow and enterprise APIs; enforcing GitHub‐driven automation standards; driving environment hygiene and self‐healing operations; and converting operational and experience data into measurable EUC and business outcomes. 

Skills & Qualifications

- 7+ years of experience in EUC, Digital Workplace, Observability, or DEX engineering in large enterprise environments 
 - 4+ years of deep, hands‐on experience with ControlUp in production enterprise deployments 
 - Strong expertise in ControlUp RTDX, Insights, Edge DX, Scoutbees, and automation capabilities 
 - Mandatory: Advanced PowerShell scripting for automation, remediation, and troubleshooting 
 - Strong experience using GitHub for source control, reviews, and engineering best practices 
 - Hands‐on experience with REST API integrations and workflow‐driven automation 
 - Deep understanding of Windows endpoints, VDI internals, session behavior, and EUC performance signals 
 - Strong experience supporting Citrix Virtual Apps & Desktops and/or Endpoint IGEL, Windows, MacOS. 
 - Experience operating in large, regulated enterprise environments with change, security, and audit requirements 
 - Proven ability to lead platform strategy, influence engineering practices, and drive measurable outcomes 
 - Excellent documentation, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with additional DEX platforms such as ControlUp, Nexthink or Aternity 
 - Exposure to experience‐led operations, self‐healing endpoints, or AIOps‐aligned models 
 - Experience with ControlUp Workflows, automation at scale, and platform standardization 
 - Working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation‐first operating models 
 - Experience contributing to platform transformations, modernization programs, or observability strategy

Certifications (Nice to Have)

- ControlUp Certification (Admin / Advanced / DEX) 
 - Citrix CCA-V, AZ‐900 
 - ITIL Foundation

data.title: Custom Software Engineer
data.description:
Project Role : Custom Software Engineer

Project Role Description : Lead the effort to design, build and configure applications, acting as the primary point of contact. 

Must have skills : Microsoft Robotic Process Automation Advanced

Good to have skills : NA

Minimum 2 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary: 

As a Custom Software Engineer, a typical day involves leading the design, development, and configuration of software applications. This role requires taking ownership of projects, coordinating with various stakeholders, and ensuring that the applications meet the desired requirements. The position demands proactive problem-solving and continuous engagement with the team to drive the project forward while maintaining clear communication and collaboration throughout the development lifecycle. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

- Expected to perform independently and become an SME. 
 - Required active participation/contribution in team discussions. 
 - Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and analyze requirements for custom software solutions. 
 - Assist in documenting technical specifications and user guides to support application deployment and maintenance. 
 - Support junior team members by sharing knowledge and providing guidance on best practices. 
 - Continuously monitor application performance and suggest improvements to enhance efficiency and user experience.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer (C++)
data.description:
Role : Senior C++ Engineer

Location: Chennai

Years: 8+

About Lynk (Name has been changed to Elveo)

Elveo is the inventor of satellite direct to device or D2D technology, and has the world's only commercial license from the FCC to operate a commercial D2D system. Today, Lynk allows mobile network operators' subscribers to send and receive text messages to and from space via standard unmodified, mobile devices. Lynk's service has been tested and proven on all seven continents, has regulatory approvals in more than 30 countries and is currently being deployed commercially based on more than 40 MNO commercial service contracts covering approximately 50 countries. 

Our technology will enable all 8 billion people on the planet to stay connected with the existing standard phone in their pocket. Everywhere. No matter what. 

By joining Lynk, you will have the opportunity to directly touch the lives of billions. Your mission will be to bring mobile broadband to billions, pull hundreds of millions out of poverty, and save countless lives. 

What You'll Do

As a Senior Software Engineer at Lynk, you will be a technical leader in designing, building, and operating the software that powers our satellites and ground network. You will set the standard for engineering excellence, mentor other engineers, and take on our most complex challenges in distributed systems, real-time software, and global-scale operations. 

Responsibilities

- Lead the architecture and design of high-reliability, mission-critical software for our satellite and ground systems. 
 - Drive the full development lifecycle, from technical strategy and requirements definition to implementation, testing, and operational excellence. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and champion best practices in software design, particularly in object-oriented (OO) principles. 
 - Create sophisticated simulation, emulation, and hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) test environments to ensure system-wide integrity. 
 - Participate in operations, including data analysis, system monitoring, and visualization. 
 - Collaborate in architecture, design, and code reviews. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). 
 - 5+ years of professional experience in software development.

We're looking for passionate AI Engineers, Data Specialists, Architects, Cloud Engineers, and technology innovators who want to solve complex challenges, build solutions from the ground up, and shape what comes next. 

🔥 Ready to take your AI career to the next level? Explore our open positions and apply now on LinkedIn. Come build the future of Industrial AI with ArcelorMittal!

Job Title - Agentic AI Engineering Lead (Agent Engineering Practice Lead)

Job Nature - Permanent

Work Location - Hyderabad

Experience - 12+ years software engineering, of which 2+ years building production large language model / agentic applications and 4+ years leading engineers

Purpose of the Role

Own ArcelorMittal's agent engineering practice: reusable patterns for agent decomposition, orchestration, tool use, memory, evaluation, safeguards and operational behaviour; reference implementations on approved Microsoft agent frameworks; agent-specific test suites; and coaching of pod engineers so that agentic solutions are measurable, safe and reusable. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define agent decomposition, planning, tool-use, memory, state and orchestration patterns; codify them in the agent engineering standard. 
 - Select and validate implementation approaches across approved Microsoft agent frameworks (Azure AI Foundry Agent Service, Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel, Copilot Studio) and the platform's agent runtime. 
 - Build and maintain reference implementations and reusable components (tools, connectors, orchestration, guardrails) for common agent behaviours. 
 - Define agent-specific tests for task success, safety, permissions, latency, cost and failure recovery; integrate them into CI/CD evaluation gates with the AI Platform Owner. 
 - Review pod implementations, lead code and design reviews, and coach engineers on difficult agent design problems. 
 - Harvest proven components and lessons from the partner-led pods into the CoE pattern library; retire unsafe or untestable patterns. 
 - Lead the ArcelorMittal engineering community of practice for agentic AI across Europe and the India Global Capability Centre. 

Preferred Skills

- Stakeholder orientation
 - Results orientation
 - Courage to challenge
 - Inspire trust
 - Innovation and learning agility
 - Decision making
 - Cross-cultural collaboration
 - Capability building and knowledge transfer

Good to have skills

- Production software engineering in Python and/or C#/. NET with strong testing and CI/CD discipline
 - Hands-on building of large language model / agentic applications: Azure AI Foundry (Azure OpenAI), Agent Service, Semantic Kernel / Agent Framework, function calling / tools, retrieval-augmented generation and grounding
 - Agent evaluation and safety engineering: evaluation datasets, model-as-judge evaluation, red-teaming, content safety, permission boundaries
 - Designing for observability and operations: tracing (OpenTelemetry), telemetry, cost and latency management
 - Technical leadership: code review, pattern definition, coaching
 - Experience in leading team of AI Engineers, providing guidance and technical decision ability, defining strong engineering practices
 - Copilot Studio and Power Platform for low-code agents; Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility
 - Microsoft Fabric / SQL for grounding on governed data
 - Container-based runtimes (Azure Container Apps, Azure Kubernetes Service), Azure API Management, Entra ID
 - Certifications: AI-102, AZ-204, DP-600

Qualifications

Bachelor degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Data, Business or a relevant discipline. Advanced degree or equivalent professional experience is an advantage

Deliverables

The successful Agentic AI Engineering Lead (Agent Engineering Practice Lead) combines strong professional depth with a practical delivery mindset. The individual must be able to establish clear methods, make sound decisions, develop colleagues and progressively assume ownership from the implementation partner. Success requires confidence working across India and Europe and balanced judgement across delivery speed, reuse, security and Responsible AI. 

This role helps establish a permanent ArcelorMittal AI capability, embeds repeatable engineering and control practices, and reduces dependency on the implementation partner through structured ownership transfer. Success is demonstrated when: 

- Reference patterns are reused across pods; agent behaviour (task success, safety, permissions, latency, cost, failure recovery) is measurable; permission and failure paths are tested before release; duplicated engineering effort declines; ArcelorMittal engineers can build agents independently. 
 - Agent engineering standard; reference implementations; reusable tools and orchestration components; agent evaluation suite; engineering review evidence; failure and recovery patterns; coaching materials. 

Time Zone

India Standard Time (IST) with European working hours (CET/GMT) overlap

data.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world. 

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7, 000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide. 

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us. 

About Our Team

At Agoda, our Backend Engineering team builds high-scale, fault-tolerant distributed systems that power a global travel platform serving millions of users daily. We own mission-critical domains across inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms. 

Our systems run with high availability, low latency, and zero-downtime expectations, powered by modern technologies such as Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike, along with strong foundations in CI/CD, automation, and observability. 

We ship fast-often dozens of releases a day-and design systems that are resilient, self-healing, and built to scale globally. 

The Opportunity

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll own the design and reliability of a critical service or domain end-to-end - from architecture through production. Beyond writing code, you'll be expected to identify problems before they're assigned to you, make independent calls on ambiguous technical trade-offs within your domain, and raise the technical bar for your immediate team. You'll combine hands-on coding, system design, and technical ownership - accountable for outcomes within your service, and a trusted technical voice when your work touches adjacent teams. 

What You Will Do

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer II nterprise Data Platform
data.description:
The next part of your journey is right around the corner - with Standard India

A genuine desire to make a difference in the lives of others is the foundation for everything we do. With a customer-first mindset and an intentional focus on building strong teams across the nation, we've been able to uphold our legacy of financial stability while investing in new, innovative technologies that support the needs of our customers. Our high-performance culture, focused on operational excellence, thrives thanks to remarkable people united by compassion and a customer-first commitment. Are you ready to make a difference?

Job Summary

A Site Reliability Engineer II is responsible for supporting the reliability, availability, and operational health of the Enterprise Data Platform and the critical data workloads and services running on it. This role combines production operations, data platform knowledge, troubleshooting, monitoring, and automation practices to help ensure critical data processing completes successfully, and production services meet established service expectations. The engineer monitors production workloads, investigates failed or delayed data jobs, supports production incident resolution, executes approved data corrections and recovery activities, and works with Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, product teams, and other stakeholders to maintain stable and reliable production operations. These engineers independently perform repeatable operational activities and resolve known production issues using established procedures, runbooks, and engineering practices. They work with senior engineers on more complex problems while developing their troubleshooting, automation, and reliability engineering capabilities. The role contributes to improved monitoring, documentation, operational processes, and automation that reduce recurring manual effort and improve the overall reliability of the Enterprise Data Platform. 

Key Responsibility Areas

(35%) Production Operations & Data Workload Monitoring

- Monitor production data workloads, pipelines, scheduled jobs, and platform services to help ensure reliable and timely processing. 
 - Identify failed, delayed, or incomplete data jobs and perform established recovery and troubleshooting procedures. 
 - Monitor workload dependencies, operational alerts, processing status, and production health and escalate issues when appropriate. 
 - Perform approved operational recovery activities including job restarts, reruns, validation, and other documented remediation procedures. 
 - Support day-to-day operational health of the Enterprise Data Platform and its production workloads. 

(25%) Incident Management & Troubleshooting

- Investigate production incidents involving data pipelines, platform services, integrations, data processing, and related dependencies. 
 - Use logs, alerts, job execution information, platform telemetry, and established troubleshooting procedures to identify and resolve production issues. 
 - Restore services using established recovery procedures and escalate complex or unfamiliar problems to senior Site Reliability, Data Engineering, or Platform Engineering resources. 
 - Document incident symptoms, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and relevant findings to support future problem resolution. 
 - Assist senior engineers with investigation and root cause analysis of significant or recurring production issues. 

(15%) Data Corrections & Production Support

- Support investigation and resolution of production data issues and data correction requests. 
 - Execute approved data corrections, reprocessing, and recovery activities using established procedures and controls. 
 - Validate processing results and data corrections to confirm successful completion and expected outcomes. 
 - Coordinate with Data Engineering, product teams, and other stakeholders when additional investigation or engineering support is required. 

(10%) Monitoring, Automation & Reliability Improvement

- Support development and maintenance of automation that reduces repetitive operational activities and manual intervention. 
 - Assist with improvements to monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, and operational telemetry. 
 - Identify recurring operational issues and opportunities to improve production support processes. 
 - Contribute scripts, utilities, and operational improvements that increase efficiency and reliability. 

(10%) SLA/SLO Monitoring & Operational Excellence

- Monitor critical production workloads and services against defined SLAs, SLOs, and operational expectations.

Design Manager-CQV is responsible for leading and delivering end-to-end commissioning, qualification, and validation (CQV) programs for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device projects. This role combines technical subject matter expertise with project leadership, ensuring compliance with global regulatory standards while meeting project timelines, quality, and budget targets. 

The role requires deep experience in GxP environments, risk-based validation, and facility/equipment qualification, along with strong stakeholder and team management skills. The role will require an experienced, energetic, and committed CQV person with broad experience in C&Q, particularly biopharmaceuticals and having experience of >15 years. The person should have experience of leading CQV engineers for big projects and managing the C&Q documentation and execution lifecycle, from SLIA generation through to OQ/ PQ completion. They will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects. 

- Lead and execute CQV activities across multiple CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations. 
 - Act as an SME for CQV having technical authority for systems such as process equipments, process utilities, automation, HVAC and controlled environments. 
 - Manage multi-disciplinary teams including CQV engineers, vendors, and contractors. 
 - Serve as the primary CQV interface with clients, design teams and Quality & regulatory teams. 
 - Track project deliverables, budgets, risks, and timelines and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders. 
 - Drive decision-making and resolve escalations with engineering team and client. 
 - Involve in GMP review of layouts and systems and ensure CQV requirements are embedded early in the design lifecycle. 
 - Review P&IDs, layouts, URS, FS/DS, equipment specifications and vendor documentation. 
 - Mentor and guide CQV engineers and junior staff. 
 - Establish best practices, templates, and standard methodologies. 
 - Drive continuous improvement and knowledge sharing within the team. 
 - Prepare C&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan. 
 - Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level. 
 - Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports. 
 - Ensure all CQV activities comply with relevant regulatory requirements (e. g. , FDA, EMA) and industry standards (e. g. , ISPE, ASTM) and meets data integrity (ALOCOA+) principles. Well versed in commissioning and qualifying CIP & SIP systems

Here's what you'll need

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm. , M. Pharm. , B. Tech or BE or MSc.

data.description:
About The Role

Grade Level (for internal use): 

12

The Team

The role is being established within the Data Quality organisation of S&P Global's Enterprise Data Organization (EDO) to provide independent, enterprise-wide assurance of data quality. The team is accountable for assessing quality across critical data domains, strengthening governance, and building senior leadership confidence in the integrity, reliability, and trustworthiness of our data assets. 

The Impact

This senior leadership role governs enterprise-scale data quality across critical domains, driving quality strategy, governance, and proactive risk prevention to strengthen data integrity and business confidence. By partnering across Product, Technology, and Operations, the role accelerates automation, observability, and quality transformation, enhancing stakeholder trust, regulatory readiness, and sustainable growth. 

What's In It For You

- Enterprise-Wide Leadership Impact - Shape and influence data quality strategy across critical business domains, driving outcomes that directly enhance customer trust, business performance, and organisational growth. 
 - Executive Visibility & Stakeholder Engagement - Partner closely with senior leaders across Product, Technology, Operations, and Data leadership teams, with regular exposure to key decision-makers and strategic transformation initiatives. 
 - Global Scope & Cross-Functional Influence - Lead globally distributed teams and collaborate across regions, business units, and data functions to establish scalable governance, quality standards, and best practices at enterprise scale. 
 - Career Growth Through Transformation Leadership - Play a pivotal role in advancing AI-enabled quality, automation, observability, and data governance capabilities, providing a unique platform to build executive leadership, innovation, and change-management expertise. 
 - Build the Future of Data Quality - Drive the evolution of quality from a control function to a strategic business capability, influencing how one of the world's leading data providers delivers trusted, high-quality data products to customers globally. 

Responsibilities

- Govern domain‐level operations and quality strategy, ensuring consistent execution of controls, RCA discipline, and prevention mechanisms. 
 - Define outcome-based quality metrics, including defect escape rates, recurrence rates, and control effectiveness measures such as precision and recall. 
 - Establish statistical process controls and trend-based insights to detect early signs of performance deterioration and quality risk. 
 - Develop scalable sampling models, including stratified and acceptance sampling, to enhance monitoring effectiveness and quality assurance. 
 - Define a standardized evaluation and governance framework for AI/ML/LLM capabilities, incorporating benchmark datasets, scoring rubrics, regression testing, and failure taxonomy. 

What We're Looking For

- Background in Finance/Statistics and preferred certifications in data quality (Lean Six Sigma, CIMP, DCAM). 
 - Executive presence with strong influencing and decision‐making capability. 
 - Inclusive leadership, accountability, and change‐management mindset. 
 - Demonstrates strong learning agility and digital acumen, with a continuous learning mindset and the ability to adapt to evolving tools and technologies. 

What's In It For You?

Our Mission

Advancing Essential Intelligence. 

Our People

We're more than 35, 000 strong worldwide-so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all. From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We're committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference. 

Our Values

Integrity, Discovery, Partnership

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals. 

Benefits

We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That's why we provide everything you-and your career-need to thrive at S&P Global. 

Our Benefits Include

- Health & Wellness: Health care coverage designed for the mind and body. 
 - Flexible Downtime: Generous time off helps keep you energized for your time on. 
 - Continuous Learning: Access a wealth of resources to grow your career and learn valuable new skills. 
 - Invest in Your Future: Secure your financial future through competitive pay, retirement planning, a continuing education program with a company-matched student loan contribution, and financial wellness programs. 
 - Family Friendly Perks: It's not just about you. S&P Global has perks for your partners and little ones, too, with some best-in class benefits for families. 
 - Beyond the Basics: From retail discounts to referral incentive awards-small perks can make a big difference. 

For more information on benefits by country visit: https: //spgbenefits. com/benefit-summaries

Global Hiring And Opportunity At S&P Global

At S&P Global, we are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all individuals have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. Our hiring practices emphasize fairness, transparency, and merit, ensuring that we attract and retain top talent. By valuing different perspectives and promoting a culture of respect and collaboration, we drive innovation and power global markets. 

Recruitment Fraud Alert

If you receive an email from a spglobalind. com domain or any other regionally based domains, it is a scam and should be reported to reportfraud@spglobal. com. S&P Global never requires any candidate to pay money for job applications, interviews, offer letters, "pre-employment training" or for equipment/delivery of equipment. Stay informed and protect yourself from recruitment fraud by reviewing our guidelines, fraudulent domains, and how to report suspicious activity here. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

S&P Global is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, military veteran status, unemployment status, or any other status protected by law. Only electronic job submissions will be considered for employment. 

If you need an accommodation during the application process due to a disability, please send an email to: EEO. Compliance@spglobal. com and your request will be forwarded to the appropriate person.

data.title: Senior Substation Automation Engineer - Grid Modernization (IEC 61850)
data.description:
Date: Oct 1, 2026

Location: 

Pune, MH, IN

Company: Black & Veatch Family of Companies

We believe real value is powered by the unique skills and experiences of our professionals. The interchange of ideas from a diverse group of people gives our teams an expanded perspective and the ability to find better solutions for our clients. 

Req Id : 116879

Job Title : Senior Substation Automation Engineer - Grid Modernization (IEC 61850)

Business Unit sector : CPL-BVOPS-ENGR & DEV SVCS

Department: BVCPL BV OPS EDS INSTR & CONTR

Work Location : INPUNE

Opportunity Type : Staff

Relocation eligible : Yes

Full time/Part time : Full-Time

Contract Hire Only for this Project: No

Visa Sponsorship Available: No

Recruiter : Ashwini Dnyanoba Patil

Job Summary

Black & Veatch is expanding its Power SCADA team to support a strategic grid modernization initiative focused on IEC 61850‐based substation automation and virtual substation technologies. As a founding member of the Virtual Protection, Automation, and Control (vPAC) Alliance, Black & Veatch is collaborating with industry leaders to advance open, secure, and vendor‐agnostic digital substation solutions that replace traditional, hardware‐intensive architectures with virtualized, software‐defined platforms. Following successful pilot efforts, BV is now transitioning virtual substations into production environments. This role is being created to bring in experienced SCADA professionals who can help design, implement, standardize, and support production‐ready Power SCADA solutions that enable resilient, flexible, and future‐ready grid infrastructure

In this role, you may have the opportunity to: 

- Lead the transition of IEC 61850‐based digital and virtual substations from pilot to production, shaping real-world grid modernization outcomes. 
 - Design and standardize secure, vendor‐agnostic substation automation architectures that improve resilience, flexibility, and scalability. 
 - Serve as a technical leader and subject‐matter expert, influencing system architecture, best practices, and emerging standards. 
 - Collaborate with utilities, technology partners, and industry groups (including vPAC Alliance) to help define the future of protection, automation, and control

Key Responsibilities

IEC 61850 Engineering & Modeling

- Develop SCL engineering artifacts including ICD, CID, and SCD files, datasets, logical node mappings, reporting and control blocks, and GOOSE publications and subscriptions. 
 - Configure and validate MMS, GOOSE, and SV messaging for protection, automation, monitoring, and SCADA applications. 

Substation Networking & Time Synchronization

- Design and document station-bus and process-bus network architectures using PRP/HSR, VLANs, QoS, multicast management, and traffic segmentation practices. 
 - Design deterministic real-time networking paths for time-sensitive protection and automation applications, incorporating latency budgeting, PTP timing performance, and behaviors defined for substation-class devices meeting IEC 61850-3 and IEEE 1613 environmental and EMC requirements. 
 - Diagnose and optimize real-time network behavior through traffic-capture analysis, timing-accuracy evaluation, and system-level tuning techniques for time-critical digital-substation workloads. 
 - Develop PTP-based time-synchronization architectures including grandmaster, boundary, and transparent clock configurations and incorporate timing considerations into the system design. 

Protection, Automation & SCADA Integration

- Integrate multi-vendor IEDs with protection settings and logic, coordinating measurements, controls, alarms, and event data with SCADA and HMI systems. 
 - Apply IEC 61850 data-modeling concepts to confirm interoperability across mixed fleets of protection and control devices. 

Cybersecurity & System Hardening

- Incorporate cybersecurity principles into system architecture, including authentication, role-based access control, network segmentation, secure communications, and device hardening. 
 - Apply cyber-informed engineering principles by identifying high-consequence functions and integrating protective measures directly into system architecture, embedding security decisions from the earliest stages of engineering rather than treating them as add-on controls. 

Virtualization of Substation Functions

- Develop and configure virtualized protection, HMI, gateway/RTU, and related substation applications on platforms including VMware ESXi with vCenter, vSAN, and NSX; Red Hat KVM or OpenShift Virtualization; and SEAPATH's real-time, high-availability hypervisor platform designed to run virtualized protection, automation, and control workloads with deterministic performance and PTP-synchronized operation on industrial servers meeting IEC 61850-3 and IEEE 1613 criteria. 

Industry Engagement & Technical Leadership

- Contribute to, or develop toward contributing to, IEEE and IEC standards and collaborative initiatives related to IEC 61850, digital substations, time synchronization, and cybersecurity. 
 - Support participation in technical bodies and industry groups such as IEC, IEEE, CIGRE, ISA99, and vPAC Alliance workstreams. 
 - Support the advancement and practical application of virtualized protection, automation, and control concepts in alignment with the architectural direction established by the vPAC Alliance. 

Project Delivery & Collaboration

- Produce engineering documentation including network specifications, SCL models, timing plans, interface definitions, and system diagrams used across design, laboratory validation, and field implementation. 
 - Collaborate with project managers, technical leads, clients, and vendors to align designs with project goals, operational requirements, and industry best practices. 

Management Responsibilities

Preferred Qualifications

Responsibilities

What You'll do

We are seeking an Automation & AI Agentic Engineer to design, build, and support a hybrid automation portfolio that spans traditional RPA and next-generation agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate is hands-on across Microsoft Copilot / Copilot Studio, Agent Core, Power Automate, and UiPath (including UiPath Agentic Automation/Agentic Orchestration) evaluate which platform and approach - rule-based bot, low-code flow, or autonomous AI agent - best fits a given business process.

- Design, develop, test, and deploy automation solutions using UiPath and Microsoft Power Automate, following CoE development standards and reusable component libraries. 
 - Build and orchestrate AI agents using Agent Core, UiPath Agentic Automation (agentic orchestration, agent-to-agent/human-in-the-loop workflows), and Microsoft Copilot Studio for goal-driven, autonomous or semi-autonomous process automation. 
 - Use GitHub Copilot (chat, inline completion, agent mode) to accelerate development, code review, and testing across automation and supporting application code. 
 - Assess incoming automation requests and recommend the right-fit solution (deterministic RPA bot vs. low-code Power Platform flow vs. AI agent vs. hybrid) based on process complexity, data variability, and exception handling needs. 
 - Integrate automations with enterprise systems via APIs, databases, message queues, and connectors; manage credentials/secrets securely (vault integration, least-privilege access). 
 - Implement AI components where required: document/IDP processing, LLM-based reasoning steps, prompt design, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns for knowledge-grounded agents. 
 - Apply governance, security, and responsible-AI practices: exception handling, logging/observability, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, data privacy, and bias/hallucination mitigation for agentic components. 
 - Participate in solution design reviews (PDD/SDD), UAT, hypercare, and production support/incident triage for deployed bots and agents. 
 - Maintain documentation for developed solutions, including agent decision logic, guardrails, and rollback/fallback procedures. 
 - Collaborate with Solution Leads/Architects on scalability, CI/CD pipeline integration, and CoE standards adoption; mentor junior developers on both RPA and agentic development practices. 
 - Stay current on platform releases (UiPath, Agent Core, Microsoft Power Platform/Copilot, GitHub Copilot) and recommend adoption of new capabilities.

 - Understanding of GenAI/LLM fundamentals: prompt engineering, tokens/context windows, RAG concepts, and where AI agents outperform (or underperform) deterministic bots.

FalconX is a pioneering team of operators, investors, and builders committed to revolutionizing institutional access to the crypto markets. Operating at the intersection of traditional finance and cutting-edge technology, FalconX addresses the industry's foremost challenges: Navigating the digital asset market can be complex and fragmented, with limited products and services that support trading strategies, structures, and liquidity found in conventional financial markets. As a comprehensive solution for all digital asset strategies from start to scale, FalconX operates as the connective tissue empowering clients with seamless navigation through the ever-evolving cryptocurrency landscape. 

Role Overview

As an Engineering Manager for the Credit team, you will lead the core engine driving our credit systems, including the margin notification engine and loan booking system. Your primary focus will be on maximizing data accuracy, system reliability, and architectural integrity. You will lead a high-performing group of senior engineers, stream-lining technical processes, preventing over-engineering, and maintaining a high standard of delivery alongside key stakeholders. 

Role Split & Focus Areas

- Technical Leadership & Architecture (40%): Drive long-term system maintenance, architectural refactoring, and code quality. Ensure technical debt is addressed without blocking impactful business features. 
 - Process & Stakeholder Management (20-30%): Partner with product and business stakeholders to prioritize deliverables. Make decisive trade-offs and cut unnecessary overhead to maintain lean execution. 
 - People Management & Mentorship (20-30%): Manage, mentor, and guide senior technical talent across performance cycles, career growth, and talent acquisition. 

Key Responsibilities

- Oversee and maintain the reliability, precision, and efficiency of core credit applications (Margin Notification Engine, Loan Booking Systems). 
 - Drive architectural roadmap decisions, prioritizing refactoring and system longevity alongside product requirements. 
 - Streamline engineering workflows by removing friction, cutting redundant work, and avoiding over-engineered solutions. 
 - Integrate modern development tools, including AI tools, into daily engineering processes to boost overall team efficiency. 
 - Direct a team of senior technical professionals across performance reviews, hiring, retention, and team alignment. 

Requirements & Qualifications

- People Leadership: Minimum of 2-3 years of hands-on people management experience, having led teams through performance cycles, hiring, and retention management. 
 - Technical Background: Strong engineering foundation in backend systems, with primary proficiency in Python. 
 - Pragmatic Execution: Proven ability to make decisive calls on technical scope, feature trade-offs, and pragmatic engineering solutions. 
 - Domain Expertise (Preferred): Prior experience scaling lending businesses or working within fintech/credit domains. Candidates from high-throughput distributed systems backgrounds who demonstrate strong finance interest and fast learning agility will also be considered. 

Nice-to-Have: Previous experience or background in Product Management (~1 year). 

Notice at Collection and Privacy Policy

Applicants located in California and/or applying to a role based in California, please refer to our Notice at Collection and Privacy Policy here. 

Inclusivity Statement

FalconX is committed to building a diverse, inclusive, equitable, and safe workspace for all people. Our roles are intended for people from all walks of life. We encourage all those interested in applying to our organization to submit an application regardless if you are missing some of the listed background requirements, skills, or experiences!

As part of our commitment to inclusivity, FalconX would like to acknowledge that the EEOC survey has limited potential responses that you can select. For legal reasons, FalconX must use this language to align with federal requirements, however, we want to ensure that you are able to provide a response to our own voluntary survey questions about your identity that best aligns with your most true self. 

FalconX is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against an applicant or employee based on race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, citizenship, or any other legally-recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law. 

Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the Americans with Disabilities Act and other applicable state or local laws. A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on FalconX. Please inform FalconX's People team at recruiting@falconx. io, if you need assistance with participating in the application process.
