data.title: Senior Enterprise Cloud Software Engineer (Cloud Operations, AI Engineering, Azure & AWS)
data.description:
We are seeking a Senior Enterprise Cloud Software Engineer skilled in automation engineering, artificial intelligence, and cloud operations. This role represents a strategic evolution of two traditionally separate disciplines-Enterprise Cloud Software Development and Cloud Operations Engineering-into a single, high‐impact engineering role that designs, builds, and operates intelligent, automation‐first cloud platforms at enterprise scale. 

The Senior Enterprise Cloud Platform Engineer role redefines operations as software, embedding reliability, governance, security, and resilience directly into cloud services through code, automation, and AI‐assisted intelligence. 

You will help drive the future of cloud operations by creating programmable platforms, self‐healing systems, and AI‐augmented operational workflows across AWS and Azure, replacing manual toil with scalable, policy‐driven execution. 

Mission of the Role

- Transform Cloud Operations from reactive support into proactive, software‐defined platforms
 - Fuse software engineering rigor with operational ownership
 - Leverage automation, Infrastructure‐as‐Code, and AI to eliminate manual work at scale
 - Design systems that are secure, observable, resilient, and self‐optimizing by default
 - Act as a technical bridge between Engineering, Cloud Operations, Security, and Architecture

Technical Skills & Competencies

Enterprise Cloud Software Engineering

- Design and build enterprise‐grade cloud services, APIs, and automation platforms using a Python‐first stack (FastAPI/Django/Flask), with UI components where needed. 
 - Develop cloud‐native tooling and services using Azure and AWS SDKs to standardize provisioning, lifecycle management, and operational workflows. 
 - Apply modern software engineering practices: clean architecture, SOLID principles, automated testing, and CI/CD‐driven delivery. 
 - Design contract‐first APIs (REST/GraphQL) and event‐driven services to enable platform extensibility and integration. 

Cloud Operations Engineering (Software‐Defined)

- Own the full lifecycle of cloud platforms: design, build, operate, optimize, and decommission. 
 - Engineer automation‐first infrastructure operations, eliminating manual provisioning, patching, scaling, and recovery. 
 - Implement Infrastructure‐as‐Code frameworks using Terraform (modules, state management, drift detection) and supporting tools (Ansible, ARM/Bicep, CloudFormation). 
 - Build and operate high‐availability, fault‐tolerant, and disaster‐resilient architectures across hybrid and multi‐cloud environments. 
 - Lead L3/L4 troubleshooting, root‐cause analysis, and reliability improvements for complex cloud incidents. 

AI‐Driven & Intelligent Operations

- Apply AI‐assisted CloudOps practices including anomaly detection, predictive insights, event correlation, and automated remediation. 
 - Design and operate intelligent runbooks and AI agents that execute operational decisions safely and audibly. 
 - Integrate approved GenAI and ML services into operational workflows while adhering to governance and responsible AI standards. 
 - Use AI tools to accelerate development, testing, documentation, and operational analysis. 

DevOps, CI/CD & Governance

- Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and platform automation using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab. 
 - Implement policy‐as‐code, security guardrails, tagging standards, and cost‐optimization controls. 
 - Embed observability, APM, logging, and SLO/SLA practices into platforms from day one. 
 - Ensure platforms are built to be operable by design, not retrofitted for operations. 

Leadership & Engineering Influence

- Serve as a technical leader and mentor, elevating engineering and CloudOps maturity. 
 - Collaborate closely with Architecture, Security, Compliance, and Product teams. 
 - Establish standards, patterns, documentation, and reusable frameworks used across the enterprise. 
 - Drive continuous improvement, reliability engineering, and operational excellence. 

Required Qualifications

Education: 

- Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related field

Experience

- More than 5 years of Cloud Operations, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineering
 - Hands-on experience in AI-based automation is highly desirable. 
 - Proven experience operating large-scale AWS and Azure environments

Certifications: 

- Advanced certification in AWS and Azure will be preferred. 
 - Terraform Associate
 - AI or ML Certification

Core Technical Expertise

- Deep hands‐on experience in AWS and Azure at enterprise scale
 - Strong proficiency in Python and scripting for automation and platform development
 - Advanced Terraform expertise with modular, reusable, enterprise‐grade designs
 - Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, AKS, EKS)
 - Strong understanding of networking, identity, security, and cloud governance
 - Experience with CI/CD, release management, and platform operationalization

AI & Advanced Automation

- Practical experience applying AI to operational workflows
 - Understanding of AI fundamentals, safe usage, and lifecycle governance
 - Ability to design AI‐assisted automation without compromising reliability or compliance

Engineering Mindset

- Strong architectural thinking and systems design skills
 - Passion for eliminating toil through code
 - Ability to operate independently while influencing across teams
 - Excellent communication and documentation skills

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we're getting to know you-not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process. 

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
About SkySpecs

At SkySpecs, our mission is to simplify renewable asset management so that less can do more for the planet. SkySpecs is helping to make this possible by automating the operations and maintenance of wind farms using advanced robotics paired with our custom-built asset performance management software, Horizon. 

SkySpecs launched the world's first completely autonomous blade inspection product in 2016 with a custom-designed drone system. Since then, SkySpecs has inspected over 90% of the US wind turbines and expanded globally, becoming the world leader in understanding the health of turbine blades. Identifying issues with turbine blades is only the first step. In 2019, SkySpecs launched Horizon, a platform for SkySpecs to offer a multi-layered solution for customers that includes: data collection, wind turbine blade engineering expertise, and a place for all stakeholders to collaborate to manage and analyze massive amounts of data, spot trends, and create plans for high-cost repair campaigns. In 2021, SkySpecs acquired two companies specializing in wind turbine drivetrain monitoring and financial management, further expanding our asset management portfolio. Ultimately, this will help reduce the cost and risk of operations for the industry. 

What will you be getting into?

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help shape the future of our Horizon platform and the way we build software. Horizon is the platform behind SkySpecs' wind and solar inspection and asset-management business, and the work is hands-on, building end-to-end. 

As the cost of producing code falls, an engineer's impact comes more than ever from judgment, design, and outcomes, not volume. AI is central to how we work here, and we treat it as serious leverage: a force multiplier for engineers who already have strong instincts, not a substitute for them. We expect everyone to keep pushing what AI, automation, and agents make possible, and to bring the judgment that makes that leverage pay off. 

We do not separate thinking from doing. You will be expected to independently take broad, highly ambiguous problem statements, formulate scalable technical solutions, and participate directly in delivery by writing and owning production code. We value a founder's mindset; the people closest to the work are expected to challenge assumptions, optimize proposed approaches, and actively engineer high-impact business outcomes. 

This is a full-stack engineering role. While engineers may develop areas of deeper expertise, we expect everyone to be capable of working across frontend, backend, infrastructure, data, and developer tooling as needed to deliver outcomes. We value engineers who can understand the entire system, formulate end-to-end solutions, and contribute wherever the work requires. 

Our platform is built using AWS, GitLab, Auth0, Grafana, Terraform, Kafka, Node. js, Nest. js, TypeScript, Apollo GraphQL, React, Ant Design, Vitest, Playwright, and PostgreSQL. 

IN A GIVEN WEEK, YOU WILL: 

[15%] Work with product managers, customers, internal users, and other engineers to understand requirements, constraints, and desired outcomes. 

[10%] Formulate solutions, evaluate tradeoffs, and break work into executable milestones and implementation plans. 

[55%] Build and ship software: 

- Authoring and infrastructure as code. 
 - Designing and implementing new services and APIs. 
 - Building reusable user experiences and workflows. 
 - Improving reliability, performance, security, and developer productivity. 
 - Reviewing code generated by peers and by agents
 - Leveraging AI tools and autonomous agents to accelerate delivery. [20%] Improve Horizon, our engineering systems, and the way we work. Examples include: 

- Building internal tooling and automation. 
 - Improving documentation and architectural clarity. 
 - Reducing operational toil. 
 - Expanding AI and agent capabilities. 
 - Improving testing, observability, and deployment workflows. 
 - Exploring new ideas, experiments, and prototypes that could improve Horizon or the way we build software. 

Success is measured by outcomes delivered, not lines of code written. 

Requirements/Core Expectations: 

- 7+ years of experience designing, shipping, and operating production software systems. 
 - A proven track record of operating with absolute self-direction-capable of taking a loosely defined, high-level mandate and driving it to production with minimal to no supervision. 
 - Experience navigating the fast-paced, evolving environments typical of early-stage companies, scaling startups, or operating as a founding engineer. 
 - Growth & Leadership Readiness: While this role begins as an elite Individual Contributor, you possess the communication skills, high emotional intelligence (EQ), and mentoring instincts required to anchor, build, and formally lead an engineering team as the organization scales. 
 - Mastery of modern backend systems (e. g. , Node. js/TypeScript, Python, or Go) coupled with significant frontend architectural experience (e. g. , React, Angular, Vue). 
 - Advanced Infrastructure Experience: Direct production experience provisioning cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP) using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation). 
 - AI Integration Mastery: Deep familiarity with AI-assisted and agentic development workflows, with a strong internal compass for auditing, correcting, and securing agent-generated outputs. 

Bonus Points for: 

- Familiarity with our stack: AWS, GitLab, Auth0, Grafana, Terraform, Kafka, Node. js, Nest. js, TypeScript, Apollo GraphQL, React, Ant Design, Vitest, Playwright, and PostgreSQL. 
 - Experience building internal platforms, developer tooling, or automation systems. 
 - Experience operating distributed systems at scale. 
 - Background in utility-scale energy generation, emphasis on renewables

What We Value: 

- Own outcomes, not assignments: You focus on the final business value delivered, not just closing out tickets.

data.description:
Job Description

Job Description: 

Job Title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Engineering Manager to join our Defined Benefits (DB) Technology team in the Workplace Investing Technology Business Unit. In this role, you will be accountable for driving new client implementations, corporate action changes for existing clients, and ongoing maintenance of the Defined Benefits Calculation Engine-the core platform that computes participant pension benefits across a wide range of plan types, formulas, and regulatory requirements. You will be accountable for driving engineering execution, elevating technical craftsmanship, and developing strong, high-performing engineering teams that deliver accurate, timely, and compliant pension outcomes for our clients and their participants. 

We are looking for someone committed to developing both their own technical expertise and the expertise of those around them-bringing modern engineering thinking, innovation, and continuous improvement to the organization. This role is ideal for an engineering-focused leader who thrives on building world-class teams, strengthening engineering discipline, and delivering the complex, calculation-intensive platforms that serve as foundational capabilities for the Defined Benefits business. 

The Purpose of Your Role

As an engineering manager, you will combine deep technical and DB domain expertise with a passion for mentoring, coaching, and growing engineering talent. You will partner closely with other engineering teams, solution architecture, product owners, and pension benefit consultants (actuarial and plan-provision experts) to shape technical direction, translate complex plan rules and benefit formulas into robust engineering solutions, implement client-specific configurations, and ensure the teams you lead are aligned on the engineering approaches, standards, and best practices that guide how work gets done. You will be a steward of calculation accuracy, auditability, and regulatory compliance across the DB platform. 

The Value You Deliver

- Align engineering talent, skills, and team composition with DB platform strategy and priorities-enabling scalable, secure, and reliable pension calculation capabilities. 
 - Own engineering execution of new client implementations and corporate actions-mergers, spin-offs, freezes, amendments-delivering accurate, well-tested, auditable calculation outcomes on schedule. 
 - Mentor and empower engineers and managers to deepen expertise in Java, Spring Boot, distributed systems, cloud, and the DB calculation domain. 
 - Drive an agile, learning-oriented organization that embraces continuous improvement while respecting the rigor, traceability, and controls of a regulated pension environment. 
 - Champion engineering excellence-high standards for reliability, performance, resilience, security, calculation accuracy, and craftsmanship across all DB platform teams. 
 - Build trusted relationships with architecture, SRE, product leaders, and pension benefit consultants to align on platform strategy, technical direction, and execution. 
 - Lead adoption of modern engineering approaches-cloud-native architectures, DevOps, event-driven and distributed systems patterns, and AI/ML where applicable to DB calculations. 

The Skills That Are Key To This Role

- Strong Java/Spring Boot engineering abilities and experience guiding teams in modern service architecture, ideally applied to calculation-intensive or rules-driven financial systems. 
 - Knowledge of cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes orchestration, and containerization. 
 - Strong operational engineering skills-observability, reliability engineering, incident response, and performance tuning-with sensitivity to the accuracy, auditability, and controls required for pension calculations. 
 - Ability to lead complex client implementations and corporate action changes end to end-balancing delivery timelines, regulatory compliance, data quality, and calculation correctness. 
 - Ability to translate complex plan provisions, benefit formulas, and actuarial/regulatory requirements (e. g. , IRS/ERISA-driven rules) into accurate, testable calculation-engine logic and sound engineering controls. 
 - Systems thinking and deep problem-solving across interconnected ecosystems-benefit calculation logic, plan rules, and downstream payment flows-backed by rigorous test strategies (regression suites, parallel/shadow runs, reconciliation before go-live). 
 - Excellent communication and partnership skills with architecture, SRE, product teams, and pension benefit consultants, paired with a continuous learning mindset across cloud, AI, and platform modernization. 

The Expertise We're Looking For

- Deep domain knowledge of Defined Benefits, specifically the Calculation Engine, DBCS, and Workbook components, including benefit formulas, eligibility/vesting rules, plan provisions, and pension payment options. 
 - Hands-on understanding of new client implementation lifecycles and corporate actions-plan onboarding, amendments, mergers, acquisitions, spin-offs, freezes, and de-risking events-and how they translate into calculation-engine changes. 
 - Deep engineering expertise building and scaling platform capabilities, shared services, and foundational enterprise technologies, with advanced proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, and modern integration frameworks. 
 - Demonstrated leadership experience guiding software engineers and engineering managers, providing mentorship, technical coaching, and career development to build high-performing teams. 
 - 10+ years of hands-on software engineering experience with a strong command of agile delivery, iterative development practices, and robust CI/CD pipelines enabling reliable and automated deployments. 
 - Extensive experience designing and operating cloud-native platforms, with strong knowledge of AWS or Azure services and container orchestration (e. g. , Kubernetes), plus experience with AI-based coding productivity tools such as GitHub Copilot and LLM-enabled development workflows. 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or related technical field, demonstrating a solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, systems design, and core engineering principles. 

How Your Work Impacts The Organization

Workplace Investing Technology helps our customers save and invest through workplace retirement savings plans, build lifetime relationships with customers and provide employers with cost-effective, integrated employee benefit solutions. WI serves customers online, over the phone, and through a nationwide network of investor centers. WI is also committed to helping drive employee retirement readiness by delivering leading-edge financial solutions to employers, including recordkeeping, cash management products and services and personal advisory services (PAS).

Job Title: Lead Wet Utilities Engineer

Role Overview: 

We are seeking a Lead Wet Utilities Engineer to lead the planning, design, and delivery of wet utilities systems for major infrastructure and industrial developments, including roads, rail, ports, and container terminals. The role covers stormwater and foul drainage, pressurised water networks (potable, firefighting, irrigation), pumping stations, water storage tanks, and hydrology / flood studies. The successful candidate will manage multidisciplinary design teams, ensure technical excellence, and provide strategic input to master planning and project delivery. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead the end-to-end wet utilities design for major infrastructure and industrial projects, from concept through detailed design to IFC, including drainage, water supply, firefighting and irrigation systems, and associated pumping stations and reservoirs. 
 - Direct and review hydrology and hydraulic analyses to establish design flows, HFLs, catchment delineation, flood risk assessments, and flood protection measures, including the use of 1D/2D hydraulic models. 
 - Oversee hydraulic modelling and design of pressurised water networks and drainage networks (open channels, ditches, culverts, piped systems), including surge analysis, transient analysis, pump duty calculations, and system curve development. 
 - Lead preparation and approval of technical deliverables: design reports, drawings, hydraulic models, specifications, data sheets, bills of quantities, and tender documentation to meet project, client, and international code requirements. 
 - Coordinate closely with highways, rail, structures, electrical, mechanical, architectural, and environmental teams to ensure fully integrated wet utilities solutions and conflict-free layouts in complex corridors and industrial facilities. 
 - Provide technical leadership for drainage and water master planning, including system performance reviews, development assessments, operational scenario planning, and long-term capacity planning. 
 - Ensure compliance with relevant international and local standards and guidelines for water, wastewater, stormwater and flood management, and support interface with authorities for approvals. 
 - Support project managers with scope definition, fee estimates, schedules, risk registers and change management for wet utilities work packages; monitor progress, quality, and budget utilisation. 
 - Lead, mentor, and technically develop a team of wet utilities, drainage, water and hydrology engineers, including review of work, knowledge sharing, and support to training plans. 
 - Participate in client meetings, technical workshops, and design reviews; present technical solutions and defend design decisions in a clear and professional manner. 

Experience and Qualifications: 

- Experience: Typically, 14-15 years of experience in wet utilities engineering, with significant exposure to large-scale infrastructure or industrial projects (e. g. highways, rail, ports, container terminals, industrial cities), including leadership of multidisciplinary design teams

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree in civil engineering, Environmental Engineering, or Process Engineering. 
 - Master's degree in water resources, Hydraulics, or a related field is preferred

Technical Skills: 

- Strong expertise in design of stormwater and foul drainage, culverts, channels, pressurised water networks, firefighting and irrigation systems, pumping stations, reservoirs, and water storage tanks. 
 - Advanced proficiency in hydraulic and hydrologic modelling software such as Bentley SewerGEMS/StormCAD, WaterGEMS/WaterCAD, WaterHAMMER, HEC-HMS, HEC-RAS, and related tools; experience with surge/transient analysis is an advantage. 
 - Competence in Autodesk Civil 3D and AutoCAD for alignment, corridor and utilities modelling, and in GIS platforms for catchment delineation and flood hazard mapping.

data.title: Founding Backend/Systems Engineer
data.description:
About REM Labs

REM Labs is building an autonomous software delivery platform that executes engineering workflows end to end with enterprise-grade reliability, control, and governance. 

As AI systems begin participating directly in engineering workflows, the hard problem is no longer output generation or agent orchestration. It is reliable execution, safety, and explainability. 

We are building the execution infrastructure that makes this possible. 

Role Overview

We are hiring a Founding Backend/Systems Engineer to help build the core execution systems powering REM. 

This is a deeply technical founding engineering role focused on backend systems, execution infrastructure, workflow orchestration, distributed state management, integrations, and runtime reliability. 

You will work directly with the founder and early engineering team to design and build the systems that allow autonomous engineering workflows to execute safely across real enterprise environments. 

This is not a conventional CRUD backend role. 

The problems involve long-running execution workflows, distributed coordination, failure recovery, retries, state management, system integrations, execution guarantees, and observability. 

We are looking for engineers who are strong builders, think in systems, and enjoy solving hard infrastructure problems with real operational complexity. 

What You Will Work OnExecution Infrastructure

Build backend systems that orchestrate autonomous engineering workflows across tools, services, and enterprise systems. 

Workflow Orchestration

Design execution flows involving multi-step task coordination, retries, compensation handling, state transitions, and execution guarantees. 

State and Context Management

Build systems for execution state persistence, workflow context handling, execution history, and runtime continuity. 

Enterprise Integrations

Build reliable integrations with Git providers, CI/CD systems, issue trackers, cloud infrastructure, identity systems, and developer tooling. 

Reliability Engineering

Design mechanisms for failure recovery, idempotency, retries, partial failure isolation, and operational resilience. 

Runtime Observability

Build visibility into execution state, audit trails, debugging workflows, telemetry, and operational introspection. 

Enterprise Integrations & Execution Adapters

Build the integration layer that connects REM with enterprise systems including engineering tools, CI/CD platforms, identity systems, observability infrastructure, ticketing systems, and internal enterprise APIs through scalable connector and adapter abstractions. 

Platform Foundations

Help shape engineering abstractions, platform architecture, implementation standards, and long-term technical direction. 

What We Are Looking For

Typically 7-15 years of hands-on software engineering experience building production backend, infrastructure, or distributed systems. 

Strong candidates typically have meaningful experience across several of the following: 

- backend engineering in Python, Go, Java, or similar systems languages
 - distributed systems and concurrent execution models
 - workflow orchestration or execution systems
 - platform engineering or backend infrastructure
 - stateful backend systems
 - production APIs and service architecture
 - connector frameworks, adapter systems, and enterprise API integrations
 - observability, reliability engineering, and failure handling
 - cloud-native infrastructure and modern engineering tooling

Experience with developer infrastructure, CI/CD systems, internal platforms, execution engines, or workflow systems is a strong plus. Exposure to AI systems, agent runtimes, or autonomous execution systems is a plus, but not mandatory. 

We care far more about systems engineering depth, execution thinking, and engineering quality. 

What Success Looks Like

In the first few months, success means: 

- building core execution infrastructure that powers REM's autonomous workflows
 - improving orchestration reliability, execution correctness, and failure handling
 - contributing to critical architectural decisions across the platform
 - shipping production-grade backend systems with strong operational quality
 - collaborating closely with the founding engineering team
 - participating in technical architecture discussions where needed

Over time, this role is expected to evolve into a major technical leadership position as the platform scales. 

Team Culture

We value: 

- first-principles thinking
 - strong engineering judgment
 - wicked smart energy
 - design thinking and product craftsmanship
 - high agency
 - low ego collaboration
 - intellectual honesty
 - building durable systems over short-term hacks

This is a founding-stage environment. Problems are ambiguous, constraints evolve quickly, and many patterns do not yet exist.

data.title: Senior AI QA Engineer
data.description:
Opportunity

As a Senior AI QA Engineer, you will go beyond traditional functional testing. You will be responsible for building the framework that ensures our clinical insights are accurate, safe, and reliable. This role requires a unique blend of high-level software testing and data engineering to validate complex, non-deterministic medical outputs using a hybrid of automated grading methodologies. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architect Multi-Layered Validation Frameworks: Design and implement structured testing strategies that combine deterministic checks, semantic similarity metrics, and model-based evaluations. 
 - Automated Model Grading: Develop systems to evaluate clinical pipeline outputs for faithfulness, safety, and hallucination detection using various automated scoring techniques (e. g. , BERTScore, ROUGE, or custom heuristics). 
 - Vibe-Driven Development: Leverage agentic AI tools to rapidly prototype complex test harnesses, "red-team" clinical logic, and build internal validation utilities at high velocity. 
 - Data Pipeline Integrity: Execute integration and regression tests for data-heavy backend processes, ensuring medical data remains consistent from ingestion to insight generation. 
 - Collaborative Strategy: Work closely with Data Scientists and Product Managers to define "Ground Truth" datasets and clinical evaluation rubrics. 
 - Root Cause Analysis: Deep-dive into complex system failures to identify whether issues stem from code logic, data drift, or model behavior. 

Requirements

- 6+ years of technical experience in Quality Assurance, with a strong focus on system architecture and backend data validation. 
 - Advanced Python Proficiency: Expert-level skills in Python for building custom test scripts and working within AI/ML ecosystems. 
 - AI/ML Validation Experience: Proven experience testing model outputs using diverse metrics (e. g. , Semantic Similarity, NLP metrics, and custom scoring algorithms). Familiarity with tools like LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or MLflow. 
 - Vibe Coding Mastery: Proficiency with AI-native development tools such as Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code. 
 - Modern Automation Stack: Proficiency with frameworks like PyTest, and experience with traditional tools (Cypress, Playwright, or Selenium) for end-to-end flows. 
 - API & Data Testing: Solid understanding of API testing (Postman/RestAssured) and database validation (SQL/NoSQL). 
 - Strategic Thinking: Experience serving as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on test process development for large-scale systems. 

Preferred (Good To Have)

- Clinical Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with healthcare data standards such as FHIR, HL7, or SNOMED CT. 
 - Healthcare Compliance: Understanding of HIPAA regulations and the nuances of handling ePHI/PHI. 
 - Statistical Foundation: Understanding of sensitivity, specificity, and F1-scores in a clinical context. 

About GW RhythmX

GW RhythmX is revolutionizing healthcare through connected, AI-native intelligence that unites clinical insight, patient engagement, and system-wide care orchestration. The company combines market-leading AI precision care technology with extensive trusted patient engagement leadership to help health systems deliver the right care, at the right time, through the right clinician and channel. Its solutions are deployed across more than 150 health systems, touching more than 85M patients including 8M U. S. military veterans. 

The company's award-winning solutions were recognized again in 2024 by KLAS Research, Fierce Healthcare, and AVIA Marketplace. A SymphonyAI Group company, GW RhythmX leverages various firm assets, including $1B+ in R&D investment, longitudinal data related to 300 million patients, 4. 4 billion total annual claims, and 1. 8 million healthcare professionals at more than 3, 000 facilities globally. 

GW RhythmX is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age or veteran status.

Detailed Job Description

Senior Java Azure Cloud Engineer

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior Java Azure Cloud Engineer to design, develop, test, deploy, and support scalable cloud-based applications. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in Java 17/21, Spring Boot 3. x, microservices, REST APIs, Azure Cloud, Azure DevOps, SQL, and automated testing. 

The selected professional will work across the complete application lifecycle, including technical design, backend development, code quality, cloud deployment, production monitoring, performance improvement, and incident resolution. The role also involves collaboration with business, engineering, testing, DevOps, and support teams in an Agile environment. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Application Design and Development

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications using Java 17/21 and Spring Boot 3. x. 
 - Build secure, reliable, and high-performing microservices and RESTful APIs. 
 - Apply object-oriented programming concepts, SOLID principles, reusable design patterns, and clean coding standards. 
 - Participate in technical design discussions and convert functional requirements into appropriate technical solutions. 
 - Develop maintainable application components with proper exception handling, logging, validation, and documentation. 
 - Use modern Java capabilities such as Records, Switch Expressions, Streams, Text Blocks, and Pattern Matching where appropriate. 2. Microservices and API Engineering

- Design independently deployable microservices with clearly defined responsibilities. 
 - Develop REST APIs following API-first design principles. 
 - Maintain API specifications using OpenAPI/Swagger. 
 - Implement standardized error handling using Spring Boot capabilities such as @ControllerAdvice and @ExceptionHandler. 
 - Integrate applications with internal and external services using technologies such as WebClient or Feign Client. 
 - Support asynchronous and event-driven integrations using Kafka or Azure Service Bus, where required. 
 - Apply appropriate API security methods, including OAuth2 or mutual TLS, based on application requirements. 3. Azure Cloud Deployment and Management

- Deploy, configure, and support Java applications within the Microsoft Azure environment. 
 - Work with applicable Azure services such as Azure App Service, Azure Key Vault, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Event Hub, and Azure Service Bus. 
 - Ensure application configuration and secrets are handled securely. 
 - Support environment-specific application configurations using Spring Profiles and configuration files. 
 - Contribute to infrastructure automation using Terraform or ARM templates, where applicable. 
 - Identify opportunities for Azure resource optimization and efficient cloud usage. 4. CI/CD and Source-Code Management

- Build, maintain, and improve automated deployment pipelines using Azure DevOps. 
 - Manage source code using Azure Repos and Git. 
 - Follow effective branching, pull-request, and peer-review practices. 
 - Integrate code-quality, security, dependency, and license checks into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Work with tools such as SonarQube, Fortify, and Nexus IQ, where available. 
 - Ensure that unit and integration tests are automatically executed as part of the deployment pipeline. 
 - Support controlled deployments across development, testing, and production environments. 5. Automated Testing and Quality Engineering

- Develop comprehensive unit tests using JUnit 5 and Mockito. 
 - Create integration tests using Spring Boot Test. 
 - Support behaviour-driven or API testing using Cucumber, where required. 
 - Maintain testable code through dependency injection, modular design, and proper separation of concerns. 
 - Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to defined coding and testing standards. 
 - Investigate defects, perform root-cause analysis, and deliver sustainable fixes. 
 - Contribute to application performance or load testing using tools such as JMeter, where applicable. 6. Database Development and Performance Optimization

- Design and develop database interactions using SQL and Spring Data JPA. 
 - Write and optimize SQL queries for relational databases, including Azure SQL. 
 - Review query execution plans and identify table scans, inefficient joins, or indexing issues. 
 - Address common ORM performance concerns such as the N+1 query problem. 
 - Apply appropriate indexing, batch-processing, transaction-management, and connection-pooling practices. 
 - Configure and optimize database connection pools such as HikariCP. 
 - Use optimistic or pessimistic locking where needed to maintain data consistency. 
 - Support large-scale data processing through Spring Batch or JDBC batching when appropriate. 7. Monitoring and Production Support

- Monitor application availability, performance, errors, and dependencies using Azure Monitor and Application Insights. 
 - Review logs, distributed traces, live application metrics, and KQL-based monitoring information. 
 - Provide advanced production support and troubleshoot complex application or performance issues. 
 - Perform root-cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Support alert configuration for application failures, high resource utilization, memory issues, and increased server errors. 
 - Identify slow queries, application bottlenecks, and inefficient resource usage. 
 - Recommend improvements related to application performance, reliability, scalability, and Azure cost utilization. 8. Agile Delivery and Collaboration

- Participate actively in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, refinement, reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Collaborate with product owners, architects, developers, testers, DevOps engineers, and support teams. 
 - Clarify functional requirements and contribute to technical specifications. 
 - Provide technical guidance and constructive feedback during design and code reviews. 
 - Maintain clear technical documentation for APIs, application components, deployment processes, and operational support. Take end-to-end ownership of assigned deliverables and communicate risks or dependencies clearly. Mandatory Technical Skills

- Strong hands-on development experience with Java 17 or Java 21.

 - Strong SQL knowledge, including query development and performance optimization. 
 - Knowledge of application monitoring, troubleshooting, and production support.

data.title: AI Test Architect
data.description:
Driven by the passion to improve quality of people's lives, WS Audiology continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively. 

We're looking for an AI Test Architect to define, implement, and scale the next generation of quality engineering powered by AI. You will own the test architecture strategy end-to-end-combining LLM-driven automation, computer vision, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) systems-to deliver robust, scalable, and privacy-first testing for mobile applications and hardware-integrated products. 

This is a senior, hands-on architecture role: you'll set the strategy, establish standards, lead technical decision-making, and build reusable platforms and frameworks while mentoring teams across QA, Dev, and DevOps. 

What You'll Do

- AI Test Strategy & Architecture
 - Define and maintain the enterprise test architecture, roadmap, and standards spanning functional, non-functional, integration, mobile, and HIL layers. 
 - Drive a shift-left and automation-first culture; architect frameworks that are modular, resilient, and easy to evolve. 
 - Establish test design principles, risk-based testing approaches, and coverage models aligned with business goals and compliance requirements. 
 - Lead architecture reviews and decision forums; evaluate build vs. buy for AI tooling and frameworks. 
 - AI-Driven Test Innovation (LLMs, RAG, CV/OCR)
 - Architect and implement RAG-based test generation using local LLMs (e. g. , Ollama, llama. cpp) and frameworks like LangChain/LlamaIndex to reason over requirements, app states, and logs. 
 - Build AI agents that can: interpret acceptance criteria, propose and prioritize test scenarios, and auto-generate test cases/scripts. 
 - Develop computer-vision and OCR pipelines (OpenCV, Tesseract, or equivalent) for precise UI validation, visual diffing, and visual regression analysis. 
 - Design models for UI anomaly detection, flakiness prediction, and self-healing locators beyond traditional Appium-style selectors. 
 - Automate localization testing for text, layout, and formatting across languages and screen sizes using AI. 
 - Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) & Mobile Systems
 - Define and evolve a Python-based HIL framework for end-to-end validation of Mobile/Desktop/WebApp interacting with hardware (e. g. , medical devices, sensors, wearables). 
 - Architect communication interfaces (USB, Bluetooth, Serial) and test harnesses to control/observe device interactions reliably at scale. 
 - Incorporate AI-driven adapters that learn device behaviors, detect drift, and improve robustness of HIL scenarios over time.

data.title: Head of Software Engineering Edge Platform
data.description:
Head of Software Engineering

Tesco Technology | Bengaluru, India

About the role

Tesco operates a large, geographically distributed retail estate where technology is

fundamental to the day-to-day running of our stores. Critical retail capabilities, including

checkout, payments, stock management and colleague-facing applications, depend on

technology that must operate reliably at the edge, close to where our business operates. 

The Edge Platform provides the underlying computing environment and software capabilities

that enable applications to run across our stores. It encompasses edge computing, server

hardware, Linux operating systems, virtualisation, storage, platform software, infrastructure

automation and centralised management capabilities required to deploy, operate, secure and

maintain technology consistently across a diverse retail estate. 

The Edge Platform is business-critical to Tesco. Store technology must remain dependable

despite connectivity disruptions, constrained local resources and the complexity of managing

software and infrastructure changes across thousands of locations. Failures or poorly executed

changes can directly affect store operations, colleague productivity and customer experience. 

As Head of Software Engineering: Edge Platform, you will lead two major, interconnected

engineering priorities: modernising Tesco's edge virtualisation estate through the migration

from VMware to Proxmox, and building a robust, scalable software-driven Edge Management

Platform to provision, manage, monitor and maintain the retail edge estate throughout its

lifecycle. 

You will define the technology strategy and architecture, lead complex engineering and

migration programmes, and build a high-performing engineering organisation. You will combine

deep software engineering expertise with infrastructure knowledge, strategic thinking and

organisational leadership to simplify complexity, improve resilience, drive automation and

deliver a scalable, secure and cost-efficient platform for the future of Tesco's stores. 

This role requires a leader who can move seamlessly between enterprise-level strategy and

detailed technical decisions, balancing the safe execution of a large-scale infrastructure

transition with the long-term development of a modern software platform. 

Key responsibilities

1. Technology strategy and architecture

• Define and execute the Edge Platform engineering strategy, target architecture and

modernisation roadmap, aligned with Tesco's wider technology objectives. 

• Lead the evolution of the platform across edge computing, server hardware, Linux, 

virtualisation, storage, distributed systems and platform software, balancing reliability, 

scalability, security, cost and maintainability. 

• Establish architectural principles, engineering standards and reusable capabilities that

simplify the technology landscape and enable consistent operation across the retail

estate. 

• Make sound architectural decisions, challenge technical assumptions and balance

immediate delivery commitments with long-term platform sustainability. 

• Partner with enterprise and domain architects to ensure the Edge Platform integrates

effectively with wider infrastructure, cloud, network, security and store technology

capabilities. 

2. Virtualisation modernisation: VMware to Proxmox

• Own the engineering strategy and execution of Tesco's migration from VMware to

Proxmox across the edge estate, delivering a secure, reliable and cost-effective

alternative virtualisation platform. 

• Define the target architecture, migration patterns and repeatable build configurations

for different store environments, accounting for hardware compatibility, workloads, 

networking, storage and operational constraints. 

• Lead the assessment, design, engineering, testing and production validation of platform

variants before progressive rollout across the retail estate. 

• Establish automated approaches for hypervisor provisioning, configuration, workload

migration, upgrade management, validation, rollback and recovery. 

• Manage migration dependencies, technical risks, compatibility challenges and cross

functional delivery, ensuring changes are introduced safely without compromising

critical store operations. 

• Establish clear engineering ownership, documentation, knowledge transfer and

operational handover so the platform can be sustainably supported and evolved by

Tesco teams. 

3. Edge Management Platform engineering

• Lead the design and development of a robust, software-driven Edge Management

Platform that provides centralised management and lifecycle control of Tesco's

distributed edge estate. 

• Define a modular, API-first architecture that enables automated provisioning, 

configuration management, fleet inventory, health monitoring, software distribution, 

patching, upgrades and remote diagnostics. 

• Drive engineering across Java, Micronaut, microservices, REST APIs, Python

automation, Terraform and Infrastructure as Code, applying appropriate technologies

and architectural patterns to build maintainable, scalable platform capabilities. 

• Establish consistent abstractions and automation for managing different hardware

configurations, Linux environments, virtualisation platforms and store deployment

patterns. 

• Design for scale, resilience and intermittent connectivity, including safe handling of

disconnected stores, asynchronous operations, configuration drift, failed deployments

and recovery scenarios. 

• Build in observability, auditability, security controls, role-based access and policy

driven configuration to enable reliable and secure fleet-wide operations. 

• Create reusable platform services and self-service capabilities that reduce manual

effort, simplify store technology operations and enable consuming engineering teams to

deploy and manage workloads consistently. 

• Ensure the management platform evolves independently of individual infrastructure

technologies wherever practical, reducing future migration complexity and supporting

long-term technology flexibility. 

4. Software engineering and automation

• Set high engineering standards across software design, development, testing, 

deployment and production operations. 

• Champion automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure provisioning, configuration

management and observability to improve engineering productivity, release confidence

and operational consistency. 

• Establish repeatable approaches for building, testing, deploying and upgrading platform

software and infrastructure across diverse store environments. 

• Ensure software and infrastructure are designed for maintainability, resilience and

predictable operation, including stores with constrained resources or intermittent

connectivity. 

• Promote continuous improvement in engineering quality, developer productivity, 

deployment safety and operational efficiency. 

5. Engineering and people leadership

• Lead and develop a high-performing engineering organisation through Engineering

Managers, Principal Engineers and senior technical leaders. 

• Build the capabilities required to deliver both the virtualisation migration and the long

term Edge Management Platform roadmap, maintaining clear ownership and delivery

accountability across workstreams. 

• Establish a culture of engineering excellence, technical curiosity, collaboration, 

ownership and continuous improvement. 

• Develop engineering leaders, strengthen succession planning and build sustainable

internal expertise in edge computing, virtualisation, platform software and automation. 

• Empower teams to make decisions and deliver independently while maintaining clear

architectural standards and engineering governance. 

6. Reliability and operational excellence

• Drive platform reliability, security, resilience and operational readiness across the retail

estate. 

• Establish repeatable approaches for hardware and firmware lifecycle management, 

Linux upgrades, virtualisation maintenance, storage management, patching and

recovery. 

• Ensure platform releases and migration waves are thoroughly tested, progressively

deployed and supported by effective rollback and recovery strategies. 

• Establish service-level objectives, fleet health monitoring and operational metrics to

improve availability, incident recovery and service quality. 

• Partner with Infrastructure Operations, Cyber Security and Store Technology teams to

ensure the platform meets business-critical operational and security requirements. 

7. Strategic execution and commercial outcomes

• Translate business priorities into clear engineering roadmaps, investment plans, 

milestones and measurable outcomes. 

• Lead complex, cross-functional programmes, managing dependencies, risks and

competing priorities across engineering, architecture, infrastructure, security, 

operations and store technology. 

• Balance the demands of the immediate VMware exit programme with investment in the

strategic Edge Management Platform, ensuring neither compromises the other. 

• Drive cost optimisation through automation, hardware consolidation, improved

compute and storage utilisation, technology standardisation and reduced operational

complexity. 

• Evaluate technology investments and supplier decisions based on long-term value, 

total cost of ownership, operational risk and strategic fit. 

• Influence senior stakeholders, communicate complex technical trade-offs in business

terms and build alignment around the platform strategy and migration roadmap. 

What you will bring

• 15+ years of experience in software engineering and technology, with a proven track

record of technical leadership, architecture and delivery of complex software platforms. 

• Significant experience leading multiple engineering teams, developing engineering

leaders and delivering large-scale technology transformation. 

• Strong technical foundations and credibility across Java, Micronaut or comparable Java

frameworks, microservices, REST APIs, Python automation and Terraform. 

• Solid experience with Linux operating systems, edge computing, server hardware, 

virtualisation and storage technologies, including the design, integration, deployment or

lifecycle management of infrastructure platforms. 

• Experience designing and evolving distributed systems, infrastructure software, fleet

management solutions or platform management systems operating at scale. 

• Experience leading major infrastructure modernisation or virtualisation migration

programmes, ideally involving VMware and Proxmox or comparable hypervisor

technologies. 

• Demonstrated ability to design and deliver software platforms for automated

provisioning, configuration management, fleet monitoring, lifecycle operations and

remote management. 

• Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, automated testing, 

configuration management, observability and production reliability. 

• Experience with hardware and software compatibility, operating system upgrades, 

firmware management, capacity planning and infrastructure lifecycle management. 

• Proven ability to define technical strategy, make architectural decisions and translate

long-term vision into executable roadmaps and measurable outcomes. 

• Strong people leadership skills, including developing Engineering Managers and senior

technical leaders, building effective teams and establishing accountability. 

• Commercial acumen, including investment planning, cost optimisation, supplier

management and total cost of ownership. 

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to

influence senior leaders, navigate competing priorities and make sound decisions in

complex enterprise environments. 

How success will be measured

• Virtualisation migration: Safe and predictable migration from VMware to Proxmox, 

successful validation of required store configurations, reduced legacy dependencies

and effective operational handover. 

• Edge Management Platform: Delivery of a scalable, secure and resilient management

platform with automated provisioning, fleet visibility, configuration management and

lifecycle capabilities. 

• Reliability and resilience: Improved platform availability, reduced incident impact and

stronger recovery capabilities across the retail estate. 

• Engineering effectiveness: Increased automation, improved software quality, faster and

more predictable delivery, and reduced manual intervention. 

• Infrastructure consistency: Improved configuration compliance, reduced drift and

standardised hardware, operating system and virtualisation lifecycle management. 

• Cost efficiency: Lower total cost of ownership, improved compute and storage

utilisation, reduced licensing exposure and lower operational overhead. 

• Security and operational readiness: Effective security controls, timely vulnerability

remediation, validated releases and sustainable operational support. 

• Organisation effectiveness: Strong engineering leadership, clear accountability, 

improved internal technical capability and effective collaboration across Tesco

Technology. 

Success will be measured against agreed baselines and targets, balancing the immediate

delivery of the virtualisation migration with the sustainable development of the strategic Edge

Management Platform. 

About Tesco

At Tesco, our purpose is serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every

day. Our technology teams build and operate the platforms that enable our colleagues to serve

customers effectively and keep our business running. 

We value collaboration, inclusion, continuous improvement and engineering excellence. 

Joining Tesco Technology means solving complex engineering challenges at scale and helping

shape the technology that supports our stores, colleagues and customers every day.

The Principal Engineer role is a highly strategic position, operating at the same level as an Engineering Director. data.title: Automation Test Lead
data.description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. 

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. 

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65, 000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1, 000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200, 000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. 

In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6. 95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years. 

Job Description

QA Test Lead

Eurofins IT Solutions, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

With 36 facilities worldwide, Eurofins BioPharma Product Testing (BPT) is the largest network of bio/pharmaceutical GMP product testing laboratories providing comprehensive laboratory services for the world's largest pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, and medical device companies. 

BPT is enabled by global engineering teams working on next-generation applications and Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS). As Senior Automation Engineer, you will be a crucial part of our delivery team, ensuring the product features are completely automated and reducing the idea to live time to Business. As a technology leader, BPT wants to give you the opportunity not just to accept new challenges and opportunities but to impress with your ingenuity, focus, attention to detail and collaboration with a global team of professionals. 

This role reports to a Manager. 

Required Experience and Skills

Experience: 

- Experience between 8 to 10 yrs. Responsibilities

- Develop and implement test strategies, plans, and schedules for both manual and automated testing. 
 - Define and prioritize testing tasks based on project requirements, risks, and timelines. 
 - Collaborate with stakeholders to understand requirements and design comprehensive test cases. 
 - Lead and mentor a team of QA engineers, providing guidance and support. 
 - Coordinate and manage the testing team's activities, ensuring productivity and adherence to testing standards. 
 - Conduct regular team meetings, performance reviews, and provide constructive feedback. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and scripts using C# and Selenium , Typescript of Java. 
 - Integrate test automation into CI/CD pipelines for continuous testing and delivery. 
 - Design and implement automated tests for RESTful APIs using tools like RestSharp or similar libraries. 
 - Validate API functionality, performance, and security through thorough testing. 
 - Oversee the execution of manual and automated tests, track results, and report defects. 
 - Generate and present detailed test reports, metrics, and dashboards to stakeholders. 
 - Ensure that defects are tracked and managed effectively throughout the testing lifecycle. 
 - Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure high-quality deliverables. 
 - Participate in requirement reviews, sprint planning, and retrospectives to provide QA input. 
 - Continuously evaluate and improve testing processes, tools, and methodologies. 
 - Stay updated with the latest industry trends and best practices to enhance testing efficiency. 
 - Identify and mitigate risks related to software quality and testing processes. 
 - Ensure compliance with quality standards and project requirementsRequired Skills: 

- Proficiency in C#, Typescript for developing and maintaining automated test scripts and frameworks. 
 - Strong understanding of object-oriented programming concepts, design patterns, and coding best practices. 
 - Expertise in using Selenium WebDriver for automating web application testing. 
 - Knowledge of Selenium Grid for distributed test execution. 
 - Familiarity with Selenium best practices for managing locators and handling dynamic content. 
 - Good knowledge in Database & SQL. Ability to create & mine data using SQL queries. 
 - Experience with RestSharp or similar libraries for creating and executing API test cases. 
 - Understanding of RESTful principles and common HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE). 
 - Ability to validate API responses, handle authentication, and test error handling. 
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks using tools like NUnit or MSTest for C#, WebDriver IO , Selenium
 - Knowledge of integrating test automation with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI/CD
 - Proficiency with version control systems like Git for managing test scripts and collaborating with the development team. 
 - Familiarity with test management tools like JIRA, TestRail, or similar for tracking test cases, execution, and defect management. 
 - Ability to write and execute SQL queries for data validation and verification. 
 - Understanding of performance testing concepts and tools (e. g. , JMeter) for assessing application performance under load. 
 - Experience working in Agile environments, including participation in Scrum ceremonies like stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective collaboration and reportingDesirable Experience

- Knowledge of Performance testing. 
 - Knowledge of Security testing. 
 - Knowledge of Mobile Automation Testing. Personal Skills: 

- Excellent analytical and problem solving skills
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills
 - Ability to articulate and present different points-of-views on various topics related to project and otherwise. 
 - Successful teamwork experience and demonstrated leadership abilities are required. 
 - Eager to learn and continuously develop personal and technical capabilities. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

- MCA or Bachelors in Engineering, Computer Science or any other equivalent degree. 

Additional Information

Personal Skills: 

- Customer-service oriented with a problem-solving attitude; 
 - Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential; 
 - Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change; 
 - Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing); 
 - Structured and clear writing skills; 
 - Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning; 
 - Demonstrated positive attitude, self-motivated, team player. PERFORMANCE APPRAISAL CRITERIA: Eurofins has a strong focus on Performance Management system. This includes quarterly calibrations, half-yearly reviews and annual reviews. The KPIs shall be set and may vary slightly between projects. These will be clearly communicated, documented during the first 30 days of your joining.

data.title: Manager I - Senior Software Engineer, SAP Quality Management
data.description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, "Who are you working for?"-a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. 

At Bristol Myers Squibb, we are inspired by a single vision - transforming patients' lives through science. In oncology, hematology, immunology and cardiovascular disease - and one of the most diverse and promising pipelines in the industry - each of our passionate colleagues contribute to innovations that drive meaningful change. We bring a human touch to every treatment we pioneer. Join us and make a difference. 

Position Summary

At BMS, digital innovation and Information Technology are central to our vision of transforming patients' lives through science. To accelerate our ability to serve patients around the world, we must unleash the power of technology. We are committed to being at the forefront of transforming the way medicine is made and delivered by harnessing the power of computer and data science, artificial intelligence, and other technologies to promote scientific discovery, faster decision making, and enhanced patient care. 

The Senior Software Engineer, SAP Quality Management should have strong experience supporting and delivering SAP QM capabilities in an SAP S/4HANA environment, with working knowledge of manufacturing integration points across PP/PI, MM, IM, WM/EWM, MES, and LIMS. This role focuses on quality inspection processes, quality notifications, batch and material quality controls, master data, regulated validation expectations, and operational support in an FDA and GxP environment. 

If you want an exciting and rewarding career that is meaningful, consider joining our diverse team!

🚀 Shape the Future of Quality Technology | SAP S/4HANA Quality Management Specialist

Are you ready to make an impact where Quality meets Innovation?

We're looking for a talented SAP Quality Management Specialist to join our global team and help drive the next generation of intelligent, compliant, and cloud-enabled quality solutions. If you're passionate about SAP QM, digital quality transformation, AI-enabled innovation, and regulated manufacturing excellence, we'd love to hear from you. 

💡 Delivering Smart Quality Solutions

- Design, implement, and support SAP S/4HANA Quality Management solutions across inspection planning, inspection execution, results recording, usage decisions, quality notifications, batch release, and quality certificate processes. 
 - Own end-to-end delivery across requirements, design, configuration, testing, deployment, validation support, and operational excellence. 
 - Provide scalable and compliant SAP QM solutions aligned with business and regulatory expectations. 

🔗 Connecting the Dots

- Partners with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Warehouse, Laboratory, and Enterprise Platform teams to deliver integrated quality processes. 
 - Support integrations with MES, LIMS, Batch Release Hub, BTP/BIAP, and other enterprise platforms. 
 - Ensure seamless execution of quality processes across manufacturing, inventory, warehouse, and laboratory systems. 

☁️ Driving Cloud & AI Transformation

- Support digital quality transformation initiatives leveraging SAP S/4HANA and cloud technologies. 
 - Apply AI, GenAI, automation, process mining, reporting, and analytics to improve operational efficiency, accelerate documentation, strengthen quality compliance, and reduce manual effort across SAP QM processes. 
 - Identify and support AI-enabled use cases including quality anomaly detection, proactive incident prevention, automated root cause analysis, intelligent incident resolution, quality trend analytics, and process mining insights. 
 - Use AI/GenAI responsibly in regulated environments to support GxP documentation, test script preparation, validation evidence reviews, audit-readiness checks, and knowledge management while aligning with Information Technology Quality System (ITQS), Information Technology Quality Assurance (ITQA) Teams, data integrity, and validation expectations. 
 - Contribute to enterprise modernization initiatives involving SAP RISE, BTP/BIAP, and digital manufacturing capabilities. 

🛡️ Keeping Us Compliant

- Support FDA, GxP, Information Technology Quality System (ITQS), and Information Technology Quality Assurance (ITQA) compliant solution delivery, documentation, and operations. 
 - Produce and maintain GxP documentation including SDLC deliverables, validation plans, requirements traceability, test scripts, testing evidence, deviations, approvals, and audit-ready records in alignment with Information Technology Quality System (ITQS) and Information Technology Quality Assurance (ITQA) expectations. 
 - Ensure quality processes and system changes meet regulatory, validation, inspection readiness, and compliance requirements. 

🤝 Collaborating & Innovating

- Build strong relationships with Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Validation, Enterprise Platform, IT Business Partners, and external partners. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives and promote adoption of emerging technologies. 
 - Lead stakeholder communications and influence cross-functional decision making. 
 - Mentor team members and contribute to organizational capability development. 

What You'll Bring

- ✅ Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Life Sciences, Quality, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - ✅ 5-7+ years of SAP QM experience in SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA environments. 
 - ✅ Strong experience in Inspection Management, Quality Notifications, Batch Management, Quality Master Data, and Quality Certificates. 
 - ✅ Experience supporting FDA-regulated and GxP-compliant environments, including Information Technology Quality System (ITQS) / Information Technology Quality Assurance (ITQA) documentation, validation evidence, traceability, change control, and audit readiness. 
 - ✅ Knowledge of SAP QM integration with PP/PI, MM, IM, WM/EWM, MES, and LIMS. 
 - ✅ Experience supporting SDLC, validation, testing, deployment, and operational support activities. 
 - ✅ Ability to apply AI, GenAI, automation, analytics, and process mining to improve SAP QM delivery, documentation quality, incident prevention, testing efficiency, and compliance outcomes. 
 - ✅ Strong stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills. 
 - ✅ Passion for continuous learning, innovation, and adoption of emerging technologies. 

Bonus Points If You Have. . . 

- ⭐ Experience with SAP RISE, SAP BTP/BIAP, cloud transformation initiatives, or enterprise integration platforms. 
 - ⭐ Experience with Batch Release Hub and advanced quality release processes. 
 - ⭐ Hands-on exposure to AI/GenAI, Copilot-style productivity tools, automation, process mining, predictive analytics, anomaly detection, or intelligent operational support in SAP, Quality, Manufacturing, or regulated environments. 
 - ⭐ Pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated manufacturing industry experience. 
 - ⭐ Experience supporting global SAP programs and enterprise-scale deployments. 

What Makes You Stand Out

You combine deep SAP Quality Management expertise with a passion for innovation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. You thrive in complex environments, build trusted partnerships across business and technology teams, and proactively leverage modern technologies such as AI, GenAI, automation, process mining, analytics, and cloud platforms to improve quality processes, reduce manual effort, strengthen compliance, and support better patient outcomes. You bring a growth mindset, strong leadership capabilities, and a commitment to delivering compliant, scalable, and business-focused solutions in a regulated digital environment. 

Why You Should Apply

Around the world, we are passionate about making an impact on the lives of patients with serious diseases. Empowered to apply our individual talents and diverse perspectives in an inclusive culture, our shared values of passion, innovation, urgency, accountability, inclusion and integrity bring out the highest potential of each of our colleagues. 

Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. 

#HYDIT

We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials - if this role excites you, but doesn't perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. 

How We Work

Where you work matters - because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models: site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities. Learn more at https: //careers. bms. com/ways-of-working. 

Supporting People With Disabilities

BMS is dedicated to ensuring that people with disabilities can excel through a transparent recruitment process, reasonable workplace accommodations/adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Applicants can request a reasonable workplace accommodation/adjustment prior to accepting a job offer. If you require reasonable accommodations/adjustments in completing this application, or in any part of the recruitment process, direct your inquiries to adastaffingsupport@bms. com. Visit careers. bms. com/eeo-accessibility to access our complete Equal Employment Opportunity statement. 

Candidate Rights

BMS will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, pursuant to applicable laws in your area. 

For roles based in Los Angeles County only: If you live in or expect to work from Los Angeles County if hired for this position, please visit this page for important additional information: https: //careers. bms. com/california-residents/

Data Protection

We will never request payments, financial information, or social security numbers during our application or recruitment process. Learn more about protecting yourself at https: //careers. bms. com/fraud-protection. 

Any data processed in connection with role applications will be treated in accordance with applicable data privacy policies and regulations. 

If this posting is missing required information required by local law or incorrect, contact BMS at TAEnablement@bms. com with the Job Title and Requisition number. Do not send application-related inquiries to this email. To check your application status, please login to your Candidate Home Account.

data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Lead Software Engineer

Overview

As part of a fast-paced team delivering innovative payment, digital commerce, and platform solutions, this role provides technical leadership across architecture, software engineering, AI-enabled development, and cloud-native modernization initiatives. The successful candidate will lead large-scale engineering programs, design scalable and secure solutions, drive adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices, and collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to deliver high-quality products. 

Role & Responsibilities

- Lead complex software engineering initiatives with significant business impact. 
 - Define and execute technology strategy, architecture roadmaps, and modernization programs. 
 - Design, develop, and deliver scalable, high-performance, cloud-native applications and APIs. 
 - Drive decomposition of monolithic platforms into reusable microservices and domain-driven architectures. 
 - Partner with Product Managers, TPMs, Architects, and Engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions. 
 - Evaluate emerging technologies, AI capabilities, and third-party platforms to improve business outcomes and engineering efficiency. 
 - Develop Proofs of Concept (POCs) and validate new architectural approaches. 
 - Champion engineering excellence through code reviews, design reviews, automated testing, and continuous improvement. 
 - Drive adoption of AI-powered development tools and practices to improve developer productivity, code quality, testing efficiency, documentation, and operational excellence. 
 - Mentor engineers, foster technical growth, and promote a culture of innovation and continuous learning. 
 - Communicate architecture decisions, risks, trade-offs, and technical strategies effectively to leadership and stakeholders. 
 - Ensure adherence to security, compliance, quality, reliability, and software development standards. 

Education

ABOUT YOU

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience. 

Experience & Qualifications

- Extensive experience designing, developing, and leading enterprise-scale software platforms. 
 - Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Microservices, PostgreSQL, and distributed systems. 
 - Experience building secure, resilient, high-availability applications in cloud environments. 
 - Proven ability to architect and deliver mission-critical systems at scale. 
 - Experience integrating external APIs, payment platforms, SaaS products, and third-party services. 
 - Strong understanding of software architecture patterns, domain-driven design, event-driven architectures, and API-first development. 
 - Hands-on experience with Agile, DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and cloud-native engineering practices. 
 - Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, AI coding assistants, intelligent code generation, automated testing, and developer productivity platforms. 
 - Demonstrated ability to learn, evaluate, and adopt emerging technologies, frameworks, and AI innovations. 
 - Strong leadership, communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
