- Lead architecture and design decisions across multiple products, platforms, and engineering teams. 
 - Develop and maintain reference architectures, engineering standards, and best practices. 
 - Design and implement scalable APIs, microservices, integrations, and event-driven systems. 
 - Drive engineering quality through automated testing, code reviews, observability, reliability engineering, and operational excellence. 
 - Build secure solutions aligned with Security by Design principles, OWASP standards, PCI-DSS, and enterprise security requirements. 
 - Optimize application performance, scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency. 
 - Lead root cause analysis, troubleshooting, and resolution of complex production issues. 
 - Establish development standards, automation frameworks, and quality metrics. 
 - Influence technical direction, backlog prioritization, and management of technical debt. 
 - Partner with engineering leadership to improve delivery velocity, reliability, and customer experience. 
 - Coach and mentor engineers through design sessions, technical reviews, and knowledge-sharing activities. 
 - Support talent acquisition, technical interviews, and team development. 
 - Drive adoption of AI-enabled software engineering practices across the SDLC, including requirements analysis, coding, testing, documentation, observability, and operational support. 
 - Use data, metrics, and AI-driven insights to improve engineering effectiveness, developer experience, and platform reliability. 

Skills & Abilities

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to solve complex technical challenges. 
 - Expertise in software architecture, design patterns, distributed systems, and cloud-native application design. 
 - Ability to balance business priorities, technical strategy, and long-term platform sustainability. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills for working with global, cross-functional teams. 
 - Hands-on engineering leader capable of contributing to architecture, design, coding, code reviews, and technical decision-making. 
 - Experience driving innovation, modernization, automation, and engineering productivity initiatives. 
 - Ability to lead multiple concurrent programs in a matrixed, geographically distributed environment. 

KEY TECHNOLOGY AREAS

Core Engineering

- Java (Java 17+ preferred)
 - Spring Boot

 - Microservices Architecture
 - Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
 - Event-Driven Architecture
 - Distributed Systems

Key Responsibilities

- Carry out stage-wise quality inspections during the fabrication of pressure vessels, heat exchangers, and related equipment. 

- Review engineering drawings, material specifications, approved procedures, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), and Quality Assurance Plans (QAPs). 

- Perform incoming material inspection and verify Material Test Certificates (MTCs), material grades, identification, and traceability. 

- Conduct fit-up, dimensional, visual welding, and final inspections as per approved drawings and applicable code requirements. 

- Verify compliance with approved Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS), Procedure Qualification Records (PQR), and welder performance qualification records. 

- Ensure weld identification, material traceability, and inspection records are maintained throughout manufacturing. 

- Coordinate NDT activities, including RT, UT, MT, and PT, as required by the approved inspection plan and applicable code. 

- Monitor hydrostatic testing and other applicable pressure tests, ensuring approved procedures and safety requirements are followed. 

- Coordinate inspections with Authorized Inspection Agency (AIA) representatives, third-party inspectors, and customer inspectors, as applicable. 

- Prepare and maintain inspection reports, non-conformance reports (NCRs), corrective action records, and manufacturing quality documentation. 

- Support preparation and review of the final manufacturing data report and quality dossier, including applicable ASME documentation and the Manufacturer's Data Report (U-1 or applicable form). 

- Ensure inspection hold points and witness points are followed and properly released. 

- Identify quality issues, coordinate root cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions to minimize rejection and rework. 

- Support ASME U Stamp-related quality activities in accordance with the company's Quality Control System (QCS) and applicable code requirements. 

- Coordinate with Production, Engineering, Procurement, and Project teams to resolve quality-related issues and ensure timely inspection clearance. 

Required Qualifications and Experience

- Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline. 

- 3-6 years of relevant experience in pressure vessel, heat exchanger, or process equipment manufacturing. 

- Practical experience in fabrication quality control and inspection of welded pressure equipment. 

- Working knowledge of ASME Section VIII, Division 1, and applicable material and welding requirements. 

- Knowledge of welding inspection, WPS/PQR, welder qualifications, NDT, dimensional inspection, and material traceability. 

- Experience in quality documentation, ITP/QAP implementation, NCR handling, and final inspection. 

- Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working in an ASME U Stamp-certified manufacturing facility. 

- NDT Level II certification in applicable methods. 

- Welding inspection certification such as CSWIP or AWS-CWI. 

- Familiarity with ASME material traceability, pressure testing, and Manufacturer's Data Report documentation. 

- Knowledge of ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems.

data.description:
About This Role

Wells Fargo is seeking a Software Engineering Senior Manager to lead development teams working on Corporate Accounting Data applications. 

In This Role, You Will

Required Qualifications

- 7+ years of Software Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

data.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Golang (Product Engineering)
data.description:
ABOUT OOLIO: 

Oolio is a leading B2B SaaS platform transforming how hospitality venues operate and grow. Trusted by more than 22, 000 venues, we power mission-critical POS, payments, online ordering, kiosks, loyalty, kitchen management, and real-time insights - all within one connected ecosystem. 

We are building the operating system for modern hospitality - simplifying complex operations, accelerating service, and unlocking smarter, data-driven decisions. Built by hospitality professionals with decades of industry experience, we understand the realities of every shift, every service rush, and every guest interaction. From cafés and quick-service restaurants to pubs, multi-site groups, and stadiums, Oolio enables venues to operate seamlessly at scale. With next-business-day settlements, powerful third-party integrations, and 24/7 real human support, we go beyond software - we become long-term partners in growth. 

As a rapidly scaling product-led organisation, we're shaping the future of hospitality technology. 

We build the technology backbone that powers modern hospitality businesses to perform, compete, and thrive at scale. 

JOB DESCRIPTION: 

At Oolio, Senior Backend Engineers - Golang are hands-on engineers who design, build, and operate scalable, reliable, and high-performance backend systems. You will take ownership across the backend engineering lifecycle - from technical design and development through testing, deployment, observability, and production support. 

The role requires strong expertise in Golang, microservices, distributed systems, APIs, event-driven architectures, cloud-native technologies, and system performance. As AI continues to transform software engineering, you will also be encouraged to leverage AI-powered development tools, automation, and emerging AI capabilities to improve engineering productivity, accelerate delivery, enhance code quality, and solve real-world engineering problems. 

The primary focus of this role is hands-on backend engineering, with opportunities to contribute to technical design, architecture decisions, and engineering best practices. You will work closely with Product, Design, Platform, and Engineering teams to build customer-facing products and backend capabilities that support Oolio's growing global platform. 

RESPONSIBILITIES: 

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain reliable and scalable backend services using Golang. 
 - Contribute to the design and implementation of scalable microservices with strong emphasis on performance, concurrency, maintainability, and reliability. 
 - Contribute to technical design and architecture discussions, including HLD/LLD, service boundaries, data flows, and integration patterns. 
 - Design and implement event-driven systems using asynchronous messaging, queues, pub/sub, and streaming patterns where appropriate. 
 - Build and maintain RESTful and/or gRPC APIs that power web, mobile, and third-party integrations. 
 - Work collaboratively across the stack when required, including integration with React and Node. js services to deliver end-to-end product features. 
 - Develop and operate cloud-native services deployed on AWS, leveraging Kubernetes and Docker for containerized environments. 
 - Identify and resolve performance, scalability, and reliability bottlenecks as product usage and customer scale increase. 
 - Implement effective testing strategies including unit, integration, contract, and performance testing. 
 - Contribute to observability best practices including structured logging, monitoring, metrics, tracing, and alerting. 
 - Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving engineering standards, coding practices, and overall code quality. 
 - Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement sustainable fixes to prevent recurrence. 
 - Collaborate with other engineers to deliver high-quality solutions within agreed timelines. 
 - Mentor and support junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge sharing. 
 - Leverage AI-powered development tools and automation to improve development productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, and software delivery. 
 - Explore and adopt relevant AI capabilities and engineering tools that can solve practical software development and operational challenges. 

REQUIREMENTS: 

Role: Senior Backend Engineer (Product Engineering) - final role will depend on candidate experience, credentials, and interview outcomes

Experience: 5 - 9 Years

Education: Preferred - B. Tech/B. E/M. Tech/M. E/MCA/M. S

Technology Stack: 

(A) Core Engineering: 

Golang, Microservices, Distributed Systems, Event-Driven Architecture, REST APIs, gRPC, System Design (HLD/LLD), Performance Optimization, Testing Frameworks, AI-Powered Development Tooling

(B) Good/Nice to Have: 

ReactJS, NodeJS, GraphQL

OTHER REQUIREMENTS: 

- Strong hands-on experience building production-grade backend systems in SaaS or product-based organisations. 
 - Strong expertise in Golang, including concurrency patterns, goroutines, channels, memory management, profiling, and performance optimization. 
 - Proven experience developing and operating scalable microservices and distributed systems. 
 - Strong understanding of API design, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, and system reliability principles. 
 - Experience with PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, or similar databases, including schema design, indexing, transactions, and query optimization. 
 - Hands-on experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native application development. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern software development and delivery practices. 
 - Good understanding of observability, monitoring, logging, tracing, fault tolerance, and production reliability. 
 - Experience troubleshooting production issues, conducting root cause analysis, and implementing long-term improvements. 
 - Experience working in high-scale or high-transaction environments is highly desirable. 
 - Practical experience leveraging AI-powered development tools to improve engineering productivity, software quality, and delivery outcomes. 
 - Exposure to AI-powered workflows across development, testing, documentation, deployment, or operational processes is a plus. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced product engineering environment. 
 - Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional and engineering teams while taking ownership of assigned services and features. 
 - Strong focus on writing clean, maintainable, well-tested, and production-ready code.

The successful candidate will lead the end-to-end delivery of AI-native internal products - self-service infrastructure portals, workflow orchestration engines, policy-as-code enforcement systems and operational automation platforms - built on modern cloud-native stacks including Kubernetes, Temporal, Terraform and Angular. They will have sufficient infrastructure awareness to understand the operational context of what they are building, and will work closely with I&O engineering teams to translate complex infrastructure workflows into elegant, automated, AI-augmented software solutions. 

Your Key Responsibilities

The I&O Platform Infrastructure AI-Native DevSecOps Developer designs and delivers bespoke internal software products that eliminate manual infrastructure workflows, accelerate provisioning and give engineers and stakeholders real-time, self-service operational visibility. Drawing on AI coding tools as a core development accelerant, this professional dramatically compresses delivery timelines - prototyping, iterating and shipping production-grade software at a pace that traditional development workflows cannot match. 

The role spans the full software development lifecycle - from requirements and architecture through build, test, security hardening, deployment and ongoing improvement - with a security-first mindset embedded at every stage. The developer will own the product delivery end-to-end, partnering with I&O platform engineers, architects and service management stakeholders to ensure what is built reflects the real operational needs of the infrastructure estate and is designed to scale across EY's global data center footprint. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

- Demonstrated ability to build and ship production-grade software rapidly using AI development tools as a primary delivery accelerant (exclusionary). 
 - Deep, active use of AI coding assistants throughout the development lifecycle, including: 
 - GitHub Copilot or equivalent AI pair-programming tools
 - ChatGPT, Claude or similar LLMs for architecture design, code generation and review
 - AI-assisted test generation, security scanning and code refactoring
 - Prompt engineering for development workflow automation
 - Strong full-stack development capability across front-end and back-end disciplines: 
 - Angular (v14+) for self-service portal and operational UI development
 - Python or Go for back-end services, APIs and automation engines
 - REST and GraphQL API design and implementation
 - Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration platforms, particularly Temporal. io. 
 - Strong Kubernetes engineering skills - deployment, Helm charts, operators, RBAC and namespace management. 
 - Infrastructure-as-Code authoring using Terraform and Ansible for provisioning automation. 
 - Strong DevSecOps pipeline development - CI/CD design, security gate integration and automated deployment: 
 - GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps pipelines
 - SAST/DAST tooling integration (Snyk, SonarQube, OWASP ZAP or equivalent)
 - Container image scanning and policy enforcement (Trivy, Cosign, OPA/Gatekeeper)
 - Policy-as-Code implementation using Open Policy Agent (OPA) or equivalent. 
 - Experience building AI-native product features, including: 
 - LLM integration via API (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic or equivalent)
 - Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns for operational knowledge bases
 - AI-driven workflow decision making and self-healing automation
 - Copilot / chat interface integration into operational tooling
 - Sufficient infrastructure platform knowledge to design software that reflects real-world operational constraints: 
 - Virtualization and hyperconverged infrastructure concepts (Nutanix, Hyper-V, VMware)
 - Windows Server and Linux operating system fundamentals
 - Networking concepts - VLANs, DNS, IP management, load balancing
 - Storage and compute provisioning workflows
 - ServiceNow ITSM integration patterns
 - Strong software product ownership mindset - able to take a problem statement from whiteboard to production with minimal hand-holding. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills - able to demo working software and articulate product decisions to both technical and executive audiences. 
 - Strong working knowledge of Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks. 

To qualify for the role, you must have experience with

- Full-stack software product development and delivery - 5-7 years. 
 - AI-assisted software development as an active daily workflow - 2+ years. 
 - Angular front-end application development (v14+) - 3-5 years. 
 - Python or Go back-end service development - 5+ years. 
 - Kubernetes cluster management and application deployment - 3-5 years. 
 - Terraform and Ansible Infrastructure-as-Code authoring - 3-5 years. 
 - Temporal. io or equivalent workflow orchestration platform (Argo, Conductor or equivalent). 
 - CI/CD pipeline development with integrated security gates - 3-5 years. 
 - LLM API integration for production AI-native product features. 
 - Open Policy Agent (OPA) or equivalent policy-as-code enforcement. 
 - REST API design, development and documentation. 
 - Container build, scanning and secure image management (Docker, Podman). 
 - Git-based source control and pull-request-driven development workflows (GitHub, Azure DevOps). 
 - SAST/DAST security tooling integration in CI pipelines. 
 - ITSM platform integration - ServiceNow API or equivalent. 
 - Agile sprint-based delivery with regular demo and release cadences. 
 - Infrastructure provisioning workflow automation (VM builds, network configuration, DNS/IP management). 
 - Helm chart authoring for Kubernetes application packaging and deployment. 

Ideally, you'll also have

- Microsoft Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204) or equivalent cloud certification (desired). 
 - Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) or CKA certification (better to have). 
 - HashiCorp Terraform Associate certification (desired). 
 - ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary). 
 - Experience building on or integrating with Nutanix platform APIs (NCM, Prism, Calm). 
 - Experience with Temporal Cloud or self-hosted Temporal cluster operations. 
 - Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio or Azure AI Studio for enterprise AI product development. 
 - Familiarity with GitOps patterns using ArgoCD or Flux for continuous deployment. 
 - Experience contributing to or maintaining open-source infrastructure automation projects. 

What We Look For

A builder - someone who moves fast, thinks in systems and ships working software that solves real infrastructure problems. We are looking for an individual who genuinely uses AI as a development superpower, who understands enough about infrastructure to design software that works in the real world, and who takes pride in owning a product end-to-end from first commit to production. The ideal candidate has already built something like HCSP - a platform that replaces manual, multi-portal, error-prone operational workflows with a single automated, observable, self-healing system - and is ready to do it again at EY scale. 

What We Offer

We offer a competitive remuneration package where you'll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development. Plus, we offer: 

- Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. 
 - Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. 
 - Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. 
 - Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.description:
Location: 

Hyderabad, IN, 500 081

Requisition ID: 19765

Brightstar is an innovative, forward-thinking global leader in lottery that builds on our renowned expertise in delivering secure technology and producing reliable, comprehensive solutions for our customers. As a premier pure play global lottery company, our best-in-class lottery operations, retail and digital solutions, and award-winning lottery games enable our customers to achieve their goals, fulfill player needs and distribute meaningful benefits to communities. Brightstar has a well-established local presence and is a trusted partner to governments and regulators around the world, creating value by adhering to the highest standards of service, integrity, and responsibility. Brightstar has approximately 6, 000 employees. For more information, please visit www. brightstarlottery. com. 

About The Role

We are the Delivery QA team for iLottery Global Business Solutions delivery. We test the complete integrated customer journey across web, mobile, and API - not individual products in isolation. 

This is a senior hands-on engineering role. You will write automation code that runs in CI, operate an AI-assisted test design pipeline, and act as a human reviewer who governs the quality of AI-generated test output before it reaches production. 

Responsibilities

- Design and deliver automated tests across web portal, mobile (iOS and Android), and API channels. 
 - Operate an AI-assisted test pipeline - from Jira story to linked automated test - under a structured human review process. 
 - Review and govern AI-generated test artefacts, accepting or rejecting them against acceptance criteria before they merge or reach the test management system. 
 - Author and maintain shared test interaction libraries that work across multiple customer sites without duplication. 
 - Onboard new customer sites into the automation suite, including test data setup, environment configuration, and CI integration. 
 - Contribute to pipeline tooling and scripting that connects Jira, test management, and CI/CD. 
 - Collaborate with QA Leads, BAs, and delivery teams to ensure acceptance criteria are testable before design begins. 
 - Maintain CI/CD pipelines and test reporting across all three test channels. 

Required Skills

All of the following are Non-Negotiable. 

Test Automation

- Playwright TypeScript - web portal and API test authoring, multi-environment configuration, fixture design
 - Robot Framework + Appium - native iOS (XCUITest) and Android (UIAutomator2) test authoring and parallel execution
 - API testing - REST assertion patterns, schema validation, auth flows (OAuth, JWT), multi-step orchestration
 - Cloud device testing - real-device execution on a platform such as BrowserStack or Headspin

AI-Augmented Testing

- AI-assisted test pipeline operation - experience working within a workflow where AI generates test artefacts, including prompt engineering for test design
 - Human-in-the-loop governance - reviewing, challenging, and rejecting AI-generated test artefacts; not treating AI output as automatically correct
 - Test management integration - linking AI-generated tests to acceptance criteria and a test management system before approval

Tooling & Engineering

- GitHub Actions - CI/CD pipeline authoring, multi-environment matrix strategies, secrets management
 - Python scripting - automation tooling, REST API integration, JSON processing, metrics reporting
 - Jira + Xray - test lifecycle management, execution results, coverage traceability
 - Test reporting (Allure or equivalent) - suite-level results and flaky test identification

Qualifications

- 10+ years - sustained hands-on QA/SDET delivery across automation and framework engineering (not management only). 
 - Integration testing mindset - experience testing end-to-end flows that cross multiple back-end services or products. 

Success Profile

- Leading Complexity
 - Leading People

data.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer (Python & Playwright)
data.description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Full Automation Testing QA Engineer who will take ownership of quality assurance through strong test automation practices. The role focuses on designing and maintaining automated test solutions across API, UI, integration, regression, and performance testing, while working closely with product and engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle. 

Roles & Responsibilities

Test Strategy & Planning

- Define and implement comprehensive automation‐first test strategies for API and UI applications 
 - Create detailed test plans covering functional, integration, regression, and performance testing 
 - Collaborate with product and engineering teams to define acceptance criteria, quality metrics, and release readiness 
 - Identify test scope, risks, and dependencies early in the development cycle 
 - Continuously improve QA processes, test coverage, and automation best practices

API [GI1] Automation Testing

- Design, develop, and execute automated test cases for RESTful APIs built using NodeJS & Python frameworks ( FastAPI, Flask, Django, etc. ) 
 - Validate request/response payloads, headers, status codes, and business logic 
 - Test API authentication, authorization, and security scenarios 
 - Cover negative scenarios, edge cases, and boundary conditions 
 - Use tools such as pytest, Postman, REST Assured, or similar frameworks for API automation

Integration & Regression Testing

- Build and maintain automated integration test suites across backend services and system components 
 - Develop robust regression automation to ensure existing functionality remains stable across releases 
 - Validate data flow between frontend, backend, databases, and third‐party systems 
 - Track, document, and communicate integration issues and system dependencies 
 - Manage test data requirements for integration and regression scenarios

UI Automation Testing ( Backstage[PN2] / React)

- Create and maintain automated UI test suites for React‐based web applications 
 - Automate UI tests using Playwright, Cypress, Jest, or React Testing Library 
 - Validate UI workflows, component behaviour, and user interactions 
 - Ensure cross‐browser compatibility and responsive behaviour 
 - Perform basic accessibility testing and validate WCAG compliance where applicable

Performance Testing

- Design and execute performance and scalability testing strategies for APIs and UI components 
 - Define performance benchmarks and acceptance thresholds 
 - Conduct load, stress, and endurance testing 
 - Analyze results, identify bottlenecks, and collaborate with engineering teams on improvements 
 - Document performance test results and recommendations using tools like Locust, JMeter, or k6

Automation Frameworks & CI/CD Integration

- Build and maintain scalable automation frameworks using Python (pytest, unittest, etc. ) 
 - Write clean, reusable, and maintainable automation code 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines for continuous test execution 
 - Generate automation reports and dashboards for test results and coverage 
 - Participate in test automation code reviews and follow coding best practices

Requirements

Required Skills

Core Technical Skills

- Strong experience in test automation using Python[GI3] & NodeJS 
 - Hands‐on expertise in API automation, UI automation, Selenium and integration testing 
 - Experience with: 
 - API Testing: pytest, Postman, REST Assured 
 - UI Testing: Playwright, Cypress, Jest, React Testing Library 
 - Solid understanding of: 
 - Software testing principles (STLC) 
 - REST APIs, HTTP protocols, JSON 
 - Microservices‐based application testing 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (tool‐agnostic) 
Nice to Have (Non‐Cloud)

- Experience with databases and SQL for test validation 
 - Familiarity with performance and reliability testing concepts 
 - Experience working in Agile / Scrum teams

Soft Skills

- Strong analytical and problem‐solving skills 
 - Clear written and verbal communication 
 - Ability to work independently and collaborate across teams 
 - Strong ownership of quality and attention to detail

Experience & Education

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience 
 - 3-6 years of experience in QA automation or software testing (adjustable as needed)

data.title: Staff AI Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff AI Engineer based in India (Remote-First). 

As a Staff AI Engineer, you will shape the technical direction and development of advanced AI systems that solve complex, high-stakes business challenges. You will design, build, and deploy production-ready large language model (LLM) and natural language processing (NLP) solutions, ensuring they remain reliable, accurate, and scalable. Working at the intersection of applied machine learning, software engineering, and AI innovation, you will turn ambiguous business needs into practical, impactful products. You will establish robust evaluation frameworks, monitoring systems, and safeguards that promote trustworthy AI and responsible human oversight. Alongside hands-on development, you will mentor engineers, influence architectural decisions, and establish reusable foundations that accelerate delivery across teams. This remote-first opportunity is ideal for a technically accomplished AI leader who enjoys combining strategic thinking with coding, experimentation, and cross-functional collaboration. 

Accountabilities

- AI system development: Design, develop, and operate production-grade LLM and NLP systems, machine learning services, and data pipelines. Guide critical components from early experimentation and prototyping through deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. 
 - Technical architecture and leadership: Define the architecture, technical standards, and engineering practices for AI systems. Make informed decisions about model selection, build-versus-buy approaches, and trade-offs between accuracy, latency, scalability, and cost. 
 - AI reliability and evaluation: Build evaluation frameworks, performance metrics, monitoring systems, and traceability mechanisms to measure model quality, detect hallucinations, identify failure patterns, and improve reliability in production. 
 - Responsible AI implementation: Design appropriate safeguards, explainability mechanisms, and human-in-the-loop workflows to support trustworthy AI outputs, particularly when users rely on the system for sensitive or high-impact decisions. 
 - Problem discovery and delivery: Collaborate with product teams, customers, and subject-matter experts to translate complex, ambiguous requirements into well-defined AI use cases and deliver practical solutions that generate measurable business value. 
 - Reusable AI infrastructure: Develop shared evaluation tools, deployment pipelines, data practices, and engineering foundations that make future AI projects faster, safer, more consistent, and easier to maintain. 
 - Engineering excellence: Lead technical design discussions, conduct architecture and code reviews, document important decisions, and promote high standards for software quality, maintainability, testing, and production readiness. 
 - Mentorship and team development: Coach engineers across experience levels, share technical expertise, improve development practices, and contribute to hiring, onboarding, and the long-term growth of the AI engineering team. 
 - Research and experimentation: Stay informed about advances in LLMs and applied machine learning, conduct focused experiments, and translate promising research and emerging technologies into useful production capabilities. 
 - Cross-functional communication: Work closely with engineering leadership, product stakeholders, and business teams to explain complex technical concepts, communicate trade-offs, and align AI development with organizational priorities. 
 - End-to-end ownership: Take responsibility for critical AI components throughout their lifecycle, ensuring that solutions remain effective, observable, maintainable, and aligned with evolving business requirements. 

Requirements

- Professional experience: At least 8 years of experience building and delivering machine learning systems, with a demonstrated record of technical leadership and ownership of production-grade solutions. 
 - Programming expertise: Strong proficiency in Python, including the ability to write clean, maintainable, well-tested, production-ready code and support services throughout their lifecycle. 
 - Machine learning and NLP: Deep, hands-on experience with machine learning, natural language processing, deep learning, and modern large language models, including deploying models in real-world applications. 
 - Evaluation and monitoring: Experience designing model evaluation frameworks, defining meaningful performance metrics, monitoring deployed models, and implementing processes to identify and address reliability issues. 
 - Mathematical foundations: Strong knowledge of statistics, probability, and linear algebra, with the ability to apply these concepts to machine learning development, experimentation, and model evaluation. 
 - Production infrastructure: Experience building and operating scalable machine learning services using Docker and AWS, including serverless computing environments. 
 - Technical leadership: A proven ability to make architectural and technical decisions that influence broader engineering practices, lead complex projects without relying on formal authority, and balance long-term design with immediate delivery needs. 
 - Mentorship and collaboration: Experience mentoring engineers, leading design and code reviews, improving team development practices, and fostering a culture of technical excellence. 
 - Problem-solving: Comfort working with ambiguous, open-ended problems, identifying the most valuable opportunities for AI, and translating complex requirements into clear technical solutions. 
 - Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions, limitations, and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Education: A master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Preferred LLM expertise: Experience applying LLMs to non-conversational use cases, including information extraction, classification, structured output generation, and reasoning over complex documents. 
 - Preferred industry experience: Background in compliance, human resources technology, regulatory environments, or other sensitive and audit-intensive domains where accuracy, traceability, and reliability are essential. 
 - Responsible AI experience: Familiarity with explainable AI approaches, human-in-the-loop workflows, and mechanisms for improving transparency and trust in AI-powered systems. 
 - Infrastructure automation: Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools is an advantage. 
 - Professional mindset: A balance of strategic thinking and hands-on engineering, combined with intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, ownership, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous learning and measurable results. 

Benefits

- Competitive compensation: Salary determined through objective market benchmarking, with final compensation based on relevant skills, experience, qualifications, education, and geographic location. 
 - Additional compensation: Eligibility for an annual performance-based bonus for non-sales roles, subject to applicable compensation policies and individual and company performance. 
 - Remote-first flexibility: The opportunity to work remotely from India, supporting flexibility and an environment designed to help distributed teams perform at their best. 
 - Comprehensive healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision insurance options, subject to applicable employee benefit plans. 
 - Family support: Generous paid parental leave to support employees and their families through important life events. 
 - Flexible time off: Paid time-off arrangements designed to support personal wellbeing, rest, and work-life balance. 
 - Financial wellbeing: Access to spending accounts and additional benefits, depending on the applicable employment and benefits plan.

 - Global collaboration: The opportunity to work with distributed, cross-functional teams and contribute to technology that supports businesses and professionals across international markets.

data.title: System Software Engineer - Infrastructure
data.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It's a unique legacy of innovation that's fueled by great technology-and amazing people. 

Today, we're tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what's never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you'll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. 

Do you derive more satisfaction from eliminating a manual process than from completing one? Are you the resident tool-builder and creative solution specialist on your team? We're looking for the engineer who invents, crafts and overall automates everything they touch. AI, scripts, workflow redesigns, documentation - it's all at your disposal to empower teams making the world's best firmware for the world's best GPUs. 

Join us, the GPU Firmware Infrastructure team, whose mission is crafting extraordinary automation, tools, and practices that accelerate NVIDIA's GPU innovation. We're responsible for the substrate: dev tools, build compute, test farms, artifact and release pipelines, secure signing services, and the observability that proves it all works. When our platforms are fast and trustworthy, every product ships faster! This is your chance to make waves in the industry while working alongside some of the most top-valued diverse set of minds in the business, building the best AI Supercomputers. If you're up for the task, we'd like to hear from you!

What You'll Be Doing

- Build, supervise, and improve the core infrastructure our firmware teams run on: build systems, regression farms, CI/CD pipelines, developer tooling, and the frameworks and web services that sit on top of them
 - Debug and resolve issues across hardware, software, infrastructure, and team processes - solving not just the present problem, but for that entire class of issue in the future
 - Invent and build AI-powered workflows that scale to multiply your own, your team's, or the whole company's output
 - Learn, document, and automate processes, services, and tooling for teams via many internal-facing and external-facing projects
 - Seek out, identify and eradicate toil company-wide by growing your ideas for improvements from a proof-of-concept to fully shipped and scalable solutions

What We Need To See

- BS or MS degree in EE/CS/CE (or equivalent experience) and 5+ years of software, infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE engineering
 - Hands-on experience with modern CI/CD and test automation: architecting and debugging pipelines, working inside the frameworks that orchestrate the tests (pytest or equivalent)
 - History in, or curiosity about device BIOS, firmware, or other low-level embedded software, and interest in building tooling for the engineers who write it
 - Solid understanding of the services and data behind infrastructure: web services, REST APIs, relational databases and schema design (SQL, PostgreSQL)
 - Scalability thinking
 - Strong Python and comfort working in Linux shell environments
 - Strong communication skills: ability to articulate the sharp questions, write clear requirements, review critically, and explain trade-offs
 - Exceptional interpersonal and empathy skills, and the curiosity to match as you'll work closely with both hardware and software engineers to design, develop, and debug process and tooling enhancements

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Sense of humor heavily encouraged, but not required
 - A side project, open source contribution, or internal tool you built because something annoyed you enough
 - Track record of writing clear technical proposals, design docs, or architecture decisions that others have acted on independently
 - Experience with containers, orchestration, or infrastructure-as-code tooling (K8s)
 - Experience using AI-assisted development tools: knowing what's trustworthy, when to be diligent, and when to throw away the output

Widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www. nvidiabenefits. com/

data.title: Senior Software Engineer Rust- Assistant Vice President
data.description:
Department Overview

The Equities Technology division is responsible for building and maintaining the high-performance, ultra-low-latency trading infrastructure that powers our global equities business. This includes market data dissemination, order routing, algorithmic execution, smart order routing (SOR), and real-time risk management systems. We operate in a highly competitive environment where microseconds matter, requiring cutting-edge software engineering practices, deep hardware-software co-design, and robust system reliability. 

Role Summary

We are seeking an exceptional Senior Software Engineer with deep expertise in Rust and C++ to join our Equities Low-Latency Trading Technology team. 

In this role, you will design, develop, and optimize our next-generation trading systems. You will lead the strategic transition of legacy high-performance C++ components to modern Rust where safety and concurrency are paramount, while continuing to maintain and optimize critical ultra-low-latency C++ execution paths. This is a highly technical role requiring a strong understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, network protocols, and modern software engineering paradigms. 

Key Responsibilities And Skills

8+ YOE is a must have

- System Design & Development
 - Architect, build, and maintain ultra-low-latency trading systems, including exchange connectivity gateways, market data feeds, and algorithmic execution engines using Rust and C++
 - Design clean, modular, and reusable APIs and libraries that can be leveraged across multiple trading desks. 
 - Lead the strategic migration of critical trading components from C++ to Rust, leveraging Rust's memory safety and concurrency guarantees without sacrificing performance. 
 - Performance Optimization
 - Profile and optimize systems to achieve sub-microsecond latencies and deterministic performance. 
 - Apply low-latency techniques such as CPU pinning, cache-friendly data structures, lock-free programming, memory-mapped files, and custom memory allocators. 
 - Utilize kernel bypass technologies (e. g. , Solarflare OpenOnload, DPDK, EF_VI) to minimize network stack overhead. 
 - Concurrency & Reliability
 - Design and implement highly concurrent, thread-safe, and lock-free algorithms to handle massive throughput with minimal jitter. 
 - Implement rigorous testing methodologies, including unit testing, integration testing, property-based testing (in Rust), and high-fidelity simulation/back testing environments. 
 - Ensure the high availability and operational resilience of trading systems through robust error handling and failover mechanisms. 
 - Collaboration & Support
 - Work closely with quantitative researchers, traders, and product managers to translate complex trading strategies and business requirements into robust, production-ready software. 
 - Build real-time telemetry, monitoring, and alerting tools to ensure operational visibility. 
 - Provide level-3 escalation support for production systems during market hours. 

Required Technical Skills & Qualifications

Programming Languages

- C++: Expert-level proficiency in C++ (C++11/14/17/20), with a deep understanding of template metaprogramming, RAII, move semantics, smart pointers, and the standard library (STL). 
 - Rust: Strong proficiency in Rust, including ownership/borrowing concepts, lifetimes, unsafe Rust boundaries, macro systems, and the Cargo ecosystem. 

Systems Programming & Low-Latency

- Deep understanding of Linux operating system internals (kernel tuning, memory management, virtual memory, page faults, system calls). 
 - Experience with low-latency networking (TCP/IP, UDP, Multicast) and socket programming. 
 - Familiarity with hardware-level concepts: CPU cache hierarchies (L1/L2/L3), TLB, branch prediction, and memory barriers. 

Concurrency

- Proven experience in multi-threaded programming, memory models (sequential consistency, acquire-release), and lock-free data structures. 

Equities Domain Knowledge

- Solid understanding of Equities market structure, order types, exchange protocols (FIX, OUCH, ITCH), and trading lifecycles. 

Tools & Infrastructure

- Experience with profiling and debugging tools (gdb, valgrind, perf, VTune, heaptrack). 
 - Proficiency with build systems (CMake, Cargo) and CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins/GitHub Actions). 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with FPGA integration or hardware acceleration. 
 - Experience with kernel bypass technologies (Solarflare EF_VI, OpenOnload, DPDK). 
 - Knowledge of market-making, smart order routing (SOR), or statistical arbitrage execution strategies. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related quantitative field. 

Core Competencies

- Analytical Thinking: Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze complex systems and identify performance bottlenecks. 
 - Collaboration: Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional team environment. 
 - Adaptability: Eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving business requirements and market conditions. 
 - Quality Focus: Commitment to writing clean, well-documented, and thoroughly tested code.

PETADATA is looking for a skilled Senior Technical Architect to own the architecture of a scalable, secure, multi-tenant SaaS platform. The role will drive system design, distributed systems, data architecture, cloud infrastructure, security, and integrations while setting technical standards across engineering. The ideal candidate is a principal-level architect with proven experience scaling production SaaS systems and strong technical leadership skills. 

Key Responsibilities Multi-Tenant Architecture

- Design the platform's multi-tenancy model, including tenant isolation, data partitioning, per-tenant configuration, and noisy-neighbor mitigation. 
 - Architect reliable tenant provisioning, onboarding, scaling, and decommissioning. 
 - Ensure tenant data isolation and security across all system layers. 

Scalability & Distributed Systems

- Design systems capable of handling large data volumes and concurrent migration workloads. 
 - Architect async/event-driven processing, queues, horizontal scaling, backpressure, retries, and idempotency. 
 - Define the overall data architecture, including storage, partitioning, streaming, batch processing, and data pipelines. 
 - Select appropriate architectural patterns while avoiding unnecessary complexity and over-engineering. 

Reliability & Security

- Establish high availability, fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and SLA strategies. 
 - Build security and compliance into the architecture, including encryption, access control, secrets management, auditing, and tenant isolation. 
 - Define the observability strategy for monitoring, tracing, and troubleshooting distributed systems. 

Integration & Platform Architecture

- Architect a scalable connector and integration framework supporting systems such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, databases, and object stores.

 - Partner with DevOps/Infrastructure teams on cloud and multi-cloud architecture across AWS, GCP, and Azure. 

Technical Leadership

 - Deep expertise in distributed systems, including event-driven processing, queues, horizontal scaling, consistency, fault tolerance, and high-throughput workloads. 
 - Strong data architecture experience covering data modeling, partitioning, batch/streaming pipelines, and data-intensive systems.

 - Strong understanding of security, compliance, tenant isolation, encryption, access control, and frameworks such as SOC 2/GDPR. 
 - Strong software engineering and coding skills, with the ability to prototype and work directly with complex parts of the codebase. 
 - Proven technical leadership and influence, with experience setting architecture direction and earning trust across engineering teams. 
 - Experience with data migration, ETL/integration, iPaaS, or large-scale connector frameworks is preferred.

data.title: Lead Developer - Java and Microservices
data.description:
We are seeking a highly experienced and technically accomplished Application Dev Lead to join our team, responsible for architecting, developing, and leading our core banking integration strategies and modern microservices ecosystem. The ideal candidate will be a subject matter expert in integration technologies, possess deep, hands-on expertise in Java Microservices and enterprise Database engineering (Oracle/SQL), have extensive knowledge of the financial services domain, and demonstrate a proven track record of leading technical teams to deliver robust, scalable, and secure solutions. 

This role requires a unique blend of hands-on technical excellence, architectural vision, database performance optimization, and strong people management skills to drive the modernization and stability of our mission-critical banking systems. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Leadership & People Management

- Team Leadership & Mentorship: Lead, manage, and mentor a high-performing team of developers, backend engineers, and integration specialists, fostering technical capability, career growth, and engineering excellence across Java microservices and middleware platforms. 
 - Project & Delivery Ownership: Take full ownership of technical delivery across complex integration initiatives, including architectural scoping, task breakdown (WBS), accurate sprint estimation, resource planning, and milestone prioritization. 
 - Quality Assurance & Engineering Governance: Enforce best-in-class engineering practices by conducting rigorous code reviews, pull request audits, and comprehensive architectural design reviews (TDRs). 
 - Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate seamlessly across business lines, enterprise architecture, database administrators, infrastructure, Information Security, and third-party vendor teams to align technical delivery with strategic business goals. 
 - SME & Agile Delivery: Act as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for complex escalations, production incident triage (Sev-1/MIM), and root-cause analysis, while driving Agile/Scrum ceremonies to ensure predictable, high-quality, and timely delivery. 

Technical & Domain Responsibilities

- Java Microservices Architecture: Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, containerized Java microservices using Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and RESTful/gRPC APIs, implementing distributed resilience patterns (Saga orchestrations, Circuit Breakers, Bulkheads, Outbox pattern). 
 - Database Engineering & Query Performance: Design robust database models and persistence layers (Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, JDBC), execute query tuning, analyze execution plans (EXPLAIN PLAN), optimize indexing strategies (B-Tree, Bitmap, composite), and resolve connection pool (HikariCP) and row-level locking contentions in enterprise Oracle/SQL environments. 
 - High-Availability Integration Design: Design and implement resilient, distributed integration solutions prioritizing active-active high availability (HA), fault tolerance, multi-region disaster recovery (DR), recoverability, and minimal business disruption. 
 - Legacy-to-Cloud Modernization: Lead the architectural evolution and phased decomposition of legacy centralized middleware (TIBCO BusinessWorks, IBM MQ) into distributed, event-driven architectures utilizing Apache Kafka and cloud-native Java microservices. 
 - Banking Domain Systems Integration: Apply deep expertise in banking and financial services to integration architecture, specifically in real-time fraud detection, payment processing rails (ISO 20022, SWIFT, Fedwire, ACH), clearing and settlement, and core enterprise banking ledgers. 
 - Security, Audit & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all integration services strictly comply with enterprise security baselines, audit controls, regulatory mandates (OCC, Fed, PRA, MAS), data protection rules (PII, PCI-DSS), Mutual TLS (mTLS) certificate management, and operational resilience standards. 
 - High-Volume Real-Time Messaging: Oversee the architecture, throughput tuning, and management of real-time transaction flows, high-volume messaging pipelines, dead-letter queue (DLQ) automation, and sub-second SLA routing. 

Recommended Qualifications

Core Technical Skills

- Java & Microservices: 
 - Advanced proficiency in Core Java (Java 11/17/21), Multithreading, Concurrency, and JVM tuning (Memory management, Garbage Collection - G1GC/ZGC). 
 - Hands-on mastery of Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Batch). 
 - Deep experience with Microservices patterns (Saga Orchestration/Choreography, CQRS, Circuit Breaker via Resilience4j, API Gateway routing). 
 - Containerization and orchestration experience using Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift. 
 - Database & Data Persistence: 
 - Advanced expertise in Relational Databases: Oracle (19c+), SQL, PL/SQL, stored procedures, functions, packages, and triggers. 
 - Deep knowledge of Query Performance Tuning, Execution Plan analysis (EXPLAIN PLAN), index design, partitioning, and stats gathering. 
 - Mastery of connection pool management (HikariCP), lock contention mitigation, deadlock resolution, and transaction isolation levels (READ COMMITTED, SERIALIZABLE). 
 - Solid understanding of ORM frameworks (Hibernate, JPA) and mitigation of ORM antipatterns (N+1 queries, dirty checks). 
 - Enterprise Middleware & Messaging: 
 - Subject Matter Expertise in TIBCO technologies: TIBCO BusinessWorks (BW 5. x / 6. x), TIBCO Enterprise Message Service (EMS), TIBCO Administrator/TEA. 
 - In-depth experience with enterprise queuing and streaming: IBM MQ and Apache Kafka (Topic design, Partitioning, Consumer Groups, Schema Registry). 
 - APIs & Protocols: 
 - Contract-first API development: RESTful Web Services, OpenAPI/Swagger, SOAP Web Services, gRPC. 
 - Data formatting & transformation: JSON, XML, XSD, WSDL, XPath, XSLT, and Canonical Data Modeling. 
 - Security & Cryptography: 
 - Solid foundation in transport and application security: SSL/TLS 1. 3, Mutual TLS (mTLS), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Keystores/Truststores, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, and API Key/Token management. 
 - DevOps, CI/CD & Observability: 
 - Build & CI/CD toolchains: Git, Maven, Gradle, Harness, TeamCity, Jenkins, uDeploy. 
 - Comprehensive monitoring & logging: Splunk, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, Micrometer, and distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry/Zipkin). 
Good To Have Skills

- Automated Testing & Quality Engineering: 
 - Experience with Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD). 
 - Familiarity with unit and integration testing frameworks such as JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers, and Spring Boot Test. 
 - Experience with API contract testing tools (Pact, Spring Cloud Contract) and performance/load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling). 
 - Knowledge of automated code quality gates and static analysis tools (SonarQube, Checkstyle). 
Banking Domain Expertise

- Deep expertise in banking and financial services integration architecture and enterprise application patterns. 
 - Proven experience with real-time fraud detection pipelines, payment processing rails (ISO 20022, SWIFT MT/MX, Fedwire, NACHA/ACH, RTP), core ledger accounting, and trade/transaction processing systems. 
 - In-depth knowledge of real-time transactional flows, straight-through processing (STP), guaranteed exactly-once delivery, idempotency key patterns, and high-volume messaging resilience. 
 - Hands-on familiarity with global banking regulations, audit readiness, operational resilience standards, and data protection frameworks (GLBA, GDPR, PCI-DSS). 

Leadership & Management

- Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, and managing technical teams of developers, backend engineers, and integration architects. 
 - Proven ability to manage full end-to-end technical delivery, including architectural roadmapping, scope definition, backlog grooming, estimation, and task prioritization. 
 - Track record of establishing engineering best practices, leading code reviews, reducing technical debt, and elevating team capabilities in modern technologies. 
 - Exceptional stakeholder management, technical communication, and presentation skills across technical teams and executive business sponsors. 
 - Strong proficiency in driving agile project delivery using Scrum/Kanban methodologies, sprint planning, and release governance.

Job Description

JOB DESCRIPTION

Senior Firmware Developer - Thermal Application

Location - Pune Chakan

Position Summary

The Senior Firmware Developer - Thermal Application engineer will be responsible for leading the design, development, validation, and support of electrical and electronic systems for HVAC equipment, with strong hands‐on experience in screw chiller machines and thermal products. This role involves technical leadership, cross‐functional coordination, and end‐to‐end ownership of electrical, controls, and integration activities throughout the product lifecycle-from concept to commissioning. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design and development of electrical and electronic systems for HVAC machines, including screw chillers and thermal products. 
 - Prepare, review, and approve electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, control panel layouts, interlock logic, and BOMs. 
 - Select and integrate electrical and electronic components such as VFDs, controllers, PLCs, HMIs, sensors, protection devices, and safety components. 
 - Lead and support PLC and HMI programming activities, including control logic review, I/O allocation, tag mapping, alarm handling, and parameter optimization. 
 - Drive BMS integration (BACnet / Modbus or equivalent), including points list definition, signal mapping, validation, and coordination with site/BMS teams. 
 - Support control philosophy development and close integration of electrical systems with controls and embedded software. 
 - Drive design validation testing (DVT), dry testing, performance testing, and troubleshooting in lab and factory environments. 
 - Lead root cause analysis and corrective action implementation for electrical and controls‐related issues identified during testing or field operation. 
 - Support commissioning, field issues, and service escalations related to electrical, controls, and automation systems. 
 - Coordinate with Mechanical, Software, Product Management, QA, Sourcing, and Service teams to ensure successful product execution. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable electrical standards, safety norms, cybersecurity guidelines (where applicable), and regulatory requirements. 
 - Support component localization, alternate sourcing, and cost optimization initiatives without compromising performance or reliability. 
 - Provide technical guidance, reviews, and mentoring to junior engineers and team members. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, or Instrumentation Engineering (or equivalent). 
 - 4 to 6 years of relevant industry experience, preferably in HVAC, industrial machinery, or automation systems. 
 - Strong machine‐level experience with HVAC systems, particularly screw chiller machines and thermal products. 
 - Deep knowledge of industrial electrical systems, power distribution, control panels, safety circuits, and VFD applications. 
 - Solid working experience with PLC and HMI programming in industrial or HVAC applications. 
 - Proven exposure to BMS integration using standard industrial protocols such as BACnet and Modbus. 
 - Working knowledge of programming languages such as C, C++, Structured Text (ST), and Function Block Diagram (FBD); ability to review logic and coordinate with software teams. 
 - Hands‐on experience in testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting complex HVAC and automation systems. 
 - Proficient in reading and interpreting electrical drawings, control schematics, functional descriptions, and technical specifications. 
 - Strong analytical, problem‐solving, communication, and team‐leadership skills.

data.title: Director of Engineering- Frontend
data.description:
About The Role

ThoughtSpot is looking for a bold, technically fearless Director of Engineering to lead the Connected Insights track - the heart of ThoughtSpot's visualization, navigation, and frontend experience. This track spans three high-impact teams: FE Infra (module federation, client caching, build systems, performance, and developer platform tooling), Charts (the rendering engine for ThoughtSpot's visualization library, from core charting primitives to agent-driven chart configuration via the Answer API), and Liveboard (the primary interactive canvas in ThoughtSpot - architecture, presentation & interactivity, agent integration, and the AI-driven Liveboard experience). 

This is a pivotal moment for the Connected Insights track. The frontend tech stack is deep and modern - React, GraphQL, module federation, complex state management - and the architecture is ready for a thoughtful rethink. We need someone who will question assumptions, challenge the status quo, and bring the curiosity and technical horsepower to redesign for the next era of ThoughtSpot's scale and AI-first product vision. 

Equally important: the bug backlog is real. This leader must approach quality differently - not just as a process checkbox, but as an engineering culture and operational discipline that the team owns and takes pride in. 

What You'll Do

Lead & Scale Three Frontend -Heavy Teams

- Own the engineering roadmap, headcount, and technical vision for FE Infra, Charts, and Liveboard - three teams with deep React and TypeScript DNA. 
 - Be an active presence in architecture forums and design reviews - not just signing off, but shaping technical direction hands-on. 
 - Build and develop engineering managers and senior ICs into the next generation of ThoughtSpot leaders. 
 - Hire relentlessly for intellectual curiosity, ownership mindset, and frontend depth. 

Rethink the Architecture

- Audit the current architecture across module federation, client cache design, state management, rendering performance, and component system - and build a compelling vision for what comes next. 
 - Lead the move to a scalable, maintainable, and AI-ready frontend foundation that can power ThoughtSpot's Spotter, SpotterViz, and next-generation Liveboard experiences. 
 - Drive architectural decisions with first-principles thinking, not convention - question every assumption about how the frontend is structured today. 
 - Define and own the technical north star for frontend infrastructure, charting capabilities, and interactive Liveboard experiences. 

Attack the Bug Backlog & Raise the Quality Bar

- Treat the bug backlog as a cultural and operational challenge, not just a ticket queue - instill a quality-first mindset across all three teams. 
 - Build operational systems (on-call hygiene, bug SLAs, regression prevention, automated testing frameworks) that structurally reduce bug accumulation. 
 - Define quality metrics that the teams live by - not just defect counts, but incident response time, customer-impacting regressions, and release reliability. 
 - Partner with customer success and support to close the loop between customer-facing bugs and engineering accountability. 

Drive Cross-Functional Impact

- Work tightly with Product, Design, and the AI/Spotter teams to ensure the frontend platform keeps pace with an increasingly AI-native product surface. 
 - Represent the Connected Insights track in R&D staff reviews, quarterly planning, and executive discussions with clarity, data, and conviction. 
 - Be the connective tissue between what customers experience in the UI and what engineering builds - customer obsession must be visible in every architectural and process decision. 

What You Have

Non-Negotiables

- 15+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5+ years in senior engineering leadership (Director level or above) managing multiple teams. 
 - Deep hands-on frontend engineering background - production React, GraphQL caching patterns, module federation, and the modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem at scale. 
 - Proven track record of architectural reinvention - you've led a team through a meaningful frontend re-architecture, not just incremental improvement. 
 - Track record of raising quality standards in a team with a meaningful bug backlog - you know how to make this cultural, not just procedural. 
 - Excellent judgment in hiring, developing, and retaining senior IC and EM talent. 
 - Strong communication and cross-functional influence - comfortable presenting to executive leadership and working shoulder-to-shoulder with product and design. 

Strongly Valued

- Experience building or scaling visualization/charting systems - chart rendering performance, SVG/Canvas tradeoffs, animation, responsive design at scale. 
 - Familiarity with AI-integrated product surfaces - building frontend systems that adapt to and expose LLM/NLP capabilities to end users. 
 - Experience in enterprise SaaS environments with multi-tenancy, embedded analytics (SDK, iframe, component embedding), and stringent performance/security requirements. 
 - Prior experience working in geographically distributed teams, particularly with India-based engineering centers. 
 - Exposure to backend services and data pipelines - enough to have informed conversations with backend counterparts and own end-to-end product quality.

data.title: Head – Quality (Food & Nutraceutical Ingredients)
data.company: Spray Drying and Chemicals Pvt Ltd
data.description:
About the role

SDC is hiring a Head - Quality to build the quality and food safety system of a fast-scaling ingredient manufacturer, not to maintain one that already exists. 

Spray Drying and Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. (SDC) manufactures food and nutraceutical ingredients at Saykha Industrial Estate, Bharuch, Gujarat. We are FSSC 22000, Halal and Kosher certified, US FDA registered, and export to the US and EU. The plant runs 24x7, and new production lines are being added. 

Growth has outrun our systems. Documentation, batch records, specifications and audit readiness exist, but they are not yet lived on the shop floor every shift. The gap is cultural as much as technical. This role exists to close it. 

You will report directly to the Directors, own the Quality Assurance and Quality Control functions end to end, and have the mandate to change how the plant works. This is a leadership seat with a board-level voice, not a documentation role. Building systems and building culture are the two things that matter most in this role; everything else follows from them. 

Role at a glance

• Reports to: Directors

• Direct reports: QA and QC teams (team leads, executives, analysts)

• Base: Surat Head Office, with presence at the Saykha (Bharuch) plant at least 3 days a week and whenever the plant needs it

• Key interfaces: Production, Engineering, Projects, Warehouse, R&D, Purchase, Sales, customers, auditors, certification bodies, FSSAI

• Scope: Full accountability for food safety, quality systems, QC laboratory, compliance, customer quality and quality culture across the site

What you will own

You are accountable for outcomes, delivered through your team. Culture and systems are the priority; they are where the role will be judged first. 

1. Quality culture and leadership

• Make food safety and quality a shop-floor habit on every shift, not a QA-department activity. 

• Build a culture where operators stop a line, raise a deviation and record it honestly without fear. 

• Lead, structure and grow the QA and QC teams: roles, KRAs, training plans, succession and performance. 

• Act as the senior voice for quality with Production and Engineering; resolve quality-versus-output conflicts at the leadership level. 

• Run a visible quality rhythm: daily shop-floor rounds, weekly quality reviews, monthly management review with the Directors. 

2. Quality and food safety management systems

• Own the FSMS and QMS end to end: FSSC 22000, ISO 22000, HACCP, GMP, GHP, PRPs and allergen management. 

• Build and maintain the full documentation architecture: manuals, SOPs, work instructions, formats, records and document control. 

• Design and govern Batch Manufacturing Records: issue, in-process checks, label verification, post-production review and release. 

• Run the CAPA, deviation, change-control and non-conformance systems so that root causes are found and closed, not just logged. 

• Own validation, verification, calibration and the internal audit programme. 

3. Quality control and laboratory

• Set specifications and test plans for raw materials, packaging, in-process material and finished goods. 

• Run the QC laboratory: methods, instruments, calibration, reference standards, analyst competence and data integrity. 

• Manage external laboratory testing and the testing schedule required by certifications and customers. 

• Own the release decision for every batch. 

4. Compliance, certifications and audits

• Keep SDC audit-ready at all times for FSSC 22000, Halal, Kosher, organic, US FDA and FSSAI. 

• Lead all certification, regulatory and customer audits; own the response and closure of findings. 

• Track Indian and international regulatory change (FSSAI, US FDA, EU) and translate it into plant practice. 

• Own supplier quality: approval, specifications, audits and performance for imported raw materials and packaging. 

5. Customer quality

• Own customer complaints: investigation, root cause, response and prevention. 

• Deliver customer quality documentation: questionnaires, specifications, certificates, statements and technical files, working with Sales. 

• Support customer audits and technical visits as the quality face of SDC. 

6. Systems for scale

• Design the quality system for the new production lines so new capacity starts compliant on day one. 

• Digitise quality records and dashboards in SDC's internal ERP; replace paper where it slows the plant. 

• Define and report quality KPIs to the Directors: right-first-time, deviations, CAPA closure, complaints, audit findings, training coverage. 

7. New product development and regulatory

• Own the quality and regulatory workstream for every new product: specifications, test methods, shelf-life and stability studies, allergen and contaminant assessment. 

• Prepare and maintain process validation, cleaning validation and method validation documentation for new products and new lines. 

• Build the regulatory file for each new product: FSSAI compliance, export market requirements (US FDA, EU), labelling and claims, certification scope extensions (Halal, Kosher, organic). 

• Work with R&D from concept stage so that products reach the plant with specifications, controls and documentation already in place. 

What success looks like in the first 12 months

By 90 days: a gap assessment of the plant against FSSC 22000, GMP and customer requirements with a prioritised closure plan agreed with the Directors; the QA/QC team mapped with capability gaps and a hiring or training plan; daily quality rounds and a weekly quality review running and attended by Production. 

By 6 months: BMR, deviation and CAPA systems redesigned and in use on every shift; SOP and document-control architecture rebuilt; shop-floor training programme live with coverage tracked by shift and role; quality KPIs reported monthly to the Directors. 

By 12 months: a surveillance or recertification audit passed with no major non-conformance; customer complaints closed with documented root cause within an agreed turnaround; quality system ready for the new production lines before commissioning; quality decisions made at floor and team-lead level without escalation to the Directors. 

Who we are looking for

A quality leader who has already built or rebuilt a system in a growing food plant and wants to do it again with full ownership. 

Experience

• 10-15 years in quality assurance and quality control in food, nutraceutical, dairy, flavour or food-ingredient manufacturing; at least 4 years heading or deputy-heading a plant quality function. 

• Has personally led a site through FSSC 22000 or ISO 22000 certification, or through a major system rebuild; has faced customer and regulatory audits as the accountable person. 

• Experience in an export-oriented B2B ingredient business supplying US or EU customers is a strong advantage. 

• Experience with powder, drying, blending or encapsulation processes is an advantage; a strong learner from an adjacent food sector will also be considered. 

• Has built or led a team of 8 or more across QA and QC. 

Education and certifications

• B. Tech, B. Sc or M. Sc in Food Technology, Dairy Technology, Microbiology, Chemistry or a related discipline. 

• FSSC 22000 or ISO 22000 lead auditor; HACCP certification. PCQI (US FDA FSMA) is an advantage. 

Competencies that matter here

• Changes behaviour on a shop floor, not just documents in an office; comfortable spending most of the day in the plant. 

• Holds the line on quality with Production under output pressure, and does it without creating enemies. 

• Builds systems that survive without them: clear ownership, simple formats, trained people. 

• Finds root causes; is not satisfied by a CAPA that only reassigns blame. 

• Communicates clearly in English and Gujarati or Hindi with operators, Directors, auditors and overseas customers. 

• Thrives in a company where structure is still being built and ambiguity is normal. 

Why join SDC

• Build, not maintain. You will design the quality system of a plant that is adding new production lines, and it will carry your name. 

• Direct access to the Directors. No layers. Decisions on budget, hiring and plant changes happen in the same week they are raised. 

• Global customers. Our products go into food and nutraceutical brands in the US, EU and Asia; your work is tested against international audit standards, not local ones alone. 

• A growing platform. SDC is moving from a single-ingredient specialist to a multi-product ingredient and contract-manufacturing platform, with an in-house R&D and pilot facility. The quality function grows with it. 

• Compensation that reflects a head-of-function role. Competitive fixed salary benchmarked to established food companies, performance-linked variable pay, and relocation support for the Bharuch-Surat region. Specific terms discussed at interview. 

How to apply

Apply through LinkedIn, or email your CV to hr@sdcplindia. com
