data.title: Senior Enterprise Software Engineer (JD Edwards)
data.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a highly accomplished, hands-on Senior Lead Operations Manager to join our enterprise technology leadership team. This pivotal role blends deep technical execution with strategic leadership across four core disciplines: JD Edwards EnterpriseOne (JDE E1), IBM Integration technologies, Cloud Architecture, and emerging Artificial Intelligence practices. 

The ideal candidate is not a bystander manager - they roll up their sleeves, architect solutions, and directly contribute to development, configuration, and administration while simultaneously guiding a team of engineers and analysts. You thrive in fast-paced environments, absorb new technologies at exceptional speed, and champion a culture of continuous innovation. 

Key Responsibilities

Operational Leadership & Team Management

- Lead, mentor, and manage a cross-functional team of developers, CNC administrators, integration engineers, and cloud architects. 
 - Define operational KPIs, SLAs, and delivery roadmaps for all enterprise platform areas. 
 - Drive Agile/DevOps delivery practices including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives. 
 - Act as escalation point for critical incidents and ensure timely resolution with root-cause analysis. 
 - Partner with business stakeholders, functional analysts, and C-suite to translate business needs into technology solutions. 

JD Edwards EnterpriseOne - Development, Architecture & CNC Administration

- Provide hands-on technical leadership across the complete JDE E1 stack spanning custom development, functional configuration, CNC infrastructure, and Oracle database administration. 
 - Architect and develop JDE customizations using Business Functions (BSFNs), Named Event Rules (NERs), Report Design Aid (RDA), Form Design Aid (FDA), Table Design Aid (TDA), and Data Dictionary extensions. 
 - Design and deploy JDE Orchestrator Framework solutions - building orchestrations, connectors, cross-reference rules, and form requests to automate business workflows and expose JDE services as REST APIs. 
 - Lead User Defined Object (UDO) governance: Composite Pages, Watchlists, Notifications, One View Reports, and EnterpriseOne Pages configuration and lifecycle management. 
 - Architect and implement JDE integrations via Business Function calls, Interoperability (XML/Z-files), RESTful and SOAP web services, and third-party middleware adapters. 
 - Own and lead end-to-end JDE EnterpriseOne upgrade projects - from current-release assessment and gap analysis through to production cutover - including major application releases (e. g. , 9. 0 to 9. 2) and incremental Application Service Packs (ASPs). 
 - Plan and execute JDE Tools Release upgrades (e. g. , TR 9. 2. x. x series): download and stage ESU/ASU bundles from Oracle Update Center, run the Tools Release installer on Enterprise and HTML Web Servers, validate planner and spec merge, and post-upgrade regression test all critical business objects. 
 - Manage the full Application Service Update (ASU) and Electronic Software Update (ESU) lifecycle: evaluate Oracle support patches, assess object conflicts using the Object Management Workbench (OMW) conflict checker, apply updates through Change Management, and produce post-apply validation reports. 
 - Perform and document pre-upgrade checklist activities: hardware and OS prerequisite validation, Oracle Database version compatibility matrix review, JVM and WebLogic/JBoss version alignment, disk capacity planning, and backup verification. 
 - Coordinate co-existence environments during upgrade cycles - maintaining multiple tools release levels across DV, PY, and PD path codes to support parallel development, QA testing, and production stability simultaneously. 
 - Perform deep CNC administration across all JDE server tiers: Enterprise Server (Logic Server), HTML Web Server, Deployment Server, and Batch Processing / UBE Server on both Linux (RHEL / Oracle Linux) and Windows Server platforms. 
 - Provision, configure, and maintain JDE environments from scratch: stand up new logic server instances, configure jde. ini / jdbj. ini / jas. ini, define server maps, configure ports and JMX monitoring, and register environments in the Server Manager Management Console (SMMC). 
 - Administer the Deployment Server: manage path codes (PRISTINE, DEMO, DV733, PY733, PD733, and custom path codes), configure package build INI settings, maintain the Central Objects business data source, and control check-in/check-out workflows in OMW. 
 - Execute full package builds - both Full and Partial packages - including: setting package build definitions, resolving spec merge errors, monitoring Package Assembly and Deploy logs, managing the deployment queue, and validating successful client and server package deployment. 
 - Configure and manage JDE Change Management: define environments and path codes, set up promotion paths (DV -> PY -> PD), govern Object Librarian (OL) projects, manage OMW user roles and activity rules, and enforce promotion approval workflows. 
 - Administer JDE Security: configure Application Security (Action, Row, Column, Tab, Version security), Orchestrator token-based security, Single Sign-On (SSO) via SAML/LDAP integration, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) aligned with SOX and audit requirements. 
 - Manage the JDE Scheduler: configure and monitor UBE job queues, set host and subsystem job priorities, tune concurrent job limits, diagnose stuck/failed jobs, and manage batch version control and interactive server routing. 
 - Monitor and tune JDE system performance: analyze HTML Server heap dumps and GC logs, tune JVM parameters (Xmx/Xms/MaxPermSize), review logic server kernel configuration, diagnose slow UBE execution, and optimize jde. log / jdedebug. log verbosity and rotation policies. 
 - Lead new JDE environment provisioning projects end-to-end: requirements scoping, server sizing, OS-level prerequisite configuration, Oracle DB schema creation, JDE Planner installation, workbench environment setup, and handoff to development or QA teams. 
 - Build and configure additional path codes for specialized purposes (e. g. , RETROFIT, TRAINING, UAT, REPORT-DEV) - including creating new business data sources, system data sources, and object librarian data sources, and configuring server map entries accordingly. 
 - Establish and maintain Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity (BCP) environments: configure replication or restore procedures for Enterprise Server, Deployment Server, and Oracle databases; document and periodically test failover runbooks. 
 - Administer Oracle Database (versions 12c, 19c, and 21c) supporting JDE EnterpriseOne on both Oracle Linux / RHEL and Windows Server platforms - including installation, patching (PSU/CPU/RU), listener configuration, and TNS connectivity. 
 - Manage JDE-specific Oracle DB objects: Central Objects (COCTL), Business Data, Control Tables, and Versions data sources - including tablespace sizing, index management, and regular schema statistics gathering (ANALYZE / DBMS_STATS) to ensure query plan stability. 
 - Perform Oracle DBA tasks in support of JDE operations: export/import using DataPump (expdp/impdp) for environment refreshes, RMAN backup and restore, Flashback operations, AWR and ADDM performance report analysis, and deadlock/latch contention investigation via V$ views. 
 - Tune Oracle SQL performance for JDE: review execution plans using EXPLAIN PLAN and SQL Trace / TKPROF, identify and resolve full table scans on high-volume JDE tables (F0911, F4211, F43121 etc. ), create or rebuild indexes, and gather optimizer statistics on schedule. 
 - Configure and manage Oracle Data Guard or Oracle RAC (Real Application Clusters) to provide high availability for JDE production database tiers on Linux; manage redo log shipping, standby switchover/failover procedures, and TAF (Transparent Application Failover) settings. 
 - Administer Oracle networking on Linux: configure tnsnames. ora, listener. ora, sqlnet. ora; manage Oracle Wallet for encrypted database connections; and control OS-level oracle user permissions, ulimits, and kernel parameter tuning (shmmax, semaphores, open file limits). 
 - Manage Oracle databases on Windows Server: configure Oracle Windows Services, OracleDBConsole, NTFS permission structures for Oracle homes, Windows Scheduler tasks for backup jobs, and Event Log integration for Oracle alert log monitoring. 
 - Perform periodic JDE database health checks: purge JDE log tables (F9861, jdeDebug), archive obsolete versions, compress historic business data, and manage tablespace free-space thresholds with proactive alerting. 

IBM Integration - Integration Developer & MQ/IIB Administration

- Architect, develop, and administer IBM Integration Bus (IIB) / App Connect Enterprise (ACE) message flows, policies, and deployment BAR files. 
 - Design and manage IBM MQ infrastructure including queue managers, channels, topic-based messaging, and high-availability clustering. 
 - Lead integration governance - define patterns, reusable components, and API management policies. 
 - Implement end-to-end monitoring for integration pipelines using MQ Explorer, IBM Operations Console, and third-party observability tools. 
 - Troubleshoot production integration failures, analyze message flows, and lead performance optimization efforts. 
 - Evaluate and plan migration paths from IIB to IBM App Connect Professional/Enterprise or cloud-native alternatives. 

Cloud Solution Architecture & Automation

- Design, implement, and govern multi-cloud and hybrid-cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP) aligned with enterprise security and compliance standards. 
 - Lead cloud-native solution design including microservices, serverless computing, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and API Gateway strategies. 
 - Drive cloud automation initiatives using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools - Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or equivalent. 
 - Develop CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices to accelerate delivery velocity while maintaining quality gates. 
 - Oversee cloud cost optimization, FinOps practices, and capacity planning. 
 - Establish cloud security posture management (CSPM), identity and access policies, and compliance guardrails (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR). 
 - Lead cloud migration strategies for on-premises JDE and IBM workloads into cloud environments. 

AI Strategy & Emerging Technology Adoption

- Champion an AI-first mindset across the operations and engineering team - identifying automation, efficiency, and insight opportunities. 
 - Evaluate, pilot, and operationalize AI/ML tools and platforms (e. g. , AWS , Azure AI Services, OpenAI APIs). 
 - Integrate generative AI and intelligent automation into business workflows, JDE processes, and integration pipelines. 
 - Stay current with the rapidly evolving AI landscape; rapidly acquire new skills and facilitate team enablement workshops. 
 - Partner with data engineering and analytics teams to build AI-ready data pipelines and governance practices. 

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we're getting to know you-not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process. 

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

data.description:
Sanas is pioneering the future of human communication. Founded by a team of Stanford researchers and entrepreneurs with deep industry experience, Sanas has developed the world's first real-time speech AI platform capable of accent translation, noise cancellation, speech enhancement, cross-language communication, and more. 

Sanas makes conversations clearer, more inclusive, and more effective, removing barriers that prevent people from being understood, regardless of accent, background noise, or native language. 

Sanas is currently one of the fastest growing startups in Silicon Valley, growing from $16M to $50M ARR in 2025. The company's core business is profitable and is on track to end 2026 with >$77M ARR. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering with a design-minded product engineering culture to build and ship cutting-edge AI models and experiences - entirely in-house. 

Sanas is a 130 person team, established in 2020. In this short span, we've successfully secured over $100 million in funding. Our innovation has been supported by the industry's leading investors, including Insight Partners, Google Ventures, Quadrille Capital, General Catalyst, Quiet Capital, and other influential investors. Our reputation is further solidified by collaborations with numerous Fortune 100 companies. With Sanas, you're not just adopting a product; you're investing in the future of communication. 

If you're looking to have a significant role in roadmapping and driving technical directions, if you're looking to deploy challenging and big ideas without much overhead or slowness, if you're looking to leave your mark on an ambitious, generational mission to change how the worlds thinks about speech + AI, then Sanas is a well-suited place for you. 

About The Role

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to set technical direction across multiple teams and raise the bar for how we build real-time voice AI. You'll own our hardest cross-cutting problems: the architecture of a platform that runs in live conversations, reliability and latency at production scale and developer velocity across our Desktop App, SDK, Voice Gateway and Portal. 

As Sanas expands beyond contact centers into telecom, enterprise communication and custom voice products, your architectural decisions will shape how the platform scales. 

This is a senior individual contributor role, not a management track. You'll stay hands-on in the code while multiplying the impact of the engineers around you. 

What You'll Do

- Set technical direction. Define and drive architecture across our client (Desktop App / SDK), gateway and cloud backend systems. Balance near-term customer delivery against long-term scalability as we move from contact centers into telecom and enterprise. 
 - Own real-time performance. Treat end-to-end latency, audio quality, CPU and memory footprint and uptime as first-class requirements. Our products run live on customer calls, where regressions are immediately audible. 
 - Lead cross-team initiatives. Take ambiguous, high-impact problems that span the SDK, backend, ML inference and DevOps teams, turn them into clear plans and see them through to production. 
 - Stay hands-on. Write and review production code, prototype new approaches and dig into the hardest bugs across the client, backend services and deployment layers. 
 - Make decisions visible. Write design docs and architecture decision records that explain the reasoning behind technical choices. 
 - Raise the bar. Establish and model best practices for code quality, testing, observability, security and operational excellence. 
 - Mentor and grow engineers. Coach senior and mid-level engineers and help shape how we interview and level technical talent. 
 - Partner beyond engineering. Work with Product, Research/ML, Customer Success and leadership to shape the roadmap, surface technical risks early and support enterprise customer and technical requirements. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field. 
 - 8-12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant time at a senior or staff level. 
 - A track record of designing and shipping large-scale, low-latency systems that served real users and held up in production. 
 - Deep expertise in one or more of Rust, Python & GoLang with strong command of distributed systems and RESTful API design. 
 - Hands-on experience with AWS, Docker and Kubernetes (preferably EKS), CI/CD and modern observability tooling. 
 - Familiarity with databases such as PostgreSQL and ClickHouse. 
 - The ability to lead through influence: aligning stakeholders, resolving technical disagreements and driving outcomes without formal authority. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining complex tradeoffs to engineers and non-technical partners. 
 - Sound judgment about when to build for the long term and when to ship pragmatically. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with real-time audio, speech, VoIP/SIP, WebRTC, or telephony systems. 
 - Experience productionizing ML inference on-device or in the cloud with tight latency budgets. 
 - Experience with cross-platform desktop application or SDK development. 
 - Experience with Kafka or other event-driven platforms and with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools. 
 - Experience scaling a system through an order-of-magnitude increase in load at a high-growth startup. 
 - Exposure to enterprise security and compliance requirements (SOC 2, ISO 27001). 
 - Ability to rapidly develop high-quality code with AI copilots (like Claude) using spec-driven development methods. 
 - Contributions to open source, technical writing, or conference talks. 

What Success Looks Like

- First 90 days: You understand our real-time pipeline end to end, from client and SDK through gateway to cloud. You've shipped meaningful code and identified the top technical risks and opportunities. 
 - Within 6 months: You're leading at least one cross-team initiative end to end and your design reviews and mentorship are visibly lifting the team. 
 - Within 12 months: The architecture you've shaped makes teams faster and systems more reliable as Sana

data.description:
Job Description

Job Description - ASIC/SoC Verification Engineer

We are seeking an experienced Principal ASIC/SoC Verification Engineer to join our dynamic and fast‐paced engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the functional correctness, robustness, and overall quality of our cutting‐edge semiconductor and SoC designs. If you thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy solving complex technical challenges, this opportunity is an excellent fit. 

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Verification Planning and Execution
 - Develop and execute comprehensive SoC/IP‐level verification plans aligned with design specifications and project goals. 
 - Drive verification closure through functional, code, and assertion coverage, ensuring high‐quality deliverables. 
 - Apply industry‐standard ASIC/SoC verification techniques including test planning, testbench creation, constrained‐random and directed stimulus, assertions, and coverage‐driven verification. 
 - Perform SoC integration verification, validating interactions across subsystems, interfaces, and power/performance domains. 
 - Testbench & Environment Development
 - Architect, develop, and enhance SystemVerilog UVM/OVM‐based testbenches for IP and SoC‐level verification. 
 - Build and integrate reusable Verification IP (VIP) and scalable verification components. 
 - Collaborate with internal teams and third‐party VIP providers to ensure seamless integration and compliance. 
 - Develop checkers, scoreboards, monitors, and coverage models to support robust verification. 
 - Methodology, Flows & Best Practices
 - Demonstrate strong understanding of ASIC/SoC design and verification methodologies, including constraint‐random verification and object‐oriented programming principles. 
 - Contribute to verification methodology improvements, automation, and flow optimization. 
 - Ensure adherence to best practices in UVM architecture, reuse, and maintainability. 
 - Advanced Verification Skills
 - Perform Gate‐Level Simulation (GLS) including SDF annotation, timing verification, and debug of post‐synthesis/post‐layout issues. 
 - Execute power‐aware verification using UPF/CPF, validating power modes, isolation, retention, and sequencing. 
 - Debug complex SoC‐level issues involving multiple clock domains, resets, and power states. 
 - Apply formal verification techniques where appropriate to complement simulation‐based verification. 
 - Technical Skills
 - Strong proficiency in SystemVerilog (UVM/OVM) and scripting languages such as Python, Perl, Tcl, C/C++, and Verilog PLI. 
 - Familiarity with standard protocols and interfaces (e. g. , I2C, SPI, UART, AXI/AHB/APB). 
 - Experience with simulation, debug, and coverage tools from major EDA vendors (Synopsys, Cadence, Siemens). 
 - Knowledge of CI/regression automation, version control, and workflow tools is a plus. 
 - Collaboration & Communication
 - Work effectively with design, architecture, DV, validation, and firmware teams to drive verification to completion. 
 - Communicate technical concepts clearly through documentation, reviews, and cross‐functional discussions. 
 - Demonstrate initiative, strong analytical problem‐solving skills, and adaptability in a diverse team environment. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field. 
 - 10 Years of experience in SoC/IP verification, . 
 - Strong expertise in SystemVerilog, UVM, and advanced verification methodologies. 
 - Hands-on experience with ARM-based SoC architectures, AMBA protocols (AXI/AHB/APB), and system-level interactions. 
 - Proven ability to build reusable, scalable testbench architectures. 
 - Solid understanding of test planning, coverage-driven verification, and verification metrics. 
 - Experience with GLS, timing verification, and debug. 
 - Knowledge of power-aware verification (UPF/CPF). 
 - Strong scripting and automation skills (Python, Perl, Shell, Make, etc. ). 
 - Exposure to AI/ML techniques applied to verification (e. g. , intelligent stimulus generation, failure triage, coverage optimization). 
 - Excellent problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills. 

About Us

onsemi (Nasdaq: ON) is driving disruptive innovations to help build a better future. With a focus on automotive and industrial end-markets, the company is accelerating change in megatrends such as vehicle electrification and safety, sustainable energy grids, industrial automation, and 5G and cloud infrastructure. With a highly differentiated and innovative product portfolio, onsemi creates intelligent power and sensing technologies that solve the world's most complex challenges and leads the way in creating a safer, cleaner, and smarter world. 

More details about our company benefits can be found here: 

https: //www. onsemi. com/careers/career-benefits

We are committed to sourcing, attracting, and hiring high-performance innovators, while providing all candidates a positive recruitment experience that builds our brand as a great place to work.

data.description:
Location: Erode, Tamil Nadu

Department: Quality / Medical Education

Employment Type: Full-time

Job SummaryThe position is responsible for coordinating hospital quality management, accreditation compliance, patient safety initiatives, and academic administration of DNB/DrNB programmes. The role involves ensuring adherence to applicable NABH and QAI accreditation standards, including Advanced Stroke Centre requirements, while coordinating postgraduate medical training activities in accordance with applicable National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS) guidelines. 

The role requires effective coordination with clinical and non-clinical departments, medical faculty, trainees, hospital management, and quality committees to maintain compliance, improve operational efficiency, and ensure accreditation and academic assessment readiness. 

Key Roles and Responsibilities1. Quality Management & Accreditation
 - Implement, monitor, and maintain compliance with applicable NABH and QAI accreditation standards, including Advanced Stroke Centre requirements. 
 - Develop, review, update, and maintain hospital policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), quality manuals, records, and accreditation documentation. 
 - Conduct internal audits, gap assessments, and mock assessments to evaluate compliance and identify areas for improvement. 
 - Monitor audit findings and ensure timely implementation and closure of Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA). 
 - Monitor patient safety practices, incident reporting, risk management, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and clinical and non-clinical quality indicators. 
 - Track patient feedback, complaints, and resolution timelines to support continuous improvement in patient experience. 
 - Coordinate quality committee meetings, management reviews, staff training, and accreditation-related activities. 
 - Maintain document control systems and monitor applicable statutory and regulatory requirements. 
 - Analyse quality performance data and prepare monthly dashboards, reports, and compliance updates for management. 
 - Collaborate with all departments to implement quality improvement initiatives and sustain compliance with hospital quality and patient safety standards. 2. DNB/DrNB Academic Coordination
 - Coordinate and monitor the academic and administrative activities of DNB/DrNB programmes in accordance with applicable NBEMS guidelines and institutional policies. 
 - Coordinate trainee admissions, joining formalities, faculty communication, academic calendars, and clinical postings. 
 - Monitor trainee attendance, logbooks, case presentations, seminars, journal clubs, and periodic academic assessments. 
 - Maintain records of trainee progress, leave, examination schedules, thesis submissions, and research activities. 
 - Coordinate with the Head of Department, teaching faculty, trainees, and hospital management to ensure timely completion of prescribed training requirements. 
 - Maintain mandatory academic records, reports, and documentation required for institutional assessments and NBEMS inspections. 
 - Monitor applicable requirements relating to faculty eligibility, clinical exposure, academic activities, and training documentation. 
 - Identify gaps in academic and administrative compliance and coordinate corrective actions. 
 - Facilitate institutional assessments, inspections, and other academic compliance activities as required by NBEMS. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 - Compliance with applicable NABH and QAI accreditation standards. 
 - Completion of internal audits and closure of audit findings within defined timelines. 
 - Timely closure and effectiveness of CAPA. 
 - Accuracy and completeness of quality and accreditation documentation. 
 - Staff training completion and awareness of quality standards. 
 - Monitoring and reporting of clinical and non-clinical quality indicators. 
 - Patient safety incident monitoring and complaint resolution. 
 - Accreditation and assessment readiness. 
 - Timely completion and maintenance of DNB/DrNB academic records. 
 - Compliance with applicable NBEMS training and documentation requirements. 
 - Coordination and completion of scheduled academic activities and assessments. Benefits
 - Cell phone reimbursement

 - Strong organisational, documentation, coordination, and communication skills.

data.title: Lead Engineer, Agentic AI Engineering
data.description:
About Trinity & This Role

Trinity Life Sciences is a leading analytics and technology partner to the biotech and pharma industry, helping clients solve their hardest commercialisation challenges across market access, forecasting, field force, customer engagement, and real world evidence. AI Foundations is the internal team making AI adoption fast, safe, and repeatable across Trinity - building the platforms, standards, and reusable components that product teams build on. 

Trinity is seeking a Lead AI Engineer - Agentic Systems to take ownership of technical execution across the AI Foundations engineering team in India. This is a step up from Senior Engineer: you are still deeply hands-on, but you carry additional responsibility for how the team executes - ensuring deliverables land on time and to standard, coaching engineers on agentic and platform development approaches, and acting as the technical authority the team rallies around. The right candidate leads by doing, holds the bar high, and understands that their success is measured as much by the team's output as their own. 

Key Responsibilities

Team Oversight & Project Execution

This is the dimension that distinguishes the Lead role from Senior. You are responsible for how the team delivers, not just what you personally build. 

- Own end-to-end delivery of agentic AI engineering workstreams - planning, prioritisation, dependency management, and ensuring deliverables complete on time and to the quality standard the business expects. 
 - Track progress across parallel workstreams; surface blockers early, escalate when needed, and remove obstacles so engineers can focus on building rather than navigating process. 
 - Maintain visibility into the health of ongoing projects: scope creep, technical debt accumulation, integration risks, and resource constraints - and act before they become problems. 
 - Coordinate with Data Scientists, product managers, and stakeholders to align on requirements, timelines, and definition of done - ensuring engineering and business expectations stay in sync throughout delivery. 
 - Run effective sprint rituals, design reviews, and retrospectives that keep the team sharp and continuously improving without adding unnecessary overhead. 

Architecture Standards & Technical Governance

- Act as the technical authority for agentic systems architecture within the India team - reviewing and approving significant design decisions, ensuring consistency with Trinity's established patterns and guardrails. 
 - Enforce adherence to engineering standards: coding conventions, testing requirements, CI/CD practices, security and RBAC patterns, and agent harness implementation - not as bureaucracy, but as the foundation that makes the team go faster over time. 
 - Own the team's reference architectures and reusable component library; keep them current as the agentic AI landscape evolves and new approaches prove themselves. 
 - Identify and address technical debt proactively - make the call on when to refactor versus when to ship, and be transparent with stakeholders about the trade-offs. 

Hands-On Engineering

The Lead role is not a management role. You remain a significant individual contributor and the technical credibility that comes from that is what makes the rest of the role work. 

- Architect and deliver complex agentic AI solutions end-to-end - multi-agent systems on LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Google ADK, and platforms including AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, Snowflake Cortex, and Databricks Mosaic AI. 
 - Design for MCP/A2A interoperability, agent memory systems, tool registries, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints; implement agent execution harnesses with sandboxed tool execution, policy-as-code guardrails (NeMo Guardrails, Guardrails AI), and full observability via Langfuse or LangSmith. 
 - Build or integrate with full-stack enterprise applications - applying enterprise-grade security (OAuth2, SAML, SSO, RBAC), secrets management, audit logging, and secure API design as first-class engineering concerns. 
 - Make informed, production-tested choices on inference infrastructure (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM), container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes / EKS / AKS), and data tooling (SQL, Snowflake, Databricks). 

Team Growth, Mentorship & Culture

- Coach and mentor engineers across all levels on agentic AI development, platform engineering, and software engineering craft - investing in their growth as seriously as in the team's output. 
 - Run structured technical sessions: design reviews, architecture walkthroughs, code review standards, and knowledge-sharing forums that build collective capability in agentic and platform development. 
 - Identify skill gaps in the team and work with leadership to address them - through hiring, coaching, or deliberate project assignments that stretch engineers in the right directions. 
 - Foster a culture of ownership, high standards, and continuous improvement; be the kind of technical leader people want to work for and learn from. 
 - Contribute actively to hiring - define what good looks like for engineering roles, assess candidates rigorously, and help build a team that makes everyone in it better. 

Stay Current & Drive Adoption of What Works

- Stay ahead of the agentic AI field - evaluate new frameworks, protocols, and techniques with a critical eye and bring well-formed recommendations to the team on what is worth adopting. 
 - Champion the adoption of AI-enabled development practices that improve team productivity: code generation, automated testing, documentation tooling, and developer experience improvements. 

What We Are Looking For

- 8+ years of software engineering in production, with 4+ years in AI/ML or agentic systems - and at least 2 years in a technical lead or principal engineering capacity. 
 - Proven ability to drive delivery across a team: you have owned project timelines, managed dependencies, and ensured engineering work lands on time and to standard. 
 - Deep technical expertise across the agentic AI stack - frameworks, cloud platforms, agent safety, evaluation, inference infrastructure, and full-stack enterprise integration. 
 - Strong Python and SQL proficiency; hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes in production container environments. 
 - Demonstrated ability to set and uphold engineering standards - coding, testing, architecture, and security - and bring a team along with you, not just impose them. 
 - Excellent communication: able to represent technical decisions to senior leadership, align with business stakeholders, and coach engineers at every level. 
 - Passion for the agentic AI field and a genuine habit of staying current - you bring ideas to the team, not just execution. 
 - Background in life sciences, pharma, or regulated environments is a strong differentiator. Degree from IITs, NITs, BITS, or comparable; strong applied track record considered equally. 

The Kind of Achievements We Respect

- "Led a 4-person engineering team to deliver a multi-agent analytics platform on AWS Bedrock in 12 weeks. All milestones hit. Adopted by 3 product teams within a month of launch. "
 - "Introduced architecture review and testing standards across the team. Deployment-related incidents dropped by 70% in the following quarter. "
 - "Coached two engineers from mid-level to senior in 18 months through structured design reviews, paired engineering sessions, and deliberate project ownership. "

Why This Role Matters

Trinity is building something foundational in India - a team that will shape how AI gets built and adopted across the enterprise. The Lead Engineer is the person who makes that team deliver with consistency and craft. If you are energised by the combination of deep technical work, team ownership, and genuine influence over how an AI organisation develops, we would like to meet you.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer - AI Native UX
data.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone-freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow- helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. 

Join us to put AI to work for people. 

Job Description

What you'll do: 

UX Architecture & Strategy - Define and own the long-term architecture for AI-native user experiences across the platform, making critical build-vs-buy decisions (design systems, agent-to-UI interaction patterns, real-time/streaming UX for AI-generated content) to ensure the experience layer stays resilient and coherent as the platform scales. 

AI-Native Intelligent Experiences - Design and build user-facing surfaces where agentic backends - recommendations, autonomous triage, generated fixes/insights, multi-step agent reasoning - are exposed to end users through fast, trustworthy, low-friction interaction patterns. Own the hard UX problems unique to AI-native products: progressive disclosure of agent reasoning, graceful handling of uncertainty/latency, human-in-the-loop review flows, and making autonomous system behavior legible and controllable to end users rather than a black box. 

UXC & Workspace Platform - Deep ownership of the UXC (User Experience/Workspace, UI16) surface - component architecture, design system consistency, and performance - as the primary canvas AI-native features are built on top of. 

Agentic Pipeline Awareness - Partner closely with platform/ML teams building the agent orchestration and tool-calling infrastructure underneath (multi-agent dispatch, MCP-style tool integration, reasoning traceability) - translating what these backends can do into UX patterns that make them usable, safe, and trustworthy for real users. 

Business Alignment - Align UX and technical architecture with business goals, ensuring engineering velocity, experience quality, and adoption of AI-native features directly support customer acquisition, retention, and time-to-market. 

Hands-on Engineering - Write high-performance, clean, production-grade code primarily across the frontend/experience stack (Lit. js, React/TypeScript, design systems, component architecture), with working fluency in backend/platform code (Java, Python, Postgres, K8s) to collaborate effectively with platform teams. 

Cross-functional Execution - Drive business-critical UX and platform outcomes in close collaboration with ML, backend platform, and product teams. 

Engineering Culture - Mentor senior engineers, champion UX and engineering excellence, and foster a culture of rapid, impact-driven innovation in AI-native product development. 

Ownership & Initiative - Proactively identify UX and platform gaps in the AI-native experience, propose solutions, align stakeholders, and drive execution with a high degree of ownership. 

Qualifications

- Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into engineering and platform work-AI-powered tooling, automated operational workflows, agentic systems for fleet visibility and operations, or reasoning about AI's impact on how infrastructure is built and run. 
 - 15+ years of software engineering experience with demonstrated progression into senior technical leadership, and a track record concentrated in user experience and frontend platform engineering. 
 - Deep UXC / AI-native UX expertise - has shipped intelligent, AI-driven user experiences (not just consumed an LLM API), with strong intuition for how agent/model output should surface to real users. 
 - Hands-on experience with agentic/multi-agent systems from the consumer side - understands agent orchestration, tool-calling protocols (MCP or equivalent), and reasoning traceability well enough to design UX around them, even if platform-layer implementation sits with another team. 
 - Strong hands-on coding ability with deep design thinking in the frontend/experience stack (React/TypeScript, component/design systems), working proficiency in backend fundamentals (K8s, Java, Python, Postgres) to bridge into platform architecture conversations. 
 - Demonstrated ability to connect UX and engineering decisions to business outcomes - adoption, retention, time-to-market, not just technical metrics. 
 - Self-driven with strong ownership, able to identify UX and system gaps, propose solutions, align stakeholders, and execute at startup pace. 
 - Experience integrating or critically evaluating AI tools/agentic workflows in product and engineering decision-making, particularly from a user-experience and trust/legibility angle. 

Good to Have

- Prior experience in distributed systems performance/scalability, even if not the primary focus of recent roles. 
 - Open-source contributions to major AI-native UX, design-system, or agent-framework projects. 
 - Prior startup experience working closely with Product and Growth teams in an early-stage environment. 

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements. 

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow. com for assistance. 

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U. S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

data.description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you're passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team. 

Work Mode: Hybrid (working in US time zone - EST)

Role Summary

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior DevOps Engineer / Site Reliability Engineer with minimum of 8+ years of experience in DevOps area to join our team. The ideal candidate should be able to quickly understand the product and platform, onboard effectively, and work both independently and collaboratively across teams. 

This role requires strong hands-on expertise in AWS cloud infrastructure, CI/CD automation, container platforms, scripting, monitoring, and production support. The candidate will also be expected to contribute to engineering initiatives, proof of concepts, automation ideas, and continuous platform improvements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, implement, and manage scalable, secure, and reliable infrastructure on AWS
 - Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines for faster and more reliable software delivery
 - Automate infrastructure provisioning and deployment workflows using Terraform, Chef, and scripting tools
 - Manage and support containerized workloads using ECS
 - Work closely with development, QA, and cross-functional teams to enable smooth build, release, and deployment processes
 - Monitor applications and infrastructure using observability tools and proactively address stability or performance issues
 - Handle incidents, troubleshoot production issues, and drive root cause analysis and resolution
 - Support artifact management and release processes using JFrog Artifactory
 - Contribute to POCs, new initiatives, automation opportunities, and continuous improvement efforts
 - Apply a developer mindset to solve engineering problems efficiently and improve platform reliability
 - Participate in operational excellence initiatives including system resilience, troubleshooting, and production stability

Primary Skill Set

- Strong hands-on experience with AWS cloud services/resources
 - Good working knowledge of AWS CLI
 - Experience with Jenkins and/or TeamCity
 - Strong expertise in CI/CD pipeline design, implementation, and support
 - Hands-on experience with Terraform, Chef
 - Strong scripting and automation skills using: 
 - Shell scripting / PowerShell
 - Python
 - Experience with ECS Containers
 - Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as: 
 - Splunk
 - Datadog
 - Experience with JFrog Artifactory
 - Basic knowledge of SQL and PostgreSQL queries
 - Strong incident handling, production support, and troubleshooting skills
 - Ability to work with a developer mindset and collaborate effectively across teams

Secondary Skill Set

- Experience with EKS
 - Knowledge of Helm Charts
 - Familiarity with GitOps
 - Exposure to ECR
 - Understanding of SRE principles and architecture mindset
 - Experience with 3rd-party vault/secrets management solutions
 - Exposure to vulnerability analysis / security scanning tools

Preferred Qualifications

- AWS certification is preferred
 - Experience working in distributed or global teams
 - Ability to quickly understand product architecture and business workflows
 - Strong ownership, initiative, and problem-solving skills
 - Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively in a team environment
 - Experience contributing to POCs, platform improvements, and technical initiatives

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on Senior DevOps / SRE individual contributor who can ramp up quickly, understand the product and engineering ecosystem, and independently drive automation, reliability, deployment efficiency, and operational improvements. This person should be comfortable balancing day-to-day support needs with long-term engineering initiatives and innovation. 

We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company-and ultimately a community-that recognizes and celebrates everyone's unique perspective.

These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.

data.title: Senior Performance Engineer - DGX Cloud
data.description:
Joining NVIDIA's DGX Cloud AI Efficiency Team means advancing the performance, efficiency, and resiliency of large-scale AI workloads. We help AI researchers and platform teams understand end-to-end behavior across GPUs, networking, storage, and software stacks. We are seeking a Senior Performance Engineer to characterize workloads, establish performance baselines, diagnose bottlenecks, and drive optimizations from investigation through deployment. Your work will shape scalable DGX Cloud systems, turn complex measurements into prioritized engineering decisions, and continuously raise the performance and reliability of AI workloads. Join our technically diverse team of infrastructure experts to unlock more efficient AI at scale. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Analyze end-to-end performance of large-scale AI workloads across compute, network, storage, and software stacks. 
 - Design and execute rigorous performance studies to establish baselines, diagnose regressions, and quantify bottlenecks. 
 - Define performance and efficiency evaluation methodologies, benchmarks, and success metrics for AI workloads. 
 - Use profiling, observability, and data analysis to turn performance measurements into actionable optimization plans. 
 - Partner with deep learning engineers, platform teams, and GPU architects to validate and deliver performance improvements. 
 - Communicate performance findings, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to influence system and software design decisions. 

What We Need To See

- BS or higher degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 
 - 12+ years of experience in strong programming skills in C++ and Python, with the ability to build reliable analysis and automation workflows
 - Solid foundation in operating systems, computer architecture, and distributed systems
 - Experience with performance engineering, benchmarking, profiling, and optimization of complex software or systems
 - Ability to communicate technical findings, prioritize high-impact work, and build alignment across teams

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Experience analyzing large-scale AI clusters or distributed training and inference workloads
 - Experience with CUDA, GPU computing systems, and GPU performance analysis
 - Hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX/XLA
 - Deep understanding of system-level performance analysis, workload characterization, and optimization

NVIDIA leads the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions, from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is looking for exceptional people like you to help us accelerate the next wave of artificial intelligence.

data.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Digital Payments and Emerging Markets
data.description:
Description

What if every customer around the world could pay for their order in the way that feels most natural to them? The Digital and Emerging Payments team at Amazon is working to make that happen, building payment experiences that work across geographies, platforms, and customer expectations. From Android and Fire devices to resilient back-end systems that guarantee no order is ever lost, the technical challenges here are real and the customer impact is global. 

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to help lead the technical direction of our payments platform. You will own the design and delivery of systems that process transactions at massive scale, mentor fellow engineers, and shape architectural decisions that determine how millions of customers complete their purchases. If you're passionate about solving complex distributed systems challenges and want to make a direct impact on the customer experience, this could be the role for you. 

Key job responsibilities

- Lead the design and delivery of payment platform features end-to-end, ensuring systems are reliable and performant across multiple geographies and device platforms. 
 - Own your team's architectural direction by evaluating technology choices, defining engineering best practices, and guiding future system design while balancing short-term delivery with long-term maintainability. 
 - Collaborate with product managers, partner engineering teams, and stakeholders across Amazon to define requirements, align on technical approaches, and deliver integrated solutions. 
 - Mentor engineers on your team through code reviews, design discussions, and hands-on guidance, raising the overall quality of the codebase. 
 - Use metrics and operational data to identify improvement opportunities, drive rapid iteration on features, and maintain high availability for payment systems. 

A day in the life

You review a design document for a new payment method integration, providing feedback that helps a teammate strengthen their approach. You dive deep into code, building a service component that must process thousands of transactions per second while staying resilient when downstream dependencies are unavailable. You join a cross-team sync with product managers to discuss upcoming requirements for an emerging market, then pair with a junior engineer on a tricky concurrency issue. Throughout the day, you balance hands-on engineering with the architectural thinking that keeps the platform reliable and ready for what comes next. 

About The Team

The Digital and Emerging Payments team is responsible for how Amazon customers pay across the globe. We build and run the systems that connect customers to the payment methods they trust, whether that is a credit card, a mobile wallet, or a region-specific option unique to their market. Our mission is to make every transaction feel simple and reliable. 

We are an inclusive group that values knowledge sharing and mentorship. Team members at every experience level contribute to technical decisions, and we invest in each person's growth by matching projects to development goals. If you want to shape the future of payments at Amazon's scale, we would love to hear from you. 

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
 - 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

data.title: Manager, SDR (Night Shift)
data.description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U. S. More than 2, 000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov's mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov. com. 

Job Summary

The SDR Manager, based in Pune, leads a team of Sales Development Representatives dedicated to generating pipeline for OpenGov's US go-to-market team. This role owns the performance, coaching, and day to day execution of the Pune SDR team, ensuring consistent, high quality outbound activity into the US public sector market. You'll report to a US-based Director of Sales Development and act as the connective tissue between the Pune team and US leadership, translating strategy into daily execution and results. 

Responsibilities

- Manage and coach a team of 6 SDRs so they consistently hit pipeline and activity targets
 - Monitor individual and team metrics (calls, emails, meetings booked, pipeline generated) and run regular one on one meetings and performance reviews
 - Translate US GTM strategy and territory priorities from US leadership into daily and weekly execution plans for the Pune team
 - Build onboarding, ramp plans, and ongoing skill development programs so new SDRs reach full productivity quickly
 - Partner closely with the US-based Director of Sales Development and US Account Executives to align on lead quality, handoff process, and feedback loops
 - Ensure the team uses Salesforce, Outreach, and LinkedIn effectively, and maintain clean, accurate reporting for leadership
 - Manage a team working US-aligned hours from Pune, including shift scheduling and coverage planning
 - Deliver regular updates to US leadership on team performance, pipeline health, and areas for improvement
 - Build a high energy, competitive, and supportive team culture that keeps SDRs engaged and motivated

Requirements And Preferred Experience

- 7+ years of experience in sales development or outbound sales, including a proven track record managing SDR or BDR teams
 - Experience managing a team that supports a US market or works US-aligned hours
 - Strong coaching skills, with a track record of developing reps and improving individual performance
 - Comfortable working US-aligned hours from Pune
 - Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate effectively with US-based leadership and stakeholders
 - A data driven approach to managing pipeline and activity metrics, with fluency in Salesforce and sales engagement tools (Outreach or similar)
 - Genuinely curious about technology and its role in government, with the ability to translate that curiosity into team level coaching
 - Background in B2B, SaaS, BPO, or government focused sales organizations is a strong plus
 - Bachelor's degree preferred

Why OpenGov?

A Mission That Matters. 

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it's the core of our democracy. 

Opportunity to Innovate

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything-from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We've touched 2, 000 communities so far, and we're just getting started. 

A Team of Passionate, Driven People

This isn't your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune. 

A Place to Make Your Mark

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.

We are seeking an experienced Sterling OMS Lead to architect, design, and lead the implementation of enterprise-level Order Management System solutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in IBM Sterling OMS, modern cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure), and full-stack Java development .

Technical Leadership & Strategy

Lead the design, development, and customization of IBM Sterling OMS modules, including Web SOM, Web COM, and Call Center UI .

Define and enforce best practices for development, customization, integration, and code quality, including conducting code reviews . 

Guide the team in translating functional requirements into detailed technical design documents and configuration specifications . 

Act as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for all technical aspects of the Sterling OMS platform, providing guidance on complex business scenarios . 

Development & Implementation

Lead the development of core OMS functionalities, including order orchestration workflows, sourcing rules, fulfillment logic, and pipeline configurations . 

Oversee the integration of Sterling OMS with external systems such as ERP (e. g. , SAP), WMS (e. g. , Blue Yonder), CRM, payment gateways, and e-commerce platforms . 

Build and maintain Java-based microservices and REST/SOAP APIs to support scalable order management and integration needs . 

Leverage cloud platforms (AWS/Azure) and containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes) for deployment and management of applications . 

Manage and execute data migration, system configuration, and deployment processes . 

Team & Stakeholder Management

Mentor and lead a team of 3-10 developers and engineers, both onshore and offshore, fostering a culture of technical excellence . 

Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, business analysts, QA, and DevOps, to ensure seamless delivery . 

Participate in client discussions, status reporting calls, and manage stakeholder expectations effectively . 

Production Support & Troubleshooting

Oversee L2/L3 support, proactively monitoring production systems to ensure high availability, performance, and scalability . 

Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for high-impact production issues and implement permanent fixes . 

Provide off-hours support for critical production downtime and business-impacts .

Experience & Education

Total Experience: 8+ years of overall experience in software development and IT, with a minimum of 4-6 years of hands-on experience specifically in IBM Sterling OMS .

Technical Proficiency

Cloud & DevOps: Extensive experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred, or Azure/GCP), containerization (Kubernetes, Docker), and CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Maven) . 

Database: Proficient in writing optimized SQL queries and working with relational databases like Oracle or DB2 . 

Architecture: Deep understanding of microservices architecture, event-driven design (e. g. , Apache Kafka), and integration patterns . 

Domain & Process Knowledge

Retail & eCommerce: Solid understanding of the Retail domain, including e-commerce, order-to-cash lifecycle, and fulfillment models (e. g. , SFS, BOPIS, Dropship) . 

SDLC & Agile: Proven experience in the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and working within Agile/Scrum environments .

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills . 

Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder management abilities . 

Proven ability to lead, mentor, and guide technical teams .

data.title: Lead Response Technology and Automation Security Engineer
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Lead Response Technology and Automation Security Engineer

Overview

The Corporate Security Threat and Response Management product ownership team is looking for a Lead Level Security Engineer to help drive our Security Operations modernization strategy. The ideal candidate is passionate about the modern security tools, capabilities, and strategies. 

The RESPOND product team executes on the multi-year strategy and roadmap set by the RESPOND product owner to evolve and modernize SecOps incident investigation and response technology, capabilities, tools, and process. 

Response product team members work closely with regional SOC teams to execute the RESPOND product strategy on the ground. This role is the connective tissue between product vision and operational reality: building, tuning, and operationalizing response automation, AI-augmented workflows, and analyst tooling that SOC and DFIR teams rely on every day. The RESPOND product team is hands-on with SOAR development, agentic AI integration, notebook-based investigation tooling, and continuous improvement of analyst workflows. 

Core Responsibilities

- Execute the RESPOND product roadmap in close partnership with SOC and Incident Response teams in the region. 
 - Design, build, test, and maintain SOAR playbooks used for incident triage and response scopes to collect and process digital evidence and artifacts at speed and scale. 
 - Build and operationalize AI-augmented response capabilities, including: 
 - Agentic AI workflows integrated into triage, enrichment, and response. 
 - Prompt books and prompt libraries tuned for SOC and Incident Response use cases. 
 - Prompt-book/code notebook (Jupyter, etc) development for repeatable investigation, hunt, and DFIR workflows. 
 - LLM-driven enrichment and summarization integrated into case management. 
 - Define strategic requirements and oversee management for connectors, apps, and integrations between SOAR, SIEM, EDR, identity, ticketing, threat intelligence, and AI/LLM platforms (including MCP servers where applicable) for build through our dedicated engineering partners. 
 - Build and maintain response tooling: scripts, live-response packages, enrichment services, and automation utilities deployable via EDR and SOAR. 
 - Embed with SOC and DFIR analysts to identify high-toil workflows and convert them into automated, AI-assisted, or fully autonomous playbooks with appropriate guardrails. 
 - Tune and optimize playbooks and AI-assisted workflows against measurable outcomes (MTTR, false-positive rate, analyst touch time, AI-assist accuracy). 
 - Contribute to the centralized response tooling, prompt book, and notebook libraries, ensuring code quality, documentation, version control, and reusability across regions. 
 - Support major incident response activities by deploying and operating response tooling and AI-assisted investigation workflows under pressure. 
 - Provide feedback into the product backlog and partner with the PO on requirements refinement. 
 - Document playbooks, prompt books, notebooks, and technical designs to enterprise standards. 

All About You

- 5+ years in security operations, incident response, detection engineering, or security automation engineering
 - Prior experience as a SOC analyst, Security Engineer, Digital Forensics Examiner, SOAR engineer, and/or threat hunter preferred. 
 - Hands-on SOAR development experience with low-code/no-code or hyper-automation tools and concepts. Must be able to define and build reliable, scalable response capabilities. 
 - Demonstrated enterprise experience executing on AI-augmented SOC concepts, including at least two of: 
 - Building and maintaining AI prompt books for analyst workflows. 
 - Developing Jupyter notebooks for investigation, hunt, or DFIR. 
 - Integrating LLMs or agentic AI into XDR, SOAR, case management, or response tooling. 
 - Leveraging IDEs with AI connectors to process data and execute AI workflows
 - Deploying agent-based AI workflows for triage or enrichment in production. 
 - Strong scripting skills in Python and PowerShell. Comfortable with basic code repo management using Git or equivalent. 
 - Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and authentication patterns (OAuth, API keys, managed identities). 
 - Solid grounding in incident response fundamentals and the IR lifecycle. 
 - Hands-on experience with: EDR platforms (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Defender for Endpoint), SIEM (Splunk ES, Microsoft Sentinel), identity platforms (Entra ID, Okta), cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and cloud protection products (CNAPP, CWPP, CSPM). 
 - Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and the ability to map response actions to adversary techniques. 
 - Demonstrated ability to operate inside an agile delivery model with a product backlog. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, cybersecurity, or IT-focused disciplines (or equivalent experience). 
 - At least two Industry certifications: GCFA, GCIH, GNFA, GCFR, GREM, or equivalent. 
 - Experience with SecOps focused MCP server architectures, agentic frameworks, or tools
 - Experience building EDR live-response scripts and tool libraries. 
 - Exposure to detection-as-code and response-as-code practices, including CI/CD for security content. 
 - Background in regulated financial services or Fortune 500 SOC environments. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Staff Devops Engg
data.description:
Staff DevOps EngineerAbout the Role

LeadSquared serves thousands of businesses around the world, each with its own requirements for data residency, latency, and compliance. CloudOps runs the infrastructure behind all of it: the production estate that serves customers today, the shared services every product team depends on, and the modern platform that new products are built on. 

We're hiring a Staff DevOps Engineer to set the technical direction for infrastructure across the whole LeadSquared platform. This is not a ticket queue role. You'll decide how a new environment comes up, how tenants are isolated, how a production change is reviewed and rolled out, how existing workloads move to more modern foundations without disrupting customers, and how we know something is broken before a customer tells us. Then you'll build those systems and make sure they keep working after you move on to the next problem. 

You'll work across CloudOps, every product engineering team, Security, and Engineering leadership. Your influence will reach well beyond the code you write yourself. 

What You'll Own

- Architecture: Set the long-term direction for LeadSquared's cloud infrastructure across all products and environments through design documents and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs). Lead migrations from today's estate to a standardised platform without customer impact. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Bring all infrastructure under reviewed code with safe change practices, including PR-driven plan and apply, policy as code, drift detection, and production guardrails. 
 - Runtime and Delivery: Own the compute, Kubernetes, and CI/CD platforms so that shipping a service or onboarding a tenant becomes self-service. 
 - Reliability: Define SLOs, own observability, lead major incidents and postmortems, and regularly test disaster recovery. 
 - Security and Compliance: Enforce least-privilege access, secrets management, and encryption by default. Support audits through automated evidence collection. 
 - Cost Optimisation: Treat cloud spend as an engineering metric, with visibility into costs per product, tenant, and service. 
 - Leadership: Mentor engineers, represent CloudOps to product teams, and eliminate operational toil through automation. 

What We're Looking ForMinimum Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, infrastructure, or platform engineering, with clear ownership of production systems at meaningful scale. 
 - Deep, hands-on AWS expertise, including multi-account organisations, networking, IAM, compute, containers, managed data services, and edge delivery. 
 - Expert-level Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform or equivalent tools, including designing reusable modules and structuring code across multiple environments. 
 - Expert-level Kubernetes experience in production, including cluster upgrades, autoscaling, networking, RBAC, and debugging under pressure. 
 - Production experience with CI/CD and GitOps practices. 
 - Experience running and migrating a large, existing production estate, not just building greenfield environments. 
 - Strong programming or scripting skills in at least one language, with the ability to build production-grade tooling. 
 - A track record of leading incidents, writing postmortems, and delivering the reliability improvements that follow. 
 - Proven ability to write clear technical documents and influence decisions across teams without formal authority. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience designing or operating highly available, active-active, or disaster recovery (DR) architectures in the cloud. 
 - Experience leading large-scale migrations, such as moving from virtual machines to containers, with zero or near-zero customer impact. 
 - Experience building an observability practice with SLOs and error budgets. 
 - Experience with policy as code and software supply chain security. 
 - Experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms, including tenant isolation models, per-tenant routing, and capacity management. 
 - FinOps experience with demonstrable cloud cost reductions. 
 - Contributions to open-source infrastructure tooling or public speaking and writing on platform engineering. 

What Success Looks LikeFirst 90 Days

- Understand LeadSquared's infrastructure end to end across products, accounts, and environments, and join the on-call and incident commander rotation. 
 - Deliver at least one meaningful improvement to change safety or developer experience across teams. 
 - Produce a written assessment of the platform's top reliability, security, and cost risks, along with a proposed roadmap. 

First Year

- New environments can be provisioned from code in days, not weeks. 
 - Most production infrastructure is managed as code and changed only through reviewed pull requests. 
 - SLOs are defined for critical customer journeys, alerting is driven by them, and error budgets inform release decisions. 
 - Disaster recovery has been tested end to end, with documented results. 
 - Cloud spend per unit of load is measurably lower. 
 - At least two engineers on the team are operating at the next level as a result of your mentorship. 

How We Work

- Everything is code, everything is reviewed: Infrastructure changes go through pull requests, plans are visible, and production applies are deliberate. 
 - Standards over snowflakes: One consistent way to build an environment, deploy a service, and manage observability. 
 - Blameless by default: Incidents are opportunities to improve systems, not to blame people. 
 - Writing is how we decide: Design documents and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) come before major changes. 

LeadSquared is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of gender, religion, caste, disability, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.
