data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Principal Engineer. Job Overview

We at Arm are crafting the future of Software-Defined Vehicles and Robotics driven by Physical AI by building next-generation reference software platforms for sophisticated compute subsystems. We are looking for a passionate and highly skilled Principal Software Engineer to join our growing team and help drive this exciting transformation

You will lead key technical initiatives in multiple engineering domains. You will collaborate with software leads, architects, and program management teams. Your goal is to deliver robust, scalable, highly optimized system solutions that demonstrate the full potential of Arm platforms. 

This is a great opportunity for engineers who enjoy working across the complete software stack - from low-level system firmware and operating systems to middleware and application development. You will have the chance to tackle intricate technical problems, influence architecture decisions, and contribute to innovative progress in physical systems based on artificial intelligence. 

Beyond technical excellence, we are looking for individuals who are passionate about building high-performing teams, mentoring engineers, and fostering a strong culture of collaboration and innovation. 

If you are excited about groundbreaking technologies, eager to work on industry-defining solutions, and motivated to help build an exceptional engineering team at Arm, we would love to hear from you. 

Roles and Responsibilities

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will play a key role in overseeing the implementation and end-to-end validation of platform firmware and software features for next-generation Physical AI compute platforms. 

You will own the design and implementation of features, scalable test infrastructure, automation frameworks, and modern quality assurance practices to ensure delivery of high-performance, reliable software. 

You will work closely with developers, architects, product owners, and multi-functional teams to breakdown end-to-end system-level firmware and software requirements, and develop comprehensive solutions. 

You will also champion the use of industry-standard open-source frameworks and tools, established internal test environments, and continuously improve software quality, performance, and development efficiency across the group. 

This position offers the opportunity to influence platform-level engineering decisions, tackle sophisticated technical challenges, and contribute to modern innovations in Physical AI systems. 

In addition to technical leadership, you will mentor and guide a distributed software engineering team, fostering a strong culture of collaboration, innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning. 

You should be able to clearly communicate architecture, decisions, risks, alternatives and recommendations to engineers as well as senior technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 16+ years of experience in software development, end to end verification and validation of system firmware across semiconductor development life cycle. 
 - Deep understanding of low-level system BSP firmware like TF-A, TF-M, SCP, OP-TEE, Xen, Zephyr etc. 
 - Good in programming embedded C/C++, Python, Bash/Shell scripting, and familiar with Git, Pytest, ROS2, GitLab/GitHub, and Virtualization software
 - Hands-on experience of defining test strategies, test methods, test metrics, productization of firmware etc. 
 - Leading and driving team to achieve excellent result!
 - Good interpersonal and communication skills, excellent written and spoken English, and the ability to write coherent documentation, influence, and build consensus

Desirable Skills & Qualities

- Strong debugging skills, capable of navigating complex software stacks and delivering effective solutions
 - Experience in qualifying automotive/robotics workloads, use cases, AI / ML software stacks, and tooling
 - Experience with automotive/robotics software safety/security qualification is an added advantage!
 - Good understanding of architecture and microarchitecture concepts, ideally for the Arm architecture. 

If this sounds like you, please don't hesitate to apply. 

In Return

We provide an opportunity to learn about the latest Arm architecture features, working closely with a highly skilled engineering team on ground-breaking technology!

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

Use of AI in Your Application

At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm. com so we can support you. 

Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team's needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you. 

Equal Opportunities

Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

data.title: Sr. Test Analyst
data.description:
Job Summary

Serve as a senior test analyst specializing in MES validation and automation for hybrid work model projects ensuring high quality manufacturing execution solutions through rigorous functional integration and AI assisted testing. Apply expertise in Camstar MES platforms and multi layer integration to improve reliability reduce defects and support efficient supply chain operations while collaborating with diverse global teams. 

Responsibilities

- Design and execute comprehensive test strategies for MES validation that align with project scope regulatory expectations and enterprise quality standards ensuring reliable delivery of manufacturing execution capabilities across hybrid work environments. 
 - Develop and maintain detailed automated test suites for MES applications using suitable frameworks focusing on regression coverage repeatability and rapid feedback to project teams to reduce release cycle times and production defects. 
 - Perform thorough manual functional and integration testing for MES features where automation is not yet feasible documenting clear test conditions reproducible steps and evidence to support release readiness decisions. 
 - Validate and test MES L4 L3 and L2 integration flows across enterprise planning systems shop floor control systems and field devices ensuring accurate data exchange timing and transaction integrity for manufacturing and supply chain scenarios. 
 - Configure and validate Camstar MES features workflows and business rules in test environments ensuring that process configurations meet user requirements while upholding data integrity and traceability standards for regulated manufacturing contexts. 
 - Utilize generative AI tools in a compliant manner to accelerate test design test data generation and defect analysis while applying critical judgment to review AI generated outputs for accuracy relevance and risk. 
 - Collaborate closely with business analysts developers MES engineers and operations stakeholders to clarify requirements define acceptance criteria and proactively identify risks or gaps that could impact manufacturing continuity or supply chain visibility. 
 - Analyze test results and production like data patterns to identify systemic defects performance bottlenecks and integration issues then work with technical teams to prioritize and verify fixes that provide measurable operational improvements. 
 - Create and maintain clear test documentation including test plans test cases traceability matrices and execution reports that support audits and provide transparent evidence of validation coverage for all MES components. 
 - Provide mentoring and practical guidance to other test professionals on MES validation techniques automated testing practices and integration testing patterns fostering a culture of quality ownership across the delivery team. 
 - Engage in defect triage sessions and change review activities presenting well reasoned impact analyses and retest strategies that balance quality risk with project timelines for day shift hybrid operations. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance test automation frameworks test data management and environment stability thereby increasing efficiency across recurring MES validation cycles. 
 - Partner with manufacturing and supply chain stakeholders to understand process flows and key performance indicators ensuring that test scenarios reflect real operational conditions and help safeguard product quality and service reliability. 

Qualifications

- Demonstrate extensive hands on experience in MES validation and automated testing with a proven track record of owning test design execution and reporting for complex enterprise scale implementations. 
 - Exhibit strong proficiency in manual MES validation activities including requirement analysis test case creation risk based prioritization and evidence collection suitable for regulated manufacturing environments. 
 - Show advanced skills in testing L4 L3 and L2 integration scenarios across planning manufacturing and shop floor systems with an ability to troubleshoot data flow discrepancies and interface failures effectively. 
 - Apply practical knowledge of generative AI in the context of software quality engineering using it to enhance test asset creation and analysis while maintaining strict review controls and compliance awareness. 
 - Demonstrate deep working knowledge of Camstar MES configuration object modeling and workflow behavior enabling precise validation of manufacturing processes and electronic records under varied operational conditions. 
 - Display solid understanding of manufacturing and supply chain business processes including work order management inventory tracking and quality events so that test coverage aligns with real world operational needs. 
 - Communicate findings and recommendations clearly in written and spoken form to cross functional teams enabling timely decisions on release readiness and risk mitigation in a hybrid day shift setting. 
 - Maintain strong analytical and problem solving capabilities supported by a methodical approach to root cause analysis that helps reduce recurring defects and enhances overall MES ecosystem stability.

Are you ready to turn the latest AI breakthroughs into resilient, production-grade systems that accelerate late-stage scientific discovery and move life-changing medicines closer to patients? Can you picture yourself setting enterprise-wide Data and AI strategy while building reusable autonomous frameworks and GenAI capabilities that scale with confidence?

In this role, you will lead how we embed intelligence into the digital backbone of drug development. You will develop long-term platform funding priorities, capability roadmaps, and technology choices. Then you will translate strategy into solutions that make complex enterprise workflows simpler, safer, and faster for our scientists and product teams. 

Join us at a pivotal point in our transformation into a digital and data-led enterprise. Backed by investment and an ecosystem of partners, you will work across AI science, engineering and business partners to create patterns that become the standard and prove them through high-impact deliveries that stand up in a regulated environment. 

Accountabilities

- Shape and evolve the long-term Data and AI strategy for drug development, including platform investments, capability roadmaps, technology choices and alignment with enterprise architecture. 
 - Partner with AI science teams to design reusable agentic patterns, GenAI components and scalable solutions that streamline sophisticated enterprise workflows and accelerate delivery. 
 - Influence enterprise architecture decisions and lead strategic vendor evaluations, pilots and ecosystem partnerships to bring the best technologies into the enterprise. 
 - Lead multi-functional engineering teams, driving end-to-end delivery from prototype to robust, compliant production systems. 
 - Define, govern and promote engineering standards, guidelines and reusable design patterns; produce and review detailed technical designs across data models, APIs, integrations, security, deployment, error handling, performance, monitoring, testing and support. 
 - Promote strong data integrity and governance, including clear ownership, quality management, metadata, lineage, audit trails, master and reference data, and standardized terminology. 
 - Establish and maintain AI and ML governance controls, covering risk assessment, proper use, human oversight, explainability, model approval, versioning, performance monitoring, change control and retirement. 
 - Implement production-grade controls for GenAI and retrieval-augmented generation solutions to deliver reliable, traceable and secure outputs based on trusted information, including prompt and model management, response quality testing, source referencing, access controls and mitigations for prompt attacks and data leakage. 
 - Define and operate comprehensive evaluation and monitoring frameworks that track accuracy, reliability, security, response quality, business relevance, degradation, latency, cost and operational stability. 
 - Establish API-based and event-driven integration standards, including data formats, contracts, versioning, interoperability and integration with legacy and regulated systems. 
 - Improve value from enterprise data platforms and guide the implementation of DevOps, DataOps and MLOps practices to deliver resilient, automated, auditable pipelines across data, ML and AI. 
 - Ensure data solutions adhere to FAIR principles-findable, accessible, interoperable and reusable-and support end-to-end machine learning and AI workflows. 
 - Foster a culture of continuous improvement, experimentation, collaboration, and innovation across engineering and AI teams, encouraging thoughtful use of AI and digital tools in day-to-day work.

 - Fluency in Python, with a good understanding of secure software engineering practices. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and leading high-performing teams.

 - AWS Cloud Certification or equivalent. 

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world. 

Why AstraZeneca

Here, your work directly accelerates the development of life-changing medicines by pairing leading science with modern data platforms, analytics and AI. You will join a community that brings unconventional combinations of expertise together to spark bold thinking, supported by real investment and the freedom to experiment-from hackathons to high-impact deliveries in production. We value kindness alongside ambition, recognize meaningful contributions and create space for diverse minds to collaborate, learn fast and shape how an entire enterprise uses data and AI to create patient impact.

About The Role

Here at Tide, we are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Team Leader to oversee our Acquiring Transaction Monitoring team in our first line of defence with experience in transaction monitoring within the card acquiring space or merchant banking, with a deep understanding of fraud detection, compliance, and risk management. This role requires strong leadership skills, along with a deep understanding of fraud prevention, risk management, and compliance within the payments ecosystem. 

Your team will be responsible for the monitoring of the transaction and behaviours across our customer base, ensuring we put our genuine members first, whilst spotting and investigating potentially suspicious activity. This role is a key element of our team, so we're looking for someone who is a passionate investigator, possesses good knowledge on merchant payments, who will help reduce risk to tide, and let our members get back to doing what they love. 

- Lead, manage, and mentor a team of Transaction Monitoring Analysts, ensuring they meet performance metrics, including transaction reviews, case resolution times, and fraud detection accuracy.

 - Ensure all monitored transactions comply with industry regulations and standards, including AML, and card network rules (Visa, MasterCard, etc. ). 
 - Develop strategies to reduce fraudulent activities across merchant card payments and ensure merchants meet compliance requirements. 
 - Use data-driven insights to recommend improvements in transaction monitoring processes and fraud mitigation strategies. 
 - Keep the team updated on emerging fraud trends and adjust detection rules and constantly measure, assess and improve our risk policies, procedures and controls across products
 - Foster a collaborative team environment focused on continuous improvement and high operational efficiency. 
 - Representing your area in front of different stakeholders, including internal and external auditors. 

What We Are Looking For

- You are willing to work in flexible shift patterns. 
 - 3-5 years of experience in merchant banking, card acquiring, merchant acquiring, transaction monitoring, or merchant card payments with automated processes and data driven decisioning tools/culture. 
 - Proven leadership experience, with a track record of managing teams in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. 
 - Deep understanding of card acquiring processes, merchant acquiring systems, payment networks (Visa, MasterCard, etc. ), and fraud detection methodologies. 
 - Analytical mindset with a proven ability to interpret complex transaction data and identify fraud patterns. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience in handling escalations and coordinating cross-functional teams. 
 - Ability to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

data.title: System Architect
data.description:
EVA Equity Partners acquires enterprise software companies and transforms them into AI-native, profitable, scalable businesses. We don't add AI features. We redesign foundational architecture so autonomous agents can safely build, test, and ship production software at scale. 

The role

We are hiring a Agentic Systems Architect to transform 10+ year legacy codebases into high-velocity, agent-operable architectures. This role sits at the intersection of software architecture, AI-agent orchestration, and engineering governance. You will be embedded into EVA portfolio companies, design system patterns and MCP interfaces, and govern what AI generates. 

What you'll do

Agent-operable system architecture

- Decompose legacy monoliths into agent-readable, modular systems with strict boundaries and single responsibility
 - Lead incremental modernization using the Strangler Pattern, wrapping legacy logic in modern, contract-driven interfaces
 - Enforce SOLID principles, Dependency Injection, and Hexagonal Architecture to ensure deterministic AI execution and low regression riskAgentic framework and MCP leadership

- Architect and maintain the agent context layer: standardized Skills, Rules, and Commands for AI-driven engineering workflows
 - Build and operate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers exposing legacy APIs, services, and databases as typed, secure, AI-consumable tools
 - Own contract-first API design as the primary interface between human intent and autonomous agent executionEngineering governance and AI quality control

- Act as architectural gatekeeper for AI-generated pull requests, ensuring scalability, security, and long-term maintainability
 - Mandate test-driven development (TDD) and characterization testing to preserve legacy behavior during refactoring
 - Monitor and optimize agentic reasoning loops to balance cost, speed, and architectural integrityWhat we're looking for

- 7+ years in software architecture, platform engineering
 - Proven experience modernizing large, undocumented legacy systems
 - Deep hands-on expertise with TypeScript, . NET, and Node. js
 - Strong background in API design, distributed systems, and modular architectures
 - Practical experience with agentic development, MCP, LLM tooling, or AI-assisted engineering
 - Bias toward clean code, deterministic systems, and production-grade AI
 - Comfort operating in high-ambiguity, high-ownership, remote-first environmentsNice to have

- Experience in PE-backed or SaaS transformation environments
 - Background working across multiple companies or codebases as a consultant or fractional leader
 - Familiarity with LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar agentic orchestration frameworksWhy this role matters

You are not adding AI features. You are designing the architectural substrate that allows AI to safely build software at scale. This is a career-defining role for architects shaping how autonomous systems write, change, and govern production code.

About Juniper Square

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We're the Operations Partner trusted by 2, 300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700, 000+ LPs on platform, we've built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we're reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1, 000+ employees strong, we're building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come. 

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you're energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U. S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time. 

About The Role

We're looking for a Technical Lead to join our Platform team. Nice To Have And AI Experience

data.title: Manager, Data Storage Platforms
data.description:

For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients- that is what Vantive aspires to deliver. 

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don't settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients' lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities. 

The Manager, Data Storage Platforms is responsible for leading a team of platform engineers overseeing the planning, the build, and the operations of data platforms. They will be responsible for architecting, engineering, and optimizing large‐scale, cloud‐native data platforms on AWS and Azure. This role leads development of event‐driven data architectures, CDC frameworks, data lake ingestion pipelines, and scalable ETL/ELT processes. The architect partners closely with cross‐functional teams, leads technical delivery, ensures operational excellence, and provides hands‐on support for global data transformation initiatives. They will be a part of the Data Services Platforms team and provide technological and process expertise and support the global domain data product delivery teams. They will provide leadership by assisting business partners in identifying and responding to opportunities for cost-effective data implementations and solutions by analyzing and making decisions that have cross functional business impact. 

Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of data platform engineers
 - Accountable for strategic planning and technical roadmap development for data platforms. 
 - Oversee the design, implementation, and maintenance of data engineering pipelines in a multi-cloud environment, including integrations with a variety of data sources (including structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data)
 - Collaborate with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams and other stakeholders in Architecture, Data Integration, DevOps, and Data Governance to deliver data platform initiatives
 - Ensure data engineering standards align with industry best practices for data governance, data quality, and data security. 
 - Monitor and optimize the performance of data pipelines, ensuring they meet SLAs for data availability and quality. 
 - Evaluate and recommend new data technologies and tools to improve data engineering processes and outcomes, in collaboration with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams.

Key Experiences & Attributes

- Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or relevant subject area

data.title: Senior Staff AI Application Engineer
data.description:
Job Description Summary

We are looking for a senior full-stack engineer who has shipped production applications, and who has owned software that other engineering teams depended on - a framework, SDK, shared library or internal developer platform - living with an abstraction decision long enough to have had to correct it while consumers depended on it. Establishing engineering standards through automation rather than documentation should be instinctive. 

You will be the senior technical owner of GE HealthCare's internal AI engineering platform: the shared libraries, standardised interfaces, code generation tools and automated verification our data scientists and engineers use to take AI solutions into production. It exists to deliver four outcomes for the company: 

- reduce time from working prototype to production from months to days; 
 - allow data scientists to ship production-grade AI without expertise in cloud infrastructure, deployment, application security or front-end development; 
 - make security, compliance and consistency automatically enforced properties of every solution, rather than outcomes dependent on scarce expert review; 
 - allow underlying technologies to be replaced - model provider, agent framework, user interface approach - without rewriting the solutions built on them. 

Your accountability is the platform's architecture and public interfaces, the automated verification that enforces our engineering standards, and the versioning and migration approach that keeps it dependable as it evolves beneath a growing number of applications. The role also includes building AI applications end to end yourself - front end, back end and agents - where that is the fastest way to prove a platform capability or unblock a priority use case; the emphasis at this level sits firmly on the platform, with application work serving it rather than competing with it. This is a hands-on senior engineering role with substantial architectural responsibility and organisational influence - not a management position, and not a research position. 

Job Description

GE HealthCare's Chief Data and Analytics Office is delivering a portfolio of strategic AI programmes across Commercial, Finance, Supply Chain, Quality, Manufacturing and Operational Excellence. 

The problem this team addresses is structural. Most people creating AI solutions here are data scientists, and it would be neither reasonable nor efficient to require deep infrastructure, security and front-end expertise of them. Every solution must nonetheless reach production as a secure, reliable, observable, supportable enterprise system, and remain so through years of change. That is the central design constraint: the platform and its automated safeguards must substitute for a depth of software engineering review that is not available at the scale and pace we require. 

The failures a strong platform engineer prevents - undetected interface drift, poorly chosen abstractions that become permanent, over-broad access permissions, configuration that cannot be reviewed or reversed - are silent, and present months later as an outage, an audit finding or a security incident rather than as a broken feature. 

Core Responsibilities

Architecture and design

- Define the platform's architecture and public interfaces: what is offered, what is guaranteed, what is private, and what a version number promises to dependent applications. 
 - Design isolation boundaries so each significant third-party technology - agent framework, model provider, message queue, data source, UI rendering approach - is confined to a single replaceable component, with automated checks making that a verified property rather than a documented intention. Validate each in practice, for example by running the same agent unmodified on two frameworks (LangGraph and AWS Bedrock AgentCore, say) with equivalent evaluated behaviour. 
 - Design the interfaces between roles and components as machine-readable specifications with automated verification, so no two teams need to read each other's code to work together reliably. 
 - Hold the boundary between declarative configuration and executable code - configuration states what, code implements how - preventing the familiar progression by which a configuration format acquires conditional logic and becomes an undocumented programming language with no type checking, debugger or tooling. 
 - Record architectural decisions formally (options rejected, trade-offs accepted, revisit conditions), and decline unnecessary abstraction in writing and with reasoning. A significant part of this role's value lies in shared capability deliberately not built. 

Engineering delivery and long-term ownership

- Lead the highest-leverage components hands-on: the agent execution layer, the secure data resolution layer, and the configuration-driven user interface system. This is a building role, not a supervisory one. 
 - Build selected AI applications end to end - front end, back end and agents - where that is the fastest way to prove a platform capability or unblock a priority use case, and judge what should then be harvested into the platform and what should remain specific to that use case. 
 - Establish automated verification before the practice it enforces is adopted - a standard that is not automatically enforced does not, in practice, exist - including automated quality evaluation of AI behaviour in the release path, so degraded output prevents release and a change of model or framework can be shown to have preserved behaviour. 
 - Own backward compatibility and the migration path. The platform will change continuously while dozens of solutions depend on it; making that change inexpensive and safe for consumers is a primary responsibility. 
 - Prevent version divergence across applications and shared components; run deprecation properly - announce, migrate, remove - and maintain visibility of the platform's own engineering health, acting before it is raised. 

Interfaces with adjacent disciplines

- Define and maintain the interfaces between this team and adjacent specialist functions - infrastructure, security, data - as version-controlled specifications with automated validation rather than request queues or standing meetings. These cover what an environment provides, what an infrastructure component accepts, what a service requires to run and is permitted to do, what must pass before release, what artefact is deployed and how it is promoted, and what telemetry and service level commitments apply. 
 - Anticipate and act on the recognised ways such boundaries deteriorate: a request queue re-forming, resources created outside the sanctioned path, release throughput constrained by a single function, divergent standards emerging, or incidents beginning with a dispute about ownership. 
 - Represent the platform's architecture and trade-offs to enterprise architecture, information security, risk and senior leadership, in terms appropriate to each audience. 

Technical leadership

- Mentor engineers and data scientists moving into platform and application engineering, and establish a review culture in which human review addresses design judgement and business fit, because formatting, type correctness, security fundamentals and interface compliance are handled automatically. 
 - Author the guidance, reference implementations and worked examples that let colleagues and AI coding assistants work productively without direct supervision, and set the standard for responsible use of those assistants under named human accountability. 

Experience Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent demonstrable practical experience. An advanced degree is welcome but not required. 
 - Minimum 8 years of professional software engineering experience, including demonstrable ownership of a shared library, framework, SDK or internal developer platform relied upon by other engineering teams. This is the essential requirement: not a record of delivering many applications, but an engineer whose software other engineers' software depends on, and who can describe concretely what it cost when an abstraction had to change. 

Software engineering

- Expert Python: advanced static and structural typing (mypy or Pyright, strict), interface definition, and judgement about where type-level guarantees earn their cost. Strong TypeScript and modern component-based front-end engineering (React), sufficient to design typed component contracts and a design token system rather than only consume them. 
 - API and interface design and long-term evolution: specification (OpenAPI), generated clients, versioning, compatibility, deprecation. Relational databases and SQL at depth: schema design, migrations, indexing, behaviour under load, injection resistance established structurally rather than by review. 
 - Testing strategy across unit, integration, interface-contract and end-to-end levels; CI/CD design (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) including shared reusable pipeline components, and the discipline of keeping checks fast enough that engineers do not bypass them. 

AI and Generative AI engineering

- Substantial production experience with LLM systems: instruction design, tool and function calling, structured output, retrieval-augmented generation and retrieval quality, cost and latency control, characteristic failure modes. 
 - Hands-on experience with more than one AI agent framework (for example LangGraph, LangChain, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, OpenAI Agents SDK) and demonstrated ability to design a durable abstraction across them - including rigorous reasoning about which capabilities belong in a common, framework-independent agent definition and which do not. 
 - Familiarity with emerging standards for AI tool and context interoperability (for example the Model Context Protocol), with the judgement to design toward such a standard's shape without prematurely building infrastructure for it. 
 - Evaluation-driven development at depth: designing evaluation suites and quality measures for non-deterministic systems and using them as a formal release gate. 

Required

Cloud and delivery engineering Infrastructure and production operations are specialist disciplines owned elsewhere in the organisation; our applications request what they need through version-controlled declarations validated automatically, rather than by authoring infrastructure or access policies directly. You are not expected to author infrastructure modules, access policies or network components, nor to own cloud estate design, release execution or infrastructure on call. Required at this depth: 

- Strong working knowledge of a major public cloud, ideally AWS: serverless compute (Lambda), messaging (SQS), object and vector storage (S3, S3 Vectors), secret management, managed relational databases (Aurora), content delivery, event routing, managed AI model services (Bedrock) - sufficient to design well against them and reason about cost, quota, scaling and failure. 
 - Infrastructure-as-code: fluent reading and review (Terraform) - interpret an execution plan, evaluate whether a component's interface meets a requirement, articulate precisely what is missing and why. Access-management design literacy at boundary level: what a grant permits, what a boundary constrains, why least-privilege access is better generated than hand-written, and how to identify an over-broad request in review. 
 - Observability design (OpenTelemetry): distributed tracing, structured logging, standardised telemetry, service level objectives and error budgets. Supply chain and delivery security: immutable artefact identity, build provenance, secret scanning, dependency vulnerability management, short-lived federated credentials. 
 - Cost engineering at the level of declared resource requirements: compute sizing, execution limits, model consumption, caching and result limits. 

Leadership and communication

- Ability to explain a technical design and its trade-offs to executive leadership, to security and risk, and to a data scientist, adjusting the level without losing the substance - and willingness to state clearly when a programme is blocked and what would unblock it. 
 - Experience leading work where the principal difficulty was organisational rather than technical, with a concrete account of how a cross-team boundary was kept healthy. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) - Kubernetes / Observability / Java

Role Summary

We are looking for an experienced Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) with a strong background in Kubernetes, production support, observability, SQL, and Java-based applications. The role will focus on ensuring the availability, reliability, scalability, and performance of business-critical production systems. 

The ideal candidate will combine strong application troubleshooting skills with SRE and DevOps practices, using Datadog and/or Prometheus for monitoring and observability and Kubernetes for managing containerized workloads. A strong understanding of Java applications and relational databases/SQL is essential for diagnosing issues across application, infrastructure, and data layers. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the reliability, availability, and operational health of business-critical production applications and services. 
 - Provide L2/L3 production support, including incident triage, troubleshooting, resolution, and stakeholder communication. 
 - Monitor and support applications deployed on Kubernetes, including pods, deployments, services, ingress, resource utilization, scaling, and cluster-related issues. 
 - Implement and maintain application and infrastructure monitoring using Datadog, Prometheus, dashboards, metrics, logs, and alerts. 
 - Define and monitor SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, error budgets, and service-health indicators for critical applications. 
 - Troubleshoot production issues across Java applications, APIs, microservices, Kubernetes, databases, and infrastructure. 
 - Analyze Java application logs, exceptions, JVM performance, memory utilization, thread behavior, and garbage collection to identify performance and reliability issues. 
 - Use SQL to investigate production incidents, validate data, identify data-related issues, and perform application-level troubleshooting. 
 - Participate in incident management, major incident calls, root-cause analysis (RCA), and post-incident reviews. 
 - Identify recurring production issues and drive permanent remediation through automation and engineering improvements. 
 - Build and enhance monitoring dashboards, alerting mechanisms, and operational runbooks to improve early detection and reduce recovery time. 
 - Drive improvements in MTTR, availability, performance, capacity, and production stability. 
 - Automate repetitive operational activities using scripting and appropriate DevOps/SRE tooling. 
 - Support application releases, production deployments, rollback activities, and post-deployment validation. 
 - Work closely with Development, Infrastructure, DevOps, Database, Security, and Business teams to ensure production readiness. 
 - Participate in on-call and production support rotations as required. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 5+ years of overall IT experience, with significant experience in SRE, Production Support, Application Support, or DevOps roles. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerized applications. 
 - Experience with Datadog and/or Prometheus for monitoring, alerting, metrics, and observability. 
 - Strong experience supporting Java/J2EE or Java-based microservices applications in production. 
 - Good understanding of JVM troubleshooting, application logs, memory, threads, garbage collection, and performance issues. 
 - Strong SQL skills with experience troubleshooting relational databases and application data issues. 
 - Experience managing P1/P2 production incidents, including incident coordination, RCA, and problem management. 
 - Good understanding of REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and application integration patterns. 
 - Experience with Linux/Unix environments and shell scripting. 
 - Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, release management, and deployment practices. 
 - Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose issues across multiple technology layers. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS/ Azure. 
 - Familiarity with Docker, Helm, GitLab/GitHub Actions, or similar DevOps tooling. 
 - Experience with centralized logging platforms such as ELK/OpenSearch or Splunk. 
 - Exposure to Infrastructure as Code tools such as Ansible/Terraform. 
 - Understanding of load balancing, networking, DNS, certificates, and application security. 
 - Experience implementing automation to reduce manual operational effort and production toil. 
 - Familiarity with ITIL processes including Incident, Problem, and Change Management. 

Key SRE Competencies

- Production Reliability: Ability to maintain highly available and resilient production services. 
 - Observability: Strong understanding of metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerting. 
 - Incident Management: Ability to rapidly diagnose and restore services during critical incidents. 
 - Problem Management: Strong RCA skills with focus on permanent remediation rather than repeated tactical fixes. 
 - Automation: Ability to identify and automate repetitive production-support activities. 
 - Performance Engineering: Ability to identify bottlenecks across Java applications, Kubernetes, and databases. 
 - Stakeholder Management: Ability to communicate clearly during incidents and work effectively across engineering and business teams. 

Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured through improvements in system availability, SLO adherence, MTTR, incident recurrence, application performance, alert quality, production stability, and reduction of manual operational effort.

Value Proposition

The Principal Software Engineer in DevSecOps brings a unique blend of security expertise, automation excellence and architecture foresight enabling the organization to build and deliver secure, scalable software at speed

Drive reliability and resilience - Ensure critical applications and platforms are highly available, scalable, resilient and capable of meeting defined SLOs and SLAs. 

Shift reliability and security left - Embed reliability and security practices early in the software development lifecycle, reducing production risks and remediation costs. 

Improve incident responses and recovery: Establish effective monitoring, alerting, incident response and RCA practices.

Position Title: Principal Software Engineer

Career Level: P4

About The Team

Our team is a strategic team that drives in adoption of secure, automated and scalable software delivery practices. We set the standards, frameworks and best practices for integrating security into Devops process. By Embedding automated security controls into CI/CD pipelines promoting secure coding practices and enabling infrastructure as code the team empowers developers to deliver quickly without compromising safety. 

Impact

As a DevSecOps SRE Engineer on our team, you will play a key role in building and operating secure, scalable and highly reliable platforms. You will bridge development, security and operations by embedding reliability and security into software delivery life cycle, driving automation and observability, improving incident response and enabling faster and safer software delivery. The role offers an opportunity to influence engineering practices at scale, solve complex reliability challenges, and build platforms that improve both developer productivity and business resilience

Key Deliverables

- Define and implement SRE practices, standards and reliability engineering principles across applications and platforms

 - Design, implement and maintain CI/CD templates with integrated security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA, secret scanning etc). 
 - Develop automation for vulnerability scanning, compliance checks and infrastructure hardening across cloud and on prem. 
 - Define and enforce secure IaC practices. 
 - Conduct Code reviews and provide guidance on application and infrastructure security architecture
 - Set up and manage observability tools and implement alerting and logging for early issue detection and ensuring the reliability and performance of DevSecOps applications and services in preproduction and production.

 - Bridge gaps between teams to create shared accountability for secure delivery

 - Strong experience with Linux/Unix systems administration and troubleshooting

 - Experience collaborating with teams using tools like Jira/Confluence

About Us
At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living and a net-zero future. As one of the world's largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.

ExxonMobil's affiliates in India

ExxonMobil's affiliates have offices in India in Bengaluru, Mumbai and the National Capital Region. 

ExxonMobil's affiliates in India supporting the Product Solutions business engage in the marketing, sales and distribution of performance as well as specialty products across chemicals and lubricants businesses. The India planning teams are also embedded with global business units for business planning and analytics. 

ExxonMobil's LNG affiliate in India supporting the upstream business provides consultant services for other ExxonMobil upstream affiliates and conducts LNG market-development activities.

To know more about ExxonMobil in India, visit ExxonMobil India and the Energy Factor India. 

What Role You Will Play In Our Team
The Wells Quality Engineer - Drilling Services is a broad role definition for individuals, generally with an Operations background, supporting the global Wells business with a focus on Drilling Services, Equipment, and Tools. This role focusses on application of risk mitigations through quality best practices and processes to ensure integrity and compliance of materials, products, and equipment to industry and specified requirements and provides guidance on fit-for-purpose quality implementation. This position is embedded in the technical center (based in Bengaluru) and provides support to business units and the global Wells Quality network. 

This role is also responsible for stewarding monthly Global Wells Quality Network meetings, driving efficiencies in the standardization of processes, sharing quality catches and alerts across business units, and enabling the implementation of best practices through continuous improvement and industry engagement. 

What You Will Do

- Stewards monthly Global Wells Quality Network meetings - leads the standardization of processes and enables the implementation of best practices through lessons learned and industry engagement. 
 - Leads the standardization and improvement of the Interval Problem Reporting / Quality Event Reports (QER) across business units - facilitating the development of associated tools and dashboards. 
 - Assist the maintenance and distribution of quality catches associated with Drilling Services and equipment manufacturing activities. 
 - Aids the Global Quality network with ExxonMobil Rig equipment inspection, testing, and preventive maintenance requirements. 
 - Stewards the maintenance of Wells Teams Quality Plans for business units and aids the implementation of Quality Control Plans for Suppliers and Service Quality Plans for Drilling Contractors and Service Partners. 
 - Support the Global Wells Quality network with the stewardship of capability and QMS assessments of Drilling Contractors, Service Partners and Suppliers
 - Provide support for business units (when requested) to ensure that all drill string and BHA equipment and services meet the minimum specified technical and quality requirements
 - Provide support (when requested) on tool and equipment preparations and inspections to include, but not limited to, manufacturing, disassembly, inspection, repair, servicing, reassembly, pressure testing, and function testing of equipment including directional drilling, BHA & drill pipe, tubular handling, cementing, wireline and coil tubing equipment to ensure proper procedures are followed (e. g. quality plans and Equipment Preventive Maintenance, Inspection and Test Plans - PMITPs). 
 - Reviews of documents for manufacturing or services related to incoming equipment (Drill Pipe Inspection reports, TPI reports associated with manufacturing, MTRs etc. )
 - Coordinates equipment and service failure investigations, root cause analysis, corrective action identification and implementation. 
 - Assists Wells Engineering staff with resolution of Nonconformance Reports (NCRs) and Requests-for-Exception (RFEs). 
 - Organize, plan, and supervise verification programs via Third Party Inspectors (TPIs) to ensure conformance with the applicable ExxonMobil specifications and industry codes and standards. 
 - Ensure appropriate budget allocation for Third Party inspection agencies in collaboration with Wells Teams. 
 - Maintain sound understanding of API specifications and ExxonMobil Quality procedures. 

About You
Skills and Qualifications

- Must have a bachelor's degree from a recognized university in engineering (Mechanical or Manufacturing or Equivalent) as a minimum. 
 - Minimum 8-10 years of relevant experience in oil and gas Drilling Services equipment inspection and testing in the field of Quality. 
 - Candidate must have a minimum CGPA of 7. 0 out of 10. 
 - Must have strong knowledge of drilling services and rig equipment inspection, testing, preventive maintenance and major certification requirements. 
 - Must have strong knowledge of design & testing BOP equipment, control systems and recommended practices regarding BOP equipment, testing and maintenance (API 16A, API 16D, API RP53). 
 - Experienced and familiar with API Q1, API Q2 & API Product specifications such as API 5CT, API 5DP, API 7-1. 
 - Experienced with Drill String Inspection (DS-1) and maintenance. 
 - Must hold NDT Level II certification in MPT, UT, LPT, RT, and VT. 
 - Experienced and familiar with API and proprietary premium connection (VAM, Tenaris, JFE and Hunting), rotary connection inspection and threading operations. 
 - Certification or auditing experience (ISO 9001 or API Q1 or Q2) is preferable. 
 - Certification or welding experience (through a recognized body like AWS/CSWIP 3. 1/3. 2) is preferable. 
 - Thorough knowledge of sound quality assurance practices. Abreast of best practices and latest technology in meeting minimum industry standards and specifications (such as API and/or ISO 9000, ASME, DS-1, NACE, etc. ) for inspection, assembly, testing, storage and transportation of drilling services equipment. 

Your Benefits
An ExxonMobil career is one designed to last. Our commitment to you runs deep our employees grow personally and professionally, with benefits built on our core categories of health, security, finance and life. We offer you: 

- Competitive compensation

data.title: Senior Software Test Engineer
data.description:
About the Company

Every minute of every day, Smiths Detection's threat detection and security screening technology helps to protect people and infrastructure, making the world a safer place. Smiths Detection is a global leader in the development, manufacture and management of security and detection solutions designed to make the world a safer place. Our technology provides threat detection and screening solutions for customers in our key markets: aviation, ports and borders, defence, and urban security. Our expertise spans 21 global offices, seven manufacturing sites and five R&D centres, with a global network of 3, 000 dedicated colleagues contributing towards over 40 years at the frontline of advances in safety and security. This results in careers built on variety and the opportunity to work on a range of state-of-the-art solutions, where you can develop your knowledge and experience every day. 

About the Role

Job Purpose: 

The Senior Software Test Engineer role ensures delivery of high‐quality, reliable, and secure software by leading comprehensive testing across distributed, microservices‐based applications. It involves designing and executing test cases, supporting automation frameworks, and integrating testing into CI/CD pipelines to validate functionality, performance, and scalability. By collaborating with cross‐functional teams, identifying and documenting issues, and driving continuous improvement, the role enhances product stability and accelerates delivery cycles. 

Responsibilities

- The Senior Software Test Engineer role ensures delivery of high‐quality, reliable, and secure software by leading comprehensive testing across distributed, microservices‐based applications. 
 - It involves designing and executing test cases, supporting automation frameworks, and integrating testing into CI/CD pipelines to validate functionality, performance, and scalability. 
 - By collaborating with cross‐functional teams, identifying and documenting issues, and driving continuous improvement, the role enhances product stability and accelerates delivery cycles. 
 - As per company policy, this role requires presence in the office 4 days per week. 

Duties: 

- Test Case Development & Execution: Collaborate with senior engineers to develop and execute comprehensive test cases that align with project requirements, ensuring thorough testing of software functionality, performance, and security. 
 - Automation Support: Contribute to the development and maintenance of automated test scripts and frameworks. Assist in enhancing test automation coverage for both system-level and front-end applications. 
 - Issue Identification & Documentation: Identify, track, and document software defects, functionality issues, and performance problems, working closely with developers to reproduce, debug, and resolve issues. 
 - Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product owners, and senior testers, to ensure alignment on testing goals and priorities. Communicate findings and progress effectively. 
 - Test Reporting & Metrics: Contribute to the preparation of test reports and track key testing metrics to assess test coverage, defect resolution, and overall testing progress. 
 - Support in Test Planning: Participate in test planning activities, contributing to discussions about scope, approach, and strategy for different types of testing, such as functional, regression, and integration testing. 
 - Version Control & Configuration Management: Utilize version control systems (e. g. , Git, Subversion) for maintaining test scripts, test cases, and related artifacts. 
 - CI/CD Integration: Assist in integrating test scripts into Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to ensure that automated tests are executed as part of the development process. 
 - Manual Testing: Conduct manual testing where required, especially in areas that are difficult to automate or require more exploratory testing to identify edge cases. 
 - Collaboration on Automation Strategy: Support senior engineers by contributing ideas and improvements to the automation strategy, tools, and frameworks used in the testing process. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Provide feedback on testing processes and practices, suggesting improvements and applying lessons learned from past testing cycles to enhance efficiency and test effectiveness. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. 

Required Skills

- 4-7 years of hands‐on experience testing distributed, microservices‐based applications, including test strategy definition, design, execution, and maintenance. 
 - Strong expertise in automated testing frameworks such as Robot Framework and Python for service‐level and end‐to‐end testing across backend and consumer‐facing applications. 
 - Proficiency in API testing (RESTful services), including contract validation, payload verification, error handling, and service dependency checks. 
 - Hands‐on experience with containerisation technologies (Docker) and orchestration platforms (Kubernetes), including deployment validation and scalability testing. 
 - Working knowledge of cloud platforms and their deployment models. 
 - Experience supporting applications deployed via CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Bitbucket) with understanding of microservices promotion across environments. 
 - Proficiency with Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence), test management tools (TestRail), and version control systems (Git). 
 - Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, microservices concepts, and test methodologies with ability to collaborate across development, DevOps, and testing teams. 
 - Demonstrated ability to write clear test cases, maintain accurate documentation, and track quality metrics in fast‐moving environments. 

Preferred Skills

- Broader exposure to advanced automation strategies or scripting for test environments. 
 - Certifications in testing frameworks, cloud technologies, or DevOps practices. 
 - Experience with performance testing and monitoring tools. 
 - Familiarity with security testing or compliance validation in microservices architectures. 
 - Resourceful with strong analytical and communication skills at all organisational levels. 
 - Self-starter with excellent time management, attention to detail, and initiative. 
 - Proven ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional and cross-cultural teams.

The role is responsible for : the design, development and integration of building management systems and the controls that run our modular MEP platforms for data centers. This role is responsible for the full controls stack: architecture, PLC/SCADA programming, data integration, control logic, sequencing and system-level validation. 

You'll work closely with mechanical, electrical, and systems architects to define how each MEP module is monitored, automated and coordinated so the entire facility operates reliably and efficiently. You'll also guide best practices, review vendor implementations and help shape the long-term controls roadmap.

What You'll Need

 - Hands-on experience with PLC programming (Allen-Bradley, Siemens or equivalent) and HMI/SCADA platforms.

data.title: Senior Data Engineer
data.description:
About us

Factori is a rapidly growing location and consumer intelligence company built for an AI-first world. Each day we ingest billions of privacy-compliant signals and maintain the world's most comprehensive consumer, mobility and point-of-Interest database. 

Our AI-driven insights help Fortune 500 brands, global media agencies and technology innovators decide where to invest, build and grow. Headquartered in New York City with hubs across APAC, EMEA and the Americas, we operate with the ownership mindset of a startup and the global footprint of an enterprise data leader. 

About the Role: 

We are hiring a Senior Data Engineer to own and scale a petabyte-scale data platform on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), processing TB scale of data every day with Apache Spark. You will lead a small team of data engineers, drive cloud cost optimisation across our data workloads, and build AI-driven workflows that change how we support and operate the platform. 

This is a product engineering role, not a services or consulting engagement. You will own systems end to end, live with your design decisions in production, and help define data engineering culture in India. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Build and scale the platform

- Design, build and operate highly available, fault-tolerant batch and streaming pipelines on GCP that ingest hundreds of terabytes a day into a petabyte-scale data lake and warehouse. 
 - Write and tune large Spark workloads (PySpark, Spark SQL, Scala/Java) on Dataproc or Spark on Kubernetes (GKE): partitioning, shuffle and join optimization, skew handling, memory and executor sizing. 
 - Build real-time and near-real-time pipelines with Pub/Sub or Kafka and Spark Structured Streaming or Dataflow (Apache Beam), with clear guarantees on latency, ordering and exactly-once or idempotent processing. 
 - Model data in BigQuery and the lakehouse (Parquet, Avro, Delta Lake or Apache Iceberg) into clean, simplified datasets that teams can self-serve. 

Own data quality

- Build data cleaning, validation and reconciliation pipelines that stay correct when source data is late, duplicated, malformed or missing. 
 - Put data contracts, schema evolution rules, quality checks and alerting in place, and own data mapping, business logic and transformations end to end. 

Lead cloud cost optimization

- Own the cost of our GCP data workloads: measure cost per pipeline and per customer, then reduce it through right-sizing, autoscaling, preemptible/Spot VMs, storage tiering, BigQuery slot and query optimization, and job consolidation. 
 - Set up cost visibility (billing export, labels, dashboards) and FinOps practices so cost is tracked and owned, not discovered after the fact. 

Lead and mentor

- Lead and mentor 2-4 junior and mid-level data engineers: plan and break down work, review code and designs, and raise the team's engineering bar. 
 - Lead system design and architecture discussions, write design docs, and make trade-offs on scalability, reliability, latency and cost. 

Innovate with AI

- Design AI-driven workflows for technical support and operations: LLM-assisted triage of pipeline failures and data incidents, automated root-cause analysis, runbook automation, and agents that answer data questions from internal teams. 
 - Turn repeated support work into automated, process-driven workflows, and measure the time and tickets they save

Run it in production

- Own production reliability: on-call, monitoring and observability, incident response, postmortems, and low-level debugging and performance tuning on large clusters. 
 - Orchestrate pipelines with Airflow / Cloud Composer and ship through CI/CD and infrastructure as code (Terraform). 

What we are looking for : 

Experience: 

- 6 plus years in data engineering or backend/software engineering, with at least 4 years building big data pipelines in production. 
 - Minimum 1-2 years as a tech lead or team lead, mentoring junior engineers and owning delivery for a team. Product background: 

- Most of your experience at product or SaaS companies, owning platforms you built and ran in production, rather than consulting or IT services delivery. Apache Spark at scale: 

- Deep hands-on PySpark and Spark SQL; Spark internals (DAG, stages, shuffle, catalyst, AQE), performance tuning, and handling data skew on multi-terabyte jobs. Scala or Java Spark is a strong plus. Google Cloud Platform: 

- Production experience with BigQuery, Dataproc, Cloud Storage (GCS), Pub/Sub, and Cloud Composer or Airflow. Dataflow, GKE and Bigtable are a plus. Batch and stream processing: 

- Designed and run both, with a solid grasp of windowing, watermarks, late data, checkpointing, backfills and idempotency. Kafka or Pub/Sub plus Spark Structured Streaming, Flink or Dataflow. SQL: 

- Expert-level, including window functions, complex joins and query optimization on large analytical warehouses. Programming and OOP: 

- Strong Python and Java with object-oriented design, design patterns and clean, testable, reusable code. Data quality: 

- Built data cleaning, validation, deduplication and reconciliation pipelines, with automated quality checks and alerting. System design: 

- Can design a scalable, fault-tolerant distributed data system and defend the trade-offs in consistency, latency, cost and failure handling. Cloud cost optimization: 

- A track record of measurably reducing cloud or data platform costs (state the numbers on your CV). Databases and storage: 

- Parquet, Avro and ORC; partitioning and clustering; production experience with PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch and Bigtable (or comparable relational, search and NoSQL stores). 

Good to have : 

- Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer or Professional Cloud Architect certification. 
 - Lakehouse table formats: Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg or Apache Hudi. dbt, Trino/Presto or ClickHouse. 
 - Terraform, Docker and Kubernetes (GKE) for data infrastructure. 
 - Data observability and lineage tools such as Monte Carlo, OpenLineage or DataHub. 
 - Building with LLM APIs, RAG or agent frameworks (Vertex AI, Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, LangChain). 
 - Domain experience in ad tech, martech, marketing attribution or measurement. 

Who thrives here : 

- You own outcomes. When a pipeline breaks at 2 a. m. or a number looks wrong, you treat it as yours until it is fixed and the root cause is gone. 
 - You are accountable. You make commitments you can keep, flag risks early, and close the loop without being chased. 
 - You think like a product engineer. You care about the customer impact of data quality, latency and cost, not just whether the job finished. 
 - You raise the people around you. You give clear reviews, share context, and help junior engineers grow into owners. 
 - You simplify. You prefer fewer, well-understood systems and automate repeated work, increasingly with AI. 

How to apply : 

If this sounds like you, apply now at careers@lifesight. io. We'd love to hear from you! For more information visit - https: //factori. ai/

data.description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description. 

About JumpCloud®
JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times. 

  

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT. 

Position Overview
We are seeking a Senior / Lead Software Engineer to drive the architectural evolution, security posture, and engineering execution of our core platform. In this role, you will lead the design of scalable microservices, integrate enterprise Privileged Access Management (PAM) frameworks, drive automated delivery pipelines, and champion cutting-edge AI-assisted engineering practices. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- 
Architecture & Core Engineering: Design, build, and maintain scalable, highly available microservices using C#, . NET Core, Go, and TypeScript via gRPC and the ABP framework. 

- 
Privileged Access Management (PAM): Design and deploy enterprise-grade Privileged Access Management (PAM)/IDAM solutions (e. g. , CyberArk, BeyondTrust, HashiCorp Vault), enforcing Zero Trust principles, Least Privilege access, and SCIM protocol integrations. 

- 
Delivery & Test Engineering: Own end-to-end continuous delivery using Origin CI, Kargo, and WoK. Ensure platform resilience by implementing unit, functional, and Playwright E2E suites alongside Performance, Scalability, and Reliability (PSR) testing. 

- 
AI Adoption & Technical Leadership: Champion the BMAD framework to establish governance and structure for AI-assisted workflows (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot). Mentor engineers, conduct RFC reviews, and build shared team skill libraries. 

- 
Multi-Platform & Full-Stack Development: Build cross-platform services and native desktop applications (macOS, Windows, Linux) supporting complex enterprise user workflows. 

- 
Observability & Operational Excellence: Implement robust telemetry, logging, and tracing across microservices to monitor system health, reduce latency, and ensure strict SLA/SLO compliance. 

- 
Technical Debt & Governance: Partner with Product, Design, and Infrastructure teams to manage technical debt, refactor legacy components, and establish standardized engineering best practices across Agile sprints. 

- 
Problem solving & Troubleshooting: Active participation in the incident management process and contributing PIRs, taking ownership/accountability for a quick turn-around to resolve the incident.   

Required Qualifications & Technical Skills

- 
Experience: 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with proven leadership as a Lead Architect or Senior Staff Engineer in a modern product environment. 

- 
Backend Stack: Deep expertise in C#, . NET (ASP. NET Core / ABP Framework), Go, gRPC, and RESTful APIs. 

- 
Databases: Advanced proficiency with relational (PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL (DocumentDB) architectures. 

- 
Cloud & DevOps: Strong hands-on experience with AWS, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and custom CI/CD automation pipelines. 

- 
Testing: Proficiency with automated testing frameworks, specifically Playwright for E2E automation and dedicated load/stress testing tools. 

- 
Artificial Intelligence: Direct experience establishing spec-driven AI development workflows in production teams. 

Where you'll be working/Location: 

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description. 

  

You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.   

  

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed. 

  

Language: 

JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.   Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description. 

  

Why JumpCloud?   

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You'll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We're out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You'll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.     

  

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to "Build Connections. " To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed. " - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

  

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud.   Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.     

  

JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. 

  

Scam Notice: 

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment. 

  

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud. com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud. com with the subject line "Scam Notice"  

  

#BI-Remote

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https: //jumpcloud. com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.
