data.title: Senior Silicon Engineer - Front -End CAD
data.description:
Overview

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft's expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft's "Intelligent Cloud" mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for engineers to help achieve that mission. 

As Microsoft's cloud business continues to accelerate, the ability to deliver new silicon innovations and infrastructure at scale, with quality, speed, and cost efficiency, has never been more critical. Within SCHIE, the Methodology, Infrastructure & Labs Engineering (MILE) organization plays a pivotal role in enabling Microsoft's silicon strategy. MILE is responsible for end-to-end silicon design methodologies, EDA/CAD ecosystems, and the underlying compute infrastructure that powers the development of Microsoft's custom silicon portfolio - the Azure Cobalt and Azure Maia processors. 

We are seeking a Silicon Front-End (FE) CAD Software Engineer to develop, maintain, and support CAD flows and methodologies, as well as dashboards, CAD indicators, and automation used across Microsoft's front-end silicon design ecosystem. The role requires Python software-development skills, hands-on experience building and testing end-to-end, system-level software, and a solid understanding of front-end CAD flows and methodologies. 

#SCHIE

Responsibilities

- Develop, maintain, and support Frontend CAD flows and methodologies. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain CAD software, utilities, and automation for FE flows using Python, following disciplined software-engineering practices. 
 - Build and maintain dashboards and CAD indicators/metrics that provide visibility into flow health, quality, runtime, and design productivity. 
 - Develop and maintain regression and continuous-integration frameworks to evaluate flow stability, functionality, runtime, and quality of results. 
 - Analyse results and identify functional, runtime, resource, or quality regressions across tool and flow releases. 
 - Debug complex issues across CAD software, flows, scripts, and compute/cloud environments. 
 - Automate repetitive CAD activities and develop scalable, system-level utilities and applications, primarily in Python. 
 - Use Git-based version control and code-review practices to manage CAD flow development and releases. 
 - Collaborate with design, verification, methodology, and CAD engineers, and EDA vendors, to collect requirements and improve design productivity. 
 - Maintain high-quality documentation for software and flow releases, regression results, known issues, and methodology changes. 
 - Continuously improve flow reliability, scalability, automation, and turnaround time. 
 - Using AI to automate daily tasks and implementing AI based workflows

Qualifications

- Required Qualifications: 
 - BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - At least 6 years of hands-on experience developing and supporting software, automation, or CAD flows and methodologies, with proficiency in Python. 
 - Hands-on experience with end-to-end, Python-based, system-level development projects, including testing of complex systems. 
 - Preferred Qualifications: 
 - MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent work experience. 
 - 4+ years of relevant experience developing and maintaining FE CAD flows, methodologies, automation, or infrastructure software. 
 - Experience building dashboards, CAD indicators/metrics, and reporting or analytics solutions. 
 - Familiarity with front-end design and verification flows and methodologies (RTL, DV, DFT, lint, CDC/RDC, IP integration, design handoff/release). 
 - Experience with FE CAD infrastructure - build/run/release flows, continuous integration (CI/CD), flow orchestration, design data management, and version control; object-oriented programming and software-development practices; exposure to Azure cloud infrastructure and DevOps. 
 - Hands-on experience developing AI-based workflows and automation. 
 - Self-motivation, Growth mindset, Ownership mindset, attention to detail, and good written, verbal, and presentation skills are critical to success in this role

Other Requirements

- Ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements is required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to, the following specialized security screening: 
 - Microsoft Cloud Background Check. This position is required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter. 
 - This role will require access to information that is controlled for export under export control regulations, potentially under the U. S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations or Export Administration Regulations, the EU Dual Use Regulation, and/or other export control regulations. As a condition of employment, the successful candidate will be required to provide either proof of their country of citizenship or proof of their U. S. permanent residency or other protected status (e. g. , under 8 U. S. C. 1324b(a)(3)) for assessment of eligibility to access the export-controlled information. To meet this legal requirement, and as a condition of employment, the successful candidate's citizenship will be verified with a valid passport. Lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees may verify status using other documents, where applicable.

data.description:
About Officeworks: 

Officeworks' purpose is "we bring big ideas to life at low prices". It's how we create shared value for customers, team members, suppliers, communities and shareholders. 

We are Australia's leading omnichannel retailer of complete technology solutions, stationery, furniture, art supplies, and learning resources. We also offer services including Print & Create, and Geeks2U. 

Our products and services provide solutions to our diverse range of customers across Australia from households, students, small to large sized businesses, governments and schools. 

Our culture is built on beginning with customer, doing the right thing, executing with accountability, and leading with ambition. We are one team who are proud to "wear the blues" and deliver for our customers. 

We are an inclusive, forward-thinking organisation where diverse perspectives enable innovation, continuous improvement and better outcomes for our customers and teams. The work we do plays an important role in helping Australians work, learn, create and connect. 

The role: 

Title: Senior AI Engineer

Function: Technology

Location: Bengaluru

About the Technology Function: 

By joining the Technology team in the GCC you will play a direct role in Officeworks' global digital transformation, contributing to world-class capabilities that sit at the heart of how the business operates and grows. The GCC will support Officeworks' purpose of helping to bring big ideas to life at low prices, ensuring technology remains a true enabler of customer value and operational excellence. 

This opportunity to join as a founding member of the new global hub is a chance to be part of the original build-out of our GCC. Early joiners will influence how the hub operates and help shape the future state of some of Officeworks' core technology ecosystem. 

These roles are best suited for people who enjoy: 

- Exposure to eCommerce and digital platforms, customer facing services enabled online and in retail stores, and an expanding presence into generative and agentic commerce - covering operations, security, development, automation, and solution architecture
 - Supporting global initiatives and modernising business critical systems
 - being the forefront of global innovation and transformation, helping digitise the Officeworks business
 - Joining a place where your skills matter, your growth is intentional, and your work has visible impact on business outcomes. 

Why this role exists: 

The Senior AI Engineer sits inside a Customer Platforms pod and orchestrates the technical agents that produce code, tests, documentation and design artefacts. The role is a full stack engineering role that takes complete ownership of the quality engineering and testing, holding accountability for everything committed to production. 

The role exists to translate product specifications into functional agent tasks, maintain the human-in-the-loop review gate, and ensure system design integrity, non-functional performance and security standards are met. It plays a critical role in enabling continuous delivery across Customer Platforms while mentoring junior engineers and continuously improving agent workflows across pods. 

Where you will make a difference: 

In this role you will: 

Agent Orchestration and Execution: 

- Decompose Product Orchestrator specifications into functional tasks for technical agents. 
 - Run multiple agents in parallel across coding, test generation, documentation and design workflows. 
 - Sequence workstreams and manage technical dependencies to maintain high pod delivery velocity. 
 - Apply base context, security policies and platform standards to every agent execution cycle. 

Quality Control and Commit Gate: 

- Hold the human-in-the-loop review and commit gate independently on complex and high-risk change. 
 - Perform fast, accurate code and test reviews to ensure correctness, specification alignment and standards conformance. 
 - Owns end-to-end quality assurance accountability by designing agent test coverage and evaluation logic. 
 - Own defect management for the pod, from identification through root cause and resolution tracking, escalating systemic quality risks. 
 - Identify when agent workflows are insufficient and apply direct engineering intervention to resolve technical issues. 

System Design and Non-Functional Excellence: 

- Own architectural fit and system design judgement across the features delivered by the pod. 
 - Ensure non-functional outcomes, including performance, scalability, resilience and security, are met across all releases. 
 - Lead production incident resolution within the pod across touched platform domains. 
 - Contribute to domain design decisions as a consulted partner to the Solution Architects. 

Knowledge Governance and Workflow Improvement: 

- Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation and knowledge artefacts to serve as context layers for future agent runs. 
 - Feed refined domain context back to central repositories in collaboration with Context Engineers. 
 - Continuously refine and optimize agent workflows and share best practices across engineering pods. 
 - Mentor engineers on test design, defect triage and quality engineering practice across the pod. 

Who you will be working with: 

- Pod Leadership and Delivery Teams: Partner with Product Orchestrators and fellow pod engineers to refine requirements, assess technical feasibility and execute workstreams. 
 - Architecture Teams: Consult with Domain Architects and Solution Architects on domain design, system architecture and escalation pathways. 
 - Capability and Platform Specialists: Collaborate with Context Engineers, Associate AI Agent Evaluation Engineers and Associate Platform Engineers to align on shared context, security standards and tooling. 
 - Vendor and Platform Partners: Liaise with external AI tooling providers and vendor technical support to resolve complex platform constraints and adopt new capabilities. 

What success looks like: 

- Commit Gate Integrity: Low commit gate escape rate on complex and high-risk production changes. 
 - Innovation and Scaling: Agent workflow improvements developed within the pod are successfully adopted across broader engineering teams. 
 - Operational Resilience: Rapid resolution of production incidents within the pod with minimal downtime or customer impact. 
 - Delivery Velocity: High throughput of automated coding and testing tasks achieved without compromising technical quality or architectural standards. 
 - Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks' values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture. 

How you will lead: 

Individual Contributor

- Lives our Officeworks values and behaviours
 - Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
 - Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
 - Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop
 - Contributes to an inclusive and respectful environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels safe to speak up and belong

Our Values: 

Our values shape the way we work, our behaviours and how we interact with each other, our customers, suppliers and communities. 

We begin with customer: 

- We start with our customer' needs in every decision. 
 - We offer simple, helpful and affordable solutions. 
 - We listen, learn and continuously improve. 

We do the right thing: 

- We lead with integrity and care for our team communities and planet. 
 - We work together safely and treat everyone with respect, inclusion, and trust. 
 - We collaborate across teams and think Officeworks-wide. 

We execute with accountability: 

- We are accountable for our decisions, actions, results, and mistakes. 
 - We stay across the details and focus on delivering what matters. 
 - We move with pace and agility to deliver outcomes. 

We lead with ambition: 

- We set bold ambitions that help us to win and transform. 
 - We are courageous with new ideas. 
 - We focus on transformation, not incremental steps. 

Qualifications and work experience: 

Essential: 

- Education: Tertiary degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Experience: 8-10 years of software engineering experience, primarily full stack with microservices architecture exposure, including senior-level ownership of quality engineering and test strategy. 
 - AI-Assisted Delivery: Proven experience or strong proficiency in delivering production software using AI coding, test generation and orchestration tooling. 
 - Quality Ownership: Demonstrated track record of owning end-to-end code quality, test strategy design, defect management and release gates directly, built through hands-on quality engineering experience. 
 - Stack Breadth: Broad technical exposure across front-end, back-end and integration layers. 
 - System Design: Strong system design judgement with the capability to evaluate, challenge and refine agent-generated architectural outputs. 
 - Technical Support: Experience supporting production cloud environments, including logging, alerting, incident response and observability
 - Proficient in Kotlin, with a strong understanding of Jetpack Compose, View-based layouts (XML), , Kotlin Flows, Coroutines and asynchronous programming (async/await, structured concurrency). 
 - Solid grasp of MVVM architecture, Clean Architecture patterns (Use Cases / Repositories), and Navigation Component. 
 - Experienced in unit and UI testing using JUnit, Mock, and Espresso / Compose Test frameworks. 
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, preferably Bitrise. 
 - Experienced in managing dependencies using Gradle (Kotlin DSL / Version Catalogs). 

Preferred: 

- Retail and Commerce Exposure: Experience in retail, e-commerce, or complex omnichannel platform ecosystems. 
 - Advanced AI Tooling: Familiarity with modern AI agent frameworks, model gateways, and evaluation platforms.

Our culture is built on beginning with customer, doing the right thing, executing with accountability, and leading with ambition. We are one team who are proud to "wear the blues" and deliver for our customers. 

We are an inclusive, forward-thinking organisation where diverse perspectives enable innovation, continuous improvement and better outcomes for our customers and teams. The work we do plays an important role in helping Australians work, learn, create and connect. 

About the Data and AI Hub: 

By joining the Technology team in the GCC you will play a direct role in Officeworks' global digital transformation, contributing to world-class capabilities that sit at the heart of how the business operates and grows. The GCC will support Officeworks' purpose of helping to bring big ideas to life at low prices, ensuring technology remains a true enabler of customer value and operational excellence. 

This opportunity to join as a founding member of the new global hub is a chance to be part of the original build-out of our GCC. Early joiners will influence how the hub operates and help shape the future state of some of Officeworks' core technology ecosystem. 

These roles are best suited for people who enjoy: 

- Exposure to eCommerce and digital platforms, customer facing services enabled online and in retail stores, and an expanding presence into generative and agentic commerce - covering operations, security, development, automation, and solution architecture
 - Supporting global initiatives and modernizing business critical systems
 - Being the forefront of global innovation and transformation, helping digitize the Officeworks business joining a place where your skills matter, your growth is intentional, and your work has visible impact on business outcomes. 

Why this role exists: 

The Associate AI Engineer sits inside a Customer Platforms and supports by orchestrating AI agents to produce code, tests, and documentation, ensuring features across Officeworks' digital properties are built and maintained efficiently. The role is a full stack engineering role and bridges feature development and quality assurance by directing agent workflows and conducting critical reviews before code is committed to production. 

In addition to feature development, the role contributes to the ongoing operation, maintenance, and support of Customer Platforms systems in production. This includes monitoring system performance and health, identifying and resolving production issues, supporting incident and defect resolution, and implementing fixes and enhancements to ensure the reliability, stability, and continuous improvement of digital platforms

Where you will make a difference: 

In this role you will: 

Agent Workstream Orchestration: 

- Run single or paired agent workstreams across coding, test generation, and documentation workflows. 
 - Translate technical and product specifications into precise, structured instructions for AI agents to execute. 
 - Apply platform context, base coding standards, and security policies to every agent execution. 
 - Monitor parallel agent tasks and confirm that generated outputs satisfy specified functional requirements. 

Code Review and Quality Assurance: 

- Perform rigorous reviews of agent-generated code, automated tests, and technical documentation. 
 - Design and execute test cases across unit, integration, and end-to-end scenarios, extending beyond AI-generated coverage where gaps exist. 
 - Evaluate generated code for functional correctness, security vulnerabilities, performance, and architectural fit. 
 - Identify, document, and track defects to resolution, escalating severity and blockers to Senior AI Engineers where required. 

Documentation and Shared Context Management: 

- Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation and knowledge artefacts to ensure context repositories effectively feed subsequent agent runs. 
 - Identify and resolve missing, outdated, or ambiguous context in shared repositories that negatively affects agent accuracy. 
 - Log technical decisions and specification updates to maintain end-to-end trace abilities for system workflows. 

Operational Support and Issue Resolution: 

- Support the investigation and resolution of production issues across the platform domains managed by the pod. 
 - Participate in on-call support rotations as required to maintain platform reliability and system availability. 
 - Support release verification and post-deployment checks to confirm features perform as tested before hyper care handover. 
 - Track runtime anomalies or recurring defects and feed learnings back into context documentation and agent guidance. 

Who you will be working with: 

- Pod Delivery Teams: Partner with Product Orchestrators and fellow pod engineers to translate specifications into executable agent workflows and deliver features in continuous flow. 
 - Platform and Architecture Specialists: Work with Context Engineers, Solution Architects, and Associate AI Agent Evaluation Engineers to align work with base contexts, security policies, and review frameworks. 
 - Operations and Enablement Teams: Collaborate with Platform Engineers, Associate AI Agent Operations Engineers, and the AI Enablement Manager to leverage shared tools, continuous integration pipelines, and observability platforms. 
 - Vendor and External Partners: Engage with external vendor support and technology partners as directed to resolve tooling issues or platform integration requirements. 

What success looks like: 

- Delivery Velocity and Quality: High review pass rate on submitted code and test artefacts, with minimal defects escaping to production environments. 
 - Capability Progression: Demonstrated growth in independent review judgement, prompt engineering literacy, and agent orchestration. 
 - Artefact Currency: High accuracy and completeness of shared context repositories and technical documentation contributed to the pod. 
 - Operational Resilience: Timely response to and resolution of domain incidents, maintaining reliable and secure platform performance. 
 - Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks' values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture. 

How you will lead: 

Individual Contributor: 

- Lives our Officeworks values and behaviours
 - Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
 - Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
 - Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop
 - Contributes to an inclusive and respectful environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels safe to speak up and belong

Qualifications and work experience: 

Essential: 

- Education: Tertiary degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Experience: 3+ years of software engineering experience, with exposure to full-stack delivery, cloud-based systems, and hands-on software testing or quality assurance. 
 - Tooling Literacy: Practical experience utilizing AI-assisted coding and agent tools (e. g. , Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex) to build and test software. 
 - Full Stack Capability: Foundational knowledge across front-end, back-end, and integration technologies (e. g. , JavaScript/TypeScript, Node. js, React, REST APIs). 
 - Quality Engineering: Hands-on experience designing and executing test cases (unit, integration and end-to-end) and documenting defects to resolution, not just familiarity with testing principles. 
 - Software Quality: Understanding of software testing principles, including automated unit, integration, and end-to-end testing practices. 
 - Specification and Logic: Ability to interpret functional specifications, construct precise logic instructions, and review generated code for correctness. 
 - Collaboration and Process: Familiarity with modern continuous integration and delivery pipelines (CI/CD), Git version control, and continuous flow delivery models. 
 - Proficient in Kotlin, with a strong understanding of Jetpack Compose, View-based layouts (XML), , Kotlin Flows, Coroutines and asynchronous programming (async/await, structured concurrency). 
 - Solid grasp of MVVM architecture, Clean Architecture patterns (Use Cases / Repositories), and Navigation Component. 
 - Experienced in unit and UI testing using JUnit, Mock, and Espresso / Compose Test frameworks. 
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, preferably Bit rise. 
 - Experienced in managing dependencies using Gradle (Kotlin DSL / Version Catalogs). 

Preferred: 

- Retail and Commerce Exposure: Familiarity with modern omnichannel commerce platforms or digital retail environments. 
 - Observability Frameworks: Exposure to cloud logging and observability tooling such as Sumo Logic or Datadog. 
 - Cloud Technologies: Basic exposure to Amazon Web Services (AWS) or serverless cloud architecture patterns.

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products - including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more - help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to WorkTM. So far, we have 13, 000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution. 

About The Role

Our Customer Support team is the first point of contact for millions around the world, delivering fast, thoughtful help when it matters most. They're the voice of our customers, working closely with product teams to improve experiences and keep wow-level service at the heart of Revolut. 

We're looking for a Quality Assurance Analyst to work closely with support teams and optimise our processes so we can deliver the best possible results to customers. 

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Reviewing complaints and chats to assess the root cause analysis (RCA) directly from the customer's perspective

 - Ensuring QA includes precise technical and contextual details
 - Identifying recurring issues that severely impact the customer experience
 - Taking full ownership of raised findings by monitoring their progress, updating their status on the roadmap, and validating the outcome
 - Collaborating across departments by escalating actionable findings to the Customer Contact Automation (CCA) team, and Product and Support teams

What You'll Need

- Fluency in English
 - Experience with quality support
 - A proven track record of positive evaluations
 - Impeccable attention to detail
 - Impressive analytical skills
 - Familiarity with G-Suite (Sheets, Forms, and Slides)

Building a global financial super app isn't enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that's why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We're doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That's why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team. 

Important notice for candidates: 

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles. 

- Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don't use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment. 
 - Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut. com domain. 

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it's a scam. Report it immediately. 

By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

data.title: Supplier Development Professional – Specialist
data.description:
About Milacron

We serve the primary market segment: Milacron Injection, Molding & Extrusion (MIME), which designs, manufactures, and sells injection and extrusion equipment, co-injection systems and related parts and services. 

THE ROLE

The Milacron Supplier Development group, a global and progressive function within Milacron, is currently seeking strong, results-oriented candidates for the positions as a Supplier Quality Professional ranging from Specialist to Engineer. 

Reporting to Global Supplier Development, this position will support, facilitate, and lead Supplier Development actions for multiple regional facilities. The role focuses on supply chain performance with responsibility for supplier quality, assessing supplier capability, verifying the quality of purchased items at the source, providing timely and accurate supplier performance metrics, facilitating continuous improvement and training of the supporting supply base. In this role you will manage the resolution of supplier quality issues at the regional facilities as well as global suppliers for specific categories. 

As part of the Supplier Development organization, you will provide technical guidance in the use of quality management tools incorporating the technical disciplines found in FAI, PPAP, SPC, FMEA, Control Plans and Problem Analysis. Coordinate formal supplier training to drive consistency in process, including supplier continuous improvement and development programs. Work with underperforming suppliers to improve On-time Delivery (OTD) and non-conformance rates using improvement tools like 8Ds, A3's, etc. Review and maintain evaluations of perspective suppliers and existing supplier performance, report status of supplier performance, and proactively act when quality trends indicate such action is warranted. Serve as liaison between engineering, procurement, quality and production to assure quality and reliability from the supply base. In addition, you will help build and sustain a strategic supply base that aligns with the corporate category management team strategy. 

General Characteristics

To perform this job successfully, the candidate will possess the skills, aptitudes, and abilities to perform the essential duties proficiently. 

- Process and results driven with strong project management skills
 - Have functional working knowledge of Quality Engineering principles
 - Be a self-starter with a proven ability to manage supplier improvement initiatives
 - Strategically lead supplier performance improvement projects to increase the supplier capability of consistently meeting Milacron requirements
 - Must be able to establish cross functional relationships and partnerships through your product and process knowledge
 - Implement and monitor the part qualification and certification process with elected suppliers
 - Champion problem solving and root cause analysis activities with suppliers and customers to eliminate recurrence of non-conformances
 - Function as liaison between procurement, engineering, manufacturing and suppliers to resolve supplier quality issues and to provide technical support
 - Work to resolve supplier technical issues in a timely manner to ensure continuity of supply
 - Support leadership and maintain a high level of performance in carrying out the goals of the department and corporation
 - Review targeted supplier manufacturing processes, evaluate supplier root cause corrective actions relative to those processes and confirm identified failure modes. 
 - Ability to travel (up to 50%) is required

Experience

- 5+ years of experience in Supplier Development, Manufacturing Quality or Supplier Quality Engineering in a manufacturing environment or Comparable Work Experience
 - Understanding of Print Reading and Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerance (GD&T)
 - Experience in Casting, Machining and Machined Components is preferred
 - Experience in facilitating change and working with cross functional teams including engineering and manufacturing
 - Experience in a high mix low volume global business is desired
 - Familiarity in auditing supplier manufacturing processes and quality systems
 - Familiarity with US and International Industry measurement standards and tools
 - Familiarity with quality standards such as ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and compliance auditing experience
 - Experience in using structured problem solving to drive acute and chronic quality issues to closure

Education

- B. E/B. Tech degree from an accredited 4-year college or university in a technical or supply chain related discipline or equivalent combination of education and experience with a minimum of 4 years of experience in Quality, Manufacturing, Shop Operations, Materials or Sourcing
 - Proficient oral and written communication skills
 - Proficient in English language (verbal and written communications). 

Who We Are

Milacron is a global industrial leader in the manufacturing and distribution of highly engineered and customized injection molding and extrusion solutions, and aftermarket parts and service for the plastics processing industry. The company's 1, 900+ associates worldwide collaborate to serve a diverse range of end-markets, such as automotive, construction, medical, telecommunications, material handling, packaging, and much more. With expertise in plastics spanning nearly 60 years, Milacron holds longstanding relationships with more than 27, 000 customers around the world. The original equipment provider of plastics manufacturing solutions is the largest US-owned and globally served of its kind. Headquartered in Batavia, OH, Milacron's global footprint is also serviced through regional facilities in Asia, Europe, and South America.

The policy of Milacron is to extend opportunities to qualified applicants and employees on an equal basis regardless of an individual's age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression or veteran status. We are committed to being an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer and offer opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. data.description:
Overview

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft's expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft's "Intelligent Cloud" mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for engineers to help achieve that mission. 

The Compute Silicon & Manufacturing Engineering (CSME) organization within SCHIE is responsible for design, development, manufacturing and packaging of Microsoft's state-of-the-art computer chips, notably the Azure Cobalt. Our solutions provide sustainable strategic advantages to Microsoft and enable our customers to achieve more. 

As Microsoft's cloud business continues to grow the ability to deploy new offerings and hardware infrastructure on time, in high volume with high quality and lowest cost is of paramount importance. To achieve this goal, the Verification & Validation team is instrumental in defining and delivering operational measures of success for hardware manufacturing, improving the planning process, quality, delivery, scale and sustainability related to Microsoft cloud hardware. We are looking for experienced engineers with a dedicated passion for customer focused solutions, insight and industry knowledge to envision and implement future technical solutions that will manage and optimize the Cloud infrastructure. 

We are looking for a Principal SOC Performance Verification Engineer to join the team. 

#SCHIE #CSME

Responsibilities

The candidate for this position will be expected and able to complete the following responsibilities: 

- Establish yourself as an integral member of a pre-silicon SoC verification team, owning aspects of performance verification, and aligning with architecture, design, firmware, and emulation.

 - Develop verification strategy, test plans, requirements, environments, tools, and methodologies. 
 - Apply your knowledge of performance verification principles and techniques and your judgement to write test plans and implement them by developing tests, test generators, test benches, checkers, coverage, and other verification collateral.

 - Apply your growth mindset to learn and adapt in a complex and dynamic environment.

 - Embody our culture and values. 

Qualifications

- 14+ years of pre-silicon SOC or subsystem or IP verification experience.

Preferred Qualifications

- 14+ years of experience as part of a CPU, SoC and/or IP development team focusing on performance
 - Demonstrated expertise in one or more of the following:

 - Coherent and non-coherent fabric IPs and protocols 
 - PCIe/CXL Controller/PHY IPs and protocols

 - Proficient communication, collaboration and teamwork skills and ability to contribute to diverse and inclusive teams. 
Screening Requirements

These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. 
 - This role will require access to information that is controlled for export under export control regulations, potentially under the U. S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations or Export Administration Regulations, the EU Dual Use Regulation, and/or other export control regulations. As a condition of employment, the successful candidate will be required to provide either proof of their country of citizenship or proof of their US. residency or other protected status (e. g. , under 8 U. S. C. 1324b(a)(3)) for assessment of eligibility to access the export-controlled information. To meet this legal requirement, and as a condition of employment, the successful candidate's citizenship will be verified with a valid passport. Lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees may verify status using other documents, where applicable. 

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

About Officeworks: 

Officeworks' purpose is "we bring big ideas to life at low prices". It's how we create shared value for customers, team members, suppliers, communities and shareholders. 

We are Australia's leading omnichannel retailer of complete technology solutions, stationery, furniture, art supplies, and learning resources. We also offer services including Print & Create, and Geeks2U. 

Our products and services provide solutions to our diverse range of customers across Australia from households, students, small to large sized businesses, governments and schools. 

Our culture is built on beginning with customer, doing the right thing, executing with accountability, and leading with ambition. We are one team who are proud to "wear the blues" and deliver for our customers. 

We are an inclusive, forward-thinking organisation where diverse perspectives enable innovation, continuous improvement and better outcomes for our customers and teams. The work we do plays an important role in helping Australians work, learn, create and connect. 

The role: 

Title: Senior AI Engineer

Function: Technology

Location: Bengaluru

On Call: Yes

About the Technology Function: 

By joining the Technology team in the GCC you will play a direct role in Officeworks' global digital transformation, contributing to world-class capabilities that sit at the heart of how the business operates and grows. The GCC will support Officeworks' purpose of helping to bring big ideas to life at low prices, ensuring technology remains a true enabler of customer value and operational excellence. 

This opportunity to join as a founding member of the new global hub is a chance to be part of the original build-out of our GCC. Early joiners will influence how the hub operates and help shape the future state of some of Officeworks' core technology ecosystem. 

These roles are best suited for people who enjoy: 

- exposure to eCommerce and digital platforms, customer facing services enabled online and in retail stores, and an expanding presence into generative and agentic commerce - covering operations, security, development, automation, and solution architecture
 - supporting global initiatives and modernising business critical systems
 - being the forefront of global innovation and transformation, helping digitise the Officeworks business
 - joining a place where your skills matter, your growth is intentional, and your work has visible impact on business outcomes. 

Why this role exists: 

The Senior AI Engineer sits inside a Customer Platforms pod and orchestrates the technical agents that produce code, tests, documentation and design artefacts. The role is a full stack engineering role that takes complete ownership of the quality engineering and testing, holding accountability for everything committed to production. 

The role exists to translate product specifications into functional agent tasks, maintain the human-in-the-loop review gate, and ensure system design integrity, non-functional performance and security standards are met. It plays a critical role in enabling continuous delivery across Customer Platforms while mentoring junior engineers and continuously improving agent workflows across pods. 

Where you will make a difference: 

In this role you will: 

Agent Orchestration and Execution: 

- Decompose Product Orchestrator specifications into functional tasks for technical agents. 
 - Run multiple agents in parallel across coding, test generation, documentation and design workflows. 
 - Sequence workstreams and manage technical dependencies to maintain high pod delivery velocity. 
 - Apply base context, security policies and platform standards to every agent execution cycle. 

Quality Control and Commit Gate: 

- Hold the human-in-the-loop review and commit gate independently on complex and high-risk change. 
 - Perform fast, accurate code and test reviews to ensure correctness, specification alignment and standards conformance. 
 - Owns end-to-end quality assurance accountability by designing agent test coverage and evaluation logic. 
 - Own defect management for the pod, from identification through root cause and resolution tracking, escalating systemic quality risks. 
 - Identify when agent workflows are insufficient and apply direct engineering intervention to resolve technical issues. 

System Design and Non-Functional Excellence: 

- Own architectural fit and system design judgement across the features delivered by the pod. 
 - Ensure non-functional outcomes, including performance, scalability, resilience and security, are met across all releases. 
 - Lead production incident resolution within the pod across touched platform domains. 
 - Contribute to domain design decisions as a consulted partner to the Solution Architects. 

Knowledge Governance and Workflow Improvement: 

- Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation and knowledge artefacts to serve as context layers for future agent runs. 
 - Feed refined domain context back to central repositories in collaboration with Context Engineers. 
 - Continuously refine and optimise agent workflows and share best practices across engineering pods. 
 - Mentor engineers on test design, defect triage and quality engineering practice across the pod. 

Who you will be working with: 

- Pod Leadership and Delivery Teams: Partner with Product Orchestrators and fellow pod engineers to refine requirements, assess technical feasibility and execute workstreams. 
 - Architecture Teams: Consult with Domain Architects and Solution Architects on domain design, system architecture and escalation pathways. 
 - Capability and Platform Specialists: Collaborate with Context Engineers, Associate AI Agent Evaluation Engineers and Associate Platform Engineers to align on shared context, security standards and tooling. 
 - Vendor and Platform Partners: Liaise with external AI tooling providers and vendor technical support to resolve complex platform constraints and adopt new capabilities. 

What success looks like: 

- Commit Gate Integrity: Low commit gate escape rate on complex and high-risk production changes. 
 - Innovation and Scaling: Agent workflow improvements developed within the pod are successfully adopted across broader engineering teams. 
 - Operational Resilience: Rapid resolution of production incidents within the pod with minimal downtime or customer impact. 
 - Delivery Velocity: High throughput of automated coding and testing tasks achieved without compromising technical quality or architectural standards. 
 - Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks' values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture. 

How you will lead: 

Individual Contributor: 

- Lives our Officeworks values and behaviours
 - Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
 - Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
 - Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop
 - Contributes to an inclusive and respectful environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels safe to speak up and belong

Our Values: 

Our values shape the way we work, our behaviours and how we interact with each other, our customers, suppliers and communities. 

We begin with customer: 

- We start with our customer' needs in every decision.

We execute with accountability:

We lead with ambition: 

- We set bold ambitions that help us to win and transform. 
 - We are courageous with new ideas. 
 - We focus on transformation, not incremental steps. 

Qualifications and work experience: 

Essential: 

- Education: Tertiary degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

• Design reliable financial workflows with strong transaction integrity, consistency, concurrency control, idempotency,   locking, transaction isolation, retry/recovery handling, and rollback mechanisms; implement controlled  workflow/state management, auditability, traceability, and reconciliation between internal and external systems. 

Event-Driven & Distributed Systems

• Design event-driven and distributed architectures using Kafka, RabbitMQ, Celery, or similar technologies;   

implement reliable asynchronous processing, retries, failure handling, recovery, and appropriate patterns for scalability  and resilience. 

Database & Data Architecture

• Design and optimize PostgreSQL schemas, data models, SQL queries, indexes, transactions, and database  

performance; work with Redis for caching/distributed processing and MongoDB/NoSQL where appropriate. 

Security & Financial Controls

• Implement secure backend and API solutions covering authentication, authorization, RBAC, OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, MFA,   access control, least privilege, encryption, TLS, secrets management, audit logging, and secure coding; protect  sensitive financial data and enforce critical transaction authorization and business rules server-side; follow OWASP principles and support appropriate security monitoring and controls. 

Cloud & DevOps

• Deploy and support services on Microsoft Azure using Docker, CI/CD, and Git; establish effective logging, monitoring,   health checks, diagnostics, deployment practices, and production troubleshooting. 

Required Skills

Backend & Architecture: Python, Django/FastAPI, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, SQL, system design, backend architecture,   microservices, distributed systems, transaction processing, concurrency, idempotency, workflow/state management,   reconciliation, asynchronous processing. 

Messaging & Processing: Kafka, RabbitMQ, Celery, event-driven architecture, message-based processing, retry and failurerecovery patterns. 

Security: API security, authentication, authorization, RBAC, OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, MFA, encryption, TLS, secrets management,   access control, audit logging, secure coding, OWASP principles. 

Cloud & Engineering: Microsoft Azure, Docker, CI/CD, Git, application monitoring, logging, performance optimization, and  production support. 

Leadership: Technical leadership, architecture ownership, code reviews, mentoring, technical decision-making, problemsolving, stakeholder collaboration, and end-to-end delivery ownership. 

Preferred Skills & Experience

• Banking, Fintech, Payments, Trading, Brokerage, Treasury, or Financial Technology experience. 

• Experience developing transaction-heavy, financially critical, or regulated applications. 

• Experience with financial reconciliation, settlements, balances, payments, positions, or transaction lifecycles. 

• Experience with ETRM or Treasury Management Systems. 

• Experience with banking APIs, payment systems, financial integrations, trading platforms, or market-data systems. 

• Experience with banking-grade security, compliance, audit, and access-control requirements. 

• Knowledge of PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or similar security frameworks. 

• Experience with MongoDB, Redis, Kubernetes, and multi-tenant SaaS architecture. 

• Familiarity with React, Angular, TypeScript, or Java. 

• Exposure to Oracle is an advantage but not mandatory. 

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a hands-on Python backend engineer with strong technical leadership and architectural capability, able  to work across application design, development, databases, messaging, security, cloud, and production support. 

- We particularly value candidates who understand that financial systems require correctness, transaction integrity, security,   concurrency, auditability, reconciliation, reliability, and performance. Financial-system roles increasingly emphasize these  areas alongside Python, PostgreSQL, messaging, API security, and cloud engineering.

data.description:
About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world's most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12, 000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog. 

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them. 

Shape What Comes Next

By joining our team, you'll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills-and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale. 

About The Role

Coursera's AI adoption has moved fast - engineering teams code AI-first, dozens of internal tools have shipped, and functions across the business are building their own AI agents and automations. The next phase requires something different: a shared technical foundation that lets many teams build safely and cost-effectively at scale, instead of each team solving governance, security, and cost from scratch. 

This role owns that foundation. The Senior Agentic AI Architect Lead designs and builds the core architecture that Coursera's AI Builders and business pods will run on - so that a small team (a Business Product Owner, a Process Expert, an IT Product Owner, and an AI Engineer) can redesign a workflow and ship an AI-native solution in weeks, not months. 

This is a hands-on architecture role, not a pure strategy role: you will be building, not just advising. 

What You'll Own

- Context & Semantic Architecture - Design how AI agents access and understand Coursera's internal data and knowledge, so agents retrieve the right information rather than guessing or over-fetching. Establish reusable patterns for RAG, semantic search, structured data access, and enterprise context, partnering with the Data team on existing data models and pipelines. 
 - Agentic Architecture & Harness Engineering - Design reusable patterns for agent orchestration, tool use, multi-step workflows, state management, and human-in-the-loop decisions. Build the engineering harness around agents, including testing, evaluation, guardrails, retries, observability, and failure recovery, so agentic solutions are reliable and production-ready. 
 - Governance Architecture - Build technical guardrails that enforce-not just document-who can build what, what data and systems an agent can access, and what gets logged for audit and review. Establish standards for agent ownership, lifecycle management, and production readiness. 
 - Security Architecture - Design defenses specific to agentic AI, including agent identity and access control, least-privilege permissions, prompt injection, data leakage, secure credentials, and safe tool execution. Coordinate with Security to extend existing enterprise security standards. 
 - Self-Serve AI Development ("Vibe Coding") with CI/CD Automation - Extend and mature Coursera's self-serve deployment path so AI-assisted, conversational development ships through automated testing, security checks, and evaluation gates-safe by default, not safe by manual gatekeeping. 
 - LLM Cost & Performance Optimization - Design caching, model routing (matching task complexity to the right-sized model), token and context optimization, and usage monitoring so AI adoption can scale without costs growing linearly. Establish cost, latency, quality, and usage metrics. 
 - Agent Operating Model & Adoption - Define agent ownership, lifecycle management, production-readiness standards, adoption metrics, and reusable patterns so business teams can scale AI capabilities consistently across functions. Measure success through usage, workflow outcomes, productivity, quality, and business value. 
 - Architecture Strategy & Execution - Turn ambiguous business problems into scalable technical direction, practical roadmaps, architecture decisions, and production delivery. 
 - Enterprise Systems & Integration Architecture - Design AI solutions that understand dependencies across enterprise systems, business processes, integrations, and downstream impacts. Establish reusable patterns for APIs, enterprise tools, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable integration standards where appropriate. 
 - Production Readiness & Operational Excellence - Establish standards for reliability, observability, incident response, security, operational ownership, and continuous improvement across AI platforms and solutions. 

How This Role Works With Others

This role sits at the intersection of four groups and requires strong cross-functional partnership-it does not operate in isolation. 

- Engineering Leadership: Partner directly with Engineering leadership to align architecture decisions and share resources and infrastructure where possible, avoiding duplicate build efforts across the company. 
 - IT: IT owns broader company-wide tooling and platform decisions (procurement, provisioning, cost governance, enterprise policy). Coordinate closely with IT so agentic architecture decisions align with company-wide technical direction rather than creating a parallel, ungoverned stack. 
 - Data Team: The Data team owns Coursera's underlying data strategy. Partner with them to ensure context and semantic architecture aligns with existing data models, pipelines, and ownership rather than building a parallel, disconnected data layer for AI. 
 - Security Team: Design security architecture specific to agentic AI-including access control, prompt injection defense, and credential handling-in coordination with the Security team, which owns broader security standards and policy. 
 - Business Pods: Enable the 3-4 person pods (Business Product Owner, Process Expert, IT Product Owner, AI Engineer) to redesign workflows, build AI-native solutions, and drive measurable business outcomes using reusable architecture. 
 - Change Management & Enablement: Help teams adopt AI-enabled workflows through enablement, feedback loops, process redesign, and continuous improvement. 

People Leadership

Build, coach, and develop the architecture and engineering capability required to scale the platform. This includes hiring, delegation, technical leadership development, performance management, and creating clear ownership across teams. 

Build strong technical leaders who can independently own architecture, delivery, stakeholder alignment, and operational outcomes. 

AI Center of Excellence / VP, AI and Operations

Report directly to the VP, AI and Operations, providing regular updates on architecture progress, risks, business impact, and resourcing needs. 

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

- 12+ years of experience with clear progression from engineer to senior/staff engineer to architect leader, including ownership of platforms or infrastructure used by multiple teams-not just individual feature delivery. 
 - Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks and orchestration (e. g. , LangGraph or comparable) and familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar standards for connecting AI systems to enterprise data and tools. 
 - Experience designing agent harnesses, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, testing, observability, and failure recovery for production AI systems. 
 - Practical experience with enterprise context architecture, RAG, semantic search, or structured data access. 
 - Practical experience with LLM cost and performance engineering-prompt caching, model routing, token economics-with quantifiable results. 
 - AI security fundamentals, including access control, data isolation, prompt injection defense, and secure tool execution. 
 - CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, APIs, and production operations experience. 
 - Experience defining enterprise AI architecture, reusable platform patterns, operating models, or governance standards across multiple teams. 
 - Direct people-management experience, including hiring, coaching, delegation, performance development, and building technical leadership capacity. 
 - Experience measuring AI adoption, productivity, quality, reliability, cost, and business value. 
 - Hands-on experience taking architecture from design through implementation, deployment, observability, and production operations. 
 - Strong architecture decision-making and communication skills, with the ability to align technical and business stakeholders around trade-offs involving value, risk, cost, and execution. 

For more information about how Coursera collects and uses your personal information, please see our Coursera + Udemy Global Applicant Privacy Notice. 

To protect against recruitment fraud, Coursera + Udemy recruiters only communicate via official coursera. org/udemy. com email addresses and never through personal accounts. We do not accept resumes via email or social media; please submit all applications directly through our careers page. 

If you encounter suspicious recruitment activity, please report it via our Fraudulent Activity Submission Form. 

Coursera is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a welcoming and inclusive workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics and provide reasonable accommodations upon request at recruiting@coursera. org.

Job Description Summary

Principal Engineer is one of the most coveted technical IC titles at Walmart - and this role lives up to it. As a Principal Engineer on the Marketplace team within Growth Tech, you will be developing services that helps millions of sellers to onboard and do business with Walmart. You will write code, design systems, review architectures, and solve the problems that are complex. Your world-class expertise in distributed systems, API design, and platform engineering will be paired with a Al-forward mindset. 

About Team

Walmart's Marketplace is the backbone of a thriving ecosystem connecting millions of third-party sellers to hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. As Principal Engineer, WFS, you will be responsible for building applications that enable the fulfilment for a Seller. You will be building application to enable sellers to engage on Walmart retail platform. 

This is a high-impact role sitting at the intersection of scale, commerce, and platform engineering. You will own the technical vision and execution for a portfolio of mission-critical, cross-cutting services that enables Seller to operate through Seller Center UI and APIs. You will build and grow a world-class engineering organization capable of delivering innovation at Walmart speed. 

What You'll Do

The Walmart Fulfilment Services team is essential to the Marketplace ecosystem, responsible for designing and scaling the global platform that supports the complete seller fulfilment within Walmart marketplace journey. The team develops robust global workflows, and complex multi-platform integrations connecting cloud microservices, seller portals, and AI-driven analytics. You will own Architecture, design, development and delivery of Seller journey, addressing distributed systems challenges, optimize APIs, and establish architectural standards to enable international marketplace growth. 

What You'll Bring

Architecture & System Design

Lead end-to-end technical design for complex initiatives involving from API contracts, UI interfaces and data models to distributed system topologies and cross-cutting concerns. 

Author and review RFCs and architecture decision records (ADRs) that become the technical canon for the platform

Hands-On Engineering

Write production-grade code and not prototypes or proof-of-concepts, test and deploy them to production

Solve complex problems considering performance, reliability and scalability

Prototype new solutions rapidly using Al-augmented development workflows and then drive them to production quality

Conduct deep-dive code reviews that raise the technical bar of the team. 

Own the full software development lifecycle for your initiatives involving design, development, testing, deployment, observability

Complex Problem Solving

Solve the hardest and complex problems and enable the team while doing so

Lead technical investigations for P0/P1 incidents affecting platform services; own the root cause analysis and define permanent fixes

Challenge technical assumptions early in the design process before they become expensive production mistakes

Navigate ambiguity with confidence by breaking down underspecified problems into structured technical approaches and drive alignment across stakeholders

Platform Reliability & Operational Excellence

Design for resilience from first principles. Define and own the platform's non-functional requirements

Instrument systems to be deeply observable and use the signals to drive continuous improvement

Build runbooks and operational playbooks that enable the broader team to operate the services confidently

Al & Innovation

This role is Al-forward by design and needs someone who actively shapes how it is used and pushes the frontier of what Al-augmented engineering looks like at scale. 

Day-to-Day Al Fluency

Proficient with GitHub Copilot, Wibey, and LLM-based tooling as active, daily parts of your development workflow

Use Al to compress every phase of the engineering loop: schema design validation, code generation and review, test coverage acceleration, documentation, drafting, incident root-cause analysis, and API design feedback

Identify where Al can replace toil, then build the automation yourself

Al-Native Platform Thinking

Architect and build Al-native capabilities like intelligent API health monitoring, Al-assisted seller onboarding flows, smart alerting and anomaly detection

Evaluate and integrate Al/ML capabilities into services where they create measurable seller value

Stay current on the fast-moving AI tooling landscape and bring high-signal, opinionated recommendations to the team

Al Advocacy & Enablement

Model Al-augmented engineering practices for the team through live demos, pairing sessions, and written guides

Work with engineering leadership to identify and prioritize investments where Al creates the most leverage across teams

Contribute to the broader Walmart engineering community's understanding of how to build and operate Al-augmented systems responsibly

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. 

Work

Belonging

By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.

data.title: Senior Engineer – Integrated Command Center (ICC)
data.description:
Where Ambition Meets Innovation

At LPL's Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We're proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad. 

Join us as we create something extraordinary together. 

Role Overview

LPL Financial is seeking a Senior Engineer - Integrated Command Center (ICC) to serve as a principal technical authority within Production Services. This role is responsible for enterprise‐wide incident response excellence, observability maturity, and operational resilience across LPL's most critical platforms. 

As a Senior Engineer, you will lead complex incident management, advanced diagnostics, monitoring strategy, and systemic risk reduction initiatives. You will partner deeply with SRE, Observability, Infrastructure, Automation, and Application Engineering teams to proactively prevent incidents, reduce detection ambiguity, and improve mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to restore (MTTR) at scale. 

This is a high‐impact role focused on technical leadership, influence, and long‐term reliability outcomes, rather than day‐to‐day alert handling. 

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Incident Response Leadership

- Act as a principal technical authority during high‐severity and enterprise‐impacting incidents. 
 - Lead advanced troubleshooting and multi‐domain triage across applications, infrastructure, cloud, and network layers. 
 - Drive technical containment and restoration strategy in partnership with domain engineering teams. 
 - Establish incident command best practices, escalation models, and responder behaviors. 
 - Ensure incidents are resolved with a focus on durable fixes, not temporary recovery. 

Observability & Monitoring Strategy

- Own and evolve the ICC monitoring and observability strategy, ensuring alignment with enterprise reliability objectives. 
 - Define standards for actionable alerting, thresholds, routing, deduplication, and noise reduction. 
 - Architect and oversee Dynatrace dashboards, service views, and eyes‐on‐glass experiences for mission‐critical services. 
 - Partner with Observability and SRE teams to improve logs, metrics, traces, and service telemetry coverage. 
 - Continuously evaluate tooling capabilities to ensure operational visibility keeps pace with platform complexity. 

Advanced Platform Diagnostics

- Perform deep, cross‐stack troubleshooting across AWS, Windows, Linux, networking, middleware, databases, and application services. 
 - Validate hypotheses using evidence‐based diagnostics rather than trial‐and‐error recovery. 
 - Serve as a go‐to expert for complex, ambiguous failure scenarios and cascading incidents. 
 - Provide technical guidance to reduce time‐to‐diagnose during critical events. 

Root Cause & Resilience Engineering

- Lead or significantly influence complex root cause analysis (RCA) for major or recurring incidents. 
 - Identify systemic weaknesses, architectural risks, and operational gaps. 
 - Translate incident learnings into preventative engineering, monitoring, or process improvements. 
 - Track recurring failure modes and sponsor long‐term remediation initiatives. 

Operational Readiness & Risk Management

- Drive operational readiness reviews for new or materially changed services. 
 - Ensure services meet readiness standards including: 
 - Monitoring and alerting coverage

data.description:
Description

AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations - from foundational services such as Amazon's Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS's services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you'll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services. 

Do you want to work on a product that can do the following?: 

Access petabytes of data in single-digit milliseconds

Replicate tables across continents

Stream terabytes of data updates per hour continuously

Back up hundreds of terabytes of data in seconds

Encrypt petabytes of data with no performance degradation

Amazon DynamoDB is a NoSQL database service that does all this and more. DynamoDB is a key-value and document database that delivers single-digit-millisecond performance at any scale. DynamoDB can store petabytes of customer data and handle peaks of more than 20 million requests per second. 

As a fast growing service at the core of the AWS Cloud, our business and engineering decisions have widespread impact across AWS, Amazon, and beyond. Many of the world's fastest growing businesses, such as Lyft, Airbnb, and Redfin, as well as enterprises, such as Samsung, Toyota, and Capital One, depend on the scale and performance of DynamoDB to support their mission-critical workloads. 

DynamoDB is one of the largest distributed database systems in the world, and we continue to believe it is Day 1 for the DynamoDB business. We are constantly improving and adding new capabilities to DynamoDB, and we are looking for a deeply technical, team-first software development engineer to push DynamoDB even further. 

DynamoDB engineers are constantly challenged to think of unique and innovative solutions. The quality bar is high. As an engineer here, you will work on the hardest engineering problems in distributed systems at a massive scale and on multiple dimensions. You will exercise your intellectual curiosity, work with motivated teams of sharp individuals, and get insightful guidance from senior and principal engineers.

Formulation, Filling, Packing, Warehouse, QC, Utilities etc

Large, multi-disciplinary engineering & maintenance organization

Lead the complete engineering and maintenance function for a Drug Product (DP) manufacturing site operating within a Vaccine MFG /CDMO environment, ensuring reliable, compliant, and cost-effective operation of all process areas and utilities. The role owns asset reliability, GMP engineering compliance, expansion project delivery, and the development of a large multi-disciplinary engineering team, with the mandate to build a world-class maintenance culture that consistently meets client, quality, and regulatory expectations.

The role provides engineering leadership and maintenance support across the full DP value chain and site infrastructure: 

- Process & support areas: formulation, aseptic/sterile filling, packing, warehouse, QC laboratories, and the complete utilities envelope. 
 - Utilities: HVAC and cleanrooms, purified water / WFI, clean steam, compressed air and process gases, chilled water, BMS/EMS, and power distribution. 
 - Projects: engineering scope on capital projects is limited to expansion projects (capacity additions, line/area upgrades, and de-bottlenecking) rather than new greenfield facility builds.

Maintenance & Asset Reliability

- Establish and drive a world-class maintenance system built on preventive, predictive, and reliability-centered maintenance (RCM), TPM, and a mature CMMS. 
 - Improve equipment reliability, OEE, and MTBF/MTTR; minimize unplanned downtime and breakdowns. 
 - Own spares strategy, criticality analysis, and asset lifecycle / obsolescence management for all critical equipment. GMP Compliance & Quality

- Ensure all engineering activities meet cGMP, data integrity, and regulatory expectations (USFDA, EMA, WHO, and other applicable agencies). 
 - Own the qualification and validation lifecycle (URS, DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ), calibration, change control, and computerized system compliance. 
 - Lead engineering readiness for regulatory, corporate, and client/CDMO audits; own and close engineering CAPAs on time. Expansion Projects & Engineering

- Plan and deliver site expansion and upgrade projects on time, within budget, and to defined quality and compliance standards. 
 - Manage design, procurement, commissioning, qualification, and handover in coordination with global engineering, project, and client teams. Utilities & Facilities

- Ensure uninterrupted, qualified operation of all clean and black utilities and controlled cleanroom environments. 
 - Drive energy efficiency, sustainability, and utility cost optimization. EHS, Budget & Cost

- Embed a strong safety culture; ensure compliance with EHS regulations, permit-to-work systems, and risk assessments. 
 - Own the site engineering opex and capex budgets; drive cost optimization without compromising compliance or reliability. Leadership Responsibilities

- Lead a large, multi-disciplinary engineering organization across process areas, disciplines, and shifts. 
 - Build capability through structured training, succession planning, and talent development; grow future engineering leaders. 
 - Set direction, KPIs, and performance standards; foster accountability, ownership, and a continuous-improvement mindset. 
 - Act as the site's senior engineering leader and a key member of the site leadership team. Stakeholder Management

- Serve as the primary engineering interface for internal customers / CDMO clients on technical, reliability, and project matters, building trust and credibility. 
 - Partner closely with Production, Quality, Supply Chain, Projects, and EHS to align engineering priorities with site and business goals. 
 - Manage relationships with the engineering function, OEMs, contractors, and service providers. 
 - Represent engineering in client reviews, audits, and business meetings; communicate clearly across technical and leadership audiences. Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's / Master's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, or Chemical Engineering. 
 - 15-20+ years of pharmaceutical / biopharma / vaccine engineering experience, with significant exposure to sterile/aseptic DP facilities. 
 - Proven track record of leading large engineering teams and building world-class maintenance systems. 
 - Strong knowledge of GMP, qualification/validation, sterile-manufacturing utilities, and regulatory audits. 
 - Experience in a CDMO or client-facing manufacturing environment strongly preferred. 
 - Demonstrated success in delivering expansion / upgrade capital projects and driving reliability improvement.

Strategic and hands-on engineering leadership; reliability and TPM mindset; regulatory and quality orientation; project management; financial acumen; excellent stakeholder and client management; and the ability to drive cultural change at scale.
