Job Title: Staff Engineer, Intelligent Automation & Process Excellence

Location: Bangalore (Hybrid)

Minimum Exp: Overall 6 to 8 years of core experience in BPM (Business Process Management), process mining, and AI/Automation development. 

Why should you choose us?

Rakuten Symphony is reimagining telecom, changing supply chain norms and disrupting outmoded thinking that threatens the industry's pursuit of rapid innovation and growth. Based on proven modern infrastructure practices, its open interface platforms make it possible to launch and operate advanced mobile services in a fraction of the time and cost of conventional approaches, with no compromise to network quality or security. 

Rakuten Symphony has operations in Japan, the United States, Singapore, India, South Korea, Europe, and the Middle East Africa region. For more information, visit: https: //symphony. rakuten. com. 

Building on the technology Rakuten used to launch Japan's newest mobile network, we are taking our mobile offering global. 

To support our ambitions to provide an innovative cloud-native telco platform for our customers, Rakuten Symphony is looking to recruit and develop top talent from around the globe. We are looking for individuals to join our team across all functional areas of our business - from sales to engineering, support functions to product development. 

Let's build the future of mobile telecommunications together!

About Rakuten Group, Inc. (TSE: 4755) is a global leader in internet services that empower individuals, communities, businesses and society. Founded in Tokyo in 1997 as an online marketplace, Rakuten has expanded to offer services in e-commerce, fintech, digital content and communications to 2 billion members around the world. The Rakuten Group has over 30, 000 employees, and operations in 30 countries and regions. For more information visit https: //global. rakuten. com/corp/. 

What Do We Expect From You

We are seeking a highly skilled Staff Engineer, Intelligent Automation & Process Excellence (6 to 8 years of experience) to serve as a bridge between strategic process architecture and next-generation AI implementation. You will lead our transformation initiatives by combining advanced BPM methodologies and process mining with cutting-edge Agentic-AI. The ideal candidate is a hands-on practitioner who can translate complex, fragmented legacy workflows into highly optimized, automated, and AI-driven ecosystems that deliver measurable business value. 

Key Requirements: 

Process Strategy & Architecture

- Design and architect enterprise-grade, end-to-end business processes
 - Act as a strategic advisor to cross-functional units, translating operational challenges into scalable process frameworks. 
 - Conduct rigorous process audits and benchmark internal KPIs against global industry standards (e. g. , APQC frameworks) to establish performance baselines

Process Mining & Data-Driven Insights

- Lead process mining initiatives to ingest event log data, discover "as-is" operational realities, and pinpoint bottlenecks/compliance deviations. 
 - Utilize advanced data skills (SQL, Python, or R) to transform data for process discovery and performance analysis

AI & Agentic Automation

- Portfolio of Implementation: Must demonstrate a proven, hands-on track record of deploying Agentic-AI solutions in production environments. Candidates should be prepared to discuss the specific architecture of their agents, the reasoning models used, and how they handled tool-use and error correction. 
 - Architect and deploy Agentic-AI solutions to solve specific problems across telecom domains and verticals. 
 - Create AI agents to automate complex tasks: log analysis, code debugging, telecom protocol troubleshooting, and proactive performance monitoring. 
 - Evaluate workflows for automation readiness, calculating ROI and feasibility before orchestrating pipelines using RPA and Workflow Engines

Operational Support & DevOps

- Provide technical support for DevOps infrastructure (e. g. , Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Contribute to the development of automated tools/scripts to improve support efficiency and maintain optimal Customer Experience (CX). 

Required Skills & Experience: 

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Electronics/Comm, IT, or related field. 
 - Experience: Overall 6 to 8 years of core experience in BPM, process mining, and AI/Automation development. 
 - Process Mining/BPM: Technical expertise in Process mining and workflow platform tools
 - Agentic-AI: Proven, hands-on experience in the design, implementation, and orchestration of advanced AI agents and workflows. 

Technical Stack: 

- Automation: RPA tools and Low-Code/No-Code engines. 
 - DevOps/Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Docker, Jenkins. 
 - Data: SQL, Python/R, and BI tools
 - Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of Telecom Network architectures (OSS/BSS). 

Core Competencies

- Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience with Agentic frameworks such as LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or Haystack. Proficiency in implementing RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), ReAct (Reasoning and Acting) patterns, function calling, and long-term memory management for AI agents. 
 - Analytical Rigor: Ability to identify root causes in complex telecom architectures and translate them into automated solutions. 
 - Hands-on Leadership: A track record of "doing the work"-developing models, pipelines, and agents-rather than just providing oversight. 
 - Soft Skills: Strong interpersonal skills and stakeholder management to drive cross-functional adoption of next-generation automation in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. 

This role is for the "Architect-Builder" who understands that true automation requires both the structure of disciplined process management and the intelligence of modern AI. You will have the opportunity to transform our operational landscape from the ground up, utilizing the latest in process mining and Agentic-AI to set the standard for our organization. 

Rakuten Shugi Principles: 

Our worldwide practices describe specific behaviours that make Rakuten unique and united across the world. We expect Rakuten employees to model these 5 Shugi Principles of Success. 

- Always improve, always advance. Only be satisfied with complete success - Kaizen. 
 - Be passionately professional. Take an uncompromising approach to your work and be determined to be the best. 
 - Hypothesize - Practice - Validate - Shikumika. Use the Rakuten Cycle to success in unknown territory. 
 - Maximize Customer Satisfaction. The greatest satisfaction for workers in a service industry is to see their customers smile. 
 - Speed!! Speed!! Speed!! Always be conscious of time. Take charge, set clear goals, and engage your team.

data.title: Manager, Core Infrastructure Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

For a single team delivering components of distributed systems. Translates goals into a 1-2 quarter execution plan, sets coding, testing, and scalability practices, and provides hands-on oversight of performance tuning and load/perf testing. Guides the team in building fault-tolerant, in-service-upgradable components (redundancy, replication, failover) and in applying resiliency patterns (retries, circuit breakers, timeouts). Ensures robust observability (tests, alarms, dashboards, telemetry) and operational readiness via reviewed runbooks and standard procedures. Manages delivery of scoped features and correctness testing (including fault-injection/brownouts), and directs implementation of data replication/synchronization to maintain integrity and availability. Leads team incident response and root-cause efforts, enforces no-customer-downtime practices, and drives use of automation/IaC for troubleshooting. Oversees team security implementation (encryption, access controls), tracks remediation plans, verifies compliance documentation, and coaches adherence to change-management plans for safe patching, updates, and rollbacks. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

- Provides oversight to the team on the development of components of distributed systems, including the use of distributed state management tools. 
 - Monitors and enables optimization of code and/or systems for large-scale data processing. 
 - Guides team to implement scalability requirements for assigned components. 
 - Coaches team to leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 
 - Ensures team accurately implements and executes performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

- Provides guidance to the team in building fault-tolerant systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by leading the implementation of redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 
 - Guides the design of components to effectively handle service disruptions. 
 - Coaches team on various approaches to handle network unreliability, including retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

- Guides team to implement testing and alarming configurations for detecting and addressing issues/failures. 
 - Ensures team effectively supports recovery efforts by reviewing and aligning on runbooks and operational procedures. 
 - Coaches team on building and customizing dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health. 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

- Manages the implementation and design of functional requirements and testing for features within an existing system. 
 - Coaches team on implementing test scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 
 - Guides the implementation of data replication and synchronization techniques within the team to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

- Leads team efforts in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in system components to support ongoing operation. 
 - Ensures teams are following protocols for preventing interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 
 - Manages team in effectively implementing automation scripts and tooling when troubleshooting operational issues. 
 - Creates schedules and manages operational support rotations. 

Compliance & Security: 

- Manages team implementation of robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, overseeing encryption techniques and access controls. 
 - Manages execution of remediation plans to address identified security gaps, ensuring continuous improvement of security measures. 
 - Reviews documentation and ensures cloud infrastructure compliance with industry standards and regulations. 

Automation & Change Management: 

- Leads the maintenance of automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure. 
 - Coaches team on change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Creates and owns the execution plan for the team's work and multiple projects or initiatives, monitoring timelines and budgets (when applicable) to ensure projects are completed on time and in adherence with requirements. 
 - Delegates work across the team and helps them prioritize their work. 
 - Identifies resource needs and adapts plans based on changing priorities and business needs. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Strengthens collaborative partnerships across teams to align on expectations and shared objectives. 
 - Guides team members to build relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure effective collaboration. 
 - Practices active listening and asks insightful questions to promote an inclusive culture. 

Problem Solving: 

- Leads team to identify and address moderately complex operational and/or technical issues in accordance with standard practices, providing guidance as appropriate. 
 - Directs team to analyze data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot moderately complex errors. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Actively seeks learning opportunities for self and team to enhance knowledge and skills in key areas and remain current with industry advancements. 
 - Uses feedback and training to elevate personal and team skills, modeling a commitment to learning. 
 - Identifies skill gaps within the team and supports team members in learning opportunities by providing resources and fostering an environment that encourages knowledge-sharing. 

Continuous Improvement:

Performance and Development:

About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. 

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365-all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1. 8B+ from the world's top investors including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. 

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling. com addresses. 

About The Team

The Tax Payment team is powering the tax remittance of $30 billion+ to 5000+ tax agencies. We ensure taxes are paid on the time. We ensure billions of tax payment across 40+ countries get get remitted on time through automated systems.

We've built intelligent engine to plan the tax remittance to maximize the float income and remitt taxes to 5000+ tax authorities without minimal manual intervention while maintaining strict compliance and audit requirements. Job Description

Technical Architect - ServiceMax

We are seeking an experienced Technical Architect - ServiceMax - with 10+ years of expertise in designing, governing, and delivering enterprise-scale ServiceMax and Salesforce solutions. This role will lead architecture strategy for global field service transformation programs, ensuring scalable, secure, integrated, and business-aligned solutions that support standardized global processes and country-specific rollout needs.

- Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, and delivery teams to translate field service requirements into scalable ServiceMax architecture, solution designs, and technical specifications.

 - Define the global ServiceMax template architecture and manage controlled country-specific localization, including regional process variations, deployment sequencing, training readiness, change management, and hypercare support.

data.title: DIRECTOR OF PLATFORM ENGINEERING
data.description:
About Armor Defense Inc

At Armor, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in securing cyberspace. Our vision is to be the trusted protector and de facto standard that cloud-centric customers entrust with their risk. We strive to continuously evolve to be the best partner of choice, breaking norms and tirelessly innovating to stay ahead of evolving cyber threats and reshaping how we deliver customer outcomes. We are passionate about making a positive impact in the world, and we're looking for a highly skilled and experienced talent to join our dynamic team. 

Armor has unique offerings to the market so customers can a) understand their risk b) leverage Armor to co-manage their risk or c) completely outsource their risk to Armor. 

Learn more at: https: //www. armor. com

Summary

Reporting to the Head of Product, the Director of Platform Engineering owns the reliability and operational health of the products that generate the vast majority of Armor's revenue. That means Armor Enterprise Cloud (private cloud hosting, firewalls, WAF, OS templates, backups), Armor Agent (endpoint and EDR), and the infrastructure underpinning Armor MDR. When these systems go down, customers feel it immediately, and renewals are at risk. This role is responsible for keeping them running, making them cheaper to operate, and reducing the amount of human effort required to do both. If you think of reliability engineering as a product discipline rather than an ops cost center, this is your job. 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (Additional duties may be assigned as required)

- Own uptime, SLA adherence, and incident response for Armor Enterprise Cloud, Armor Agent, and MDR infrastructure. When something breaks at 2am, your team is the one that gets paged. 
 - Lead the SRE and infrastructure engineering team. Set on-call rotations, define escalation paths, run blameless postmortems, and make sure the same incidents don't keep happening. 
 - Define and maintain SLIs/SLOs across all production services. Use them to drive prioritization, not just dashboards. 
 - Reduce operational toil through automation. If a human is doing it repeatedly, it should be a script, a pipeline, or an agent. 
 - Own infrastructure cost management. Know where the money goes, find the waste, and make the case for where to invest. 
 - Drive infrastructure migrations (Proxmox, Rackspace hardware refresh) without disrupting customers. You own the migration playbooks and the customer communication cadence alongside support. 
 - Maintain compliance and audit readiness for PCI, HIPAA, and SOC 2. This isn't a side task; it's a production requirement. 
 - Coordinate with the product engineering team on shared resources and handoffs. New features ship into your production environment, so you have a say in how they're built. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and rollback mechanisms. One-click deploys, not prayer-based deployments. 
 - Make AI-assisted operations real: automated incident triage, AI-driven root cause analysis, predictive alerting. Measure whether it actually reduces mean time to resolution. 
 - Hire and develop infrastructure engineers who think in systems, automate by default, and treat reliability as a craft. 

Required Skills

- You've kept production systems running at scale, and you know what it costs when they don't. SRE, DevOps, infrastructure engineering -- the title matters less than the scars. 
 - Deep knowledge of private cloud infrastructure: VMware/Proxmox, firewalls, WAF, backup and DR platforms (Zerto, Rubrik, or equivalent). This is Armor's bread and butter. 
 - Strong with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible, or similar). You don't configure things by hand. 
 - Fluent in at least one scripting language (Python, PowerShell, Bash) and you use it daily to solve real problems, not just interview questions. 
 - Understands SLI/SLO frameworks and knows how to use them to make prioritization decisions, not just pretty graphs. 
 - Comfortable with monitoring and observability stacks (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or equivalent). Can design alerting that catches real problems without drowning the team in noise. 
 - Knows networking at the system level: DNS, load balancing, firewalls, VPNs. This isn't optional in an infrastructure role. 
 - Familiar with compliance frameworks (PCI, HIPAA, SOC 2) and what it takes to pass an audit without a fire drill. 
 - Proficiency with git version control and CI/CD pipeline design. GitOps is the expectation, not the aspiration. 
 - Proficiency with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent). Uses AI to write automation, analyze incidents, and reduce toil. 
 - Understanding of AI/LLM security risks, including prompt injection, data leakage, and model limitations. 
 - Can spot when AI-generated output is wrong, even when it looks right. 
 - Works best when things are on fire, and nobody is panicking. Calm under pressure, direct in communication, allergic to finger-pointing. 

WHY ARMOR

Join Armor if you want to be part of a company that is redefining cybersecurity. Here, you will have the opportunity to shape the future, disrupt the status quo, and be a part of a team that celebrates energy, passion, and fresh thinking. We are not looking for someone who simply fills a role - we want talent who will help us write the next chapter of our growth story. 

ARMOR CORE VALUES

- Commitment to Growth: A growth mindset that encourages continuous learning and improvement with adaptability in the face of challenges. 
 - Integrity Always: Sustain trust through transparency + honesty in all actions and interactions regardless of circumstances. 
 - Empathy In Action: Active understanding, compassion, and support to the needs of others through genuine connection. 
 - Immediate Impact: Taking initiative with swift, informed actions to deliver positive outcomes. 
 - Follow-Through: Dedication to delivering finished results with attention to quality and detail to achieve the desired outcomes.

We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer for the ongoing development and evolution of a high-performance distributed file system. The ideal candidate will possess deep system software development expertise, strong technical leadership capabilities, excellent communication skills, and a proven ability to drive complex projects independently. This role requires close collaboration with globally distributed teams to quickly learn DDN products, technologies, deployment architectures, and operational workflows. The candidate will also contribute to the integration of monitoring, health-check, observability, and alerting capabilities across the product ecosystem.

- Design, develop, and optimize the core I/O infrastructure that underpins the distributed file system, including memory management, threading models, task scheduling, resource allocation, and execution frameworks. 
 - Architect and implement scalable concurrency and synchronization mechanisms to support extreme performance, low latency, and high throughput under demanding production workloads. 
 - Design and enhance Quality of Service (QoS), fairness, prioritization, and resource management capabilities to ensure predictable performance across diverse workloads and tenants. 
 - Integrate and optimize SPDK (Storage Performance Development Kit) within the I/O Core to leverage direct hardware access, minimize software overhead, and maximize storage efficiency. 
 - Design and implement distributed locking mechanisms and concurrency models to ensure consistency, fault tolerance, and scalability across distributed system components.

 - Lead the design and implementation of scalable, high-performance storage and file system infrastructure. 
 - Define, document, and communicate technical architectures, design decisions, and implementation strategies.

 - Mentor and guide engineers across the organization, promoting engineering excellence and best practices. 
 - Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure successful product deployment and timely resolution of production issues.

Requirements

- Accountable, highly motivated, and capable of leading through influence and technical expertise.

At Amgen, if you feel like you're part of something bigger, it's because you are. Our shared mission-to serve patients living with serious illnesses-drives all that we do. 

Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas -Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease- we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives. 

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

 - Partner with cross-functional teams to establish and improve digital tools, data flows, and analytical ways of working as the voice of customer

 - Set project timelines and priorities for key initiatives and team activities; translate business, technical, and regulatory needs into team capabilities, priorities, and execution plans

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.

 - Master's degree and 15 years of analytical sciences, process development, manufacturing, or biotechnology experience OR

 - 4 years of managerial experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs, or directing the allocation of resources

 - Strong leadership skills with the ability to build teams, establish new capabilities, and implement effective processes

Job title: Senior Software Engineer

  

About SailPoint: 

SailPoint is the leader in identity security for the cloud enterprise. Our identity security solutions secure and enable thousands of companies worldwide, giving our customers unmatched visibility into the entirety of their digital workforce, ensuring workers have the right access to do their job - no more, no less. 

About the role: 

Want to be on a team that full of results-driven individuals who are constantly seeking to innovate? Want to make an impact? At SailPoint, our Engineering team does just that. Our engineering is where high-quality professional engineering meets individual impact. Our team creates products are built on a mature, cloud-native event-driven microservices architecture hosted in AWS. 

SailPoint is seeking a Backend Software Engineer with a strong API(REST/GraphQL) development/design background with a flair for programming in java (and Go desired) with a demonstrated history of learning, passionate about building and delivering reliable, scalable, observable microservices for enterprise-grade, multi-tenant SaaS products. The position will be part of Identity Security Cloud Business Services group that develops governance features - Access Certifications, Access Request & Approvals, Password Management, Separation of Duties, Identity/Account Refresh and Provisioning to connect and centrally control access to every application. As part of this team, we are defining the API management strategy for the range of SaaS products, and bring uniformity to the API creation across all teams, adopting diverse cloud-native technologies (persistence, messaging, analytical processing - to name a few) and enabling the product to scale seamlessly while providing a performant user experience. You'll work with teams that are passionate about continuous improvement and agility in a fast-paced environment. 

Responsibilities  

- Drive the planning, design, construction, and reviewing the construction of APIs. 
 - Drive the design, implementation, and deployment of efficient, maintainable, robust microservices to deliver medium-to-high complexity features. 
 - As a member of the API strategy team, you will collaborate with the services team and help your stakeholders follow the organization's strategy for designing, building, and maintaining APIs. 
 - Produce designs and rough estimates, and implement features based on product requirements. 
 - Collaborate with peers on designs, code reviews, and testing. 
 - Produce unit and end-to-end tests to improve code quality and maximize code coverage for new and existing features. 
Requirements  

- 6+ years of experience in Java-based backend development. 
 - Strong knowledge in developing server-side, Object-Oriented Programming and Spring Boot framework
 - Experience in designing, implementing RESTful/GraphQL APIs for an API-first application architecture. 
 - Experience using cloud-native technologies from AWS/other cloud providers. 
 - Experience developing microservices in multi-tenant SaaS application. 
 - Experience using SQL/NoSQL, EKS, Kafka, Redis
 - Experience using monitoring, alerting, visualization tools like Prometheus, Grafana
 - Experience with AI development tools such as Cursor or Claude. 
 - Experience working with remote teams
 - Great communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills

  

Desired

- Professional experience in design/implementation of event-driven architecture. 
 - Experience writing software applications in Go

What success looks like in the role

Within the first 30 days you will: 

- Onboard into your new role, get familiar with our product offering and technology, proactively meet peers and stakeholders, set up your development environment. 
 - Seek to deeply understand business problems or common engineering challenges and develop feature and unit test it. 

By 90 days: 

- Proactively implement different enhancements, defect fixes by interacting independently with different (sometimes  many) stakeholders, architects and members of your team. 
 - Take a committed approach to contributing to different projects development alongside less experienced engineers on your team-there's no room for ivory towers here. 
 - Is able to provide 12x7 on-call support during their day. 

By 6 months: 

- Collaborates with Product Management and Engineering Manager to estimate and develop small to medium complexity features more independently. 
 - Lead projects with small group of 3-4 members. Participate in resource planning, backlog refinement activity. 
 - Occasionally serve as an analysis expert during escalations of systems issues that have evaded the ability of less experienced engineers to solve in a timely manner. 
 - Share support of critical team systems by participating in calls with customers, learning the characteristics of currently running systems, and participating in improvements. 

About SailPoint India and our Benefits: 

Nestled in the heart of Pune, a bustling hub of technology and culture, the office exemplifies SailPoint's commitment to excellence. Surrounded by a vibrant atmosphere, the Pune office serves as a strategic center for the company, where cutting-edge solutions are crafted and implemented to address the ever-evolving challenges in identity security. With a team of highly skilled professionals, the office embodies SailPoint's values of Integrity, Innovation, Impact and Individuals.   
  
Our Pune team works under a hybrid model enjoying the office 3 days a week (unless otherwise specified). We provide excellent office amenities, competitive salaries and strong benefits:   

- Our benefits program offers medical insurance for employees and their dependents, accident insurance and term life insurance for all employees. All premiums are paid by SailPoint.   
 - Company sponsored health-checkups for employees and discounted rates for dependents  
 - Annual performance bonus

Description

Amazon's Relay Operations Center (ROC) is the execution backbone of North America's middle-mile transportation network-managing tens of millions of loads annually across a vast asset base. As we deploy an ambitious automation program that will fundamentally transform how carriers and drivers interact with our network, we need a results-driven Program Manager to ensure that speed never comes at the cost of experience. 

You will lead quality improvement cycles, drive customer experience (CX) metric adoption, and partner with operations, technology, and training teams to deliver measurable improvements in carrier and driver experience across NA ROC operations. This role requires you to think big, dive deep, and balance strategic planning with hands-on program execution. 

As Program Manager, ROC Quality & Customer Experience, you will serve as a strategic advisor to internal and external stakeholders while driving the adoption and engagement of ROC's quality and CX programs. You will be responsible for developing long-term OP planning inputs, contributing to the three-year vision, and building strategic roadmaps for quality and training. In addition to long-term strategic planning, you will partner closely with operations, workforce planning, learning partners, and technology teams to operationalize and deliver improvement initiatives at mid-term horizons. 

You will lead a diverse team across various levels and capabilities-program managers, quality analysts, and business analysts-to drive results for NA Transportation Operations. You will set and drive a culture of defect reduction through continuous improvement cycles, maintaining accountability across multiple business units to deliver large-scale, high-visibility projects. It is an exciting role where you will interact with Sr. Leaders (Directors and VPs) from different organizations across NA. 

Key job responsibilities

CX Metrics & Quality Improvement

- Own execution and continuous improvement of core CX metrics - TTR, PRR, FCR, and Repeat Rate - across automated and human-handled interactions
 - Drive quality defect reduction through closed-loop cycles: defect detection → root cause analysis → SOP update → training content → effectiveness validation
 - Support deployment of AI-powered quality monitoring (Contact Lens) to expand audit coverage and identify tone, clarity, and soft-skill gaps across voice transactions

Training & Operational Effectiveness

- Partner with L&D and workforce planning teams to operationalize training plans addressing quality gaps and automation readiness
 - Develop strategic roadmaps for quality and training, including OP planning inputs and three-year vision contributions
 - Lead continuous improvement initiatives that reduce defect rates through structured coaching frameworks and SOP standardization

Voice of Customer & Carrier Advocacy

Drive the Anecdotes Program - intake, 5-why investigation, closed-loop resolution, and systemic prevention of recurring carrier issues

- Partner with Relay Product, TTS, and Middle Mile teams to translate carrier feedback into actionable program improvements and roadmap priorities

Automation CX Readiness

- Conduct pre-launch CX impact assessments and 30/60/90-day post-launch audits for automation deployments, ensuring quality parity between automated and manual processes

Stakeholder Management & Reporting

A day in the life

You start your morning reviewing CX metrics dashboards and preparing a narrative update for a leadership review. By mid-morning, you are in a working session with Relay Product and Middle Mile partners, aligning on carrier feedback themes and roadmap priorities. After lunch, you hold a one-on-one with a direct report to discuss their development goals and review a quality audit proposal they have drafted. Job Description - API Test Architect & Test Solution Lead

API Modernization | Microservices | Healthcare | Quality Engineering

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced API Test Architect & Solution Lead to lead the quality engineering strategy, architecture, and implementation for large-scale API modernization and microservices transformation programs within the healthcare domain. 

The role will be responsible for defining the end-to-end API testing architecture and modernization validation strategy for enterprise services being transformed from legacy/monolithic platforms into modern RESTful APIs and microservices. 

This is a customer-facing technical leadership role requiring strong expertise in API testing, test automation architecture, microservices, legacy-to-modern API parity validation, CI/CD integration, healthcare data validation, and AI-assisted Quality Engineering. 

The Solution Lead will work closely with enterprise architects, API developers, product owners, business teams, DevOps teams, and QA engineering teams to ensure modernized services meet functional, integration, data integrity, performance, security, and release-readiness requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

API Test Architecture & Solutioning

- Define the enterprise API Quality Engineering architecture, strategy, standards, and implementation roadmap for API modernization programs. 
 - Design scalable and reusable API automation frameworks supporting hundreds of APIs and thousands of test scenarios. 
 - Establish standardized testing approaches using Cucumber, TestNG, REST Assured, Gradle, Git/Bitbucket, Jenkins/Udeploy, and automated reporting. 
 - Define framework architecture with clear separation of: 
 - Test data
 - Test logic
 - Configuration
 - Validation utilities
 - Reporting
 - Environment management
 - Build reusable automation components, utilities, libraries, and common validation capabilities that can be adopted across multiple projects. 
 - Establish traceability across requirements → feature files → test data → automated execution → defects → results. 

API Modernization & Microservices Validation

- Lead testing strategy for migration of legacy enterprise services to REST APIs and microservices architecture. 
 - Define legacy-versus-modernized service parity testing to ensure business functionality and data behavior remain consistent during modernization. 
 - Establish baseline request/response datasets from legacy services and compare them against modernized API responses. 
 - Design automated comparison capabilities for: 
 - Request/response validation
 - JSON/XML payload comparison
 - Schema validation
 - Field-level comparison
 - Business-rule validation
 - Data transformation validation
 - Database/backend validation
 - Error and exception handling
 - Validate service decomposition and interactions across distributed microservices. 
 - Develop testing approaches for synchronous and asynchronous service integrations. 
 - Define regression strategies that allow modernization teams to continuously verify functional parity during incremental migration. 

API Functional & Integration Testing

- Define comprehensive API testing coverage including: 
 - Functional testing
 - Integration testing
 - Contract testing
 - Schema validation
 - Positive and negative testing
 - Boundary testing
 - Authentication and authorization validation
 - Error handling
 - Data integrity validation
 - Regression testing
 - End-to-end service validation
 - Establish API test scenarios based on OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, GraphQL schemas, interface contracts, business requirements, and legacy system documentation. 
 - Define reusable test-data strategies using Excel, generated datasets, synthetic data, and approved production-like samples. 
 - Drive automation-first testing while identifying scenarios requiring specialized or exploratory validation. 

Healthcare Domain Validation

- Provide Quality Engineering leadership for healthcare enterprise services supporting areas such as: 
 - Member and eligibility
 - Provider
 - Claims
 - Benefits
 - Enrollment
 - Accumulators
 - Authorization
 - Payments
 - Clinical and administrative integrations
 - Ensure modernization testing validates critical healthcare business rules and cross-system data integrity. 
 - Support testing of healthcare interoperability and data exchange services where applicable, including FHIR/HL7-based APIs and healthcare integration patterns. 
 - Ensure appropriate handling of sensitive healthcare test data and alignment with organizational security, privacy, and compliance requirements. 

Automation Framework Engineering

- Architect and enhance BDD-based API automation frameworks using: 
 - Cucumber
 - TestNG
 - REST Assured
 - Java
 - Gradle
 - Define reusable feature files, step definitions, API clients, assertion libraries, data utilities, and comparison utilities. 
 - Develop configurable validation mechanisms capable of supporting different APIs without extensive custom coding. 
 - Establish coding standards, framework governance, peer reviews, and reusable engineering patterns. 
 - Optimize automation suites for parallel execution, maintainability, stability, and faster regression cycles. 

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate API automation into Jenkins/Udeploy CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Define automated quality gates for builds and deployments. 
 - Enable API regression suites to execute across development, QA, integration, staging, and release environments. 
 - Establish mechanisms for: 
 - Pipeline-triggered execution
 - Environment configuration
 - Test-data management
 - Parallel execution
 - Failure diagnostics
 - Automated reporting
 - Partner with DevOps and engineering teams to enable continuous testing and shift-left quality engineering. 

Reporting & Quality Metrics

- Define enterprise-level API Quality Engineering reporting using: 
 - Cucumber Reports
 - JSON Reports
 - HTML Reports
 - Execution Logs
 - CI/CD dashboards
 - Establish metrics for: 
 - API automation coverage

 - Regression coverage

 - Provide technical insights and quality recommendations to engineering leadership and customer stakeholders. 

AI-Assisted Quality Engineering

 - Requirement and API specification analysis
 - Test scenario generation
 - Test case generation
 - Gherkin/feature-file generation
 - REST Assured automation development

 - Test-data generation

data.description:
Description

Everyday Essentials (EE) is a $100B+ business and one of the fastest-growing categories at Amazon - the household staples, health and personal care, grocery, and beauty products hundreds of millions of customers reorder. We're reinventing how customers discover, buy, and get more value from them, and we're looking for Software Development Engineers who want to build that future. 

The EE Experiences organization builds the shopping experience for the products customers come back for most. Our charter is Progressive Discovery and Monetization: helping customers find better products for their needs, complete their baskets, and get more value on every essentials purchase - and giving the world's largest consumer brands new and effective ways to reach those customers and grow with Amazon. We build a durable, profitable business at the intersection of the two, on the surfaces customers use every day. 

This is a space where the hardest problems don't have off-the-shelf answers. We're not polishing a solved product - we're inventing experiences that don't exist yet, and the decisions we make now shape a business with room to grow for years. You'll have the freedom to propose new ideas, prototype them, and ship them worldwide. Your work moves from whiteboard to production in front of a very large customer base, with visibility all the way to senior leadership. 

We're an AI-first team, and that shows up in two ways. We use AI throughout how we build software, and we expect our engineers to keep learning and applying the latest tools to move faster and raise the quality bar. AI is also at the core of what we build - the intelligence that helps customers find the right product is a modeling and engineering problem we work on hand in hand with scientists. If you're curious about AI, learn quickly, and like using it to solve real customer problems while keeping a clear head about where it helps and where it doesn't, you'll fit right in. 

Key job responsibilities

- Design, build, and own software end to end - working backwards from the customer through design, code, testing, deployment, and operations. 
 - Take on ambiguous problems where the goal is clear but the path is not, bring clarity, and deliver simple solutions to hard problems. 
 - Partner closely with scientists, product managers, and designers to turn customer problems into products that ship worldwide. 
 - Use AI tools and modern engineering practices to build faster and at a higher bar of quality, and help the team level up how it uses them. 
 - Own operational excellence for what you build - monitor it, respond when issues arise, and keep improving the customer and partner experience. 
 - Raise the technical bar through code reviews, mentoring, and hiring for the best talent. 

A day in the life

Most days start with the customer problem in front of you: how to help someone find a better everyday-essentials product, or fill their basket faster. You dig into data, sketch a design, and talk it through with product managers and scientists before writing any code. By the afternoon you might be prototyping an idea that didn't exist yesterday, reviewing a teammate's change, or debugging something in production. Because so much here is new, you won't just pick up tickets. You'll help decide what to build, push for the approach you believe in, and see your work reach customers in weeks, not quarters. 

About The Team

Our team owns how customers discover and buy the everyday essentials they rely on - and how the brands behind those products reach them. Our mission is to make restocking the things you need effortless, and to help customers find better options along the way. Day to day you'll work with fellow engineers and partner closely with product managers, designers, and scientists, who bring the customer and data insight that shapes what we build. We're a small, fast-moving group solving open-ended problems for hundreds of millions of shoppers - a place where you own problems end to end and your ideas reach customers fast. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
 - Experience debugging, profiling, and implementing best software engineering practices in large-scale systems

Messaging & Event Systems

Security & Cloud

Testing & Quality

Value Competencies

 - Collaborates effectively across engineering, product, and data science

Where you belong

We are part of the CTO Organization for Intelligent Spend and Business Network at SAP, building a next-generation Search Platform that powers enterprise discovery at a global scale. 

Our team works on cutting-edge challenges across distributed systems, search relevance, and AI-driven retrieval-combining traditional IR techniques with modern LLM-based approaches. data.title: Engineer /Senior Engineer (Verification)
data.description:
Job Overview

Experience : 2-8 years

Responsibilities

You'll be part of a team that builds complete reference systems around Arm IPs and use it for and Arm IP stress verification, giving you exposure far beyond traditional DV roles. 

- Integrate Arm CPU and system IPs into full reference platforms
 - Bring up systems across simulation and emulation
 - Debug real system issues spanning hardware + low-level software
 - Develop system-level tests (C/C++/Assembly driven)
 - Work closely with design, architecture, and global teams
 - Contribute to improving verification flows, tools, and efficiency

Why This Role Stands Out

- 🔧 Early System-level exposure - go beyond UVM/testbench work
 - 🧠 Strong learning curve - CPU architecture, AMBA, memory systems
 - 🚀 High ownership - own IP integration, features, debug, and bring-up
 - 🌍 Global collaboration - work with teams across UK, US, and Europe
 - ⚡ Real impact - your work directly influences quality of Arm IPs. 

Required Skills And Experience

- 2-8 years of experience in SoC/IP development or verification
 - Solid understanding of verification fundamentals & debug
 - Experience with C/C++ or Assembly-based testing
 - Exposure to pre-silicon environments (simulation/emulation)
 - Basic understanding of CPU or SoC architecture

Good to Have

- Knowledge of Arm architecture / AMBA protocols
 - Experience in embedded software or firmware bring-up
 - Exposure to SoC integration or system-level validation
 - Scripting in Python/Perl
 - Familiarity with Verilog/SystemVerilog

Who You'll Fit In Best As

- You enjoy debugging and figuring out system integration problems
 - You want to work close to real hardware and full systems
 - You're looking to move beyond pure DV into system understanding
 - You take ownership and can drive tasks end-to-end

Our 10x mindset guides how we engineer, collaborate, and grow. Understand what it means and how to reflect 10x in your work: https: //careers. arm. com/en/10x-mindset

We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Hybrid Working

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. This role combines hands-on cyber review expertise with people leadership, quality oversight, operational coordination, and data-driven decision-making.

data.title: GDS Consulting - AIA - AI Archictect- Manager
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

AI Architect

Enterprise GenAI, Agentic AI and AI Platform Architecture

Career Family AIA - AI / GenAI / Agentic AI

Role Type Full Time

The opportunity

We are seeking an experienced AI Architect to lead the design and delivery of secure, scalable and production-ready enterprise AI solutions. The role combines hands-on architecture with consulting leadership across Generative AI, Agentic AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI/ML, cloud platforms and modern application engineering. The architect will translate business priorities into target-state architectures, reusable patterns and implementation roadmaps while guiding multidisciplinary teams from discovery through deployment and operationalization. 

The ideal candidate has delivered enterprise or client-facing AI solutions in pre-production or production environments and can explain the use case, architecture, personal contribution, controls, delivery approach and outcomes. Certifications, personal projects and demonstrations alone are not sufficient. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Lead discovery and architecture workshops, clarify business outcomes and non-functional requirements, and convert them into scalable AI solution designs and delivery roadmaps. 
 - Architect LLM applications, copilots, RAG and Graph RAG solutions, autonomous agents, multi-agent workflows, tool/function calling, memory patterns and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Define reference architectures and reusable patterns for document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, grounding, prompt workflows, model routing and enterprise integrations. 
 - Select fit-for-purpose models, cloud services, vector stores, orchestration frameworks and evaluation approaches based on security, quality, latency, cost, scalability and maintainability requirements. 
 - Design API-first, event-driven and microservices-based integrations with enterprise applications, data platforms, workflow systems and user experience layers. 
 - Establish AI evaluation and observability covering retrieval quality, groundedness, accuracy, hallucination risk, agent trajectories, tool execution, latency, cost and user experience. 
 - Embed Responsible AI, privacy, security and compliance controls including PII protection, access control, auditability, prompt-injection mitigation, content safety, secure tool execution and data-leakage prevention. 
 - Define cloud-native deployment and operations patterns using containers, Kubernetes or managed services, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, model/LLM operations, monitoring and release controls. 
 - Lead architecture reviews, technical design reviews, code reviews and production-readiness assessments; troubleshoot complex issues and guide performance optimization. 
 - Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, data scientists, engineers, UX teams, security and platform teams to ensure alignment from design through adoption. 
 - Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, estimates, executive presentations, accelerators, reusable assets and AI practice development. 
 - Lead and mentor architects and engineers, promote engineering standards, and build capability through coaching and knowledge sharing. 

Skills And Attributes

Professional experience

- 10+ years of experience in AI, data, analytics, software engineering or digital transformation, including significant responsibility for solution architecture and end-to-end delivery. 
 - Strong hands-on experience designing and deploying enterprise-scale AI/ML, GenAI, RAG or Agentic AI solutions in client-facing environments. 
 - Proven experience leading cross-functional teams, architecture governance, stakeholder engagement and complex delivery programs. 
 - Ability to communicate architecture decisions, trade-offs and business value to technical and executive audiences. 

Technical Skills

- Deep understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, Graph RAG, Agentic RAG, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, knowledge graphs, model evaluation and fine-tuning approaches. 
 - Hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI or Google Agent SDK, and familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP). 
 - Strong experience with at least one enterprise cloud AI ecosystem: Microsoft Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI; AWS Bedrock; or GCP Vertex AI and Gemini. Multi-cloud exposure is preferred. 
 - Experience with data and AI platforms such as Databricks, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, BigQuery or equivalent enterprise data services. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python and SQL; working knowledge of REST APIs, FastAPI, JSON, asynchronous processing, microservices and event-driven architecture. 
 - Experience with vector databases, enterprise search, relational and NoSQL data stores, caching and analytics stores. 
 - Understanding of ML, deep learning, NLP, predictive analytics and the end-to-end AI lifecycle. 
 - Experience with Docker, Kubernetes or OpenShift, Git, CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, MLOps, LLMOps, observability and production support. 
 - Strong knowledge of enterprise architecture, data governance, model risk, Responsible AI, privacy, cybersecurity, accessibility and regulatory controls. 

Consulting And Leadership Skills

- Strong client engagement, workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, presentation and executive communication skills. 
 - Ability to translate complex business requirements into practical, high-quality technical architectures and phased implementation plans. 
 - Leadership in solution estimation, delivery governance, risk management, quality assurance, mentoring and capability building. 
 - Curiosity, structured problem-solving, commercial awareness and commitment to continuous learning. 

Education And Preferred Certifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative discipline. 
 - Relevant certifications in Azure AI, AWS, Google Cloud, Databricks, AI/ML, Generative AI or enterprise architecture are preferred. 

Why join us

- Be at the forefront of AI-driven innovation across multiple client sectors. 
 - Work with global clients to deliver measurable business impact. 
 - Collaborate with AI experts, analytics leaders and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment. 

What We Offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. 

- Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. 
 - Success as defined by you: We provide the tools and flexibility so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. 
 - Transformative leadership: We provide insights, coaching and confidence to help you become the leader the world needs. 
 - Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be empowered to use your voice and help others find theirs. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.description:
Location: Ahmedabad

Experience: 4-5 years

Key Responsibilities

- Quality System Management: Develop, implement, and maintain robust Quality Management Systems (QMS) across the manufacturing plant. Ensure compliance with ISO standards and industry-specific regulations (Pharma/F&B GMP standards). 
 - Inward Quality Control (IQC): Oversee the inspection of incoming raw materials (e. g. , SS 304/316), fabricated parts, and bought-out components (electrical, pneumatic, and mechanical) to ensure they meet engineering specifications. 
 - In-Process Inspection: Monitor machining, fabrication, and assembly line processes. Implement rigorous quality checkpoints during the machine building phase to prevent defects and rework.

data.title: Sr Principal Verification Engineer
data.description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www. analog. com and on LinkedIn and X. 

Analog Devices is seeking Digital Design Sr Principal Verification Engineer, who will be responsible for design verification of highly integrated solutions and products in a multifunctional team. You will be working on driving real revenue growth on the next generation of Intelligence at the Edge products across multiple products and business units. 

About ADI: 

Analog Devices, Inc. is a leading global high-performance analog technology company dedicated to solving our customers' most complex engineering challenges. We play a critical role at the intersection of the physical and digital world by providing the building blocks to sense, measure, interpret, connect, and power devices and systems. We design, manufacture, test, and market a broad portfolio of solutions, including integrated circuits (ICs), software and subsystems that leverage high-performance analog, mixed-signal and digital signal processing technologies. We embrace a culture of innovation and collaboration to push the state of the art. 

About The Role

Lead design verification team for SOC or subsystem design pre silicon verification. The candidate will be responsible for formulating verification strategies, Define verification architecture, Flow, Methodology and leading, driving and completing verification of large integrated products. As a senior team member, it is expected that he/she will lead and influence verification methodologies within both DBU and ADI. The candidate is also encouraged to participate in cross company technical initiatives as well as patent and publish work where possible. 

Responsibilities

- Lead end-to-end SoC verification for complex digital SoCs, driving execution from planning to signoff. 
 - Verify complex microprocessor-based designs, AI/ML accelerators, and high-speed peripherals using advanced verification methodologies. 
 - Define and drive team execution by planning tasks, tracking progress, and providing technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance. 
 - Collaborate closely with architecture and design teams to define requirements and align on verification deliverables and dependencies. 
 - Drive pre-silicon readiness by aligning with emulation, FPGA, and software teams to cover post-silicon validation scenarios early. 
 - Develop and execute end-to-end system-level use cases for comprehensive functional validation. 
 - Architect and implement scalable UVM-based testbenches, DV flows, and methodologies. 
 - Define and review test plans; ensure closure of functional and code coverage across block, subsystem, and SoC levels. 
 - Work cross-functionally with emulation, FPGA, firmware, and system teams to ensure full-system correctness. 
 - Apply formal verification techniques for IP and subsystem-level validation. 
 - Lead NoC/interconnect verification and ensure robust data flow across the SoC. 
 - Perform performance verification and system-level analysis across real-world use cases. 
 - Drive innovation in verification strategies to meet aggressive schedules and quality goals. 
 - Define overall verification strategy based on product requirements and design specifications, leveraging modern techniques such as formal, emulation, portable stimulus, and virtual platforms. 

Requirements

- B. Tech/M. Tech with 20+ years of experience in digital pre-silicon verification, including leadership across IP, subsystem, or SoC-level DV. 
 - Strong understanding of SoC/Subsystem architectures with hands-on expertise in Verilog/SystemVerilog and UVM-based testbench development, debugging, and methodology implementation. 
 - Proven track record in verification closure using functional and code coverage metrics across block, subsystem, and SoC levels. 
 - Expertise in NoC, bus, and interconnect verification, along with coverage analysis and optimization. 
 - Experience in architecting scalable testbench environments and defining robust DV flows and methodologies. 
 - Strong background in power-aware verification (UPF), including power analysis and optimization. 
 - Hands-on experience with formal verification, including flow definition, connectivity, and functional property checking. 
 - Solid protocol knowledge and verification experience across high-speed and low-speed interfaces such as I2C, SPI, Ethernet, UART, AXI/AHB, DMA, and SVI3. 
 - Experience in security and safety verification, ensuring compliance with secure design and functional safety requirements. 
 - Familiarity with gate-level simulations with timing annotation (GLS). 
 - Strong expertise in test planning, constrained-random verification, assertions, and transaction-level modeling. 
 - Good understanding of processor-based systems (ARM, RISC-V, Tensilica), AI/ML accelerators, and proficiency in C/C++, SystemC, and scripting (Python/TCL/Shell). 
 - Exposure to mixed-signal/analog verification (ADC/DAC/PLL/PHY) is a plus. 
 - Excellent communication and leadership skills with the ability to collaborate across global teams and drive verification innovation. 
 - Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to quickly learn and adopt new technologies

Meet the Team

Customer Experience (CX) is a team of extraordinary technical experts whose #1 focus is to deliver a premier customer experience and accelerate value realization. Our team, Solution Validation Services (SVS), is an integral part of Cisco Customer Experience, specializing in pre-deployment solution validation, software qualification, and architectural assurance for complex, mission-critical networks prior to Go-Live. Our success is proven through accelerated customer deployments, reduced operational risk, premier customer satisfaction metrics, and employee engagement excellence. 

Your Impact

As An Architect In SVS, You Will Provide Top-tier Technical Leadership And Drive The Validation Strategy For Next-generation Service Provider Networks

- Architectural Influence: Translate complex validation outcomes and testbed findings into actionable business risk mitigation strategies for C-level and senior engineering leadership. 
 - Solution Validation & Assurance: Lead end-to-end testing of next-generation Service Provider routing architectures, major software releases (Cisco IOS-XR 64-bit), and modern transport solutions (SRv6, BGP EVPN, Routed Optical Networking) to guarantee production readiness. 
 - Lab Digital Twin Simulations: Build full-scale, high-fidelity customer simulations in world-class SVS test laboratories to uncover, isolate, and resolve sophisticated protocol, scale, and multi-vendor interoperability bottlenecks before production deployment. 
 - Test Automation Excellence: Architect and implement continuous test automation frameworks using Cisco pyATS/Genie, CXTM, and CI/CD pipelines, driving automated test coverage and accelerating project delivery velocity. 
 - Defect Advocacy & Engineering Liaison: Act as the primary technical escalation authority during validation, partnering directly with Cisco Product Engineering (XR Dev, HW/Silicon teams) to triage defects, validate SMUs/patches, and ensure rapid resolution. 
 - Pre-Sales & Scoping Leadership: Partner with SVS Business Development Managers (BDMs) and Account Teams on pre-sales scoping, developing Statements of Work (SOW), Level of Effort (LOE) models, and Joint Test Plans on Record (JTPOR). 
 - Talent Mentorship: Mentor, coach, and elevate the technical proficiency of consulting engineers across the global SVS organization, fostering a culture of innovation and delivery excellence. 

Decision Making & Scope of Impact

- Strategic Autonomy: High degree of technical autonomy: determines validation methodologies, test strategies, and architectural best practices across global SP engagements. 
 - Business Impact: Decisions directly impact customer Go-Live success, network availability, multi-million dollar project margins, and Cisco's trusted advisor standing with Tier-1 accounts. 
 - Organizational Alignment: Translates global CX and SVS strategic priorities into concrete technical initiatives, testbed innovations, and delivery standards. 

Role-Specific Responsibilities

- Customer Architectural Engagement: Collaborate closely with customer Principal Architects, Cisco Account Teams, and CX Technical Leaders to define validation scopes, acceptance criteria, and migration test strategies. 
 - Deliverable Governance: Author, review, and formally approve key SVS deliverables, including Detailed Test Plans (DTP), Joint Test Plans on Record (JTPOR), Method of Procedures (MOP), and End of Test Reports (EOTR). 
 - Performance & Scale Validation: Synthesize complex traffic profiles and performance benchmarks utilizing industry-standard hardware traffic generators (Spirent TestCenter, Keysight/Ixia IxNetwork) and WAN impairment tools to validate line-rate throughput, QoS behavior, and failover convergence. 
 - Automation & Tooling Leadership: Drive the adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Test Automation as Code across SVS delivery pods, building reusable pyATS test scripts and CI/CD validation pipelines. 
 - Advanced Troubleshooting & RCA: Lead root cause analysis (RCA) on sophisticated customer defects, analyzing packet captures, router debug logs, and telemetry streams to pinpoint software bugs and configuration regressions. 
 - Knowledge Transfer & Assets: Champion knowledge sharing by authoring best-practice whitepapers, test methodology playbooks, and reusable test suites to scale delivery efficiency globally. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Education & Experience: Typically requires a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Telecommunications Engineering, or equivalent plus 10-15+ years of relevant experience in Service Provider network design, testing, validation, or advanced technical delivery. 
 - Core Platform Expertise: Deep, hands-on architectural and validation expertise in Cisco Service Provider routing platforms and network operating systems. 
 - Consulting & Client Engagement: Proven experience in customer-facing consulting, technical leadership, or solution architecture roles engaging with senior-level decision makers. 
 - Certifications: Expert-level Cisco certification (CCIE Service Provider or CCIE Enterprise/Routing & Switching) or equivalent proven industry standing is strongly desired. 
 - Software & Automation: Demonstrable foundation in software programmability and automation scripting (Python, REST APIs, JSON/YAML). 
 - Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication, executive presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to navigate ambiguous, high-pressure environments. 

Preferred Technical Qualifications

Strong architectural understanding and hands-on validation expertise across minimum two of the following SP domain areas: 

- Service Provider Core & Edge Routing Architectures (Converged SDN Transport & RON): 
 - Cisco SP Platforms
 - Operating Systems
 - Core Routing Protocols
 - Segment Routing & Traffic Engineering
 - Multi-Service VPNs & EVPN
 - SP Network Timing & 5G Sync
 - Routed Optical Networking (RON)
 - SP Resiliency & Security
 - SP Automation, Orchestration, Observability & Tooling: 
 - Cisco pyATS & Genie Test Frameworks
 - SP SDN Orchestration & Controllers
 - Data Modeling & Interfaces
 - Streaming Telemetry & Observability
 - Scripting & CI/CD Pipelines
 - Test Lab Simulation, Traffic Generation & Telco Cloud: 
 - Hardware Traffic Generation
 - Virtualization & Digital Twin Platforms
 - SP Cloud & Telco Infrastructure

Leadership & Autonomy

- Self-Direction & Initiative: Operates with high autonomy, determining methods and validation frameworks on strategic, high-visibility customer projects. 
 - Strategic Advisor: Serves as a trusted technical advisor to leadership and customers, translating strategic technology goals into actionable validation programs. 
 - Team Leadership: Champions innovation, leading internal initiatives to advance SVS testing capabilities, tooling, and delivery best practices. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

Experience in systems design and distributed systems. 

Excellent organisation, communication and interpersonal skills

Work

Equal Opportunity Employer

Walmart, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer - By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing diversity- unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions - while being inclusive of all people.

Master's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, information systems, cybersecurity, or related area and 1 year's experience leading information security or cybersecurity projects, We value candidates with a background in creating inclusive digital experiences, demonstrating knowledge in implementing Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2. 2 AA standards, assistive technologies, and integrating digital accessibility seamlessly.
