data.title: Lead QA Engineer
data.description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

Qualys is looking for a Lead QA Engineer to own quality for products in the Cybersecurity and Compliance domain used by thousands of enterprise customers. 

You will act as a senior individual contributor and technical mentor for QA and automation engineers. You will define the test strategy across UI, backend, and data pipelines, and drive the move toward AI-assisted, self-healing automation. This is a hands-on technical role: you set quality direction, influence release decisions, and actively write and review framework code. Candidates who have built or meaningfully enhanced AI-based self-healing automation tools will stand out. 

Responsibilities

QA Mentorship & Strategy

- Mentor and guide QA and automation engineers through technical coaching, code reviews, and knowledge sharing. 
 - Define and own the end-to-end test strategy for legacy components by improving automation coverage, while ensuring all new components are fully automated from the start. 
 - Act as the quality voice in sprint planning, design reviews, and release readiness; make data-backed go/no-go recommendations. 
 - Establish scalable QA processes: defect triage, severity/priority standards, regression tiers, test case management, and root-cause analysis for escaped defects. 
 - Track and report quality metrics (defect leakage, automation coverage, flaky-test rate, mean time to detect, release cycle time) to engineering and product leadership. 
 - Partner closely with Development, Product, Support, and Sustenance teams to shift quality left and reduce customer-reported issues. 

Test Automation (Hands-On)

- Architect and evolve automation frameworks across React/TypeScript front ends, Java/Spring Boot microservices, REST APIs, and Kafka-based pipelines. 
 - Own API and contract testing (REST Assured, Pact, Postman/Newman) covering OAuth2, JWT, token, and Basic auth flows, pagination, throttling, and vendor error handling. 
 - Own CI/CD quality gates in Jenkins or GitHub Actions with fast PR-level feedback and tiered regression runs. 

AI-Driven & Self-Healing Automation

- Lead the design and rollout of self-healing automation: automatic locator recovery, DOM-similarity scoring, element fingerprinting, and confidence-based fallback that keeps suites green through UI changes. 
 - Apply LLMs across the QA lifecycle - generating test cases from requirements and API specs, converting manual tests to automated scripts, summarizing failures, and suggesting root causes from logs. 
 - Build intelligent flaky-test detection, failure classification, and auto-quarantine to separate real regressions from environmental noise. 
 - Set guardrails for AI use in QA - validating AI-generated tests, measuring healing accuracy, and preventing false passes. 

Qualifications

Experience

- 8-10+ years in QA / test engineering, with at least 2 years leading or mentoring a QA team. 
 - Proven track record of building automation frameworks from scratch and owning release quality for a SaaS product. 
 - Hands-on experience building, extending, or productionizing an AI-based or self-healing automation solution, with the ability to explain how you measured its impact. 

Skills

Automation & Testing

- Robot, Playwright and/or Selenium 4; TestNG or JUnit 5; Cypress, Jest, or Vitest
 - API automation: REST Assured, Postman/Newman, schema validation
 - Contract testing (Pact), service virtualization, and mocking (WireMock or similar)
 - Performance testing with JMeter, k6, or Gatling
 - Visual regression and accessibility testing

Programming & Backend

- Python, Java(17+) and JavaScript/TypeScript
 - SQL and data validation on Oracle or similar
 - Familiarity with microservices, Spring Boot, and Kafka (or other event streaming systems)

AI in QA

- Self-healing locator strategies and intelligent element matching
 - LLM integration: prompt design, structured outputs, and embedding model calls into test tooling
 - AI-assisted test generation, failure clustering, and log/trace summarization
 - Familiarity with RAG or vector search over test artifacts is a plus
 - Working knowledge of AI testing platforms (Healenium, Applitools, mabl, Testim)

DevOps & Tooling

- CI/CD with Jenkins or GitHub Actions
 - Docker and Kubernetes fundamentals
 - Test management (Jira/Xray, TestRail, or Zephyr)
 - Observability tools (Grafana, Prometheus, ELK) for test and pipeline diagnostics

Technical Mentorship

- Strong ability to mentor engineers through technical guidance and code reviews
 - Clear communication with engineering, product, and leadership stakeholders
 - Data-driven decision-making on quality and release readiness

Preferred

- Background in cybersecurity - vulnerability management, Policy Compliance
 - Experience testing multi-tenant SaaS at large data volumes. 
 - Open-source contributions to testing or automation projects.

 - Stream Processing: Apache Flink for real-time log parsing, rolling aggregations, and anomaly detection before storage. 
 - Backend Languages: Java for building heavy stream-processing applications, supplemented by Go and Python for operators and tooling. 
 - Ad-Hoc OLAP Analytics: Apache Druid to power sub-second, interactive dashboard queries over massive historical datasets. 
 - Log & Trace Storage: ClickHouse for fast columnar event storage, natively tiered to AWS S3 / GCP Cloud Storage for cost-effective cold storage. 
 - Time-Series Metrics: VictoriaMetrics, M3DB, or Prometheus to ingest and compress millions of high-cardinality metric rollups. 
 - Visualization & Alerting: Grafana and Apache Superset for single-pane-of-glass UI, paired with Prometheus Alertmanager for incident routing. 

You're Our Person If. . . 

- You have deep experience building software and leading engineering teams. 
 - You know how to move, store, and work with very large amounts of data.

 - You have hands-on experience with open-source tools like Kafka, Flink, and Apache Druid. 
 - You are a kind and helpful mentor to other engineers.

Even Better If. . . 

- You have worked on an Observability stack before (tools that monitor system health and logs).

 - You enjoy talking directly to customers to understand and solve their problems. 

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

data.description:
About The Team / Role

As a Director, Data Platform Engineering, you will be the primary leader and visionary for the core data infrastructure that powers the entire enterprise. This is a "platform-as-a-product" role; your mission is to lead the team building the internal foundation-creating the high-performance engines, abstraction layers, and self-service frameworks that enable hundreds of other engineers to move faster. You will manage a team operating at the intersection of Systems Programming and Data Engineering, solving "hard-tech" problems like automated schema evolution, multi-engine compute optimization, and global data discovery. As a top-level technical leader, you will bridge the gap between long-term business strategy and engineering execution, ensuring WEX's data platform remains a competitive advantage. 

Is this role for you?

- YES, if: You are an Engineering Manager or Lead Backend/Software Engineer who loves leading teams that solve "Big Data" problems, build APIs for data discovery, and optimize distributed systems. 
 - NO, if: Your primary expertise is managing teams that write SQL queries, build Tableau dashboards, or manage ETL workflows without deep experience in Java or Python system architecture. 

How You'll Make An Impact

- Strategic Roadmap & Sovereignty: Define and execute the 3-5 year technical roadmap for the Data Lakehouse. You will guide your team in deciding how storage, compute, and metadata layers (e. g. , Apache Polaris, Unity Catalog or Datahub Catalog) interact at an elemental level. 
 - Platform-as-a-Product Delivery: Lead the development of internal SDKs, CLI tools, and automated orchestration frameworks. Your goal is to ensure your team abstracts away cloud complexity via Control Planes and Custom Operators, allowing Data Engineers to focus on business logic rather than infrastructure boilerplate. 
 - Internal R&D Management: Champion and resource prototyping and benchmarking of emerging technologies (e. g. , specialized Spark extensions) to keep the platform at the bleeding edge of performance and cost-efficiency. 
 - Global Governance & Security: Oversee the architecture of "compliance-by-design" systems. Ensure the team automates data lineage, PII masking, and fine-grained access control across petabyte-scale environments without sacrificing developer velocity. 
 - AI Governance Lake: Facilitate real-time data ingestion by implementing streaming support for Open Telemetry data from AI Agents into the Data Lake, drive the development of advanced AI evaluation metrics and reporting. 
 - Engineering Excellence & Delivery: Set the gold standard for code quality and system design across the company. You will oversee Cross-Functional Architecture Reviews and ensure your team effectively resolves the most complex system outages or performance bottlenecks. 
 - Team Leadership & Mentorship: Hire, mentor, and grow a world-class engineering team. Foster an "Engineering Community, " influencing the hiring bar and professional development paths for the entire data engineering organization. 

Experience You Will Bring

- Experience: 15+ years in software engineering and distributed systems, with at least 4 years of experience managing high-performing engineering teams delivering platform-scale initiatives. 
 - Core Technical Competencies (Software Engineering Focus): 
 - Strong Software Foundations: Deep understanding of software engineering, system architecture, and scalable production applications (Algorithms, Data Structures, and System Design). Experience in the Java/J2EE ecosystem (Spring Boot, Microservices) and Python. We are looking for a leader who ensures their team writes clean, testable, and high-performance code, not just scripts. 
 - Data as a Product: Experience managing or building the platforms / framework engines and APIs that power data movement, rather than just building the ETL/ELT pipelines themselves. 
 - Data Lakehouse Mastery: 
 - Deep understanding of Apache Iceberg, Hudi, or Delta Lake (metadata management, manifest files, and compaction strategies). 
 - Experience managing teams contributing to or deeply customizing open-source data projects (e. g. , Spark, dbt). 
 - Cloud & Infrastructure: 
 - Extensive experience with cloud architecture and services, including AWS (S3, EMR, Kubernetes, Lambda) and Azure. 
 - Deep understanding of CI/CD automation, modern development tools, Git Actions, Terraform and frameworks. 
 - AI-Driven Development & Productivity: 
 - AI Native Development: Experience leveraging AI Code Gen platforms into the software development lifecycle (SDLC) to automate code generation, reviews, generate unit tests, and perform root-cause analysis of system failures. 
 - LLM-Ops for Platform: Ability to guide the architecture of infrastructure required to support AI Agent development by enabling vector database integration. 
 - Leadership & Vision: 
 - Proven track record of driving adoption of new technologies across multiple autonomous teams. 
 - Ability to communicate complex architectural trade-offs (e. g. , "Latency vs. Consistency" or "Build vs. Buy") to C-suite executives and engineering teams alike. 
 - Education: 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science (Distributed Systems focus) preferred, or equivalent deep industry experience.

data.title: Software Engineering PMTS - Cloud Infra & Security
data.description:
Description

Come join our growing Hyperforce Enterprise Security organization. We are chartered with architecting, implementing, and operating security solutions that protect Salesforce's complex, multi-cloud technology landscape at scale. 

As a Principal Member of Technical Staff, you will provide technical leadership in building the next generation of infrastructure security and developer security guardrails. You will work across the software development and deployment lifecycle to identify security risks early, build scalable controls, and enable secure-by-default engineering practices without compromising developer velocity. 

Our team operates at the intersection of cloud security, application security, infrastructure security, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and runtime security. We build and operate security guardrails that identify and prevent high-risk security issues from source code and Infrastructure as Code through CI/CD and into runtime environments. 

You will be expected to operate at both strategic and hands-on technical levels, defining architecture and technical direction while also diving deeply into complex engineering problems, writing production-quality code, and driving solutions from concept through deployment and operation. 

This role is an opportunity to shape security capabilities that operate at significant scale across Salesforce infrastructure and to influence how security is embedded throughout the engineering lifecycle. 

Responsibilities

- Act as a technical leader and subject matter expert for infrastructure security and security guardrails, providing architectural direction across teams. 
 - Design and build scalable shift-left security capabilities that identify security risks in source code, Infrastructure as Code, containerized workloads, and deployment configurations before they reach production. 
 - Architect and build shift-left security controls that identify security risks early while providing developers with actionable findings and straightforward remediation paths. 
 - Design scalable policy-as-code and security enforcement frameworks for consistent security controls across multiple gates and environments. 
 - Drive risk-based security engineering by identifying exploitable, high-impact, and meaningful security risks rather than treating all scanner findings equally. 
 - Design mechanisms for security finding correlation, prioritization, deduplication, and enforcement when signals originate from multiple security systems. 
 - Lead architecture and implementation of Kubernetes admission control and workload security capabilities. 
 - Define technical strategies for reliability, scalability, performance, observability, fault tolerance, and operational readiness of security services. 
 - Establish and evolve SLIs, SLOs, telemetry, rollout strategies, and operational practices for critical security services. 
 - Own technical outcomes across the complete lifecycle - requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, production readiness, rollout, and ongoing operations. 
 - Continuously identify opportunities to improve security coverage, automation, detection quality, enforcement, and developer experience. 
 - Establish engineering standards and best practices for reliability, scalability, observability, testing, and operational readiness of security services. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and raise the technical bar across the organization. 
 - Influence technical strategy and roadmap decisions across teams and drive initiatives from concept through production. 
 - Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow by pushing the boundaries of AI development tools to deliver secure, optimized, and high-quality code. 
 - Design and orchestrate complex systems where AI agents integrate seamlessly into human workflows, driving efficiency and innovation at scale. 
 - Contribute to building and maintaining the shared system context, an explicit repository of system designs, constraints, and standards that enables AI to operate accurately and reliably. 
 - Critically evaluate code (human or AI-generated) for correctness, quality, security, and performance. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field involving software/systems engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 15+ years of software engineering, systems engineering, security engineering with significant experience designing and delivering large-scale production systems. 
 - Strong programming experience in one or more languages such as Go, Java, or Python, with the ability to design, implement, debug, and review production-quality systems. 
 - Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure and cloud security, including experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containers, and cloud-native infrastructure. 
 - Strong understanding of CI/CD architecture and DevSecOps, including deployment pipelines, security gates, policy enforcement, and automation. 
 - Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code, such as Terraform, Helm, CloudFormation, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Experience designing distributed, highly scalable, reliable, and secure systems. 
 - Strong understanding of security engineering concepts including vulnerability management, configuration security, policy enforcement, workload security, identity/access controls, and risk assessment. 
 - Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous security problems, identify the core technical challenge, and drive an architecture and implementation to completion. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex architectures and trade-offs to senior technical and business audiences. 
 - Preferred Qualifications
 - Deep experience in cloud-native security, DevSecOps, infrastructure security, or application security. 
 - Experience building security platforms/services or guardrails that operate at large enterprise scale. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes Admission Controllers, admission policies, OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno, or similar policy enforcement technologies. 
 - Experience with policy-as-code and security-as-code frameworks. 
 - Experience with IaC security and tools such as Checkov, OPA, Terraform security scanning, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of container and workload security, including Seccomp, Linux security mechanisms, container isolation, and runtime security. 
 - Experience building systems that correlate security signals from multiple sources and prioritize findings based on risk, exploitability, exposure, and business impact. 
 - Experience with vulnerability management, cloud security posture management, container security, or automated security remediation. 
 - Experience designing developer-facing security products with a strong focus on actionable findings, low friction remediation, and developer experience. 
 - Experience designing security controls across the complete lifecycle: source → IaC → CI/CD → deployment → admission → runtime. 
 - Strong understanding of cloud networking, identity, workload architecture, and distributed systems. 
 - Experience driving technical strategy across multiple engineering organizations. 
 - Demonstrated ability to identify new security opportunities and turn them into scalable engineering solutions. 
 - Experience mentoring senior engineers and serving as a technical leader for complex, multi-team initiatives. 
 - A demonstrated, genuine AI-first approach to engineering - using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty. 
 - Experience using AI tools (e. g. , Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc. ) in development workflows. 
 - Advanced prompt engineering skills and the ability to write precise, structured prompts and cultivate the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production-ready

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will be expected to: 

- Raise the technical bar for infrastructure and developer security engineering. 
 - Build security controls that are effective, scalable, reliable, and developer-friendly. 
 - Move security closer to the point where risks are introduced through strong shift-left and automated enforcement. 
 - Improve the ability to distinguish noise from meaningful and exploitable risk. 
 - Establish consistent security coverage and enforcement across the software delivery lifecycle. 
 - Drive complex initiatives from architecture and design through implementation, production deployment, and operational maturity. 
 - Identify gaps in the current security landscape and proactively develop innovative solutions to address them.

data.title: Lead Software Engineer
data.description:
Hands-on Senior Backend Engineer to lead a pod of 4-5 engineers building high-throughput, stateful backend systems. In this role, you will bridge the gap between high-level architectural blueprints and tactical software execution. 

Dedicated system architects will provide the macro architecture and domain designs; your job is to translate those blueprints into concrete Low-Level Designs (LLDs), data schemas, and clean API contracts, while writing production code alongside your team. You will run daily technical unblocking, review pull requests with high standards, and maintain the pod's delivery cadence. 

Key Responsibilities

Hands-on Feature Engineering (60%): Write clean, production-grade asynchronous backend code, build stateful workflow engines, and integrate third-party APIs, data stores, and event brokers. 

Low-Level Design & Task Scaffolding (20%): Take high-level architectural diagrams and break them down into modular interface designs, schema validations and well-scoped technical tickets for 4-5 engineers. 

Technical Mentorship & Unblocking (20%): Run PR reviews, pair-program through complex race conditions and deadlocks, establish testing/mocking standards, and maintain CI/CD pipelines.

data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world's most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

Whether you're designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger - technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we'll advance your career. 

Robotics Lead Validation Engineer

About The Role

Join AMD's PAVS team as a Robotics Developer experience Usecases Validation Engineer where you will Validate and Execute diverse Robotics platforms, variants and customer usecases for advanced robotics systems across software, hardware, and integrated platforms. Your work will ensure safety, reliability, and performance through rigorous testing in simulation, Gazebo, Isaac sim, SIL/HIL environments, and real-world deployments. 

Key Responsibilities

- Validation Strategy & Usecases : Define Usecases and execute validation plans for robotics software stacks (perception, planning, control) and hardware subsystems. 
 - Automation & Frameworks: Develop automated test suites for ROS2 nodes, navigation stack (Nav2), and fleet APIs using Python/C++, pytest, gtest/gmock. 
 - Simulation & Scenario Testing: Build simulation environments (Gazebo/Ignition, Isaac Sim) for warehouse layouts; author scenarios for obstacle avoidance, dynamic traffic, and multi-robot coordination. 
 - SIL/HIL Validation: Set up Software-in-the-Loop and Hardware-in-the-Loop rigs for AMR controllers, LiDAR emulators, and safety sensors; automate provisioning and logging. 
 - Sensor QA: Validate LiDAR, depth cameras, IMU, wheel encoders, and odometry accuracy under varying conditions. 
 - Navigation & Fleet QA: Test SLAM, localization robustness, path planning, and fleet orchestration (traffic management, task allocation, VDA5050 compliance). 
 - Safety & Compliance: Execute safety protocols for AMRs (emergency stop, zone monitoring, speed limits) aligned with ISO 3691-4, ISO 13849, ANSI/RIA R15. 06. 
 - Performance & Reliability: Measure latency, throughput, and stability under high-load scenarios; validate battery management and docking behaviors. 
 - CI/CD Integration: Embed automated tests into pipelines for continuous validation; monitor KPIs like defect escape rate and scenario coverage. 
 - Leadership: Act as a strong individual contributor and mentor for robotics validation teams; collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure customer experience is prioritized. 

Required Qualifications

- 6-12 years in QA/Validation, with 7+ years in robotics or AMR systems. 
 - Strong Python for automation and C++ for ROS2 integration. 
 - Hands-on experience with ROS2, Nav2 stack, colcon, and simulation tools (Gazebo/Ignition, Isaac Sim). 
 - Expertise in LiDAR, depth cameras, IMU, odometry, and sensor calibration. 
 - Familiarity with fleet management systems, traffic control, and VDA5050 protocol. 
 - CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Jenkins; Docker-based test environments. 
 - Knowledge of functional safety standards for mobile robots (ISO 3691-4, ISO 13849). 

Preferred Skills

- Multi-robot coordination, dynamic obstacle handling, and SLAM algorithms. 
 - Robotics AMR safety PLCs, zone scanners, and emergency stop circuits. 
 - Warehouse automation workflows, WMS integration, and OPC-UA. 
 - Performance benchmarking, reliability testing, and telemetry dashboards. 

Success Metrics

- Automated coverage of navigation and fleet scenarios. 
 - Reduction in field defect escape rate. 
 - Stability and reliability under multi-robot deployments. 
 - Compliance with safety standards and successful audits.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Electronics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or a related field.

data.title: Build and Integration (B&I) Staff Engineer - Customer Engineering Team
data.description:
Company

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Applications Engineering

General Summary

JOB OVERVIEW

This position is part of the Qualcomm Customer Engineering Group, which collaborates closely with automotive partners and customers - from concept through commercialization - across Qualcomm's broad Snapdragon Automotive platform portfolio. The team supports all aspects of embedded software including hardware and software architecture, feature bring-up, platform integration, software customization, system validation, and complex debugging efforts that are critical to product launch. 

This is a Staff-level Software Applications Engineering position focused on Build & Integration (B&I) and Release Engineering for Qualcomm Snapdragon Automotive platforms. The primary mission of this role is to own, drive, and continuously improve build systems, integration pipelines, and release processes that enable automotive software delivery across IVI, ADAS, and FLEX segments for global automotive customers. The role spans multiple OS environments including Linux, Android, QNX (HQX), and HGY (Gunyah Hypervisor) with multi-OS virtualized stacks. 

The successful candidate will serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Build & Integration engineering within the BDC CE team, driving cross-functional collaboration between Customer Engineering, Dev/Platform SW teams, and global automotive OEM/Tier-1 partners. As a Staff Engineer, this individual will provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, define build and release methodologies, and contribute to the continuous improvement of automation frameworks and engineering productivity tooling. 

Key Responsibilities

Build, Integration & Release Management

- Own and manage end-to-end build, integration, and release activities for complex Snapdragon Automotive software products spanning multiple OS platforms. 
 - Design, implement, and maintain scalable and reliable build infrastructures and CI/CD pipelines tailored for embedded and HLOS automotive software stacks. 
 - Drive continuous improvement of build systems, toolchains, automation frameworks, and release processes across program milestones. 
 - Establish release governance, versioning, branching, tagging, and artifact management strategies for multi-OS automotive software deliveries. 
 - Monitor build health, integration quality, and release readiness across multiple product streams and chipset generations. 
 - Collaborate with development, quality engineering, and platform teams to ensure successful integration and deployment. 
 - Identify bottlenecks and implement measures to improve build performance, reliability, and delivery efficiency. 
 - Define and maintain build and release KPIs, dashboards, and operational metrics to track program health. 
 - Ensure compliance with software development standards, security policies, and release governance processes. 
 - Lead investigations and root-cause analysis for build failures, integration issues, and release blockers. 

Triage & Engineering Support

- Serve as the primary escalation point for build and integration-related issues across the Customer Engineering (CE) team. 
 - Provide timely triage, troubleshooting, and resolution support for development, integration, and release issues. 
 - Analyze build logs, compiler errors, dependency conflicts, toolchain issues, and deployment failures. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for recurring engineering issues; own Change Requests (CRs) end-to-end from triage through patch validation. 
 - Partner with product, platform, and infrastructure teams to resolve cross-functional technical challenges. 
 - Develop self-service tools, documentation, and best practices to improve engineering productivity across the BDC CE team. 
 - Track and manage technical debt associated with build environments, toolchains, and integration workflows. 

Customer Engagement & Technical Support

- Serve as a key technical interface for build and integration queries from automotive OEM and Tier-1 customers across regions. 
 - Support Automotive RFI (AutoRFI) assessments for B&I-related NRE scoping, communicating technical complexity and resource requirements. 
 - Engage with customers during bring-up, pre-CS, and post-CS phases to proactively identify and mitigate build and integration risks. 
 - Provide on-site customer support as required during critical program milestones. 
 - Collaborate with NA, EU, and India CE teams to ensure global follow-the-sun build and integration support. 

Automation, Tools & Engineering Productivity

- Drive development and validation of build and release automation frameworks for multi-OS automotive software platforms. 
 - Design and maintain automated build health monitors, integration quality dashboards, and triage tooling to reduce mean time to resolution. 
 - Partner with platform and APT (Automated Platform Test) teams to define and integrate build qualification checks across CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Create and maintain build guides, integration runbooks, and reusable diagnostic artifacts for build and release issues across platforms. 
 - Track and analyze build and integration trends across program stages (Bringup → ES → L0-L4 → FC → CS) and communicate risk to program and customer teams. 
 - Contribute to secure software supply chain and DevSecOps practices within the automotive software delivery pipeline. 

Technical Leadership & Mentorship

- Serve as the B&I SME for the BDC CE team, providing architectural guidance on build system design, integration strategy, and release engineering. 
 - Lead cross-functional B&I reviews with Dev, QA, DevOps, and CE teams; drive root-cause analysis delivery to enable process improvements. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on build system concepts, CI/CD best practices, scripting, and customer engagement. 
 - Influence feature design and architecture decisions to proactively prevent build and integration failures in future Snapdragon Automotive SPs. 
 - Scale technical knowledge through reusable documentation, training materials, and knowledge-base contributions. 

Minimum Qualifications

Education & Experience

- One of the following: 
 - B. E. / B. Tech in Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, or related field with 8+ years of Software Applications Engineering, Embedded Systems, or related experience. 
 - M. Tech / M. S. in relevant field with 6+ years of experience. 
 - Ph. D. in relevant field with 4+ years of experience. 

Required Technical Skills

- 5+ years of hands-on experience in build, integration, and release engineering for large-scale software products. 
 - Strong expertise in CI/CD pipeline design, implementation, and optimization. 
 - Hands-on experience with build automation systems (Make, CMake, Bazel, Ninja, Gradle, or similar). 
 - Proficiency in scripting languages: Python, Shell/Bash for build and automation workflows. 
 - Strong expertise in source control management and branching strategies (GitFlow, Trunk-Based Development). 
 - Experience with artifact repository management and release artifact governance. 
 - Experience with Linux/Unix build environments and containerized build infrastructure. 
 - 3+ years of customer-facing or cross-functional technical support experience. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to document RCAs and communicate technical findings to cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Staff-level experience owning build and integration engineering for production automotive programs (IVI / ADAS / FLEX) from bringup through SOP. 
 - Experience with multi-OS build environments spanning Linux, Android, QNX (HQX), and HGY (Gunyah Hypervisor). 
 - Familiarity with Qualcomm Snapdragon Automotive chipsets across Gen3 / Gen4 / Gen4. 5 / Gen5 software delivery pipelines. 
 - Experience with DevSecOps practices and secure software supply chain management. 
 - Knowledge of containerization (Docker) and cloud-native build pipelines for embedded software. 
 - Familiarity with ASPICE process compliance, ASIL functional safety considerations, and automotive program delivery cycles. 
 - Experience with AutoRFI processes, NRE scoping, and CDEV (Chipset Development) activities within CE programs. 
 - Knowledge of build and release KPI frameworks, dashboards, and workload-based productivity trend analysis. 
 - Proven experience collaborating with global automotive OEM and Tier-1 customers on build, integration, and release escalations. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Software Applications Engineering, Software Development experience, or related work experience. 

OR

Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Software Applications Engineering, Software Development experience, or related work experience. 

OR

PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Applications Engineering, Software Development experience, or related work experience.

data.title: Software Engineer, Senior B Performance Engineering
data.description:
Senior Software Performance Engineer

6+ Years Experience | PAX India

About The Role

Help scale the performance engineering discipline across Blackbaud - building the tooling, practices, and expertise that let dev and ops teams do their own performance analysis, while staying hands-on enough to solve the hardest problems yourself and mentor others. 

Our core stack is Kubernetes/Azure-based microservices, though you'll occasionally support older, more monolithic systems too - the core skills (profiling, load testing, root-cause analysis) transfer directly. 

This is a hands-on coding role: most of your time goes to building and maintaining our load/synthetic test tooling (including AI-assisted testing) and integrating it into our SDLC. The rest is split between observability tooling and ad hoc performance analysis, with strong ownership of latency, throughput, and resource efficiency. 

What You'll Do

Load & Synthetic Test Tooling

- Build and maintain our synthetic/load-testing framework - test development (Playwright/Gatling), execution, and reporting. 
 - Apply AI capabilities to improve test development - AI-assisted authoring, scenario generation, result analysis. 
 - Integrate performance and synthetic tests into CI/CD pipelines so checks run continuously, not just ad hoc. 

Observability & Ad Hoc Performance Analysis

- Improve observability tooling (Splunk, Grafana, Honeycomb, App Insights, AppDynamics, New Relic): dashboards, alerting, SLIs/SLOs, instrumentation. 
 - Run load, stress, and soak tests to catch bottlenecks before production; profile CPU, memory, GC, I/O, and network in C#/. NET and/or Java services. 
 - Troubleshoot production performance issues (latency regressions, resource exhaustion, throttling) and tune resource usage in Kubernetes/AKS (requests/limits, autoscaling, kubectl diagnostics). 

Ongoing

- Build self-serve performance capabilities (dashboards, guardrails, docs) so teams can diagnose issues without escalating. 
 - Design and maintain C#/. NET and/or Java microservices with a focus on performance and scalability. 
 - Collaborate via Agile/GitHub workflows and mentor junior engineers on profiling and troubleshooting. 

What You'll Bring

- 6+ years of software engineering experience with meaningful exposure to performance, scalability, or reliability engineering. 
 - Strong C#/. NET and/or Java skills, plus strong Azure experience. 
 - Solid grasp of how compute resources (CPU, memory, I/O, network) drive performance/scalability, including tuning in containerized environments. 
 - Hands-on experience with a load-testing tool (k6, JMeter, Locust, Gatling) and a browser-automation tool for synthetic/end-to-end testing (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright). 
 - Experience with profiling tools (dotnet-trace, PerfView, App Insights profiler) and observability/APM tooling (Splunk, Grafana, Honeycomb, AppDynamics, New Relic). 
 - Some experience applying AI/LLM tools to dev workflows (AI-assisted coding, test generation, analysis). 
 - Experience integrating tooling/tests into CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) and troubleshooting production performance issues. 
 - Working knowledge of Linux fundamentals and networking basics (DNS, TLS, routing) as they relate to performance. 
 - Experience with Agile/GitHub, strong documentation and communication skills, and comfort working across time zones. 

You'll Thrive in This Role If You

- Are self-motivated and comfortable driving your own investigations without step-by-step direction. 
 - Have systemic curiosity - you want to understand how a system behaves end-to-end, and think across layers from application code down through infrastructure and database. 
 - Question assumptions and keep digging until you find the actual root cause, not just the first plausible explanation. 

Nice to Have

- Gatling or Playwright experience specifically. 
 - AKS experience (cluster ops, node pools, scaling) with a performance/capacity lens. 
 - Front-end development experience using Angular/TypeScript. 
 - Database-layer performance troubleshooting (query plans, indexing, stored procedure tuning). 
 - Familiarity with distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry), capacity planning and cost/performance trade-off analysis. 

Quick Summary

"Backend-heavy engineer who codes daily, hunts down and fixes performance bottlenecks, and operates production systems; strong in C#/. NET and/or Java, Azure, compute/resource performance fundamentals, load testing, and observability. "

Stay up to date on everything Blackbaud, follow us on Linkedin, X, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube

Blackbaud is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining an inclusive work environment. data.title: Engineering Manager - .NET & Azure
data.description:
Engineering Manager - . NET & Azure

Hands-on engineering leadership | Architecture | Client collaboration

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on engineering leader to help a capable team take a mature and growing product forward. The role involves working on interesting product and engineering challenges, combining technical leadership, engineering delivery, mentoring, architecture and close collaboration with product and client stakeholders, with room to influence technical direction and how the team works. 

This is not a traditional project-management role, nor a people-management role disconnected from engineering. You'll remain meaningfully involved in the engineering itself - moving comfortably between code, architecture, debugging, technical decisions and planning, while helping the team make sound decisions and deliver well. 

You'll be working on a product with a rapidly expanding customer base across the global AEC industry. 

Dwaravati is a software development studio with a small team of experienced engineers. We work closely with client stakeholders to shape and build products, and operate as a lean, cohesive and highly effective company with a flat hierarchy and an open, collaborative environment where experienced engineers have significant ownership and autonomy. 

At a glance

- Experience: Engineering Manager / Senior Engineering Manager / Development Manager / Technical Lead
 - Core technology: Microsoft . NET / C# / Azure
 - Engineering: Hands-on leadership across architecture, design, coding, debugging and technical delivery
 - Systems: Significant experience with mature, long-lived production software
 - Leadership: Experience leading and mentoring engineering teams
 - Collaboration: Strong experience working with product, business and client stakeholders

The role and your ownership

You will lead day-to-day engineering and delivery, combining technical leadership, hands-on engineering, mentoring and direct collaboration with product, QA, delivery and business stakeholders. Coding, design reviews and debugging will remain a meaningful part of the role. 

You will work closely with the founder during a gradual leadership transition, learning the product, domain and technical context that has accumulated over time. As you build that context, you will increasingly take ownership of engineering and delivery decisions and become the team's first point of contact for most engineering matters. 

The founder will remain involved in selected architectural, strategic and people matters, while providing historical context where useful. You will have significant autonomy in how the team and system evolve, with the support and context needed to make good decisions. 

This is a role for someone who enjoys ownership without unnecessary hierarchy - someone who still likes getting into technical detail, but also wants the scope to influence engineering direction, help others grow and make the team and product better over time. 

What you will do

Lead technical direction

- Guide architecture and implementation decisions across a mature, long-lived production codebase. 
 - Be a trusted technical sounding board for engineers, helping them work through design choices, difficult bugs, performance and reliability problems, and architectural questions. 
 - Stay hands-on through coding and prototyping, design and code reviews, technical investigation, debugging, system design and technical documentation. 
 - Help the team evolve the system pragmatically, balancing immediate needs with maintainability, performance, reliability and long-term technical health. 

Help the team deliver well

- Work with engineers on estimation, planning, technical task breakdown, sprint execution, bug triage and capacity. 
 - Help turn uncertainty and competing priorities into clear engineering decisions and practical delivery plans. 
 - Identify recurring problems and improve the underlying system or practices rather than repeatedly treating the symptoms. 
 - Improve engineering practices and processes where they make a meaningful difference to quality, delivery or team effectiveness. 

Work closely with product and client stakeholders

- Work directly with product, QA, client and business stakeholders to turn incomplete or evolving requirements into actionable plans. 
 - Explain technical options, constraints and uncertainty clearly, including implications for performance, scalability, reliability and cost. 
 - Disagree constructively when needed, while keeping discussions focused on the problem and the outcome. 

Mentor and support engineers

- Help engineers improve not only their code, but their engineering judgment and ability to make sound technical decisions. 
 - Provide technical guidance and mentoring suited to each engineer's experience and needs. 
 - Contribute to performance discussions, career development and the continued growth of the engineering team. 

Essential experience

This role could suit an Engineering Manager, Senior Engineering Manager, Development Manager, Technical Lead or similar engineering leader with genuine responsibility for both people and engineering outcomes. 

- Strong . NET engineering experience: Substantial experience designing, building and maintaining long-lived production applications using . NET and C#. You have the technical depth and interest to remain hands-on, and are comfortable reasoning about architecture, services and APIs, asynchronous and concurrent systems, persistence and data access, performance, diagnostics and observability. You understand how maintainability, deployment and runtime behaviour shape the evolution of a system over time. 
 - Practical Azure experience: Meaningful production experience with Azure and cloud-hosted applications. You should be comfortable reasoning about compute, messaging, databases and storage, caching, scaling, monitoring, reliability and deployment, including performance and cost. You do not need to know every Azure service. 
 - Engineering leadership: Meaningful experience leading and mentoring engineers, balancing technical and delivery priorities, and taking responsibility for team and engineering outcomes. You are comfortable working with Scrum or similar agile practices and adapting the process when circumstances call for it. You are comfortable giving difficult feedback, handling competing priorities and supporting engineers through their growth. 
 - Strong stakeholder communication: Substantial experience working directly with product, business or client stakeholders. You can explain complex technical situations clearly, navigate ambiguity, discuss trade-offs openly and disagree constructively when needed. 
 - Engineering judgment: You are comfortable working with imperfect information and making pragmatic decisions in complex, evolving systems. You care about long-term technical health without losing sight of the product and business outcomes the team needs to deliver. 

Helpful but not required

Any of the following would be useful, but is not essential: 

- High-volume or performance-sensitive applications
 - Experience with mature B2B products
 - Experience as an application or solution architect
 - Azure or Microsoft certifications
 - AEC domain experience

How we work

We value thoughtful engineering over unnecessary complexity, responsibility over hierarchy, and direct but respectful communication. 

We expect senior people to form opinions, test assumptions and change their minds when better information emerges. We encourage constructive disagreement, intellectual honesty and low-ego collaboration. 

We value sustainable processes that improve outcomes without unnecessary bureaucracy. People are trusted to take ownership, make decisions and raise problems early, while working together to find the best solution for the product, the team and our clients.

Role Overview

Looking for a Firmware Architect who can own and evolve complex firmware and embedded OS layer architecture for high-assurance hardware products. The person should be comfortable working at the boundary of firmware, embedded software, system architecture, product behavior, and real-world customer use cases. The role requires someone who can understand complex end applications, translate them into clean technical architecture, and guide the implementation toward a stable, auditable, and production-ready product. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own firmware and embedded OS-layer architecture for hardware-based products. 
 - Understand product use cases, deployment environments, customer workflows, and system-level requirements. 
 - Translate high-level product and application requirements into firmware architecture, design modules, interfaces, and execution flows. 
 - Comprehend the existing architecture, identify gaps, and evolve it without unnecessary redesign. 
 - Define clean software boundaries across boot, system initialization, runtime services, application layers, management interfaces, and update flows. 
 - Work closely with hardware, FPGA, product, application engineering, and validation teams. 
 - Build architecture that is maintainable, testable, scalable, and suitable for long product lifecycles. 
 - Create clear design documents, interface specifications, state machines, flow diagrams, and implementation guidance for the engineering team. 
 - Review firmware implementation for correctness, robustness, security posture, error handling, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Support structured external evaluation, technical evidence preparation, and product assurance activities. 
 - Mentor engineers and help them convert ambiguous requirements into practical implementation steps. 
 - Own technical decisions across architecture, trade-offs, debugging, and release readiness. 
 - 
Relevant Experience

- o Around 7+ years of experience in embedded firmware, embedded software, or system software development. 
 - o Strong experience in firmware architecture or embedded OS-layer design. 
 - o Good understanding of boot flows, memory management, task scheduling, inter-process or inter module communication, error handling, fault recovery, and system initialization
 - o Experience working with complex embedded systems where firmware interacts with hardware, application logic, and external interfaces. 
 - o Ability to read and understand existing codebases and architecture without needing everything to be explained from scratch. 
 - o Strong C/C++ programming background. 
 - o Ability to design abstractions, interfaces, and modular firmware components. 
 - o Experience with RTOS, embedded Linux, bare-metal systems, or custom embedded runtime environments. 
 - o Good debugging ability across software-hardware boundaries. 
 - o Strong documentation skills for architecture, design, and engineering handover. 
 - o Ability to work with incomplete information and still bring structure to the problem.

NET Core, Angular with Highcharts, SQL Server, Microsoft Azure, and Azure DevOps CI/CD, along with strong engineering practices around quality, security, and performance.

Key Responsibilities

 - Collaborate with Customer Support to troubleshoot customer-reported issues, perform root-cause analysis, and drive timely resolution through hotfixes and regular releases. 
 - Develop high-quality, maintainable, and scalable code that is peer-reviewed, unit/integration tested (as applicable), documented, and delivered in line with agreed engineering standards. 
 - Ensure solutions meet security and compliance requirements, applying industry-standard secure coding and cybersecurity practices. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD and DevOps practices (Azure DevOps pipelines), improving reliability of builds, deployments, and release readiness. 
 - Drive continuous improvement of engineering practices, performance, observability, and overall product quality; mentor junior engineers and support technical reviews. 

Essential Requirements

- 8+ years of software engineering experience. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in C#, . NET / ASP. NET Core, and enterprise cloud-based application development. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with modern front-end development, particularly Angular (TypeScript) and data-visualization libraries such as Highcharts. 
 - Working knowledge of Generative AI, LLMs, and AI application development. 
 - Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure and cloud-native architecture (microservices, containers, Kubernetes, messaging, observability). 
 - Strong software design fundamentals, including OOP, SOLID principles, design patterns, and reusable framework/component design. 
 - Strong engineering quality and security mindset, including automated testing, secure coding, authentication/authorization, dependency risk management, and vulnerability remediation. 
 - Strong technical leadership skills, including mentoring engineers, conducting design/code reviews, defining engineering standards, and collaborating across Development, DevOps, Security, Product, and R&D teams. 
 - Strong awareness of cybersecurity principles and secure SDLC practices. 
 - Ability to translate business/product requirements into technical designs, executable backlogs, dependencies, estimates, and realistic delivery plans. 

Desired Skills And Competencies

- Good understanding of Azure DevOps, CI/CD practices, Infrastructure-as-Code, and Azure automation using PowerShell / Azure CLI. 
 - Strong operational awareness, including observability, logging, monitoring, troubleshooting, performance diagnostics, and production support. 
 - Experience with technical discovery, prototypes/POCs, architecture documentation, and communicating technical decisions across teams. 
 - Experience using AI to improve developer productivity, automated testing, code quality, and engineering workflows. 
 - Familiarity with emerging AI development frameworks and tools. 
 - Good knowledge of SQL Server, database design, data access patterns, and performance considerations. 

R&D at AVEVA

Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name. 

Our track record of innovation is no fluke - it's the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.

Find out more: aveva. com/en/about/careers/r-and-d-careers/

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it's powered by the anime content we all love.

About The Role

We are hiring a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our India Operations and play a crucial role in our mission to establish a world-class data engineering team within the Center for Data and Insights (CDI). In this role, you'll play a key part in building a cutting-edge, real-time data platform, designed to deliver insights at scale and power data-driven decision-making across our organization. Responsibilities will include collaborating with the data team and working on both backend microservices & frontend interfaces, crafting solutions that ensure data is processed, analyzed, and visualized in real time. 

The ideal candidate will bring strong full-stack engineering expertise across modern frontend and backend technologies, with hands-on experience building scalable, secure, and cloud-native applications. You will leverage Java, Spring Boot, React, Next. js, TypeScript, Kubernetes, and modern DevOps practices to deliver high-quality solutions that enable data-driven decision making for our business partners. This role requires a proactive, self-driven engineer who thrives in a collaborative environment, takes ownership from design through production, and balances technical excellence with business impact. By joining the CDI team, you will play a key role in shaping the data product application, building intuitive user experiences, scalable APIs, and robust platform capabilities that empower teams worldwide with timely, actionable insights. If you are passionate about solving complex problems, delivering exceptional user experiences, and driving continuous improvement across the full technology stack, we'd love to hear from you. 

Core Areas of Responsibility

- Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end features across the product, spanning React/Next. js frontend applications and Java Spring Boot backend services. 
 - Build secure, scalable REST APIs using OpenAPI-first design principles and implement robust authentication and authorization using Okta OIDC, OAuth2, and JWT-based security. 
 - Develop intuitive, accessible, and localized user experiences, including dashboards, analytics, data tables, and visualizations, ensuring WCAG-compliant implementations. 
 - Collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, UX designers, and stakeholders to deliver high-impact features and platform enhancements. 
 - Manage integrations with Databricks and other data platforms, optimizing API performance, database connectivity, and concurrent processing for large-scale analytics workloads.

 - Support cloud-native deployments using Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions, and GitOps practices, while maintaining observability through Datadog and production monitoring tools. 
 - Drive engineering excellence through code reviews, architectural discussions, performance optimization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

We get excited about candidates, like you, because. . . 

- 8+ years of experience building and delivering modern full-stack applications using Java and React-based technologies. 
 - Strong expertise in Java 21, Spring Boot, REST API design, and secure application development using OAuth2, OIDC, and JWT authentication. 
 - Hands-on experience with React, Next. js, TypeScript, and modern frontend frameworks, including state management, API integration, and component-driven development. 
 - Solid understanding of SQL-based data platforms and API-driven integrations, with experience optimizing application performance and scalability. 
 - Experience working with containerized and cloud-native environments, including Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms such as GCP and/or AWS. 
 - Proven ability to write high-quality, maintainable code supported by automated testing frameworks and engineering best practices. 
 - Strong collaboration, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

To lead and manage the production function for wire and cable harness manufacturing operations, ensuring products meet ISO and customer quality standards, driving continuous improvement, line balancing, lean manufacturing, Low cost automation, fixture concept, Poke-yoke, Kaizen, localization initiatives, and effective troubleshooting of process and product quality issues across all manufacturing stages.

Leadership & Production System

- Lead and manage the production function and teams across wire harness manufacturing lines.

Wire Harness Production

 - Drive localization of wire harness components, connectors, and raw materials, ensuring supplier qualification, PPAP approval, and quality validation of localized parts. 
 - Conduct root cause analysis (5-Why, Fishbone, 8D) for in-house rejections, customer complaints, and field returns, and implement effective countermeasures.

Supplier & Customer Quality

- Manage supplier quality assessments, QMS audits, and supplier rating for wire harness components and raw materials.

 - Address customer complaints and quality escalations, ensuring root cause identification, corrective action, and PPM reduction. 
 - Maintain strong customer relationships to ensure sustained quality satisfaction and reduced return PPM. 

Documentation, Reporting & Team Development

- Ensure accurate and updated quality documentation as per ISO requirements (control plans, PFMEA, work instructions, inspection standards). 
 - Prepare and present production performance reports, KPIs, and improvement trends to senior management. 
 - Train, mentor, and develop the production team including engineers and line inspectors on quality procedures, troubleshooting techniques, and best practices. 

Key Skills & Competencies

- Strong technical knowledge of Wire Harness manufacturing processes (crimping, splicing, molding, testing). 
 - Hands-on experience in Line Balancing and manpower/process optimization on assembly lines. 
 - Proven skills in Troubleshooting of process, product, and machine-related quality issues. 
 - Experience driving Localization of components and supplier development for import substitution. 
 - Sound knowledge of ISO, FMEA, SPC, MSA, 7 QC Tools, 8D Problem Solving. 
 - Strong leadership, team management, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
 - Proficiency in MS Office, SAP, ERP systems, and quality reporting tools. 

Qualification & Experience

- Diploma / Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Electronics Engineering. 
 - 8-10 years of relevant experience in automotive component manufacturing, with significant exposure to wire harness or electrical/electronic parts quality. 
 - Prior experience in automotive sector Tier-1 organization is mandatory.

Position: Assoc Director/Director - Quality (Medical Coding) Coimbatore

Department: Medical Coding - Quality & Compliance

Profile Description

This role is responsible for defining and driving the quality strategy across one or more medical coding portfolios while ensuring coding accuracy, regulatory compliance, client satisfaction, and continuous process improvement. The Director - Quality will lead enterprise quality initiatives, strengthen audit governance, partner with Operations and Training teams, and leverage analytics to improve coding quality, reduce denials, and enhance client outcomes. The role is also responsible for ensuring compliance with industry standards, payer guidelines, and organizational quality frameworks. 

Key Responsibilities

Process

- Own the Quality Management System (QMS) across assigned coding portfolios and ensure consistent execution of quality processes. 
 - Establish and maintain coding quality standards aligned with ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS, payer policies, CMS guidelines, NCCI edits, and specialty-specific coding requirements. 
 - Drive achievement of internal and client-defined quality SLAs across all accounts. 
 - Develop audit methodologies including concurrent, retrospective, prospective, focused, and validation audits. 
 - Ensure calibration across Quality, Operations, Training, and Client teams through standardized audit guidelines. 
 - Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for quality defects and implement effective corrective and preventive actions (CAPA). 
 - Monitor coding trends, denial trends, payer edits, and regulatory updates to proactively mitigate quality risks. 
 - Drive continuous process improvement initiatives through Lean, Six Sigma, and automation opportunities. 
 - Standardize quality scorecards, audit tools, and governance dashboards across portfolios. 
 - Ensure readiness for client audits, internal audits, compliance reviews, and external accreditation requirements. 
 - Establish governance around coding policy changes and ensure timely implementation across operations. People

- Build and lead a high-performing Quality organization across multiple coding specialties. 
 - Coach and mentor Quality Managers and Leads to improve audit effectiveness and leadership capabilities. 
 - Develop competency frameworks for auditors and quality professionals. 
 - Partner with Operations and Learning teams to identify knowledge gaps and implement targeted training interventions. 
 - Drive certification programs (AAPC/AHIMA), continuing education, and ongoing competency assessments. 
 - Promote a culture of quality ownership across Operations rather than quality inspection. 
 - Drive employee engagement, succession planning, talent retention, and career development within the Quality function. 
 - Conduct regular calibration sessions to ensure inter-auditor reliability and consistency. 
 - Foster innovation by encouraging adoption of AI-assisted quality monitoring and analytics. Client

- Serve as the Quality leader during client governance meetings including Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs), Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs), and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs). 
 - Present quality performance, audit findings, denial trends, and improvement initiatives to clients. 
 - Build trusted client relationships through proactive communication and consultative quality leadership. 
 - Partner with client coding compliance teams to resolve coding interpretation differences. 
 - Support client onboarding, transitions, and implementation activities by establishing quality governance. 
 - Lead provider education initiatives arising from coding audit findings when required. 
 - Ensure client quality KPIs, contractual obligations, and compliance expectations are consistently achieved. Financial

- Improve client ROI by reducing coding defects, rework, denials, and revenue leakage. 
 - Partner with Operations leadership to improve first-pass quality and operational efficiency. 
 - Support account profitability by minimizing quality-related cost of poor quality (COPQ). 
 - Measure and report financial impact of quality improvement initiatives. 
 - Participate in business reviews and support strategic growth opportunities through quality excellence. 
 - Drive automation initiatives that improve audit efficiency and reduce manual effort. 

Governance & Compliance

- Ensure compliance with HIPAA, CMS regulations, payer-specific guidelines, OIG recommendations, and organizational policies. 
 - Monitor coding compliance risks and implement mitigation strategies. 
 - Lead internal compliance audits and support external regulatory audits. 
 - Maintain documentation supporting quality governance and audit readiness. 
 - Ensure timely dissemination and implementation of coding guideline updates. Analytics & Continuous Improvement

- Develop executive dashboards highlighting quality trends, DPU, accuracy, denials, auditor agreement, productivity, and compliance metrics. 
 - Perform advanced trend analysis using audit data to identify systemic process improvements. 
 - Utilize statistical quality control techniques and predictive analytics to improve coding performance. 
 - Lead enterprise quality transformation initiatives leveraging AI and automation. 
 - Benchmark organizational performance against industry standards and best practices. Qualifications

- Graduate in any discipline is mandatory. 
 - BPT, MPT, B. Sc Nursing, M. Sc Nursing, B. Pharm, M. Pharm, BOT, or Life Sciences preferred. 
 - AHIMA or AAPC certification (CPC, CCS, CCS-P, CIC, CRC or equivalent) is mandatory. 
 - Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt preferred. 
 - MBA or Master's degree in Healthcare Administration or Quality Management will be an added advantage. 
 - MBBS, BDS, BAMS, BHMS, or other healthcare professional qualifications would be an added advantage. Role Prerequisites

- 12+ years of experience in Medical Coding with significant leadership experience in Coding Quality and Compliance. 
 - Minimum 5 years of managing enterprise quality programs across multiple specialties and clients. 
 - Extensive experience in coding audits, coding compliance, provider education, and denial prevention. 
 - Strong understanding of US healthcare regulations, payer policies, CMS guidelines, and coding compliance. 
 - Experience in leading quality transformation initiatives across large teams (300+ FTE preferred). 
 - Demonstrated experience working with executive leadership and external clients. 
 - Experience in AI-enabled quality assurance, analytics, or automation initiatives is preferred. Functional Competencies

- Expert knowledge of ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS, CMS Guidelines, and NCCI edits. 
 - Expertise across multiple coding specialties. 
 - Advanced coding audit methodology and compliance knowledge. 
 - Strong understanding of revenue cycle management and denial prevention. 
 - Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective & Preventive Action (CAPA). 
 - Statistical quality analysis and performance analytics. 
 - Governance reporting and executive dashboard preparation. 
 - Lean Six Sigma process improvement methodologies.

 - Decision Making
 - Continuous Improvement Mindset
 - Communication and Executive Presence
 - Change Leadership
 - Innovation

data.title: Supplier Quality Engineer - Mechanical
data.description:
Role: Supplier Quality Engineer - Mechanical

Department: New Product Development Location: Bengaluru, India Experience: 5-10 Years

Your Team: 

You'll be working with New Product Development - a group that runs on coffee and an infectious passion for building products that have never been built before. Our Flexible Energy Stack consists of the e^pack (battery pack) and e^pump (charging station), which unlock 15-minute rapid charging. 

Our philosophy: 

Break. Believe. Build. 

Break stuff, break assumptions, break the thumb rule. 

Believe in the team, the process, and through failures. 

Build fast, build passionately, build to simplify. 

Own it like you mean it. 

What you'll own: 

The Supplier Quality Engineer - Mechanical is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and process capability of mechanical components and assemblies supplied to the organization. The role will drive supplier quality from new product development through mass production, including PPAP, supplier audits, process validation, problem solving, supplier development, and continuous improvement. 

The role requires strong technical understanding of mechanical engineering, manufacturing processes, engineering drawings, GD&T, dimensional inspection, and supplier quality management. The engineer will work closely with Design, VCD, Manufacturing, IQC, and suppliers to prevent quality issues and establish robust supplier processes. 

What you'll do: 

Supplier Quality Management

- Own quality performance of assigned mechanical suppliers. 
 - Monitor supplier KPIs including PPM, rejection rate, line rejection, customer complaints, 8D closure, and repeat issues. Conduct regular supplier performance reviews and drive improvement plans for poor- performing suppliers. 
 - Lead supplier containment and corrective action for critical quality issues. 
 - Establish and maintain supplier quality improvement roadmaps. 
 - Support supplier selection, evaluation, development, and qualification. 
 - Develop suppliers to achieve consistent quality, process capability, and delivery performance

Mechanical Product & Process Quality

- Provide technical quality expertise for mechanical components, parts, and assemblies
 - Review engineering drawings, specifications, BOMs, GD&T requirements, material specifications, and engineering changes from a quality perspective. 
 - Ensure critical-to-quality and special characteristics are identified and effectively controlled. 
 - Assess and control manufacturing processes such as fabrication, welding, casting, forging, machining, sheet metal, heat treatment, surface treatment, and assembly. 
 - Evaluate process risks and establish appropriate process controls, inspection methods, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Drive process capability and quality improvement for critical characteristics. 
 - Support dimensional inspection and validation using appropriate measuring equipment and inspection methods

PPAP

- Support and drive supplier PPAP activities from new product development through SOP and mass production. 
 - Review and approve supplier PPAP deliverables. 
 - Review and challenge Process Flow, PFMEA, Control Plan, Work Instructions, MSA/GR&R, SPC, capability studies, inspection standards, and PPAP documentation. 
 - Ensure special characteristics and critical-to-quality characteristics are identified and adequately controlled. 
 - Conduct supplier Run-at-Rate and production readiness assessments. 
 - Review and approve PPAP submissions for new and modified mechanical components

Supplier Process Audit & Development

- Conduct supplier process audits based on IATF 16949, VDA 6. 3, customer-specific requirements, and internal standards
 - Conduct manufacturing process audits covering various mechanical manufacturing processes. 
 - Assess process robustness, process controls, traceability, inspection systems, and operator practices. 
 - Identify process risks and gaps through manufacturing process audits. 
 - Develop suppliers through structured improvement plans, technical training, and process improvement. 
 - Verify implementation and effectiveness of corrective actions through follow-up audits. 
 - Drive process capability improvement for critical characteristics

Problem Solving & Failure Analysis

- Lead technical investigation and root-cause analysis of mechanical quality issues. 
 - Drive effective containment, 8D, 5-Why, Fishbone, RCA, corrective and preventive actions with suppliers. 
 - Analyze issues related to dimensional variation, machining defects, casting defects, welding defects, fabrication defects, material issues, surface treatment, assembly, and functional performance. 
 - Use appropriate problem-solving and analytical techniques to identify root causes. Coordinate with suppliers and cross-functional teams to validate root cause and corrective actions. 
 - Ensure corrective actions are effective and prevent recurrence. Identify systemic improvement opportunities from recurring supplier quality issues

Incoming Quality & Manufacturing Support

- Work closely with IQC and Manufacturing Quality to establish appropriate incoming inspection requirements. 
 - Define critical inspection parameters, sampling requirements, inspection methods, and acceptance criteria based on supplier process capability and risk. 
 - Support production teams in resolving supplier-related quality issues. 
 - Establish defect standards and limit samples where required. 
 - Drive reduction of supplier-related line stoppages, production rejections, and quality escapes

Change & Sustenance Quality

- Review supplier ECR/ECN/PCN changes for potential quality risks. 
 - Ensure changes related to material, process, tooling, equipment, manufacturing location, or sub-suppliers are appropriately evaluated and validated. 
 - Ensure changes are validated and approved before implementation. 
 - Monitor quality performance after supplier/process/material changes. 
 - Drive continuous improvement projects for chronic supplier quality issues. 
 - Maintain lessons learned and standardization across suppliers

What you'll bring: 

- Education qualification
 - B. E. /B. Tech/Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or related discipline
 - 5-10 years of experience in Supplier Quality / Quality Engineering, preferably in automotive, EV, or similar manufacturing industries
 - Strong hands-on experience in mechanical component manufacturing and supplier quality
 - Good knowledge of multiple manufacturing processes such as fabrication, welding, casting, forging, machining, sheet metal, heat treatment, surface treatment, and assembly
 - Good understanding of engineering drawings, GD&T, dimensional inspection, and measurement systems
 - Experience in supplier quality management, supplier audits, APQP, PPAP, and supplier development
 - Hands-on experience with PFMEA, Control Plan, MSA, SPC, Process Capability, 8D, RCA, and problem-solving tools

Preferred Experience (Good to Have): 

- Experience with VDA 6. 3 / VDA 6. 5
 - IATF 16949 Internal Auditor / Lead Auditor certification
 - Core Tools certification. Practical knowledge of GD&T and dimensional inspection
 - Experience with CMM, profile projector, height gauge, gauges, and other precision measurement equipment
 - Experience in supplier capability studies and manufacturing process audits
 - Experience with casting, forging, welding, fabrication, and machining suppliers
 - Experience in new product development and industrialization
 - Experience working with global automotive / industrial / construction equipment suppliers
 - Knowledge of material specifications, heat treatment, surface treatment, and metallurgicalrequirements

What matters to us: 

- Quality of work
 - Structured problem-solving
 - Dissatisfaction with mediocre work
 - Ability to multi-task and handle a dynamic working environment
 - Resilient attitude to bounce back after failing

About Us: 

Exponent is building the energy stack powering commercial EVs in India. Our proprietary battery and charging technology enables safe, reliable 15-minute rapid charging while delivering a 3, 000-cycle battery life warranty using standard lithium-ion cells. Today, our platform powers high-utilisation commercial vehicles - from three-wheelers to intercity buses, making electric mobility rapid, more reliable and more affordable than petroleum. 

Founded by Arun Vinayak (Founding Partner & Former Chief Product Officer, Ather Energy), Exponent is a 250+ member team of passionate builders solving some of the toughest engineering challenges in energy. 

If solving hard engineering problems across mechanics, thermal systems, power electronics, manufacturing, and the charging network, while staying obsessed with customer experience excites you, we'd love to build with you.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Screening Checklist
