data.title: Senior AI Evaluation Analyst
data.description:
Senior AI Evaluation Analyst

Location: Kochi

Experience: 5-8 Years

Role Overview

Seeking an experienced and detail-oriented professional to join its Machine Learning Science team, supporting the development and improvement of AI-powered travel products. The team works on conversational AI agents that help travelers discover options, compare products, plan trips, and receive assistance throughout their travel journey. 

You will play a key role in evaluating the quality, accuracy, relevance, and reliability of AI-generated responses against established guidelines and quality metrics. You will analyze evaluation results, identify recurring errors and quality gaps, and translate findings into actionable insights that help improve AI agent performance. 

This role requires a strong foundation in data annotation, quality evaluation, analytical problem-solving, and guideline-based decision-making. The position is suited to professionals who enjoy hands-on evaluation and analysis of AI outputs rather than traditional business reporting or dashboard development. 

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is an experienced, hands-on professional who combines strong evaluation and quality assurance skills with analytical thinking. They should be comfortable reviewing large volumes of information, applying structured guidelines, identifying recurring quality issues, and converting observations into meaningful insights. 

Candidates with experience in AI evaluation, data annotation, content quality, search relevance, or similar quality-focused roles are encouraged to apply. Direct experience with LLMs or conversational AI is an advantage but is not mandatory for candidates with strong transferable experience. 

Key Responsibilities

- Evaluate AI-generated responses from conversational agents against predefined guidelines, evaluation criteria, and quality standards. 
 - Perform and review data annotation, labelling, and classification to assess the accuracy, relevance, completeness, and appropriateness of AI-generated content. 
 - Identify and document incorrect, misleading, incomplete, inconsistent, or irrelevant responses, including potential AI hallucinations. 
 - Conduct quality assurance reviews to ensure consistency, accuracy, and adherence to evaluation guidelines. 
 - Analyze large and complex datasets to identify recurring errors, quality trends, performance gaps, and opportunities for improvement. 
 - Interpret quality metrics such as error rates, evaluation consistency, reviewer disagreement, and other relevant indicators. 
 - Investigate ambiguous or borderline cases and apply sound judgment while adhering to established evaluation criteria. 
 - Prepare clear documentation of evaluation findings, root causes, observations, and recommended improvements. 
 - Use Excel or Google Sheets and, where applicable, basic SQL to filter, analyze, and summarize evaluation data. 
 - Collaborate with Machine Learning Scientists, AI product teams, and other stakeholders to communicate quality insights and support improvements in AI agent performance. 
 - Contribute to the refinement of evaluation guidelines, quality frameworks, and review processes based on observed issues and emerging patterns. 
 - Maintain accurate documentation and track identified issues through appropriate ticketing and workflow management systems. 

Required Skills and Qualifications

- 5-8 years of relevant experience in data annotation, data labeling, AI evaluation, content quality, quality assurance, search relevance evaluation, or similar guideline-based assessment roles. 
 - Strong experience evaluating data, content, or system outputs against predefined guidelines, quality standards, and measurable criteria. 
 - Demonstrated ability to analyze large datasets, identify patterns, investigate quality issues, and derive actionable insights. 
 - Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, particularly when dealing with ambiguous or inconsistent information. 
 - Excellent attention to detail and the ability to apply evaluation criteria consistently. 
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for data filtering, analysis, quality tracking, and reporting. 
 - Strong written communication skills and the ability to document findings, explain issues, and communicate insights clearly. 
 - Ability to work independently on evaluation tasks while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams. 
 - Genuine interest in artificial intelligence, conversational AI, and data-driven product improvement. 
 - Experience with Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows, AI training data validation, model output assessment, or LLM-as-a-judge evaluation. 

Good to Have

- Exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, conversational agents, or AI-generated content evaluation. 
 - Familiarity with evaluating AI responses for factual accuracy, relevance, completeness, helpfulness, and hallucinations. 
 - Basic SQL knowledge for extracting, filtering, and analyzing datasets. 
 - Experience with quality metrics such as error rates, inter-annotator agreement, reviewer disagreement, and evaluation consistency. 
 - Experience maintaining evaluation guidelines, quality documentation, review workflows, or issue-tracking systems. 
 - Exposure to travel, hospitality, customer experience, search relevance, policy evaluation, or content quality operations.

Job Description: 

The Service Desk Lead is responsible for the day-to-day operational leadership of the IT Service Desk team, ensuring SLA targets are met, escalations are managed effectively, and analysts are supported, coached, and held accountable to performance standards. This role acts as the bridge between the Service Desk team and IT management, owning team-level metrics, scheduling, quality, and process governance while remaining hands-on for critical incidents. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Supervise the Service Desk team, including task allocation, shift/roster scheduling, coverage planning, attendance/leave management, and shift swaps. 
 - Conduct coaching, identify skill gaps, coordinate training and onboarding plans, and handle first-line people issues. 
 - Own overall team performance against SLAs (FCR, ART, CSAT, backlog, response/abandonment rates), monitoring queues in real time and reallocating resources during volume spikes or shortages. 
 - Act as incident commander for major incidents (P1/P2), driving communication, coordinating with Level 2/3 and vendors, and ensuring post-incident reviews are completed. 
 - Own escalation paths between Service Desk and Level 2/3 teams, and manage the ITSM tool's queues, routing rules, and SLA configuration. 
 - Review and approve knowledge base articles, SOPs, and runbooks for accuracy and consistency. 
 - Drive continuous improvement, analysing incident trends for root-cause/problem elimination, identifying automation and self-service opportunities, and leading quality audits (ticket/call/chat reviews) with structured analyst feedback. 
 - Own Service Desk SOPs, escalation matrices, and onboarding documentation; 
 - Serve as the primary stakeholder contact for Service Desk performance and major incidents; prepare and present performance reports to IT leadership. 
 - Represent the Service Desk in cross-functional forums (Change Advisory Board, Problem Management reviews, rollout planning) and lead shift handovers and team huddles. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. 
 - 5-8 years of experience in an IT Service Desk, Help Desk, or Technical Support role guiding analysts including at least 2 years in a team lead, supervisory, or shift lead capacity
 - Strong knowledge on ITIL process and hands on of ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or similar ticketing systems. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills
 - Customer-focused approach with strong interpersonal skills. 

Shift Pattern: U. S. Business Hours / Rotational Shifts (Flexible based on business requirements)

Role is onsite and expected to work from office for 5 days

Organization: 

At CommBank, we're building tomorrow's bank today, which means we need creative and diverse engineers to help us redefine what customers expect from a bank. Envisioning new technologies that are waiting to be invented and reimagining products that support our customers and help build Australia's future economy. 

Job Title: Staff Software Engineer

Location: Bangalore

Business & Team: Retail Technology

Impact & Contribution: 

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Full Cycle Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software development, testing, and automation, with a passion for DevOps and a systematic approach to solving complex problems. This role requires excellent debugging and troubleshooting skills, experience in leading teams, and a deep understanding of the infrastructure that runs . NET applications

- Deep Knowledge of Core Banking systems and experience with SAP Transactional Banking Services including functional and technical aspects
 - Provide technical/functional leadership to shape architecture and design decisions impacting enterprise SAP systems. 
 - Ability to independently design and deliver end to end solutions. 
 - Extensive experience in designing and deploying scalable, high performance banking technology solutions. 
 - Proficient in one or more of the following: SAP Deposits Management, Master Contract Management, Loans Management. 
 - Proficient in Contract Management Framework, Product management, Pricing Modules, Payments, Settlement & accrual Process, Correspondence Modules, End of Day processes.

data.title: Engineering Lead (EL3)
data.description:
About Whatfix

Whatfix is an AI platform that makes enterprise software, and now enterprise AI, usable for the people who depend on it. We call this userization: technology should adapt to the user, not the other way round. 

Our proprietary AI engine, ScreenSense, reads what a user is doing inside an application and the intent behind it. It then delivers guidance, knowledge and automation in the flow of work. ScreenSense powers Digital Adoption, Product Analytics and Mirror, with Whatfix AI Agents built into each. Our newer AI-first products include Seek, an AI-native assistant that understands business context and acts across applications, and Mirror 2. 0, which pairs system and role simulation with assessment. 

- 700+ enterprise customers, including 80+ of the Fortune 500
 - ~$270M raised, including a $125M Series E led by Warburg Pincus with SoftBank Vision Fund 2
 - Named a Leader in Digital Adoption Platforms by Gartner, Forrester, IDC and Everest Group, and a Gartner Customers' Choice for DAP in 2024 and 2025
 - Seven offices across the US, India, UK, Germany, Singapore and Australia

The role

This is a leadership role for someone who still builds. 

Engineering at Whatfix has changed how it works. Every engineer takes a problem from spec to production, with coding agents doing much of the implementation. People own the judgment: what to build, how it should work, and whether what the agent produced is actually right. 

As an Engineering Leader (EL3), you own engineering for a product or platform area end to end. You lead a team of around 7-12 or more engineers and shape the human + agent system they work in. You stay close enough to the code to make, and challenge, the important technical calls. And you still ship. 

What you'll own

- Your area, end to end. Delivery, architecture, reliability, production health, and infrastructure and AI cost for a product or platform area. 
 - The technical bar. Important design decisions in your area come from you or go through you. You take architecture choices to our Architecture Review Board (ARB) and guide other teams that touch your code. 
 - Production quality. Work goes live with a spec, automated tests, monitoring and runbooks. Production issues get root-cause fixes and systemic improvements, not patches. 
 - Customer impact. You stay on top of customer issues, keep customers unblocked, and make sure Presales, Solutions and Support can confidently represent what your area does. 
 - The roadmap, with Product. You bring a clear technical and customer point of view, plan sprints, run spikes to retire risk early, and balance new work against tech debt and stability. 

How your team builds

You don't just encourage AI adoption. You build the system that makes delegating to agents reliable. 

- Spec-first by default. Every meaningful change starts with a written spec: the problem, expected outcome, constraints and acceptance criteria. 
 - The right context and guardrails. Repository context and instruction files, shared specs and prompts, tooling and review workflows that let engineers hand substantial work to coding agents with confidence. 
 - A Definition of Done that holds up with agents in the loop. Spec in the repo, tests before delegation, human review of agent-generated code, context files kept current. 
 - Engineers who verify, not just generate. You coach the team to write executable specs, delegate well, and critically review what comes back. Nothing ships because it compiles or passes its own generated tests. 
 - Clear accountability. Every engineer owns what they merge, whether a person or an agent wrote it. 
 - Safe use of AI. Approved tools only, with security, privacy, data and licensing requirements intact. 

You still build

We mean this literally. With coding agents, there's no longer a trade-off between leading a team and shipping product. 

- You take real problems from spec to production, using coding agents. 
 - You review specs, designs and agent-generated code closely enough to catch the race condition, the missing index or the weak assumption. 
 - You debug production issues hands-on and can explain, change and fix any system your team owns. 
 - You prototype and run spikes on the hardest technical questions before the team commits to an approach. 

Leading the team

- Manage around 7-12 engineers directly, and over time possibly a further team through another Engineering Leader. 
 - Own performance end to end: expectations, ongoing feedback, reviews, compensation inputs, promotions, and managing underperformance, with support from HR. 
 - Give clear, direct feedback all the time, not just at review time. 
 - Build a team that can run several large initiatives in parallel, without you as the bottleneck and with no single points of failure. 
 - Hire for Engineering, not just your team. Raise the bar in interviews and help close strong senior talent. 
 - Build a culture of trust and ownership, where good work gets recognized publicly and in real time. 

What success looks like

- First 90 days: You know your area's architecture, production health and cost. You've shipped real work yourself through the team's agent workflow. Every engineer knows exactly what you expect from them. 
 - By 6 months: Specs, the Definition of Done and agent guardrails are followed consistently, not just on paper. Customer issues are under control. Product and customer-facing teams come to you first for your area. 
 - By 12 months: Your team owns several large features at once without leaning on you. You can show measurable gains in cycle time, rework or escaped defects that come from better specs and delegation, not longer hours. At least one engineer has grown into a bigger scope. 

What you bring

- Usually 8-15 years in software engineering, including time managing engineers directly. What you've owned matters more to us than the number. 
 - Strong engineering judgment in system design and distributed systems, including performance, scalability, fault tolerance and high availability. 
 - Full-stack fluency. Our services are mostly Java and Spring Boot, our frontends TypeScript and React, running on Docker, Kubernetes and cloud-native CI/CD with relational and NoSQL stores. We don't hire by stack boundary. You work across it. 
 - Real experience with coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot on meaningful work. You've delegated substantial work, seen where agents go wrong, and changed how you scope and verify as a result. 
 - A track record of leading teams that ship production-quality software, and of growing engineers who now own complex systems. 
 - Customer-first thinking. You tie technical decisions to business outcomes. 
 - Clear, structured communication. You can explain a hard trade-off to an engineer, a product manager or a customer. 
 - Good to have: experience building AI features into products, such as LLM integration, retrieval, agents or evaluation harnesses. 

This may not be the right role if

- Your current role is mostly reviews, planning and people management, and you don't miss building. 
 - You see coding agents as a productivity add-on rather than a change in how engineering gets done. 
 - You'd rather own one layer of the stack than a whole problem. 

How we'll assess you

Our interviews look like the job. You'll use a coding agent of your choice wherever it fits. 

- Discovery conversation with a peer or our Head of Engineering
 - Problem solving with a coding agent: build something that works, adapt it when a new constraint lands, explain what the agent produced, and review AI-generated code critically. 
 - System design and review: work through a larger problem end to end, then critique an existing design or code. 
 - Leadership conversation: how you've built and run teams, including a real example of meaningful work you handed to an agent, the context you gave it, and what you caught in review. 

Working at Whatfix

How we work. We believe being together in the office 4-5 days a week makes communication easier, builds community and speeds up innovation. 

Benefits (India). Best-in-class medical insurance, lunch and dinner buffet, doorstep cab drop, education sponsorship, internal and global mobility programs, and the chance to represent Whatfix at global events. 

Our values. Customer First · Empathy · Transparency · Fail Fast and Scale Fast · No Hierarchies for Communication · Deep Dive and Innovate · Trust, Do It as You Own It. 

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse people because of, not in spite of, their differences. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability status.

data.title: Senior Java Developer Assistant Vice President
data.description:
Job Summary

At Citi, we believe in the power of engineering to drive success and foster a culture where innovation, collaboration, and professional growth thrive. 

Join Citi's Oasys Financial team as a Senior Java Developer and take a pivotal role in a landmark modernization project. Oasys is Citi's core sub-ledger system for the Over-the-Counter (OTC) business, processing millions of trades daily. We are embarking on a major strategic initiative to transform this key platform, moving it from a legacy system built on shell scripts into a state-of-the-art architecture based on modern Java microservices. 

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated technical leader to drive the design, development, and delivery of our next-generation financial accounting systems, ensuring they meet the highest standards of scalability, performance, and security. 

Key Responsibilities

As a Senior Developer, you will be a technical leader at the heart of this transformation. Your duties will include: 

- Re-Architect and Modernize: Lead the re-architecture of our legacy financial ledger, migrating complex business logic from shell scripts and stored procedures into a modern, event-driven platform built on Java microservices. 
 - Hands-On Development: Design, develop, and implement high-performance, scalable, and secure Java applications that will form the new backbone of our financial systems. 
 - Champion Code Quality: Write clean, well-documented, and thoroughly testable Java code. Act as a champion for software engineering best practices, including Object-Oriented Design, SOLID principles, and Test-Driven Development (TDD). 
 - Database Integration: Collaborate closely with database teams to design and implement strategies for data integration and migration as part of the transition to the new Java architecture. 
 - Problem Solving: Act as a key technical expert, troubleshooting and resolving complex issues that arise during system migration, modernization, and in production. 
 - Mentorship and Leadership: Conduct rigorous code reviews, mentor junior developers, and contribute to the continuous improvement of team standards and development processes. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work in close partnership with product managers, business analysts, and other global teams to ensure technical solutions are perfectly aligned with evolving business requirements. 

Qualifications

Required: 

- Experience: 8+ years of hands-on professional experience in designing and building robust, scalable, and maintainable server-side applications using Java. 
 - Technical Depth: Strong expertise in Object-Oriented Design, data structures, design patterns, and concurrency. 
 - Database Skills: 5+ years of significant experience with SQL databases, demonstrating proficiency in writing complex queries and optimizing database performance. 
 - Operating Systems: Strong command of the Unix/Linux environment, including familiarity with system-level operations and administration. 
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 

Preferred (Highly Desirable): 

- Legacy Modernization: Proven experience in migrating complex, large-scale legacy systems (particularly those heavily reliant on shell scripting and monolithic databases) to modern, cloud-native microservices architectures. 
 - Modern Technologies: Deep familiarity with modern Java frameworks (e. g. , Spring Boot), microservices architecture, and containerization platforms (e. g. , Docker, OpenShift). 
 - AI-Assisted Development: Experience using AI-powered development tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Claude, Devin) to accelerate development and improve code quality. 
 - Database Systems: Hands-on experience with enterprise-level SQL databases such as MSSQL. 
 - Scripting: Proficiency in shell scripting, which will be essential for understanding and migrating the legacy system. 
 - Domain Knowledge: A solid understanding of the financial accounting domain, including concepts like posting, calculations, and sub-ledger processes. 

Why Join Us?

- Impact: Take a leadership role in a high-visibility modernization project that will directly shape the future of Citi's global financial operations. 
 - Challenge: Solve unique and rewarding technical challenges while dismantling a legacy system and building a cutting-edge platform from the ground up. 
 - Culture: Be part of a world-class engineering team in a dynamic, collaborative, and supportive environment that encourages innovation and continuous learning. 
 - Growth: Access Citi's extensive professional development resources and enjoy clear pathways for career advancement within a leading global financial institution.

data.title: Test Development Engineering Technical Leader
data.description:
Meet the Team

Within Cisco's Product Operations, we transform engineering innovation into products that power the internet - from enterprise networks to the world's most demanding hyper-scaler AI infrastructure. Our Manufacturing Test Development team sits at the critical intersection of design engineering and global manufacturing, ensuring that Cisco's most complex systems are launched with the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and scale. We are a cross-functional, globally connected team collaborating closely with Hardware, Software, and Supply Chain partners across multiple time zones to bring next-generation products to life. Our work directly impacts the reliability and performance of Cisco's high-end router portfolio, including our latest AI-optimized hyper-scaler platforms. If you thrive on solving hard problems at the edge of what's technically possible, this is the team for you. 

Your Impact

- As a Manufacturing Test Development Engineer, you will lead the end-to-end test strategy from Design for Testability (DFT) assessments through mass production readiness. 
 - Drive the development and deployment of board and system-level automated functional test processes at contract manufacturing sites globally, ensuring maximum test coverage and manufacturing efficiency. 
 - Develop robust Python-based test automation scripts and leverage data analytics to continuously improve test capacity, yield, and overall product quality. 
 - Serve as the expert resource for product failure analysis and fault isolation, guiding debug processes at both component and system level to accelerate resolution. 
 - Collaborate with global cross-functional teams across Hardware, Software, and Supply Chain to coordinate proto-build support and ensure seamless production ramp. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication, or Computer Science Engineering. 
 - 8+ years of advanced experience in product test and validation within a multinational corporate environment. 
 - Expert-level understanding of hardware development processes from concept through end-of-life, including manufacturing test solutions such as ICT and Boundary Scan (BSCAN). 
 - Deep proficiency in Ethernet technologies (10/100/400/800G) and hardware protocols including I2C, SPI, PCIe, and SerDes. 
 - Advanced Python scripting skills with demonstrated experience developing automated test frameworks and analytics-driven improvement processes. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, resolve technical conflicts, and make data-driven decisions in a fast-paced environment. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience specifying, developing, and procuring test fixtures and traffic test solutions including Spirent or IXIA for high-speed interface validation. 
 - Proven track record to lead Design for Testability (DFT) assessments and define risk mitigation plans in partnership with hardware and software engineering teams. 
 - Experience supporting proto-builds and driving mass production readiness across globally distributed contract manufacturing sites. 
 - Dedicated and adaptable, with a track record of effective collaboration across global time zones. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

data.title: NPI Quality Lead
data.description:
About The Business

Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL) is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing precision components. 

Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd. ) is building India's first AI-enabled state-of-the-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU) and high-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence. 

Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata group. The Tata Group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission 'To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with Trust. '

Role Summary

The NPI Quality Lead - OSAT is responsible for end‐to‐end quality planning and execution during new product introduction at external assembly & test (OSAT) partners. This role drives product and process qualification, builds robust control plans, ensures readiness for ramp, and achieves target DPPM/FPY through data‐driven problem solving. You will be the single‐threaded owner for NPI quality at OSAT-leading gates, aligning design/manufacturing/test stakeholders, and ensuring flawless launch to mass production (MP). 

Key Responsibilities

NPI Quality Planning & Governance

Own NPI quality deliverables from concept to MP: quality plan, control plan, PFMEA/DFMEA inputs, MSA, SPC strategy, sampling plans, and Run@Rate readiness. 

- Lead phase‐gate reviews (e. g. , PRQ/POR/ES/CS/MP) and drive issue closure across design, packaging, test, and supplier teams. 
 - Define CTQs/CTPs, PPV/FAI criteria, golden lot strategy, and qualification lots (ES/CS/MP). 
 - Align acceptance criteria with product requirements (e. g. , performance, reliability, package integrity, test coverage). 

Supplier (OSAT) Readiness & Process Control

- Validate OSAT readiness for assembly & test flows (e. g. , wafer sort handoff, die attach, wire bond / flip‐chip, mold, singulation, final test, burn‐in). 
 - Review and approve OSAT process documentation: traveller/routers, work instructions, control charts, change management procedures, and escape prevention controls. 
 - Implement robust SPC (control charts, control limits, reaction plans) for critical steps; drive MSA (GR&R) for inline and end‐of‐line measurements. 
 - Ensure material control (lots, traceability, moisture sensitivity, bake, MSD handling, labeling, pack‐out). 

Qualification & Reliability

- Plan and execute package/product qualification per target standards and customer segment: 
 - Automotive: AEC‐Q100/Q104 alignment, IATF 16949 processes, PPAP‐like evidence pack. 
 - Industrial/Consumer: JEDEC JESD47/22/94 as applicable. 
 - Define qual matrices, sample sizes, and acceptance criteria; assess results (e. g. , HTOL, HAST/uHAST, TC, THB, BHAST, AC, drop, warpage/co‐planarity, BIB/burn‐in). 
 - Coordinate FA (FIB/SEM/CSAM/X‐ray/decap) and drive 8D for any qual test failures with clear containment, corrective and preventive actions. 
Test Strategy & Yield/Reliability Improvement

- Partner with Test Engineering to ensure test coverage, guard bands, OBA/OLA, correlation, and outlier screening are adequate for NPI risk profile. 
 - Monitor DPPM, FPY, bin paretos, retest/rework, drift and excursions; lead DOE and root‐cause analysis to drive yield up and escapes down. 
 - Build escape prevention and early‐warning systems (e. g. , SPC triggers, stop‐ship criteria, deviation controls, recipe locks, recipe checksum audits). 

Documentation, Compliance & Change Management

- Own the NPI Quality Pack: Control Plan, PFMEA, MSA studies, SPC control setup, qualification report, FA reports, deviations, 8D records, and readiness checklist. 
 - Ensure compliance to QMS (e. g. , ISO 9001; Automotive: IATF 16949 core tools-APQP/PPAP, MSA, SPC, FMEA, 8D). 
 - Assess and approve OSAT PCNs; manage ECN/PDN/PCN impacts to customers and internal stakeholders. 

Stakeholder & Customer Interface

- Act as the quality voice for NPI with Design, Pkg Eng, Test Eng, Reliability, Supplier Quality, and Operations. 
 - Support customer audits, qualification evidence packs, and early customer samples/CS trials with rapid feedback loops. 
 - Provide executive‐level updates on NPI quality risk, readiness, and mitigation plans. 

Essential Attributes

- Strong command of quality tools: PFMEA/DFMEA, Control Plans, MSA (GR&R), SPC (X‐bar/R, IMR, Cpk/Ppk), DOE, 8D/5Why, Ishikawa. 
 - Hands‐on experience with reliability/qualification per JEDEC/AEC, and FA workflows (CSAM, X‐ray, SEM/FIB, decap, SAM/warpage). 
 - Data analysis proficiency (e. g. , Minitab/JMP; SQL/Python a plus). 
 - Excellent communication and leadership; capable of influencing OSAT teams and cross‐functional stakeholders. 
 - Experience with layered process audits (LPA), process capability studies for advanced packaging (FC, WLCSP, SiP). 

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electrical, Electronics, Materials, Mechanical, Industrial) or related. 

Desired Experience Level

10+ years in semiconductor manufacturing/assembly/test quality, and in NPI and supplier/OSAT management.

data.title: Engineering Lead L 3
data.description:
About Whatfix

Whatfix is an AI platform that makes enterprise software, and now enterprise AI, usable for the people who depend on it. We call this userization: technology should adapt to the user, not the other way round. 

Our proprietary AI engine, ScreenSense, reads what a user is doing inside an application and the intent behind it. It then delivers guidance, knowledge and automation in the flow of work. ScreenSense powers Digital Adoption, Product Analytics and Mirror, with Whatfix AI Agents built into each. Our newer AI-first products include Seek, an AI-native assistant that understands business context and acts across applications, and Mirror 2. 0, which pairs system and role simulation with assessment. 

- 700+ enterprise customers, including 80+ of the Fortune 500, such as Shell, Schneider Electric and UPS Supply Chain Solutions
 - ~$270M raised, including a $125M Series E led by Warburg Pincus with SoftBank Vision Fund 2
 - Named a Leader in Digital Adoption Platforms by Gartner, Forrester, IDC and Everest Group, and a Gartner Customers' Choice for DAP in 2024 and 2025
 - Seven offices across the US, India, UK, Germany, Singapore and Australia

The role

This is a leadership role for someone who still builds. 

Engineering at Whatfix has changed how it works. Every engineer takes a problem from spec to production, with coding agents doing much of the implementation. People own the judgment: what to build, how it should work, and whether what the agent produced is actually right. 

As an Engineering Lead (EL3), you own engineering for a product or platform area end to end. You lead a team of around 7-10 engineers and shape the human + agent system they work in. You stay close enough to the code to make, and challenge, the important technical calls. And you still ship. 

What you'll own

- Your area, end to end. Delivery, architecture, reliability, production health, and infrastructure and AI cost for a product or platform area. 
 - The technical bar. Important design decisions in your area come from you or go through you. You take architecture choices to our Architecture Review Board (ARB) and guide other teams that touch your code. 
 - Production quality. Work goes live with a spec, automated tests, monitoring and runbooks. Production issues get root-cause fixes and systemic improvements, not patches. 
 - Customer impact. You stay on top of customer issues, keep customers unblocked, and make sure Presales, Solutions and Support can confidently represent what your area does. 
 - The roadmap, with Product. You bring a clear technical and customer point of view, plan sprints, run spikes to retire risk early, and balance new work against tech debt and stability. 

How your team builds

You don't just encourage AI adoption. You build the system that makes delegating to agents reliable. 

- Spec-first by default. Every meaningful change starts with a written spec: the problem, expected outcome, constraints and acceptance criteria. 
 - The right context and guardrails. Repository context and instruction files, shared specs and prompts, tooling and review workflows that let engineers hand substantial work to coding agents with confidence. 
 - A Definition of Done that holds up with agents in the loop. Spec in the repo, tests before delegation, human review of agent-generated code, context files kept current. 
 - Engineers who verify, not just generate. You coach the team to write executable specs, delegate well, and critically review what comes back. Nothing ships because it compiles or passes its own generated tests. 
 - Clear accountability. Every engineer owns what they merge, whether a person or an agent wrote it. 
 - Safe use of AI. Approved tools only, with security, privacy, data and licensing requirements intact. 

You still build

We mean this literally. With coding agents, there's no longer a trade-off between leading a team and shipping product. 

- You take real problems from spec to production, using coding agents. 
 - You review specs, designs and agent-generated code closely enough to catch the race condition, the missing index or the weak assumption. 
 - You debug production issues hands-on and can explain, change and fix any system your team owns. 
 - You prototype and run spikes on the hardest technical questions before the team commits to an approach. 

Leading the team

- Manage around 7-12 engineers directly, and over time possibly a further team through another Engineering Lead. 
 - Own performance end to end: expectations, ongoing feedback, reviews, compensation inputs, promotions, and managing underperformance, with support from HR. 
 - Give clear, direct feedback all the time, not just at review time. 
 - Build a team that can run several large initiatives in parallel, without you as the bottleneck and with no single points of failure. 
 - Hire for Engineering, not just your team. Raise the bar in interviews and help close strong senior talent. 
 - Build a culture of trust and ownership, where good work gets recognized publicly and in real time. 

What success looks like

- First 90 days: You know your area's architecture, production health and cost. You've shipped real work yourself through the team's agent workflow. Every engineer knows exactly what you expect from them. 
 - By 6 months: Specs, the Definition of Done and agent guardrails are followed consistently, not just on paper. Customer issues are under control. Product and customer-facing teams come to you first for your area. 
 - By 12 months: Your team owns several large features at once without leaning on you. You can show measurable gains in cycle time, rework or escaped defects that come from better specs and delegation, not longer hours. At least one engineer has grown into a bigger scope. 

What you bring

- Usually 8-15 years in software engineering, including time managing engineers directly. What you've owned matters more to us than the number. 
 - Strong engineering judgment in system design and distributed systems, including performance, scalability, fault tolerance and high availability. 
 - Full-stack fluency. Our services are mostly Java and Spring Boot, our frontends TypeScript and React, running on Docker, Kubernetes and cloud-native CI/CD with relational and NoSQL stores. We don't hire by stack boundary. You work across it. 
 - Real experience with coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot on meaningful work. You've delegated substantial work, seen where agents go wrong, and changed how you scope and verify as a result. 
 - A track record of leading teams that ship production-quality software, and of growing engineers who now own complex systems. 
 - Customer-first thinking. You tie technical decisions to business outcomes. 
 - Clear, structured communication. You can explain a hard trade-off to an engineer, a product manager or a customer. 
 - Good to have: experience building AI features into products, such as LLM integration, retrieval, agents or evaluation harnesses. 

This may not be the right role if

- Your current role is mostly reviews, planning and people management, and you don't miss building. 
 - You see coding agents as a productivity add-on rather than a change in how engineering gets done. 
 - You'd rather own one layer of the stack than a whole problem. 

How we'll assess you

Our interviews look like the job. You'll use a coding agent of your choice wherever it fits. 

- Discovery conversation with a peer or our Head of Engineering
 - Problem solving with a coding agent: build something that works, adapt it when a new constraint lands, explain what the agent produced, and review AI-generated code critically. 
 - System design and review: work through a larger problem end to end, then critique an existing design or code. 
 - Leadership conversation: how you've built and run teams, including a real example of meaningful work you handed to an agent, the context you gave it, and what you caught in review. Rounds are in person at our Bengaluru office. 

Working at Whatfix

How we work. We believe being together in the office 4-5 days a week makes communication easier, builds community and speeds up innovation. 

Benefits (India). Best-in-class medical insurance, lunch and dinner buffet, doorstep cab drop, education sponsorship, internal and global mobility programs, and the chance to represent Whatfix at global events. 

Our values. Customer First · Empathy · Transparency · Fail Fast and Scale Fast · No Hierarchies for Communication · Deep Dive and Innovate · Trust, Do It as You Own It. 

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse people because of, not in spite of, their differences. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability status.

The Safal platform includes multi-role procurement workflows, approval chains, and enterprise-level system logic. The QA engineer must be able to understand these workflows deeply and validate that the system behaves correctly across multiple roles, conditions, and edge cases. 

This role requires someone who is comfortable working with developers, writing structured documentation, and gradually automating QA processes. 

We are particularly looking for candidates who actively use modern automation tools and AI-assisted workflows to improve QA productivity, automate documentation, generate test cases, and build strong test coverage systems.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer (Autofills Coverage)
data.description:
Bitwarden promotes better internet security and safety with the leading open source password management solution for individuals, teams, and business organizations. Our philosophy on security is that "we are all in this together" - we continue to offer a full-featured free version of Bitwarden so that everyone can be protected with strong password management. We also provide enterprise-grade solutions to some of the largest companies in the world, and will continue to innovate in the identity and authentication market as the world starts to grow beyond passwords. Read more on the Bitwarden blog. 

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Autofills side of this team, yyou will help make autofill work reliably on the sites people actually use, and keep it fast and unobtrusive as the product evolves. Autofill is the Bitwarden capability that fills logins, payment details, and identities into web forms across browsers. The Autofill Coverage team maintains and expands a curated dataset of site-specific autofill rules, builds automation that continuously

checks autofill across popular websites, and builds lab-based measurement of autofill's performance in the browser. Every engineer on the team works across all of this, so we value curiosity and range over a perfect match to any single tool. This is a hands-on role. You will spend your time writing, reviewing, and shipping code, alongside your teammates and in close partnership with the wider Autofill team. 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- End-to-End Delivery & Ownership: Own substantial pieces of the team's work from design through production: the site-specific rule dataset and its tooling, theautomation that continuously checks autofill on real websites and turns failures into fixes, and the benchmarking harness that measures autofill's performance impact and responsiveness. Stay with your work once it is live. 
 - Automation at Scale: Design browser automation that runs reliably against real, constantly changing websites. Handle flakiness, dynamic content, and anti-bot measures, and turn results into actionable signal rather than noise. 
 - Performance Measurement: Build and improve lab-based benchmarks that measure how autofill affects page responsiveness, rendering, and memory. Treat measurement as engineering: control noise, question surprising numbers, and make sure a metric means what it claims before anyone acts on it. 
 - Engineering Standards and Automated Quality: Build and maintain the validation, versioning, and CI checks that catch bad data and misleading results before they ship. Review teammates' pull requests with care and invite the same scrutiny of your own. Keep documentation and contribution guidance in our open source repositories clear. 
 - Decoupled Architecture and Service Boundaries: Design the dataset so it can evolve independently of client release cycles, with backward compatibility across supported client versions. Keep test and measurement tooling cleanly separated from the product code it exercises. 
 - Technical Mentorship: Pair on hard problems, share what you learn, and help SDETs and newer engineers find their footing in a security-sensitive codebase. 
 - AI-Assisted Development: Use AI coding assistants effectively in daily engineering and exercise judgement about where they help and where they do not. Build assistive tooling that speeds up rule authoring, with a human always reviewing and approving the result. 
 - Operational Stewardship: Triage autofill defects from support, internal reports, automated checks, and benchmarks. Fix what belongs to the team and route the rest to the right owner with clear attribution. 
 - Cross-Functional Partnership & Collaboration: Partner closely with the Autofill team, Product, Security, and SDET teammates to design and validate solutions before implementation begins. 

WHAT YOU BRING

- Overall Experience: 5-9 years building and operating production software, with a track record of owning substantial, technically demanding work end to end as an individual contributor. 
 - Technical Stack: We hire for strength and mindset, not an exact tool match. You should be strong in at least one of browser automation or front-end performance, and keen to grow into the other. 
 - Expertise - TypeScript or JavaScript, and Node. js - The DOM, HTML forms, and CSS selectors, including how real-world pages diverge from spec - Browser automation with Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or Cypress, or front-end performance analysis with Chrome DevTools, Lighthouse, and Core Web Vitals - CI/CD with GitHub Actions or a similar platform
 - Experience - Shell scripting and Docker - Data validation with JSON Schema or similar, and maintaining versioned datasets or configuration - Reading performance data: percentiles, run-to-run variation, and telling a real regression from noise - Dashboards and alerting with Datadog, Grafana/Prometheus, New Relic, or similar - AI-assisted development, preferably Claude Code
 - Familiarity - Browser internals such as rendering, garbage collection, the Chrome DevTools Protocol, and Performance APIs (PerformanceObserver, Long Tasks, User Timing) - Browser extension architecture (Manifest V3, content scripts, extension messaging) - Front-end frameworks and tooling such as Lit, React, RxJS, and webpack
 - T-Shaped Engineering Mindset: Depth in one area and genuine range across others. You ask why, not just what; you treat a flaky test or a surprising number as something to understand rather than hide; and you pick up new tools quickly. 
 - Practical experience with containerized environments, automated test frameworks (unit, integration, and end-to-end), CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling. 
 - Secure Coding: Familiarity with zero-trust and zero-knowledge security architectures, encryption standards, and threat-modeling methodologies, and an understanding of why vetted, human-authored rules and heuristic-based autofill carry different security postures. 
 - Collaborative Spirit: A highly collaborative and adaptable mindset, excited to work in rapid, outcome-driven feedback loops. 
 - Open Source Passion: Excitement and enthusiasm for open source, developer advocacy, and building a more secure internet. 
 - Problem-Solving: Excellent problem-solving skills, valuing written, clear documentation and using data to make technical decisions. 

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to play a foundational role in shaping our India Engineering COE from the ground up. Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world's largest organizations. 

Become an expert. You'll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. You'll work alongside talented global teams, solve meaningful engineering challenges, influence how we scale our engineering organization & contribute to products used by customers around the world. 

If you're passionate about building exceptional teams, enabling engineering excellence, and making a lasting impact within a fast-growing engineering company, we'd love to hear from you. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

data.title: Engineering Manager - Infrastructure Security
data.description:
About the team

The Platform & Infrastructure Engineering team owns the foundational estate that everything else runs on. The team designs, builds, automates, and operates scalable cloud-native systems across networks, security, data & storage, and compute. It carries significant regulatory and operational responsibility, with its platforms directly underpinning critical customer-facing systems such as payments and banking, so security and availability are not optional. 

About the role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Infrastructure Security at slice. You will own charters like cloud security, network security, and software supply chain security and build a team that makes the secure path the default path for every engineer. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the architecture, hire and grow the team, and be accountable for measurable, auditable security outcomes across our cloud and hybrid estate. 

What You will do

- Lead, hire and scale the Infrastructure Security team, setting goals, mentoring engineers, and developing technical leaders. 
 - Own the cloud and hybrid network security architecture and roadmap, balancing security, reliability, scalability, velocity and cost. 
 - Establish secure-by-design principles, guardrails and baseline configurations across AWS accounts, organizations and future cloud regions. 
 - Drive Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and platform automation to ensure security controls are version-controlled, tested, repeatable and consistently enforced. 
 - Own IAM, SSO/Identity Center, PAM, least-privilege access, just-in-time access and secrets management. 
 - Enforce encryption, KMS/HSM key management, certificate lifecycle management and data protection standards. 
 - Secure Kubernetes (EKS), compute workloads and container images through hardening, runtime protection and automated patching. 
 - Design secure network architecture, including VPC segmentation, hybrid connectivity, egress controls, firewalls, DNS security, IDS/IPS, and zero-trust access. 
 - Protect internet-facing services and APIs using DDoS mitigation, WAF, bot management, rate limiting, and API security controls. 
 - Harden CI/CD pipelines and implement DevSecOps practices, including short-lived credentials (OIDC), SCA, image scanning, SBOMs, artifact signing and provenance. 
 - Implement policy-as-code and admission controls to prevent misconfigured infrastructure and untrusted or vulnerable artifacts from reaching production. 
 - Govern open-source and third-party dependencies through vulnerability management, license compliance, and remediation of SLAs. 
 - Establish security metrics for control coverage, policy violations, exposure and remediation timelines; continuously detect and remediate misconfigurations and security drifts. 
 - Partner with Cybersecurity, AppSec, GRC and SOC teams to address security and compliance gaps and support audits. 
 - Lead infrastructure security incident responses, including DDoS attacks and cloud misconfigurations, and drive blameless post-incident reviews. 
 - Strengthen resilience through availability planning, disaster recovery, capacity management, incident readiness, and recovery exercises for critical infrastructure. 

What You will need

- 9+ years in infrastructure, cloud or security engineering, including 2+ years managing and building high-performing teams. 
 - Deep hands-on expertise in AWS/GCP/Azure security (IAM, Organizations/SCPs, KMS, Security Hub, Guard Duty or equivalents) and cloud security architecture. 
 - Strong understanding of IAM, SSO, PAM, secrets management, encryption and key management. 
 - Deep expertise in cloud and data-center networking, hybrid connectivity, firewalls, WAF, DDoS protection and IDS/IPS. 
 - Practical experience with CI/CD hardening, SCA and image scanning, SBOMs, artifact signing and policy enforcement. 
 - Strong infrastructure-as-code skills (e. g. , Terraform) and experience building guardrails at scale. 
 - Solid grounding in observability, incident management, disaster recovery, and capacity planning. 
 - Strong understanding of Linux, networking, and distributed systems. 
 - Experience designing infrastructure for high-scale, highly available environments. 
 - Experience in fintech, banking, or another highly regulated industry. 
 - Experience with multi-cloud or hybrid-cloud environments. 
 - Experience with RBI cyber security and IT governance directions, CERT-In guidelines, PCI DSS or NPCI audits. 
 - Depth in admission controllers, policy engines and runtime security tools. 
 - Certifications such as AWS Certified Security - Specialty, CCSP, CISSP or CKS. 
 - Contributions to security tooling, open source or the wider security community. 

Life at slice

Life so good, you'd think we're kidding: 

- Competitive salaries. Period. 
 - An extensive medical insurance that looks out for our employees & their dependants. We'll love you and take care of you, our promise. 
 - Flexible working hours. Just don't call us at 3AM, we like our sleep schedule. 
 - Tailored vacation & leave policies so that you enjoy every important moment in your life. 
 - A reward system that celebrates hard work and milestones throughout the year. Expect a gift coming your way anytime you kill it here. 
 - Learning and upskilling opportunities. Seriously, not kidding. 
 - Good food, games, and a cool office to make you feel like home. An environment so good, you'll forget the term "colleagues can't be your friends".

data.title: Founding Staff Engineer
data.description:
This role is for one of our clients
Industry: Technology, Information and Internet

Company Name: Conatus

Seniority level: Mid-Senior level

Min Experience: 5+ years

Location: Remote (India)

JobType: full-time

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. 

The business
We are two founders with three exits between us. We have raised more than $15m from world class investors, and our companies have generated more than $50m across those exits. We build consumer products, and this one is funded from our own profits. There is no VC timeline, no fundraise we need to close, and no plan to raise external capital, so we can build for the long term without the usual pressure to keep financing the business. Salary is top of market and stable, with a defined path as the business grows. 

The product
You step into a book as a character. You decide what you do and say, and the story moves around you. The people in it remember what happened, want things of their own, and do not always do what you expect. 

Millions of people already spend hours a day talking to fictional characters, but the products they use are chat windows with a costume on. Nothing remembers properly, nothing builds, and nothing pays off. A story here may run for hundreds of turns. Different characters have to remember different things, relationships have to change, old events have to matter again at the right moment, and the story has to stay surprising without drifting. All of that has to disappear behind an experience that feels like reading. Nobody has done it well yet, because it is a hard AI problem and a hard product problem at the same time. 

The role
You are the first engineer. You work directly with the founders and the founding product designer to build the product, take it to market, and improve it quickly from what real readers do. You will ship the whole product, from the database to the screen the reader sees, and you will use coding agents to do most of the typing. Your time goes on the things agents are still bad at: knowing what should be built, designing the experiment that tells us whether it works, and deciding where AI can and cannot be trusted to make the call. 

What you will own. 

- The production loop. Data model, streaming, background work, concurrency, payments and the credit ledger, deployment, observability. Every turn must be reconstructable after the fact, because failures in a system like this are hard to reproduce. 

- Benchmarks and evals. Test cases for continuity, character behaviour, narrative quality and failure modes, developed alongside the first working loop so they tell us what to build rather than only whether we built it. 

- Memory, context and models. How a story is remembered across hundreds of turns, which models do which jobs, retrieval, orchestration, cost and latency. We have starting points. We expect you to make the simple approaches fail on our own test cases before we build anything bespoke. 

- The standards the next hire inherits. Enough structure around agents that speed does not turn into unmaintainable code. 

A world class former CTO and two senior technical advisers are on call as a sounding board. The founders come from product and growth, have worked closely with engineers before, and know how to give you what you need and then get out of the way. 

How We Work
The bar is a tier A consumer product: story quality, latency, typography, state and reliability all count, and we will push on all of them. 

We would rather test three approaches in a week than debate them for a month. We expect you to push back when we are wrong, and we will say so plainly when we think you are. You are never stuck alone: founders are available daily, advisers are a message away, and you will have the tooling, compute and model budget to run real experiments. If something is slowing you down, we remove it. 

What We Are Looking For
- AI first. Models, context, memory, evals and coding agents are part of how you naturally think about software, and you know where they fail. 

- A real product engineer. You have shipped consumer products end to end, not worked only in notebooks or research settings. 

- You have built and operated a production system with language models at its core, seen it fail with real users, understood why, and been responsible for fixing it. 

- You design the experiment before you reach for custom infrastructure, and you can build an eval that measures something rather than producing a reassuring score. 

- Strong on databases, APIs, concurrency, background work and production reliability. Agents can write a migration; you have to know whether it can destroy fifty thousand running stories. 

- Design instinct, and the confidence to make the call when nobody hands you a spec. - Genuine interest in why people come back to a product and what makes something feel good. 

- You can explain a hard technical decision in plain English, and you are comfortable challenging founders and advisers. 

- You want unusually broad ownership and a path to Head of Engineering as the team grows. 

Requirements
Non negotiable: real production engineering depth, and the ability to build with models, context, memory and evals as a natural part of how you work. 

Preferred: several years as a full stack product engineer, experience as one of the first engineers at an early stage company, and a strong technical education such as IIT, NIT, IIIT or BITS. 

Stack
Web first. We currently expect TypeScript, Next. js and Postgres, frontier models over API, and background jobs for anything that should not sit on the live reader path. None of it is sacred. You will have real say in what we use, what we buy, what we borrow from existing AI systems, and what is worth building ourselves. If you would choose differently, tell us why. 

Must-have skills

Large language models, Backend, System Design

Good-to-have skills

ai agents, LLM Evaluation, Full-Stack Development

Provides design quality engineering guidance and support for New Product Introduction (NPI) and/or Product Life Cycle Management (LCM) activities, with a focus on product quality while ensuring compliance to company-wide Quality Management System and regulatory requirements for life science products (electro-mechanical devices, software, hardware, biocides, detergents, biological and chemical indicators). - Owns the Risk Management process and deliverables (hazard analysis, DFMEA/SWFMEA, software hazard analysis, risk control verification, and the Risk Management File/Report per ISO 14971), collaborating with representatives from other functional areas to facilitate risk analyses and design control processes, reviewing and approving design verification and validation documentation. 
 - Owns the complaint-to-design-input pathway as the Design Quality liaison between Customer Quality and Design Engineering to ensure field signals (complaint trends, service data, post-market surveillance and CAPA outputs) are assessed against the risk file, translated into design inputs (design, software, labelling or documentation changes), and tracked through implementation and verification of effectiveness; drives related process improvements.

 - Provides training and informal guidance on quality management system elements to colleagues with less experience and representatives from other functional areas.

 - Provides back-room support for third-party inspections and audits, such as Registrar, Notified Body, FDA, or customer audits. 
 - May interface during audits with regulatory agencies or customers. 
 - May interface with contract laboratories or external design/development partners on behalf of ASP and works to build consensus on technical and quality requirements. 

Education And Experience

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Science (Biology, Microbiology, Chemistry, etc. ) or other technical field. Engineering degree preferred. 
 - At least 5-8 years of experience preferred in Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, or related field. 
 - Minimum 3 years quality engineering experience in FDA or other regulated industry (medical device, pharmaceutical, aerospace, etc. ) or equivalent; medical device preferred. 

Role And Competencies Requirements

- Outstanding business and technical communication skills (verbal, written, presentation). 
 - Experience planning and executing projects, including small projects with manageable risks and resource requirements, critical path analysis, and analytical, microbiological, or hardware/software test method validation. 
 - Ability to communicate in a cross-cultural environment. 
 - Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint and other standard software. 
 - Preferred: familiarity with requirements/test management and defect tracking tools (e. g. Jira/Xray/DOORS) and statistical and/or other data analysis software. 
 - Strong working knowledge of FDA QSR 21 CFR 820 / ISO 13485 quality system requirements and knowledge of both regulatory requirements and other compliance areas; working knowledge of IEC 62304, ISO 14971, IEC 62366-1 and the IEC 60601 series preferred. 
 - Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple activities and responsibilities. 
 - Demonstrated proficiency in Risk Management, FMEAs, Design Control, Root Cause, and Design Verification and Validation methodologies.

data.title: Senior Emulation Engineer
data.description:
Axiado is building the future of AI powered digital infrastructure. We are a fast-growing, well funded silicon, systems, and solutions company pioneering a new category of semiconductor called the Trusted Control/Compute Unit (TCU) that combines advanced hardware security, AI driven resilience and efficiency, and real-time platform management. Our technology protects the world's most critical infrastructure-from data centers to next generation cloud and AI platforms-by securing systems at the foundation levels of hardware, independent of host CPUs and operating systems. 

Founded in 2019 and now over 150 employees are strong, Axiado has evolved into a recognized leader in the convergence of AI, security, and silicon innovation. We partner with and are actively engaged in commercial programs with multiple Tier 1 industry leaders, validating both our technology and our long-term market trajectory. Axiado has also won numerous industry awards for our ground-breaking products and technological innovations, including being named one of Fast Company's 2025 Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Security, winning the 2025 Global InfoSec Award for Outstanding AI Security Solution, and being named a finalist for the Global Semiconductor Alliance's 2025 "Start-Up to Watch" award. 

At Axiado, developing breakthrough technology takes more than great engineering-it takes a team of exceptional people who collaborate boldly, challenge assumptions, and take pride in building what comes next. We value curiosity, execution, respect, and a shared desire to make a meaningful impact on the security and reliability of the digital world. 

If you're driven to innovate, energized by hard problems, and excited to help define the future of secure AI infrastructure, we invite you to apply and join us on this journey. 

Job Description

The Senior Emulation Engineer position is your opportunity to join one of the industry's leading companies in platform security management and ransomware detection for cloud datacenters, 5G infrastructure and disaggregated compute ecosystems. We are looking for an emulation engineer to run and debug system-level workloads on Synopsys ZeBu emulation platforms and to own the integration and bring-up of transactors (XTORs) that connect the emulated SoC to real and virtual interfaces. Your focus is what happens once the design is running: getting the interfaces alive, executing firmware, OS, and use-case validation, triaging failures, and finding issues before silicon. This role is critical for validating the interoperability of our design with commercial AI servers, and for bridging the gap between hardware and software, as well as supporting SW development. 

Key Responsibilities : 

Runtime validation

- Execute and debug system-level tests, firmware, and software workloads on ZeBu emulation models
 - Bring up and validate secure boot flows (ROM, bootloader, Linux/RTOS) and platform security features such as root of trust, attestation, and firmware update on the emulated SoC
 - Develop and run use-case scenarios covering platform security management, ransomware detection workloads, and datacenter/5G traffic patterns
 - Triage failures and isolate root cause across RTL, firmware, driver, testbench, XTOR, and emulation environment; produce clear, reproducible bug reports
 - Use ZeBu runtime debug capabilities (waveform capture, triggers, memory/register access, checkpoint/restore, force/release) to debug efficiently at speed
 - Run and manage long-running regressions and soak tests; track pass rates, failure trends, and run-to-run stability
 - Perform power-aware and performance validation runs: activity capture, bandwidth/latency profiling, and use-case benchmarking

XTOR integration and bring-up

- Integrate and configure ZeBu transactors and speed adapters (PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, NVMe, DDR/LPDDR, I2C/I3C/SMBus, SPI, UART, JTAG, etc. ) at the testbench and runtime level
 - Bring up XTOR-to-DUT links from first connectivity through link training, enumeration, and stable data traffic; resolve protocol-level and configuration issues
 - Develop host-side software and drivers that control XTORs (C/C++, Python, SystemVerilog DPI, ZeBu API), including connections to real devices, virtual peripherals, or hybrid platforms
 - Debug XTOR-related failures using protocol analyzers, waveforms, and logs; determine whether the issue lies in the DUT, the XTOR, clocking/speed-adapter configuration, or the host
 - Tune XTOR configuration for throughput, latency, and emulation-frequency compatibility
 - Maintain XTOR configuration, version control, and documentation across model releases
 - Configure host servers, boot environments to interact with the emulated design
 - Integrate, develop and debug transactors, bridges and protocol adapters as needed
 - Debug and root-cause embedded HW, SW and test failures in emulation
 - Collaborate with RTL, DV and SW teams to resolve system level bugs

Qualifications

- BS or MS degrees or higher in EE, CE or related fields
 - 7+ years of hands-on experience in prototyping, emulation, SOC design and validation
 - Self-driven, good problem solving and communication skills
 - Hands-on experience running and debugging designs on Synopsys ZeBu (or comparable emulators such as Palladium or Veloce), including runtime control (NGTB or C based), waveform capture, and checkpoint/restore
 - Experience integrating and debugging high-speed and low-speed interfaces
 - Familiarity with embedded software bring-up and bootloader/kernel interactions
 - Proficiency with scripting languages (Python, Perl, TCL) for automation
 - Preferred qualifications include: experience in design verification, hardware/software co-simulation, Linux device drivers, bare-metal FW or boot loaders

Additional Information

Axiado is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber talent in a diverse and multifaceted environment. We are headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, with access to the world's leading research, technology and talent. 

We are building an exceptional team to secure every node on the internet. For us, solving real-world problems takes precedence over purely theoretical problems. As a result, we prefer individuals with persistence, intelligence and high curiosity over pedigree alone. Working hard and smart, continuous learning and mutual support are all part of who we are. 

Axiado is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Axiado does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

data.description:
About Us: 

Mobileum is a leading provider of Telecom analytics solutions for roaming, core network, security, risk management, domestic and international connectivity testing, and customer intelligence. More than 1, 000 customers rely on its Active Intelligence platform, which provides advanced analytics solutions, allowing customers to connect deep network and operational intelligence with real-time actions that increase revenue, improve customer experience, and reduce costs. Know our story: https: //www. mobileum. com/

Headquartered in Silicon Valley, Mobileum has global offices in Australia, Dubai, Germany, Greece, India, Portugal, Singapore and UK with global HC of over 1800+. 

About NTR: 

NTR (Network Traffic Redirector) is Mobileum's flagship in-path roaming traffic steering solution, deployed across 600+ operator networks worldwide and engineered for five-nines availability. Built on Core Java, RAID (our no-code/low-code UI and ETL platform), Couchbase, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, and Kubernetes/OpenShift, NTR steers roaming traffic in real time at carrier scale. We're now building agentic, GenAI-powered copilot capabilities on top of NTR, enabling autonomous configuration, natural-language operator assistance, and intelligent, self-healing traffic-steering decisions. 

Overview: 

We are hiring a Principal Engineer to architect Mobileum's agentic, GenAI-powered copilot capabilities for NTR - our carrier-grade, in-path roaming traffic steering platform used across 600+ operator networks. You will design how multi-agent orchestration, tool integration, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) let NTR autonomously configure and operate itself, while staying hands-on with core NTR engineering and mentoring the wider team. This is a deep technical architecture role: you set the target-state design and technical standards for agentic AI on NTR, and you're still writing code and prototyping alongside the team. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Agentic Architecture & Strategy

- Define the target-state architecture for NTR's agentic copilot platform: multi-agent orchestration, tool/function-calling integration, and RAG pipelines over NTR configuration, telemetry, and documentation
 - Select and evaluate agent frameworks, LLM providers, and orchestration patterns (e. g. , LangGraph-style stateful workflows)
 - Define the model-hosting strategy (self-hosted/on-prem vs. API-based LLMs), accounting for the data-residency and security constraints typical of Tier-1 telco on-premise deployments
 - Establish safety, guardrail, and evaluation standards for autonomous or semi-autonomous NTR actions (approval workflows, audit trails, hallucination/regression checks)

Platform & Integration Engineering

- Architect the integration layer between agentic services and NTR's Core Java backend (with a RAID-based no-code/low-code UI), ensuring safe, auditable access to live configuration and telemetry
 - Design context management, memory, and retrieval strategy across NTR's data stores (Couchbase, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL)
 - Set standards for agent observability, tracing, and production monitoringCore NTR Engineering

- Remain hands-on with core NTR features and architecture: roaming traffic steering, signaling/session handling, and high-availability service design
 - Ensure the copilot platform meets NTR's carrier-grade, five-nines reliability bar

Technical Leadership & Enablement

- Provide architectural guidance and mentorship to the Technical Lead and engineers building on the platform
 - Partner with product, telecom domain experts, and customers to prioritize agentic use cases with the highest operator impact
 - Represent the agentic AI roadmap in architecture reviews and executive updates

Required Technical Skills

Core Engineering

- Deep expertise in Core Java, distributed systems, and backend architecture at carrier scale; familiarity with RAID (Mobileum's no-code/low-code UI and ETL platform) a plus
 - Strong system design across distributed data stores (Couchbase, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, Redis, or similar), Kafka, and Kubernetes/OpenShift

Agentic AI & GenAI

- Proven experience architecting production LLM/agentic systems: multi-agent orchestration, tool/function calling, RAG
 - Deep familiarity with agent frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar) and Python
 - Strong grasp of vector databases, context/memory management, and agent evaluation, safety, and observability practices

Telecom Domain

- Familiarity with telecom/roaming systems, protocols, and roaming analytics; NTR or similar in-path traffic-steering experience a strong plus

Leadership

- Strong technical influence and mentorship without relying on direct management authority

Required Qualifications

- 12-16 years of software engineering experience with deep distributed systems/backend architecture expertise (Core Java)
 - 3+ years hands-on designing and shipping production LLM-based or agentic AI systems
 - Proven ability to set technical direction and influence across teams without direct authority

Preferred Qualifications

- Telecom/roaming domain experience, ideally including NTR or in-path traffic-steering products
 - Deep experience with agent orchestration frameworks and multi-agent architecture patterns
 - Familiarity with MCP/A2A or similar agent communication protocols
 - Experience with model evaluation, safety/guardrails, and production LLM observability
 - Exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA) or model serving infrastructure

Work Experience: 12-16 Years

Educational Qualification: BE. / B. Tech. , M. E. /M. Tech. or M. Sc. in Computer Science / Electronics Engineering / MCA

Location: Bangalore
