data.title: Software Engineer II (JVM)
data.description:
EngRadar / Nexla

Software Engineer II (JVM)

Nexla

Nexla is the leading Integration platform, built with AI, for AI, accelerating development for GenAI, Analytics, and Inter-company data. 

Nexla is the employer - EngRadar is a job radar, not a recruiter. We track this posting from their own careers page and send you straight there; we never handle applications or CVs. 

Bengaluru, Karnataka, India Posted today data integrationai

Apply directly →

Nexla, briefly

Nexla is the data layer for enterprise AI. We give AI apps and agents the connectivity, context, and governance to work across more than 1, 000 enterprise systems in real time, and we process over a trillion records a month doing it. DoorDash, LinkedIn, Johnson & Johnson, Instacart, and LiveRamp run mission-critical data on us. Honorable Mention in the Gartner Magic QuadrantTM for Data Integration Tools, and top-rated by customers on Gartner Peer Insights four years running. Founded 2016, remote-first, headquartered in San Mateo. 

Our values are short and we actually use them: Have Empathy. Be Curious. Be Intellectually Honest. Achieve Excellence. Remember to Relax. 

Role

You would work on the backend systems that move data through Nexla: JVM services, the streaming runtime on Kafka, and the distributed processing underneath it. Production Java every day. You take a problem, shape the design, build it, and own it through deploy and on-call. You debug it when it breaks. Small, focused team, which is why the ownership is real rather than nominal. This role sits closest to the integration layer, where the platform meets everything outside it, so the problem below is the one you would live in. 

What You'll Own

- Core framework features, designed and shipped by you. Schema evolution, pagination, rate limiting, circuit breaking, and the automated retries and self-recovery that keep pipelines running without a human watching. The SDKs and interfaces other teams build on sit here too: you write them, document them, and use them yourself. 
 - The streaming and processing path in production. Kafka, Spark, and Flink workloads, checkpointing, backpressure, and failure recovery. You operate what you build. 
 - Design decisions inside your scope, and a real voice in the ones above it. Multi-tenancy, concurrency, and latency show up in almost everything here, and you would be expected to have views on the tradeoffs rather than only implementing someone else's. 
 - The hard debugging. Trace failures across Kafka clusters, distributed runtimes, and flaky third-party APIs, fix them, then build the guardrails so they do not come back. 

Roughly 70% building and shipping, 15% design and technical discussion, 15% code review and the RFCs, runbooks, and docs that come with it. 

The hard problem

Our platform integrates with more than a thousand external systems, each with its own schema quirks, auth scheme, rate limits, and retry semantics. The framework problem is the N+1 one: making the thousandth integration as cheap to add as the tenth. That means absorbing the differences into the abstraction rather than special-casing them, while the data underneath keeps moving at production volume. 

Must-Haves

- 5 to 8 years of software engineering, with some of it on backend platforms, services, or SDKs rather than only end-user applications. 
 - Strong Java. You understand JVM memory management, concurrency models, and non-blocking I/O, and you can work your way to the cause of a thread starvation issue from a heap dump. 
 - Hands-on experience with distributed systems in production: Kafka, Spark, Flink, or similar. You have run them, not only built against them. 
 - Comfort with the modern data stack and the protocols around it: Snowflake, Databricks, gRPC, GraphQL, webhooks, and CDC. 
 - You have owned production systems and know what good operational discipline looks like. 
 - You use AI tools in your actual work and can say specifically where they help and where they mislead you. 

Bonus points

- Contributions to open-source data projects such as Airbyte, Flink, Debezium, or Arrow. 
 - Time at an iPaaS or ELT company: MuleSoft, Fivetran, Informatica, Airbyte, or similar. 
 - Deep Kubernetes and cloud-native experience, including Strimzi for Kafka. 
 - Security architecture: OAuth 2. 0, mTLS, and encrypted credential management at scale. 

You'll thrive here if

- You want ownership and will take it. You write code every day and you carry what you ship, through deploy and on-call. 
 - You are comfortable defining scope on the fly and shipping before the full picture is clear. 
 - You would rather build the guardrail than fix the same failure twice. 
 - You raise the quality of what is around you through review and pairing, not just the quality of what you write yourself. 

One thing to be clear about: our product definition is still moving as AI reshapes data integration, and the platform has to move with it. If you want a stable, well-defined surface to work on, this is not it. 

How We Hire

Four conversations, about two weeks end to end. 

- Coding. Working through real code rather than a puzzle. 
 - Low-level design. How you structure a system at the class and interface level, and the tradeoffs you would defend. 
 - High-level design. Distributed systems design on a problem close to what we run in production. 
 - Hiring Manager. Ownership, clarity of thinking, and how you actually use AI in your work. 

On AI in the coding round. Use it the way you would on the job, ours or anyone else's. We build AI tooling and we expect you to use AI tooling, so watching you work without it would tell us nothing useful. What we dig into is your judgment: what you delegated, what you verified, and what you threw away. 

You will hear from us either way. 

The practical stuff

Bengaluru, hybrid, 2 days a week in office. Compensation includes base salary and equity, set by depth and experience rather than by title. You will need to overlap with morning Pacific hours for syncs, design reviews, and collaboration with our US-based leadership and engineering teams. 

Worth a look before you apply

- What we are building now. MCP Studio and Express, our two newest bets. 
 - Who uses us, and why. nexla. com/customers
 - The product in engineer terms. docs. nexla. com
 - Our CEO on why we take "Remember to Relax" seriously. Read the founder story
 - Everything else. nexla. com
 - Blog
 - All open roles

Why Nexla? Why now?

A few large companies - DoorDash, SentinelOne, Johnson & Johnson, LinkedIn, Amex, Integrity Marketing, among them use Nexla for data integration. Connectors, runtime, transformations, scheduling, the parts of the stack where data has to move between systems reliably. 

The reason this is an interesting moment to join is what the agent shift is doing to the category. Data integration used to mean "land this data in that warehouse so a human can look at it. " That product is mature. What it's becoming is closer to "an agent asks a business question, and the platform figures out which data and what code and which APIs add up to a real answer. " That's a much bigger problem, and most of the architecture for it hasn't been built yet by anyone. 

A concrete example. A revenue team wants to ask "which enterprise customers are showing renewal risk" and get a real answer through whatever agent or app they work in. Today there is no clean way to answer that question, it requires CRM, usage, support, and billing data joined in org-specific ways, and the calling agent can't just invoke a tool that returns the right answer unless someone first establishes whether the underlying data is even capable of producing one. 

That is the system we are building. A probe agent investigates the data plane whether the right fields are populated, whether freshness is adequate, whether the joins exist, whether credentials cover the required scope and returns a grounded feasibility answer. Where there are gaps, Express. dev composes the pipelines to close them. The capability is then exposed as an MCP server: "renewal risk" as a curated product, with the business logic correct and the query semantics described well enough that the calling agent uses it as intended. The MCP Gateway governs which agents can call which capabilities, with the policies, audit, and observability an enterprise control plane requires. 

The bet is that ten years of connector work, an enterprise customer base, and a runtime that already moves real volume are the right foundation to define this layer from.

Job Description: 

About Us

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. 

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates' physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits. 

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. 

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs. 

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Global Business Services

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations. 

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation. 

In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services. 

Process Overview: Global Banking & Markets division serves mid- to large-sized corporations and institutional clients worldwide. It is comprised of Business Banking, Global Commercial Banking, Global Corporate & Investment Banking, Global Markets and Wholesale Credit. Aligned with these client-facing groups are Global Capital Markets and Global Research. Global Banking and Markets Technology provides end-to-end technology solutions for Global Markets and banking businesses including Equities, Prime Brokerage, Interest Rates, Currencies, Commodities, Derivatives, Structured Products, Commercial Card, Cash Management, Payments, Sales, Servicing and Fulfillment. Across all these products, solutions include architecture, design, development, change management, implementation and support using various enterprise technologies

Job Description: -

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Assistant Vice President, Devops Lead to join our Technology organization, based in India. This Devops lead engineer is responsible for an India-based DevOps lead engineer to manage deployment processes and support the modernization initiative for managing a portfolio of business-critical application supporting Payments and Transaction Banking services across the globe. The successful candidate will ensure timely release execution, seamless coordination with the India-based Finnacle team, and accelerated delivery outcomes. This job is responsible for configuring complex software delivery automation. Key responsibilities include ensuring software deployments are configured to meet access, ownership, and authentication standards, providing technical direction within a functional domain, modifying code for software deployment automation, and overseeing software promotion pipelines for complex/high availability applications following Continuous Delivery practices. Job expectations include the ability to integrate development, testing practices, software delivery tools, and runtime application standards at the bank. 

Responsibilities: 

- Mentors and clarifies issues and practices for DevOps Engineers by decomposing more complex tasks into actionable work units and deliverables and assigning the work units to an individual or teams of DevOps Engineers
 - Responds to escalated events or issues from DevOps Engineers and creates issues and action-plan summaries for stakeholders
 - Collaborates with Application Owner(s) on mid-term and long-term strategy for Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) tool adoption efforts across groups of applications
 - Monitors and responds to aggregate alert trends across application and infrastructure key performance indicators (KPI) for the service supporting CI/CD services
 - Works with Infrastructure and Solutions Engineers to prioritize and propose new features and capabilities for CI/CD service platform that fosters increased automation across a group of applications or line of business
 - Responds to risk or audit identified issues with access control processed designed for compliance with firm separation of duties practices and software release management standards, and policies
 - Works with Site Reliability and Infrastructure Engineers to reconcile and integrate planned CI/CD service platform changes across the monitoring, alerting, forecasting, and reporting functions

Requirements

- Education- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - Certifications if any-NA
 - Experience Range- 12 -15 Yrs

Foundational skills: 

- CI/CD & DevOps - Must Have

Git / GitHub Enterprise/Jenkins Pipelines/GitHub Actions/Pipeline as Code/Build promotion strategies/Release management/Automated testing integration

Skills: Jenkins / GitHub Actions /SonarQube/Artifactory/JFrog/Maven/XLR

- OpenShift & Kubernetes-Must Have

Kubernetes fundamentals/OpenShift administration/Container lifecycle management/Route/Ingress management/Resource quotas and limits/RBAC/Secrets management

Hands-on Experience With oc CLI/DeploymentConfig/ConfigMaps/Secrets/Operators

- Helm & GitOps-Must Have

Helm Charts/Helm templating/Values management/Environment-specific deployments/Kustomize/GitOps principles

- Infrastructure & Automation-Must Have

Linux Administration/Bash/Shell scripting/Python scripting/Infrastructure automation/AWS cloud experience

- Security & Secrets Management-Must Have

HashiCorp Vault/Certificate management/TLS/SSL lifecycle management/Secret rotation

Desired skills: 

- Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or similar engineering productivity solutions. 
 - Familiarity with containerization, cloud-native technologies, and modern platform engineering practices. 
 - Understanding of technology lifecycle management, infrastructure modernization, and large-scale transformation programs. 
 - Venafi/IAM integration

Work Timings-10: 30 AM to 7: 30 PM

Job Location- Chennai / Hyderabad

Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together. 

As the Senior Director of Software & AI/ML Engineering for GTS, you will drive the strategic vision, architectural direction, and production delivery of scalable, resilient, and secure software and AI/ML solutions that support healthcare applications and workflows. Combining deep software engineering expertise with applied AI/ML leadership, you will build and lead teams delivering cloud-native services, reusable components, and robust APIs alongside machine learning models, generative AI solutions, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and AI agents that enable workflow automation and decision-making. You will advance the adoption of AI-powered development tools and cloud AI services, establish engineering standards for automated evaluation, deployment, and monitoring, and ensure solutions align with security, reliability, and responsible AI practices. , You will own people management, talent development, team performance, and delivery across both areas, partnering with product, data, security, and business leaders to shape the roadmap and deliver measurable business value. In this senior leadership role, you will develop engineering leaders, guide critical architecture decisions, and accelerate software modernization and AI adoption through your teams, maintaining technical depth through reviews and targeted prototypes rather than serving primarily as a hands-on individual contributor. 

Primary Responsibilities

- Set engineering strategy, roadmaps and delivery standards. Prioritize the software and AI/ML portfolio with business and product partners, balancing value, risk, technical debt and capacity
 - Manage people and lead software and AI/ML teams. Set clear goals, provide regular coaching and feedback, conduct performance reviews, support career development and address performance concerns
 - Own hiring, workforce planning, skills development and succession planning. Develop engineering managers and senior engineers, where appropriate, and build a culture of accountability, inclusion and continuous learning
 - Own multi-team delivery commitments, resource allocation and engineering budgets. Manage cloud and AI service costs, resolve dependencies and communicate progress, risks and trade-offs to senior stakeholders
 - Guide architecture for scalable, resilient and secure cloud-native services, application programming interfaces (APIs), data integrations and reusable platforms. Strengthen quality through design and code reviews
 - Lead applied ML, generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents and cloud AI services for workflow automation and decision support. Select approaches based on business needs, data readiness and measurable benefits
 - Set evaluation standards for large language models (LLMs) and other models. Require baselines and tests for accuracy, unsupported claims, robustness, bias, latency and cost before release and throughout production use
 - Establish ML operations (MLOps) and LLM operations (LLMOps) practices for versioning, automated evaluation, deployment, monitoring and rollback. Oversee model serving, data quality and changes in model performance over time
 - Make responsible AI, security and privacy part of design and delivery. Partner with data and security teams on access controls, sensitive-data protection, human review and safeguards against prompt injection and unsafe agent actions
 - Strengthen coding, testing and continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) practices. Own production readiness, service reliability and incident improvements, with clear accountability across software and AI/ML teams
 - Drive adoption of reusable components, shared AI capabilities and AI-powered development tools. Measure business impact, user adoption, quality and productivity, and use evidence to scale, improve or stop initiatives
 - Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
 - 18+ years of relevant engineering experience, including substantial experience delivering production software and cloud-based systems
 - 7+ years of people leadership experience, including direct people management, hiring, performance management and career development; experience leading multi-team delivery and developing technical leaders
 - 5+ years leading production AI/ML initiatives, with accountability for model evaluation, deployment, monitoring and business outcomes. Experience requirements may overlap and are not additive
 - Experience setting engineering roadmaps, managing capacity and costs, and making portfolio trade-offs across competing business and technical priorities
 - Proven solid technical grounding in backend engineering, distributed systems, APIs, cloud architecture and secure delivery; experience with a production backend language and Python sufficient to guide technical decisions and reviews
 - Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and partner across product, data, security and operations. Ability to communicate technical risks clearly and lead teams through delivery and organizational change

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience leading engineering in healthcare or other regulated environments, including responsible use of sensitive data
 - Experience developing engineering managers or leading through managers, and building shared software or AI platforms used by multiple teams
 - Experience with generative AI, RAG evaluation, vector search, AI agents and ML frameworks; ability to assess when AI is appropriate and when a simpler software solution is better
 - Experience with containers, infrastructure as code, model registries and automated model delivery; success scaling AI adoption with demonstrated improvements in quality, productivity or cost

About Vanguard

Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe-directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries. 

Vanguard India

Vanguard's office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients. 

Role Summary

The Manager, IT Delivery role manages and leads a team of technical support staff who design, develop, test, implement, and monitor software and tools; works with business leaders to define scope and requirements, and plans and executes the development of various systems; and acts as liaison with business sponsors and principals, while leading cross-functional teams, managing project risks and resources, and integrating cybersecurity best practices to ensure secure and successful project delivery. 

Responsibilites

- Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures. 
 - Responsible for delivering software releases relating to the product for the business units. Works with business clients to determine scope, and develops environmental requirements for each project. 
 - Works closely with management to develop and implement staffing and operational plans. Participates in the development of short and long term department goals. Monitors and reports on service delivery metrics and overall performance. 
 - Develops and implements changes to department policies and procedures to meet changing business needs and to achieve department objectives. Identifies opportunities for continuous improvement. 
 - Leads quality initiatives to improve the delivery of service levels. Works with senior management in the planning, development, and execution of short and long range goals. 
 - Presents status, metrics, and department initiatives at meetings with management and project peers. Maintains relationships with technical teams, IT, and business partners. 
 - Participates in the development of the department budget. Reviews expenses and ensures department operates within budgetary guidelines. 
 - Ensures staff complies with information technology and information security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements. 
 - Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned. 
 - Lead cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration and effectively communicating project progress and updates to stakeholders. 
 - Identify potential risks throughout the project lifecycle and implement strategies to mitigate them, ensuring smooth project delivery. 
 - Develop comprehensive project plans, set timelines, allocate resources efficiently, and manage budgets to ensure successful project delivery. 
 - Enhance cybersecurity frameworks by integrating advanced security measures and best practices into IT projects to safeguard company data and assets. 

Qualifications And Skills

- Minimum 8 years of experience in IT project management, software development, or IT service delivery. Previous leadership experience required. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. PMP, ITIL, or Agile certifications preferred. 
 - Strong expertise in IT project management, Agile methodologies, and SDLC best practices with experience in IT infrastructure, software development, and enterprise IT solutions. 
 - Must have skills: Node. js, TypeScript, ECS, Kubernetes, Kore. AI, Android, iOS development
 - Proficiency in risk management, budgeting, and IT governance. Understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and IT compliance standards.

Location

This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered. 

Our mission

Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.

Financial wellness

data.title: Engineering Manager - Integration
data.description:
Sectigo is the most innovative provider of certificate lifecycle management (CLM), delivering solutions that help the world's largest brands simplify how digital trust is managed and scaled. Sectigo's automated, cloud-native CLM platform issues and manages digital certificates across enterprise environments, enabling organizations to reduce complexity, accelerate time to value, and strengthen security across environments. Sectigo is one of the largest, longest-standing, and most reputable CAs with more than 700, 000 customers, including 65% of the Fortune 500. Sectigo holds six combined active leadership seats in the CA/Browser Forum and ETSI and brings two decades of delivering unparalleled digital trust. 

Simplicity at Scale. 

How we show up with each other and our customers every day is just as important, and we win as #OneSectigo by living out our core values - Support, Excellence, Communication, Teamwork, Integrity, Growth and Openness. We are committed to investing in our diverse teams where everyone understands their role and how they support our strategic goals, we drive operational excellence through scale and efficiency, and we strive to delight our customers and become the market leader in our industry. If you aspire to join a driven team that holds each other accountable to meeting our lofty goals and you'd like to be part of our growth story in delivering a market leading user experience, we'd like to talk to you. 

Job Description

We are looking for a talented Engineering Manager - Integrationto join our growing global team at Sectigo. 

The Engineering Manager - Integration will build and drive integration engineering capability from our India GCC. This team owns our engineering-led approach to third-party and platform integrations, starting with our ServiceNow implementation and a new pilot integrating PSA (Professional Services Automation) marketplace platforms into our core platform. This leader is genuinely AI-native by integrating AI tools daily in how we code, test, document, and make decisions. 

Please Note: The Reporting Manager and the Work Arrangement requirements may be modified and redesigned based on business needs to ensure operational flexibility and organizational effectiveness. 

Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role: 

Build the team, from zero

- Define team structure and hiring plan for a new Integration Engineering org in Chennai. 
 - Own a blended workforce model: manage specialized consultants and a contracting team, with a contract-to-hire approach as the default and direct hiring for key roles where warranted. 
 - Recruit, onboard, and develop engineers; set the technical bar and team culture from day one. Own integration engineering delivery
 - Take ownership of the ServiceNow workstream already underway, including a candid retrospective on what hasn't worked so far. 
 - Stand up the engineering model for the Pax8/ConnectWise marketplace/PSA integration pilot, in partnership with specialized consultants and the core platform team. 
 - Build this into a repeatable capability as the integration portfolio grows beyond these two initiatives. Define the operating model with core platform engineering
 - Partner directly with the core platform engineering leadership to define architecture and integration patterns, required APIs/workflows, source-code access boundaries, development standards, and the technical point-of-contact model between teams. 
 - Push for a model where the core platform team focuses on the platform and exposes clean APIs/capabilities, while your team builds and owns integrations on top not one where core teams build every integration themselves. Lead as an AI-native engineering manager
 - Use AI tools yourself, day to day for design exploration, code review, testing, documentation, and even parts of people/project management and set that as the visible norm for the team, not an optional add-on. 
 - Build documentation, API contracts, and integration patterns that are discoverable and usable by AI agents, not just humans. 
 - Create an engineering environment where AI increasingly assists with implementation, testing, validation, documentation, and knowledge transfer this is a core operating principle for the org from day one, not a future aspiration. 
 - Actively evaluate and introduce new AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows as they emerge, rather than waiting for direction from above. Operate as a proactive, senior engineering leader
 - Work through ambiguity: propose structure, process, and scope rather than waiting for it to be handed to you. 
 - Partner closely with Product for visibility and alignment, while keeping engineering ownership and decision-making inside engineering. 
 - Provide regular updates, risks, and recommendations to senior (US-based) engineering leadership, including workforce and contract-to-hire decisions. 
 - Maintain meaningful overlap with US working hours for real-time collaboration with distributed stakeholders, architects, and product partners. 
 - Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs. More information about this role: 

- This is a full-time and in-office position, reporting to our Chennai office 5 days a week. 
 - This individual may manage a team and will be reporting directly to our General Manager, Chennai Center of Excellence. 
 - The targeted compensation package for this role is between INR 35, 00, 000 LPA and INR 40, 00, 000 LPA. We may make further adjustments through an approval process if the targeted compensation range needs to be modified based on business needs and market trends. 

Qualifications

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or Engineering; platform or vendor certifications (e. g. , ServiceNow, cloud platform, or API-management certifications) is strongly recommended. Experience: 

- Minimum 8+ years in software, systems, or integration engineering, including experience directly managing engineers (as an EM, or as a senior/staff engineer with clear, demonstrable people leadership experience) is required. 
 - Track record of building or scaling a team from the ground up ideally in a GCC, global captive, or new-site environment, not just growing an existing, well-defined team. 
 - Hands-on design and administration of API/integration platforms ServiceNow, MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, Azure Integration Services, or comparable including workflow, connector, and access design is required. 
 - Familiarity with the PSA (Professional Services Automation) ecosystem tools like ConnectWise, Autotask, Kaseya, or similar and how MSPs/partners consume vendor integrations through them. 
 - Integration design fundamentals: API contract design, data mapping and transformation, authentication patterns, and designing clean ownership boundaries and handoffs between systems and teams. 
 - AI-native, hands-on daily, practical use of AI tools in your own workflow (AI coding assistants, agentic dev tools, AI for documentation/testing), with the disposition to keep learning as the tooling changes, in line with our AI-DLC direction. 
 - ITSM/ticketing and collaboration tooling ServiceNow (or an equivalent ITSM tool) and the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence) for engineering workflow, tracking, and documentation. 
 - Experience operating in environments with formal change management, compliance requirements, and high security standards (e. g. , SOC 2, ISO 27001) directly relevant given Sectigo's security/PKI domain. 
 - Genuine comfort with ambiguity able to create structure, process, and scope where none exists yet, without needing constant top-down direction. 
 - Ability to establish priorities and work independently with minimal supervision across time zones, with meaningful overlap with US business hours (e. g. , available into the evening IST for standups, architecture reviews, and leadership syncs). 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across time zones, functions, and seniority levels. Ideal Candidate Profiles, Talents, and Desired Qualifications: 

- An established practice of using an AI assistant inside your engineering workflow change review, log analysis, documentation drafting. 
 - Relational databases and reporting/BI tools; directory services and access management (Active Directory or equivalent); general network and security concepts relevant to integration architecture. 
 - PKI and certificate management particularly relevant given Sectigo's core business. 
 - Prior experience setting up or leading a team inside a Global Capability Center (GCC) in India. 
 - Experience with contract-to-hire staffing models specifically in the India market. 
 - Broader background in cybersecurity or certificate/identity infrastructure. 

Additional Information

Sectigo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. 

At Sectigo, we are committed to providing equal opportunities throughout your career. We hire and promote the most qualified individuals based on their skills, experience, job requirements, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the countries where we operate. 

Our "One Sectigo" culture fosters a strong sense of belonging and supports a respectful, inclusive workplace free from discrimination and harassment. 

Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Our Hiring Process at Sectigo: 

To enhance your experience, Sectigo may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools during the recruitment process. We are committed to using AI responsibly and transparently, ensuring fairness, accuracy, and human oversight at every stage. 

Global team. Global reach. Global impact. 

At Sectigo, we believe doing good is good business. Our strength and our success come from our team of passionate, engaged individuals who make a difference, both locally and globally. Our commitment to engagement is rooted in an unconditionally inclusive workforce, embodying our unique perspectives, heritages, and backgrounds, all as diverse as the experiences of each Sectigo employee. Importantly, we strive to be recognized not only as the CLM leader but also for our intentional efforts to promote employees into the roles that most challenge and excite them, into experiences that allow them to grow their interests as we grow the business. We are committed to bringing a little bit of fun and a whole lot of happiness into everything we do so that our work - and our team members - reflect the positive outcomes we deliver to our customers every day.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life's uncertainties. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

The Software Engineer - Expert or Lead Consultant is a hands-on senior individual contributor who architects, builds, and operates complex digital products across AI, agentic systems, semantic technologies, data engineering, and cloud platforms. The role provides cross-product technical leadership, guides engineering teams, resolves critical technical challenges, and owns production performance and measurable product outcomes.

 - Direct complex, business-critical engineering initiatives spanning teams, products, sites, or platforms.

Software Development

Shift Time

ajhat@allstate. com

data.title: Staff Software Engineer – AI Platform
data.description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1, 500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore. 

The Role

We are currently seeking a Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure to join the AI Platform team that powers seamless insights and interaction through natural language and data intelligence across our AI products. 

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll architect, build, and operate the backend and platform systems that power AI Platform. You'll work across service design, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, event-driven processing, observability, CI/CD, and production reliability, helping shape the technical direction of a platform that supports scalable, client-facing AI experiences. 

This role requires a strong software engineering foundation combined with deep infrastructure and systems thinking. We are looking for an engineer who can write high-quality production code, make sound architectural tradeoffs, and own platform capabilities end-to-end - not someone focused only on scripting, cloud configuration, or infrastructure tooling in isolation. 

You will collaborate closely with frontend, product, and AI/ML engineers to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable systems that align with Addepar's standards of performance, resilience, and trust. 

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and operate backend services and infrastructure that power AI Platform products. 
 - Write high-quality production code for platform and service layers, with strong emphasis on maintainability, reliability, and performance. 
 - Architect and evolve distributed systems that support AI Platform capabilities such as real-time interactions, asynchronous processing, and secure data workflows. 
 - Build and extend cloud-native infrastructure across core services, networking, storage, identity, and observability layers. 
 - Design and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform, including reusable modules, environment management, and drift-safe workflows. 
 - Build and operate Kubernetes/EKS-based services, including deployment strategies, health checks, scaling configuration, and containerization workflows. 
 - Design and improve CI/CD pipelines, release workflows, and engineering productivity systems. 
 - Build and maintain asynchronous and event-driven systems using queues, RPC/service communication, and resilient failure-handling patterns. 
 - Design and evolve relational and NoSQL data models, including schema design, migrations, replication, and access patterns. 
 - Build and maintain observability across metrics, logs, tracing, dashboards, and alerting. 
 - Apply secure-by-default engineering practices across IAM, secrets, encryption, network isolation, and production operations. 
 - Mentor engineers through code review, design review, incident reviews, and technical guidance. 
 - Drive technical decisions that improve platform reliability, scalability, developer productivity, and long-term system health. 

Who You Are

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). 
 - At least 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience in backend, infrastructure OR platform oriented work. 
 - Strong proficiency in at least one production backend language such as Python (preferred), Go, OR Java and the ability to work effectively across a polyglot environment. 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals, including system design, debugging, code quality, testing, and operational ownership. 
 - Deep hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure in production environments. 
 - Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code workflows such as Terraform or equivalent tools. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes/EKS, Docker, and modern deployment practices. 
 - Experience designing or extending CI/CD pipelines in production environments. 
 - Experience with distributed systems, microservice communication, message queues, asynchronous processing, and failure handling. 
 - Experience with both relational and NoSQL database design in production systems. 
 - Strong observability and production-debugging skills. 
 - Strong communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills. 
 - Ability to operate as a software engineer first: we are not looking for someone who is only strong in scripting, cloud configuration, or infrastructure tooling without corresponding depth in production software engineering. 

Bonus

- Experience with AI/ML platform tooling such as Databricks, Spark, MLflow, or model-serving systems. 
 - Experience with real-time streaming or WebSocket-based systems at scale. 
 - Experience with multi-region architectures, data residency, or failover design. 
 - Experience in fintech or other highly regulated environments. 
 - Experience optimizing platform cost, performance, and reliability tradeoffs at scale. 

Important Note: This role requires working from our Pune office 3 days a week (Hybrid work model)

Our Values

- Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes. 
 - Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
 - Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success. 
 - Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
 - Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility. 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews, " and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar. com.

data.title: Products & Solutions Development Team Leader
data.description:
Job Requirements

Engineering Manager - Digital Backbone

Role purpose: Build the teams, engineering system, and leadership capability that turn Digital Backbone into the reusable, trusted foundation for Siemens Healthineers' next generations of connected, cloud-ready, AI-enabled healthcare products. The role combines people leadership, product-minded engineering management, and cross-organization influence to convert platform strategy into measurable customer, business, and engineering outcomes. 

What Digital Backbone Is

Digital Backbone is the common digital and engineering foundation that connects products, services, data, devices, and clinical workflows across Digital & Automation. It provides reusable platform capabilities for cloud, edge, and on-premises deployments so business lines can innovate faster without repeatedly rebuilding infrastructure, integration, deployment, data, fleet, licensing, observability, and workflow capabilities. Its value is not measured only by platform delivery, but by the speed, quality, reuse, interoperability, and new business outcomes it enables across the Siemens Healthineers ecosystem. 

What Digital Backbone Must Enable In The Coming Years

- One engineering foundation across deployment models: enable containerized components and consistent development, integration, release, and operation across cloud, edge, and on-premises environments. 
 - Reusable platform products at enterprise scale: shift from local solutions to governed capabilities that multiple business lines can discover, adopt, integrate, and evolve. 
 - Connected and interoperable healthcare ecosystems: strengthen common services for clinical information exchange, workflow orchestration, fleet and device connectivity, deployment, data, analytics, licensing, and business operations. 
 - AI-ready and AI-native healthcare engineering: provide safe, auditable foundations for AI-enabled workflows while embedding responsible AI into the software lifecycle, engineering knowledge, quality, and productivity. 
 - Faster customer value and new business models: shorten time-to-market, decouple software development from delivery, expand fleet-wide services, and enable subscription, metering, marketplace, and data-driven offerings. 
 - Operational trust at scale: make reliability, cybersecurity, privacy, regulatory evidence, observability, supportability, and lifecycle sustainability intrinsic platform qualities. 
 - A product-oriented global operating model: create clear end-to-end ownership, transparent priorities, strong domain leadership, and accountable collaboration across product, engineering, architecture, quality, and business stakeholders. 

Engineering Manager Mission

Create an environment in which autonomous, inclusive, high-performing teams deliver dependable platform products and continuously increase their impact across Digital & Automation. The Engineering Manager owns the health and capability of the engineering organization: the right people, skills, ways of working, quality discipline, delivery system, and partnerships needed to scale Digital Backbone outcomes. 

Core Accountabilities

- Translate strategy into team outcomes: connect Siemens Healthineers, Digital & Automation, BTT, platform, and product priorities to clear team objectives, roadmaps, technical investments, and measurable outcomes. 
 - Own organizational capability: build balanced teams, identify future skill needs, develop succession, grow technical and people leaders, and enable mobility across products, domains, and geographies. 
 - Lead predictable value delivery: establish outcome-based planning, dependency and risk management, transparent flow metrics, and effective collaboration across teams without reducing agility to ceremony compliance. 
 - Drive engineering excellence: improve architecture realization, software craftsmanship, automation, CI/CD, test strategy, cybersecurity, reliability, observability, maintainability, and lifecycle cost. 
 - Scale platform adoption and reuse: treat internal consumers as customers, reduce onboarding friction, actively manage feedback, avoid duplicate solutions, and make reusable capabilities the preferred path. 
 - Lead responsible AI transformation: model effective AI use, establish human validation and governance, develop AI-native skills, and convert successful experiments into reusable engineering practices and product value. 
 - Manage end-to-end ownership: ensure teams understand and own build, release, operation, support, quality, and improvement of their platform products throughout the lifecycle. 
 - Shape cross-functional decisions: partner with Product Managers, Architects, System Engineers, Quality, Cybersecurity, Operations, and business lines to resolve trade-offs and align investment with enterprise value. 
 - Build a trusted culture: create psychological safety, high standards, inclusion, accountability, candid feedback, and space for experimentation and learning. Promote and protect Peakon participation and leverage it as strategic tool for employee engagement. 
 - Represent engineering: communicate progress, risks, options, and impact in business language; influence priorities and secure the decisions, funding, and staffing needed for sustainable outcomes. 

Role Boundaries and Key Partnerships

The Engineering Manager is accountable for people, engineering capability, delivery health, and the environment in which technical decisions are executed. Product Managers own product value, priorities, and market outcomes; Architects own architectural direction and integrity; technical leaders guide implementation and engineering practices. The Engineering Manager connects these accountabilities, makes ownership explicit, removes systemic barriers, and ensures decisions become dependable outcomes rather than parallel plans. 

Measures of Success

- Accountability: the degree to which the engineering manager can create accountability amongst developers and team leadership acting as the anchor for stability and transparency. 
 - Customer and ecosystem impact: adoption, active consumers, integration lead time, reuse, customer outcomes, and satisfaction of internal and external partners. 
 - Delivery performance: predictable commitments, shorter lead time, improved flow, controlled dependencies, and faster recovery from issues. 
 - Engineering quality: automation, defect escape rate, reliability, security posture, observability, maintainability, and reduced technical debt or lifecycle cost. 
 - AI and modernization impact: measured productivity and quality gains, reusable AI-enabled workflows, responsible adoption, and migration from legacy approaches. 
 - People and capability: critical-skill coverage, internal growth, leadership pipeline, engagement, inclusion, retention, and evidence-based development. 
 - Business contribution: avoided duplication, lower cost to serve, faster time-to-market, platform-enabled revenue opportunities, and progress against strategic targets. 

What Makes This Role Exciting

This is an opportunity to shape how future healthcare software is built and delivered-not only to manage an existing team. The Engineering Manager will help create the foundation on which connected devices, interoperable clinical workflows, AI-enabled solutions, fleet services, and future software-defined products can scale. The role offers influence across business lines and geographies, combines people leadership with technology transformation, and turns engineering excellence into visible customer and business impact.

data.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
data.description:
We are building the Customer Lifetime Orchestrator - an omni-channel marketing and customer engagement platform that helps banks engage end customers and influence financial behaviour. 

As Senior SDET, you own quality for this domain together with the engineering team: test strategy, automation completeness, and the team's ability to execute effectively. This is a hands-on test design and automation role - not a downstream QA handoff. 

You will partner with Product, UX, and full-stack engineers (web, mobile, backend, AI-assisted features) to shift quality left and scale automation. 

Define and execute test strategy and test plans per release (scope, risks, schedule, entry/exit criteria). 

Co-author acceptance criteria and Gherkin scenarios with Product; act as quality gatekeeper before releases. 

Build and maintain Playwright web E2E tests for real-world customer journeys across engagement channels. 

Govern mobile E2E strategy (Android/iOS) with engineers; use device-farm/matrix testing. 

Integrate automated tests into CI/CD with GitHub Actions (smoke, regression, quality gates). 

Manage test environments with Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm. 

Use Grafana (or similar) to analyse test results and improve feedback loops. 

Combine automation with exploratory and manual testing for edge cases; reduce flakiness and improve parallelization. 

Coach engineers on TDD, BDD, contract tests, synthetic data, and shift-left practices. 

Advocate AI-assisted testing (generation, visual regression, maintenance). 

Required

5+ years as SDET or hands-on QA with an automation-first mindset. 

Strong test planning and acceptance-criteria design with Product/UX. 

Playwright (web), Espresso (Android), XCUITest (iOS). 

Java and JavaScript/TypeScript; Angular SPA, mobile, microservices. 

API testing (REST, Postman, RestAssured or equivalent). 

CI/CD (GitHub Actions/Jenkins), BDD/Gherkin, web and mobile E2E. 

Cloud platforms (preferably Azure) and Docker/Kubernetes. 

Device/browser farms (Sauce Labs, BrowserStack, or equivalent). 

Git/GitHub, Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence). 

Non-functional testing (performance, security, accessibility, localization). 

Excellent communication in distributed teams (India, Vietnam, Europe). 

Nice to have

Digital banking, martech, or campaign/engagement management. 

Performance testing (k6, Gatling, JMeter). 

SaaS or enterprise software testing experience. 

AI/ML product testing; XRay, CucumberStudio, SonarCloud, security tooling. 

What We Offer

Premium customer-facing platform used by leading banks worldwide. 

Shape quality engineering across web, mobile, backend, and AI orchestration. 

Global, distributed team with core hours in India and overlap with Europe.

data.title: AI Architect
data.description:
Job Description

Shape ZenseAI. QI and ZenseAI. AssureAI

- Architect and evolve the platform suite across both engines: the 18-agent ZenseAI. QI stack (DeepSpeci, CaseGeni, Auto-PlayPilot, DataGeni, Secure-Xi, Perf-Xi, Insights360, RIA and Accessibility Intelligence) and the four-pillar ZenseAI. AssureAI framework (Data Quality, Model Evaluation, Trustworthiness, and Scalability & Security). 
 - Design and refine the archetype-specific assurance lifecycles for Classical ML, Generative AI and Agentic AI, including the signature eight-axis agentic trajectory scorecard graded on every run. 
 - Keep the platforms LLM-agnostic and deployable on any client stack - on-prem, cloud or hybrid - as model-mixing and constant provider churn become the market norm. 
 - Own technical roadmap decisions for accelerators such as the Agentic Foundry (a 25-blueprint reference matrix) and the curated, swap-ready tooling ecosystem around each archetype. 

Lead Evaluation-Driven Development

- Build and govern eval suites - ground-truth Q&A sets, LLM-as-judge rubrics, frozen baselines - that gate every release rather than validate it after the fact. 
 - Own trajectory grading, red/purple/blue-team probes and safety attestations for agentic and generative systems, and drift monitoring and fairness audits for classical ML. 
 - Translate evaluation results into release decisions: eval-threshold gates, red-team severity floors, canary and shadow deployments, and rollback rehearsals. 
 - Bring evaluation-driven development practice into client engagements - showing, not just telling, how a live harness beats a one-time audit. 

Own Presales and Client Proposals

- Respond to RFPs, RFIs and client proposals across both engines, translating client requirements into a defensible solution architecture and commercial structure. 
 - Architect engagements across the full ladder - AI QA Assessment, AI QA Transformation, Managed AI QA - and fast-starts such as the LLM Health Check, Agent Stress Test and Compliance Sprint. 
 - Build estimates, staffing plans and technical win themes that hold up under client and internal scrutiny, across client-managed, risk-reward and Zensar-managed commercial models. 

Present and Articulate Value to Clients

- Present the ZenseAI. QI and ZenseAI. AssureAI value proposition directly to client stakeholders - from QA Directors and Heads of AI/ML Engineering to CTOs, Chief Risk Officers and Chief AI Officers - adapting the narrative to each audience. 
 - Lead client workshops and technical walkthroughs, including guiding a CIO through the Agentic Foundry in a single session. 
 - Build and deliver executive trust scorecards and portfolio risk heat maps that make the assurance story board-ready. 

Represent Zensar in Client Captives for Sales

- Present live in client captive sessions and sales pursuits as the senior technical voice for Quality Intelligence, alongside account and sales leadership. 
 - Run and narrate proof-of-concept demonstrations that turn a client's stated risk into a small, credible proof - the practice's proof-first approach to closing. 
 - Represent the practice at partner and industry forums as the practice's thought leadership and pipeline develop. 

Build Practice IP and Mentor the Next Generation

- Contribute reusable accelerators, reference architectures and industry packs across BFSI, TMT, and Manufacturing & Retail back into the practice's IP base. 
 - Mentor and help build out the practice's emerging AI-specialist roles - Prompt Engineer, LLM-Eval Engineer, Agent Architect, Trajectory Eval Engineer, Knowledge/RAG Engineer, AI Security Analyst and Adversarial Red/Blue Team Lead. 
 - Support GenAI and AI-enablement training for QI associates across the practice. 

Responsibilities

Must-Have

- Approximately 17-21 years of overall technology experience, including a substantial, hands-on foundation in Quality Engineering / Test Engineering - automation architecture, test strategy and the full software testing lifecycle - not AI experimentation layered on top of a thin QE background. 
 - Working architectural knowledge of agentic AI systems: multi-agent orchestration, tool use, memory, and the operational risks specific to agents - unauthorised tool calls, trajectory drift, memory leakage across accounts. 
 - Direct experience with evaluation-driven development: building or governing eval suites, LLM-as-judge frameworks, ground-truth datasets, frozen baselines and red-teaming / adversarial testing for generative or agentic systems. 
 - Strong client-interfacing capability: comfortable owning technical content in an RFP response, presenting to CXO-level stakeholders, and holding the room in a live client or sales captive setting. 
 - Ability to talk convincingly across both deterministic QE and probabilistic AI assurance - the "one estate" narrative is the core sell, and the architect has to embody it, not just recite it. 
 - Familiarity with the regulatory and standards backdrop shaping AI assurance conversations: EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001. 

Qualifications

- Approximately 17-21 years of overall technology experience, including a substantial, hands-on foundation in Quality Engineering / Test Engineering - automation architecture, test strategy and the full software testing lifecycle - not AI experimentation layered on top of a thin QE background. 
 - Working architectural knowledge of agentic AI systems: multi-agent orchestration, tool use, memory, and the operational risks specific to agents - unauthorised tool calls, trajectory drift, memory leakage across accounts. 
 - Direct experience with evaluation-driven development: building or governing eval suites, LLM-as-judge frameworks, ground-truth datasets, frozen baselines and red-teaming / adversarial testing for generative or agentic systems.

 - Familiarity with the regulatory and standards backdrop shaping AI assurance conversations: EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001. 

About Us

At Zensar, we're "experience-led everything". We are committed to conceptualizing, designing, engineering, marketing, and managing digital solutions and experiences for over 130 leading enterprises. Part of the $4. 8 billion RPG Group, we're a community of 10, 000+ innovators across 30+ global locations, including Milpitas, Seattle, Princeton, Cape Town, London, Zurich, Singapore, and Mexico City. data.title: Lead Validation Engineer
data.description:
Job Description Summary

Responsable de la conception, du développement et du test des logiciels intégrés (micrologiciels), des plates-formes et des systèmes contrôlant et fonctionnant sur des périphériques devant être adaptés aux besoins du matériel qu'ils doivent contrôler et sur lequel ils doivent s'exécuter (c'est-à-dire qui contrôle directement les fonctions en temps réel d'un dispositif physique tel que des moteurs, des alternateurs, des vannes, des ventilateurs et d'autres dispositifs et produits). Cela nécessite généralement une compréhension approfondie des caractéristiques du périphérique physique contrôlé, des fonctions en temps réel qu'il est censé exécuter, ainsi que la capacité de concevoir, de développer, d'implémenter et de tester la logique et les logiciels nécessaires à l'exécution de la fonctionnalité temps réel. Habituellement adapté aux produits et services de divers comptes de résultat. Exerce une influence sur les opérations département et est responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution. Ce rôle jouit d'une certaine autonomie, mais est axé sur l'exécution d'activités au sein d'une discipline opérationnelle couverte par les pratiques et procédures fonctionnelles standard. Un certain discernement peut être nécessaire, mais généralement dans le cadre d'une orientation. 

Job Description

Rôles et responsabilités

- Conçoit, design et/ou programme/développe un petit module ou un grand composant, une fonctionnalité, un ensemble de fonctionnalités, une zone de fonctionnalités complète ou un produit logiciel intégré complet. Les domaines d'expertise peuvent inclure, sans toutefois s'y limiter, les réseaux, les systèmes d'exploitation, la cybersécurité, les bases de données ou les applications. Peut être responsable de la création d'un produit entier. [Les petites équipes utiliseront ce rôle pour inclure toutes les phases du cycle de conception/développement jusqu'à la sortie]
 - Développer une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et une expertise technique acquise pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie. 
 - Compréhension approfondie des principaux facteurs opérationnels ; utilise cette compréhension pour accomplir son propre travail. Compréhension approfondie de la manière dont le travail de sa propre équipe s'intègre aux autres équipes et contribue à son domaine. 
 - Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis, dans le cadre d'une orientation. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et la formation professionnelle pour résoudre des tâches simples. Possède les compétences techniques et l'esprit d'analyse nécessaires à la résolution de problèmes. Peut utiliser plusieurs sources internes en dehors de sa propre équipe pour prendre des décisions. 
 - Un poste à ce niveau est susceptible d'être un contributeur individuel, avec des compétences interpersonnelles éprouvées ou un People Leader capable d'embaucher et de développer des talents. Fournit des conseils informels aux nouveaux membres de l'équipe. 

Qualifications De Base

- 
 - Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis - Ce rôle nécessite une expérience significative de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent). 
 - Pour les rôles aux États-Unis - Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 4 ans d'expérience dans la fonction). 

Caractéristiques souhaitées

- Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité à influencer les autres et à diriger de petites équipes. Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. Capacités d'analyse et d'organisation prouvées. Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années. Cette description de poste a pour but de fournir un guide détaillé du rôle. Toutefois, il n'est pas prévu de modifier ou de restreindre et/ou d'élargir de quelque manière que ce soit les tâches requises de chaque employé, telles qu'elles sont définies dans leur contrat de travail respectif et/ou convenues d'un commun accord entre un employé et son responsable. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

data.description:
Company

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Applications Engineering

General Summary

JOB OVERVIEW

This position is part of the Qualcomm Customer Engineering Group, which collaborates closely with automotive partners and customers - from concept through commercialization - across Qualcomm's broad Snapdragon Automotive platform portfolio. The team supports all aspects of embedded software including hardware and software architecture, feature bring-up, platform integration, software customization, system validation, and complex debugging efforts that are critical to product launch. 

This is a Staff-level Software Applications Engineering position focused on BSP and HLOS Stability for Qualcomm Snapdragon Automotive platforms. The primary mission of this role is to own, triage, debug, and resolve system stability issues across IVI, ADAS, and FLEX segments for global automotive customers. The role spans multiple OS environments including QNX (HQX) and HGY (Hypervisor Gunyah with Linux/Android GVM), covering both QNX PVM and multi-OS virtualized stacks. 

The successful candidate will serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for platform stability, driving cross-functional collaboration between the Customer Engineering team, Dev/Platform SW teams, and OEM/Tier-1 customers. As a Staff Engineer, this individual will also provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, define debug methodologies, and contribute to the continuous improvement of stability tools and automation frameworks. 

Key Responsibilities

System Stability - Debugging & Resolution

- Lead triage and root-cause analysis of system stability issues (crashes, hangs, watchdog resets, panics, SOC resets) across QNX (HQX) and HGY (Gunyah) platforms for automotive customers. 
 - Debug kernel crashes, process crashes, resource-manager failures, and OS-level hangs on QNX IVI, ADAS, and FLEX variants. 
 - Analyze full ramdumps, minidumps, and guest-dumps (QNX/Android/Linux GVM) using Crashscope, QXDM, QDSS traces, and other Qualcomm diagnostic toolchains. 
 - Identify, isolate, and drive resolution of stability regressions across chipset generations (Gen3, Gen4, Gen4. 5, Gen5) on both HQX and HGY stacks. 
 - Own stability-related Change Requests (CRs) end-to-end - from initial triage through root-cause analysis, patch validation, and integration into customer branches. 
 - Collaborate with Dev/PLT teams to diagnose Linux kernel panics, Android GVM crashes, and Gunyah hypervisor-level faults within the HGY multi-OS virtualized stack. 
 - Investigate stability failures related to HLOS system services, BSP drivers, inter-VM communication (GLINK, IPCC, SMP2P), and framework-level issues. 
 - Drive MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures) improvements for customer SPs targeting ADAS/IVI production SOP milestones. 

Customer Engagement & Technical Support

- Serve as the primary technical point of contact for stability-related issues from automotive OEM and Tier-1 customers across regions. 
 - Analyze and triage stability CRs submitted via customer issue tracking systems; provide timely, technically accurate responses and resolution paths. 
 - Support Automotive RFI (AutoRFI) assessments for stability-related NRE scoping, communicating technical complexity and resource requirements. 
 - Engage with customers during bring-up, pre-CS, and post-CS phases to proactively identify and mitigate stability risks. 
 - Provide on-site customer support as required during critical program milestones. 
 - Collaborate with NA, EU, and India CE teams to ensure 24/7 global follow-the-sun stability support. 

Stability Testing, Tools & Automation

- Drive development and validation of stability test automation frameworks for HGY and QNX platforms (e. g. , Axiom-based stability pools, CI/CD integration). 
 - Enable and validate security hardening passes that impact stability: Syzcaller, KASAN, UBSAN, KTSAN, CFI, PTRAUTH on HGY Linux-based stacks. 
 - Develop and maintain automated ramdump/minidump parsers and triage tools to reduce mean time to diagnosis. 
 - Partner with APT (Automated Platform Test) teams to define test cases targeting top stability hitters across program milestones. 
 - Create and maintain debug guides, triage runbooks, and reusable diagnostic artifacts for stability issues across QNX and HGY platforms. 
 - Track and analyze stability trends across program stages (Bringup → ES → L0-L4 → FC → CS) and communicate risk to program and customer teams. 

Technical Leadership & Mentorship

- Serve as the stability SME for the BDC CE BSP team, providing architectural guidance on platform stability design and debugging strategy. 
 - Lead cross-functional stability reviews with Dev, APT, PDT, and CE teams; drive root-cause analysis (RCA) delivery to enable new test case generation. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on system stability concepts, QNX/HGY platform architecture, debugging methodology, and customer engagement. 
 - Influence feature design and architecture decisions to proactively prevent system instability in future Snapdragon Automotive SPs. 
 - Scale technical knowledge through reusable documentation, training materials, and knowledge-base contributions (e. g. , Confluence, CE KnowledgeBase). 

Minimum Qualifications

Education & Experience

One Of The Following

- B. E. / B. Tech in Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, or related field with 8+ years of Software Applications Engineering, Embedded Systems, or related experience. 
 - M. Tech / M. S. in relevant field with 6+ years of experience. 
 - Ph. D. in relevant field with 4+ years of experience. 

Required Technical Skills

- 3+ years of hands-on experience debugging system stability issues on embedded platforms (crashes, panics, watchdog resets, kernel oops). 
 - 3+ years of experience with C, C++, Python, or similar languages in an embedded/real-time environment. 
 - Strong knowledge of QNX OS architecture: process management, IPC, resource managers, POSIX interfaces, and real-time scheduling. 
 - Experience debugging QNX-based systems using ramdump parsers (QXDM Crashscope), QDSS traces, and guestdump analysis. 
 - Hands-on experience with QNX HQX platform: BSP drivers, power management, framework services, and OS-level debugging. 
 - Experience with Linux kernel debugging (kernel panic, KASAN, UBSAN, ftrace, perf) on automotive or embedded platforms. 
 - Understanding of multi-OS hypervisor stacks: VM communication (GLINK, IPCC), hypervisor fault isolation, guest OS crash analysis. 
 - Experience with automotive embedded debugging tools: QDSS, QFIL, QXDM, Axiom, Crashscope, and PCAT. 
 - 3+ years of customer-facing technical support experience. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to document RCAs and communicate technical findings to cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Staff-level experience owning platform stability for production automotive programs (IVI / ADAS / FLEX) from bringup through SOP. 
 - Deep expertise in HGY (Gunyah Hypervisor) platform stability: Linux PVM, Android GVM, and multi-OS virtual stack crash analysis. 
 - Experience with QNX stability areas: SSR (Subsystem Restart), PIL (Peripheral Image Loader), SMMU faults, memory corruption, ECC errors, and HAB (Hypervisor Access Bridge) failures. 
 - Experience triaging and resolving issues across HLOS and non-HLOS boundary: GLINK/IPCC communication failures, shared memory corruption, VMM/VDEV faults. 
 - Familiarity with Qualcomm Snapdragon Automotive chipsets: SA8255P, SA8775P, SA8650P, SA8295P across Gen3 / Gen4 / Gen4. 5 / Gen5. 
 - Experience with security-related stability testing: Syzcaller fuzzing, KASAN, UBSAN, KTSAN, CFI, and PTRAUTH on Linux-based platforms. 
 - Experience working with Axiom automation infrastructure for automotive stability testing and CI/CD integration. 
 - Familiarity with ASPICE process compliance, ASIL functional safety considerations, and automotive program delivery cycles.

 - Experience with AutoRFI processes, NRE scoping, and CDEV (Chipset Development) activities within CE programs.

OR
