data.title: Senior SDET – BDD Test Automation (C#.NET)
data.description:
What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values - caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like what we're saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

DMS Change Management provides reference data management and valuation solutions for many of the world's leading and most innovative financial institutions, including regional and global banks and asset management firms. 

The Senior SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test) in the DMS Change Management Team is a strategic asset for our organization operating in this complex and demanding sector. Deep expertise in BDD-driven test automation using Gherkin and Cucumber on the C#. NET stack, combined with strong engineering discipline and leadership, is essential for ensuring the quality, reliability, and security of software applications that underpin the financial system. 

By designing robust, maintainable automation frameworks and embedding quality early in the development cycle, the Senior SDET plays a crucial role in mitigating risks associated with software releases - translating into significant cost savings by avoiding rework and potential financial losses due to production errors. 

Senior SDETs take on leadership roles within engineering and testing teams, guiding junior members, driving automation strategy and framework design, conducting code/test reviews, and mentoring others on BDD and automation best practices. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

Technical Expertise: 

- Expert-level design and implementation of BDD frameworks using Gherkin and Cucumber (SpecFlow) on the C#. NET platform. 
 - Strong hands-on programming skills in C#. NET for building and maintaining scalable, reusable test automation frameworks (Hybrid and Data-driven). 
 - Proficiency in agile methodology and workflow, Azure DevOps (pipelines, work item tracking), and Salesforce know-how. 
 - Knowledge of databases and SQL queries: ability to write queries to extract test data or verify results. 
 - Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated BDD test suites into build/release pipelines. 
 - Working knowledge of Capital Markets - financial instruments, trading platforms, regulations, and industry best practices - is a strong plus. 

Testing Activities: 

- Design and execute test plans and strategies: align testing activities with business requirements and project objectives. 
 - Author clear, business-readable Gherkin feature files and scenarios covering functionalities, user journeys, and edge cases. 
 - Build and maintain automated regression, smoke, and sanity suites; execute manual testing where needed; identify, report, and track defects. 
 - Perform performance and security testing to ensure the system meets required standards. 
 - Analyze automation results and test metrics, identify trends, and recommend improvements to optimize testing processes and framework reliability. 

Communication and Collaboration: 

- Effectively communicate with stakeholders: developers, product owners, business analysts, etc. 
 - Collaborate with the development team to resolve defects and improve code quality. 
 - Participate in code reviews and provide testing/automation feedback. 
 - Present testing results, automation coverage, and findings in clear and concise reports. 
 - Proactive, eager to learn, and driven by efficiency and accuracy. 

Additional Responsibilities: 

- Stay updated on industry trends: continuously learn and adapt to new technologies, tools, and BDD/automation best practices, including within the Capital Markets domain. 
 - Contribute to the testing community: share knowledge and expertise through presentations, internal training, or participation in industry forums. 
 - Take ownership of specific automation areas: become a subject matter expert for the BDD/Cucumber automation framework and drive its evolution. 

What We Value

Must have

- 7-8 years of experience as a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) / Test Automation Engineer in Quality Assurance. 
 - Expert-level, hands-on experience with Gherkin and Cucumber (SpecFlow) for BDD test automation, including framework design and implementation. 
 - Strong programming proficiency in C#. NET; target platform for automation development is C#. NET. 
 - Solid experience with test automation frameworks (Hybrid and Data-driven) and UI/API automation tooling. 
 - Up-to-date knowledge of the latest test automation developments and BDD best practices. 
 - Strong analytical skills. 
 - Strong interpersonal skills and a self-assured approach. 
 - Excellent communication and presentation skills, including listening skills. 
 - Proactive nature and a natural drive for problem-solving. 
 - Enthusiastic, committed, and result-oriented. 

Good to have

- Capital Markets domain knowledge is a plus, preferably with buy-side firms and experience. 
 - ISTQB certification. 
 - Experience working with Reference Data Management setup and understanding of various asset classes (Equity, Derivatives, Fixed Income, etc. ) and market data feeds (Reuters, Bloomberg, MarkIT, etc. ). 
 - Experience with performance/security testing tools and practices. 

The expectations of a Senior SDET's behavioural skills are centered around an agile mindset of working in teams. Business knowledge requirements vary across product domains but are overall within the financial sector. In SimCorp, we use several coding languages and technical domains, so the concrete skills here also vary across the organization. 

Benefits

- Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference. 
 - Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application. 
 - Self-Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work. 
 - Inclusive and diverse company culture 
 - Work-life balance - We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace
 - Empowerment - We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. 

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. 

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. 

WHO WE ARE?

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3, 000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Are you a passionate developer with an agile mindset? And would you like to be a strategically important part of the organization in one of the world's leading software providers within the Fintech industry? Then you should join SimCorp as a C# & APL Senior/Lead Software Engineer!

WHO WE ARE?

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with large and global investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 2, 500+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educational backgrounds, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds in general. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated in our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients. While striving to deliver client value, we believe it is vital to consider our people and our planet in every business decision we make. Acting responsibly is not optional. It is essential. 

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

We are building and evolving Investment Foundation, a top-priority project for SimCorp right now and we are building this area to meet our strategic decisions and deliver more outcomes. We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer with expertise in C#, a deep understanding of its ecosystems and a strong background in object-oriented programming. The ideal candidate should be familiar with the . NET framework, skilled in designing and implementing architectural patterns. Additionally, proficiency in automated testing platforms, unit tests, and Git for code versioning, along with experience in Azure environments, is highly desirable. The ideal candidate should have an eagerness to learn APL (A Programming Language). Prior experience with APL isn't required, we provide comprehensive training and a supportive environment to help you succeed. Our company also partly owns Dyalog APL, ensuring the language remains actively maintained and relevant. For now, the most of our work is done in APL. 

WHY SIMCORP, WHY NOW

Simcorp is growing rapidly in the market and we see increasing demand from existing and potential clients. That's why SimCorp is investing in creating a development area Area that is placed uniquely in our Product development ecosystem to meet our top priority strategic decisions and deliver valuable outcomes for our clients. You would be working on topics that touch different areas of Simcorp Dimension which places you in a unique position to view

What You Will Be Responsible For

As a Senior/Lead Engineer, you will help drive both technical excellence and team execution, end-to-end: 

- Lead design and development of backend systems in APL (current core). 
 - Architect scalable, secure, high-performance solutions as we move toward cloud-native approaches on Microsoft Azure. 
 - Mentor and guide engineers through code reviews, technical planning and agile ways of working.

 - Use Git-based workflows and work effectively in a continuous integration environment. 
 - Collaborate with cross-located teams and contribute to shared ways of working across sites. 
 - Require excellent business and communication skills and to be able to understand client specific requirements.

 - Solid experience in C#/. NET (Core/Framework) and building backend systems (APIs, services, integrations).

 - Experience with automated testing and CI/CD, plus strong code review habits. 
 - Acquaintance with AI tools and ML is a plus 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team. 
 - Comfortable collaborating with multiple stakeholders and communicating clearly in an international environment. 

APL READINESS

- You don't need prior APL experience. What matters is curiosity and willingness to learn. We provide training and a supportive environment to help you succeed, and SimCorp partly owns Dyalog APL, helping ensure the language remains actively maintained and relevant. 

NICE-TO-HAVE

- FinTech / regulated-industry experience. 
 - Exposure to vector-based or functional languages (helpful for ramping up in APL).

Benefits

Benefits Competitive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, at SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. On top of that, we have IP sprints where you have time you can spend on mastering your skills as well as contributing to the company's development. There is never just only one route, we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. 

NEXT STEPS

Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your CV in English as soon as possible. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is the right fit, submit your CV anyway. data.title: Sr. Staff Engineer - C++
data.description:
Senior Staff Engineer - C++

Let's be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth-powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set. 

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives. We're a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work. Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be CertifiedTM by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at www. circana. com. 

Role Overview: 

We are seeking Senior Staff Engineer to drive design, evolution, and execution of our next-generation, massively parallel processing (MPP) clustered database engine (Whitebox) that currently powers large-scale retail and consumer analytics solutions across Circana clients in 22+ countries and serving millions of queries every day in real-time against massive data sets . This is a highly technical role for an expert who bridges the gap between High-Performance Computing (HPC) and Big Data systems engineering and low-latency machine learning infrastructure and involves database internals, distributed systems, performance engineering, data processing at scale. 

In this role, you will be one of the primary designers and developer responsible for building low-latency, high-throughput distributed database kernels. You will design bare-metal optimized software layers, ensuring our database product fully exploits modern multi-core, vectorized hardware and distributed network fabrics to process terabyte/petabyte-scale datasets and where appropriate, seamlessly executes highly performant analytics and in-database ML inference directly on relational and the occasional vector datasets. 

Job Responsibilities: 

- Architecture & Design: Play a key role in core architectural choices and roadmap for our distributed database kernel, including query execution engines, custom/hybrid columnar storage layers, distributed transaction managers, and cluster coordination protocols. 
 - Low-Level Development: Write, optimize, and maintain highly performant, production-ready backend code utilizing modern C++ (C++20/23). 
 - Parallel Execution Planning: Architect MPP execution engines that distribute, schedule, and execute queries across several dozens to hundreds of nodes using MPI and hybrid OpenMP models. 
 - Hardware Optimization: Profile and eliminate execution bottlenecks by implementing explicit SIMD vectorization (AVX-512, ARM Neon, SVE) and ensuring absolute cache locality (L1/L2/L3). 
 - Distributed Memory & Networks: Design ultra-low latency cluster communication subsystems utilizing RDMA, RoCE, or kernel-bypass tech (DPDK). 
 - In-Database ML Framework Design: Architect and implement a native, highly performant, zero-copy ML execution framework directly inside the MPP engine to eliminate data serialization and transport bottlenecks between the database and external AI pipelines. 
 - Functional & High-Performance Algorithms: Develop mathematically rigorous, cache-oblivious, and highly vectorized algorithms for real-time statistical computations, matrix operations/manipulations on clustered data
 - Vector & Embedding Infrastructure: Design and optimize or embed/reference distributed high-dimensional vector storage subsystems, custom SIMD-accelerated indexing structures (e. g. , HNSW, IVF-PQ), and parallelized approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search algorithms. 
 - Be comfortable working in a cross country/multi time zone team of elite systems engineers, implementing as well as conducting rigorous peer design and development reviews
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams in defining and developing new platform capabilities. 
 - Actively participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and technical mentoring. 
 - Investigate and resolve complex performance and scalability issues. 

Required Technical Qualifications: 

- Minimum - 4 years Computer Science engineering degree from a reputed institute. Masters in HPC (high performance computing) and Bigdata engineering areas preferred for Senior staff engineer and above roles
 - Modern C++ Expertise: 8+ years of production experience writing hands-on, low-level systems in C++ (C++17/20/23 preferred). Mastery of template metaprogramming, concepts, coroutines, and custom memory allocators is key. 
 - HPC Parallelism: Very good to expert-level knowledge of cluster-scale distributed programming using MPI (Message Passing Interface) paired with shared-memory thread-level programming via OpenMP and MapReduce frameworks. 
 - Hardware-Aware Engineering: Documented experience with microarchitectural optimization, loop vectorization, pointer-aliasing constraints, and manual SIMD intrinsics programming. 
 - Concurrency Mechanics: Deep understanding of OS internals, memory barriers, lock-free data structures, and atomics (std: : atomic). 
 - Database Internals: Practical experience designing core database subsystems (e. g. , vectorized query operators, LSM-trees, B-trees, custom buffer pools, columnar serialization frameworks and query plan optimizers). 
 - Strong debugging, performance tuning, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Proficiency in one or more leading memory and compute monitoring/performance tools (such as Valgrind, Purify, Intel/AMD/ARM diagnostics etc. )

Bonus Qualifications: 

- Track record contributing to open-source or work experience on proprietary distributed engines (e. g. , ClickHouse, DuckDB, Doris, CockroachDB, RocksDB, ScyllaDB, or Velox). 
 - Experience with cloud-native distributed, elastic environments, object storage tiering (S3/GCS), or zero-copy networking. 
 - Experience integrating heterogeneous acceleration (NVIDIA CUDA / ROCm) into big data workloads and hybrid CPU/GPU setups. 
 - Vector & Graph Algorithmic experience: Experience building or modifying high-performance vector index/search engines, graph-based indices, or localized quantization frameworks. 
 - Functional domain awareness - CPG, Retail, Pharma verticals

What We Offer

- Work on the bleeding edge of data infrastructure, tackling next gen big data engineering problems to support real time querying and analytics against some of the largest data sets at high concurrency
 - Challenging engineering problems - all the way from functional/data science algorithm implementations on a HPC setup to bare metal/close to OS kernel level programming involving handling of hundreds of billions of records to support real-time analytics at scale. 
 - Plenty of valuable exposure to broader BI/Analytics/Bigdata ecosystem including great opportunity to functionally better understand CPG, Retail and related domains. 

Stimulating work environment and a great Circana work culture that allows members to bring their best daily. 

Circana Behaviors: 

Beyond technical skills, experience, and role-specific attributes, these shared behaviors are fundamental to our culture and success. We seek individuals who consistently demonstrate and champion these behaviors in their daily work: 

- Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. 
 - Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. 
 - Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. 
 - Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. 
 - Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. 
 - Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. 
 - Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location: 

This position can be located in the following area(s): Bangalore

Prospective candidates may be asked to consent to background checks (in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice ) Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

data.title: Sr. Embedded Test Engineer
data.description:
Your role

As a Senior Embedded Test Engineer at Atlas Copco Group, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality and reliability of embedded software across a range of advanced industrial products. Your responsibilities include comprehensive verification of embedded software through manual and automated testing, collaboration with cross-disciplinary engineering teams to refine requirements, and the development of Python-based automation to expand regression coverage and enhance testing efficiency. 

You will be embedded within a multidisciplinary team responsible for cutting-edge products such as PLC controllers utilizing CODESYS and Straton, vacuum pump controllers, industrial communication modules, and EtherCAT-based devices. This role demands hands-on expertise in setting up and executing functional, integration, and system tests, managing test artifacts within tools such as Jira Xray, and advancing automated testing frameworks integrated with continuous integration pipelines like TeamCity and Jenkins. 

Your day-to-day tasks will also include thorough analysis of test failures through logs and system behavior observations, defect tracking and retesting, and contributing to the continuous improvement of QA practices and automation tools. You will provide technical guidance and mentorship to peers, influencing quality standards and methodologies across projects. 

Technical and Product Environment

You will work with embedded operating systems, network stacks, industrial communication protocols (such as Modbus, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, CANopen), hardware interfaces, and automated test systems. This environment balances both legacy and modern technologies, providing a stimulating setting for innovation and technical growth. 

Key Responsibilities

- Collaborate with product owners and developers during sprint planning to ensure test coverage aligns with acceptance criteria. 
 - Create, maintain, and execute detailed test plans and cases, both manual and automated, ensuring traceability to requirements. 
 - Develop and enhance Python-based automation frameworks and scripts to increase regression test efficiency and reliability. 
 - Perform embedded system testing on physical hardware and hardware simulators, including hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing. 
 - Analyze, document, and report identified defects, facilitating resolution through close cooperation with the development team. 
 - Integrate automated tests into continuous integration workflows to provide rapid feedback on software quality. 
 - Provide technical leadership in QA best practices, contributing to process improvements, and coaching junior QA engineers. 
 - Maintain detailed test documentation and contribute to project documentation to support compliance and audit requirements. 

To succeed, you will need

- Minimum five years of experience in software testing, with proven expertise in embedded systems and Python automation. 
 - Strong capability in defining and executing functional, integration, and regression test suites based on user requirements. 
 - Experience with test management tools such as Jira Xray, defect tracking, and continuous integration systems like TeamCity or Jenkins. 
 - Ability to independently lead QA activities, prioritize tasks effectively, and provide technical mentorship. 
 - Familiarity with embedded hardware, communication protocols, and debugging methodologies. 

In return, we offer

- Join a prestigious global industrial leader with a legacy spanning over 150 years, committed to innovation and excellence. 
 - Empower your professional growth through a culture that encourages autonomy in research and development initiatives. 
 - Engage in challenging projects developing next-generation embedded systems using advanced technology. 
 - Experience global exposure and career development opportunities through Atlas Copco's extensive internal mobility network. 
 - Benefit from a workplace culture that emphasizes mutual care, sustainability, and social responsibility. 
 - Enjoy a competitive total rewards program, including comprehensive insurance coverage, educational support, and flexible working arrangements to promote work-life balance. 

Job location

This position is based in Pune, India, with a hybrid working model. You will have the flexibility to work partly from our Atlas Copco Group, GECIA premises, and partly remotely. This arrangement supports a healthy work-life balance while maintaining effective collaboration with the onsite team. 

Uniting curious minds

Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. Our robust product portfolio includes world-leading MCUs, SoCs, analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. Renesas employs roughly 21, 000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

The Sr System Software Validation Engineer serves as embedded and system software domain expert, driving software quality, evaluation and validation objectives, and technical execution while collaborating closely with systems, firmware/software, validation, and platform develop teams. 

As part of one of Renesas's fastest growing product lines, you will have the opportunity to directly impact customer experience through work on software products that enable feature rich hardware to shine.  - C#/. NET / Python (automation/tools, GUIs, packaging)

 - Drive system bring‐up on evaluation boards, development boards and reference designs
 - Analyze validation data and logs, track issues through structured closure, and contribute to quality metrics.

Join us as a Principal Engineer

- This is a challenging role that will see you design and engineer software with the customer or user experience as the primary objective
 - You'll actively contribute to our architecture, design and engineering centre of excellence, collaborating to improve the bank's overall software engineering capability
 - You'll gain valuable stakeholder exposure as you build and leverage relationships, as well as the opportunity to hone your technical talents
 - We're offering this role at vice president role

What you'll do

As a Principal Engineer, you'll be creating great customer outcomes via engineering and innovative solutions to existing and new challenges, and technology designs which are innovative, customer centric, high performance, secure and robust. 

You'll be working with software engineers in the production and prototyping of innovative ideas, engaging with domain and enterprise architects to validate and leverage these in wider contexts, by incorporating the relevant architectures. You'll come with significant experience in software engineering, software or database design and architecture, as well as experience of developing software within a DevOps and Agile framework. 

Along with an expert understanding of the latest market trends, technologies and tools, you'll bring significant and demonstrable experience of implementing programming best practice, especially around scalability, automation, virtualisation, optimisation, availability and performance. 

You'll Also Need

- Strong Python skills or Java back-end engineering experience
 - Generative and agentic AI using AWS services
 - Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and vector databases
 - Long-term and short-term agent memory configuration and tuning
 - Context management and response-suppression techniques
 - AI guardrail implementation and enforcement
 - Tool-calling design and implementation
 - Agent logging, monitoring and auditability

Your role

Position Summary

Atlas Copco GECIA is seeking an experienced Technical Leader to strengthen Electrical, Instrumentation and Digital Engineering capabilities. The position will provide technical leadership for complex customer projects, engineering governance, competence development, standardization, digitalization and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on engineering experience, sound technical judgment and the ability to develop skills in the people, build organizational competence and collaborate effectively with global stakeholders. 

Key Responsibilities

To succeed, you will need

 - Demonstrated experience in technical leadership, multidisciplinary engineering reviews and competence development.

Personality Requirements

The role requires the ability to balance project delivery with long-term capability building, develop engineering talent, strengthen technical governance and facilitate the responsible adoption of emerging digital technologies. 

In return, we offer

In Return, We Provide

Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world-leading MCUs, SoCs, analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world's leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you. 

Renesas employs roughly 21, 000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

- Define and own the end‐to‐end silicon validation strategy for automotive and HPC SoCs, from pre‐silicon enablement through post‐silicon production release. 
 - Ensure first‐time‐right silicon, robust validation coverage, and zero customer escapes across all assigned programs. 
 - Lead global validation teams responsible for silicon bring‐up, characterization, and system‐level validation across multiple concurrent programs. 
 - Establish and drive a System Use Case Validation Program, harvesting real customer/OEM and system scenarios and converting them into automated, traceable validation suites. 
 - Influence SoC architecture, design, and program decisions through early validation insights, risk identification, and data‐backed recommendations. 
 - Drive shift‐left validation as a measurable engineering program, increasing reuse across simulation, emulation/FPGA, and silicon to reduce late surprises. 
 - Own escape‐prevention strategy, including robustness testing, fault scenarios, coverage models, and disciplined validation signoff criteria. 
 - Build and scale high‐performing validation organizations, developing strong technical leadership (Staff/Principal pipeline) and execution ownership. 
 - Lead automation, standardization, and infrastructure modernization across validation labs, board farms, and CI systems. 
 - Establish validation methodologies, quality benchmarks, metrics, and dashboards aligned with Renesas standards and automotive expectations. 
 - Identify technical, execution, and program risks early; drive data‐driven mitigation and executive decision‐making. 
 - Provide clear executive‐level reporting on validation status, risks, readiness, and outcomes. 
 - Act as a trusted partner to Design, DV, Test, Firmware, Software, Product Engineering, Quality, and BU leadership. 
 - Adoption of industry best practices as a measurable program

Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience

- B. E. /B. Tech or M. E. /M. Tech in Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Engineering, or equivalent industry experience. 
 - 10 to 16 years of experience in semiconductor validation, characterization, or silicon engineering, with demonstrated ownership of silicon quality outcomes. 
 - Strong domain expertise in automotive SoC validation, system‐level use‐case testing, and robustness validation. 
 - Proven experience delivering complex SoC programs from first silicon through production release. 
 - Deep understanding of silicon validation flows, lab environments, and post‐silicon debug ecosystems. 
 - Demonstrated success building and scaling automation‐first validation frameworks using Python, C++, or similar technologies. 
 - Strong experience driving cross‐functional execution in a matrixed, global environment. 
 - Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, and decision‐making skills. 
 - Experience with AI frameworks for SoC Validation efficiency and quality gain- eg validation specific AI agents, Cody AI for content development etc. Preferred

- Experience with ISO 26262 / ASIL‐D development and validation environments. 
 - Exposure to emulation/FPGA‐based shift‐left validation and pre↔post silicon continuity models. 
 - Strong foundation in mixed‐signal and digital silicon validation, including pattern‐based and system‐level methodologies. 
 - Track record of institutionalizing industry best practices across multiple programs and organizations. 
 - Experience leading culture change toward proactive risk ownership, evidence‐based closure, and challenge‐ready execution. 
 - Automotive OEM or Tier‐1 customer engagement experience. 

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose 'To Make Our Lives Easier. ' As the industry's leading expert in embedded processing with unmatched quality and system-level know-how, we have evolved to provide scalable and comprehensive semiconductor solutions for automotive, industrial, infrastructure, and IoT industries based on the broadest product portfolio, including High Performance Computing, Embedded Processing, Analog & Connectivity, and Power. 

With a diverse team of over 21, 000 professionals in more than 30 countries, we continue to expand our boundaries to offer enhanced user experiences through digitalization and usher into a new era of innovation. We design and develop sustainable, power-efficient solutions today that help people and communities thrive tomorrow, 'To Make Our Lives Easier. '

data.title: Emulation Verification Engineer (AI)
data.description:
Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. 

As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications. 

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we'd love to have you apply!

About The Role

As a part of the Emulation Team at Ampere, you will be part of verification of the next generation of microprocessor cores on hardware emulation platform by developing and deploying new capabilities and test content to accelerate bug finding in pre-silicon. 

What You'll Achieve

Your responsibilities may include, but are not limited to, the following: 

- Be part of the emulation verification execution team and be responsible for planning, development, and execution of test content in varied domains including system stress, cache coherency and concurrency. 
 - Work in collaboration with design and architecture teams to root-cause failures using advanced debugging techniques. 
 - Create emulation models from RTL to run test content, using industry standard emulation platform technology. 
 - Develop or integrate high performance transactors and emulation test bench in System Verilog, System C/C++ and Python

About You

- M. Tech or B. Tech in Electronics Engineering or Computer Engineering with 2+ years of semiconductor experience
 - Good understanding of Soc architecture and System Verilog for design and verification. 
 - Strong software development experience in compiled (C/C++) and interpreted (Python, Tcl) languages
 - Strong hardware/software co-debug skills. 
 - Knowledge about Cache coherency models, memory consistency models in AArch64 and/or x86. 
 - Knowledge about coherent interconnect protocols such as AMBA CHI, AXI4, ACE, etc. Knowledge of PCIE, Ethernet, DDR/LPDDR technology is a plus. 
 - Experience developing bare-metal content using C/C++ and assembly language for verification. ARM assembly expertise preferred. 
 - Emulation technology of Zebu, Palladium or Mentor Veloce or FPGA Prototyping would be preferred. 
 - Self-motivated engineer with passion for innovation and demonstrated out-of-box thinking is strongly required.

data.description:

At Allegion, we help keep the people you know and love safe and secure where they live, work and visit. With more than 40 brands, 14, 000+ employees globally and products sold in 130 countries, we specialize in security around the doorway and beyond. 

Additionally, Allegion is proud to be recognized with the 2026 Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award (GEWA) for the third consecutive year, earning distinction in both the employee engagement and strengths categories. This year, Allegion also received Gallup's With Distinction honor - a designation reserved for a select group of organizations that go above and beyond in building exceptional workplace cultures. 

Key Responsibilities

Product Validation & DVP&R

- Develop and own Design Verification Plans & Reports (DVP&R) aligned with product requirements, standards, and engineering intent. 
 - Plan and execute mechanical functional, durability, lifecycle, performance, and environmental tests. 
 - Ensure full traceability between requirements, DVP&R and compliance with applicable regulatory and industry standards. 
 - Review, approve, and present test reports and validation summaries. 

Test Fixture & Rig Development

- Lead the design, development, and validation of mechanical test fixtures, jigs, and automated test rigs. 
 - Create and review CAD designs ensuring accuracy, repeatability, safety, and test intent alignment. 
 - Define fixture and instrumentation needs early in the DVP&R phase. 
 - Support BOM creation, vendor coordination, fabrication, assembly, and commissioning. 
 - Drive continuous improvement of fixtures and rigs based on test data, failures, and design evolution

Measurement, Data Logging & Instrumentation (Hands-On)

- Perform hands-on setup and configuration of measurement and data acquisition systems, including DEWESoft or equivalent DAQ platforms. 
 - Select, integrate, and validate sensors such as load cells, strain gauges, displacement, torque, pressure, and temperature sensors. 
 - Define sampling rates, channel configurations, filtering, triggering, and synchronization to ensure high‐quality data capture. 
 - Ensure measurement accuracy through calibration, system validation, and troubleshooting of signal issues. 

Automation & Test Systems

- Define functional and performance requirements for PLC‐controlled and automated test systems, and collaborate with automation engineers to develop, troubleshoot, and optimize PLC logic. 
 - Integrate PLC controls with DAQ and data‐logging systems to enable synchronized testing and measurement. 
 - Ensure reliability, repeatability, and safe operation of all test equipment. 

Data Analysis & Root Cause Analysis

- Identify failure mechanisms using measurement data, instrumentation feedback, and physical inspection. 
 - Analyze test data to identify trends, degradation behaviour, and failure modes. 
 - Lead root cause analysis (RCA) using structured problem-solving methods (5‐Why, Fishbone, DFMEA, etc. ). 
 - Correlate laboratory test data with field performance and engineering feedback. 

Cross‐Functional Collaboration & Lab Ownership

- Partner with Product Design teams to support Design for Test (DFT) and validation readiness. 
 - Provide validation input to DFMEA and risk assessments. 
 - Own lab equipment, test rigs, instrumentation, and DAQ systems. 
 - Ensure compliance with safety, quality systems, 5S, calibration, and audit requirements. 
 - Support lab capability expansion and mentor test technicians. 

Required Skills & Experience

- Strong experience in DVP&R execution and mechanical product validation
 - Proven expertise in test fixture and rig design
 - Hands‐on experience with DEWESoft or similar data logging systems
 - Knowledge of sensors, DAQ systems, signal conditioning, and calibration
 - Experience with PLC-based or automated test systems
 - Strong RCA and failure analysis capability
 - Proficiency in CAD tools (Creo, SolidWorks, CATIA, or equivalent)
 - Familiarity with ECN, BOM, and product lifecycle processes
 - Excellent analytical, documentation, and communication skills

Preferred: Experience with architectural door hardware and exposure to BHMA / UL standards.

- Experience: 5+ years in mechanical design, testing, validation, or product assurance roles

Observability & Debuggability

Test Data & Environment Management

data.title: SoC Verification Technical Lead
data.description:
Alternate Job Title: 

- SoC Verification Technical Lead

We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent years in the trenches of SoC verification, where the difference between a chip that tapes out on schedule and one that slips six months often comes down to a verification plan you wrote in week two. You know that verification is not just about coverage numbers, it is about understanding what can actually break in silicon and making sure it does not. 

Leading a team does not mean delegating and disappearing. You are in the weaveform debugger alongside your engineers when a protocol violation shows up at 2am, and you can spot a gap in a testbench architecture during a design review without needing to see the code. You have learned to read a customer's SOC spec and immediately know where the risk lives, whether it is in the interconnect, the power domain crossings, or that custom accelerator block nobody wants to talk about yet. 

You do not wait for perfect requirements. You ask the right questions, build a verification plan that actually maps to what can go wrong, and adjust as the design evolves. At Synopsys, you will work directly with customers building chips for AI, automotive, aerospace, and high-performance computing, and the verification strategies you build will determine whether their silicon works. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead verification execution for customer SoC, subsystem, and IP projects, from verification planning through signoff, working directly with customer engineering teams to define scope and deliverables
 - Lead verification teams of 3-4 engineers, assigning tasks, reviewing testbenches and coverage reports, and mentoring engineers through complex debug scenarios
 - Develop verification plans that map customer requirements to testbench architecture, coverage goals, and resource allocation, then track execution and adjust as designs evolve
 - Integrate and deploy Synopsys VCS, Verdi, and third-party VIP for protocols like PCIe, Ethernet, USB, and DDR into customer verification environments
 - Debug complex multi-protocol and multi-domain SoC issues using waveform analysis, coverage analysis, and cross-functional collaboration with design, architecture, and post-silicon teams
 - Identify project risks early, propose mitigation strategies, and communicate status and blockers to Synopsys management and customer stakeholders
 - Drive methodology improvements across the SSG verification team, whether that is UVM reuse strategies, regression optimization, or new tool adoption

The Impact You Will Have

- Your verification plans and execution will directly determine whether customer chips tape out on schedule or slip quarters, affecting product launch timelines for AI accelerators, automotive SoCs, and aerospace systems
 - The engineers you mentor will grow into technical leads themselves, building verification capability across Synopsys that scales to future customer engagements
 - Your early identification of design risks and verification gaps will prevent costly respins and post-silicon surprises for customers building chips in 5nm and below
 - The methodology improvements you drive will reduce verification cycle time and improve coverage quality across dozens of SSG projects annually
 - Your direct customer engagement will shape how leading semiconductor companies adopt and deploy Synopsys EDA tools and IP in their verification flows
 - The testbench architectures and VIP integration strategies you build will become reusable assets for future projects, compressing ramp time for new customer engagements
 - Your technical leadership will help Synopsys win and retain customer relationships in high-performance computing, automotive, and aerospace markets where verification complexity is a competitive differentiator

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's in Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field with 5+ years of hands-on SoC, subsystem, or IP verification experience
 - Deep technical expertise in UVM testbench development, coverage analysis, verification planning, and complex multi-domain debug
 - Proven experience leading verification teams through full project cycles, including resource planning, task assignment, and delivery against customer schedules
 - Strong working knowledge of industry-standard protocols such as PCIe, Ethernet, USB, or DDR, and how they interact in real SoC architectures
 - Hands-on proficiency with Synopsys VCS, Verdi or equivalent waveform analysis tools, and integration of third-party VIP into verification environments
 - Experience with ARM-based technologies including Coresight debug infrastructure, processor architecture, or AMBA protocols is a strong plus
 - Solid understanding of ASIC design flows, RTL design concepts, and how verification fits into the broader chip development process

Who You Are

- You can walk into a customer meeting, hear a high-level SoC architecture description, and walk out with a verification plan that identifies the three highest-risk areas before anyone else in the room sees them
 - When a regression fails at 3am and your team is stuck, you can look at the waveform, the coverage report, and the testbench code and know within 15 minutes whether it is a real bug or a testbench issue
 - You give feedback that makes engineers better, not just feedback that makes you feel heard, and your team knows the difference
 - You do not let a project drift. If a customer requirement is vague or a timeline is unrealistic, you say so early and propose a path forward that actually works
 - You can explain a complex protocol violation to a customer architect, a verification coverage gap to your manager, and a UVM sequence bug to a junior engineer, and all three conversations will be clear and useful
 - You stay current on verification methodology and tooling not because it is required but because you care about doing this work well, and you bring that knowledge back to your team

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join the System Solutions Group (SSG), a team that delivers end-to-end SoC design and verification services to Synopsys customers across automotive, high-performance computing, aerospace, and defense. SSG works on everything from individual IP blocks to full turnkey SoCs, partnering with customers ranging from startups to industry leaders and government agencies. Your verification work will span subsystems and full chips, and you will collaborate closely with Synopsys architecture, design, EDA application engineering, and sales teams to deploy tool and IP solutions that solve real customer problems. 

Rewards And Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.title: Principal Delivery Architect
data.description:
Role Mandate & Core Responsibilities

You own the thread from customer problem to production outcome. The role is consultative and hands-on: determine what should be built, architect how it should work, guide delivery, remove blockers and ensure the solution can scale. 

1. Customer Discovery & Value

• Lead R&D/QC discovery and requirements workshops; understand science, process, data, pain points and constraints. 

• Quantify value, define success criteria and guide customers toward scalable, sustainable choices. 

2. Solution & Delivery Architecture

• Architect end-to-end solutions spanning DLX, instruments, CDS/LIMS/ELN/LES, APIs, databases, cloud and enterprise systems. 

• Translate requirements into functional, integration, data, security and deployment architecture; own delivery-level technical decisions. 

3. Scalable Delivery & Industrialization

• Establish First-of-Kind patterns and Adaptive Workflows for materially distinct instrument/application families. 

• Drive configuration-led reuse, process harmonization and wave-based scale across laboratories and sites. 

4. Forward Deployed Leadership

• Act as the technical bridge between the customer and PAS, ESG, Product, Engineering, Validation, Support and PMO. 

• Surface dependencies early, accelerate decisions, resolve blockers and bridge central program teams with site/lab stakeholders. 

5. AI-Enabled Lab Transformation

• Translate AI agents and automation into concrete scientific and operational use cases. 

• Map AI opportunities to customer pain points and identify practical uses across data processing, decision support, testing, documentation and delivery. 

6. Proof of Value & Production Readiness

• Lead or advise PoV, pilot and early-production engagements; define success criteria for functionality, security, operability, scalability and reuse. 

• Ensure solutions are testable, monitorable, supportable, traceable and ready for production. 

7. Regulatory & Validation Alignment

• Work with QA/Validation to align delivery with GxP, CSA/CSV, 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5 and data-integrity expectations. 

• Understand intended use and validation impact; ensure evidence supports the agreed assurance strategy. 

8. Cross-Functional & Commercial Alignment

• Partner with Sales, Services, Product, Engineering, Strategy, Marketing and Customer Success. 

• Review SOWs, estimates, assumptions and technical proposals for achievability; feed customer insight into roadmap and methodology. 

9. Technical Governance & Team Multiplication

• Provide technical governance across internal teams, customer stakeholders, System Integrators and vendors. 

• Mentor PAS teams and create reusable architectures, playbooks, templates, patterns and implementation accelerators. 

10. Competitive & Market Awareness

• Understand the lab technology and integration landscape and articulate Scitara's differentiation. 

• Connect technology choices to business value, scalability, risk and total cost of ownership. 

Experience & Technical Bar

Experience

• Typically 10+ years in pharma/life-sciences technology, laboratory informatics, scientific software, enterprise integration or adjacent domains. 

• Significant customer-facing technical/consulting experience with evidence of leading discovery, architecture or complex implementations. 

Scientific & Laboratory Domain

• Strong understanding of R&D and/or QC processes and scientific data flows. 

• Demonstrated ability to solve real scientific/laboratory problems; applications scientist, lab informatics, lab manager or scientist experience is a strong differentiator. 

Lab Informatics & Instruments

• Working knowledge of LIMS, ELN, LES, CDS, scientific data platforms, laboratory automation and instrument integration. 

• Exposure to platforms such as Empower, Chromeleon, UNICORN/ÄKTA, SoftMax Pro, Magellan, LabX and common analytical instruments is desirable. 

Enterprise Integration & Cloud

• Strong understanding of APIs, JSON/XML, file interfaces, SQL/databases, event-driven integration, mapping/transformation, authentication, error handling and retry/recovery. 

• Comfort with cloud/hybrid architecture and enterprise networking; AWS knowledge is advantageous. 

Regulated Delivery

• Working knowledge of GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, ALCOA+, CSA/CSV, data integrity and regulated-system lifecycle expectations. 

• Able to engage credibly with QA/Validation stakeholders. 

Education & Mobility

• Bachelor's degree or above in a scientific, engineering, computer science or related discipline. 

• Excellent verbal, written, presentation and listening skills; willing to travel domestically and internationally, typically 20-30%. 

AI & Software Engineering Expectations

AI PROFICIENCY IS A CORE EXPECTATION

AI is not a future training objective for this role. Candidates should already demonstrate active, self-directed use of modern AI technologies and a willingness to build with them. 

Expected AI Familiarity

• Generative AI / LLMs; agentic AI; prompt/context engineering; tool/function calling; RAG; AI-assisted development and workflow automation. 

Evidence We Expect

• Courses, prototypes, projects or internal initiatives completed through self-directed learning. 

• Examples of agents, automations or AI-enabled workflows personally explored or built. 

Software & Data

• Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript proficiency is strongly preferred. 

• Comfort with APIs, structured data and data-engineering approaches for analytics and AI/ML. 

How You Will Apply AI

• Improve discovery, design, coding, testing, documentation, troubleshooting and knowledge retrieval. 

• Help customers design AI-enabled scientific workflows grounded in trusted, contextualized data. 

Leadership DNA

Consultative Leadership - Ask incisive questions and recommend - do not simply accept requirements. 

Ownership - Stay accountable for outcomes and drive issues through to closure. 

Technical Credibility - Earn the confidence of scientists, architects and engineers. 

Executive Presence - Make complex issues clear and actionable for senior stakeholders. 

Constructive Challenge - Professionally disagree when evidence or customer outcomes require it. 

Decision Making - Make sound recommendations even when information is incomplete. 

Influence Without Authority - Mobilize teams and vendors across organizational boundaries. 

Commercial Awareness - Understand how technical choices affect scale, effort, risk and total cost. 

Curiosity - Continuously learn, experiment and stay current - especially in AI. 

Low Ego, High Accountability - Prioritize outcomes and team success over hierarchy or visibility. 

Who Should Apply

This role is designed for a rare combination of domain expert, architect, consultant and delivery leader. You should recognize yourself in most of the statements below: 

• You can walk into an ambiguous customer situation and quickly structure the problem. 

• You are comfortable leading scientists, architects, QA leaders, engineers and executives in the same discussion. 

• You can move from scientific workflow to architecture to delivery implications without losing the thread. 

• You challenge unnecessary customization and naturally look for reusable, scalable patterns. 

• You make recommendations and decisions rather than waiting for perfect information. 

• You influence teams and vendors that do not report to you. 

• You remain engaged through production; you do not stop at the architecture hand-off. 

• You actively experiment with AI and modern software practices because curiosity is part of how you work. 

THE MINDSET

A strong implementation specialist asks: "What needs to be built?" A Principal Delivery Architect asks: "What problem are we solving, what should we build, how should we architect it, and how do we make it repeatable, scalable and successful in production?"

Why Join Scitara?

Shape Digital Labs

• Work on enterprise-scale transformation of pharmaceutical and life-sciences laboratories. 

Solve Hard Problems

• Operate across instruments, scientific applications, enterprise systems, cloud, data and regulated processes. 

Lead at the AI Frontier

• Help define how AI, agents and automation are applied to trusted scientific data and workflows. 

Influence Product & Delivery

• Turn customer experience into better product decisions, architecture patterns and delivery methods. 

Work With Global Experts

• Engage directly with scientists, architects, executives, technology vendors and System Integrators. 

Multiply Your Impact

• Create reusable patterns and methods that can scale across hundreds of instruments, laboratories and sites. 

What Success Looks Like

• Customers treat you as a trusted technical advisor, not simply a vendor resource. 

• Solutions are scalable, supportable and production-ready - not one-off implementations. 

• First-of-Kind patterns are deliberately reused and industrialized. 

• Technical and organizational dependencies are surfaced early and resolved quickly. 

• Services teams become more capable because you mentor, standardize and create reusable playbooks. 

• AI is used practically to improve both customer solutions and delivery productivity. 

FINAL EXPECTATION

We are looking for someone who can understand the scientific and business problem, determine the right solution, earn stakeholder confidence, make difficult technical decisions, mobilize the organization, and remain accountable until the outcome is successfully delivered and adopted. 

If your professional development stops when the working day ends, this role is unlikely to be the right fit. 

We are looking for people whose curiosity naturally drives them to experiment, learn, build and stay current with technologies changing the way scientific work is performed.

Team Overview

An M02 is responsible for managing a development team, ensuring delivery of software solutions, and aligning execution with business and product goals. 

The Role Balances

- People management
 - Technical oversight
 - Delivery accountability

Typically owns a single team of engineers This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week. 

Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Delivery

- Lead a team of software and data engineers (typically 5-10 members). 
 - Ensure timely and high-quality delivery of platform capabilities, data processing solutions, and feature enhancements. 
 - Drive execution of large-scale distributed processing initiatives and data platform modernization efforts. 
 - Foster a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and accountability. 

Technical Oversight

- Provide technical leadership for large-scale distributed data processing systems built on Apache Spark. 
 - Guide architecture, design, and implementation decisions for scalable, fault-tolerant, and high-performance data processing workloads. 
 - Establish best practices for Spark application development, optimization, observability, and operational excellence. 
 - Ensure adherence to coding standards, performance requirements, scalability guidelines, and security controls. 
 - Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex production issues involving Spark jobs, data pipelines, cluster performance, and resource management. 
 - Drive optimization of Spark workloads through partitioning strategies, query tuning, caching, memory management, and efficient resource utilization. 

Data Platform & Spark Engineering

- Design and oversee development of batch and real-time data processing pipelines using Apache Spark. 
 - Collaborate on architecture involving Spark, Iceberg, Hive, Hadoop, AWS EMR, AWS Glue, GCP Dataproc, BigQuery, and other modern cloud-native data platform technologies. 
 - Ensure reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency of enterprise-scale data workflows. 
 - Drive adoption of data engineering best practices, CI/CD automation, testing frameworks, and monitoring for Spark workloads. 
 - Champion performance benchmarking, capacity planning, and cost optimization initiatives across data processing platforms. 

Stakeholder Collaboration

- Work closely with product managers, architects, data scientists, platform teams, and business stakeholders. 
 - Translate business and data processing requirements into executable engineering plans. 
 - Communicate delivery status, technical risks, architectural decisions, and mitigation plans to leadership. 
 - Partner with cross-functional teams to deliver data-driven products and platform capabilities. 

People Management

- Conduct performance reviews, coaching, and regular feedback sessions. 
 - Mentor engineers in distributed systems, Spark development, performance optimization, and software engineering best practices. 
 - Build technical depth within the team through knowledge sharing and career development. 
 - Support hiring, onboarding, and growth of engineering talent with expertise in big data and distributed computing. 

Process & Quality Management

- Ensure Agile, SDLC and engineering governance practices are followed. 
 - Track delivery, quality, reliability, and operational metrics. 
 - Improve engineering productivity through automation, standardization, and platform improvements. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on system reliability, performance, and customer satisfaction. 

Required Knowledge And Experiences

Required Knowledge and Experience

Technical Expertise

- Strong hands-on experience with Apache Spark (Spark Core, Spark SQL, Structured Streaming, DataFrames, Dataset APIs). 
 - Proven experience building and operating large-scale distributed data processing systems. 
 - Strong understanding of Spark performance tuning, partitioning strategies, joins, shuffles, caching, memory management, and resource optimization. 
 - Experience with one or more programming languages such as Scala, Java, or Python. 
 - Experience with modern data ecosystems including Hadoop, Hive, Iceberg, AWS EMR, AWS Glue, GCP Dataproc, BigQuery, or equivalent technologies.

 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and scalability principles. 
 - Hands-on experience deploying and managing Spark workloads on AWS and/or GCP. 

Leadership Experience

- Proven experience leading engineering teams and delivering complex technical initiatives. 
 - Ability to balance hands-on technical leadership with people management responsibilities. 
 - Experience driving cross-functional collaboration and influencing technical direction. 
 - Demonstrated success managing technical roadmaps, execution planning, and delivery commitments. 

Scope & Positioning

- Mid-level management role positioned between Senior Engineer/Technical Lead and Senior Engineering Manager.

data.title: Program Director, Agriculture, AI Access Initiative (EAII Advisors)
data.description:
About The AI Access Initiative (2AI)

We're at an inflection point in artificial intelligence - presenting both tremendous potential opportunity and risk for people in developing countries. AI capabilities are improving on a timescale measured in months, while development systems often move on timescales measured in decades. Much of the technology needed for positive impact exists today, but few organizations exist to bridge research, deployment, and scaled implementation: we must act now to ensure AI's benefits reach people in poverty in LMICs. 

Incubated at Evidence Action, we're scaling The AI Access Initiative, an organization focused on scaling AI-enabled 'big bets' to benefit tens or hundreds of millions of people in poverty in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). We operate at the intersection of global development actors, top AI labs, and leading researchers to drive meaningful access to AI's benefits for the 3. 5 billion people living in poverty globally. We create "public good, " open-sourced playbooks, toolkits, and insights that define how to design and launch tractable and impactful AI-enabled programs. Given the scale of opportunity, we expect our portfolio to expand substantially, but to start, we're scaling two programs focused on AI in Agriculture and AI in Health. 

- Agriculture: We have an ambitious goal to reach 100M+ farmers with AI-enabled weather forecasts, expand forecast R&D to generate novel forecasts, and build public and private sector (WhatsApp, telcos) delivery channels to deliver new, LLM-generated voice and image content that maximizes behavior change. 
 - Health: Here, our initial goal is to scale AI-enabled clinical decision support to 20M+ people via telemedicine platforms, dramatically improving diagnosis and health outcomes at a national level. We are also planning to explore and test novel interventions for low-resource settings, including direct-to-consumer (DTC) health interventions. 

We are led by former Evidence Action CEO Kanika Bahl, a founding member of Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust, and advised by Nobel Laureate Michael Kremer; Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic; and Kent Walker, President, Global Affairs for Alphabet and Google. This work builds on Evidence Action's track record reaching 530M+ people with cost-effective, evidence-based programs across 9 countries in Africa and Asia, with a focus on last-mile delivery. 

About 2AI India And EAII Advisors

EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long-term wellbeing of children and families. 

2AI India is being incubated as a project within EAII Advisors, with plans to spin off into an independent entity at the end of this year. We are hiring a founding team: the first hires will shape the culture, establish the operating model, and own early wins before the organization scales. 

Roles And Responsibilities

The Program Director for Agriculture is the domain expert and relationship anchor for 2AI's first India program area. Agriculture is where 2AI India starts, beginning with AI-enabled weather forecasting and advisory services for smallholder farmers, with potential to expand into adjacent interventions over time. This person brings both substantive knowledge of the Indian agriculture sector and a network across government, research, and implementing organizations that can be activated quickly to accelerate program design and partnership development. 

This is a founding role, which means it is not only a strategy and relationships job. At this stage, everyone executes. We are looking for someone genuinely energized by what AI can do for farmers, who brings opinions and hypotheses rather than only process, and who is not so tied to any one institution's approach that it limits our ability to build something new. 

Program Strategy and Design

- Owns the strategy and multi-year plan for 2AI India's agriculture portfolio, and translates it into annual workplans with milestones and owners
 - Designs and oversees pilots across dissemination channels and intervention types, each with a clear learning agenda agreed with the Evidence Lead
 - Identifies which AI-enabled interventions are worth pursuing in the Indian context, forms a view on why, and revises it as evidence accumulates

Government and Partner Relationships

- Builds and holds trusted relationships with national and state agriculture departments, relevant central ministries, meteorological agencies, and agricultural universities and research institutions
 - Anticipates the needs of government counterparts while holding partnerships accountable to delivery commitments, and shows understanding of how policy decisions actually get made
 - Manages relationships with partners in implementation, research, technology, and AI labs, coordinating them toward a coherent program rather than a set of parallel projects
 - Represents 2AI India's agriculture work externally, including to funders and in sector forums

Hands-On Execution

- Does the early operational and analytical work personally. This is a founding-team role with a limited delegation layer underneath it. 
 - Works with the Associate Director, Program Operations to translate program design into action at the state level, bringing deep knowledge of state level realities to program strategy and management

Team Building

- Recruits, coaches, and manages the agriculture team as it grows, including state-level and field staff, and sets the performance standard for it
 - Builds a team culture that connects to 2AI globally, not only to the India office
 - Fosters a strong, values-aligned culture as a leader across the organization
 - Willingness to roll-up sleeves and pitch in to the organization building activities required of a founding team

Disclaimer: The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time. 

Requirements

Essentials

- Relevant professional background: 10-12 years of experience in agriculture, rural development, or a closely adjacent field, with a track record of scaling programs to reach large numbers of farmers. 
 - Deep sector knowledge: real depth in Indian smallholder agriculture, including farmer contexts, state-level agricultural systems in more than one state, relevant government ministries, and the ecosystem of implementing organizations and research institutions. 
 - Building & maintaining relationships: brings an established network across government, research, and implementation in Indian agriculture, and has also succeeded in forging new relationships rather than only maintaining inherited ones. Uses discretion, reads the policy decision process accurately at both state and central levels, and is trusted
 - Strategic thinking: sees the gap before it is named, and can hold an ambitious direction and a realistic view of constraints at the same time. Moves between operational detail and portfolio-level logic without losing either
 - Experience standing up a new program, venture, or state operation from scratch
 - Forward-looking on AI: genuinely energized by what AI can do for farmers, current on what is actually working, and motivated to figure out what that looks like in the Indian context. Brings hypotheses, not just processes
 - Builder instincts: Experience standing up a new program, venture, or state operation from scratch. Low ego, no task too small, and willing to do the operational and analytical work personally at this stage
 - People management: has built teams that were cohesive, motivated, and mission-driven, and can point to people who grew under them
 - Clear communication: translates technical information into common language, and writes and presents compellingly for government, funder, and technical audiences
 - Comfort with ambiguity: thrives in high-growth scenarios, adjusts quickly to shifting timelines and priorities, and is comfortable with a direction that may change every three to six months in the near term

What Success Looks Like

In the First 6 Months: 

- You are implementing a program strategy for agriculture you co-designed with the 2AI India Country Director, with clear prioritization, milestones, and ongoing learnings incorporated via quick feedback loops
 - At least one substantive state or central government relationship has moved from introduction to an active working conversation about delivery
 - A first pilot or design partnership is scoped, with a learning agenda agreed with the Evidence Lead, and you know what would cause you to stop it
 - You have hired, or supported the Associate Director, Program Operations in hiring, the capacity the program needs at both the national and state level during it's initial launch and scale-up

Compensation

Competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience, and previous pay scale. 

Benefits

EAII provides a comprehensive benefits package for employees. Benefits include: 

- Comprehensive health insurance with IPD and OPD provisions
 - Life and Accidental insurance
 - PF, ESIC and Gratuity as per statutory requirements
 - Generous leave
 - Mental and physical wellbeing benefits
 - Learning & Development benefits
 - Avenues for engagement and recognition

Note: This role will be open for applications until 9 October 2026. Please apply at your earliest convenience. We may close this search earlier than the specified date if we find the right fit. Due to the volume of applications received, we will only be able to contact shortlisted candidates.
