data.title: Senior Staff Agentic AI Engineer
data.description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world's digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet. 

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future. 

Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers-because progress starts with fresh ideas. You'll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you-because when you feel valued, you're empowered to do your best work. 

Job Summary

Build the Agents That Build Our Software

Most engineering roles now come with AI tools. This one comes with a mission. Equinix Incubation builds the agentic systems that run the software delivery lifecycle end to end: from intake and business case through design, code, test, release, and value tracking, with humans directing the work and owning every gate. 

We are hiring Staff and Senior Staff Engineers to build those agents and the platform they run on. You will not just use AI to code faster. You will design, ship, evaluate, and harden production agents that colleagues across a global organization trust with real delivery work. Your agents will write software; your engineering decides what ships. 

What You'll Do

Build Production AI Agents

- Design, build, and ship LLM-powered agents that execute real lifecycle work: intake triage, estimation, requirements, technical design, coding, testing, release, and operations. 
 - Engineer the scaffolding that makes agents dependable: tool use via MCP, agent-to-agent handoffs (A2A), event-driven orchestration, and deep Jira and enterprise system integration. 
 - Build on Equinix's enterprise AI platform: AI gateway, orchestration, audit, and access control, with security and privacy by design. 

Make Agents Trustworthy: Evals, Guardrails, Gates

- Design and automate eval suites that measure agent output quality on every change, and make passing evals the release gate for agents. 
 - Define guardrails, human-in-the-loop approval points, review thresholds, and escalation paths, so agent autonomy is earned, not assumed. 
 - Instrument agent behavior end to end (quality, latency, cost, adoption), find failure patterns, and tune prompts, context, and configurations until the numbers move. 

Engineer Context and Knowledge

- Build the knowledge layers agents depend on: retrieval over process libraries, decision histories, code, and delivery data. 
 - Establish reusable prompt patterns, context standards, and agent configurations that other teams adopt. 
 - Own agents through their full lifecycle: instructions, context freshness, performance monitoring, feedback, and retirement. 

Ship the Platform and Raise the Bar

- Contribute to the orchestrator, persona consoles, and dashboards that keep humans in command of agent-led delivery. 
 - Dogfood relentlessly: use agents to build agent systems, and feed what you learn back into the platform. 
 - Bring strong engineering craft. The fundamentals still decide whether this works: architecture, code quality, testing, CI/CD, and cloud-native design. 

What Success Looks Like

- Agents you built are doing live delivery work, with measurable cycle-time and quality gains, and humans confidently in control. 
 - Your eval suites are the reason people trust agent output; "passes evals" means something because you made it mean something. 
 - Your context patterns, guardrails, and agent standards are reused by teams you have never met. 
 - You can explain to an executive, in plain language, what an agent did, why, and how you know. 
 - The platform gets simpler, faster, and cheaper as it scales, because you treat agent cost and reliability as engineering problems. 

Required Qualifications

- 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a record of shipping and operating production systems. 
 - Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications or agents: prompt and context engineering, tool calling, retrieval, or multi-agent workflows. 
 - Experience designing evaluations for AI systems, or strong test-engineering instincts you are eager to apply to non-deterministic software. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript, plus solid API, microservices, and event-driven architecture skills. 
 - Fluency with modern engineering practice: Git, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, and cloud platforms. 
 - Sound judgment about when to trust automation and when to demand human review, and the communication skills to explain that reasoning. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with agent frameworks and protocols such as MCP, A2A, Anthropic or OpenAI APIs, Bedrock, Vertex, or LangGraph. 
 - Experience building developer platforms, orchestration systems, or SDLC tooling, including Jira, GitHub, or ServiceNow integration. 
 - Knowledge-engineering experience: retrieval systems, embeddings, or enterprise knowledge graphs. 
 - Experience taking AI features through security, privacy, and responsible AI review in an enterprise. 
 - Evidence of craft: open-source contributions, technical writing, or internal platforms with devoted users. 

Core Competencies

Agent Engineering

- LLM application architecture; prompt and context engineering; tool use and orchestration; multi-agent design. 

Evals and Trust

- Eval design and automation; guardrails and human-in-the-loop gates; AI observability; responsible AI governance. 

Platform Craft

- API and event-driven design; CI/CD and automation; cloud-native engineering; enterprise integration. 

Judgment and Impact

- Systems thinking; pragmatic risk-taking; mentoring and standards-setting; clear communication. 

Why This Role

Incubation is a durable capability, not a project team: the team persists, and the product rotates. Agentic delivery is product one; the next incubation bets follow. You will help define how AI-first engineering works at Equinix, with the autonomy of a startup and the reach of a global platform company. Few roles let you change how an entire organization builds software. This one exists to do exactly that. 

Equinix is committed to ensuring that our employment process is open to all individuals, including those with a disability. If you are a qualified candidate and need assistance or an accommodation, please let us know by completing this form. 

Equinix is an Equal Employment Opportunity and, in the U. S. , an Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to unlawful consideration of race, color, religion, creed, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, place of birth, citizenship, sex, pregnancy / childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic partnership status, age, veteran or military status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, political / organizational affiliation, status as a victim or family member of a victim of crime or abuse, or any other status protected by applicable law. 

We use artificial intelligence in our hiring process. Learn more here.

Supplier Development Engineer

Role Summary

The Supplier Development Engineer is responsible for supporting the development, qualification, and improvement of supplier capability and capacity in line with strategic business initiatives. The role focuses on improving supplier performance, competitiveness, quality, delivery, cost, capacity, process capability, certifications, and compliance. 

Working closely with Procurement, Quality, Engineering, Category Management, and Divisional teams, this position drives proactive supplier-development activities, continuous improvement, supplier readiness, risk mitigation, and long-term supplier partnerships. The role may also provide technical subject-matter expertise and support for reactive supplier-performance issues, including critical root-cause corrective-action activities. 

The Supplier Development Engineer, Specialist supports supplier onboarding, qualification, capability evaluations, supplier audits, and improvement programs to help meet operational, quality, cost, sustainability, and supply-continuity objectives. 

Key Responsibilities

Supplier Development and Performance Improvement

- Lead supplier-development initiatives to improve supplier quality, delivery, cost, capacity, certifications, process development, and compliance. 
 - Identify underperforming suppliers and establish structured improvement plans with defined key performance indicators. 
 - Support the development and qualification of key suppliers' capability and capacity in support of strategic initiatives. 
 - Drive supplier continuous-improvement projects using Lean, Six Sigma, or similar methodologies. 
 - Provide supplier-development support for assigned Category Management and Divisional team initiatives. 
 - Act as a key escalation resource for supplier-performance issues and support critical root-cause corrective-action activities when required. 

Supplier Assessment, Qualification, and Onboarding

- Conduct supplier assessments, audits, capability evaluations, and PPAP reviews to support new supplier approvals and onboarding. 
 - Support supplier onboarding, qualification, and development programs. 
 - Evaluate supplier capability, process readiness, certifications, and compliance against company requirements. 
 - Ensure suppliers meet applicable company standards, regulatory requirements, quality-system expectations, and sustainability goals. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner with Procurement to support sourcing strategies and supplier segmentation. 
 - Work collaboratively with Procurement, Quality, Engineering, Category Management, and Divisional teams to support supplier-development priorities. 
 - Support Product Development Lifecycle activities, including supplier-readiness activities and globalization/localization projects. 
 - Maintain clear, open, two-way communication with relevant internal stakeholders and suppliers. 
 - Build strong, collaborative relationships with strategic and critical suppliers. 

Supplier Risk and Supply Continuity

About Lilly

At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50, 000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work-but it's work worth doing. If you're driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. 

Manufacturing & Quality Technical Hub, Hyderabad

Lilly's Hyderabad hub is a first-of-its-kind technical center built to lead the manufacturing and quality science agenda for Lilly's global supply network, and the work done here reaches patients in more than 110 countries. 

This hub oversees contract manufacturing of starting materials and intermediates for API manufacturing in India, managing the full scientific agenda for manufacturing and quality. We're building a cutting-edge scientific organization and looking for top talent in process engineering, chemistry, analytical and data sciences to be part of it. 

The science you develop here doesn't stay here. It moves through Lilly's global supply network and reaches patients across more than 110 countries who are counting on it. 

Digital Manufacturing Engineering (DME) is part of the Corporate Engineering Tech Center (ETC). The ETC is a technical resource for training, standards, project implementation, and the center of engineering excellence for the corporation, providing deeply technical resources to solve the most intractable technical problems in manufacturing. DME provides Digital Engineering Platform ownership, OT data integration solutions, engineering data standardization/ownership, and digital manufacturing solutions for Lilly Manufacturing. Our team focuses on connecting our facilities (securely) and leveraging the data from those facilities to deliver digital manufacturing solutions to improve manufacturing productivity, data integrity / compliance, quality, and operational excellence. Digital Manufacturing Technologies include digital twins, computational modeling, edge/IoT, and analytics solutions. Digital Engineering Platforms include CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System), GECMS (Global Engineering Content Management System) and many other digital platforms leveraged by engineers across Lilly Manufacturing. 

Position Description And Responsibilities

The Principal Digital Solutions Engineer will design, develop, support, and continuously enhance digital solutions across Lilly's global manufacturing network, while serving as the owner for one or more digital products developed by the DME team. Representative solutions in scope span the four pillars of the Engineering Digital Strategy and include - but are not limited to - the Intralogistics Monitor (ILM), Audit Trail solutions, Condition-Based Maintenance solutions, RCA and troubleshooting solutions, equipment health and predictive maintenance dashboards, capital project and qualification workflow tools, engineering knowledge search, and inspection-readiness data products. These solutions are developed on standard Digital Engineering Platforms supported by the DME team, and the engineer will partner with data leads to ensure the necessary IT, OT, and ET data is available to support each solution. The engineer is also expected to leverage AI tools and platforms - such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, and Anthropic's Claude - to accelerate development and to embed AI capability into solutions, including building agent skills, prompt-based workflows, and retrieval/automation patterns on top of existing Lilly-approved AI platforms. This role is not focused on training or developing foundation models; it is focused on applying AI tools effectively and responsibly to manufacturing problems. This is a global role, supporting functional initiatives and all Lilly Manufacturing sites globally. 

This role operates within an evolved Digital Solutions Engineering operating model. The team includes a Rapid Innovation branch that works at speed to prototype concepts and proof-of-value solutions against key business problems surfaced from the manufacturing network. The Principal Digital Solutions Engineer takes ownership of those solutions once they have been validated as worth scaling - maturing them from prototype to production-grade, hardening them for validated-system and data-integrity requirements, deploying and supporting them across sites, and providing long-term ownership over their roadmap, enhancement, and lifecycle. This split lets the Rapid Innovation branch stay focused on speed and discovery while the Principal Digital Solutions Engineer ensures that the most valuable concepts become durable, well-supported solutions that scale across the global manufacturing network. 

The primary focus of the role is twofold. First, to develop and continuously enhance high-quality digital solutions that deliver measurable value to manufacturing operations - improving productivity, data integrity and compliance, quality, and operational excellence. Second, to assume the role of owner for those solutions: defining the product roadmap, managing the backlog, owning the technical architecture and lifecycle, ensuring compliance with validated-system requirements, and providing direct technical support to global users across Lilly Manufacturing. The engineer will work under guidance of the Digital Program Lead and partner closely with site engineers, network engineering organizations, and IT/OT platform owners to ensure each solution remains fit-for-purpose as the network and the underlying technology landscape evolve. 

Key Objectives/Deliverables

- Develop and continuously enhance digital solutions in support of the Engineering Digital Strategy for Manufacturing and Quality across its four pillars: Asset Delivery & Qualification, Asset Performance/Maintenance & Reliability, Engineering Fundamentals, and Training & Knowledge Management. 
 - Build and own solutions across a broad portfolio that may include: the Intralogistics Monitor (ILM), Audit Trail solutions, Condition-Based Maintenance solutions, equipment health and predictive maintenance dashboards, RCA and troubleshooting tools, capital project and equipment qualification workflow tools, engineering knowledge search, change-management assistants, and inspection-readiness data products. 
 - Serve as owner for one or more DME-developed digital products, including ownership of the product roadmap, backlog, technical architecture, and full lifecycle from build through sustained operation. 
 - Partner with the Rapid Innovation branch of the Digital Solutions Engineering team to take in validated prototypes and proof-of-value solutions, then mature them into production-grade, validated, scalable solutions ready for global deployment. 
 - Lead the deployment of solutions across Lilly Manufacturing sites - including site onboarding, configuration, change management, training, and stand-up of ongoing support. 
 - Provide direct technical support for owned solutions across the global manufacturing network - triaging issues, performing root cause analysis, delivering fixes, and managing the change and release process to keep solutions reliable and validated. 
 - Drive continuous enhancement of solutions in production, prioritizing improvements based on user feedback, operational data, evolving site needs, and emerging technology capabilities. 
 - Leverage AI tools and platforms - such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, and Anthropic's Claude - to accelerate solution development, automate routine engineering tasks, and embed AI capability into DME solutions. This includes building agent skills, prompts, retrieval-augmented patterns, and automated workflows on top of existing Lilly-approved AI platforms; it does not include training or developing foundation models. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI tools and patterns and integrate them responsibly into DME solutions, in alignment with Lilly's AI governance, data integrity, and validated-system requirements. 
 - Write, review, and maintain production-quality Python code that powers DME digital solutions; establish and uphold development standards, code review practices, and version control discipline. 
 - Build analytics, monitoring, and visualization capabilities using Seeq and Power BI to surface manufacturing insights to engineers, operators, and leadership. 
 - Partner with data leads within DME to define and provide the IT, OT, and ET data requirements needed to support each solution, and ensure data flows are reliable, governed, and fit-for-purpose. 
 - Ensure all solutions are designed, operated, and enhanced in accordance with validated-system, data-integrity, and GMP requirements, and develop and implement the associated technical requirements and documentation. 
 - Develop proof-of-concept solutions to explore new concepts within the Engineering Digital Strategy and progress them toward production-grade deployments. 
 - Ensure solutions focus on value generation and demonstrate measurable impact on manufacturing capacity, resilience, compliance, and operational excellence. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Computer/Software Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering/science field. 
 - Minimum 3 years manufacturing experience. 
 - Demonstrated software development experience, with a strong working knowledge of Python. 
 - Knowledge of manufacturing datasets and experience accessing and using IT, OT, and ET data sources. 
 - Experience leveraging data to solve problems within a manufacturing environment. 
 - Experience working with validated systems. 
 - Experience in pharma or GMP industry. 

Additional Skills/Preferences

- Hands-on experience building solutions in Seeq (advanced analytics, asset framework, monitoring) and Power BI (data modeling, DAX, dashboards). 
 - Experience acting as an owner or product owner for a production digital solution, including roadmap, backlog, technical support, and lifecycle ownership. 
 - Demonstrated experience providing ongoing technical support and continuous enhancement of digital solutions in a production environment. 
 - Experience leveraging AI tools and platforms (e. g. , Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar) to accelerate development and to build agent skills, prompts, and automated workflows. Experience training or developing foundation models is not required. 
 - Familiarity with industrial data sources and protocols (e. g. , Aveva PI, OPC UA, MQTT, historian/SCADA systems) and with enterprise data platforms (e. g. , Databricks, SQL/relational data stores). 
 - Experience with one or more of the example solution domains: intralogistics monitoring, audit trail/data-integrity tooling, condition-based maintenance, equipment health monitoring, RCA/troubleshooting, equipment qualification, capital project workflows, or engineering knowledge management. 
 - Familiarity with modern software engineering practices: source control (Git/Azure DevOps), CI/CD, automated testing, and code review. 
 - Strong technical writing and communication skills; ability to translate between manufacturing engineers, IT/OT teams, and software developers. 
 - Ability to work well across different cultures and global manufacturing sites. 

At Lilly, caring is not only what we do for patients. It is how we work. We believe the people who dedicate themselves to making medicines better deserve an environment that makes their lives better too, one where they are supported, respected, and given the space to do their best work. This is not just a policy. It is who we are.

 - Partner with cloud, application, infrastructure, and support teams to improve reliability and availability. 
 - Create and maintain technical documentation, standards, and operating procedures. 

How You'll Succeed

Observability & Engineering Expertise

 - Deep understanding of logs, metrics, traces, OpenTelemetry, and telemetry architecture. 
 - Strong Python and/or Golang development skills with API integration experience.

Automation & ARE

 - Understanding of ARE principles, autonomous operations, and self-healing architectures.

Collaboration & Delivery

WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences-from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career. 

Lead Software System Design Eng - System PNP

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated System Power & Performance Engineer to join our System PnP team. This role will have a dual focus: 

- Benchmarking, Profiling, and bottleneck analysis on AMD's system PnP stack, with emphasis on Linux and virtualized environments. 
 - Driving competitive benchmarking across market segments, comparing AMD SoCs against competition. 

The ideal candidate will combine strong technical depth in system performance analysis with a passion for competitive evaluation, ensuring AMD delivers industry-leading performance and power efficiency. 

Key Responsibilities

System Power & Performance / PnP

- Plan, execute and own system performance including low level profiling and bottleneck analysis on AMD's SoCs, focusing on Linux (Ubuntu, Yocto) and virtualized software stacks for Robotics, automotive and industrial. 
 - Perform benchmark characterization, system-level tuning, micro architecture and workload analysis across CPU, GPU, NPU, AI and memory subsystems. 
 - Collaborate with SoC architects, BIOS/FW teams, and software developers to identify performance gaps and recommend optimizations. 
 - Generate comprehensive technical reports, dashboards, and documentation for leadership reviews, customer engagements, and outbound collateral. 
 - Contribute to automation for benchmark execution, data collection, and results visualization. 
 - Work with cross-functional teams to debug system-level issues blocking performance goals. 

Competitive Benchmarking

- Drive competitive benchmarking initiatives by running workloads on competitive platforms (Nvidia, Intel, Qualcomm, ARM-based SoCs) and building comparative landscapes across segments (client, embedded, industrial, automotive). 
 - Build comparative performance landscapes across segments including client, embedded, server, industrial, and automotive. 
 - Provide actionable insights that help influence future SoC, firmware, and platform design. 

Automation, Reporting & Documentation

- Support development of automation for benchmark execution, data collection, and results visualization. 
 - Generate technical reports, dashboards, and documentation for leadership and customer engagements. 
 - Foster continuous improvement and innovation within validation and performance analysis environments. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 14+ years of relevant experience in system performance engineering, profiling, bottleneck analysis, or post-silicon validation. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Linux system performance analysis; exposure to Android and virtualized stacks is a plus. 
 - Good to have experience with ROS2 framework, Robotics algorithms and components: 
 - Perception pipelines (SLAM, visual‐odometry, sensor fusion)
 - Planning & control loops
 - Kinematics, dynamics, and real-time constraints
 - Middleware communication patterns: pipes, shared memory, zero‐copy
 - Expert in Linux internals (scheduling, memory management), Real Time systems (RT kernel, interrupt and jitter), QoS Tuning. 
 - Hands on in performance profiling tools: Perf, valgrind, LTTng, perfetto, Trace Compass, wireshark, Nsight, Vtune, Oprofile, Flameghraphs, GPU Perf studio etc
 - Strong understanding of x86 SoC architecture, CPU/GPU/NPU performance, memory hierarchy, PCIe, BIOS/FW interactions, and system-level behavior. 
 - Experience with industry benchmarking suites such as SPEC, 3DMark, PCMark, GFXBench, MLPerf, MobileMark, browser benchmarks, and multimedia workloads. 
 - Proficiency in Python/Bash/C/C++/Perl for automation, data processing, and reporting. 
 - Strong knowledge of embedded OSes and hypervisors (Linux, Windows Server, VMware, KVM, Xen, etc. ). 
 - Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in fast-paced environments. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills with experience producing clear, data-driven reports. 
 - Proven cross-team collaboration skills and ability to drive complex debug efforts. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with virtualization technologies (Xen, KVM, Hyper-V, container environments). 
 - Exposure to post-silicon bring-up, system validation flows, and early silicon testing. 
 - Experience with competitive benchmarking methodologies and customer-facing documentation. 
 - Debug expertise at system level and SoC level. 

Education

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager, MineStar
data.description:
Career Area

Engineering

Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. 

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do - but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here - we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. 

Senior Engineering Manager, MineStar

Your Work Shapes the World

Whether it is groundbreaking products, best-in-class solutions or creating a lifelong career, you can do work that matters at Caterpillar. When you join Caterpillar, you join a global team of makers, innovators and doers who turn progress and innovation into outcomes for customers and communities. 

Job Summary

Caterpillar is seeking a Senior Engineering Manager to provide product and technical leadership for MineStar development. This role leads engineering teams responsible for developing, integrating, enhancing, maintaining and supporting mining technology solutions that deliver measurable value for customers. 

The Senior Engineering Manager operates across a broader product and organisational scope than an Engineering Manager while providing direct leadership to engineering managers and supervisors in the organization. The role translates MineStar product strategy into executable engineering priorities, develops leaders and technical talent, and ensures teams deliver safe, reliable, supportable and competitive solutions. 

This leader will partner closely with product management, commercial and product support organisations, process owners, suppliers, dealers and mining customers. Success requires strong engineering judgement, disciplined program execution, customer focus, global collaboration and the ability to influence complex decisions through technical and business expertise. 

What You Will Do

- Lead a portfolio of MineStar product development, integration, enhancement, maintenance work, aligning engineering outcomes with product strategy and business priorities. 
 - Translate strategic direction into department objectives, roadmaps, resource plans, budgets and measurable delivery commitments across multiple teams or technical workstreams. 
 - Provide leadership and performance management for engineering managers, technical leaders and product development staff. Build succession strength and a high-performing leadership pipeline. 
 - Coordinate technical feasibility assessment, architecture and design optimisation, validation planning, cost and schedule management, risk assessment, mitigation and ongoing production support. 
 - Own or influence engineering investment decisions and manage the research and development budget for the assigned MineStar portfolio, balancing new capability, modernisation, quality, reliability and customer support. 
 - Establish governance and operating rhythms that provide stakeholders with clear visibility into scope, decisions, dependencies, risks, financial performance and delivery status. 
 - Guide the resolution of complex, cross-component and field issues by bringing together internal experts, suppliers, dealers and customer teams. Ensure that lessons learned improve future product and process decisions. 
 - Champion systems and software engineering discipline, technical excellence, cybersecurity, safety, quality, reliability, scalability and lifecycle support across MineStar solutions. 
 - Monitor customer needs, market dynamics, competitor movement and technology developments. Recommend product, capability and engineering responses that strengthen MineStar customer value and competitive position. 
 - Build strong partnerships across Caterpillar business units and functions and with external suppliers. Reconcile competing priorities and create shared accountability for outcomes. 
 - Represent MineStar with customers, dealers, suppliers and senior leaders, communicating complex technical and business issues clearly and serving as a trusted engineering adviser. 
 - Foster innovation, operational excellence, inclusion and continuous improvement while maintaining urgency and accountability for commitments. 

Education Requirement

- Bachelor's degree in an accredited Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering or closely related technical curriculum. 
 - An advanced technical or business degree is preferred. 

What Skills You Will Have

Planning: Tactical and Strategic

Develops integrated plans across multiple teams; converts product strategy into sequenced engineering priorities; allocates people and funding against the highest-value outcomes; and adjusts plans using data, risks and changing business conditions. 

Technical Excellence

Creates an environment that rewards technical excellence; provides recognised leadership on complex systems and software challenges; engages the appropriate subject-matter experts; and ensures decisions reflect sound architecture, engineering evidence and lifecycle considerations. 

Decision Making and Critical Thinking

Frames ambiguous problems, evaluates alternatives with multiple stakeholders, distinguishes facts from assumptions, anticipates second-order effects and makes timely decisions during high-impact or customer-critical situations. 

Product Design and Development

Leads cross-functional development from concept through production and support; strengthens development methods and governance; and balances customer value, speed, quality, cost, reliability and technical debt. 

Customer and Market Focus

Maintains a direct understanding of mining customer needs and success criteria; responds proactively to market and competitive shifts; resolves difficult customer issues; and converts field insight into prioritised product and engineering action. 

Influencing Through Expertise

Explains complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences; challenges decisions constructively with evidence; builds trust across organisational boundaries; and develops others as credible technical advisers. 

Collaborating Globally

Builds networks across functions, regions, dealers, suppliers and customers; reconciles conflicting interests; uses collective expertise to solve complex problems; and creates shared ownership for business results. 

People Leadership and Career Development

Develops managers and technical leaders, establishes business-driven development plans, identifies mission-critical capability gaps, supports targeted rotations and learning, and links talent decisions to long-term MineStar needs. 

Program, Financial and Risk Management

Manages a portfolio of commitments, budgets, dependencies and risks; establishes transparent operating mechanisms; and intervenes early when delivery, quality, cost or customer outcomes are at risk. 

Troubleshooting and Production Support

Directs the structured resolution of complex and non-recurring failures, coordinates internal and external experts, establishes mechanisms for problem tracking and organisational learning, and ensures corrective actions address root causes. 

Basic Qualifications

- Typically fifteen or more years of progressively responsible experience in engineering, software, systems or product development, including significant leadership responsibility. Equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading managers, technical leaders or multiple engineering teams delivering complex products or integrated systems. 
 - Experience managing product development scope, schedules, budgets, risks and production-support priorities. 
 - Experience working across organisational boundaries and communicating with senior leaders, customers and external partners. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, make evidence-based decisions and deliver outcomes through others. 

Top Candidates Will Also Have

- Experience with MineStar, mining technology, autonomy, fleet management, site systems or related digital products. 
 - Experience with software-intensive and systems-of-systems product development, including cloud and on-premises deployments and integration with machine or site technology. 
 - Experience implementing Gen AI development tools and practices. 
 - Knowledge of Caterpillar product development and new product introduction processes, or comparable lifecycle governance in a complex industrial environment. 
 - Experience modernising established products while maintaining compatibility, quality and customer continuity. 
 - Demonstrated success developing engineering managers and senior technical talent across global teams. 
 - Direct experience engaging mining customers, dealers, suppliers and product support organisations. 

Additional Information

- Location, relocation support and travel requirements will be confirmed for the final posting. 
 - The role is expected to include regular interaction with global teams, suppliers, dealers and mining customers. 
 - Final experience requirements and internal job classification should be validated with Human Resources before posting. 

What You Will Get

A career with a global team whose engineering work helps customers build a better, more sustainable world, together with Caterpillar total rewards and development opportunities applicable to the position and location

Posting Dates

October 12, 2026 - October 26, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

This suite of products helps customers in different industries (like finance, banking, eCommerce, airlines, etc. ) manage their API platforms and operations at scale. Our customers expect secure, reliable, high scale, low latency offerings from Kong whether running on-premise or in the public cloud. 

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will develop high-performance Go runtime, CLI engines and declarative state managers. You will architect the software that thousands of engineering teams use every day to interact with Kong's runtime - including deck (Kong's state management & drift detection engine), the Kong Terraform Provider, official Go SDKs and automated spec-driven API tooling. 

What You Will Build & Own

You will balance Software Development with APIOps Architecture: 

What You'll Bring: 

- Declarative Engine
 - State & Drift Management Engines: Design and optimize algorithms in Go for state diffing, validation, and real-time drift detection across large-scale multi-tenant API topologies. 
 - Go SDK & Core Libraries: Architect and maintain enterprise-grade, high-performance Go SDKs used by Kong's internal microservices and external clients to interface with the Konnect SaaS platform. 
 - API Design & Standardization: Define clean, extensible REST API contracts across Kong's platform runtimes. 
 - Code Generation & Tooling Pipelines: Architect spec-driven tooling (OpenAPI/AsyncAPI) to dynamically generate SDKs, client libraries, and IaC definitions without manual developer toil. 
 - APIOps & IaC Ecosystem
 - Core CLI Engineering: Build modern, fast, and intuitive CLI-first developer experiences designed for both human developer workflows and high-concurrency CI/CD automation pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins). 
 - Terraform & Provider Ecosystem: Build and extend high-reliability Terraform Providers to enable seamless IaC operations. 
 - Support for Next-Gen Runtimes: Bring new runtime capabilities into the declarative management ecosystem as native API primitives. 
 - 5+ years of software engineering experience designing and delivering production-grade backend systems and developer tools using Golang. 
 - API Design Mastery: Proven experience crafting intuitive, developer-friendly API schemas (REST, gRPC, OpenAPI), with a strong focus on backwards compatibility, versioning and developer experience (DX). 
 - Hands-on IaC / Platform Understanding: Production exposure to Terraform provider development, Kubernetes operators or stateful CI/CD automation pipelines. 
 - Engineering Rigor: Strong commitment to clean code, comprehensive automated testing (unit, integration, end-to-end), benchmarking and robust software architecture. 
 - Communication & Technical Leadership: Ability to articulate complex technical decisions, mentor junior engineers and collaborate across global backend and platform teams. 

Why Join Kong?

- Build for Engineers: Your work is open-source adjacent and directly impacts millions of developers and Fortune 500 enterprises around the globe. 
 - Solving Deep Technical Problems: Move beyond standard CRUD services to solve high-impact problems in declarative state sync, API governance and distributed connectivity. 
 - High-Growth Pre-IPO Startup: Scale your career alongside a market-leading company driving the future of API management and AI connectivity. 

About Kong

Kong Inc. , the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong's unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic - on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www. konghq. com.

data.title: DGM - APS & Lean Management
data.description:
Purpose of the Role

Managing and leading a cross-functional team of engineers and production specialists to design, deploy, and sustain a world-class Production System (PS) grounded in Lean Manufacturing principles. The role is pivotal in driving cultural and operational transformation across the cell manufacturing plant by embedding lean tools, methodologies, and a continuous improvement mindset at every level of the organisation. The DGM will be responsible for developing and implementing the Agratas Production System (APS) framework, standardising work processes, eliminating waste, and enabling measurable improvements in people, safety, quality, delivery, cost, maintenance, energy and environment (PPSQDCMEE). The role requires close collaboration with production, maintenance, quality, supply chain, and HR functions, as well as engagement with external partners and benchmarking organisations. 

Key Responsibility Areas

Technical / Functional

- Agratas Production System (APS) Development & Deployment: Design, develop, and implement a comprehensive Production System framework aligned with Lean principles (LEAN MANUFACTURING -PS-derived), covering all manufacturing areas of the cell plant. 
 - Lean Transformation Leadership: Lead end-to-end lean transformation initiatives across all shop floors, including Electrode, Assembly, Formation, and End-of-Line, ensuring sustained change management and cultural adoption. 
 - Value Stream Mapping (VSM): Conduct detailed current-state and future-state VSM exercises to identify waste, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities across the manufacturing value chain. 
 - Standardised Work & Work Instruction Management: Establish, maintain, and continuously improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), standardised work documents, and operator work instructions. 
 - Kaizen & Continuous Improvement Programme: Plan, facilitate, and drive structured Kaizen events, improvement workshops, and CI projects targeting PSQDCME metrics. Track and report savings and impact. 
 - 5S & Visual Management: Design and sustain 5S systems, visual factory standards, shadow boards, andon systems, and production control boards across all production areas. 
 - Line Balancing & Flow Optimisation: Lead cycle time studies, takt time analysis, line balancing exercises, and layout optimisation to enhance throughput and reduce WIP

Knowledge Generic

IT SkillsExperience with layout design, ergonomics, and material flow optimisation in greenfield or brownfield plants is desirable

- Proficiency in MS Excel (advanced), PowerPoint, and data analysis tools such as Minitab and project management. 
 - Familiarity with digital lean tools, plant simulation software, or Industry 4. 0 platforms is an advantage. 
 - Good presentation and facilitation skills for senior stakeholder engagement and shop-floor coaching. 
 - 
 - Strong understanding of the Lean manufacturing - Production System philosophy and its application in high-volume high-speed discrete or process manufacturing. 
 - Proven experience in leading large-scale lean transformations with measurable business impact. 
 - Knowledge of statistical process control (SPC), Six Sigma methodologies (Black Belt preferred), and problem-solving tools (A3, 8D, PDCA). 
 - Understanding of battery cell manufacturing processes (Mixing, Coating, Calendaring, Slitting, Assembly, Formation) is desirable. 
 - OEE Improvement: Drive Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) improvement programmes in collaboration with maintenance and production teams; identify and eliminate losses across availability, performance, and quality. 
 - Pull System & Kanban Implementation: Design and implement pull-based material flow systems, supermarkets, and Kanban replenishment loops across internal logistics and production areas. 
 - People Development & Lean Capability Building: Develop and deliver lean training programmes for all levels of the organisation, from operator to senior management. Coach and mentor internal lean champions. 
 - Production System Governance & Lean Maturity Model Adherence: Establish LMM frameworks to assess PS maturity, compliance, and sustainability. Drive corrective action plans based on findings. 
 - Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, Launch Integration, Supply Chain, and HR to align lean initiatives with overall plant and business objectives. 
 - Benchmarking & Best Practice: Lead external benchmarking activities across automotive and adjacent industries. Adapt and integrate best practices into the Agratas Production System. 
 - Project Management: Manage multiple lean and PS projects simultaneously, ensuring on-time delivery, resource allocation, budget adherence, and stakeholder communication. 
 - KPI Monitoring & Reporting: Define, track, and report on lean KPIs including lead time, cycle time, defect rates, first-pass yield, scrap, OEE, and cost savings to senior leadership. 
 - Establish metrics: Ability to identify and drive the drill down of organisational metrics to the front-line leadership level
 - Ability to integrate concepts such as TPM with the broader Production System and lean transformation

Job Context Specific

Mandatory / Desired

- Engineering degree in Mechanical / Industrial Engineering / Manufacturing Engineering or equivalent. 
 - Lean Six Sigma Green Belt (minimum); Black Belt preferred. 
 - Formal Lean / Production System training from an automotive OEM, Tier-1 supplier, or recognised lean institute. 

Mandatory Desired

- 15 to 20 years of experience in manufacturing operations with at least 8 to 10 years in a dedicated Lean / Production System role. 
 - Demonstrated track record of implementing Production Systems in high-volume manufacturing industries such as Automotive, Battery / EV, Pharma, Electronics, FMCG, Tyre, or Aerospace. 
 - Proven experience in building and leading lean teams, coaching frontline supervisors and managers, and driving cultural change. 
 - Experience working in greenfield manufacturing set-ups or transformative lean journeys from inception is strongly preferred.

data.title: ENGINEER - QUALITY (SPECIAL PROCESS)
data.description:
Sansera Engineering Limited

PRIME FUNCTION

To support Quality Control and Assurance activities for Special Processes in accordance with Nadcap, AS9100, customer, and regulatory requirements by performing inspections, maintaining records, monitoring process controls, and assisting with audits and corrective actions under the guidance of senior quality personnel. 

Job Description / Responsibilities

- Perform incoming, in-process, and final inspections for Special Process components as per approved procedures, drawings, specifications, and control plans. 
 - Verify process parameters, inspection results, and traceability records, and promptly report deviations to the responsible senior engineer or manager. 
 - Maintain inspection reports, process logs, check sheets, calibration status records, and other quality documentation. 
 - Support preparation for Nadcap, AS9100, customer, and internal audits by compiling records and ensuring workplace readiness. 
 - Assist in recording non-conformities, segregating nonconforming product, and supporting root cause analysis and corrective action implementation. 
 - Monitor basic quality indicators such as rejection, rework, first-pass yield, and process compliance, and escalate adverse trends. 
 - Coordinate with Production, Engineering, Maintenance, and other functions to resolve routine quality issues. 
 - Follow approved QMS procedures, safety requirements, work instructions, and good documentation practices. 
 - Participate in training, improvement activities, and assigned quality projects to build technical competence. 

AUTHORITY

- Authority to hold or identify nonconforming material and immediately escalate the issue to authorized quality personnel. 
 - Authority to request correction of incomplete or inaccurate inspection and process records. 
 - Authority to raise non-conformance reports and recommend corrective actions for review and approval. 
 - Authority to seek clarification when process, drawing, specification, or quality requirements are unclear. 

JOB SPECIFICATION / COMPETENCY

Qualification: 

- Diploma/B. E. /B. Tech in Mechanical, Production, Metallurgy, Industrial Engineering, or a relevant discipline

Experience: 

- 1-5 years of experience in Quality Control, Quality Assurance, manufacturing, or Special Processes; 

Technical Competencies

- Basic understanding of engineering drawings, specifications, inspection methods, and aerospace quality requirements. 
 - Awareness of SPC, RCA, FMEA, non-conformance control, and QMS practices. 
 - Basic awareness of Nadcap Special Process requirements and audit expectations. 
 - Awareness of AS9100 requirements, document control, and traceability. 

Behavioral Competencies

- Attention to detail, discipline, and willingness to learn. 
 - Basic analytical, problem-solving, and decision-support skills. 
 - Clear communication, teamwork, and timely escalation of quality concerns. 

Tools Required

- Quality Management System and document control applications

data.description:
About The Team

The Marketplace Platform is Walmart's horizontal engineering layer for the seller and partner ecosystem. Your technical ownership spans the full scope of the platform: 

The team drives platform standardization across marketplace verticals - defining and enforcing implementation patterns so teams build consistently, securely, and at scale. The Identity, Seller Profile & Org Data layer is the foundational data layer every vertical depends on for authentication, authorization, and seller context. The Communication Platform delivers multi-channel messaging across email, push, in-app, SMS, and webhooks - built for reliability, extensibility, and operational scale. External-Facing APls & Integration Health represent the public contract Walmart makes with its developer community, where quality, versioning, and observability are non-negotiable. 

The Reporting Portal enables self-serve access to diverse report types across the organization. The Developer Portal & Sandbox are the front door for developers integrating with Walmart's marketplace - from account creation through API discovery to sandboxed experimentation before hitting production. 

What You'll Own

Architecture & System Design

Lead end-to-end technical design for complex initiatives involving from API contracts, UI interfaces and data models to distributed system topologies and cross-cutting concerns. 

Drive platform standardization by defining and documenting reference architectures, design patterns, and implementation guardrails that teams adopt

Evaluate and select technologies, frameworks, and cloud-native patterns with a clear-eyed understanding of trade-offs at Walmart's operational scale

Author and review RFCs and architecture decision records (ADRs) that become the technical canon for the platform

Hands-On Engineering

Write production-grade code and not prototypes or proof-of-concepts, test and deploy them to production

Solve complex problems considering performance, reliability and scalability

Prototype new solutions rapidly using Al-augmented development workflows and then drive them to production quality

Conduct deep-dive code reviews that raise the technical bar of the team. 

Own the full software development lifecycle for your initiatives involving design, development, testing, deployment, observability

Complex Problem Solving

Solve the hardest and complex problems and enable the team while doing so

Lead technical investigations for P0/P1 incidents affecting platform services; own the root cause analysis and define permanent fixes

Challenge technical assumptions early in the design process before they become expensive production mistakes

Navigate ambiguity with confidence by breaking down underspecified problems into structured technical approaches and drive alignment across stakeholders

Platform Reliability & Operational Excellence

Design for resilience from first principles. Define and own the platform's non-functional requirements

Instrument systems to be deeply observable and use the signals to drive continuous improvement

Build runbooks and operational playbooks that enable the broader team to operate the services confidently

Al & Innovation

This role is Al-forward by design and needs someone who actively shapes how it is used and pushes the frontier of what Al-augmented engineering looks like at scale. 

Day-to-Day Al Fluency

Proficient with GitHub Copilot, Wibey, and LLM-based tooling as active, daily parts of your development workflow

Use Al to compress every phase of the engineering loop: schema design validation, code generation and review, test coverage acceleration, documentation, drafting, incident root-cause analysis, and API design feedback

Identify where Al can replace toil, then build the automation yourself

Al-Native Platform Thinking

Architect and build Al-native capabilities like intelligent API health monitoring, Al-assisted seller onboarding flows, smart alerting and anomaly detection

Evaluate and integrate Al/ML capabilities into services where they create measurable seller value

Stay current on the fast-moving AI tooling landscape and bring high-signal, opinionated recommendations to the team

Al Advocacy & Enablement

Model Al-augmented engineering practices for the team through live demos, pairing sessions, and written guides

Work with engineering leadership to identify and prioritize investments where Al creates the most leverage across teams

Contribute to the broader Walmart engineering community's understanding of how to build and operate Al-augmented systems responsibly

What You'll Bring

Distinguished Engineers at Walmart lead through technical gravity. Your impact multiplies across teams. 

Raise the floor - your code reviews, design feedback, and written standards lift the quality of every engineer in the team

When a team is stuck on a systems design challenge or a production crisis, you are the person who helps unblock

Your architectural decisions today shape the technical capabilities and codebase for the future

Grow technical depth across the org through tech talks, design reviews, RFCs, and hands-on pairing, you are a force multiplier for technical growth across Growth Tech

Bridge platform and product translate complex technical constraints into clear trade-offs that inform product decisions; translate product ambitions into technically sound, phased engineering strategies

Pioneer Al adoption - model what Al-augmented engineering looks like at the Distinguished level and create the patterns, playbooks, and tooling that the broader team follows

• Build and operate services - Design, ship, and run Node. js/TypeScript services that sit behind the GraphQL federation. Own a slice of the ~40-service estate end-to-end: API design, schema, persistence, tests, deployment, on-call. 

• GraphQL federation subgraphs - Add types, resolvers, and capabilities to the federated Platform API. Keep subgraph boundaries clean; respect RBAC at the federation enforcement layer. 

• Commerce backbone - Build the subscription, invoicing, overage, dispute, and payout flows that integrate with Stripe and PayPal webhooks and the billing state machine. Make sure metering, billing, and payouts stay accurate, auditable, and replayable. 

• Proxy control plane - Build the management APIs and background workers that configure the runtime proxy: API keys, plans, rate-limit policies, quota caches, abuse signals. 

• Event-driven systems - Produce and consume Kafka and Kinesis events safely: schema evolution, idempotency, retries, dead-letter handling. Operate Lambda consumers where they're the right tool. 

• Data services - Help own the Node. js Analytics Service and Quota Service that front ClickHouse and Snowflake. Keep latency low, queries cheap, and authorisation correct. 

• Performance and reliability - Diagnose hot paths, tune queries, add caches where they matter, and remove caches that have become liabilities. Write the SLOs and the alerts that defend them. 

• Security isolation - Implement OAuth2 / JWT / mTLS where they belong; respect least-privilege; design APIs that fail closed. 

• On-call and incident response - Take part in the rotation. Lead investigations across services when something rooted in your area breaks. 

• LLM-assisted engineering - Use LLM-based coding and agentic tooling to evolve how features are designed, reviewed, and tested. 

What Success Looks Like

• Services you own meet their SLOs, deploy multiple times a day, and rarely wake anyone up. 

• Billing, subscription, overage, and payout flows you ship are accurate to the cent, replayable, and trusted by both providers and consumers. 

• GraphQL subgraphs you maintain stay fast, well-typed, and pleasant to extend. 

• Event pipelines you produce and consume are idempotent, observable, and survive replay and back-pressure. 

• The first generation of agent-native primitives you help build land in production and start carrying real agent traffic. 

What You Bring

• 5-8 years of backend engineering experience, with non-trivial work on production services that real customers depended on. 

• Strong TypeScript / Node. js in a production service environment; comfort with async patterns, streams, and back-pressure. 

• Solid API design - REST and GraphQL (ideally federation: Apollo Federation, Mercurius, or similar). Schema design, persisted queries, performance tuning. 

• Production fluency with SQL - MySQL and/or Postgres. Bonus for Redis or ClickHouse. 

• Experience with event-driven systems - Kafka or similar. You understand idempotency, exactly-once myths, and consumer lag. 

• Hands-on AWS (EKS, MSK, Kinesis, DynamoDB, Lambda, DMS) and Kubernetes. Comfortable reading and writing Terraform. 

• Modern engineering practice: observability, feature flags, CI/CD, and safe rollouts. 

• Care for correctness on the money path - you have shipped billing, metering, or payment code before and have the scars to show for it. 

• Bonus: experience with API gateways, rate limiting, quota enforcement, usage metering, agent protocols (MCP, A2A, x402), or LLM-based developer tooling. 

• You write small, reviewable PRs. You add the test before you fix the bug. You would rather ship a smaller thing well than a bigger thing badly.

data.title: Platform Engineer
data.description:
Job Description: Platform Engineer Relius / Oracle

Experience: Senior-level experience in Oracle DBA, PL/SQL, and production support

Platform: FIS Relius Administration

Cloud: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)

Database: Oracle 12c / 19c

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Platform Engineer Relius / Oracle to take end-to-end ownership of the FIS Relius Administration platform and its underlying Oracle database environment hosted on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). 

This role combines Oracle database administration, PL/SQL development, release management, application support, and production troubleshooting. The ideal candidate will act as a bridge between development and production, ensuring that database changes, releases, and corrective scripts are reviewed, tested, and deployed safely. 

The candidate should have strong hands-on Oracle DBA experience, the ability to debug complex legacy systems, and experience supporting production applications in regulated financial environments. 

Key Responsibilities 1. Relius Platform Administration

- Manage and maintain Relius environments across Development, UAT, and Production. 
 - Handle Relius upgrades, service packs, environment refreshes, configuration changes, and capacity management. 
 - Monitor database storage, tablespaces, audit logs, and platform health. 
 - Manage FIS support tickets and coordinate with external vendors and internal infrastructure teams. 
 - Perform application and web-tier health checks, service restarts, and deployment-related validations. 

2. Oracle Database Administration

- Administer and maintain Oracle 12c/19c databases in production environments. 
 - Perform Oracle database patching, upgrades, backup, recovery, and environment refresh activities. 
 - Manage database performance tuning, query optimization, long-running SQL, and stored procedure performance. 
 - Monitor database capacity, storage utilization, availability, and operational health. 
 - Manage database access, user provisioning, privileges, access reviews, and revocation. 
 - Support Oracle database operations on OCI; AWS or Azure database operations experience is also acceptable. 

3. PL/SQL Development and Code Review

- Develop, review, troubleshoot, and maintain PL/SQL scripts, stored procedures, functions, packages, and triggers. 
 - Review SQL/PL/SQL scripts developed by application teams before deployment to UAT and Production. 
 - Develop safe corrective scripts for production data issues and application integrations. 
 - Analyze legacy database schemas and troubleshoot data inconsistencies. 
 - Ensure database changes follow established coding standards, testing procedures, audit requirements, and change-control policies. 

4. Release and Deployment Management

- Execute scheduled releases, application updates, database deployments, and emergency hotfixes. 
 - Validate deployment readiness, database scripts, dependencies, and rollback procedures. 
 - Coordinate with development, QA, infrastructure, and database service providers. 
 - Maintain deployment records, change documentation, and release updates in Jira. 
 - Improve deployment processes to ensure repeatability, reliability, and auditability. 

5. Production Support and Troubleshooting

- Act as the primary escalation point for Relius/Oracle production incidents. 
 - Investigate transaction-processing failures, report and statement generation issues, data anomalies, and inbound/outbound file-feed failures. 
 - Perform root-cause analysis across application and database layers. 
 - Diagnose complex production issues using SQL queries, logs, database monitoring, and application-level troubleshooting. 
 - Implement corrective actions while protecting data integrity and minimizing production risk. 
 - Provide timely incident updates and coordinate resolution with vendors and technical teams. 

6. Data Integration and Monitoring

- Support Oracle data extraction, replication, and integration with downstream systems and data lakes. 
 - Work with Change Data Capture (CDC) and replication technologies where applicable. 
 - Monitor database and application health, server/event logs, alerts, and operational metrics. 
 - Support integrations with custodians, financial advisors, and other external systems. 
 - Use AI-assisted development and troubleshooting tools as part of daily engineering activities. 

Mandatory Skills And Experience

- Strong, hands-on Oracle DBA experience with Oracle 12c/19c in production environments. 
 - Expertise in Oracle database patching, backup and recovery, database refreshes, performance tuning, and capacity management. 
 - Strong PL/SQL development and debugging skills, including stored procedures, packages, functions, and corrective scripts. 
 - Experience troubleshooting legacy applications and complex database schemas. 
 - Experience handling production incidents, root-cause analysis, release deployments, and change management. 
 - Experience working with cloud-hosted databases; OCI is strongly preferred, with AWS or Azure database operations also considered. 
 - Ability to review database scripts and execute controlled changes against critical production data. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including incident reporting, vendor coordination, and cross-team collaboration. 
 - Practical, regular use of AI-assisted development tools. 

Good to Have

- Hands-on experience with FIS Relius Administration, including its database schema, service packs, and environment management. 
 - Experience in retirement administration, recordkeeping, banking, financial services, or other regulated environments. 
 - Knowledge of retirement plan and participant data, contributions, distributions, loans, and financial transactions. 
 - Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server. 
 - Experience with CDC, database replication, and data lake integration using Databricks or similar platforms. 
 - Experience with database migration, modernization, and re-platforming initiatives.

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

data.title: Head Technology & Innovation
data.description:
Huntsman Corporation is now looking for a dynamic individual as a Head Technology & Innovation. The main objective is to develop new products and new technology platforms for the Indian market. This is done by managing technical resources (people, equipment, facilities, FC and intellectual property) within the Technology & Innovation team. 

The EAIME business requires a dedicated team to develop, validate and support commercialization of new products and applications to drive differentiated growth through a world class innovation pipeline into existing as well as new market spaces to enhance the business portfolio. These resources are managed centrally for maximizing impact through a disciplined approach to project work, risk management as well as leverage and build new technical capabilities within the regional business. Close collaboration with the rest of the organisation is key for success. 

The Platform Manager must be able to effectively deal with the Marketing and Commercial team decision makers as well as work with a number of external partners. Furthermore, the incumbent must work across a wide range of internal personnel in a manner which builds trust, buy-in and understanding. The incumbent must be able to positively influence all the relationships mentioned above and be able to help define, articulate and communicate the value of the project portfolio. 

The level of interactions include higher level strategic, tactical and short- and long-term projects (3+ years). 

Major challenge for this position includes the ability to manage a complex portfolio of Product Innovation projects with a potential of high impact to the business, some results of the decisions taken will only be visible 3 years later or more. 

Project portfolio management includes allocating appropriate resource levels based on potential value creation for the business and providing strong technical expertise to deliver the project efficiently. 

The incumbent will have to be open minded to manage a complex portfolio of high impact projects and develop the skills and competences in the team to deliver those projects. 

Another challenge is to implement a strong project management culture in his/her organisation to ensure most efficient resource utilisation and decision taking. 

The expectation is that an interdependent, collaborative and team-oriented approach will be undertaken. 

This position will be based in Mumbai, India. 

As a Head Technology & Innovation, You Will

Ensure that all activities are conducted to the highest standards of Safety, Health and Corporate Compliance and that the team behavior demonstrates a commitment to safety culture. 

To efficiently manage and drive a portfolio of product development projects for maximum impact and to ensure full alignment to the regional business strategy. Projects can be related to exploring applications and markets. 

To manage and develop the team to improve the delivery of product innovation projects and maximizes value creation for the business. 

To ensure a good connection with platform managers in Tienen and other regions to allow efficient localization of established technologies, taking into account local raw materials and market needs. 

To support the innovation director in defining and delivering the EAIME vision and strategic trusts. 

To manage a seamless integration/collaboration with the other groups of the EAIME organisation as well as Global Research to ensure most efficient project delivery. 

Foster an open and collaborative culture to ensure most efficient use of resources, knowhow and expertise available in the organisation. 

To be an active member of the IMT (India Management Team)

What skills and experiences are we looking for?

The ideal candidate should have a Master in a technical discipline preferably in a chemical related field and have extensive managerial and applications experience. 

He/she should have 15-20 yrs experience in the company or 10yrs in the Polyurethane industry

The candidate should have an in-depth knowledge of how polyurethane works and the processing/applications benefits that can be achieved in existing as well as in potential new application and markets. 

The candidate must have proven managerial skills and ability to take far reaching decisions and influence situations at senior level. 

The candidate must have the ability to manage a diverse project portfolio as well as be able to set priorities in a complex environment. 

Ideally the candidate, in addition to the education above should have 15+ years technical development experience with a track record of project delivery, people management and organisational development. 

In lieu of the education noted above the candidate could qualify if (s)he possessed 15+ years experience in advanced polyurethane product and application environment. 

The incumbent, due to his/her experience, must be able to focus on strategic issues without compromising potential tactical choices. 

What can we offer?

Huntsman offers unsurpassed opportunities to build a successful future. We are a global specialty chemical company with locations in 25 countries around the world, employing over 6, 000 associates. Our diverse portfolio creates a range of career fields including manufacturing, research and development, technical services, sales and marketing, customer service - and the list goes on. 

Here, you can make an impact and make a difference. Come join us. 

Huntsman is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We provide equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all qualified applicants for employment, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, gender identification, sexual orientation and/or expression or any other characteristic protected by law in every location in which we have facilities national or local. 

Please refer to https: //www. huntsman. com/privacy/online-privacy-notice for Company's Data Privacy and Protection information. 

All unsolicited resumes presented by recruitment agencies are treated as pro bono information or service. 

Huntsman is aware of a scam involving fraudulent job offers. Huntsman does not make job offers until after a candidate has submitted a job application and has participated in a face-to-face interview. Please be advised that emails from Huntsman always end in "@huntsman. com" and that any job offer that requires payment or requires you to deposit a check is likely a scam. If you have questions about any open positions at Huntsman, please visit our Careers website at

http: //www. huntsman. com/corporate/a/Careers.
